items.desc: About Us Every business needs to know who they’re really working with whether it’s suppliers, investors, partners, or third parties. At Xapien, we’re reinventing how organisations do that, combining speed, scale and accuracy with cutting-edge AI. Since 2018, we’ve grown from a deep-tech startup to a global player in AI-driven due diligence and risk intelligence. 2024 was a landmark year as we closed a $10M Series A, earned recognition in the Chartis RiskTech100® and Everest Group’s Leading 50™, and expanded our products, markets and customer base. 2025 was even bigger: With new regulations, rising compliance pressure and growing reputation risks, organisations everywhere are demanding smarter, faster ways to work and they’re turning to us. Customers worldwide from global law firms and private banks to universities and nonprofits rely on Xapien to turn days of manual research into trusted insights, delivered in minutes. Our momentum so far Customers in a diverse range of industries, with particular growth in wealth management, financial services and supply chain onboarding. Demand accelerating beyond our UK headquarters, across multiple continents with new customers in the Middle East, Asia, and Oceania. Why this is an exciting time to join This isn’t just another job role; it’s an opportunity to shape the future of the due diligence industry with a market-leading product trusted by global organisations. Whether you’re in marketing, communications, sales, or finance, you’ll play a critical role in driving growth, building credibility, and defining how we connect our product to a rapidly evolving market. We’re scaling fast with more customers, more releases, and bigger regulatory and market challenges. Expectations are rising, due diligence now means real-time insight, delivered efficiently and with impact. You won’t just be executing campaigns, closing deals, or managing numbers, you’ll be influencing strategy, optimising processes, and helping position a brand that’s setting the new standard for trust and transparency. For people who love learning, innovating, and making an impact that matters now is the moment to be a part of Xapien. The Role We are looking for a detail-focussed Applied Research Engineer to help us develop the next generation of the algorithms at the heart of our system. Our product is experiencing tremendous growth, and we need to ensure that we continue to deliver accurate insights in a rapidly changing landscape. This role requires someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment where continuous innovation and refinement are key. You will be working closely with our product team to ensure our algorithms and models capture their domain knowledge and expertise appropriately. This is an ideal opportunity for someone looking to kick-start a career in AI. Core responsibilities: Designing, building, and testing AI-powered experiments working with leading-edge ML models. Building and deploying AI-powered microservices following standard design patterns. Implementing infrastructure as code using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation to automate deployment and scaling processes. Statistical evaluation of candidate systems against functional and non-functional requirements, optimising for performance and cost-efficiency. Collaborating with our wider engineering team Demonstrating a desire to continuously learn & improve You need to have: Being a small company, candidates need to be able to work autonomously, be comfortable without micro-management, be flexible and have initiative to solve problems. A rigorous and scientific approach to problem solving A demonstrable track record for learning and mastering complex topics Keen attention to detail Strong verbal and written communication Demonstrable experience working with Python and good Python knowledge A good understanding of statistics A strong understanding of algorithm optimisation A strong foundation of working with command-line tooling and knowledge of unix What you will gain out of it: We will provide you with support and training in everything you need. This will include background understanding of the risk and compliance sector, our product, development, AWS infrastructure, log analysis and all other related skills. Here’s our promise to you: We are going to work with you - to build a rewarding and fulfilling career with the opportunities, challenges and resources you need to do you your best work. We succeed together- you will own a meaningful part of the business through our employee shares & equity programme. Private health insurance to keep you in tip-top condition. Life Insurance – let's hope nobody ever needs this! Unlimited holidays – yes, it really is uncapped – take the time you need, when you need it. Everyone is learning, developing and challenging themselves so we have a £1k professional development fund per year if you want to learn new skills, even new things outside of work. Most importantly of all, we will work with you, …

Working with leading technologies and exceptional people, you will deliver meaningful change for high profile local and international clients. You will help shape the future of digital transformation within a people first culture that is collaborative, innovative and welcoming. At Deloitte, the world’s number one professional services firm, you will tackle complex challenges in an environment where number one never stops challenging. We offer a competitive starting salary of €53,000.00 for this role, with salary adjustments reflecting your experience level and expertise. . We are seeking talented AI Engineer(s) to join our AI Scaling and Transformation team, a centre of excellence within Deloitte's Engineering, AI & Data service offering. You will be working alongside world-class technologists and leading organisations across industries to design, build, and deploy cutting-edge AI and Generative AI solutions that solve real-world challenges and unlock measurable business value. This is a hands-on, impact-driven role where you'll combine deep technical expertise with collaborative problem-solving to deliver robust, production-grade AI solutions that drive tangible client outcomes. Key Skills And Prior Experience AI/ML Development Expertise: Proven track record designing, developing, and deploying production-grade AI and machine learning solutions in business or research environments, with hands-on experience in data pipelines, model training, and end-to-end ML workflows. Cloud & MLOps Proficiency: Solid experience deploying AI solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), implementing MLOps practices (CI/CD, model versioning, monitoring), and optimising models for scalability and efficiency in production. Generative AI & Advanced Techniques: Demonstrated expertise building and deploying GenAI solutions, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Gemini), and familiarity with deep learning, NLP, computer vision, or reinforcement learning. Cross-functional Collaboration: Strong ability to work within multidisciplinary teams, communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and influence outcomes through clear technical reasoning and client partnership. What type of work will I be doing? Design & Develop AI Solutions: Partner with client stakeholders and Deloitte leadership to understand complex business challenges and architect data and AI solutions that address their needs, ensuring alignment with best practices and regulatory requirements. Build & Optimise ML Infrastructure: Design and implement machine learning pipelines and infrastructure capable of handling large datasets and distributed computing, leveraging tools such as Hadoop or Spark. Deploy & Operationalise AI Systems: Take ownership of integrating AI models into production systems, ensuring scalability, efficiency, seamless integration with existing applications, and compliance with security and regulatory standards. Research & Apply Emerging Technologies: Stay ahead of the curve by researching, assessing, and applying emerging AI frameworks, tools, and technologies to enhance solution effectiveness and drive continuous improvement. Ensure Responsible AI Practices: Champion ethical and responsible AI implementation, including model interpretability, fairness, bias mitigation, and compliance with relevant regulations and governance frameworks. Contribute to Technical Excellence: Share knowledge and best practices with peers, stay current with emerging AI technologies, and contribute to continuous improvement of delivery approaches and solution quality. Communicate & Influence: Translate complex AI and GenAI concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences, adapting your communication style to suit technical and business stakeholders. Optimise for Production: Continuously monitor, evaluate, and optimise deployed AI models for performance, cost-efficiency, and alignment with evolving business objectives. Who is the Hiring Manager? items.desc: Kan du forklare attention på en serviet, træne en transformer fra bunden, og bygge de evals, der afslører, om den faktisk virker? Og vil du bruge dine evner på noget, der virkelig betyder noget? Så har vi en mission, adgang til Danmarks nationale AI-supercomputer, og en plads til dig, uanset om du lige har afleveret specialet eller har nogle år på bagen. Om os AI ændrer allerede rammerne for samfund, sikkerhedspolitik, og militær opgaveløsning. Fremtidens kampplads vil i stigende grad være præget af data, autonomi, og hurtigere beslutningsprocesser. Forsvarets AI Center (FAIC) er etableret som ny enhed i Forsvarskommandoen for at sikre, at AI omsættes til reel dansk og allieret forsvarsevne. FAIC sætter retning på Forsvarets brug af AI - fra doktrin til operationel virkelighed. Vi opbygger institutionel kompetence, indgår partnerskaber med NATO, allierede, akademia, og industri, og definerer de operative behov og principper som Forsvarets AI-løsninger udvikles og anskaffes ud fra - i tæt samarbejde med Forsvarets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI), så anskaffelser og leverancer tager udgangspunkt i soldaternes behov og Forsvarets kerneopgave. Vores samarbejde med Gefion, Danmarks nationale AI-supercomputer, viser arbejdsformen: åbne miljøer giver læring og tempo, mens lukkede rammer sikrer militær anvendelse hvor sikkerhed, klassifikation, og operativ relevans er afgørende. FAIC er stedet hvor Forsvarets AI-fremtid formes. Vi søger erfarne profiler der vil være med fra dag ét. Om stillingen Som AI Engineer i Forsvarets AI Center arbejder du med at udvikle, tilpasse og evaluere AI-modeller til Forsvarets operative behov. Du træner og finetuner modeller på Gefion og arbejder med alt fra transformerarkitekturer, attention-mekanismer og optimering til evaluering af modellers præcision, robusthed og sikkerhed. Du udvikler de værktøjer, evalueringsmetoder og sikkerhedsmekanismer, der gør det muligt at vurdere, om en model er klar til operativ anvendelse. items.desc: Company Description Get to know the Team The Data Science (Geo Vision) team focuses on improving maps and building map-based intelligence, including localization, routing, and traffic forecasting. We use Computer Vision, Information Retrieval, and Large Language Models (LLMs) to process diverse signals like images, text, and GPS probes. We are looking for an engineer who excels at building the scalable software foundations that power these advanced models. Job Description The Data Science (Geo Vision) team improves Grab's maps and builds map-based intelligence (localization, routing, travel-time, traffic forecasting) using computer vision and deep learning on images, video, and GPS signals. As a Data Scientist, you'll focus on bringing computer vision models to embedded/edge platforms for map creation. You will be working onsite and reporting to the Head of Data Science based in Cluj. What You'll Work On Help adapt and improve CV models (detection, segmentation, tracking) to run on resource-constrained edge devices. Apply model compression — quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation — to shrink models while preserving accuracy. Profile on-device performance (latency, memory, power) and help build efficient inference pipelines. Support training and evaluation, and use AI agents/tooling within the team's quality guidelines. What you'll gain: hands-on experience taking deep learning models to on-device deployment, plus skills in model optimization and real-time edge performance. Qualifications Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Familiarity with Python and some of: PyTorch/TensorFlow, NumPy, OpenCV, and scikit-learn. Solid ML and deep learning / computer vision fundamentals. Interest in or exposure to embedded systems, edge deployment, or model optimization (quantization, pruning, distillation) — a strong plus. Proficiency in English Additional Information Our Commitment We are committed to building diverse teams and creating an inclusive workplace that enables all Grabbers to perform at their best, regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity sexual orientation, and other attributes that make each Grabber unique.

items.desc: The AI Accelerator is a brand-new, London-based hub, within @computationalinnovation, comprising computational biology, human genetics, data and AI expertise. The purpose of the AI Accelerator is to provision production-quality, versatile, foundational biomedical AI capabilities that can be adapted and deployed to improve and accelerate portfolio decision-making, furthering understanding of the biology driving patient outcomes and identifying mechanisms that increase probability of success. To achieve this purpose, the AI Accelerator is organised around three key capabilities - AI Systems, focussing on neural methods, AI Reasoning, focussing on causality and knowing why, and AI Enablement, powering AI Systems and AI Reasoning with big data provisioning, MLOps and AI infrastructure. AI Systems will exploit neural-based methods to integrate data and impute and infer across the biomedical landscape. It could be electronic health records and medical imaging to support patient segmentation. It could be ‘omics data to understand gene regulation and identify novel therapeutic concepts; it could be predicting transcriptional change for a given disease-causing variant AI Reasoning will supplement AI Systems by focussing on developing approaches to identify cause and effect, predict the outcome of an intervention, provide a rationale for a model decision. It could be providing causal structure to multi-omics data; it could be providing orthogonal rationale to a black-box model generated hypothesis; it could be identifying features that are driving model predictions. AI Enablement will support AI Systems and AI Reasoning by provisioning harmonised multimodal data for distributed training, managing the model lifecycle and partnering with the IT organisation to ensure AI Systems, AI Reasoning and downstream beneficiaries have the necessary infrastructure and tooling to prototype, implement, adapt and deploy AI capabilities to advance the portfolio None of the above can be achieved without people. We are looking for AI scientists, machine learning engineers, research engineers, data engineers, MLOps engineers and AI infrastructure engineers from senior up to senior staff level and people leaders in AI science and engineering. If you are passionate about using your talents to build state-of-the-art AI approaches that will advance the portfolio and skilled in the required disciplines, please register your interest. Apply Now to register interest by joining our AI Accelerator talent pool. Please note that this is a talent community, not a particular recruitment process. There will be no follow up communication on this application. By applying you agree to being contacted by us, should there be a new opening in the future, matching your professional profile and/or interest in a particular position stated by you in your application form. Our Company Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,300 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com. Why Boehringer Ingelheim? With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better. Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed. Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations. Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

items.desc: We are excited to offer this opportunity to a highly motivated Research Associate to join an ambitious new team working in the field of Digital Endocrinology. The successful applicant will conduct original research aimed at translating understanding of endocrine function into precision medicine applications. The research will use data from wearable device technologies to characterise variability in circadian hormone profiles in humans, uncovering fundamental insights about endocrine rhythms that can be used to support the diagnosis and management of endocrine conditions. The position is funded through a UKRI Future Leaders Fellowship awarded to Dr Eder Zavala: “Developing a mathematical and computational framework for digital endocrinology”. The work will build on hormonal time series data collected at unprecedented time resolution in healthy humans and in patients, including studies in real life settings. We are seeking to appoint a creative and enthusiastic individual who will lead on computational data analysis projects that interrogate the mechanisms behind hormonal rhythm misalignment. The research will be closely integrated with mathematical models that predict dynamic responses to perturbations (e.g., stressors, sleep disruptions, diagnostic tests), as well as the long-term changes that occur during disease. A key challenge of your work will be accounting for the variability in hormonal rhythms observed across individuals. To characterise this variability, you will take advantage of unique in its kind datasets and advanced mathematical and computational methods and help develop personalised models. The practical element of your project will be based on, but not limited to, time series analysis, network analysis, Bayesian inference, Machine Learning, as well as computational simulation of mathematical models written in terms of differential equations. In addition to leading their own research projects, the appointed candidate will have the opportunity to contribute to the projects of PhD students in the group, as well as with an international team of collaborators including clinicians, computer scientists, and mathematicians. The team is dynamic and ambitious as well as being welcoming and supportive. The applicant should have high proficiency with scientific computer programming in Python, Julia, R and/or MATLAB, parameter estimation methods and HPC simulations. Experience with dynamical systems theory and mathematical modelling using ODEs and/or DDEs is desirable. The vacancy is for a full-time post available from 1st February 2027 until 31st December 2029. What you will get in return: Fantastic market leading Pension scheme Excellent employee health and wellbeing services including an Employee Assistance Programme Exceptional starting annual leave entitlement, plus bank holidays Additional paid closure over the Christmas period Local and national discounts at a range of major retailers As an equal opportunities employer we welcome applicants from all sections of the community regardless of age, sex, gender (or gender identity), ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation and transgender status. items.desc: Data Scientist Help build the AI and data platform changing how financial advice is delivered. Reporting to - Chief AI Officer Employment - Full time Location - Remote within the UK, with travel for team and customer meetings when required Eden Scott is delighted to be the retained search partner to Afternoon. About Afternoon Afternoon is building the operating system for modern financial advice firms. We are replacing fragmented systems and manual processes with one AI- and data-first platform that helps firms work faster, deliver better advice and serve more clients. At the heart of Afternoon is a genuinely difficult technical problem. We connect investment data from 27 platforms with client records, documents, meetings and communications, then use AI to turn that information into dependable, source-attributed outputs. Firms can prepare for meetings, capture and structure conversations, maintain client records, create complex advice reports and communicate with clients in one connected system. Our growth over the past year has been strong. We are working with a rapidly growing number of advice firms, have a live B2B partnership with a UK bank and are increasingly being recognised across the market. Afternoon won the lang cat's Advicetech Catwalk 2026, voted for by more than 150 advisers, and was named Professional Services Start-up of the Year for Scotland at the UK StartUp Awards. We were also selected for J.P. Morgan's Fintech Forward 2026 programme. We are well capitalised, ambitious and entering an important stage of growth. The team is still small enough for every new hire to shape the product, technical direction and company we become, while solving problems that matter to a large and established industry. The opportunity This is an opportunity to join Afternoon at the point where the product is proven, momentum is building and there is still enormous scope to shape our approach to AI. We are looking for a production-focused data scientist to help Afternoon understand and use information held across documents, conversations, client records and investment platforms. You will work on applied NLP and machine-learning problems where accuracy, evaluation, provenance and usability matter as much as model capability. This is not a research-only role and it is not about producing isolated proofs of concept. You will take problems from exploration and experimentation through to production, working closely with software engineers, product colleagues and financial-advice specialists. You will see customers use what you build and help establish the data-science foundations for the next stage of our growth. The role suits someone who enjoys messy real-world data, asks good questions and wants to build systems that users can rely on. What you will do Build and ship NLP and machine-learning systems for extraction, classification, retrieval, summarisation and structured generation, from first experiment to production. Work with LLMs, smaller task-specific models and deterministic methods, choosing the right approach for each problem rather than defaulting to one model or provider. Pull structured, source-attributed information out of complex financial documents and unstructured text, where every output can be traced back to where it came from. Design the evaluation that makes shipping safe: datasets, metrics and frameworks that surface failure modes in development and catch them in production. Own the pipelines behind the models, covering preparation, experimentation, training or fine-tuning, inference and monitoring, along with the reproducibility and experiment tracking that make results trustworthy. Work directly with engineers, product colleagues, advice specialists and customers: turning their problems into testable hypotheses, integrating models into product workflows through reliable APIs, and explaining plainly what works, what does not and why. What we are looking for Strong Python, and production code other people have had to maintain. NLP or machine-learning systems you have taken to production yourself, in some combination of transformers, classifiers, LLMs, named-entity recognition, embeddings and retrieval, built on pre-trained models and open-source tooling rather than from scratch. Evaluation you have designed rather than inherited, and a view on the trade-offs between model quality, latency, cost and maintainability. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system. We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber. We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers. As data centres become one of the largest and fastest-growing sources of electricity demand, Fuse is expanding into high-performance compute infrastructure at the intersection of energy and AI. items.desc: Job Description Overview As a Research Engineer, you are expected to contribute to cutting-edge projects that advance both applied and theoretical aspects of AI. This role is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building practical systems from research ideas, thrive in a collaborative environment, and are committed to supporting impactful research through technical excellence. Our team operates in two main directions: Applying AI to the design and optimization of semiconductors Conducting fundamental research that supports both our applications and the broader sci-entific community Current areas of interest include large language models (LLMs), optimization methods for deep learning, reinforcement learning (RL), and generative models. Key Responsibilities Implement and test research ideas in machine learning and artificial intelligence Build prototypes and support experiments for team and company projects Collaborate with researchers to translate theoretical models into practical systems Maintain and improve research infrastructure, tools, and workflows Assist in preparing technical documentation and reports Stay up to date with the latest advancements in AI and related fields Main Requirements and Qualifications Qualifications & Expectations Required: Experience implementing machine learning algorithms and techniques Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or similar Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work both independently and collaboratively Good communication skills, with the ability to document and explain technical work clearly Preferred: Experience with optimization, reinforcement learning, and/or large language models (LLMs) Familiarity with deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX) Experience building and maintaining research infrastructure or tools Exposure to chip design or applied AI research Ongoing Development Employees are encouraged to continue developing their technical skills, seek out new learning opportunities, and actively contribute to the team’s goals. Regular feedback, mentorship, and support will be provided to help you achieve your professional objectives and grow as a research engineer. Competitive Package Available Closing Date - 26-Oct-2026

items.desc: Structure d'accueil The Curie Institute Research Center France’s leading cancer research and treatment centre, Institut Curie unites a renowned research centre and a specialist hospital, fostering close collaboration between scientists, clinicians and healthcare professionals. It offers an environment of excellence where expertise comes together around shared values: care, humanity, openness, collaboration, efficiency, innovation, solidarity and commitment. Missions Activités principales Laboratory The RACER (Rare Cancers Exploration and Research) team, led by Dr. Sarah Watson within the Chemical Biology of Cancers Unit (INSERM U1339, CNRS UMR366) , conducts translational research focused on rare cancers, particularly cancers of unknown primary (CUP) and soft tissue sarcomas . The team integrates genomic and transcriptomic approaches, including single-cell analyses, with innovative preclinical models and direct access to patient cohorts and biological samples from Institut Curie . This position aims to support and expand the team's preclinical modeling activities, including cell lines, 3D cultures, organoids, and PDX . These models are central to therapeutic target validation and drug screening projects in sarcoma research. The successful candidate will work under the direct supervision of Dr. Watson and interact closely with researchers and technological platforms at Institut Curie. Missions Development and Characterization of Models Establish and characterize sarcoma-derived cell lines, organoids, and PDX models from patient samples Develop and optimize 3D culture systems and co-cultures with stromal or immune cells Contribute to the maintenance, monitoring, and annotation of models and associated biobanks Perform functional assays, including viability, dose-response, and drug screening studies Molecular and Cellular Characterization Extract nucleic acids and proteins and perform quality assessment Prepare sequencing samples and/or libraries and liaise with sequencing platforms Conduct standard molecular and cellular biology techniques, including RT-qPCR, Western blotting, flow cytometry, immunofluorescence, and immunohistochemistry Perform genetic engineering using transfection, lentiviral transduction, and CRISPR/Cas9 Contribute to quality control and preliminary data analysis Laboratory Organization and Scientific Contributions Ensure experimental traceability, data management, and regulatory compliance Participate in laboratory operations, including inventory management, purchasing, and equipment maintenance Train and support students and new team members in cell culture and preclinical modeling techniques Present research findings and contribute to publications, grant reports, and regulatory documentation Constraints and risks Work in a Biosafety Level 2 (BSL-2) laboratory handling human samples Occasional schedule flexibility required to accommodate cell culture experiments, in vivo studies, and receipt of clinical specimens. Profil du candidat Savoirs et compétences attendus Training And Experience Required Education and qualifications: Professional Bachelor's degree or University Bachelor of Technology (BUT) in Biology, Biotechnology, or Biological Sciences for an Assistant Research Engineer position; Master's degree (MSc) or Engineering degree in Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, Oncology, or Biotechnology for a Research Engineer position. Professional experience: 2 to 5 years of experience with a focus on the development of cellular and/or animal models in oncology. Certifications in laboratory animal science (designer or operator level) and authorization to work with Class 2 genetically modified organisms (GMOs) is an asset. Required expertise: Hands-on experience with established and primary cell culture, 3D culture systems and organoids, molecular biology techniques and NGS library preparation, cellular imaging, and flow cytometry. A solid understanding of tumor biology is expected. Experience with sarcomas or other mesenchymal tumors would be advantageous but is not required. Skills Required Language skills: Fluent French and scientific English Computing skills: Proficiency with standard office software, electronic laboratory notebooks (ELNs), and data analysis/quantification tools such as GraphPad Prism, FlowJo, and ImageJ/Fiji. Basic knowledge of R or Python for the exploration and analysis of sequencing data would be an asset. Personal skills: Strong experimental rigor and attention to traceability, ability to work independently and manage experiments autonomously, strong organizational skills with the capacity to handle multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines, enthusiasm for multidisciplinary teamwork involving clinicians, biologists, and bioinformaticians. Ons platform wordt nu in een pilot getest door universiteiten, hogescholen, mbo’s, umc’s en onderzoeksinstellingen. Bouw jij met ons mee aan de AI van morgen? Hier ga je werken SURF is de ict-coöperatie van Nederlandse onderwijs- en onderzoeksinstellingen. Samen ontwikkelen we digitale diensten en werken we aan complexe innovatievraagstukken die de kwaliteit van onderwijs en onderzoek verbeteren. We doen dit samen met de instellingen, met oog voor publieke waarden, en zoveel mogelijk open en open source. Je krijgt ruimte om architectuurkeuzes te maken, nieuwe technologieën te onderzoeken en proofs of concept door te ontwikkelen tot productieklare oplossingen. Verder werk je met vraagstukken rond cloudarchitectuur, schaalbaarheid, security, data-integriteit en AI-ethiek. Zo draag je direct bij aan een infrastructuur die het Nederlandse onderwijs toekomstbestendig maakt. Wie bij SURF werkt, werkt bij een unieke en open organisatie. Dat merk je aan alles: de structuur van de organisatie, de opzet van de projectteams, de cultuur op onze kantoren en de onderlinge sfeer. SURF biedt uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en gaat flexibel om met de werk/privé-balans. Medewerkers werken graag zelfstandig. Daarnaast krijgt iedereen de ruimte en de vrijheid om talenten zo goed en breed mogelijk in te zetten en te ontwikkelen. In dit team kom je terecht Je komt terecht in het High Performance Machine Learning Team (HPML) binnen de afdeling Advanced Solutions for Research van SURF. Het HPML-team is verantwoordelijk voor tal van activiteiten, zoals de ontwikkeling van de Nederlandse AI-Fabriek, het trainen van grote taalmodellen, de integratie van AI in grootschalige simulaties en de opzet van onze AI-Hub. Het team werkt vaak samen met onderzoekers om nieuwe AI-oplossingen te ontwikkelen en onze rekeninfrastructuur optimaal te benutten. Dit ga je doen Als Python Software Engineer werk je op het snijvlak van software development, DevOps en systeembeheer. Je ontwikkelt in Python en werkt tegelijkertijd aan het verbeteren en automatiseren van developer workflows, deployments en test pipelines. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om zelf technische keuzes te maken en nieuwe technologie aan de stack toe te voegen. Je werkt in een omgeving waarin niet alles vooraf tot in detail is uitgewerkt. Juist daarom is je nieuwsgierigheid belangrijk: je zoekt zelf uit wat nodig is, stelt vragen wanneer dat nodig is en werkt samen met je teamleden om tot de beste oplossing te komen. Je hoeft daarbij niet alle onderdelen van onze stack al te kennen. Waar je je verder mee bezighoudt Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt software in Python; Je verbetert en automatiseert developer workflows, deployment en test pipelines; Je werkt met Docker en Docker Compose en draagt bij aan de overstap naar Kubernetes; Je onderzoekt nieuwe technologie”en en bepaalt samen met het team hoe deze binnen onze stack kunnen worden toegepast; Je helpt requirements te verhelderen en vertaalt deze samen met het team naar technische oplossingen; Je werkt zelfstandig aan complexe vraagstukken en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit en continuïteit van je oplossingen. Dit breng je mee Je bent een ervaren software engineer met een sterke Python-basis en ruime ervaring met development, testen en DevOps. Je werkt graag zelfstandig, bent technisch nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken uit te zoeken. Je hebt oog voor kwaliteit en security en voelt je prettig in een technische omgeving waarin Engels de voertaal is. Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring als software developer; Ruime ervaring met CI/CD-pipelines, bij voorkeur met Git en GitLab; Ervaring met het opzetten en beheren van Docker-omgevingen; Ruimte ervaring met unit-, integratie- en end-to-endtests; Ervaring met PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy en databasemigraties Ervaring met Linux-commandline Ervarign met security-by-designprincipes; Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal. Het is een voordeel als je: Ervaring hebt met software in productieomgevingen; Ervaring hebt met Apptainer Ervarign met REST- en streaming-API’s; Ervaring met de integratie van AI in applicaties; Ervaring met Slurm/clustercomputes; Ervaring met Kafka of een vergelijkbare technologie. Voorafgaand aan indiensttreding geldt voor deze functie dat een VOG moet worden overlegd . Bij SURF doen we onze werving met veel plezier zelf, acquisitie stellen we daarom niet op prijs. As a Medior Cloud Ops / Platform Engineer you make daily impact by enabling our news media, magazines, online services, radio and TV through cutting-edge AI infrastructure. Do you want to develop yourself further ? Read on. What will you do? You take ownership of the cloud operations powering DPG Media’s GenAI Platform. You deploy AI services across managed Kubernetes, manage infrastructure spanning AWS, Azure and GCP, secure credentials and integrations, and build reliable CI/CD pipelines. Without you, our AI platform cannot scale or run reliably. You grow into LLMOps — the practice of deploying, serving and monitoring large language models in production — supported by a tech lead with hands‑on experience in this space. You achieve this by: Deploying workloads on managed Kubernetes today, and potentially dedicated GPU‑accelerated clusters tomorrow. Managing infrastructure‑as‑code (Terraform) across multiple cloud providers. Ensuring security through secrets management, credential rotation and best practices. Designing CI/CD automation and Git workflows for the team. Monitoring, observing and documenting platform operations. Who are we? We are the GenAI & Innovation department at DPG Media. We build the operational foundation for enterprise AI model serving, enabling the organisation’s AI capabilities to reach millions of users through our trusted media brands. What makes you the ideal candidate? For this role we seek a driven cloud and infrastructure professional. You are optimistic, involved, focused and collaborative. You bring: 4 + years experience in a similar role Experience deploying and operating applications on Kubernetes (CKAD level). Hands‑on expertise with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure or GCP). Infrastructure‑as‑code skills, preferably Terraform. Strong security practices around secrets and credentials. Skills in Python for automation, Git workflows and CI/CD design. Nice to have: GPU workload management (NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins). Model serving infrastructure (vLLM, SageMaker or equivalent). Multi‑cloud networking and identity federation. OpenTelemetry / distributed tracing. At DPG Media we welcome all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we invite you to apply for this position. Differences between colleagues lead to surprising insights and innovative solutions — qualities that fit our organisation perfectly. We look forward to discovering who you are and which skills and experience you bring. What do we offer? At DPG Media you gain an inspiring environment that is continually evolving. Colleagues who think in opportunities, see the glass half full, and give you room to grow daily — supported by our DPG Academy. This enables you to bring out the best in yourself and be a true media maker. A salary matching your experience A 36‑hour working week 8% holiday allowance and 4% personal choice budget Annual profit‑sharing based on DPG Media’s results Space to develop yourself on the job and online via our DPG Academy / DPG Campus Flexibility to align your own cultural holidays A great new office in Amsterdam (Mediavaert) with (spontaneous) drinks, team events and our legendary staff party — you will feel at home immediately. If you are, we will call you to schedule an appointment at our office in Amsterdam. Want to know more? Contact leonie.lugtenberg@dpgmedia.nl

items.desc: CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. We operate at the intersection of advanced cloud infrastructure and applied data science, transforming how complex industrial products - such as automotive systems, aircraft, and advanced batteries - are conceived, tested, and developed. Strong programming skills in Python, with practical experience using scientific computing and ML libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. Experience contributing to the deployment or support of ML systems, or a good understanding of how models move from experimentation into production, including cloud-based environments. Strong grounding in statistical modelling, machine learning experimentation, and evaluation. Experience working with time-series, high-dimensional, or imperfect real-world datasets. Strong technical curiosity and a habit of keeping up with current ML and AI research. Comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering, product, and customer-facing teams, and able to explain technical decisions clearly to different audiences. Preferred: (if applicable) Background in engineering, physics, chemistry, or another STEM discipline connected to complex physical systems. Experience with anomaly detection, optimisation, reliability-focused modelling, or related approaches in industrial settings. Experience building or experimenting with agents or autonomous systems. Familiarity with MLOps, model monitoring, and efficient compute practices. Experience working with sparse, noisy, or imperfect real-world data from labs, heavy industry, or other applied environments. Track record of collaborating closely with deployed or client-facing teams to bring advanced methods into operational use. Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams - even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Expect the unexpected.

Strong engineering skills, comfortable diving into complex ML codebases and distributed systems. Experience improving model behavior through data, reward modeling, or RL techniques. Evidence of owning ambitious research or engineering agendas that led to measurable model improvements. items.desc: Applied Scientists, Data Scientists & Machine Learning Researchers. Remote AI Project We are seeking experienced Applied Scientists, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Researchers, and Quantitative Professionals to contribute to a remote AI project focused on advanced analytics, experimentation, statistical modeling, and machine learning. You will analyze complex datasets, develop and evaluate machine learning models, design experiments, review AI-generated quantitative work, and create rigorous prompts, datasets, and reference solutions. What You’ll Do Design and execute statistical analyses to identify meaningful patterns, relationships, and actionable insights from complex datasets. Develop, train, tune, and validate machine learning models for practical business or research problems. Perform large-scale data transformation, feature engineering, cleaning, and analysis using Python and Pandas. Design experimentation frameworks and evaluate experimental outcomes using appropriate statistical methods. Identify flawed methodology, incorrect assumptions, statistical errors, data leakage, and weak quantitative conclusions. Create expert-level prompts, datasets, analytical problems, and reference solutions. Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics, validation strategies, and robustness checks. Document analytical methodology, results, limitations, and recommendations clearly. Deliver reproducible code, notebooks, and well-organized analytical reports. Review peer contributions and provide technically rigorous feedback. Who Can Apply Relevant backgrounds include Applied Scientists, Data Scientists, Senior Data Scientists, Research Data Scientists, and Analytics Scientists. We also welcome Machine Learning Scientists, Machine Learning Researchers, Applied Machine Learning Scientists, and ML Engineers with strong statistical foundations. Quantitative backgrounds may include Quantitative Analysts, Quantitative Researchers, Decision Scientists, and Computational Researchers. Statistics backgrounds may include Statisticians, Applied Statisticians, Statistical Scientists, Biostatisticians, and Statistical Modeling Specialists. Experimentation backgrounds may include Experimentation Scientists, Product Data Scientists, Causal Inference Specialists, A/B Testing Specialists, and Measurement Scientists. Research backgrounds may include Research Scientists, Applied Researchers, Operations Research Scientists, Econometricians, and Computational Social Scientists. Additional relevant backgrounds include Data Analysts with advanced modeling experience, Risk Modelers, Forecasting Scientists, Recommendation Systems Researchers, and Optimization Specialists. Requirements At least one year of professional experience in applied science, data science, machine learning, quantitative research, statistics, or a closely related field. Experience at a leading technology company, financial institution, research organization, or similarly rigorous environment is highly relevant. Strong proficiency in Python, including Pandas and scikit-learn. Demonstrated experience in applied statistics, experimental design, and machine learning. Experience developing, tuning, and evaluating machine learning models in practical settings. Strong data modeling and data transformation skills. Ability to identify flawed methodology and statistical errors. Strong analytical and quantitative reasoning skills. Excellent written and verbal communication. Ability to produce clear technical documentation and reproducible analytical work. Preferred Background Professional experience as an Applied Scientist, Data Scientist, Machine Learning Scientist, Quantitative Researcher, or similar role. Experience with experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, recommendation systems, optimization, or predictive modeling. Experience with Python, Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. Experience working with large, complex, or messy datasets. Experience designing analytical frameworks, model evaluation systems, or data science benchmarks. Experience reviewing technical analyses, notebooks, research outputs, or model results for methodological quality. Experience collaborating with engineering, product, research, finance, or other cross-functional teams. Advanced academic background in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline is valuable. This opportunity is ideal for applied scientists who can take a complex data problem, choose an appropriate statistical or machine learning approach, build a rigorous and reproducible analysis, identify subtle methodological errors, and explain their conclusions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. We are a referral partner of the client.

items.desc: We are looking for an early-career researcher to apply and develop Al and automation approaches across the evidence synthesis process - from literature searching and eligibility screening to (meta)data extraction. The role The role combines hands-on evidence synthesis with the development and evaluation of Al-driven approaches to make evidence synthesis processes more efficient. You will work on manual evidence-synthesis tasks, while also using Python and/or R to build and validate machine learning, automation and Al-assisted workflows for searching, eligibility screening, and (meta)data extraction. Your work will also contribute to new meta-research on how, and under what conditions, automated and Al-based tools can speed up and improve evidence synthesis in the environmental field without compromising reliability, robustness or scientific quality. Our team spans many disciplines and we welcome candidates from different backgrounds. If you have strong research and programming skills, want to help connect sustainability science with policymaking and are keen to learn evidence synthesis methods, we would like to hear from you. Key Tasks And Responsibilities Conduct and support manual literature searching, screening and (meta)data extraction for evidence synthesis projects, working with large volumes of scientific publications and grey literature (including bibliographic information and textual data). Develop and maintain reproducible workflows in Python and/or R for screening, extraction, classification, quality-checking, cleaning and harmonization of textual and bibliographic data. Apply and evaluate machine learning, natural language processing and LLM-based methods for text classification, information extraction and document analysis. Validate automated and Al-generated outputs against human decisions, quantifying errors, uncertainty and potential biases. Document methods, decisions and validation procedures to support transparent and reproducible research. Work collaboratively with researchers across environmental, sustainability, climate, energy and social science. Who You Are You are an early-career researcher with strong analytical and programming skills who enjoys working where sustainability research meets technology development - engaging with both the details of evidence synthesis and the computational methods that support it. You are happy to do detailed manual eligibility screening and (meta) data extraction, while looking for opportunities to automate these processes and make them more efficient. You have a background in, or strong interest in, sustainability or environmental research and enjoy learning from people with different disciplinary backgrounds. You do not need to be an expert in every method or technology used in this role. We value someone who is curious, careful, quick to learn and a constructive team player. The role would suit someone with: Programming and data analysis skills in Python and/or R, including version control with GitHub Experience handling large volumes of structured and unstructured text Practical experience applying machine learning, NLP or large language models to text classification, information extraction or eligibility screening An interest in evidence synthesis methodology Knowledge of, or interest in, sustainability or environmental research Experience with more advanced Al development, such as model fine-tuning or deployment, is welcome but deep expertise in machine learning or software engineering is not required. Experience with any of the following is highly desirable, but not required: Literature reviews, including systematic, scoping and rapid reviews Working with bibliographic datasets Literature eligibility screening or (meta)data extraction Formal qualifications A master's degree in data science, computer science, engineering, socio-environmental science, sustainability science or a related field. Early-career experience (1-2 years) in academic or applied research involving data analysis and Al/data-driven Personal skills Collaborative: comfortable working in teams and across disciplinary boundaries. Analytical and critical: able to assess evidence and critically evaluate Al-generated results. Systematic and data-oriented: enjoys turning complex information into reliable datasets Clear communicator: able to explain technical concepts to non-technical Curious and adaptable: interested in learning and applying rapidly developing Al Quality-focused and responsible: attentive to research integrity, transparency, uncertainty and Al-related Additional information You will join the International Climate Risk and Adaptation Team, which develops and applies pioneering research methods to define, describe, measure and communicate systemic climate risk in interdependent global systems. Drawing on diverse perspectives, its work spans quantitative and qualitative analysis, climate risk assessment, scenario and foresight development and Al-driven policy …

items.desc: R&D Data Scientist Job-ID: 14225 Location: København SV, Danish Capital Reg., DK, 2450 Country: DK Join us in shaping the future of sustainable propulsion Do you enjoy turning complex data into actionable insights? Are you excited by applying data science and AI to support the green transition? If you’re passionate about using data to solve real engineering challenges and working with purpose, we’d love to hear from you. At Everllence, we are pioneers in advanced propulsion technologies. We develop the control systems and digital solutions behind the world’s largest two-stroke engines – systems that now support operation on carbon-neutral alternative fuels. Data, simulation, edge ML, LLM integration, and advanced analytics are becoming increasingly important enablers in our company's mission to move big things to zero. About The Role As an R&D Data Scientist in our Engine Control Systems team, you will help unlock the value of data across the entire Engine Control Systems function. Working closely with Everllence R&D engineers, technical specialists, and operators you will transform operational, simulation, and test data into actionable insights that strengthen engineering decisions. You’ll be entrusted with exploring complex datasets, identifying patterns and opportunities, and developing analytical solutions that engineers can trust and use. Your work may range from data preparation, exploratory analysis, and visualization to machine-learning models, virtual sensors, optimization algorithms, and decision-support tools. You will support initiatives across core engine controls, emission reduction technologies, alternative fuels, diagnostics, simulation, verification, and future digital products, while establish robust approaches to data quality and model validation. This is a role for someone who finds satisfaction in making complex engineering data understandable and useful, enjoys close collaboration across disciplines, and wants to leave a tangible mark on how data science and AI enable the next generation of marine two-stroke engines and related systems. What We're Looking For We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us – professionally and personally – as we expand the use of data science and AI within two-stroke propulsion technology. You might already have experience applying data science in an engineering environment, or you might be at an earlier stage in your career and ready to take on significant challenges. Either way, what matters most is that you’re motivated by solving real-world problems and enjoy seeing data translated into reliable insights, models, and working solutions. Because the results may inform safety-critical evaluations, you understand the importance of high-confidence outputs, uncertainty assessment, and being able to identify and communicate when the available evidence or model confidence is insufficient to support a decision. Success in this role means developing a deep understanding of complex engineering data, identifying patterns and opportunities, and translating your findings into trusted tools and evidence-based decisions. Over time, we’ll count on you to lead data science activities from problem definition and data exploration through model development, validation, communication, and implementation, working independently when needed while contributing to shared goals across the Engine Control Systems function. You can contribute to this role by exploring new approaches, developing your knowledge, and collaborating with colleagues across disciplines, cultures, and locations. We value initiative, constructive questioning, structured problem-solving, and openness to feedback and continuous learning. Our Team Culture We work in agile-inspired teams with strong collaboration and shared accountability. Our software and systems are designed with a focus on reliability, safety, and usability. We value informal, open dialogue and support personal development. You’ll be working with skilled and motivated colleagues who are happy to share knowledge and learn from you. Hier ga je werken SURF is de ict-coöperatie van Nederlandse onderwijs- en onderzoeksinstellingen. Samen ontwikkelen we digitale diensten en werken we aan complexe innovatievraagstukken die de kwaliteit van onderwijs en onderzoek verbeteren. We doen dit samen met de instellingen, met oog voor publieke waarden, en zoveel mogelijk open en open source. Je krijgt ruimte om architectuurkeuzes te maken, nieuwe technologieën te onderzoeken en proofs of concept door te ontwikkelen tot productieklare oplossingen. Verder werk je met vraagstukken rond cloudarchitectuur, schaalbaarheid, security, data-integriteit en AI-ethiek. Zo draag je direct bij aan een infrastructuur die het Nederlandse onderwijs toekomstbestendig maakt. Wie bij SURF werkt, werkt bij een unieke en open organisatie. Dat merk je aan alles: de structuur van de organisatie, de opzet van de projectteams, de cultuur op onze kantoren en de onderlinge sfeer. SURF biedt uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en gaat flexibel om met de werk/privé-balans. Medewerkers werken graag zelfstandig. Daarnaast krijgt iedereen de ruimte en de vrijheid om talenten zo goed en breed mogelijk in te zetten en te ontwikkelen. In dit team kom je terecht Je komt terecht in het High Performance Machine Learning Team (HPML) binnen de afdeling Advanced Solutions for Research van SURF. Het HPML-team is verantwoordelijk voor tal van activiteiten, zoals de ontwikkeling van de Nederlandse AI-Fabriek, het trainen van grote taalmodellen, de integratie van AI in grootschalige simulaties en de opzet van onze AI-Hub. Dit breng je mee Je bent een ervaren software engineer met een sterke Python-basis en ruime ervaring met development, testen en DevOps. Je werkt graag zelfstandig, bent technisch nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken uit te zoeken. Je hebt oog voor kwaliteit en security en voelt je prettig in een technische omgeving waarin Engels de voertaal is. Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring als software developer; Ruime ervaring met CI/CD-pipelines, bij voorkeur met Git en GitLab; Ervaring met het opzetten en beheren van Docker-omgevingen; Ruimte ervaring met unit-, integratie- en end-to-endtests; Ervaring met PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy en databasemigraties Ervaring met Linux-commandline Ervarign met security-by-designprincipes; Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal. items.desc: The AI Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a Robot Learning Engineer (m/f/d) in VLA & Foundation Models , who will develop and deploy vision- and language-conditioned robot policies for real-world manipulation on physical robot platforms. Your Responsibilities Policy Development: Design, train, and evaluate vision- and language-conditioned robot policies using approaches such as imitation learning, diffusion models, transformer architectures, or reinforcement learning. Data Pipelines: Build workflows for collecting, structuring, and validating multimodal robot data from teleoperation, simulation, and real-world experiments, covering video, proprioception, force signals, and task outcomes. Robot Integration: Define action spaces, control interfaces, temporal chunking, and evaluation protocols to ensure learned policies are compatible with real robot execution contexts. Failure Analysis: Test policies in simulation and on physical robots, diagnosing failures caused by distribution shift, perception errors, contact dynamics, latency, and data quality. Deployment: Integrate learned policies into robot software stacks, with attention to latency, synchronization, safety checks, fallback behavior, and runtime monitoring. Research Application: Track developments in robot learning, VLA models, and foundation model methods, applying relevant advances to Agile's robot platforms and use cases. Essential Skills Background: Degree in computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a closely related field, or an equivalent combination of research and professional experience in robot learning or embodied AI. Robot Learning: Hands-on experience building or working with learning-based robot policies, including imitation learning, visuomotor control, VLA models, or closely related embodied AI methods. Robotics Systems: Practical experience with robotic hardware, including real robot manipulation, ROS/ROS2, sensor integration, control interfaces, or real-world robot deployment. ML Engineering: Working proficiency in Python and PyTorch, including the ability to implement models, training loops, data loaders, and evaluation pipelines beyond notebook-level prototypes. Experimental Practice: Ability to design experiments, compare model variants, debug failures across the ML/robotics boundary, and iterate toward measurable performance on real tasks. Beneficial Skills VLA Experience: Familiarity with VLA models or robotic foundation models such as π0, GR00T, or equivalent, including action-token or action-chunk representations. Policy Deployment: Experience deploying learned models on physical robots or edge compute platforms, including latency-constrained inference pipelines. Reinforcement Learning: Experience with online or offline RL for robotics, including reward design, simulation-based training, or combining RL with imitation learning. Simulation: Experience with simulators such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or ManiSkill and with sim-to-real transfer workflows. Data Collection: Experience building or operating teleoperation systems, human-in-the-loop data collection, or intervention learning setups. What we offer A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors. Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment. Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow. Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth. Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month. Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly. This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us! We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

items.desc: Take AI from the frontier into the field. The AI Office is a small team with a direct mandate from the CEO to make Bittium an AI-native company. We build the AI tools and infrastructure Bittium works with, and work inside our business segments to bring AI into their products. We are hiring two new Members of Technical Staff to join the AI Office and work side by side with our Head of AI. What you build ends up in your colleagues' daily work and in products depended on by defence forces, public authorities and healthcare professionals. You might be the person who has rewritten their own agent harness more than once. shipped a full app in a weekend for a team that wasn't yours, and they still use it. fine-tuned a model and knows whether the eval moving meant anything. had a new open-weights model running on their own hardware the day it came out, and had an opinion about it by lunch. was pushed by API pricing, or dreams of personal AI sovereignty, into squeezing a model onto hardware it had no business running on. has broken a guardrail, and knows why you never rely on just one. daydreams of dark software factories. What you will do We shape the role around the person, and we make room for exceptional people. If your strength isn't listed below, tell us. Keep us ahead. You live and breathe the AI takeoff: the models, the hardware, the tools and where the whole industry is heading. Separate what matters from the noise early, and steer where we put our effort. Go where the work is. Sit with legal, finance, sales, R&D or production, find the work AI should be doing, and build it fast. Run and grow our AI infrastructure and applications. Inference on our own GPUs, the services on top of it and the end-user applications people work with every day. When a new model is worth having, it is live the same week. Build the AI our products run on. Build and maintain the agent harnesses, models and safeguards our business segments build products on, and keep them working all the way out to battlefield conditions. Make models ours. Post-train open-weights models until they beat the general-purpose ones at our work. Make agents safe to trust. Alignment on the model side, and a hard boundary around it that holds even when the model gets it wrong. What we are looking for above all Taste. You know what good looks like in code, in interfaces and in products, and you don't ship less. You look for the simple solution even when it takes longer to find, because clarity is worth the effort, but you also know when to take a shortcut. An edge. At work or outside it, you have taken something further than most people ever do. We care about that far more than titles, degrees or years of experience. Ownership. We set the direction together, and you own what you build and answer for the results. Lots of freedom, lots of responsibility, so you need to be good at directing your own work. What we ask You have mastered the craft of working with language models: prompting, context, agent skills, multi-agent orchestration and compiling intent into working software, including the spells that make the difference. You build real software, fast, with coding agents, and you have opinions about where agentic development is going. One thing is sure: the future is not TUIs on laptops. A strong full-stack engineer: frontend, APIs, databases, auth and deployment (ours is mostly Go, Python, TypeScript, SolidJS, Svelte and Postgres today, but we don't hire for a stack). You take a tool from an empty repo to production on your own. Strong software engineering fundamentals: architecture, data modelling, clean interfaces, testing, Linux and networking. When agents write the code, fundamentals are how you judge it. An eye for opportunity. You have a vision. You spot what should be automated and where a product is hiding, and you find the real problem behind a request, working easily with people who are not engineers. Fluent English and at least working Finnish. Any of these will make you stand out Security: agent sandboxing, red or blue team experience. Evals: designing evals that measure what matters in real work, and knowing when a good number is misleading. AI products: you have taken an AI-driven product or technology from idea to production, with real users or customers relying on it. Inference and GPU systems: SGLang or vLLM internals, speculative decoding, disaggregated serving, KV-cache offloading, low-bit quantization, kernels in Triton or CUDA, ROCm. Infrastructure and trust: confidential computing and attestation, bare metal, AWS or other cloud. Model training: post-training, preference optimization, RL, distillation, datasets, alignment and safety. AI hardware beyond NVIDIA: AMD, Tenstorrent, Cerebras, Etched, hardwired inference silicon, NPUs and other edge accelerators. Classic ML and sensing: anomaly detection, RF signal processing, biosignals (ECG, EEG), computer vision, sensor fusion. Mission-critical and regulated domains: defence, public …

items.desc: The opportunity Perform the hands-on experimental work that shows whether promising AI technologies hold up under realistic conditions. As AI Experimentation Engineer in the Technology Validation team, part of Hitachi Energy's Data, Analytics & Artificial Intelligence (DAAI) organization, you turn selected AI opportunities into feasibility experiments, comparative evaluations, demonstrators and technical spikes. Your evidence gives architecture, platform and delivery teams what they need before they commit to a technology. The team builds to learn and demonstrate, not to operate production systems. How You Will Make An Impact Design and run time-boxed experiments and technical spikes against clear learning questions, testing first the assumption most likely to change the conclusion. Build prototypes, test harnesses, reference implementations and integrations, proportionate to the question and under sufficiently realistic conditions. Conduct fair comparative evaluations of AI models, LLMs, services, frameworks and vendor options, using a baseline or alternative where it strengthens the conclusion. Create early demonstrators that make new AI capabilities tangible for stakeholders, even before a business owner has been identified. Document method, results and constraints concisely. Maintain reproducible, reusable technical assets. Collaborate with the AI Research Engineer and AI Opportunity Lead. Provide evidence, demonstrations and constraints to DAAI Architecture, AI Platform Operations, AI Acceleration and AI Delivery without taking on delivery or product ownership. Your background A genuine passion for AI: you try new tools and models on your own initiative and can show a recent example of something you built or tried. 3+ years of experience in AI/ML experimentation, prototyping, software engineering, data science or applied AI. Strong hands-on programming skills (Python preferred, other languages such as JavaScript or TypeScript welcome) and the ability to build working prototypes quickly, using AI coding assistants where useful. Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure preferred, GCP or AWS) is an advantage. Experience evaluating LLMs, ML models, AI services or integrations. You can run a time-boxed experiment, turn the findings into a decision and stop when more work would not change it. Intellectual honesty and clear communication: you report negative results as clearly as positive ones and explain limits to non-technical audiences. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience and fluent English. A degree in computer science, data science or engineering is an advantage. The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures. This role may be open in multiple locations. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage. Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes: Competitive salary and incentives Well-being and care Paid and unpaid leave Flexible work options Benefits that support your financial security You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process. Publication date : 2026-10-15

items.desc: Capgemini Engineering, líder mundial en servicios de ingeniería, reúne a equipos de ingenieros/as, científicos/as y arquitectos/as para ayudar a las empresas más innovadoras del mundo a liberar su potencial y contribuir a un futuro mejor. Desde coches autónomos pasando por soluciones contra incendios forestales, nuestro/as expertos/as en tecnologías digitales y software se salen de lo convencional proporcionando servicios únicos de I+D e ingeniería en todos los sectores de actividad. ¡Únete al equipo y continua tu carrera en una compañía con oportunidades de crecimiento, donde puedes marcar la diferencia y donde ningún día es igual al anterior! ¿Cuál será tu rol? Pensamos en un perfil de Ingeniero/a I+D Telco para incorporar con nosotros en proyecto de telecomunicaciones para la parte de Cloud. ¿Qué harás en tu día a día? Diseño y desarrollo de soluciones innovadoras basadas en 5G-Advanced, Telco Edge Cloud y tecnologías MEC dentro de proyectos de I+D nacionales y europeos. Investigación y aplicación de técnicas de IA/ML para la automatización, optimización y orquestación de redes de telecomunicaciones. Coordinación técnica de tareas y paquetes de trabajo (Work Packages), asegurando el cumplimiento de hitos y entregables del proyecto. Colaboración con socios industriales, centros tecnológicos, universidades y organismos públicos en consorcios internacionales. Elaboración de documentación técnica, contribución a propuestas de investigación y difusión de resultados. Tu perfil Titulación en Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones, Informática o equivalente, con al menos 4 años de experiencia en proyectos de I+D. Conocimientos sólidos en redes 5G/5G-Advanced, virtualización de redes (NFV/SDN), Edge Computing y arquitecturas Telco Cloud. Experiencia en la aplicación de IA/ML para la gestión, optimización y automatización de infraestructuras de red. Valorable experiencia con entornos CI/CD (Git, Jenkins, GitLab) y despliegue de soluciones cloud-native mediante Docker y/o Kubernetes. Nivel de inglés alto. Valoramos todas las candidaturas y ofrecemos formación presencial, online y certificaciones. Aunque no cumplas el 100% de los requisitos, ¡queremos conocerte! ¿Qué te gustará de trabajar aquí? ¿Qué ofrecemos? Contrato indefinido y proyecto estable. Salario acorde a la valoración del perfil. Teletrabajo con visitas puntuales a la oficina. Vale guardería (hasta 600 b/a). Ayuda comida (1200€ b/a). Formación técnicas, en habilidades e idiomas. Plan de carrera real y adaptado a tu rol. Tenemos un catálogo de medidas de Desarrollo y Conciliación muy completo, como por ejemplo: Wellbeing HUB - Incluye políticas y acciones para la salud física (Wellhub) y mental. 24 días de vacaciones + 2 asuntos propios + 24 y 31 de diciembre + opción a comprar hasta 7 días de vacaciones al año. Formación continua, podrás disfrutar de Mylearning y de Capgemini University y de nuestros Campus Digitales y Comunidades profesionales. Tendrás acceso a plataformas como: Coursera, Udemy, Pluralsight, Harvard Manager Mentor, Education First para idiomas (inglés francés, alemán…) ¡entre otras! FlexAbroad: posibilidad de trabajar en remoto desde otro país durante 45 días. ¿Por qué Capgemini? Nuestros compromisos y prioridades: Nuestro Plan de Igualdad y Código Ético garantizan procesos inclusivos y libres de discriminación, potenciando el talento, en un entorno multicultural y accesible para personas con discapacidad (valoramos positivamente disponer de certificado de discapacidad). Capgemini es un socio global en transformación empresarial y tecnológica, que ayuda a las organizaciones a acelerar su doble transición hacia un mundo digital y sostenible, generando un impacto tangible tanto en las empresas como en la sociedad. Somos un grupo responsable y diverso, con 340.000 profesionales en más de 50 países. Con más de 55 años de trayectoria, nuestros clientes confían en Capgemini para aprovechar el valor de la tecnología y cubrir todas sus necesidades de negocio. Ofrecemos soluciones completas que abarcan desde la estrategia y el diseño hasta la ingeniería, impulsadas por nuestras capacidades líderes en inteligencia artificial, IA generativa, cloud y datos, junto con un profundo conocimiento del sector y una sólida red de partners. www.capgemini.com/es-es

items.desc: Deine Aufgaben Wähle passende Modelle aus, adaptiere und fine-tune sie für die Signal- und Sprachverarbeitung, darunter CNN- und Transformer-Architekturen, State-Space-Modelle und End-to-End-ASR Optimiere die Inferenz durch Quantisierung, Pruning, Kernel-Fusion, Batching-Strategien, Mixed Precision, TorchScript/torch.compile sowie den Export nach ONNX/TensorRT Implementiere performante Inferenzpfade mit PyTorch und LibTorch (PyTorch C++) Deplo­ye und betreibe Modelle im NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, inklusive Model Repository, Ensembles, Business Logic Scripting, Dynamic Batching und eigener Backends Baue die Verarbeitungsketten rund um die Modelle auf, von Signal-Preprocessing und Feature-Extraktion über Streaming-Pipelines bis hin zu Pre- und Post-Processing Überführe Prototypen bis zur Marktreife, kümmere dich um Benchmarking, Profiling, Testabdeckung, Reproduzierbarkeit, Monitoring und Modellversionierung, arbeite eng mit Systemarchitektur und Produktmanagement zusammen und bewerte neue Verfahren und Werkzeuge hinsichtlich ihrer praktischen Eignung für unsere Performance-Ziele Das bringst du mit Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Physik, Mathematik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation alternativ verfügst du über gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PyTorch über das Training hinaus: Du weißt, wo Modelle in der Produktion langsam werden und wie du Performance-Engpässe behebst Solide C++-Kenntnisse ab C++17, Erfahrung mit der PyTorch-C++-API und praktische Kenntnisse im Umgang mit dem Triton Inference Server konntest du bereits sammeln Fundierte Kenntnisse in digitaler Signalverarbeitung (FFT, Filterdesign, Modulation, Spektrogramm-Repräsentationen) oder in der Sprachverarbeitung (ASR, Speaker Embeddings, Speech Enhancement) In der Vergangenheit konntest du Erfahrung mit Profiling und GPU-Optimierung (CUDA-Grundlagen) sammeln und hast einen souveräner Umgang mit Linux, Git, Docker und CI/CD Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab Kontaktdetails Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, relevanten Zeugnissen sowie – sofern vorhanden – einer Übersicht deiner Publikationen oder Projekte. items.title: Data Scientist in high-tech scale-up
items.card: The Role We are looking for a Data Scientist who enjoys developing and optimizing machine learning models for real-world applications.
