 As part of our Firmware Engineering team, you'll support the development of high-performance digital systems used within advanced Electronic Warfare solutions.
 Your activities will include:
 Designing and developing FPGA firmware solutions for complex embedded and real-time systems
 Creating and verifying designs using hardware description languages and industry-standard development tools
 Supporting the development of digital processing technologies used in Electronic Warfare and sensing applications
 Conducting simulation, testing and validation activities to ensure firmware meets functional, timing and performance requirements
 Analysing technical data and presenting findings to engineering teams and stakeholders
 Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across systems, hardware, software and verification engineering to integrate firmware solutions into larger products
 Contributing to technical documentation, design reviews and customer deliverables
 Developing an understanding of the complete engineering lifecycle, from concept through to manufacture and in-service support
 What We're Looking For
 We're looking for curious, motivated graduates with a passion for engineering, problem solving and technology.
 You should have, or be on track to achieve:
 A minimum 2:2 Bachelor's degree, Integrated Master's degree, MSc or PhD in a relevant STEM discipline, such as: Electronic Engineering
 Electrical Engineering
 Computer Engineering
 Robotics Engineering
 AI & Cybernetics
 Communications Engineering
 Information Engineering
 Space Engineering
 Physics or Applied Physics
 Mathematics or Applied Mathematics
 Computer Science
 Cyber Security
 Computer Communication and Networks
 Related disciplines
 We'd also like to see:
 An interest in firmware development, FPGA design, embedded systems or digital signal processing
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 The ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively
 A collaborative approach and willingness to learn from experienced engineers
 Experience of programming, simulation, digital design or laboratory-based testing gained through university projects, placements or personal interests (desirable, not essential)
 Familiarity with hardware description languages such as VHDL , Verilog or SystemVerilog, or FPGA development tools, is beneficial but not essential

 · Receive training in both technical, management and soft skills which are tailored to the particular role and area of the business you are in.
 · The opportunity to accelerate competency attainment through rotational placements around different projects or stages of the product lifecycle, to enable you to become a well-rounded engineer.

 · Continue professional development throughout your career through formal training, site visits, internal awareness sessions, learning from more experienced engineers and keeping up to date with the latest technical developments, both internal to Leonardo and in wider industry.

 · Relevant Mechanical engineering work experience, such as summer placements or internships.
 · Experience with technical writing and project planning.
 · Strong analytical, modelling skills and laboratory skills.
 · Evidence of successfully working in a team.
 · Experience of CAD modelling tools such as PTC Creo or similar parametric modellers are desirable.
 For the Graduate Mechanical Engineer role, the acceptable degrees are typically:
 · Mechanical Engineering
 · Computer Aided Mechanical Engineering
 · Aero-Mechanical Engineering

Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to launch your career and make an impact on real-world projects from day one? 
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for graduates who want to be part of something extraordinary - shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 We are committed to developing our graduates into leading technical or business professionals, and as such we will also support you through your preferred route for professional development. The role requires an enthusiastic individual who has a passion for overcoming technical challenges.
 We are looking for a graduate to do Stress and Thermal Analysis within the Mechanical Engineering Team —shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 Our 18-month Graduate Programmes give you the opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects alongside industry leaders. 
 On joining, you will receive a starting salary of £34,000 per annum, plus a £1,000 welcome bonus. You’ll also be eligible for a £1,000 exit bonus upon successful completion of the programme. In addition, you may be eligible for a Temporary Accommodation Allowance (TAA), subject to specific criteria. 
 We encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience. 
 During the programme, as a Graduate Engineer - Stress amd Thermal Analyst, you will 
 Support the design and development of our world leading electro-optic, communications and information systems products under the guidance of experienced mechanical engineers.
 Be introduced to state-of-the-art methods, technology and tools to enable you to explore all aspects of the engineering lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, test, build, production and in-service support.
 This role allows a mixture of on-site and remote working; with attendance at our Essex facility required when Customer requirements dictate.
 Key Responsibility Areas 
 Acquiring the skills required to work effectively within a professional engineering environment. Analysing and advising on thermal and stress performance to help products meet demanding environmental and operational requirements.
 Supporting members of the mechanical engineering team in the delivery of technical solutions that meet our customer needs. Design and develop structures of products providing information about the behaviour of a structure, related to its static and dynamic response supporting both new innovations and proven legacy products.
 Creating and presenting design data to the appropriate departmental ‘best practices’ and utilising industry leading tool sets.
 Delivering detailed designs, including numerical calculations, tolerance studies, etc.
 Working to meet cost, schedule and quality demands.
 What you will bring 
 All of our roles require (a) a minimum of a 2:2 Bachelors/Integrated Master’s degree, or (b) a higher degree, such as a MSc or PhD.
 For the Graduate Stress and Thermal Engineer role, the acceptable degrees are:
 Mechanical Engineering
 Aero-Mechanical Engineering
 Mechatronics
 Electro Mechanical
 Personal Attributes 
 Be a self-motivated individual, willing to take on new challenges and drive continuous personal development.
 Strong communication skills across a variety of mediums i.e. written, verbal, digital, etc.
 The ability to develop effective working relationships with peers and stakeholders.
 Adaptable to the ever-changing demands that will be encountered within the role.
 Offer novel ideas and methods for solving complex problems, drawing on personal experiences and knowledge learned during academic studies.
 Demonstrate relevant project work and/or placements in Industry are beneficial, but not essential.
 What you’ll do
 Analyse and assess mechanical designs for strength, durability, performance and safety against regulatory and customer requirements using finite element techniques and classical hand calculations.
 Conduct thermal analysis of mechanical designs to assess performance and safety using thermal analysis software, CFD techniques, and classical hand calculations.
 Support the selection of manufacturing technologies and aerospace materials based on a sound understanding of material physical and mechanical properties and the mechanical fit, form and function of the product.
 Advise on materials and manufacturing techniques with an emphasis on thermal performance and mechanical integrity.
 Support product development through all phases—from design and testing to final certification.
 Contribute to technical documentation, including material for peer reviews and stage/gate approvals.
 All members of the Analysis Team are encouraged and supported to continually develop their skills, including (but not limited to) Structural, Thermal, Pressure and Model Driven domains.

items.desc: Job Description Are you looking for a role where you can combine theoretical computer vision, hardware integration, and robust software development? Trackman is looking for a Computer Vision Engineer to join our Golf Launch Monitor R&D team. You will join the team in building high-precision tracking systems engineered to perform reliably in challenging environments and satisfy the highest requirements of elite athletes. Whether you are a recent graduate or have a couple of years of experience in electrical engineering, computer science, embedded/mechatronics, or related fields, this is an opportunity to build deep technical expertise while working hands-on with some of the most challenging problems in computer vision and sensor technology. Since 2003, Trackman has been on the forefront of sports tracking technology,combining high-speed cameras, radar,and applied physics. Our products are used daily by professional athletes, coaches, club fitters, and broadcasters worldwide. Staying at the forefront requires more than developing new technology. It means continuously improving, testing, and hardening existing systems, so they work flawlessly every single day in real-world conditions. The Role As a Computer Vision Engineer, you will work across the development lifecycle: running feasibility studies on new optical sensors, helping design real-time tracking pipelines, and taking pride in diagnosing, maintaining, and improving products across demanding deployment environment. We are looking for motivated engineers who pair a strong theoretical academic foundation with the practical instinct to roll up their sleeves, diagnose tricky integration bottlenecks, and build technology that works. You will join the Golf Launch Monitors R&D team, a highly skilled, multidisciplinary group of specialists working across computer vision, radar signal processing, mathematical modeling, and software engineering. We are committed to excellence and operate with a first-principles mindset, constantly pushing physical and computational boundaries to ensure our tracking accuracy remains the global benchmark. Key Responsibilities Sensor & Hardware Integration: Evaluate next-generation camera sensors, optical setups, and custom illumination; diagnose hardware/software interface edge cases (e.g., latency, frame drops, synchronization). Algorithm & Pipeline Design: Develop, tune, and profile real-time 2D/3D vision tracking and calibration algorithms capable of handling all kinds of challenging cases. Production Engineering & Maintenance: Write clean, testable C++ and Python code. Maintain, refactor, and harden existing production codebases to ensure long-term stability and high uptime. Field-Data Validation: Analyze real-world datasets collected across challenging environments to identify vulnerabilities, eliminate subtle tracking bugs, and continuously raise tracking accuracy. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, firmware, and QA teams to translate ambiguous physical challenges into reliable, deployable software solutions. Job Requirements Who You Are: You are a recent MSc/PhD graduate or early-career engineer with approximately 0–3 years of experience in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field. You have gained hands-on experience with computer vision, sensors, image processing, You have a strong interest in – areas such as camera sensors, calibration, 3D geometry, feature tracking, or image-processing pipelines. You have gainedexperience in software engineering through professional research, or substantial university projects. You have strong academic or practical skills in C++ and/or Python and care about writing efficient, structured, and maintainable code. You enjoy solving complex technical problems, digging into code and data, and investigating issues until you understand their root cause. You are curious, highly motivated, organized, and comfortable taking ownership in a collaborative and informal engineering environment. Bonus Points For Experience or interest in any of the following is an advantage: High-speed or global-shutter imaging Embedded Linux or RTOS Camera-radar sensor fusion CUDA, SIMD, TensorRT, or similar acceleration technologies Sports technology, biomechanics, or golf tracking The Office We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff. Join the home of a powerful sports …

items.desc: Reaktor is looking for Machine Learning Engineers to join us in Helsinki. Turn proof of concepts and ideas into production-grade AI services. If you are interested in building and deploying bleeding edge machine learning models into production, where they continuously deliver tangible value to our customers, you might just be what we’re looking for. As a Machine Learning Engineer at Reaktor, your job is to turn proof of concepts and ideas into production-grade AI services, help your team succeed, and deliver results. At its core, Reaktor is a technology company that helps ambitious organizations become digital leaders. From premium software development to digital transformation, our global community of experts do it all – here are some of our most recent digital ventures to give you an idea of what that means. Your Daily Tasks Include Working together with the client’s tech and business teams and helping them pick the right technologies suitable for their needs Delivering the client and the team according to the needs of the project Building, deploying, and maintaining ML models that serve users reliably in production day after day. Creating architectures for the continuous gathering of new training data for ML models Building interfaces for delivering the results of ML models to end users Other software development-related tasks, such as debugging, designing, and participating in creating the architecture You enjoy designing scalable machine learning architecture that processes vast quantities of data and delivers refined results to end users. To thrive in this position, you'll need Hands-on experience in continuously developing and deploying machine learning models We don’t have a hard limit on years of experience, but we’ve noticed that these Machine Learning competencies often take 3+ years to accumulate Experience with common tools, libraries, and platforms in the field of machine learning A good grasp of common machine-learning techniques An understanding of infrastructure-as-code practices (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) Cloud development experience (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.) A solid programming foundation (Python required, other languages are a plus, for example, Java, Javascript/Typescript, C++) Experience working on data with SQL You are a software engineer at heart and you don't leave a legacy behind Good communication skills and the ability to work with clients to figure out their data needs Fluency in both English and Finnish is preferable Why join us? For two decades, we’ve been developing qualities and capabilities for adapting, reacting, and supporting change – building Reaktor to hold up in a fast-paced environment while ensuring the well-being of our people. While Working At Reaktor, We’ll Provide You With The ability to impact how you work. Together with the client, your team chooses the approach, technologies, and methodologies you think will work best in any given situation A community with as much support as your heart desires A team that’s not only experienced but considerate as well – they all want you to succeed A sustainable work-life balance and support for your daily life outside of work. (e.g., free moving day, Reaktor car share, sick child care services, office space to use for your private events, etc.) An opportunity to grow as a professional. In addition to the day-to-day work, we offer internal training courses, community events, and 15-minute coffee breaks to discuss hot topics in tech and design A possibility to take part in more extended academy-like studies like Cloud Academy 300+ hobby clubs, from winter swimming and running to knitting and archery, that bring people together outside of (and sometimes inside) office hours. Many of these are supported by Reaktor Check more benefits & perks below Diversity, equity, and inclusion Together, we are committed to making Reaktor an environment that embraces and values all of our employees for the whole of who they are. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply, knowing that studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they fully satisfy all of the requirements. If you're thinking twice about applying for this reason, we invite you to send us your application anyway. You could be just the person we're looking for. Read more about our DEI work here. Interested? Drop us a line – We'll be happy to hear from you!

items.desc: Take up a key role in our Data Science team where your work has direct and meaningful impact. Be at the core of our data-driven business, building predictive and innovative models shaping our marketing and customer strategy, and driving our growth. And every day at work, you'll be doing your part for all the charities we support. At Postcode Lottery Group, your data science work directly supports hundreds of charities across environmental, health, and community causes. Every model you build helps raise funds for a fairer, greener world. You'll join a collaborative, impact-driven team that values technical excellence and practical results. We design and deploy advanced machine learning models that make a real difference for our business and charity partners. This is an end-to-end role: from stakeholder conversations to production deployment, you’ll shape solutions that matter. You’ll also help guide the business, explore new opportunities, and demonstrate the power of data. Ali Palali , Senior Data Scientist: "At the Postcode Lottery Group, we use data science for good. As the Data Scientist team, we build and deploy robust ML models that have a real-world impact, driving business decisions that help us fund a greener, better, and a fairer world. This is a role where you will have plenty of room for innovation, growth, and a clear purpose." What You’ll Do You'll apply your skills in predictive modeling and advanced statistical techniques (like regression and classification techniques, forecasting, A/B testing and causal inference), to deeply understand and predict customer behavior, helping us make smarter decisions about retention and value. We mean it. You will take ownership of your models from end-to-end: from data exploration in Snowflake and feature engineering to deploying your models on AWS SageMaker. Be responsible for making sure your work is automated, tested, and reliable. You will work closely with GitLab. You’ll be the one translating fuzzy business questions into concrete data science problems and, just as importantly, translating your complex results back into clear, actionable insights for your stakeholders. You’ll work closely with our Machine Learning Engineering and Platform team to continuously improve our shared tools, ML platform and best practices. You’d Describe Yourself As Follows At least 4-6 years of experience as a Data Scientist, with a proven track record of taking models from an idea to a live, production system. You have a strong, practical foundation in statistical and machine learning techniques, especially for predictive modeling, regression and classification techniques, and understanding causal impact and A/B testing. You’re fluent in Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, Statsmodels etc.) and write strong, clean SQL (we use Snowflake). You believe in MLOps and building things that last. You're comfortable with concepts like containerizing models with Docker and CI/CD, and have hands-on experience with GitLab/AWS SageMaker. You're more than just a modeler—you're a great communicator and a true team player who enjoy collaborating and can guide stakeholders, manage expectations, and make the complex simple. A monthly salary indication between €4.700,- and €6.100,- based on a 40-hour week and flexible working hours. Join us! We believe an inclusive organisation is the ideal breeding ground for creativity, collaboration and innovation. Employee solidarity is important to us, too. Each of us has a part to play in that – we are the organisation, after all. We strive to make everyone feel at home. That means keeping an open mind and paying attention to each other’s welfare. items.card: Ihre Aufgaben Die Beiden Stellen Sind Bewusst Interdisziplinär Angelegt Und Arbeiten Als Tandem Eng Zusammen. Sie Richten Sich An Zwei Profile, Von Denen Ihr Profil Eines Bedienen Sollte Grundschulpädagogisches Profil mit Interesse an Informatik und KI Die Stelle ist am Lehrstuhl für Grundschulpädagogik und -didaktik mit dem Schwerpunkt Lehren und Lernen (Prof. Dr. Bärbel Kopp) angesiedelt und wird von Dr. Saskia
items.desc: Ihre Aufgaben Die Beiden Stellen Sind Bewusst Interdisziplinär Angelegt Und Arbeiten Als Tandem Eng Zusammen. Sie Richten Sich An Zwei Profile, Von Denen Ihr Profil Eines Bedienen Sollte Grundschulpädagogisches Profil mit Interesse an Informatik und KI Die Stelle ist am Lehrstuhl für Grundschulpädagogik und -didaktik mit dem Schwerpunkt Lehren und Lernen (Prof. Dr. Bärbel Kopp) angesiedelt und wird von Dr. Saskia Knoth fachlich verantwortet. Sie bringt die grundschulpädagogische und -didaktische Perspektive in das KI-EduLab ein. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Lern- und Lebenswelten von Grundschulkindern, die Gestaltung kindgerechter Lernangebote sowie die Frage, wie Kinder KI verstehen, kritisch reflektieren und für eigene Lernprozesse nutzen können. Dabei verbinden Sie das Lernen über KI als Unterrichtsgegenstand mit dem Lernen mit KI, beispielsweise durch KI-gestützte Werkzeuge zur Diagnose und Förderung.Die Stelle verantwortet die grundschulpädagogische und -didaktische Perspektive des Kollegs: Lernen und Lehren in der Grundschule, die digitale Lebenswelt von Kindern, KI als Unterrichtsgegenstand (Lernen über KI) sowie der Einsatz KI-gestützter Werkzeuge zur Diagnose und Förderung (Lernen mit KI). Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der kritisch-reflexiven Auseinandersetzung mit KI und ihrer Übersetzung in kindgerechte Lernangebote sowie auf der Erprobung in Lernwerkstatt, Schulnetzwerk und Lehrkräftefortbildung. Informatisches Profil mit Interesse an Bildung und Fachdidaktik Informatik Angesiedelt an der Professur für Didaktik der Informatik (Prof. Dr. Marc-Pascal Berges). Die Stelle verantwortet die informatische Perspektive des Kollegs: technische KI-Kompetenz (z. B. maschinelles Lernen, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision), Human-Centered Design und UX/UI für Bildungsanwendungen sowie Barrierefreiheit. Im Mittelpunkt steht, wie Informatikstudierende entlang realer Bedarfe aus Schule und Unterricht Bildungstechnologien gestalten und entwickeln – etwa adaptive Hilfestellungen oder Werkzeuge zur Unterstützung der Leistungsbeurteilung. Grundsätzlich ist für beide Stellen eine Offenheit für interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit sowie ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Fragen der KI-Bildung und digitalen Souveränität erforderlich. Aufgaben Konzeption, Durchführung und Weiterentwicklung der drei interdisziplinären Seminare des Kollegs gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Lehrstühlen und Kooperationspartner:innen der FAU Interdisziplinäre Lernbegleitung: Organisation und Moderation gemeinsamer Lernprozesse von Informatik- und Lehramtsstudierenden, insbesondere in interdisziplinären Projektteams, Inputphasen sowie Reflexions- und Feedbackrunden) Material- und Lernangebotsentwicklung: Erstellung multimedialer Lernmodule aus der jeweiligen Fachperspektive sowie Anleitung und Begleitung der Studierenden bei der Erstellung von Lernangeboten mit und über KI Projektbegleitung und Praxiserprobung: Coaching studentischer Projektteams, Mitbetreuung thematisch einschlägiger Abschlussarbeiten sowie Planung und Durchführung von Erprobungsphasen, beispielsweise im MicroTeaching, in der Lernwerkstatt, an Partnerschulen und in außerschulischen Bildungsformaten wie MobiDig Wissenschaftliche Begleitforschung: Planung und Durchführung der Begleitforschung im Design-Based-Research-Ansatz, einschließlich der Entwicklung geeigneter Erhebungsinstrumente sowie der Erhebung, Auswertung und Interpretation von Daten aus zwei Studierendenkohorten Transfer und Dissemination: Aufbereitung und Bereitstellung der entwickelten Materialien als offene Bildungsressourcen (OER), u. a. in Zusammenarbeit mit dem DigiLLab sowie Präsentation und Publikation der Projektergebnisse in Wissenschaft und Bildungspraxis Projektkoordination: Abstimmung mit den beteiligten Fachbereichen und Kooperationspartnern, Dokumentation der Projektaktivitäten und Anleitung studentischer Hilfskräfte Ihr Profil Mit gutem Erfolg abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Master, Staatsexamen oder äquivalenter Abschluss) (für 1.) Studium des Lehramts an Grundschulen (oder in verwandten Studiengängen wie Bildungs- bzw. Erziehungswissenschaften); Interesse an Technik und KI sowie idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit digitalen Medien im Grundschulunterricht (für 2.) Studium der Informatik, der Künstlichen Intelligenz, des Lehramts Informatik oder vergleichbar; fundierte Kenntnisse in KI-Methoden sowie Interesse an Bildungsfragen und an der Fachdidaktik Informatik; Erfahrungen in der Entwicklung von (Bildungs-)Software oder in Human-centered Design sind wünschenswert Interesse an empirischer Bildungsforschung; Kenntnisse qualitativer und/oder quantitativer Forschungsmethoden sind von Vorteil Freude an der Hochschullehre und an der Zusammenarbeit mit Studierenden, Lehrkräften und Kindern Fähigkeit und Bereitschaft, sich in die Fachperspektive der jeweils anderen Disziplin einzuarbeiten Eigeninitiative und Fähigkeit zum systematischen und selbstständigen Arbeiten Sehr gute …

items.card: The Population Data Science group at Swansea University ( ) supports world-leading research to develop cutting-edge analytical tools and methodologies to address the most pressing health research challenges. The following information aims to provide potential candidates with a better understanding of the requirements for this role. Home to Researchers & Data Scientists who focus on a range of projects and programmes
items.desc: The Population Data Science group at Swansea University ( ) supports world-leading research to develop cutting-edge analytical tools and methodologies to address the most pressing health research challenges. The following information aims to provide potential candidates with a better understanding of the requirements for this role. Home to Researchers & Data Scientists who focus on a range of projects and programmes that seek to improve services and people's lives through population data science research. This multidisciplinary team works in a fast-moving, agile environment and is committed to demonstrating the value of data science to a range of technical and non-technical audiences. Utilising the Secure Anonymised Information Linkage (SAIL) Databank’s ( ) rich anonymised population-scale, individual-level, linked data sources to answer important population-level questions that inform policy and evaluate national programmes and projects. We are looking for a Research Officer & Data Scientist to join our team who will work closely with various stakeholders, organisations, and groups. Our team regularly collaborates as part of many funded research projects and programmes nationally and internationally. Applications are sought from applicants with skills and experience in routine data analysis (preferably in health or social care) and a background in any of the following areas: epidemiology, statistics, operational research, or related informatics, to work in research and data science. The Research Officer & Data Scientist will be part of an active research group working on a range of impactful projects, collaborating with world-renowned data science experts, leading academics and specialist teams from multidisciplinary background and organisations.

items.desc: Powering the world’s payments ecosystem ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments As a Data Scientist you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem! The purpose of the Data Scientist role is: Designs, develops and programs methods, processes, and systems to consolidate and analyze unstructured, diverse “big data” sources to generate actionable insights and solutions for client services and product enhancement. Interacts with product and service teams to identify questions and issues for data analysis and experiments. Develops and codes software programs, algorithms and automated processes to cleanse, integrate and evaluate large datasets from multiple disparate sources. Identifies meaningful insights from large data and metadata sources; interprets and communicates insights and findings from analysis and experiments to product, service, and business managers. A typical day at ACI for a Data Scientist is: - Develops predictive models for customers utilizing a variety of statistical and machine learning algorithms. - Holds responsibility for projects of a moderate degree of complexity and very large volume datasets. - Executes all stages of model development and delivery including data definition, sampling, preprocessing, feature selection, model generation, and validation and support or production model release. - Validates and prepares data for model development, performs exploratory data analysis and data cleaning on large datasets and queries and visualizes data with a variety of tools. - Works collaboratively with a team of scientists and engineers responsible for the development and deployment of the state-of-the-art models for a variety of financial applications. - This includes the design, development and deployment of models that leverage large datasets containing structured and unstructured data. - Perform other duties as assigned. - Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics. Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed to succeed in this role: - Bachelor’s degree required. PhD preferred in Bioinformatics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Statistical Mathematics, Physics, Computational Chemistry or related field - 2+ years industry or related field experience - Experience in development of computational software (basic level with Python, pySPARK, R, SQL) - Knowledge of AI base tools to accelerate coding and implement projects Core Capabilities: We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities — these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together: - Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments. - Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. - Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions. - Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful. - Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. - Courage: stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the Romania on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future. I n return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment. Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally. Important Notice About Recruitment Scams Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company ( www.aciworldwide.com / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment. #Hybrid

Wir begegnen uns offen, duzen uns über alle Positionen hinweg und denken nicht in Hierarchien oder Silos. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und hast je nach Kundensituation die Möglichkeit, von zuhause zu arbeiten. Du arbeitest meist direkt an deinem Heimatort – weil wir Kundennähe wörtlich nehmen und uns Work-Life-Balance am Herzen liegt. Deine Weiterentwicklung wird individuell gefördert: zum Beispiel mit Trainings, Zertifizierungen, dem Besuch von Konferenzen und Fachvorträgen und einem auf dich zugeschnittenen Entwicklungsplan. Einen Teil deines Bruttogehalts kannst du in CGI-Aktien investieren – bis maximal 3 % des Monatsgehalts geben wir für jeden Euro einen weiteren hinzu. Außerdem beteiligen wir dich am Unternehmenserfolg: Du erhältst eine Gewinnbeteiligung, die sich nach deiner individuellen Leistung richtet sowie danach, wie wir als Unternehmen unsere finanziellen Ziele erreichen konnten. Mit Jobticket und Jobbike fördern wir umweltfreundliche Mobilität. Abhängig von deiner Rolle und Projektsituation sind auch Bahncard oder Elektro-Firmenwagen möglich. Sabbatical oder Elternzeit werden unterstützt. Sie sind bei uns kein Karriere-Stopper! Eine Vielzahl an gemeinsamen Events und Freizeitaktivitäten stärkt deine Verbundenheit mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. 1976 gegründet und nach wie vor familiengeführt, ist CGI heute einer der weltweit größten unabhängigen Anbieter von IT und Business Consulting. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten! Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden. Wir profitieren von unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und haben die Möglichkeit und die Verantwortung, die Strategie und Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Deine Arbeit schafft Mehrwert. Du findest innovative Lösungen und stärkst dein Netzwerk aus Kolleg:innen und Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du Zugang zu globalen Ressourcen, um große Ideen zu verwirklichen, neue Chancen zu nutzen und von der immensen Branchen- und Technologie-Kompetenz zu profitieren. Du bringst deine Karriere voran, da du in einem Unternehmen arbeitest, das auf Wachstum und Langlebigkeit ausgelegt ist. Du wirst von Führungskräften unterstützt, die deine Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit fördern – und dir Möglichkeiten bieten, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und deinen Horizont zu erweitern.

items.desc: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. About The Role Callosum believes that orders of magnitude improvements in AI systems will come through application-aware orchestration across heterogeneous hardware. We are building that vision: infrastructure that treats the full landscape of compute as a unified, co-evolving system. Callosum is purposefully placed to be the first place to access and deploy new chips, expanding beyond GPUs to enable a system that works in harmony, greater than the sum of its parts. This role sits at the foundation of Callosum’s stack, enabling the company to run AI workloads beyond the constraints of any single hardware vendor. You will build the low-level systems software - kernels, drivers, runtime tools - that make diverse and novel accelerators viable for real-world inference, surfacing the full strength of new silicon. This infrastructure is what enables us to turn a fragmented accelerator landscape into our platform; you will own the design decisions that directly influence performance and reliability. What You'll Build Build and maintain kernels, device drivers, and firmware for heterogeneous accelerators Design and implement accelerator scheduling at the execution level — kernel launches, dataflow optimisation, and resource management across diverse hardware Optimise execution paths for latency, throughput, and resource utilisation across accelerator types Work closely with internal teams and hardware vendors to onboard new accelerator platforms Contribute to low-level runtime software that bridges our inference stack and the underlying hardware What Sets You Apart Demonstrable interest in a variety of accelerator microarchitectures Deep experience in kernel development, device driver authoring, or firmware engineering Familiarity with accelerator programming models (CUDA, ROCm, or vendor-specific SDKs) Experience with compiler infrastructure such as MLIR or LLVM Strong debugging skills in environments with limited tooling and incomplete documentation What We Offer Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience Equity & Ownership Private healthcare We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all.

items.desc: Ihre Aufgaben Die Beiden Stellen Sind Bewusst Interdisziplinär Angelegt Und Arbeiten Als Tandem Eng Zusammen. Sie Richten Sich An Zwei Profile, Von Denen Ihr Profil Eines Bedienen Sollte Grundschulpädagogisches Profil mit Interesse an Informatik und KI Die Stelle ist am Lehrstuhl für Grundschulpädagogik und -didaktik mit dem Schwerpunkt Lehren und Lernen (Prof. Dr. Bärbel Kopp) angesiedelt und wird von Dr. Saskia Knoth fachlich verantwortet. Sie bringt die grundschulpädagogische und -didaktische Perspektive in das KI-EduLab ein. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Lern- und Lebenswelten von Grundschulkindern, die Gestaltung kindgerechter Lernangebote sowie die Frage, wie Kinder KI verstehen, kritisch reflektieren und für eigene Lernprozesse nutzen können. Dabei verbinden Sie das Lernen über KI als Unterrichtsgegenstand mit dem Lernen mit KI, beispielsweise durch KI-gestützte Werkzeuge zur Diagnose und Förderung.Die Stelle verantwortet die grundschulpädagogische und -didaktische Perspektive des Kollegs: Lernen und Lehren in der Grundschule, die digitale Lebenswelt von Kindern, KI als Unterrichtsgegenstand (Lernen über KI) sowie der Einsatz KI-gestützter Werkzeuge zur Diagnose und Förderung (Lernen mit KI). Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der kritisch-reflexiven Auseinandersetzung mit KI und ihrer Übersetzung in kindgerechte Lernangebote sowie auf der Erprobung in Lernwerkstatt, Schulnetzwerk und Lehrkräftefortbildung. Informatisches Profil mit Interesse an Bildung und Fachdidaktik Informatik Angesiedelt an der Professur für Didaktik der Informatik (Prof. Dr. Marc-Pascal Berges). Die Stelle verantwortet die informatische Perspektive des Kollegs: technische KI-Kompetenz (z. B. maschinelles Lernen, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision), Human-Centered Design und UX/UI für Bildungsanwendungen sowie Barrierefreiheit. Im Mittelpunkt steht, wie Informatikstudierende entlang realer Bedarfe aus Schule und Unterricht Bildungstechnologien gestalten und entwickeln – etwa adaptive Hilfestellungen oder Werkzeuge zur Unterstützung der Leistungsbeurteilung. items.desc: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts. How You'll Make An Impact Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units/factories. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy’s AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts. Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques. Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions. Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services. Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation. Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning. Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination. Improvement in accuracy of outputs by modules. Speed and scalability of prompt deployment across ACE modules within the Transformer Business Unit. Compliance with AI governance and security standards. More About Us At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives. Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes: Competitive salary and incentives Well-being and care Paid and unpaid leave Flexible work options Benefits that support your financial security You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process. For this position, you must have a PhD or equivalent professional qualifications and experience in cell and molecular
items.desc: We are seeking to recruit a Research Fellow in the Faculty of Medicine at the University of Southampton within the Lung Resilience and Remodelling group led by Professor Mark Jones Working as part of a dynamic translational research team consisting of basic and clinical scientists within the NIHR Southampton Biomedical Research Centre, the successful candidate will be based in the Brooke Laboratory at University Hospital Southampton. The role will involve human lung tissue and bronchoalveolar lavage analyses, 3D cell culture (including primary cells), analysis of cell responses by molecular and cellular techniques including ELISA, RT-qPCR, and manipulation of cells by pharmacological and gene knock-out/knock-in techniques. For this position, you must have a PhD or equivalent professional qualifications and experience in cell and molecular biology. Experience of cell culture and at least some of the techniques listed above is essential, while experience in primary lung cell culture, 3D culture techniques, and (immuno)histochemistry is desirable. The ideal candidate will be able to adapt to working with a variety of techniques across different laboratories, working efficiently and diligently, with a strong work ethic and able to use their own initiative. They will be team-oriented, with excellent organisational skills, and reliable. The successful applicant must have excellent spoken and written English communication skills. This is a full time fixed term role until 31st March 2027. For informal enquiries, please contact Professor Mark Jones - mark.jones@soton.ac.uk Applications for Research Fellow positions will be considered from candidates who are working towards or nearing completion of a relevant PhD qualification.

items.desc: Microsoft 365 / AI‑utvecklare för dig som vill sätta riktning, inte följa den. Det här är inte en annons för dig som letar nästa jobb. Det är en inbjudan till dig som redan kan, bygger och som vill påverka hur AI, Copilot och Microsoft 365 faktiskt används i praktiken. Du har en stark utvecklarbakgrund, klivit in i Microsoft 365‑ekosystemet och utforskar AI‑agenter, Copilot Studio, Azure AI och Agents Toolkit, inte för att det är trendigt utan för att det är relevant. Du rör dig obehindrat mellan teknik och verksamhet, bygger fortfarande, men din verkliga styrka ligger i att förstå vad som bör byggas, varför, och hur det faktiskt ska användas. Du är ofta tidig i nya spår, testar, prototypar och drar egna slutsatser långt innan det finns färdiga svar eller best practices. Hos oss får du: Mandat att utforska, visa vägen och påverka hur vi arbetar med M365 och AI framåt. Arbeta nära kund, Microsoft och tekniken, utan onödiga lager. Vara en röst i hur lösningar formas, inte bara levereras. Dela insikter, hålla demos, driva samtal och fungera som ett tekniskt och strategiskt bollplank. Det här är rollen för dig som: Hellre formar en roadmap än tar emot en.. Trivs i dialog snarare än i process. Vill bygga lösningar som förändrar beteenden, inte bara system. Vi bryr oss inte om titlar. Det som spelar roll är ditt mindset, din tekniska tyngd och din vilja att visa vägen i skärningspunkten mellan utveckling, AI och den moderna arbetsplatsen. Om du läser detta och känner “jag söker inte jobb, men det där låter relevant”, då är det precis dig vi vill prata med. Varför Nexer? Här får du kollegor som delar med sig, hejar på dig och bygger tillsammans. Vi gillar frihet under ansvar, öppna dörrar och högt i tak. Och vi älskar att skapa lösningar som är både hållbara och smarta på riktigt. Läs mer om oss här: Välkommen till Nexer EA - Career Hub Vårt partnerskap med Microsoft Vi på Nexer är flerfaldigt utsedda till Microsoft Partner of the Year och har ett mycket nära samarbete med Microsoft, både i Sverige och globalt. Microsoft ser oss som en nyckelpartner för att realisera affärsvärde hos företag som nyttjar deras lösningar. Vi arbetar tillsammans med Microsoft på veckobasis , i allt från strategiska initiativ till gemensamma kundprojekt. En av våra största framgångsfaktorer är vårt breda nätverk inom Microsoft som ger oss värdefulla insikter och närhet till nyheter. Här ges du möjlighet att personligen bredda ditt eget nätverk. Praktiskt Start: Så snart som möjligt, vi tar hänsyn till eventuell uppsägningstid. Omfattning: Heltid under kontorstid med flexibilitet. Plats: Hybrid med kontor i Stockholm, Lund eller Eskilstuna. Rekryteringsprocess Vi arbetar med löpande urval. Processen inkluderar telefonintervju, djupintervjuer och referenstagning. Frågor? Kontakta Claudia Jablonska på claudia.jablonska@nexergroup.com Magnus Avender Konsultchef magnus.avender@nexergroup.com Ansökan: Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan via formuläret nedan. Vi tar tyvärr inte emot ansökningar via e-post.

items.desc: ¿Quieres ser la persona que pone agentes de IA a funcionar en producción, con datos reales y en empresas que gestionan grandes volúmenes de trabajadores? En Nivel IV desarrollamos NET4, el software de gestión de personal y nómina que utilizan cerca de la mitad de las ETTs de España, y NIA, nuestra propia suite de agentes de IA integrada en el producto. Formamos parte de zvoove, grupo europeo líder en software e IA para el sector del staffing. NIA ya está en clientes, y cada vez más empresas la quieren. Buscamos a alguien que convierta cada instalación en algo rápido, fiable y repetible: que deje la IA conectada, probada y funcionando antes de entregarla al cliente, y que vaya automatizando el proceso hasta que instalar NIA sea cuestión de horas, no de semanas. Qué harás Instalar y configurar los agentes de NIA, adaptando parámetros, flujos y permisos a sus procesos. Integrar las APIs de NET4 con los sistemas del cliente y con servicios externos como WhatsApp Business API, webhooks y APIs de modelos de lenguaje. Preparar cada entorno: credenciales, secretos, accesos, certificados y conectividad. Verificar antes de entregar: pruebas de extremo a extremo, pruebas de integración y validación de cada agente con casos reales del cliente. Validar la puesta en marcha con el cliente y emitir el informe de instalación conforme. Resolver las incidencias técnicas durante la instalación y las primeras semanas en producción, escalando a Desarrollo cuando haga falta. Dejar configurada la monitorización (disponibilidad, errores, consumo) y traspasar el cliente a Soporte con la documentación completa. Estandarizar y automatizar la instalación mediante scripts, plantillas, checklists y runbooks. Encajas si… Tienes al menos 1 años de experiencia en implantación técnica de software, integración de sistemas o soporte de nivel 2/3. Has trabajado con APIs REST en la práctica: autenticación OAuth y API keys, pruebas con Postman o similar, y diagnóstico de errores a partir de logs y respuestas. Te mueves con soltura en Azure: App Services, Key Vault, redes y permisos. Usas SQL para comprobar que los datos están donde deben estar. Eres de los que no dan nada por instalado hasta que lo han probado, y lo documentas para que el siguiente no tenga que adivinar. Puedes viajar puntualmente a clientes en España. Suma puntos si… Has integrado LLMs o agentes de IA (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic u otros). Has trabajado con WhatsApp Business API u otras plataformas de mensajería. Conoces el ecosistema .NET y SQL Server. Has trabajado en SaaS con datos sensibles (nómina, salud, finanzas) y con RGPD. Qué te ofrecemos Salario acorde a experiencia aportada. Horario de lunes a jueves de 9:00 a 17:30, viernes de 8:00 a 15:00, e intensiva de 8:00 a 15:00 de junio a septiembre. IA en producción de verdad: agentes que usan clientes reales cada día, no pruebas de concepto. Un producto 100% propio, sobre stack Microsoft y dentro de un grupo europeo en pleno crecimiento. Si te ves en este puesto, escríbenos. Valoramos a las personas por lo que saben hacer y queremos un equipo diverso.

items.desc: Description Du Poste 🎯 Chargé(e) de Gouvernance Data & IA (H/F) 🎯 🚀 Votre rôle Au sein du Département Technologies, le Data Management Office (DMO) pilote la gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Il accompagne les métiers sur la valorisation, la qualité, la maîtrise et la conformité des données, ainsi que sur les usages de l'Intelligence Artificielle. Vous rejoignez une équipe de 9 personnes, dont trois collaborateurs dédiés à la gouvernance Data & IA. Aux côtés des deux collaborateurs déjà en poste, vous faites de la Data et de l'IA des leviers responsables, maîtrisés et créateurs de valeur. Votre rôle ne se limite pas à appliquer un cadre. Vous le faites vivre, vous le challengez et vous le faites progresser. Vous intervenez au croisement des métiers, de la technologie, de la réglementation et de la maîtrise des risques, dans un environnement bancaire où la confiance dans la donnée est un enjeu stratégique. 🧩 Vos missions Vos missions s'organisent autour de quatre axes. 1- Piloter les usages Data & IA Vous pilotez et suivez le développement des usages Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous accompagnez le déploiement de l'Offre de Service Data et diffusez les bonnes pratiques associées auprès des métiers. Vous analysez et challengez les dispositifs existants, identifiez les axes d'amélioration et contribuez à leur mise en œuvre. 2- Garantir la gouvernance, la conformité et la maîtrise des risques Vous contribuez aux travaux de gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous participez aux démarches de conformité et de maîtrise des risques, notamment BCBS 239 et le cadre normatif IA. Vous préparez et contribuez aux instances de gouvernance : Comité Data & IA, Comité de Qualité des Données, Comité d'Homologation IA. Vous assurez une veille sur les évolutions Data, IA, technologiques et réglementaires, et contribuez à leur prise en compte en interne. 3- Améliorer la connaissance et la qualité des données Vous accompagnez les métiers dans la connaissance et la documentation de leurs données. Vous les aidez à identifier les écarts de qualité et à mettre en place des actions d'amélioration concrètes. Vous transformez des problématiques complexes en recommandations claires et opérationnelles. 4- Diffuser une culture Data & IA Vous animez les communautés Data & IA et coordonnez les différents acteurs de la gouvernance des données. Vous concevez et déployez des actions de sensibilisation et d'acculturation à la Data et à l'IA. Vous animez des ateliers et vous faites le lien entre les experts et les métiers. 🧩 Environnement Une équipe DMO de 9 personnes, rattachée au Département Technologies. Un pôle gouvernance Data & IA de trois collaborateurs, dont vous. Des interlocuteurs variés : métiers, équipes techniques, risques, conformité et instances de gouvernance. ⚒ Environnement réglementaire et outils Réglementation : BCBS 239, cadre normatif IA Gouvernance : qualité des données, documentation, homologation des usages IA Outils appréciés : Python, SQL ou tout autre langage d'analyse de données Profil recherché 🧬 Profil recherché 🎓 Formation supérieure en data, gestion des risques, audit, finance, ingénierie ou équivalent. 💼 Expérience réussie en audit, contrôle interne, gestion des risques ou conformité, idéalement en environnement bancaire ou financier. Nous recherchons avant tout un profil hybride. Vous savez prendre de la hauteur sans perdre le fil opérationnel. Vous aimez les sujets complexes, vous savez challenger l'existant et vous formulez des recommandations qui se mettent en œuvre. La Data et l'IA vous passionnent, et vous voulez mettre cette curiosité au service d'usages utiles et maîtrisés. 🤝 Savoir-être et compétences clés Gestion de projet et coordination transverse. Capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de challenge. Connaissance ou forte appétence pour la gouvernance, la qualité et la valorisation des données. Intérêt marqué pour l'IA et ses enjeux de gouvernance, de maîtrise et de conformité. Aisance pour animer des ateliers, des communautés et des instances de gouvernance. Excellentes qualités relationnelles, rédactionnelles et pédagogiques. Curiosité, pragmatisme et sens du collectif. Ce poste ne sera malheureusement pas pour vous cette fois-ci si : vous n'avez aucune expérience en audit, contrôle, gestion des risques, conformité ou gouvernance des données ; Vous ne connaissez pas les principes BCBS239 vous recherchez un poste purement technique de développement ou de data engineering ; vous n'êtes pas à l'aise pour animer des communautés, présenter en comité et embarquer des interlocuteurs variés ; la Data et l'IA ne suscitent pas chez vous une vraie curiosité. 🎯 Ce qui fera la différence Votre capacité à relier les enjeux métiers, technologiques, réglementaires et de maîtrise des risques. Votre goût du challenge constructif, qui fait avancer les dispositifs sans bloquer les projets. Votre pédagogie pour rendre la Data et l'IA accessibles à tous. Une pratique de Python, SQL ou d'un outil …

items.desc: La mejor IA del mundo no sirve de nada si nadie la usa. ¿Te gusta enseñar, acompañar a la gente y ver cómo una herramienta nueva pasa a formar parte de su día a día? En Nivel IV desarrollamos NET4, el software de gestión de personal y nómina que utilizan cerca de la mitad de las ETTs de España, además de empresas de outsourcing, limpieza y facility services. Hemos creado NIA, nuestra propia suite de agentes de IA. Son ocho agentes que asumen el trabajo repetitivo que hoy consume horas a los equipos de nuestros clientes: recoger las horas de los trabajadores por WhatsApp, pasar a nómina los partes en papel, revisar documentación o gestionar la firma de contratos de puesta a disposicion, entre otros. Así, esos equipos pueden dedicar su tiempo a lo que de verdad necesita a una persona. Lo completan la app del trabajador y el control horario de NET4. Formamos parte de zvoove, grupo europeo líder en software e IA para el sector del staffing. La tecnología ya está construida. Buscamos a la persona que acompañe a nuestros clientes para que la usen de verdad: que el equipo de oficina confíe en un agente de IA, y que un trabajador de limpieza, de almacén o de eventos resuelva su trámite en dos minutos desde WhatsApp. Qué harás Ejecutar el despliegue de NIA en tus clientes siguiendo nuestro plan de adopción: pilotos, fases y calendario. Impartir formaciones y sesiones de lanzamiento, presenciales y online, a equipos de oficina y a trabajadores. Preparar y adaptar materiales para cada cliente: guías, vídeos cortos, webinars y mensajes de activación por WhatsApp. Hacer seguimiento de los indicadores de adopción de tu cartera (trabajadores activos, uso de cada agente) y reportar su evolución. Detectar los clientes que se quedan atrás y ejecutar las acciones para reactivarlos. Recoger el feedback de clientes y trabajadores y hacérselo llegar a Producto. Proponer mejoras a nuestro playbook de adopción a partir de lo que ves en el terreno. Detectar oportunidades de crecimiento en tus clientes y trasladarlas a Ventas. Con quién trabajarás Dependerás de la Business Operations Lead y trabajarás a diario con Implantación, Soporte, Producto, Ventas y Marketing. Encajas si… Tienes al menos 2 años de experiencia en Customer Success, formación de usuarios, implantación o soporte de software, o despliegue de herramientas digitales. Dominio del mundillo de la Inteligencia Artificial. Has formado a grupos de usuarios y sabes adaptar el mensaje a quien tienes delante, sea una directora de RRHH o un trabajador que nunca ha usado una herramienta digital de empresa. Comunicas con claridad y te sientes cómodo/a hablando en público, en persona y en vídeo. Eres organizado/a, haces seguimiento sin que te lo pidan y te gusta medir los resultados de tu trabajo. Puedes viajar puntualmente a clientes en España. Suma puntos si… Conoces el sector ETT, outsourcing o facility services. Has participado en despliegues de soluciones de IA, apps de empleado o control horario. Sabes crear contenido formativo: vídeos, tutoriales o guías visuales. Qué te ofrecemos Salario acorde a la experiencia aportada. Horario de lunes a jueves de 9:00 a 17:30, viernes de 8:00 a 15:00, e intensiva de 8:00 a 15:00 de junio a septiembre. Formación completa en NET4 y NIA desde el primer día. La oportunidad de especializarte en adopción de IA, uno de los perfiles con más futuro, en un producto que ya usan clientes reales. Si te ves en este puesto, escríbenos. Valoramos a las personas por lo que saben hacer y queremos un equipo diverso.

Leave no customer workload on-premises by engineering new EC2 instance families with hardware acceleration devices.

items.desc:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The Enterprise Trust & Governance team builds the control plane that lets the world’s largest organizations deploy Perplexity broadly and with confidence. Computer and our agents work across a growing share of our customers’ environments, tools, and models. For administrators, that makes precise, enforceable control essential: who can do what, with which data, through which agents, and within what usage limits. This team makes those controls easy to manage, reliable and consistent across every product, and transparent to the people accountable for them.

This is a product and platform engineering role with end-to-end ownership, from shaping the architecture and policy models to shipping the experiences our customers’ administrators and security teams use every day. You’ll work across product and infrastructure teams to turn complex enterprise requirements into reusable primitives and intuitive controls. The scope spans identity and provisioning, fine-grained role-based access across connectors, tool actions, and models, customer-managed encryption keys, admin APIs, audit logs, and policy and usage controls. Strong governance helps enterprises move from pilots to company-wide rollouts and gives them the confidence to entrust agents with greater responsibility over time.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own enterprise identity and provisioning, including SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM, WorkOS integrations, and support for identity providers such as Okta and Microsoft Entra ID.

 - Build the permissions platform, with fine-grained roles and permissions for connectors, tool actions, models, and model effort levels, enforced consistently across products and agent workflows.

 - Design and ship secure, well-documented admin APIs for audit logs, members, groups, roles, and settings.

 - Build policy controls for model and feature availability, staged rollouts, model deprecations, usage and spend limits, alerts, and cost-center allocation.

 - Build admin-facing analytics for adoption, usage, spend, and policy enforcement, helping organizations measure value and manage their deployments.

 - Deliver audit logs and change notifications that help administrators investigate activity, track configuration changes, and support compliance.

 - Set the technical bar for authorization correctness and reliability, with fast, consistent, explainable permission checks, well-defined failure behavior, and strong tenant isolation.

 - Partner with Product, Design, Security, Sales, and Customer Success to translate complex enterprise requirements into reusable platform capabilities and intuitive admin experiences.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex backend systems from design through production operation.

 - Strong system design skills, including building reliable, scalable, multi-tenant SaaS platforms with clear security and isolation boundaries.

 - Strong proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, or Rust, and hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS and Kubernetes.

 - Deep expertise in at least one of the following:
   
   - Enterprise identity and provisioning, including OAuth, OIDC, SAML, and SCIM.
   
   - Permissions platforms, fine-grained authorization, and policy enforcement.
   
   - Encryption, customer-managed keys, and key lifecycle management.
   
   - Enterprise admin platforms, audit infrastructure, or usage and spend analytics.

 - Experience building or integrating enterprise identity and access systems, including platforms such as WorkOS, Okta, or Microsoft Entra ID.

 - Sound technical judgment in security-sensitive systems, balancing threat models, authorization correctness, and failure behavior with usability and delivery speed.

 - A track record of leading ambiguous, cross-team initiatives from architecture through adoption, setting technical direction for shared platforms, and raising engineering quality through mentorship.

If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification. We value demonstrated impact, deep ownership, and the initiative to turn ambiguity into results.

Description Développement d’instrumentation, automatisation, traitement du signal et analyses de mesures physiques : Application au tennis de table Description du projet L’instrumentation dans le domaine sportif est courante de nos jours, avec pour objectif d’aider les athlètes et les entraîneurs à améliorer leurs performances sportives. Cette instrumentation selon le sport peut être plus ou moins intrusive, allant de la mesure physique au sein d’une aire de jeu, jusqu’aux mesures au plus proche du joueur à l’aide de « wearables » de type montre connectée [1]. Dans le cadre de la thèse de M. Thibault DELUMEAU, traitant de la détection de la fatigue chez les joueurs de tennis de table, une plateforme expérimentale pour la mesure de différents paramètres physiques propres aux joueurs. On retrouve dans ces développements une raquette instrumentée dédiée à la mesure de la gestuelle du joueur. Elle intègre un accéléromètre à 3 axes et une mesure unique dans la littérature scientifique [2] de la pression de la main (poigne et pince) basée sur une mesure de force. Cette dernière pourrait être améliorée afin d’obtenir des informations sur la position d’impact de la balle. Une étude de veille technologique et bibliographique sera à mener par la personne recrutée. Parmi les appareils de mesure de l’aire de jeu, on retrouve un appareil de mesure des paramètres cinétiques de la balle (vitesse linéaire et rotation) par un ensemble de capteurs optiques [3]. Cette mesure, couplée à un système de comptage de rebonds par mesure des vibrations de la table (via un réseau de capteurs piézoélectriques), permet d’obtenir des informations sur les dynamiques de match. Cependant, l’exploitation de ces signaux à l’échelle d’un match reste complexe pris indépendamment, car les séquences de jeu sont souvent polluées par de nombreux faits de jeu (rebonds parasites, filets, etc.). Il devient alors nécessaire de croiser l’ensemble des mesures pour fournir une analyse du jeu fiable. L’objectif du stage serait de fiabiliser les méthodes de mesure et de développer des méthodes d’analyse des signaux en conditions de laboratoire, puis en contact direct avec des joueurs de tennis de table de haut niveau. Le candidat retenu devra être force de proposition autour des axes de travail proposés : Un axe de consolidation des instruments de mesure existants Procédures de calibration et d’étalonnage Explitation des mesures automatique Un axe de développement/amélioration de l’existant Refonte de l’instrumentation de la raquette Développement du dispositif de détection de rebonds Analyse de jeu Création de scripts d’analyses basés sur l’ensemble des mesures (raquette, balle, table) Création de rendus synthétiques de match Profil recherché : Stage de master 1-2 ou équivalent en école d’ingénieurs (durée : 4 à 6 mois). Profil ouvert dans les sciences de l’ingénieur : une expérience en instrumentation ou en traitement du signal est demandée . Une appétence pour le domaine de l’analyse sportive serait un plus. Établissement d’accueil : Le stagiaire évoluera au sein du laboratoire GEPEA, dans l’équipe OSE (Optimisation – Système – Énergie) sur le site de l’IUT de Nantes à Carquefou. La date de démarrage sera déterminée avec le candidat aux alentours de février 2027. Le dépôt des candidatures se fera uniquement par la plateforme ABG. Fournir CV, lettre de motivation, relevé de notes de licence et/ou de M1. Références: 1. Zhang, J. & Oh, S.-S. An Interpretable Deep Learning Framework for Human Activity Recognition in Smart Sport Using Wearable Devices. Int. J. Comput. Intell. Syst. 19 , 170 (2026). 2. Delumeau, T., Deschamps, T., Plot, C., Le Carpentier, E. & Mousseau, P. Identifying neuromuscular and mental fatigue in elite youth table tennis players using machine learning. Sci. Rep. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-40324-w (2026) doi:10.1038/s41598-026-40324-w. 3. Delumeau, T., Plot, C., Le Carpentier, E., Deschamps, T. & Mousseau, P. items.desc: Purpose. Performance. People. Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians. With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide. For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success. The Role As an Associate, Infrastructure, you will support the evaluation, execution, and ongoing management of direct infrastructure investments at CPP Investments. You will conduct investment research, develop financial models and valuation analyses, contribute to investment recommendations, and support transaction execution and portfolio management activities. You will also work with investment teams and portfolio companies to identify and advance value creation opportunities. The Team CPP Investments’ Infrastructure division invests directly in large-scale infrastructure businesses with the objective of delivering defensive, long-term returns, inflation protection, and limited substitution risk. The division takes an active, thematic investment approach across risk profiles, structures, and geographies. The Infrastructure team invests across sectors including regulated utilities, transportation, telecommunications, data centres, and energy. With more than 50 professionals across six global offices, the team manages a portfolio of over 30 direct investments valued at approximately C$60 billion. Accountabilities Research and evaluate infrastructure investment opportunities, including investment merits, risks, expected returns, industry dynamics, regulatory considerations, and financial performance. Develop and maintain financial models and conduct valuation analyses to support investment decisions. Support due diligence processes, including reviewing legal, accounting, strategic, environmental, and other third-party assessments. Engage with company management teams to assess business performance, strategy, outlook, and industry developments. Prepare investment analyses, recommendations, and presentations for investment committees. Support transaction execution, lead selected acquisition workstreams, and coordinate with investment partners and external advisors. Monitor portfolio company performance, support valuation reviews, and contribute to identifying and implementing value creation initiatives. What You Bring Undergraduate degree or college diploma in a relevant field. Experience aligned with an Associate-level investment role, including exposure to acquisitions, due diligence, and/or asset management. Strong financial modelling, valuation, investment research, and analytical skills. Ability to assess complex information, develop actionable insights, and approach challenges creatively. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. An advanced degree or CFA designation is considered an asset. Work with satellite imagery, geospatial data, sensors, and other visual intelligence sources. Take ownership of experimental projects and rapidly explore new ideas and technologies. Collaborate closely with other engineers and technical leadership on key initiatives. Travel every 2–4 weeks for architecture reviews and team events. Experience with computer vision, VLMs, image understanding, or related ML applications. Strong interest in data, analytics, and data pipelines. Exceptional ability and motivation to learn new technologies and domains quickly. Self-directed, hands-on, and comfortable working without close day-to-day management. Strong team player with clear and honest communication. Excellent German language skills. Experience with sensors such as drones, antennas, or cameras. Background in computer vision research, e.g. Fraunhofer IGD or similar. Knowledge of Russian or Ukrainian language. Interest or experience in military, intelligence, defense, or public safety domains. A warm welcome: Every new team member gets a welcome goodie bag. Good people, good times: From summer and Christmas parties to regular team gatherings, we make time to celebrate together. (Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde). Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts : Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté. Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme. Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. items.desc: Research Associate About The Role Advance Your Engineering Career Through Innovation and Impact The Department of Mechanical Engineering is seeking to recruit a Postdoctoral Research Associate to investigate the fluid dynamics and heat transfer in rotating compressor cavities of gas turbines engines. The project is funded by the EPSRC in collaboration with the University of Surrey, Rolls-Royce and Siemens Energy. We are seeking a driven and capable individual to lead a high-impact project developing the next generation of hydrogen-compatible turbomachinery technology. This Position Will Offer You a Way To Apply Your Experience To a Project That Could Shape The Future Of Green Energy Technology And Net-zero Aerospace. As The Research Associate, You’ll Lead a Technically Ambitious Project With Real-world Application And Long-term Value. You’ll Have The Chance To Take ownership of a major research project to advance the understanding of fluid-dynamics and heat transfer through innovative experimental methods Work at the intersection of academia and industry with support from both Develop your skills in leadership, innovation, and strategic technical development Gain access to training and a personal development allowance Broaden your professional network through interaction with industrial partners This role offers the autonomy of an academic position, with the added benefits of structured support and mentoring. The goal is to investigate experimentally the buoyancy-induced rotating flow in a compressor cavity at low TRL. The research is underpinned by brand new instrumentation and to be conducted over a range of non-dimensional, engine-representative conditions. The study includes a fundamental exploration of boundary-layer transition from laminar to turbulent flow at high Grashof number. The experiments will be complemented by computational simulation at the University of Surrey, with the aim to scale data to higher TRL. The successful completion and implementation of this research will improve engine design methods at Rolls-Royce and Siemens for next-generation hydrogen-compatible engines.
