items.desc: Position: Machine Learning Engineer Department: Estimations Reporting to: Data Science Manager Location: Berlin Hybrid role: 3 days a week from our London office & 2 days working from home Full/Part time: Full time Ready for a challenge? Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We're a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it's a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe. About This Role We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with passion for using machine learning to create intelligent applications. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will be part of the Data Science team inside the Product and Tech group with +2200 brilliant developers, engineers, analysts and researchers. You will work with brilliant people with world class knowledge, and a passion for sharing knowledge and solving interesting and complex problems. You will collaboratively design, build, and productionize machine learning systems. As a member of the logistics data science team, you will develop solutions to supply and demand challenges while optimizing logistics algorithms to ensure a reliable, efficient, and profitable service. From predicting ETAs to solving pricing problems, our ML pipelines form the backbone of our delivery operations. These are some of the key components to the role: Researching, implementing, and deploying innovative ML techniques applicable to logistics problems. Scaling and transferring novel machine learning solutions to improve our decision making processes and solutions in their different product use cases. Implementing and launching Data Science applications that coordinate with front facing solutions; constant improvements using performant and efficient ML models. Implementing tools, data pipelines, and evaluation frameworks to enable development, iteration, and launch of ML ideas within the product scope. What will you bring to the team? Strong experience in Machine Learning, developing real time data streaming technologies for forecast or logistics products. Strong coding and software engineering skills in Python. Able to work independently and solve complex problems, with a demonstrated ability to productise and deploy using cloud services (e.g. Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform). Strong background in working with microservices and event-driven architecture, serverless computing, and cloud architecture patterns. Familiarity with tools and packages including Kubernetes (deployment in production) is expected. A plus would be additional experience with Airflow/Mlflow/Docker/Flink. Experience collaborating closely with multi-functional teams, driving forward best practices. Real-time production systems at scale (millions of requests/transactions per day) is desirable. At JET, This Is How We Play Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side. At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again. Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition. Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day. What else are we delivering? Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys. Are you ready to join the team? Apply now!

items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth. As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details. What You’ll Do Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making; Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers; Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights. What We’re Looking For Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics; Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems; Fluency in English, both spoken and written. Nice-to-Have Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas; Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python; Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets. €38,000 - €75,000 a year Please note: this is the same position as the one referred as “Data Scientist” on our career site, posted with different job titles to reach STEM students and graduates who might not know a Data Scientist role suits them. Why you'll love it here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 💵 Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from €38k up to €75k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

items.desc: Hello. We’re Teya. Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better. They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business. Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work. We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand. If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you Data Scientist Your Mission We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Credit & Analytics team at Teya and help build the models that underpin our lending products. You will support the development of the credit risk and pricing models that help us make better decisions for the small businesses we serve across multiple geographies. You will work across the model lifecycle, from data exploration and feature development through to deployment and performance monitoring. Working alongside senior data scientists, you will learn how to develop models in a statistically sound way and see first-hand how they shape credit decisions, pricing and portfolio performance. You will collaborate with Credit Strategy, Analytics, Product, Engineering and Data Engineering, building your understanding of how data science creates real business value. From day one, your work will contribute to live products used by our Members. This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the start of their data science career, with a strong quantitative background and a genuine interest in credit and lending, who wants to learn fast in a high-growth fintech. Responsibilities Model development: Build and test components of credit risk and pricing models, under guidance from senior team members. Data exploration: Explore internal and external data sources, clean and prepare real-world datasets, and engineer features that could improve our models. Analysis: Carry out analysis of merchant behaviour, repayment performance and product performance to answer well-defined business questions. Model monitoring: Help track model performance, flag changes or drift, and support investigations into what is driving them. Model deployment: Support Data Engineering with deploying models onto the ML Platform and integrating them into the credit decisioning system. Documentation: Document your work clearly so models and analysis are easy to understand, review and build on. Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Engineering and Credit Strategy, and actively seek feedback from senior data scientists to develop your technical and commercial skills. Requirements 0–2 years' experience in data science, quantitative analysis or a related field. Degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline. Solid grounding in statistics and an understanding of core machine learning techniques. Working knowledge of Python and SQL, with experience handling and analysing real-world datasets. Ability to explain analytical work clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Curious, pragmatic and commercially minded, with a desire to understand how models drive business outcomes. Eagerness to learn, take on feedback and grow within a collaborative team. Exposure to credit risk modelling or financial services is a plus. The Perks We trust you, so we offer flexible working hours, as long as it suits both you and your team. Physical and mental health support through our partnership with WellHub, giving free access to over 1,500 gyms in the UK, 1-1 therapy, meditation sessions, and digital fitness and nutrition apps. Our company offers extended and improved maternity and paternity leave choices, giving employees more flexibility and support. Cycle-to-Work Scheme. Health and Life Insurance. Pension Scheme. 25 days of Annual Leave (plus Bank Holidays). Office snacks every day. Friendly, comfortable, and informal office environment in Central London. Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process …

items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth. As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details. What You’ll Do Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making; Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers; Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights. What We’re Looking For Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics; Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems; Fluency in English, both spoken and written. Nice-to-Have Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas; Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python; Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets. £80,000 - £160,000 a year Please note: this is the same position as the one referred as “Data Scientist” on our career site, posted with different job titles to reach STEM students and graduates who might not know a Data Scientist role suits them. Why you'll love it here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 💵 Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from £80k up to £160k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. items.desc: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. Stockholm | Full-time | Onsite, five days a week The team AI Enablement makes Legora AI-native by default. We work across three streams in parallel: building internal agents and tools, equipping teams to build their own, and owning the standards, access and guardrails that let everyone move fast safely. We own the AI platforms and the internal products built on them. So far that includes Leya, an internal knowledge agent live in Slack that answers questions about Legora with cited sources and automates parts of our RFP and security questionnaire work. A structured, agent-readable knowledge base assembled from knowledge each domain continues to own, where agents propose changes and humans approve them. Leyf, a platform for internally built apps that lands anyone's app on shared infrastructure with guardrails scaled to how much damage it could do. And a Skills Hub, so that something one person works out becomes something the whole company can use rather than staying on their laptop. The team is small and the mandate is large. That is the job. What makes this hard Legora is an AI company of around a thousand people, most already fluent and on current tools. Internal AI here is not an adoption problem. Nobody needs convincing, which means there is nowhere to hide behind change management or training. If something we build is not used, it is because it was not good enough. Our colleagues know what good looks like and will not use something worse than what they think they could build themselves in an afternoon. So we ship things people genuinely want, and the foundations arrive with them. That constraint does not go away. The mandate is also larger than the team. The part no individual can do for themselves is the infrastructure, the access model and the architecture underneath, and getting that right across a company this size is the actual work. It does not come with a specification. What you will do You will take broad ownership of how AI works inside Legora and of the platforms we build to make it work. Build internal agents, tools and platforms, and treat them as products rather than projects. Quality, reliability and whether they actually serve the business are yours, not someone else's Take a broad goal, work out what is actually required, and break it into the work yourself Own what you build end to end, from the architecture through to whether people use it and it holds up in production Shape what we should build and in what order, and argue for it Design the foundations: knowledge architecture, access and permissions, evaluation and monitoring, the guardrails that scale with risk Work directly with the people who will use what you build, across the whole company, including the parts furthest from engineering Who we are looking for Strong engineering fundamentals. You build production systems, not prototypes that need someone else to finish them Real depth with LLM-based systems. Agents, retrieval, evaluation, tool use. You know where these systems break and you design for it Ownership by instinct. You do not wait for a specification. When the requirement is unclear or wrong, you say so and propose something better Three kinds of understanding at once. Technical, domain and business. You can hold a conversation about architecture and a conversation about what the business actually needs, and connect them Openness. You take feedback, build on other people's ideas, change your mind when the evidence moves, and push for the strongest outcome rather than the one you proposed first Comfort with ambiguity. New team, fast growth, decisions that get revisited as we learn. That should sound …

items.desc: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts. How You'll Make An Impact Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units/factories. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy’s AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts. Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques. Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions. Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services. Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation. Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning. Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination. Improvement in accuracy of outputs by modules. Speed and scalability of prompt deployment across ACE modules within the Transformer Business Unit. items.desc: What if you could help build AI capabilities that don't belong to just one product – but become part of how an entire product ecosystem evolves? At Assessio, our vision is Zero Talent Waste . We help organisations make fairer, more objective people decisions through science, technology and data – creating better outcomes for businesses while helping more people reach their full potential. We've now created a dedicated AI Squad to build AI-powered capabilities and shared services across our products, including pre- and post-hiring. Some of what we're building doesn't exist yet. The problems are real, but the technical solutions aren't always predefined. That's where you come in. We're looking for an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer who is comfortable navigating complexity, taking ownership and helping shape the technical way forward. About The Role As an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer in our AI Squad , you'll work across product, technology and codebases to turn ideas and business needs into scalable, production-ready solutions. You'll work closely with Product from discovery onwards – understanding the problem, challenging assumptions, identifying technical risks and helping decide how we should build the solution. You'll contribute across the stack, with a strong focus on backend services, APIs, data and system design. And while AI is central to the squad, you don't need to be an AI specialist . We're looking for a strong software engineer who already uses AI in their development work and is curious about what it can enable. What You'll Be Working On Designing and building backend services, APIs, frontend interfaces and integrations. Building AI-powered capabilities and shared services that can support multiple products. Taking solutions from discovery and technical design through implementation and production. Challenging solutions, identifying risks and making pragmatic technical trade-offs. Exploring unfamiliar technologies and codebases rather than staying within one preferred stack. Deploying, monitoring and improving production systems with reliability and maintainability in mind. Using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve how you develop, test and solve problems. Contributing to architecture decisions and engineering practices. Who are you? You're an experienced software engineer who is comfortable taking ownership of complex technical problems and making sound engineering decisions without needing the path to be predefined. You enjoy understanding why something should be built before deciding how to build it. You probably have technologies you know particularly well, but you don't define yourself by one language or framework. You're curious about unfamiliar systems, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to learn when the problem takes you outside your usual stack. Most importantly, you take ownership. You don't just execute tickets – you explore problems, propose solutions and take responsibility for getting them into production. We believe you have Strong software engineering fundamentals and the technical judgement to apply them across different languages, frameworks and architectural contexts. Genuine Full Stack experience across backend and frontend development. Strong backend, API and data experience, combined with solid system design thinking. Worked with AI-assisted development workflows and tooling. Experience building and maintaining software in production. The ability to learn new technologies and navigate unfamiliar codebases. A product mindset and pragmatic approach to technical decision-making. Good communication skills and excellent written and spoken English and Estonian. You may have worked with technologies such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or Ruby – but we're much more interested in your engineering fundamentals and ability to learn than in matching every technology in our current stack. It would be a plus if you have Built or integrated AI/LLM-powered functionality in production. Experience across several languages, frameworks or product codebases. Experience with shared services, platform architecture or scaling SaaS applications. Worked with cloud environments, CI/CD, automated testing and observability. An understanding of security, privacy or compliance in software development. Why this role? You'll join a relatively new squad with the opportunity to influence both what we build and how we build it. You'll help create capabilities from scratch that can eventually be used across different products and technologies, while becoming part of our growing Tallinn office and collaborating with colleagues across Engineering, Product and the wider Assessio Group. Deine Aufgaben: Du entwickelst Software- und KI-Lösungen zur Optimierung und Automatisierung unserer Inbound-Supply-Chain- und Logistikprozesse. Dabei arbeitest Du sowohl an klassischen Entwicklungsaufgaben als auch an modernen AI-Anwendungen und unterstützt den Aufbau technischer Grundlagen, die künftig für unterschiedliche Use Cases genutzt werden können. Ein wesentlicher Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe ist die Mitgestaltung einer modernen AI-Plattform, deren Architektur, technologische Standards und Betriebsmodell aktuell entstehen. Du bringst Deine Ideen in technische Entscheidungen ein, unterstützt bei der Auswahl geeigneter Technologien und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team nachhaltige Lösungsansätze. Du entwickelst, erweiterst und betreibst Backend-Services, Schnittstellen, Integrationskomponenten und gegebenenfalls Frontend- oder UI-Anpassungen. Dazu gehört auch die Anbindung interner und externer Systeme, Datenquellen, APIs und Services, um durchgängige digitale Prozesse innerhalb der Inbound-Logistik zu ermöglichen. Im AI-Kontext konzipierst und implementierst Du Lösungen auf Basis moderner Large Language Models (LLM), Agenten und Retrieval-gestützter Systeme. Zudem passt Du Plattformkomponenten wie OpenWebUI, LiteLLM oder vergleichbare Lösungen an unsere Anforderungen an und entwickelst diese sukzessive weiter. Gleichzeitig evaluierst Du neue Technologien, Frameworks und AI-Trends und unterstützt damit die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattform- und Softwarearchitektur. Darüber hinaus wirkst Du am Aufbau einer stabilen, sicheren und skalierbaren Betriebsumgebung mit, beispielsweise auf Basis moderner Container- und Cloud-Technologien. items.title: AI Adoption Partner
items.card: The role has three equally weighted objectives: make K3 more efficient; create new or better value for clients; and improve colleagues' working lives by removing repetitive, low-value work. It sits at the intersection of three things that must move together - the Group AI & Data Strategy, the pace the business wants to move at and the obligations (cyber, data and regulatory) K3 already carries as a professional
items.desc: The AI Adoption Partner is a hands-on AI delivery role where progress is measured in hours and days, not months and years. Our AI is delivered through a defined, sanctioned toolset and inside a clear governance envelope, not through open experimentation with whatever tool is fastest to hand. Embedded in the business rather than in IT, each AI Adoption Partner finds where AI genuinely moves the needle for their cluster, builds it using internal and external tools and makes sure it is adopted, measured and where it works, spread to the rest of the Group. The role has three equally weighted objectives: make K3 more efficient; create new or better value for clients; and improve colleagues' working lives by removing repetitive, low-value work. It sits at the intersection of three things that must move together - the Group AI & Data Strategy, the pace the business wants to move at and the obligations (cyber, data and regulatory) K3 already carries as a professional services group. Why this role is different This is a live build role inside a Group that has already done the strategic groundwork: an approved AI assistant (Aimee), an approved no-code build environment (Claude Artifacts), a Group AI & Data Strategy and a Cyber Security Strategy already in flight. The AI Adoption Partner does not start from a blank page, they start from a governed platform and a live strategic portfolio, and their job is to turn that into delivered, measured value inside their cluster. Success is tangible and is tracked centrally: time released, stronger client outcomes, new revenue, reduced risk, and a measurably better colleague experience. Operating Boundaries — What “responsible And Fast” Means Here Speed in this role comes from working inside a known toolset and a known governance model, not around one. Every AI Adoption Partner works within: Approved toolset only: Aimee and Claude Artifacts. No shadow AI, personal AI accounts, or unapproved frontier-model access. K3's AI Policy and “Golden Rule,” data protection obligations and professional / client confidentiality duties, applied from the first prototype not at go-live. EU AI Act obligations relevant to K3's dual provider / deployer status, including mandatory risk-tiering of any new use case before it touches live client or candidate data. Cost governance: all model usage routed and monitored under the Group's model-routing policy. Person specification Essential Proven use of AI and generative AI to deliver measurable business outcomes, ideally including a named conversational AI assistant and a no-code AI build tool (e.g. a Copilot-class assistant, Claude Artifacts/similar). End-to-end delivery experience: problem definition, prototyping, rollout and adoption. Able to understand a business problem quickly and turn it into a working solution at pace, inside a defined toolset. Sound working knowledge of data protection, client confidentiality and responsible AI in a professional or regulated environment; able to apply a risk-tiering process without being told each time. Clear communicator, credible with partners, fee-earners and support teams alike. Curious and adaptable, willing to challenge established ways of working while maintaining trust, professional judgement and toolset discipline. Desirable Professional services or regulated-advisory experience. Change, product, process-mapping or lean delivery experience. With over 1,200 employees across the Group, 25 offices in the UK, and international bases in Malaysia and Cyprus

We value
items.desc: Overview Join a fast-paced, high-impact team at the forefront of developer productivity and AI integration. As a Software Engineer in the DevDiv division, you’ll help create the next generation of development tools that empower millions of developers to bring their ideas to life more quickly and intuitively. We’re looking for engineers who share our belief that AI will fundamentally transform software development and who are eager to help shape that future. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, engage with the open-source community, and contribute to platforms that redefine how developers build, debug, and ship software. Our work spans from high-level developer experience to deep technical systems that require a strong understanding of low-level programming concepts such as memory management, performance optimization, and system architecture. We value engineers who enjoy digging into the fundamentals, whether it’s understanding how compilers work, optimizing runtime performance, or building scalable, efficient services from the ground up. At DevDiv, we foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement. We build tools that help developers work smarter, and we use the same tools ourselves to constantly improve how we build software. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong software engineering skills with a passion for low-level technologies and a desire to use AI to enhance development workflows. Responsibilities Design and develop robust, scalable, and maintainable software components that power modern developer tools. Leverage AI-powered technologies (e.g., GitHub Copilot, LLM-based code tools) to accelerate engineering workflows and contribute to the development of AI-assisted features. Dogfood internal AI tools and platforms, providing feedback and insights to improve usability, reliability, and effectiveness. Collaborate with engineers across product teams and the open-source community to co-design and iterate on developer experiences. Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and agile ceremonies, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning. Research and experiment with emerging AI techniques and integrate them into everyday engineering practices to boost productivity. Qualifications Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Solid programming skills in one or more of the following languages: C#, Java, C++, or Python. Passion for developer experience and an eagerness to understand what makes great tools. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across diverse, distributed teams. items.desc: L'entreprise Vous cherchez à développer vos talents en Cornouaille ? CORNOUALIA , c'est 25 ans d'expertise dans le recrutement et l'accompagnement de collaborateurs à temps partagé. Pour vous, un emploi construit sur mesure, ajustable et personnalisé par nos équipes: UN seul contrat et de nombreux avantages! 1 employeur, des entreprises, 1 CDI ! Chef de projet: Transition IA Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de projet intégration IA et transformation des processus métiers à temps partagé capable de faire le lien entre les besoins opérationnels, les possibilités offertes par l’IA et les enjeux humains de la transformation. Vous partirez du terrain pour comprendre les processus, identifier les tâches pouvant être simplifiées ou automatisées, faire émerger les cas d’usage les plus pertinents et accompagner leur mise en œuvre auprès des entreprises désireuses de s'approprier de maniere sécurisé la puissance de l'IA. Agents IA, automatisations, solutions no-code ou low-code, conduite du changement : vous transformerez les idées en solutions concrètes, utiles et mesurables, en collaboration avec les métiers, le SI, la direction et les partenaires techniques et vous les mettrez en place. Si vous souhaitez contribuer à une transformation numérique ambitieuse, responsable et ancrée dans les réalités du terrain, ce poste vous donnera l’occasion d’en être l’un des acteurs clés. A ce titre, vous accompagnez les entreprises adhérentes de Cornoualia pour: 2. Analyser et transformer les processus métiers 3. Qualifier et prioriser les cas d’usage IA 4. Concevoir et intégrer des solutions IA 5. Animer et accompagner l’adoption 6. Contribuer à la gouvernance et à la maîtrise des risques Construire et piloter la feuille de route numérique et IA Formaliser le plan de déploiement numérique et IA. Définir les priorités, les jalons, les responsabilités et les modalités de gouvernance. Définir des indicateurs permettant de mesurer la valeur créée, l’adoption et la qualité des solutions. Cartographier les processus, les flux d’information et les outils utilisés. Identifier les tâches répétitives, chronophages ou à faible valeur ajoutée. Repérer les opportunités de simplification, d’automatisation et d’intégration de l’IA quand nécéssaires, receuillir les besoins métiers Évaluer chaque cas d’usage selon sa valeur, sa faisabilité, son coût, ses risques et son niveau de maturité. Constituer et piloter un portefeuille de projets IA et automatisation. Identifier les projets pouvant faire l’objet d’une expérimentation rapide. Éviter les projets centrés sur l’outil sans bénéfice métier clairement défini. Traduire les besoins métiers en scénarios fonctionnels. Concevoir ou superviser des assistants, agents IA et workflows automatisés. Définir les données, les consignes, les règles de gestion, les connexions aux outils et les étapes de validation humaine. Réaliser ou faire réaliser des prototypes. Organiser les tests avec les utilisateurs. Piloter le passage du prototype à une solution réellement intégrée aux processus de l’entreprise. Développer l’acculturation aux usages de l’IA, notamment autour de Copilot et des autres outils retenus. Créer des supports, guides et méthodes d’utilisation. Suivre l’adoption et accompagner la levée des résistances. Participer à la diffusion et à l’application de la Charte IA. Intégrer les exigences liées à la confidentialité, à la protection des données et à la cybersécurité. Contribuer au volet sensibilisation de NIS2. Mettre en place des règles de contrôle, de traçabilité et de validation humaine. Veiller à la fiabilité des solutions et à la maîtrise des risques liés aux usages de l’IA. Assurer la documentation, le transfert de compétences et la pérennité des solutions. Profil recherché Nous recherchons un profil curieux, pragmatique et fédérateur, capable de dialoguer aussi bien avec les équipes opérationnelles qu’avec le CODIR. Un profil qui sait que la réussite d’un projet IA ne dépend pas seulement de la technologie, mais aussi de sa pertinence métier, de sa fiabilité et de son appropriation en interne. expérience en transformation numérique, amélioration des processus ou gestion de projets transverses ; maîtrise du recueil et de la formalisation des besoins métiers ; compréhension opérationnelle de l’IA générative, des agents IA et de l’automatisation ; capacité à concevoir ou superviser un prototype ; connaissance des outils no-code ou low-code, des API et des mécanismes d’intégration est un plus important sens pédagogique et capacité à rendre les sujets techniques accessibles ; compréhension des enjeux de gouvernance, de sécurité et de protection des données.

items.desc: Bouw mee aan de marketingmotor van Artura Stel je voor: een sterk product, tevreden klanten en een markt die er klaar voor is. Alleen weten nog te weinig mensen dat we bestaan. Daar kom jij in beeld. Over Artura Bij Artura geloven we dat system integrators beter verdienen dan versnipperde tools en eindeloos zoeken naar de juiste informatie. Daarom bouwen we één platform waarin systeemontwerp, engineering, productbeheer en projectinformatie samenkomen. Ons product werkt en onze klanten merken het verschil. Nu willen we dat verhaal bij veel meer mensen krijgen. We staan aan het begin van een groeispurt en zoeken iemand die die groei mee in gang zet. Waarom deze rol bijzonder is. Je stapt niet in een bestaande marketingafdeling met vaste processen. Je begint met een wit blad en de vrijheid om het goed te doen. Als Founding Marketeer bouw je onze marketing vanaf de basis op. Niet als een reeks losse campagnes of posts, maar als een slimme groeimotor die steeds meer zelf draait. Je bent architect en bouwer tegelijk: je bedenkt de strategie en je zet hem ook zelf om in de praktijk. AI is daarbij geen hype maar een echte hefboom. Wij moedigen je aan om te experimenteren, te automatiseren en met een klein team een grote impact te maken. Waar je mee aan de slag gaat Strategie & positionering : samen met ons scherp krijgen wie we zijn, voor wie we het doen en waarom dat ertoe doet. Content & thought leadership : verhalen vertellen die onze doelgroep echt verder helpen. Growth marketing & leadgeneratie : de juiste mensen bereiken en interesse omzetten in gesprekken. AI & marketingautomatisering : terugkerend werk slim automatiseren, zodat jij tijd overhoudt voor wat telt. Data & optimalisatie : meten, leren, bijsturen en een aanpak bouwen die beter wordt naarmate we groeien. Je hoeft dit niet allemaal al op dag één te beheersen. Belangrijker is dat je de mogelijkheden ziet, ze graag uitprobeert en ideeën echt laat werken. Herken je jezelf? Je krijgt energie van iets opbouwen en ziet kansen waar anderen vooral werk zien. Je denkt strategisch én doet het zelf : een plan uitwerken, een artikel schrijven of een automatisering opzetten voelt allemaal natuurlijk aan. AI hoort bij je dagelijkse werk. Je volgt nieuwe tools op de voet en zoekt altijd naar slimmere manieren. Je denkt in systemen en ziet hoe processen elkaar versterken. Je bent ondernemend , neemt initiatief en voelt je thuis als nog niet alles vastligt. Je wilt weten wat je werk oplevert en leert graag van de cijfers. Je maakt complexe dingen helder en aantrekkelijk in woord en beeld. Je leert snel en durft dingen uit te proberen. Ervaring in B2B, SaaS, growth, content of marketing automation is mooi meegenomen. Maar nieuwsgierigheid, initiatief en de drive om iets neer te zetten wegen voor ons zwaarder dan een perfect cv. Hoe jouw eerste jaar eruit kan zien De eerste maanden leer je onze klanten en markt kennen, scherp je samen met ons de positionering aan, kies je de eerste kanalen en leg je een stevige basis voor content en meting. Daarna bouw je aan een herhaalbare groeiaanpak: content verschijnt structureel, campagnes worden getest en verbeterd, en marketing en sales trekken steeds meer samen op. Op langere termijn groeit dit uit tot een geïntegreerd geheel waarin data, content, CRM en AI elkaar versterken. Een systeem dat continu leert en steeds meer zelf doet, terwijl jij de richting bepaalt. Succes meten we niet in aantallen posts of tools, maar in wat echt telt: naamsbekendheid, goede leads, demo’s en de groei van Artura. Wat je van ons mag verwachten Echt eigenaarschap : dit is jouw kans om marketing te bouwen zoals jij gelooft dat het moet. Impact die je ziet : jouw werk bepaalt mee hoe Artura groeit. Ruimte om te experimenteren : nieuwe ideeën zijn welkom, ook als ze anders zijn. Afwisseling : van storytelling tot technologie, data en commerciële groei. Korte lijnen : je werkt direct samen met het team en ziet snel resultaat. Groeiperspectief : groeit Artura, dan groei jij mee, richting marketing leadership en je eigen team. De concrete arbeidsvoorwaarden en werkvorm bespreken we graag in een persoonlijk gesprek. Zin om mee te bouwen? We maken graag kennis! Vertel ons niet alleen wat je al gedaan hebt, maar vooral wat je zou willen bouwen. Hoe zou jij Artura in de markt zetten? Wat zou je automatiseren? En hoe zou jij AI inzetten om met weinig mensen veel te bereiken? Geen kant-en-klaar antwoord nodig. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar hoe jij denkt. Let’s build the marketing engine. Samen.

Using Python, SQL, AI, machine learning or BI tools to explore data, identify patterns and generate insights clients can use. Building data pipelines, dashboards, reports or analytical outputs that help clients monitor risk and make better decisions. Quello che rilasci lo segui finché non hai la prova che funziona. • I prossimi prodotti. Il modello costruito sulla casa è pensato per estendersi ad altri rami: quello che scrivi quest'anno deve reggere anche il prodotto successivo. CHI CERCHIAMO • Da 2 a 4 anni su prodotti web in produzione, con utenti veri e soldi veri. TypeScript, React e Next.js sono il nostro stack quotidiano. Se arrivi da uno stack diverso ma hai lo stesso tipo di esperienza, parliamone: il linguaggio si impara, il giudizio no. • Full stack nel senso letterale. Nello stesso giorno ti può capitare l'interfaccia, il database e un'integrazione esterna. Non ti serve essere il migliore in ognuna, ti serve non fermarti davanti a nessuna. • Scrivi codice con gli agenti AI ogni giorno, e sai dove non fidarti. Qui è il modo normale di lavorare, non un esperimento. Ci interessa di più sentirti raccontare la volta che un agente ti ha fatto sbagliare, e cosa hai cambiato dopo, che l'elenco degli strumenti che usi. • Davanti a un numero che non torna apri i dati. Sai distinguere un bug da un problema di misurazione, e una spiegazione plausibile da una dimostrata. • Lavori in autonomia dentro priorità chiare. Sai cosa conta questa settimana e perché, e come arrivarci lo decidi tu. Hai accesso diretto al founder e al CTO, e una risposta lo stesso giorno in cui la chiedi. • Scrivi in modo che chi legge possa agire senza chiederti chiarimenti. In un team così piccolo, quello che non è scritto non esiste. COSA OFFRIAMO • RAL da 30k a 40k in base all'esperienza. Se porti risultati, la RAL cresce con te e valutiamo anche l'ingresso nel piano ESOP. • Milano, ibrido e flessibile. • Responsabilità vera. Quello che decidi resta, e si vede. • Velocità. Quello che scrivi va in produzione in pochi giorni, davanti a clienti che pagano. Tra una decisione e un rilascio non c'è nessuna coda. • L'AI come modo di lavorare. Budget per gli strumenti che vuoi usare, senza dover giustificare un abbonamento che ti fa risparmiare una giornata. • Un perimetro che si allarga. Il team tecnico cresce, e chi lo fa funzionare cresce con lui. COME FUNZIONA LA SELEZIONE Siamo veloci anche qui. Ogni candidatura viene letta con l'aiuto di un agente AI e confermata da una persona, poi i passaggi sono tre: • Una call tecnica con il CTO. Ci porti dentro qualcosa che hai costruito tu e noi insistiamo sul perché di ogni scelta. • Una conversazione con il founder, su come lavori e su cosa cerchi. • Un incontro finale, in cui parliamo dell'offerta. Dal primo contatto all'ultimo passaggio passano pochi giorni, non settimane. Rispondiamo a tutti, anche quando la risposta è no. PRIMA DI CANDIDARTI • Mandaci qualcosa che hai costruito: un repository, un prodotto online, un lavoro di cui vai fiero. Vale più del CV. • Due righe su come usi l'AI per scrivere codice oggi. La lettera di presentazione non serve. • Se ti riconosci in quasi tutto ma non in tutto, scrivici lo stesso e dicci su quale parte dovresti crescere. COME CANDIDARSI Scrivi a jobs@mamainsurance.it JD completa: https://www.notion.so/AI-Software-Engineer-3f8025bce8bc8182861effe6e53b4b79

items.desc: About The Role We are looking for a hands-on Security Engineer - Application Security, GRC & AI to join the R&D team of a rapidly growing international technology company serving more than 50 million users worldwide. As the company's sole dedicated Security Engineer , you will take end-to-end ownership of security operations, covering application security, vulnerability management, governance, risk assessment, internal IT security and emerging AI-related threats. Track identified vulnerabilities and ensure timely remediation in collaboration with engineering teams. Assess application security risks and recommend practical technical solutions. Review and manage user access permissions across internal systems. Strengthen identity and access management controls. Support device security management, including mobile device management (MDM). Collaborate with engineering teams to identify and mitigate AI-related security risks. Research emerging AI security techniques, tools and defensive approaches. items.desc: Description Du Poste 🎯 Chargé(e) de Gouvernance Data & IA (H/F) 🎯 🚀 Votre rôle Au sein du Département Technologies, le Data Management Office (DMO) pilote la gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Il accompagne les métiers sur la valorisation, la qualité, la maîtrise et la conformité des données, ainsi que sur les usages de l'Intelligence Artificielle. Vous rejoignez une équipe de 9 personnes, dont trois collaborateurs dédiés à la gouvernance Data & IA. Aux côtés des deux collaborateurs déjà en poste, vous faites de la Data et de l'IA des leviers responsables, maîtrisés et créateurs de valeur. Votre rôle ne se limite pas à appliquer un cadre. Vous le faites vivre, vous le challengez et vous le faites progresser. Vous intervenez au croisement des métiers, de la technologie, de la réglementation et de la maîtrise des risques, dans un environnement bancaire où la confiance dans la donnée est un enjeu stratégique. 🧩 Vos missions Vos missions s'organisent autour de quatre axes. 1- Piloter les usages Data & IA Vous pilotez et suivez le développement des usages Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous accompagnez le déploiement de l'Offre de Service Data et diffusez les bonnes pratiques associées auprès des métiers. Vous analysez et challengez les dispositifs existants, identifiez les axes d'amélioration et contribuez à leur mise en œuvre. 2- Garantir la gouvernance, la conformité et la maîtrise des risques Vous contribuez aux travaux de gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous participez aux démarches de conformité et de maîtrise des risques, notamment BCBS 239 et le cadre normatif IA. Vous préparez et contribuez aux instances de gouvernance : Comité Data & IA, Comité de Qualité des Données, Comité d'Homologation IA. Vous assurez une veille sur les évolutions Data, IA, technologiques et réglementaires, et contribuez à leur prise en compte en interne. 3- Améliorer la connaissance et la qualité des données Vous accompagnez les métiers dans la connaissance et la documentation de leurs données. Vous les aidez à identifier les écarts de qualité et à mettre en place des actions d'amélioration concrètes. Vous transformez des problématiques complexes en recommandations claires et opérationnelles. 4- Diffuser une culture Data & IA Vous animez les communautés Data & IA et coordonnez les différents acteurs de la gouvernance des données. Vous concevez et déployez des actions de sensibilisation et d'acculturation à la Data et à l'IA. Vous animez des ateliers et vous faites le lien entre les experts et les métiers. 🧩 Environnement Une équipe DMO de 9 personnes, rattachée au Département Technologies. Un pôle gouvernance Data & IA de trois collaborateurs, dont vous. Des interlocuteurs variés : métiers, équipes techniques, risques, conformité et instances de gouvernance. ⚒ Environnement réglementaire et outils Réglementation : BCBS 239, cadre normatif IA Gouvernance : qualité des données, documentation, homologation des usages IA Outils appréciés : Python, SQL ou tout autre langage d'analyse de données Profil recherché 🧬 Profil recherché 🎓 Formation supérieure en data, gestion des risques, audit, finance, ingénierie ou équivalent. 💼 Expérience réussie en audit, contrôle interne, gestion des risques ou conformité, idéalement en environnement bancaire ou financier. Nous recherchons avant tout un profil hybride. Vous savez prendre de la hauteur sans perdre le fil opérationnel. Vous aimez les sujets complexes, vous savez challenger l'existant et vous formulez des recommandations qui se mettent en œuvre. La Data et l'IA vous passionnent, et vous voulez mettre cette curiosité au service d'usages utiles et maîtrisés. 🤝 Savoir-être et compétences clés Gestion de projet et coordination transverse. Capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de challenge. Connaissance ou forte appétence pour la gouvernance, la qualité et la valorisation des données. Intérêt marqué pour l'IA et ses enjeux de gouvernance, de maîtrise et de conformité. Aisance pour animer des ateliers, des communautés et des instances de gouvernance. Excellentes qualités relationnelles, rédactionnelles et pédagogiques. Curiosité, pragmatisme et sens du collectif. Ce poste ne sera malheureusement pas pour vous cette fois-ci si : vous n'avez aucune expérience en audit, contrôle, gestion des risques, conformité ou gouvernance des données ; Vous ne connaissez pas les principes BCBS239 vous recherchez un poste purement technique de développement ou de data engineering ; vous n'êtes pas à l'aise pour animer des communautés, présenter en comité et embarquer des interlocuteurs variés ; la Data et l'IA ne suscitent pas chez vous une vraie curiosité. 🎯 Ce qui fera la différence Votre capacité à relier les enjeux métiers, technologiques, réglementaires et de maîtrise des risques. Votre goût du challenge constructif, qui fait avancer les dispositifs sans bloquer les projets. Votre pédagogie pour rendre la Data et l'IA accessibles à tous. Une pratique de Python, SQL ou d'un outil …

items.desc: Role Description The Centre for Reviews and Dissemination (CRD) at the University of York is recruiting a Grade 6 or Grade 7 Research Fellow in Health Economics. CRD is a world-leading academic research department specialising in evidence synthesis and health technology assessment (HTA). Our work spans a broad range of health and public health areas, providing high-quality evidence to inform national policy and practice decisions. The successful candidate will work primarily within our Technology Assessment Review (TAR) programme, undertaking research to support National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) decision-making as part of the York External Assessment Group (EAG). You will also contribute to our NIHR Evidence Synthesis Group (ESG) programme and broader health economic modelling projects across CRD, with scope to develop your own research interests. We welcome applications from candidates with a relevant Master’s degree and/or PhD (or equivalent experience) in health economics or another quantitative discipline, such as applied statistics or mathematics. Candidates must possess strong quantitative skills, a comprehensive knowledge of health economics and cost-effectiveness analysis, and a good understanding of HTA, systematic reviews, and meta-analysis. Candidates applying for Grade 7 must additionally have experience of critiquing, conceptualising, and constructing health economic decision models in an HTA context, as well as proven ability to lead research elements and supervise early-career researchers. Familiarity with UK health systems and research funding is desirable. Further training and career development will be supported. CRD offers a friendly, supportive environment and holds a Silver Athena SWAN award. We embrace hybrid and flexible working (minimum 0.8 FTE / 4 days per week). This is an open-ended full-time position. We actively encourage applications from underrepresented groups, particularly Black, Asian, and Minority Ethnic candidates. Please state on your application whether you are applying for Grade 6 or Grade 7. Interview date: To be confirmed Informal enquiries: Contact Matthew Walton (matthew.walton@york.ac.uk), Ash Bullement (ash.bullement@york.ac.uk), or Professor Sofia Dias (sofia.dias@york.ac.uk). The University strives to be diverse and inclusive – a place where we can ALL be ourselves. We particularly encourage applications from people who identify as Black, Asian or from a Minority Ethnic background, who are underrepresented at the University. We offer family friendly, flexible working arrangements, with forums and inclusive facilities to support our staff. #EqualityatYork As a Disability Confident employer, we will ensure that a fair and proportionate number of disabled applicants that meet the minimum (essential) criteria for each position will be offered an interview. Read more about the University of York’s commitments under the Disability Confident scheme.

items.desc: Are you a physicist or engineer passionate about solving complex technological challenges at the intersection of materials science, electromagnetism, and cutting-edge ultrasonic and eddy current technologies? Do you want to shape the future of non-destructive evaluation (NDE) for some of the most critical industries, including nuclear energy and next-generation Small Modular Reactors (SMRs)? If so, we want to meet you. Who are we? At INETEC, we push the boundaries of technology, designing and developing groundbreaking solutions for space, NDE, and the nuclear industry. Our innovations aren’t just theoretical, they’re applied globally, safeguarding vital infrastructure and advancing projects like ITER (International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor), and SMR technology, which are shaping the future of clean energy. We are looking for a top-tier R&D Expert ready to tackle fundamental technological challenges, and make a lasting impact through theoretical research, experimental validation, and transformative product design. What will you do? Role Your role will be a blend of advanced research, experimentation, and product innovation, with a focus on materials science, electromagnetism, and advanced NDE technologies: Research: Explore new ultrasonic and eddy current technologies and trends for industrial and space NDE applications, with a focus on advanced materials (e.g., ceramics, single crystals, thin and thick films). Materials development: Investigate and optimize piezoelectric, electromagnetic, and acoustically passive materials to enhance the performance of NDE systems. Conceptual design: Lead the development of next-generation ultrasonic and eddy current probes tailored for critical applications in industries such as nuclear energy and SMRs. Simulation and modeling: Design, simulate, and validate probe and instrumentation concepts using advanced computational tools. Product development: Collaborate on the design of state-of-the-art industrial instrumentation for NDE, integrating cutting-edge ultrasonic and electromagnetic technologies. Innovation: Continuously improve existing technologies to maximize quality, efficiency, and reliability while minimizing production costs. Documentation: Prepare comprehensive technical instructions, design documentation, and product procedures in compliance with international quality standards. Leadership: Manage small R&D teams and foster collaboration with business and academic partners to achieve ambitious goals. Exploration: Stay ahead of emerging technological trends in NDE, especially in the context of SMRs and other advanced nuclear technologies. Who are we looking for? We are searching for an exceptional individual with the following qualifications: A Master’s or PhD in physics, materials science, engineering, or a related field. Deep understanding of ultrasonic and electromagnetic (eddy current) technologies for NDE. Strong background in materials science and the ability to link material properties to advanced NDE solutions. Experience with computational modeling and simulation tools. A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to thrive in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment. Proficiency in English (written and spoken). A passion for innovation and a desire to work on impactful projects. What do we offer? At INETEC, You Will Find An Environment That Fuels Innovation And Supports Your Professional Growth. Here’s What You Can Expect Impactful work: Join a team that’s shaping the future of NDE for critical industries, including nuclear energy and SMRs. Cutting-edge projects: Work on groundbreaking technologies deployed globally, from nuclear power plants to fusion projects like ITER. Collaborative culture: Collaborate with leading experts in materials science, electromagnetism, mechanical engineering, software development, and electronics. Innovation-driven environment : Bring your ideas to life with full support from an organization that values creativity and problem-solving. Career development: Benefit from structured career plans and opportunities to grow through EU-funded projects and international collaborations. Global reach: Be part of a company whose technologies have a transformative impact worldwide. Your opportunity to shape the future starts here. Join us in advancing the science and technology that power the industries of tomorrow. Apply today! Submit your application by 26.10.2026.

As a Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer, working out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will own control law design and the system identification that feeds it,
items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role Harmattan AI is pushing the boundaries of high-speed autonomous flight, where control has to hold up at the edge of the envelope. Getting that right across a family of airframes is one of the most demanding parts of the flight software. As a Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer, working out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will own control law design and the system identification that feeds it, setting the control standard as the team grows. You will weigh classical against learning-based methods, from tuned control laws to reinforcement-learning policies trained in simulation and flown on hardware, and decide what actually flies. Responsibilities System Identification: Design excitation maneuvers and fit airframe models from flight data, with quantified error bounds. Control Law Design & Tuning: Inner rate and attitude loops through outer position loops, with allocation, gain scheduling, and manual or automated tuning across the airframe family and flight envelope. Sim-to-Real: Keep the in-house simulator faithful to the identified model, so control developed in simulation transfers to the aircraft. Model Consumption: Turn the stability derivatives and coefficient tables from Aerodynamics into flying control. Flight Test & Diagnosis: Verify across simulation, SITL, and HITL, including Monte Carlo campaigns, then fly and iterate from logs. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior control and GNC engineers. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, controls, robotics, or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree. System Identification & Control: Proven, hands-on identification and control on multirotor or fixed-wing platforms, validated in flight, with depth in at least one of MPC, INDI, or geometric control. Embedded Realization: Real-time control implementation on constrained targets, split cleanly between a microcontroller and a companion computer. Learning-Based Control: Familiarity with reinforcement learning and simulation-based training, and the judgment to know when a learned policy beats a classical design. Professional Attributes: Empirical and hardware-honest, disciplined about experiments and validation, grounded in real flight data. Communicates clearly, able to present control and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality. Bonus: Multi-airframe or hover-to-cruise transition experience. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
The AI Regulatory Engineer supports the development and release of AI-enabled healthcare software, and will provide guidance and set directions for the engineering operation in the area of AI/ML Product Releases within the healthcare industry. The position will work as an integrated member of cross-functional teams alongside Data Scientists, Software Developers, Data Engineers, Quality, Clinical, and Product stakeholders. 
 Job Description 
 Responsibilities 
 Provide regulatory guidance from concept through product release and post-market activities.
 Translate GEHC regulatory expectations into practical requirements for AI, software, data, and model development.
 Support regulatory strategy, risk assessments, change assessments, and release readiness.
 Review and contribute to technical documentation, including intended use, traceability, risk management, data governance, model performance, verification, and validation.
 Assess the regulatory impact of changes to software, models, training data, workflows, and intended use.
 Support submissions, audits, regulatory questions, and maintenance of product documentation.
 Help teams address topics such as model limitations, bias, robustness, explainability, monitoring, and version control.
 The ideal candidate is hands-on, pragmatic, and comfortable participating in technical discussions, team planning, risk reviews, and release activities.
 Required Qualifications 
 Experience with regulatory affairs for medical devices, SaMD, digital health, or healthcare software.
 Familiarity with AI/ML development and related regulatory expectations.
 Understanding of risk management, design controls, software lifecycle processes, and change control.
 Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and communicate clearly.
 Experience working in regulated product development environments.
 Desired Characteristics 
 Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.
 Inclusion & Diversity 
 GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities.
 Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

items.desc:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About Anthropic 
 Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About Beneficial Deployments 
 Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.
 About the Role 
 We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our Beneficial Deployments, Life Sciences team. This is a partner-facing role: you'll support nonprofits, research institutes, academic medical centres and public-sector funders as they use Claude to get treatments to patients with rare and neglected diseases, where there is little or no commercial incentive to fund development.
 The role focuses on clinical development, where we think Claude can help these partners today. Trials in these diseases have small patient populations, investigator-led or nonprofit funding and little operational support, and they often stall on protocol quality, operational risk and site start-up. Claude can help teams design better trials and start them sooner. Much of this work is drug repurposing: testing new uses for approved, usually off-patent or generic medicines, whose known safety profiles can let a good hypothesis reach patients years sooner than a new molecule.
 You'll advise and embed in partners' teams, building alongside their engineers, scientists and clinicians.
 Responsibilities 
 Work with partners' trial teams to design, review and prioritise clinical trials with Claude: drafting and reviewing protocols and statistical analysis plans, and flagging enrolment and operational risks.
 Build and validate tools that help partners find new uses for approved, mostly off-patent medicines in rare and neglected diseases, from literature, omics and patient data, and assemble the evidence so the partner can decide the next step.
 Build reusable infrastructure other institutions can adopt (MCP servers for biomedical data sources, agent skills, benchmarks grounded in real clinical questions), and feed what you learn in the field back to product, engineering and research.
 You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have 
 Hands-on clinical development experience: designing, running or analysing clinical trials, or assessing clinical evidence to decide which programmes go forward (for example due diligence or asset evaluation). Drug repurposing work as part of that is a strong plus, as is having contributed to a regulatory submission for a trial.
 Comfort with biomedical data: literature, omics, and real-world patient data (health records, registries, claims), ideally inside secure or trusted research environments.
 Strong engineering skills: you can take an LLM-powered tool from prototype to production code, and write evals to measure it.
 Experience working directly with external partners or customers in a technical role.
 Clear written and verbal communication: docs other institutes can use without you, and results clinicians trust.
 A scrappy mentality: you're comfortable in ambiguity, wear several hats, and do what it takes to get a result for a partner.

 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
 Annual Salary:
 £225,000 — £255,000 GBP 
 Logistics

items.card: You will build and operate the large-scale search and services that our models rely on as tools — from self-hosted, web-scale, search indexes to knowledge graphs and databases served through MCP. You will work closely with researchers and with the pretraining data, sandbox and data platform teams to make these services reliable, scalable and fast, on infrastructure measured in hundreds of terabytes of NVMe storage
items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.



Role Summary

We are seeking a talented and experienced Research Engineer to join our newly forming Search and Services Platform team within Research Platform. You will build and operate the large-scale search and services that our models rely on as tools — from self-hosted, web-scale, search indexes to knowledge graphs and databases served through MCP. You will work closely with researchers and with the pretraining data, sandbox and data platform teams to make these services reliable, scalable and fast, on infrastructure measured in hundreds of terabytes of NVMe storage and thousands of CPU cores to support both data generation and critical training runs.



What you will do

As a Research Engineer on the Search and Services team, your responsibilities will include (but may not be limited to):

 - Designing, building and operating large-scale search infrastructure: self-hosted Vespa clusters indexing web-scale corpora, managed indexes for smaller corpora, and vendor search endpoints.

 - Self-hosting and maintaining a wide range of structured data sources — knowledge graphs (Wikidata, UniProt, Materials Project), scholarly data (OpenAlex, OpenAIRE), statistical databases (Eurostat, World Bank, IMF, OECD), open data portals and more.

 - Designing interfaces and tools to expose to the models and agents to use the services in different ways (direct YQL or SPARQL queries, or more refined and constrained MCPs to mimic external services) to support data generation and agentic training.

 - Building the data pipelines that ingest, index and serve massive datasets, including indexing our own pretraining corpora for exploration, deduplication and eval-leakage checks.

 - Building strong relationships with researchers and adjacent teams (pretraining data,, sandbox, data platform), understanding their workflows and enabling them to achieve more by leveraging your expertise.

 - Communicating and producing documentation or any content that will help teams make the most of the services you'll build.



About you

 - 5+ years of successful experience in search engineering, data infrastructure, or a similar SRE / platform role.

 - Proficiency in software development (Python, Go...) and programming best practices.

 - Hands-on experience with large-scale search or data systems (e.g. Vespa, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch, ClickHouse or similar).

 - Exposure to site reliability engineering: root cause analysis, in-production troubleshooting, on-call rotations...)

 - Exposure to infrastructure management: containerization, orchestration (Kubernetes), infra-as-code, monitoring, logging, alerting, observability...).

 - Experience designing and operating data pipelines that address large amounts of data.

 - Excellent problem-solving and communication skills (ability to contextualizing, gauging risks and getting buy-in for high stakes and impactful solutions).

 - Ownership, high agency and constantly seeking to learn and improving things for others.

 - Autonomous, self-driven and able to work well in a fast-paced startup environment.

 - Low ego and team spirit mindset.

 - Your application will be all the more interesting if you also have:

 - First-hand Vespa (or equivalent large-scale information retrieval) experience.

 - Experience building or operating MCP servers / tool-serving infrastructure for LLMs.

 - Familiarity with knowledge graphs, RDF / SPARQL, or large structured databases (PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, DuckDB...).

 - Experience with large bare-metal infrastructure or HPC environments.




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.
