items.desc:
Overview 
 Are you passionate about using data to shape exceptional user experiences? Do you want your work to directly impact the lives of billions of people around the world? Microsoft Development Center Norway (MDCN) is expanding, and we’re looking for a talented Data Scientist who thrives on solving complex problems and delivering insights that drive innovation. 
 Who we are 
 Microsoft Development Center Norway (MDCN) is a key engineering hub within Microsoft’s Experiences & Devices division, with offices in Oslo, Trondheim, and Tromsø. Our teams are at the forefront of building and scaling the next generation of Copilot and Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities across Microsoft 365 - powering products like M365 Copilot, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, Skype, and Microsoft Teams. 
 We work on some of the world’s most advanced distributed systems, operating across hundreds of data centres globally. Our solutions are used by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies, non-profits, and hundreds of millions of users every day. 
 To deliver on our mission to empower people and organizations to achieve more, we leverage data to inform decision-making, optimize outcomes, and produce innovative solutions. We offer an agile development environment with diverse expertise in algorithms and data structures, big data, data science, machine learning, and search technology. The position is full-time and based in our Norway offices. We are looking for people who thrive in collaborative environments and are excited to push the boundaries of what AI can do for millions of users worldwide. If you are ready to work on cutting-edge technology with real impact, MDCN is the place for you. 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 Responsibilities 
 As a Data Scientist, you will work on some of the world’s largest and most advanced services, leveraging data to improve user experiences, enhance service quality, and drive measurable impact at global scale. You will partner with teams across Microsoft to analyse complex datasets, generate actionable insights, and shape the behaviour of intelligent services that empower millions of users every day. 
 Apply data analysis, AI, and modelling techniques to understand user behaviour, identify opportunities, and inform product improvements. 
 Write robust, reusable, and extensible code to support analysis, modelling, and operationalization at scale. 
 Use AI-powered tools in your daily work to accelerate analysis, experimentation, and solution development.

 AI is fundamentally changing how people work and how organisations think about their technology estate. As AI evolves from cloud-only experiences to a hybrid model spanning cloud and on-device intelligence, the endpoint is becoming an increasingly important part of an organisation's AI strategy.
 Join Microsoft as a Surface Specialist and help customers prepare their workforce and technology estate for this new era of AI-powered computing.  Ultimately, your role is to help customers answer a new strategic question: is their device estate ready for the AI workloads, experiences and ways of working that are coming next?

About Us 
 Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations gets older and a shortage in staff, healthcare system is under pressure. Our missions is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care.
 Our product enables careteams to intervene, prevent and operator more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms captures activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signal used for both react fast to risk events, like falls, and long term health analysis, for care teams to take actions.
 Teton is scaling fast, operating in Nordics, UK, DACH and US. Recently raised 20M $$ series A. Expect travel to the US, to meet users and team members.
 We focus relentless on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for cares. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, striving to always raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you.
 If you are looking for a 9-17 job, perform best with structure and struggle dealing with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration between a hard working, high agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use.
 The Job 
 We are looking for a strong backend engineer to help scale the core infrastructure powering Teton’s platform.
 Our systems ingest and process continuous streams of real-time data from thousands of deployed edge devices across care facilities. These systems power critical alerts and operational workflows used by healthcare staff around the clock.
 You will work across:
 Distributed data ingestion systems
 Real-time event pipelines
 APIs and backend services
 Databases and storage systems
 MQTT infrastructure and edge communication
 Reliability, observability, and system performance
 Cloud infrastructure and deployment architecture
 Qualifications: 
 We care more about engineering ability and ownership than specific credentials, but strong candidates will likely have experience with several of the following:
 Building and operating large-scale backend or distributed systems
 Designing reliable real-time data pipelines
 Working with event-driven architectures and asynchronous systems
 Scaling APIs and services handling high-throughput workloads
 Operating production infrastructure with strong reliability requirements
 Database design and performance optimization
 Cloud infrastructure and deployment tooling
 Debugging complex production issues under pressure
 What We Offer 
 Participation in our warrant program (stock options).
 A small team where your decisions directly shape the product.
 A Copenhagen-based office with close collaboration, no async-only culture.
 Work on software that healthcare workers depend on every day, the impact is tangible and immediate.
 Join Our Team 
 We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job.
 At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work.
 If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

items.desc:
About Us
 At Teton, we are redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology. Facing a global nursing shortage, our solutions offer vital support to overburdened health systems. With thousands of patient rooms across 4 countries already benefiting from our technology, we are aiming to expand to much more. We distinguish ourselves by focusing relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, rapidly deploying solutions that make a real difference.
 The Job
 Every patient room we deploy into puts another device on infrastructure we don't control, in a building we can't easily visit, running software that has to keep working. We're looking for an Engineer to own that problem: the systems, tooling, and infrastructure that let us ship to thousands of edge devices confidently and understand what they're doing once they're out there.
 In this role, you will focus on the following areas of interest:
 Fleet Management: Build and run the systems that provision, monitor, and manage our devices in the field, from first boot in a hospital room to end of life.
 OTA & Release Engineering: Own how software gets onto devices: staged rollouts, health checks, automatic rollback, and the confidence that a bad release won't take down a ward.
 Observability: Design the telemetry, logging, and alerting that tell us a device is degrading before a nurse notices. Make remote debugging possible so we don't fly to fix things.
 Device Bring-Up & Debugging: Work with our hardware and firmware teams on new hardware revisions, reproduce field issues on the bench, and get to the bottom of problems that span kernel, driver, network, and application.
 Infrastructure & Tooling: Build the CI/CD, image builds, and internal tools that let the whole engineering team ship to hardware quickly and safely.
 Documentation: Maintain clear and detailed documentation of your work to ensure easy collaboration and knowledge sharing within the team.
 Qualifications:
 Solid experience running Linux systems in production: ideally embedded or edge Linux, not just cloud VMs.
 Proficiency in Rust and/or Javascript/Typescript and/or Python
 Experience with device fleets at scale: provisioning, OTA update mechanisms (Mender, RAUC, balena, or something you built yourself), and remote access to constrained devices.
 Familiarity with Linux internals: systemd, kernel modules, device tree, networking stack, containers.
 Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar) and designing what to measure, not just wiring up dashboards.
 Comfortable with hardware debugging: serial consoles, working alongside hardware engineers
 Understanding of communication protocols and how devices talk to each other and to us: I2C, SPI, UART, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, MQTT.
 Pragmatism about networks you don't control: restrictive hospital IT, VLANs, proxies, flaky Wi-Fi, and long offline periods.
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
 Experience with the NVIDIA Jetson platform and Linux for Tegra is a big plus.
 Experience with Yocto, Debian packaging, or custom image builds is a plus.
 Experience in the medical device or healthcare technology field is a plus.
 What We Offer
 Participation in our warrant program (stock options).
 Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.
 A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.
 A role where you can make a significant impact on healthcare delivery.
 Join Our Team
 We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job. At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work. If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

items.desc: Aanbod Als digital workplace & AI specialist bij Wienerberger maak je deel uit van een internationale en gerenommeerde organisatie met een lokaal en familiaal karakter. items.desc: Détails de L'OFFRE Vous interviendrez au sein des départements IT de nos clients, dans les équipes responsables des outils dédiés à la lutte contre blanchiment et le financement du terrorisme, ou du respect des sanctions internationales. Vos MISSIONS Vous occuperez le rôle de Business Analyst et serez un élément clé pour aider nos clients dans la définition et/ou la mise en œuvre de leur stratégie LCB/FT. Votre poste pourra nécessiter que vous soyez capable d'analyser de nombreuses données pour alimenter les réflexions et les travaux. Vous pourrez notamment être amené(e) à réaliser les actions suivantes : Analyse des données, identification des cas, Simulations et estimations des impacts des optimisations ou autres évolutions des modèles de détection, Recueil et analyse des besoins métiers, Animation d'ateliers, Diagnostic du dispositif existant, Analyse des recommandations d'audit interne ou externe, Gap analysis, Définition des évolutions ou paramétrages nécessaires dans les outils, Rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles, Planification et suivi de la mise en œuvre, Rédaction de documents de synthèse, de présentation ou de suivi projet, Définition, réalisation et/ou suivi des plans de tests (contrôles de cohérences, tests fonctionnels ou de non régression, etc. ...) Votre PROFIL Diplômé(e) d'un niveau Master (Ecole de commerce, d'ingénieurs ou d'une université), vous avez une expérience significative en tant que MOA dans le domaine de la LCB/FT ou d'autres thèmes de la Sécurité Financière. Vous maitrisez les techniques d'analyse et de restitution des données. Vos expériences vous ont permis de maitriser un ou plusieurs outils du marché utilisés pour la détection et le traitement des alertes. Vous savez allier autonomie et esprit d'équipe, rigueur et capacité de synthèse, mais aussi être force de proposition et être proactif ou proactive. Idéalement, vous avez déjà réalisé la cartographie des risques, participé à des missions d'audit et/ou mis en place des plans de contrôle interne en lien avec les dispositifs LCB/FT. Une première expérience dans le domaine de l'IA ou du machine learning sera également un atout. Vos COMPÉTENCES Outre les savoir-faire nécessaires à la réalisation des missions énumérées ci-dessus, votre parcours a démontré les compétences suivantes : Techniques de data sciences, d'analyse des données et de restitution, Connaissance des modèles de détection, Expérience dans les données nécessaires et leur gestion, Compréhension des enjeux métiers liés à la LCB/FT et plus largement à la Sécurité Financière, Maitrise d'au moins un outil comme Actimize SAM, Netreveal, Fircosoft Trust ou Continuity, pour la mise en œuvre de modèles/scénarios et son paramétrage, Rédaction ou mise à jour de la documentation projet, notamment pour garantir la traçabilité des décisions ou des justifications pour les paramètres appliqués, Maîtrise de l'anglais obligatoire, à l'écrit et à l'oral, Capacité à travailler en méthodologie Agile (Scrum, Safe, ...) et cycle projet " En V ". Une bonne connaissance des types de messages transactionnels (Swift, MX), ou des mécanismes de lignage des données sont des plus.

items.desc: Job ID: 828744 Associate AI Inference Engineer (m/f/d/x) Hamburg Junior entry Regular T-Systems International GmbH About the position T-Systems is building Europe's next generation of AI infrastructure with the AI Industry Cloud powered by thousands of NVIDIA GPUs, including the latest generation of NVIDIA DGX B200 and B300 systems. Our platform enables companies to deploy, scale, and operate cutting-edge large language models (LLMs) and generative AI applications on a secure and high-performance infrastructure. We are looking for an Associate AI Inference Engineer to join our AI platform team. In this role, you will support the provision, operation and optimization of productive LLM inference services based on the T-Systems AI Foundation platform, which is operated on the Industrial AI Cloud. Working closely with platform engineers, AI researchers and software developers, you will help provide high-performance and reliable AI services for enterprise customers. Optimize inference workloads on NVIDIA GPU infrastructure for latency, throughput, and GPU utilization. Benchmarking and evaluation of LLM serving frameworks, inference configurations, and model deployments. Implementation and optimization of modern LLM serving techniques, such as kV cache optimization, continuous batching, and distributed inference. Working with platform engineers to deploy and scale AI workloads on Kubernetes. Analyze and fix performance issues in inference operations across software, network, and GPU infrastructure. Involvement in automating deployment, benchmarking, and operational processes Monitor inference services using metrics, logging, and dashboards to ensure reliable production operations. Working closely with AI engineers and researchers to onboard new foundation models and inference technologies. Maintaining technical documentation and participating in the continuous development of the AI inference platform. Must-Have Skills Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, information technology or a comparable technical field. A master's degree in artificial intelligence, machine learning, or a related field is an advantage. Relevant practical experience in AI engineering, machine learning engineering, or AI infrastructure engineering, including experience as a working student or research engineer. Very good programming skills in Python as well as experience in developing AI applications and corresponding tools. Practical experience deploying, benchmarking, or optimizing large language model (LLM) inference workloads. Practical experience with modern LLM serving frameworks such as vLLM and sGLang. Practical experience optimizing LLM inference workloads on NVIDIA GPU infrastructure and points of contact with NVIDIA DGX/HGX systems or next-generation GPU platforms such as B200 and B300. Experience with evaluating or optimizing advanced inference techniques such as KV caching, disaggregated prefill/decode inference, or comparable LLM serving optimizations. Knowledge of modern NVIDIA inference technologies such as NVIDIA Dynamo, LMCache, Tensorrt-LLM, Triton Inference Server, or comparable GPU inference frameworks. Experience benchmarking AI models and analyzing inference performance, latency, throughput, and serving efficiency. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Bash, and Linux-based compute environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as the ability to collaborate within multi-disciplinary engineering teams. Willingness to travel of up to 50%. International experience, for example through study, work or extended stays abroad. Nice-to-have Skills Knowledge of CUDA, NCCL, NVLink, GPUDirect RDMA, or InfiniBand Networking Experience running productive AI services on Kubernetes. Knowledge of observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry. Experience with Helm, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Infrastructure-as-Code Experience with enterprise AI platforms or multi-tenant inference environments. Knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases or embedded retrieval systems. What we offer The opportunity to work on one of Europe's largest enterprise AI platforms. Hands-on experience with advanced LLM inference technologies, including AI Foundation, vLLM, sGLang, Tensorrt-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, and lmCache. items.desc: Job ID: 862811 AI Testing Engineer – Open 6G Lab (m/f/d/x) Berlin Professional Temporary (Part Time Possible) Deutsche Telekom AG About the Position Help us shape how 6G networks are tested. Deutsche Telekom’s Open 6G Lab is part of the Deutsche Telekom 6G Program. It turns 6G concepts, AI-native network functions, Open RAN technologies and strategic use cases into demonstrable, validated results. We are looking for an AI Test Engineer with RAN expertise to join our multidisciplinary team. You will work with other Lab members and report functionally to the Functional Technical Open 6G Lab Lead. Together, you will design, set up, run and evaluate end-to-end tests—and build AI-based automation for testing and certification. Practical ability to develop or use scripts and automation (for example, Python) and to analyze logs, telemetry and test data. Experience with AI/ML solutions or test automation, and motivation to apply AI across test planning, execution, result analysis and reporting. Knowledge of 3GPP or O-RAN Alliance specifications, test procedures or certification activities; relevant certification is welcome. Experience with CI/CD, ML/LLM pipelines, automated validation or deployment. The mindset we value You are curious about how complex systems behave, careful with evidence and open about what test results do—and do not—show. items.desc: At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees. Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so. Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us! The Role For the Advanced Bioassay & Characterization team we are looking for an enthusiastic and inspiring Research Associate (RA)! The group develops mainly cell-based potency assays used internally and by external parties, such as Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs), to demonstrate the quality and characteristics of our antibody products used in clinical studies. Where possible, automation tools are implemented to support the ongoing activities of this bioassay team. We are looking for a laboratory professional who is genuinely enthusiastic about hands-on experimental work and is motivated to build their expertise in a predominantly lab-based role. The majority of your time will be spent in the laboratory, performing experiments. The remainder of your time will be dedicated to data analysis, interpretation, documentation and discussing results with colleagues. Working alongside scientists and fellow research associates, you will coordinate laboratory activities for multiple projects simultaneously. You will be joining a group of down-to-earth colleagues who value openness, collaboration and a good sense of humour. We work closely together and enjoy supporting one another, while embracing the fact that priorities in drug development can change quickly and no two weeks are exactly the same. We are therefore looking for someone who enjoys a dynamic environment, stays flexible when plans shift, and takes pride in delivering high-quality work. If you enjoy being hands-on in the lab, have a keen eye for detail, and like being part of a supportive team that celebrates successes together, we look forward to receiving your application! This position provides temporary leave coverage, so we offer a 12-month fixed-term contract. Responsibilities As Research Associate in our team, you will be working in a team of scientists and research associates dedicated to developing and validating functional bioassays. Specifically, you will participate in assay development for one of our clinical candidates. We are currently in a growing phase with a ‘knock your socks off’ pipeline of new antibody products. That is where you come in and help us realize our growth ambitions! Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: Working with scientists and RAs to set-up and execute cell-based bioassays; Conducting activities related to assigned study (e.g. conducting experiments, interpretation, and documentation); Presenting results to various teams. Requirements A development focused position lies in store for you. You are someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced biotechnology environment. With your experience in performing and developing cell-based assays, you take an active role in your field of expertise. You are highly motivated to achieve the goals that are important to Genmab’s therapeutic antibody projects. Specifically, we ask the following of you: You have a BSc/HLO degree in a life science related field; Relevant experience in performing bioassays, in industry or academia for at least 1 year. Knowledge of and/or work experience with cell-based assays, flow cytometry and immune-oncology assays. Knowledge and/or work experience with SPR would be an advantage. You are highly organized and are energized by delivering on high-quality documentation. Ability to work on several projects in parallel to each other and adjust priorities appropriately. Team player with pro-active attitude and can-do mentality. Fluency in English. You must already be based in the Netherlands at the time of application. items.desc: Placeringsort Göteborg Diarienummer FK 2026/030664 Varje år fattar Försäkringskassan 21 miljoner beslut som påverkar människors liv och hela samhället. Vi betalar ut cirka 260 miljarder kronor varje år. Det är allas skattepengar vi har hand om. Det är ett stort ansvar. Därför tänker vi nytt och använder den senaste tekniken för att förenkla och förbättra, utveckla och leverera it-tjänsterna för den svenska socialförsäkringen. Välkommen till en av Sveriges största IT-avdelningar. Inom vår enhet arbetar vi med utveckling, implementation, skalning och drift av AI-tjänster som skapar insikter och effektiviserar handläggnings- och stödprocesser inom Försäkringskassan. Vi utvecklar även AI-tjänster som kan erbjudas externt och bidrar till kunskapsspridning, omvärldsbevakning och samverkan inom AI- och dataområdet. Nu söker vi en it-verksamhetsutvecklare som vill bidra till att omsätta verksamhetens behov till utveckling och användning av AI-baserade lösningar. Hos oss får du använda din kompetens i ett område som utvecklas snabbt och där ditt arbete bidrar till Försäkringskassans samhällsviktiga uppdrag. Du får ta ansvar, påverka utvecklingen och bidra med nya idéer tillsammans med kollegor med olika kompetenser och perspektiv. Vi delar kunskap, utmanar befintliga arbetssätt och lär av varandra. Verksamhetsutveckling, Ai, kommunikation och myndighetssamverkan Som verksamhetsutvecklare arbetar du med att identifiera behov och skapa förutsättningar för utveckling av Försäkringskassans interna processer. Hos oss får du möjlighet att göra verklig samhällsnytta genom att bidra till vårt uppdrag: att öka tryggheten och minska brottsligheten. IT är ett avgörande verktyg i detta arbete, och vår IT-avdelning med drygt 1 400 medarbetare spelar en central roll i det brottsförebyggande och brottsbekämpande arbetet genom att tillhandahålla effektiva och säkra IT-tjänster till hela organisationen. Inom IT-avdelningen finns AI-plattform, en nyetablerad och expansiv grupp som ansvarar för myndighetens generella AI-förmåga och centrala lösningar. Teamet är placerat i Stockholm och består idag av sex medarbetare, där samtliga är erfarna Data Scientists som arbetat tillsammans i flera år. Nu växer vi och söker två plattformsingenjörer för att komplettera teamet. Eftersom detta är en nyuppbyggd verksamhet utan tidigare Plattformsingenjörer, får du en unik möjlighet att vara med från början och driva arbetet med plattformen framåt. Vi söker dig som är en skicklig plattformsingenjör, redo att ta eget ansvar och leverera en säker och skalbar miljö. Vi erbjuder: Roliga och utvecklande arbetsuppgifter med högt i tak. Ett team där kompetens och ödmjukhet går hand i hand. Möjligheten att påverka och bygga system från grunden i en ständig förbättringsprocess. Generösa förmåner inom bland annat semester, friskvård och pension. Läs mer om våra förmåner https://polisen.se/erbjudande Arbetsbeskrivning Vill du vara med och bygga Polismyndighetens nya AI-förmågor från grunden? Som Plattformsingenjör får du ett stort operativt ansvar för nyutveckling och förvaltning av våra AI-system. Du arbetar hands-on med att bygga robusta lösningar, sätter ribban för kodkvalitet och stöttar teamets kompetensutveckling. I rollen ansvarar du för att säkerställa hög teknisk standard och leverera verklig samhällsnytta på riktigt! Som Plattformsingenjör kommer du att arbeta i en stimulerande miljö med stor teknisk bredd. Du förväntas vara självgående, ta eget ansvar för arkitekturen och agera bollplank för teamet. En stor del av uppdraget kommer också vara att koordinera och kommunicera med andra grupper inom domänen för plattform. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter innefattar: Design och implementation: Skapa nya, robusta containerlösningar från grunden. Drift och underhåll: Konfigurera, felsöka och förbättra befintliga miljöer. Samarbete: Arbeta tätt tillsammans med utvecklings- och andra plattformsteam för att möjliggöra modern plattformsutveckling. Automatisering & Omvärldsbevakning: Driva arbetet med automatisering och hålla dig uppdaterad på senaste teknik inom open source-världen. Rollen innebär en stor variation av uppgifter och du kommer att ha en central roll i att forma hur vi arbetar med AI-utveckling inom myndigheten. Kvalifikationer För att lyckas i denna roll ser vi att du har: Minst tre års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom området. Praktisk erfarenhet av Kubernetes. God erfarenhet av Linux-systemadministration. Praktisk erfarenhet av verktyg som Ansible, ArgoCD, Helm, Kustomize, Terraform eller liknande. Erfarenhet av att konfigurera CI/CD-flöden och arbeta enligt GitOps-principer. Grundläggande förståelse för säkerhet i container- och nätverksmiljöer. Då arbetet innebär hantering av känslig information och säkerhetsskyddsklassade uppgifter ställer vi följande krav: Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. Svenskt medborgarskap. Data Exploration The Junior Data Scientist is responsible for assisting and participating in exploration of untapped data values in our business ecosystem, regardless of data formats, as well as mining external data, with the aim of utilizing them for the purpose of predictive and prescriptive modelling solutions. A truly interdisciplinary centre, with staff hailing from backgrounds in subjects as diverse as Geography, Transport Studies, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Statistics, Planning, Architecture, the Humanities and the Social Sciences, for more than 20 years we have been combining theory with novel data, sensors, computational models, analysis and cutting edge visualisation to generate new knowledge and insights addressing problems with a spatial dimension and an urban and regional focus. Find out about the UCL Ways of Working: www.ucl.ac.uk/ways-of-working. We will consider applications to work on a part-time, flexible and job share basis wherever possible. For any queries about the role please contact Prof Chen Zhong (c.zhong@ucl.ac.uk). A job description and person specification can be accessed at the bottom of this page. To apply for the vacancy please click on the ‘Apply Now’ button below. About you The successful candidate will hold a PhD (or close to completion) in ML/DL, GeoAI, urban informatics, Spatial Data Science or a closely related quantitative discipline. Communicate: Present analytical findings and actionable recommendations clearly, adapting communication styles for both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborate: Work closely with innovation, software, data engineering and enterprise data teams to ensure analytical solutions are scalable, deployable and aligned with broader technology strategies. Mentor and Document: Teach, coach and mentor peers while documenting technical knowledge, analytical approaches and best practices to support long-term capability growth. Drive Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, technical excellence and data-driven decision making. On-Site Execution: Travel to Ford manufacturing plants and supplier locations globally, as required by project and programme needs, to understand operational challenges, support implementations and collaborate directly with on-site teams. At Moorfields, we provide more than just an excellent career and great colleagues to work with. We also offer: Salary including High-Cost Area Supplement (for London based roles) Opportunity to join the NHS Pension Scheme Free 24/7 independent counselling service Learning and development opportunities Easy and quick transport links A range of attractive benefits and discounts Access to Blue Light Card and other NHS Discount Schemes Free Pilates classes Full support and training to develop your skills Flexible working friendly organisation And so much more! items.desc: Description du poste Domaine Instrumentation, métrologie et contrôle Contrat Post-doctorat Intitulé de l'offre Instrumentation et reconstruction 3D pour le diagnostic magnétique quantique des batteries Li-ion H/F Sujet de stage Rejoignez le projet OPTIMAQ au CEA-LETI de Grenoble pour repousser les limites du diagnostic batterie. Aujourd'hui, jusqu'à la moitié des cellules Li-ion produites sont mises au rebut lors de l'étape critique de formation, faute de moyens pour voir ce qui se passe à l'intérieur de la cellule en temps réel. Ce post-doctorat de 24 mois vous propose de relever ce défi en associant deux mondes : l'instrumentation de pointe, avec l'intégration d'un magnétomètre quantique à pompage optique hélium 4 capable de détecter les champs magnétiques les plus infimes, et l'intelligence artificielle informée par la physique, à travers le développement d'algorithmes RBF-FD/PINN pour reconstruire en 3D la distribution du courant interne à partir de ces mesures. De la paillasse à l'algorithme, vous piloterez toute la chaîne, en forte collaboration avec le LETI et le LITEN, avec à la clé des publications, des brevets, et une contribution concrète à la souveraineté de la filière batterie européenne. Durée du contrat (en mois) 24 Description de l'offre Le projet OPTIMAQ vise à réduire le taux de rebut de la formation des cellules Li-ion — jusqu'à 50 % aujourd'hui, objectif 5 % — grâce à un système non invasif de mesure magnétique quantique. Ce post-doctorat couvre les volets expérimental (montage du banc de mesure : magnétomètre à pompage optique hélium 4, blindage, translation de la cellule) et logiciel (reconstruction 3D de la densité de courant par RBF-FD/PINN informée par la physique) pour détecter des défauts dès la formation. Hébergé au CEA-LETI à Grenoble (LSSC), en forte transversalité avec L2EP/LAIC (instrumentation, magnétométrie quantique) du LETI et LAPS/LMPS (électrochimie Li-ion, modélisation) du CEA-LITEN, ce poste s'inscrit dans un projet de 24 mois visant un TRL 3, avec perspective de publications et de brevets. Contexte et enjeux La formation — premier cyclage contrôlé d'une cellule (~20 h pour 20 min de fabrication) — conditionne la couche de passivation (SEI), la stabilité et la sécurité de la cellule. Le taux de rebut reste élevé et coûteux, un enjeu accru par les difficultés financières récentes de la filière (faillite de Northvolt). Les pratiques actuelles reposent sur des contrôles invasifs post-production, sans visibilité directe sur la distribution interne du courant. La magnétométrie quantique offre une sensibilité supérieure aux capteurs AMR/fluxgate classiques, mais deux verrous subsistent : intégrer ce capteur dans un banc robuste aux perturbations, et inverser les champs mesurés en une carte 3D de courant à un coût de calcul compatible avec la ligne de production. Objectifs scientifiques Banc expérimental : intégration du magnétomètre He4, du blindage magnétique et du système de translation de la cellule pouch ; caractérisation du bruit et des perturbations. Reconstruction 3D : adaptation des approches RBF-FD/PINN, déjà développées au LSSC pour l'estimation rapide de source, à la géométrie réelle de la cellule et aux lois de conservation. Validation croisée : pré-entraînement sur données FEM puis affinage et détection de défauts sur mesures réelles, vers un suivi quasi temps réel. Méthodologie Le/la post-doctorant(e) interviendra sur l'ensemble de la chaîne : Instrumentation du magnétomètre He4 , intégration dans le blindage et le système de translation (avec L2EP/LAIC). Inversion physique : RBF-FD/PINN combinant écart mesuré/prédit, conservation et régularisation. Entraînement/affinage : pré-entraînement FEM (LMPS), affinage sur mesures réelles de cyclage (L2EP/LAPS). Impact et perspectives Publications (Journal of Power Sources, etc.) et dépôt de brevets sur la reconstruction hybride appliquée au diagnostic batterie. Perspectives : généralisation à d'autres pathologies, classification, fermeture de boucle sur le profil de cyclage — contribuant à la souveraineté industrielle de la filière batterie européenne. Contacts : Sylvain LEIRENS – sylvain.leirens@cea.fr, Romain FRANCHI — romain.franchi@cea.fr Moyens / Méthodes / Logiciels Python / PyTorch Profil du candidat Profil recherché : Doctorat en physique, mathématiques appliquées, traitement du signal ou instrumentation, avec une double sensibilité expérimentale (mise en œuvre de capteurs, mesures) et algorithmique (problèmes inverses, machine learning informé par la physique — PINN, Neural Operators). Une familiarité avec la magnétométrie ou l'électrochimie des batteries est un plus. Compétences clés : Instrumentation et traitement du signal (mise en œuvre de capteurs, réduction de bruit). Python / PyTorch, calcul GPU. Excellente rédaction scientifique et travail en consortium pluridisciplinaire LETI-LITEN. items.desc: L’Université d'Artois est implantée sur différents points du territoire du Nord-Pas de Calais : Arras (siège), Béthune, Douai, Lens et Liévin. Elle comprend huit UFR , deux IUT , une école d'ingénieurs , un service de formation continue (FCU) et quinze centres de recherche . Depuis sa création en 1992 , l’Université d’Artois s’impose comme un acteur de promotion sociale et bénéficie d’un environnement convivial et stimulant propice aux études et à la culture . Placée sous la tutelle du ministère de l’enseignement supérieur et de la recherche, l'Université d'Artois accueille 13 000 étudiants et emploie un peu plus de 1 000 personnes. Elle est dotée d’un budget de 116 M€, dont 89 M€ de masse salariale et 7 M€ d’investissements. L’ensemble des postes à pourvoir publiés par l’Université d’Artois est ouvert aux bénéficiaires de l’obligation d’emploi, en application des dispositions des articles L. 5212-13 et L.5212-2 du Code du Travail. Missions : Dans le cadre du projet de recherche, vous contribuerez à la tâche « Interprétation des mécanismes internes des modèles », qui vise à analyser et comprendre en profondeur le fonctionnement interne des modèles d’IA, en établissant des correspondances explicites entre leurs structures internes (poids, activations, gradients) et des concepts humains interprétables. L’objectif est de dépasser l’interprétabilité purement comportementale pour construire une compréhension mécanistique et causale, essentielle à la transparence et à la fiabilité des systèmes IA. Votre travail s’inscrira dans un plan en trois étapes cohérentes : 1. Cartographier et comprendre les représentations internes des modèles IA, en identifiant les alignements entre modalités et le désentrelacement des concepts latents. 2. Analyser la dynamique d’apprentissage et concevoir des architectures favorisant à la fois performance et interprétabilité. 3. Appliquer la compréhension mécanistique au raisonnement avancé, en rendant le raisonnement implicite lisible et en réduisant les hallucinations Profil de la personne (diplôme, cursus, compétences requises…) : Nous recherchons un(e) chercheur(e) postdoctoral(e) disposant d’une expertise à l’intersection de l’apprentissage automatique, du traitement automatique des langues, de l’interprétabilité des modèles IA et de l’analyse des représentations internes. Le/la candidat(e) contribuera à la tâche « Interprétation des mécanismes internes des modèles » dans le cadre d’un projet de recherche multidisciplinaire visant à développer des méthodes mécanistiques pour expliquer et fiabiliser le fonctionnement des modèles d’IA. Formation et expérience Doctorat en informatique, intelligence artificielle, mathématiques appliquées ou disciplines connexes. Expérience antérieure en recherche avec publications dans des conférences ou revues reconnues en IA, apprentissage automatique ou TAL Compétences et connaissances attendues Connaissances solides en apprentissage automatique, maîtrise des architectures de réseaux neuronaux profonds, en particulier les transformeurs. Connaissance approfondie des approches d’interprétabilité (métriques de similarité de représentations, analyse couche-par-couche, méthodes causales). Pratique des outils et bibliothèques pour l’expérimentation en IA (Python, PyTorch, librairies d’évaluation et de visualisation, etc.). Capacité à concevoir et à analyser des expériences complexes, et à synthétiser des résultats scientifiques. Intérêt marqué pour la transparence, la fiabilité et la compréhension mécanistique des systèmes d’IA.

By combining foundation models, multimodal machine learning, and conversational AI, Neuron aims to build a new generation of clinical intelligence infrastructure that integrates real-world data from smartphones and wearables into meaningful, longitudinal insights. The platform is designed to support pharmaceutical clinical development and, over time, personalized therapeutic delivery. We are seeking a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to join as a cofounder and lead the development of our AI and technology platform. THE ROLE As CTO and cofounder, you will lead Neuron's technical strategy, AI/ML development, software engineering, and platform architecture. Working closely with the CEO and scientific leadership, you will translate the company's vision into a production-ready platform built around foundation models, multimodal intelligence, and conversational AI. This is a hands-on founding role for a technical leader who combines deep AI/ML expertise with strong software engineering capabilities. You will shape the technical foundations of the company, from model architecture and multimodal data fusion to conversational interfaces, production infrastructure, and clinical-grade systems. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AI/ML and foundation models: Lead the development and integration of AI systems leveraging foundation models, multimodal learning, and modern machine-learning architectures. Conversational AI: Design and build conversational interfaces, including voice-based AI companions, enabling natural, context-aware interactions and personalized engagement. Multimodal intelligence: Develop systems that integrate voice, motor, physiological, behavioral, and cognitive data into meaningful representations of neurological function and longitudinal patient states. ML engineering and deployment: Build end-to-end pipelines for data processing, model evaluation, inference, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Software engineering: Own the end-to-end software architecture, backend services, APIs, mobile integrations, cloud infrastructure, and engineering practices. AI safety and system reliability: Establish robust boundaries between generative AI and safety-critical functions through deterministic controls, auditable workflows, and appropriate safeguards. Clinical intelligence infrastructure: Build the data and analytics infrastructure required to support clinical research, digital biomarker development, and pharmaceutical clinical-development workflows. Data integration: Develop secure, scalable pipelines integrating smartphone and wearable data, including Apple HealthKit, Android Health Connect, and selected third-party devices. Technical leadership: Recruit and lead the initial AI/ML and software engineering team, establish development standards, and manage external technical partners. Technology strategy: Define the technical roadmap, prioritize development against scientific and commercial milestones, and support technical due diligence for investors and partners. QUALIFICATIONS Required Significant experience in AI/ML engineering, applied machine learning, or software engineering, with a track record of building and deploying production-grade systems. Strong software engineering fundamentals across system architecture, APIs, backend development, cloud infrastructure, testing, and deployment. Practical experience with foundation models, including LLM integration, model orchestration, inference, evaluation, and production deployment. Experience developing conversational AI applications, ideally involving voice interfaces, context management, or personalized interactions. Experience building end-to-end machine-learning pipelines and translating research concepts into reliable software products. Familiarity with multimodal data processing, representation learning, or integrating heterogeneous data sources. Ability to combine hands-on technical execution with architectural leadership and team development. A founder's mindset, with the ability to operate in an early-stage environment, make decisions under uncertainty, and build from an initial prototype. Strongly Preferred Experience with multimodal foundation models, cross-modal representation learning, or sensor-based machine learning. Experience with speech technology, audio processing, voice interfaces, or conversational agents. Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning, inference optimization, and AI observability. Experience designing agentic or tool-using AI systems with reliable execution boundaries and auditable controls. items.desc: Bozen/Bolzano Institute for Renewable Energy Short description of the position: Eurac Research is looking for a chemist, environmental scientist or engineer with hands-on experience in air pollutant measurements to lead the Volatile Organic Compounds Laboratory (VOC Lab) of the "Human-centric Buildings" (HCB) team, within the Institute for Renewable Energy – Energy and Resources Efficient Building group. The position reports directly to the HCB team leader and has responsibility for the scientific activities, daily operation and development of the lab. ​ ​The VOC Lab is located at NOI Techpark in Bolzano (https://noi.bz.it/en) and operates two airtight emission test chambers (1 m³ and 6 m³) compliant with EN 16516, ISO 16000-6, ISO 16000-9 and EN 717-1, with controlled temperature, humidity and air velocity. The chambers are used to test the emissions of building materials, wood-based products and furnishings, to study the decay of airborne pollutants, and to test and calibrate IAQ sensors. ​ ​You will run the lab's emission, decay and sensor tests, from planning and chamber operation to sampling, coordination of the external analytical laboratory, and interpretation and reporting of results. You will be the main contact for industrial partners using the lab, coordinate the lab technicians, and contribute to the team's research projects on indoor air quality and health in buildings. The work combines research (Horizon Europe, Interreg, ERDF and other projects) with applied testing services for manufacturers, from established industries to developers of innovative materials.​ Tasks: Lab management and testing (about 60% of the working time): planning and running emission, decay and sensor tests according to standards; air sampling for VOCs and aldehydes and real-time measurements; coordination of the external laboratory for chromatographic analyses and quality check of results; QA/QC procedures, maintenance and continuous improvement of the lab; scheduling of lab activities, management of purchasing and safety procedures; coordination of lab technicians. ​Research (about 25%): designing experiments, analysing data, contributing to writing scientific publications and project reports; contributing to the team's research on indoor air quality and health, including field measurement campaigns in occupied buildings. ​Industry and projects (about 15%): acting as main contact for industrial partners using the lab, defining tests and writing test reports; developing the lab's services and collaborations; contributing to research proposals; co-supervising interns; disseminating results to scientific and professional audiences.​ ​ Requirements: Master's degree in Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry or Science, Chemical, Environmental or Materials Engineering, or related fields. ​Hands-on experience with laboratory or field measurements of air pollutants (e.g. active sampling, gas analysers, sensors, controlled test environments), gained in research, industry, or testing and monitoring laboratories. ​Experience in working according to standard procedures and in ensuring data quality. ​Ability to write clear technical reports. ​Very good command of English, written and spoken. ​Willingness to work on site in Bolzano, as the role involves regular hands-on laboratory activity. ​Advantages: knowledge of VOC sampling and analysis methods (e.g. ISO 16000 series, EN 16516, EN 717-1 TD-GC-MS, HPLC for aldehydes); emission testing standards or VOC labelling schemes; QA/QC or ISO/IEC 17025 environments; IAQ sensors and calibration; data analysis with Python; peer-reviewed publications; proposal writing or student supervision; Italian and/or German. We are looking for someone who: can organise their own work and lab schedule, taking ownership of tests from planning to final report; ​enjoys collaborating with colleagues from different backgrounds (engineering, architecture, etc.) and with industrial partners; ​is curious and proactive in proposing improvements to methods and services.​ We offer: The position is initially available with a fixed-term contract with the possibility to be become permanent ​Working conditions which allow professional growth and know how acquisition with carrier opportunity as applied researcher. The chance to work with local and international research centres, universities, and industry partners ​The opportunity to work in a young international team in a fast-growing sector A surrounding offering a high quality of life. Eurac Research has been elected among the best workplaces in Italy. ( https://www.greatplacetowork.it/scheda_azienda/eurac/ ) and offers many opportunities in combining work and family activities. items.desc: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The opportunity: Real-World Data Associate As a Real-World Data Associate at myTomorrows, you will support the design and execution of real-world data collection within Expanded Access Programs and other non-interventional studies. Working closely with the Real-World Data team, you will help keep communication with clients, physicians and site staff running smoothly, carry out data validation and quality-control tasks, and contribute to the documentation that supports consistent, high-quality RWD delivery. This is a great opportunity to build hands-on experience in real-world data within a purpose-driven, fast-growing company. Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance to our office in Amsterdam. What you’ll do in this role: Support the design and day-to-day execution of RWD collection within Expanded Access Programs and other non-interventional studies. Assist in maintaining communication with clients, physicians and site staff about data collection and data management. Help monitor RWD collection and completion, flagging data discrepancies or missing data for follow-up. Perform basic data validation, cleaning and quality-control tasks in electronic data capture systems. Follow relevant regulatory requirements, internal procedures and ICH-GCP principles in all RWD study activities. Support the preparation and maintenance of SOPs, templates and study documentation for RWD projects. Share observations and ideas that could improve data collection, workflows and supporting tools. Work under the guidance of more senior team members, collaborating closely with colleagues across the team and other relevant functions. What you bring to the table: A bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, biomedical sciences or another relevant scientific field. 0–2 years of experience in Data Management or Clinical Research (e.g. an internship, traineeship or first role). Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage priorities and follow through on commitments. Familiarity with, or a strong interest in learning, electronic data capture systems and structured clinical or real-world data. A basic understanding of ICH-GCP guidelines, or the motivation to develop it quickly. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Close attention to detail and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. Eagerness to learn and the ability to contribute positively to a collaborative team environment. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. What Success looks like in the first 6 months: Data completion and quality metrics for your assigned programs are consistently on target. You’re contributing ideas and improvements to RWD processes and documentation, helping to raise the bar for data excellence at myTomorrows. You’re recognized as a reliable partner by both internal teams and external collaborators, someone who ensures the integrity of real-world data to advance patient access What we offer: Serve a purposeful mission: helping patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organization. Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and equity. Great career-development opportunities in a growing company. Learning and development budget, alongside internal knowledge-sharing sessions. Attractive pension plan, with the full premium covered by us. Hybrid work model (2 days in office). Policies to support working parents. Healthy lunch at the office. Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp. An additional holiday for Liberation Day on 5 May. items.desc: Vill du utveckla system där mjukvara möter den fysiska världen – och där din kod faktiskt styr, mäter och övervakar verkliga system? Vi söker dig som gillar kombinationen av systemutveckling, problemlösning och teknik på riktigt . Hos oss får du arbeta med lösningar inom bland annat energi, IoT, säkerhet och industriella system – från kod och databaser till nätverk, kommunikationsprotokoll och fysisk utrustning. Det här är inte en roll där du enbart sitter med en avgränsad del av en applikation. Du får möjlighet att förstå hela kedjan , lösa komplexa tekniska problem och samtidigt vara med och påverka hur våra framtida system byggs. Om rollen Som systemutvecklare får du en bred teknisk roll där utveckling kombineras med systemintegration, felsökning, teknisk förvaltning och kontakt med kunder. Du kommer initialt att ha en viktig roll i förvaltningen och vidareutvecklingen av SystemOne , vår etablerade lösning för övervakning och styrning. Här får du arbeta nära både tekniken och kunderna för att utveckla funktioner, lösa problem och säkerställa att systemen fungerar i vardagen. Parallellt får du bidra till nyutveckling inom energi, IoT, integration och övervakning. I detta arbete är modern .NET-utveckling, API:er, MQTT, Edge-system och containerbaserade miljöer centrala delar. Hos oss får du kombinera ansvar för etablerade system med möjligheten att utveckla nya tekniska lösningar som skapar konkret nytta för våra kunder. Du blir en del av ett mindre team där du får ta ansvar, påverka tekniska vägval och vara med från idé till fungerande lösning. Vad kommer du att göra? Ingen dag behöver se exakt likadan ut. Ena dagen utvecklar du funktionalitet i C# och arbetar med SQL. Nästa dag felsöker du tillsammans med en kund varför en mätare har slutat leverera data. Då kanske svaret inte finns i applikationskoden. Problemet kan lika gärna finnas i databasen, nätverket, en gateway, ett kommunikationsprotokoll eller i konfigurationen av den anslutna utrustningen. Du kommer bland annat att: utveckla och vidareutveckla våra system och integrationer arbeta med C#, .NET och SQL Server förvalta och vidareutveckla kundinstallationer felsöka applikationer, databaser, nätverk och kommunikation integrera våra system med extern utrustning och andra system arbeta med industriella protokoll som OPC, Modbus och MQTT ge teknisk support till kunder och kollegor delta vid installationer, uppgraderingar och driftsättning dokumentera tekniska lösningar och förändringar. På sikt får du även möjlighet att arbeta med tekniker som ASP.NET Core, REST API, MQTT, Docker, Edge computing, SQL Server och React . Vem söker vi? Vi söker framför allt en nyfiken och lösningsorienterad tekniker som vill förstå hur saker faktiskt fungerar. Din bakgrund kan exempelvis vara inom systemutveckling, systemintegration, SCADA, automation, IoT, industriell IT eller som applikationsingenjör. Det viktigaste för oss är inte exakt vilken titel du har haft – utan vad du kan och hur du angriper tekniska problem. Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av: C# och .NET SQL och relationsdatabaser Windows-miljöer TCP/IP och nätverk Git eller motsvarande versionshantering teknisk felsökning i system med flera olika komponenter. Du behöver kunna arbeta självständigt och känna dig bekväm med att ta ansvar för ett problem hela vägen från första felsökningen till en fungerande lösning. Eftersom rollen innebär direkt kontakt med kunder behöver du också kunna diskutera tekniska frågeställningar på ett begripligt och lösningsorienterat sätt. Extra intressant om du kan något av detta Har du erfarenhet från SCADA/HMI, industriell automation, OPC, Modbus, MQTT, PLC-system, energimätning, fastighetsautomation, IoT, Edge-system eller industriella gateways är det meriterande. Detsamma gäller erfarenhet av exempelvis ASP.NET Core, REST API, Docker, React, Linux eller CI/CD . Har du arbetat med WideQuick är det positivt, men det är inget krav. Erfarenhet från andra SCADA- och automationsplattformar som exempelvis Ignition, WinCC, zenon, AVEVA/Wonderware eller iFIX är också relevant. Du behöver alltså inte kunna alla våra tekniker från dag ett. För oss är din tekniska förståelse, problemlösningsförmåga och vilja att lära viktigare än att varje produktnamn finns på ditt CV. Det här får du hos Elajo Vi vill att du ska trivas, utvecklas och ha möjlighet att prestera långsiktigt. Hos oss får du: Ett varierande och utvecklande uppdrag med goda möjligheter att växa. En trivsam och inkluderande arbetsmiljö där laganda och samarbete står i fokus. Kollektivavtal, personalrabatter och friskvårdsbidrag. En trygg och stabil arbetsgivare som värnar om balans mellan arbetsliv och privatliv. Tillgång till samtalsstöd inom bland annat hälsa, kris, stress, ekonomi och juridik. Bli en del av Elajo Elajos värdegrund bygger på Engagemang, Utveckling, Öppenhet och Förtroende . Vi tror på en arbetsplats där människor får möjlighet att utvecklas, där olikheter uppskattas och där alla ges lika möjligheter. Hos oss …

Cardiac Physiology Healthcare Scientist Assistant (Band 3) An exciting opportunity is available to join the Cardiac Physiology team at Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. We are a
items.desc: This is exciting opportunity to work as a Healthcare Scientist Assistant in the Cardiac Physiology Department in the OUH Trust. The role involves supporting Cardiac Physiologists and other medical specialities to perform electrocardiograms (ECGs), Blood pressures and a multitude of other clinical diagnostic testing in the Cardiology directorate. Cardiac Physiology Healthcare Scientist Assistant (Band 3) An exciting opportunity is available to join the Cardiac Physiology team at Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. We are a friendly, dynamic and welcoming multi-disciplinary team working routinely across the John Radcliffe Hospital in Oxford, the Horton Hospital in Banbury and various community settings around the county. The role involves hands-on clinical duties such as performing electrocardiograms (ECG’s), fitting event monitors and assisting with exercise testing. Other duties include measurement of height and weight, cannulation and urine analysis. Alongside these clinical duties this role also requires basic administration skills, good time management and organisational skills and an outstanding approach to customer care. Due to the nature of this patient facing role, candidates should have a calm and caring attitude and excellent interpersonal skills. As the role involves working across the county the ability to adapt to these varied locations, and show flexibility when necessary, is a must. No previous clinical experience is necessary as full training will be given and successful applicants will be expected to work towards SCST Certificate of Electrocardiography examination and the Trust’s Care Certificate. Interested candidates are strongly recommended to visit the department for a greater understanding of the post. Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust is one of the largest NHS teaching trusts in the country. It provides a wide range of general and specialist clinical services and is a base for medical education, training and research. The Trust comprises four hospitals - the John Radcliffe Hospital, Churchill Hospital and Nuffield Orthopaedic Centre in Headington and the Horton General Hospital in Banbury. For more information on OUH please view OUH At a Glance by OUHospitals Our values, standards and behaviours define the quality of clinical care we offer and the professional relationships we make with our patients, colleagues and the wider community. We call this Delivering Compassionate Excellence and its focus is on our values of compassion, respect, learning, delivery, improvement and excellence. These values put patients at the heart of what we do and underpin the quality healthcare we would like for ourselves or a member of our family. Watch how we set out to deliver compassionate excellence via the OUH YouTube channel . In this role you will: Without immediate supervision, use appropriate electro-medical equipment (e.g. electrocardiograph, sphygmomanometer, spirometer, weighing scales, and ambulatory recording systems) in wards or departments throughout the organisation to obtain physiological data from patients (adults, children and neonates). To perform, accurately record and report patient observations -temp, pulse, BP, following completion of relevant competencies/training. To be able to identify when to carry out and report observations, should a patients condition alter/deteriorate To perform additional tasks as directed i.e. cannulation and phlebotomy following completion of relevant competencies/training. To demonstrate good communication skills when dealing with patients, relatives and members of the multidisciplinary team utilising sensitivity, empathy and ability to manage conflict. To assist with patient moving and handling using correct methods and equipment as required (as per manual handling policy) and completion of appropriate paperwork. To demonstrate skills at time management and prioritisation of workload with support from senior cardiac physiology support worker/HSA or service lead To undertake mandatory, statutory and local training as required by the Trust and directorate. To be flexible/willing to assist all areas within cardiac physiology e.g. at times of sickness or increased workload.

items.desc: Company Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI. We develop ultra-low-latency voice models that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure. By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we're making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. This requires building high-performance systems that bridge machine learning, real-time audio processing, and distributed infrastructure. Neuphonic was founded in April 2024 and has raised significant funding from leading European investors. We work with global enterprises across hardware and consumer AI that are building the next generation of voice-enabled products. Our open source models have been downloaded over 4 million times and earned over 6,500 GitHub stars since launch. Our vision is a world where voice becomes the most natural interface for AI, enabling seamless, intuitive interactions that are accessible to everyone. Role We're looking for a Founding GTM Associate to build the top of our enterprise pipeline, working side by side with our founders and sales team. Our go-to-market runs from open source to enterprise. Developers find and build on our open models, and the companies they work for need production-grade, supported versions for products where latency, privacy and offline operation matter. Your job is to make that path faster and more predictable. This is a hands-on, commercial role with one clear goal: book as many qualified meetings as possible for our sales team. You'll report to the CEO and work directly with the founders, research team and sales team. We are not looking for a marketer measured on impressions. We're looking for someone commercially sharp, comfortable reaching out to people, and technical enough to hold their own with engineers. Your work will include: Identifying which companies are using our open models, researching them, and getting the right ones into a conversation with sales Running targeted outreach to engineering and product leaders at our target accounts, by email, LinkedIn and through our community Booking meetings directly with prospects and handing them over to our account executives with clear context Building target account lists for events, dinners and conferences, and following up within 48 hours after Creating the assets that open doors: account research, tailored demos, one-pagers and case studies Supporting open source launches and creator partnerships so they generate pipeline, not just attention Tracking which channels produce meetings, and recommending where we put more time and budget Helping build the GTM processes and playbooks we'll scale as the team grows In your first few months, the priority is turning companies already using our models into meetings. Events, launches and creator partnerships grow from there. Open source is our biggest advantage, but we care about meetings, not channels. If paid, LinkedIn or outbound gets better results, we want you to prove it and run with it. This is a role to learn fast in. You'll see how an enterprise AI company is built from the inside, and as our GTM team scales, there's a clear path for you to lead part of it. You have: 1–3 years' experience in sales development, B2B sales, consulting, a startup generalist role or another demanding commercial environment Strong commercial instincts: you can spot which companies are worth our time, and explain why Comfort reaching out to people you don't know, and following up until you get a response Sharp written communication: emails people answer, and briefs our sales team can act on Enough technical curiosity to run our models, follow an engineering conversation and learn fast Comfort being measured on one clear number, with the judgement to protect meeting quality while chasing volume Comfort testing new channels quickly and dropping what doesn't work A proactive approach and comfort building from scratch Bonus points for experience in AI, speech or edge computing, booking meetings for an enterprise sales team, or working in a CRM day to day. This probably isn't the right role for you if you're looking for a marketing or brand role, or if you'd rather support deals than create them. How we'll measure success: Success means a reliable, growing flow of qualified enterprise meetings for our sales team. We'll look at: Accepted meetings per month: meetings that are held and that an account executive confirms as a real opportunity Meeting-to-opportunity rate , so volume never comes at the expense of quality Pipeline created from the meetings you source Cost per accepted meeting across channels Location: London (King's Cross) In the office 5 days a week 10am–6pm are our usual in-office working hours Compensation and benefits: Help us …

items.desc: This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious graduate with the ability and confidence to work on a research project for developing eXplainable AI-powered Decision Models (XAI-DMs) for Insurance Under-writing, which is funded by ESRC IAA to The University of Manchester (UoM) together with Protector In-surance as industrial partner. The University of Manchester is looking to recruit a decision scientist, artificial intelligence (AI) modeller, system scientist to undertake this project, which is based on the research conducted by UoM experts over many years in areas of decision science, systems science, AI and Data Science to develop the Evidential Reasoning (ER) theory, including the Maximum Likelihood Evidential Reasoning (MAKER) framework for probabilistic reasoning with imperfect data, the ER rule for combination of uncertain evidence acquired from imperfect data and human judgment, the ER approach for multiple criteria decision making under uncertainty, and the Belief Rule Base (BRB) methodology for probabilistic system modelling and intrinsi-cally explainable machine learning funded by many EPSRC grants. The RA position will provide the successful candidate with a unique opportunity to take the lead on a strategic project, aimed at translating the ER theory and industrial domain knowledge to develop new XAI-DMs for Insurance Underwriting and to integrate them into existing working practices for Protector Insur-ance, which will be supported by the specialists of the company. The RA will therefore be faced with the challenge of understanding both the theory and the practical applications of decision modelling, data an-alytics, probabilistic inference, XAI decision modelling and evidence-based decision making to support the development of the XAI-DMs; and translating the technical know-how into a form that can be easily un-derstood and used by users within Protector Insurance. Candidates will require a minimum 2:1 with doctoral research experience in Systems Science, Decision Science, Operational Research, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, or Applied Statistics with Decision, or a PhD degree in the-afore mentioned or related subject areas, with evidence of a strong grounding in probabilistic data analysis and reasoning, XAI decision modelling, decision analysis, multiple criteria assessment, and software development in Python or equivalent. This post is funded through an ESRC IAA award together with Protector Insurance, a UK Government scheme intended to promote sustained and mutually beneficial relationships between universities and industry. Based at Alliance Manchester Business School and Protector Insurance, the successful candidate will work directly with the supervisors from the University and with other researchers and practitioners from Pro-tector Insurance. (Grades 6-9) Our benefits include: Generous employer contribution pension 29 days annual leave plus bank holidays, along with Christmas closure Ride to work and EV car scheme available For more information, please see University of Manchester Benefits. You can also find information on our Flexible and Hybrid working here. We are an open place of enquiry and challenge. We embrace and celebrate difference, diversity and debate, and we pride ourselves on being a place of education, learning and community where we are able, within the law, to question and test received wisdom, express new ideas and explore controversial or unpopular topics and opinions. Find out more from our Freedom of Speech Policy. items.desc: About Fundamental Fundamental is an AI research lab pioneering the future of enterprise decision-making. Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict. At Fundamental, you'll work on unprecedented technical challenges in foundation model development and build technology that transforms how the world's largest companies make decisions. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI. About The Role You will join the Research team as our first software engineer, owning the core codebase behind our model development. The codebase needs to be fast to iterate on, robust through experiments and large training runs, and ready to carry models all the way to production. Working alongside research scientists, you'll find what slows them down and build the infrastructure that fixes it, laying the technical foundations that let Fundamental operate at the frontier of large-scale tabular modeling. Key Responsibilities Amplify and Accelerate: You will be proactive in providing solutions which enable our researchers to be more efficient and effective, including agentic workflows. Steward: You will steward the long-term development and maintenance of our codebase. Ensuring it is production-ready, while preserving the flexibility needed for empirically driven research. You will set the bar for code quality by leading pull request reviews and acting as the gatekeeper for external contributions. Champion Best Practices: Establish and implement software engineering best practices in the machine learning domain, serving as a mentor and guide to research scientists on the team. Elevate Code Maturity & Quality: Lead the transition of our core research codebase from an early-stage experimental state to a highly scalable, maintainable and robust engineering standard. You will proactively manage technical debt, ensure experiment reproducibility, and drive overall code quality. Maintain Documentation: Develop and maintain clear, comprehensive documentation for our research infrastructure and systems. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Ensure precise interactions of the research codebase with other code at Fundamental to translate research breakthroughs into tangible, real-world impact. Demonstrated track record of developing and utilizing solutions for robustness and quality assurance within software and/or ML systems. Mission-driven mindset, motivated by the prospect of real-world impact and a relentless focus on excellence in software development. Nice to have Familiarity with MLOps best practices, CI/CD for machine learning, and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform). Experience working in an early-stage, fast-paced startup environment. A background or strong interest in tabular data, data engineering, or enterprise data architecture. Experience with other programming languages (Rust, C++, Go) Contributions to open-source machine learning libraries, frameworks, or tools. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a STEM field Benefits Competitive compensation with salary and equity Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents Paid parental leave for all new parents, inclusive of adoptive and surrogate journeys Relocation support for employees moving to join the team in one of our office locations A mission-driven, low-ego culture that values diversity of thought, ownership, and bias toward action

items.title: Research Fellows in Quantum Many-Body Physics (3 separate projects)
items.card: Do you have a background in quantum many-body physics, with expertise in topological phases of matter, lattice gauge theories, or quantum criticality? Are you interested in computational approaches to quantum many-body systems, such as tensor networks and neural quantum states? Would you like to further your career in one of the UK’s leading research-intensive universities? We are advertising three separate projects
items.desc: Do you have a background in quantum many-body physics, with expertise in topological phases of matter, lattice gauge theories, or quantum criticality? Are you interested in computational approaches to quantum many-body systems, such as tensor networks and neural quantum states? Would you like to further your career in one of the UK’s leading research-intensive universities? We are advertising three separate projects in the field of quantum many-body physics: Topological quantum matter. The focus areas of this project include topological and geometric properties of fractional quantum Hall states and fractional Chern insulators, including their classical and quantum simulations (in particular, exact diagonalisation, matrix product state and neural quantum state methods, as well as quantum simulations). Some of our recent papers relevant to the position include: https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.01955 https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.10267 https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.10395 https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.04169 https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.17352 Far-from-equilibrium physics of lattice gauge theories. The focus areas of the project include many-body dynamics, ergodicity breaking, false-vacuum decay, etc. The project will also involve developing classical and quantum simulations of lattice gauge theories (in particular, via exact diagonalisation, matrix product state and neural quantum state methods, as well as quantum simulations). Some of our recent papers relevant to the position include: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.26156 https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.14223 https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.25889 https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23794 https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.14718 Quantum criticality on the "fuzzy sphere". The focus areas of the project include conformal field theories in 2+1 dimension and their numerical simulations using the noncommutative geometry of the fuzzy sphere (in particular, via exact diagonalisation, matrix product state and neural quantum state methods). Some of our recent papers relevant to the position include: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15299 https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.22539 https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.08036 https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.25054 https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07655 To apply For further information on these vacancies and how to apply, please visit the following websites for each position, where you can also access a full candidate brief. https://jobs.leeds.ac.uk/EPSPA1142 Research Fellow in Topological quantum matter https://jobs.leeds.ac.uk/EPSPA1143 Research Fellow in Quantum Simulations of Gauge Theories https://jobs.leeds.ac.uk/EPSPA1140 Research Fellow in Quantum Criticality and Conformal Field Theory
