items.desc: Member of Technical Staff - AI Engineer Metcor Group | London | Hybrid, 3 days on site, occasional travel | Permanent, full time Reports to: Head of AI Engineering | Salary: £120k | No Visa sponsorship You will re-shape how real engineering work gets done at the UK's leading facilities management company: how our jobs get scheduled, how we predict and prevent outages before they hit our clients. We are 600+ people serving thousands of client sites. Our competitors are watching AI happen. You will extend our lead. You will be the second person in our AI team: what you build and how you build it becomes how Metcor does AI. No eighteen-month roadmap between you and production. Your deployments will move our revenue and land on our engineers in the field, and both will tell you quickly whether the thing you built works. Your budget for AI tools is unlimited, as long as you can show the business outcome. How we work We define the KPIs before we build, not after. Every project states what it is supposed to move and by how much, we track it during development, and we hold ourselves accountable afterwards whether or not it flattered us. If a feature did not do what we said it would, we iterate. This is the part of our culture we are most deliberate about, and the part you will have the most influence over. The problems Computer vision on what engineers capture on site. Offline LLMs. Agentic-first UX design for your colleagues and especially our engineers out in the field. Model training, data analysis and trend spotting on decades of data. Geo-routing and scheduling: right person, right site, right time. Who this suits Essential You have deployed agentic systems in production. If you have not done it commercially but can show a side project or demo that is genuinely agentic, that counts. We want to see it running, not described. You have commercial instincts. You can tell the difference between tinkering for its own sake and a hard problem worth doubling down on because there is real value behind it. You know the boundaries of AI: where it earns its place, where a rule or a query is the better answer, and how to tell before you have built the wrong thing. You are self-led. You take a business problem, find the people who own it, and come back with something running. Right to work in the UK. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role What would set you apart Lead or Staff level engineering. Deep production Python and SQL, your own services deployed and debugged on a cloud platform, and enough time in the job to have watched your own decisions age. An entrepreneurial or startup background. Comfortable with a blank page and no established process around you. You commit to a number up front and are comfortable reporting it honestly when it goes the wrong way. An MSc in Computer Science or a related discipline. One more thing. The job is desk based, but you will regularly spend a day out on site with our engineers, hi vis on. Those days are some of the best in the role: you see the work first hand, meet the people your tools are built for, and come back with the ideas worth building next. Apply CV plus a short note on one agentic thing you built, what it was meant to move, and whether it did: janosch.oppermann@metcor.co.uk. No agencies.

items.desc: Sted: Oslo, Norge Arbeidsform: På stedet (On-site) Startdato: Snarest mulig Varighet: 12+ måneder (fra snarest mulig til 30. juni 2029, med opsjon på å utvide med 3 måneder) Språkkrav: Norsk og fullt profesjonelt engelsknivå Om rollen: Vi søker en « Analyse ML Engineer» for en av våre kunder til å bli med på teamet deres på heltid på konsulentbasis i Oslo. Denne rollen innebærer å bygge om dataprodukter til en moderne plattform for å gå over til effektiv forvaltning, drift og kunstig intelligens (KI). Oppsettet omfatter omtrent 100 integrasjoner og 450 datasett som brukes av rundt 200 brukere til økonomiske modeller og analyser. Som analyse-/ML-ingeniør vil du legge til rette for at analytikere og forskere kan analysere data, utvikle modeller og visualisere resultatene sine på den nye plattformen, ved å bygge bro mellom standard økonomisk/statistisk analyse og avansert maskinlæring, samt veilede organisasjonen i innføringen av moderne verktøy. Hva du skal gjøre: Konfigurere analyseverktøy på den nye dataplattformen, inkludert Matlab, R, Python, SQL, EViews, Stata og Julia. Gi opplæring til brukere i bruken av disse analyseverktøyene. Utvikle operasjonelle rammeverk og retningslinjer. Etablere modelloppsett og vurdere hvordan gjeldende datamodeller kan integreres på den nye dataplattformen ved hjelp av Databricks og MLflow. Utfordre organisasjonen til å ta i bruk ny teknologi og veilede i daglig bruk av denne. Håndtere migrering av on-prem-modellering til skyen sammen med opplæring i modern teknologi. Håndtere utvikling og automatisering av modeller og figurproduksjoner for tverrgående deling. Deltas aktivt som prosjektdeltakere i analyseteamet på den nye dataplattformen. Hvem du er: Kompetanse og erfaring: Erfaring med og/eller organisering av store datamengder for analyse ved hjelp av ulike verktøy. Erfaring med å utvikle modeller som kjører på store datamengder for prognoser og trender. Erfaring med å bygge rammeverk/maler som gjør analytikernes arbeid med analyser enklere på tvers av ulike verktøy. Erfaring med maskinlæringsmodellering (ML), versjonering og historisering på tvers av ulike verktøy i et MLOps-oppsett. Sterk teknisk kompetanse innen teknologier som Databricks, MLflow, Python, R, Matlab, Stata og PowerBI. Utdanning og ansiennitet: Bachelor- eller mastergrad i IT (foretrukket). Seniornivå med omfattende yrkeserfaring. Om Sperton Sperton er et globalt rekrutterings- og konsulentselskap med kontorer i Europa, Asia og Amerika. Vi hjelper organisasjoner med å finne og engasjere dyktige fagpersoner gjennom fleksible løsninger innen rekruttering, konsulenttjenester og global mobilitet.

items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth. As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details. What You’ll Do Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making; Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers; Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights. What We’re Looking For Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics; Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems; Fluency in English, both spoken and written. Nice-to-Have Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas; Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python; Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets. €45,000 - €75,000 a year Please note: this is the same position as the one referred as “Data Scientist” on our career site, posted with different job titles to reach STEM students and graduates who might not know a Data Scientist role suits them. items.desc: Retail 4 Brands, qui sommes-nous ? Retail 4 Brands est une agence pionnière à l'intersection du e-commerce et de l'Intelligence Artificielle générative. Nous nous appuyons sur une base technologique solide pour intégrer l’intelligence artificielle et l’usage de LLM dans nos gestes métier, et redéfinir ainsi la performance dans le e-commerce au service de nos partenaires (L’Oréal, Unilever, Michelin, Nestlé, Chanel, Groupe Seb…). Ce que vous ferez chez nous L’équipe Data & AI s’occupe de tous les assets technologiques de l’entreprise, en particulier les produits et outils que nous avons conçus pour nos équipes internes et nos clients. En tant que membre de cette équipe, vous mettrez en œuvre la transformation agentique de l’entreprise en vous appuyant sur notre stack technique avancée (full cloud GCP servi par CI/CD). A l’interface entre les marques et les plateformes de e-commerce, vous aurez donc comme terrain de jeu une masse considérable de données disponibles dans un environnement souple (nos produits sont développés sur des technologies open source) et sécurisé. Quelles missions, concrètement ? 1. Construction de produits IA pour nos équipes et nos client (50% du travail) Recueillir et analyser le besoin des clients internes et externes Concevoir en lien avec le Chief Science Officer l’architecture de la solution et le plan de développement associé Créer les assets technologiques répondant aux besoins Documenter les solutions et accompagner les utilisateurs Maintenir et refactorer pour éviter la dette technique 2. Prospective (10% du travail) Veiller aux évolutions en matière d’IA et de technologie et sélectionner les innovations pouvant être testées en vue d’être intégrées dans nos modes de travail. S’intéresser en particulier aux technologies sur l’expérience consommateur en vue d’anticiper les tendances du secteur. 3. R&D (30% du travail) Tester les technologies potentiellement intéressantes en matière d’IA et de data Développer de nouvelles idées en mode tactique : idéation libre, prototypage rapide, extension et fiabilisation en cas d’essai concluant. 4. Etudes (10% du travail) Réaliser des études data ad hoc innovantes au profit de nos clients : data crunching, scraping en masse en vue de rétroingénierier les algorithmes de ranking, développement d’outils tactiques... 5. Equipe et responsabilités Assumer la charge de l’équipe en l’absence du Chief Science Officer Gérer un ou plusieurs développeurs de l’équipe dans le cadre de l’exécution des projets à forte valeur ajoutée Profil Recherché Expérience : 2 à 4 ans d'expérience minimum Bagage technique : Connaissances en python obligatoire (pydantic, asyncio, FastAPI, génie logiciel), expériences d’industrialisation sur environnement cloud (Docker / GCP), SQL obligatoire Culture de la Data : Connaissances en matière d’organisation des bases de données IA : Utilisation habituelle des LLMs en environnement de dev, création de skills, intégration de tools, maîtrise de la taille du contexte, capacité à travailler sur des modèles différents (Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Mistral…) Langues : Anglais et Français courants indispensables. Formation : diplôme d’école d’ingénieur du groupe 1 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? La possibilité de construire des réalisations immédiatement exploitées en production et d’en voir l’impact sur les équipes et les clients L’opportunité de travailler sur une stack moderne et souple, maîtrisant la chaîne de la data de bout en bout Un environnement entrepreneurial où l'expérimentation est la norme. Se former et s’exercer à l’utilisation pratique des outils IA et des LLMs dans un objectif de transformation des métiers du e-retail.

items.desc: Sted: Oslo, Norge Arbeidsform: På stedet (On-site) Startdato: Snarest mulig Varighet: 12+ måneder (fra snarest mulig til 30. juni 2029, med opsjon på å utvide med 3 måneder) Språkkrav: Norsk og fullt profesjonelt engelsknivå Om Rollen Vi søker en « Analyse ML Engineer» for en av våre kunder til å bli med på teamet deres på heltid på konsulentbasis i Oslo. Utfordre organisasjonen til å ta i bruk ny teknologi og veilede i daglig bruk av denne. Håndtere migrering av on-prem-modellering til skyen sammen med opplæring i modern teknologi. This is your chance to apply your skills to solve complex challenges, leverage diverse data sources, and deliver insights that shape policy, enhance statistics, and drive innovation. The Office for National Statistics (ONS) is the UK’s largest producer of official statistics, covering a range of key economic, social and demographic topics. These include measuring changes in the value of the UK economy, estimating the size, geographic distribution and characteristics of the population, and providing indicators of price inflation, employment, earnings, crime and migration. Job Description Data science is a broad and fast-moving field spanning maths, statistics, software engineering and communications. Data scientists will often work as part of a multidisciplinary team, using data and analytics to inform and achieve organisational goals. In These Roles, You Will Lead Teams That Will: Be inquisitive Explore and visualise data Make recommendations to address complex problems and to inform strategic and operational decision making Use data ethically and appropriately Be innovative and adaptable Explore existing and new data using a range of statistical tools and techniques, such as machine learning, AI, and predictive analytics Find patterns in data and transform them into organisational insight Deliver analysis that is fit for purpose and appropriately assured An associate data scientist is inquisitive, curious about data and keen to learn and develop. Responsibilities Understand the basics of software development and analytical methods, and be able to develop and assure basic models Understand and be able to implement a range of data science techniques, including machine learning Collaborate with others to develop fit for purpose data science solutions and outputs supporting the organisation Prepare and manipulate data and perform analytics, all with appropriate quality assurance. Present and communicate effectively Be aware of project delivery methods Be able to create, interpret, and assure statistical outputs effectively. Be aware of ethical consideration Have knowledge of the technologies used Person specification Essential Criteria: Programming & Build (data science) - Write and test scripts and create basic models in one or more languages, collaborate on shared codebases, using a variety of methodologies. (this skill will be our Lead Essential Skills Criterion). Applied maths, statistics, and scientific practices - Apply analytical methods including exploratory data analysis and statistical testing to a specific data set, to reach accurate and reliable conclusions. Understand and use different performance and accuracy metrics for model validation in data science projects, hypothesis testing and information retrieval. Compare selected applied mathematics and statistical methods and identify their differences access and use the statistical and scientific tools available within the organisation. Data Engineering - Identify the appropriate engineering support to design and provide products for the organisation. Recognise the processes and tools for cleansing and preparing data, and put reusable processes and checks in place. items.desc: Description : LE DÉPARTEMENT TERRITORIAL DE LA TRANSFORMATION NUMÉRIQUE ET DE L'INGÉNIERIE BIOMÉDICALE DU CHRU DE NANCY recrute un ingénieur projet Intelligence Artificielle. LE DTNIB : Le Département Territorial de la Transformation Numérique et de l'Ingénierie Biomédicale (DTNIB) du CHRU de Nancy regroupe trois secteurs clés qui collaborent étroitement pour mener à bien les projets de l'hôpital et offrir des services de soutien aux métiers des établissements de santé, assurant ainsi une prise en charge optimale des patients. SYSTÈME NUMÉRIQUE : Ce secteur est chargé de la gestion et de l'optimisation des infrastructures numériques de l'hôpital. Il garantit la sécurité des données, la maintenance des systèmes informatiques, l'accès aux applications métier et le développement de nouvelles solutions technologiques pour améliorer les services de santé. BIOMÉDICAL : Le secteur biomédical se concentre sur l'intégration, la maintenance, la gestion et l'innovation des équipements médicaux. Il veille à ce que les dispositifs médicaux soient toujours à la pointe de la technologie et fonctionnent de manière optimale pour garantir des soins de qualité aux patients. COORDINATION DE L'ACCOMPAGNEMENT MÉDICO-ADMINISTRATIF DU PATIENT : Ce secteur joue un rôle crucial dans l'accompagnement des patients tout au long de leur parcours de soins. Il coordonne les aspects administratifs et médicaux pour assurer une prise en charge fluide et efficace, en facilitant la communication entre les différents services de l'hôpital. En travaillant ensemble, ces trois secteurs permettent au DTNIB de réaliser des projets innovants et de garantir une prise en charge optimale des patients au sein du CHRU de Nancy. LE POSTE SERVICE : Equipe Innovations Numériques au sein de la DTNIB HORAIRES : 39h minimum par semaine CONTEXTE Le CHRU de Nancy se dote en 2026 d'une stratégie intelligence artificielle - Programme Puls'IA - pour donner les lignes directrices du déploiement de l'intelligence artificielle afin de répondre à trois principaux enjeux : Amélioration du parcours de soin par l'innovation et la recherche Optimisation du pilotage opérationnel avec une responsabilité sociale et environnementale Renforcement de la qualité de vie au travail en déchargeant des tâches administrative Cette stratégie s'attache à tirer pleinement partie de cette technologie au service des patients et et des agents tout en maitrisant ses risques. Afin de concevoir, déployer et maintenir des solutions IA, le DTNIB (Département Territorial du Numérique et de l'Ingénierie Biomédicale) accueille la cellule innovations numériques. La candidat.e retenu.e évoluera dans cette équipe en lien avec les autres ingénieurs IA du programme ENACT. fonctionnels à la lumière d'études médico-économiques et s'assurer de la pérennité des déploiements Fiabiliser et professionnaliser les développements internes en participant aux choix des stacks techniques, des infrastructures et des algorithmes d'IA Assurer le maintien en condition opérationnel des solutions déployées Accompagner les agents du CHRU dans la démocratisation de l'utilisation de l'IA dans leurs activités ACTIVITES PRINCIPALES Participation à l'identification et la qualification des besoins métiers au travers d'ateliers et interviewes Rédaction de cahiers des charges et des solutions proposées par des éditeurs ou porteurs de projet Rédaction de la documentation nécessaire pour la réplication et la diffusion des solutions développées Echanges avec les métiers pour les items.desc: Är du vår nästa Data Scientist? Vi utvecklar just nu hur vi arbetar med data och analys på ATG. Med nya verktyg och en modern dataplattform kommer vi kunna både fördjupa den analys vi redan gör och testa nya angreppssätt – från explorativ analys och prediktiva modeller till AI-baserade analysverktyg. Som Data Scientist hos oss arbetar du nära verksamheten med kund- och affärsfrågor. Det kan handla om att förstå kundbeteenden, mäta effekten av förändringar, utveckla modeller som skapar konkret nytta eller hitta helt nya sätt att använda vår data. I rollen kommer du bland annat: Driva analyser hela vägen – från att förstå och konkretisera ett affärsproblem, välja lämplig metod och bearbeta data till att presentera insikter som verksamheten kan förstå och agera på Analysera kundbeteenden och mäta effekten av olika förändringar och initiativ, exempelvis genom experiment och kontrollgruppsanalys Utveckla modeller och se till att de faktiskt går att använda och följa upp Arbeta mycket i SQL och Python/R Samarbeta med olika delar av verksamheten – från affären och andra analytiker till andra kompetenser inom data Vara med och utforska hur vi kan använda AI på ett vettigt sätt – både i verksamheten och i vårt eget analysarbete Är det här du? För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har ett starkt affärsintresse och är bekväm med statistik, machine learning och kvantitativ problemlösning. Du kan självständigt arbeta från rådata till slutsats eller produktionssatt lösning. SQL och Python/R är naturliga delar av ditt dagliga arbete, och erfarenhet av moderna molnbaserade dataplattformar, exempelvis Snowflake, är meriterande. Du har sannolikt en akademisk bakgrund inom ett kvantitativt område, till exempel teknik, statistik, matematik, datavetenskap eller nationalekonomi. Som person tror vi att du är nyfiken, strukturerad och trivs med att jobba självständigt. Du behöver inte ha jobbat med spel tidigare, men vi tror att du har ett genuint intresse för spel och är nyfiken på att förstå våra kunder och hur våra produkter fungerar. ”Som ledare vill jag skapa en välkomnande och tillåtande miljö, där vi har stort förtroende för varandras kompetens, tar eget ansvar och har nära till skratt.” Jag har jobbat på ATG i snart elva år och det som fortfarande gör jobbet roligt är kombinationen av en spännande affär, mycket data och frågor där analys faktiskt kan göra skillnad. I teamet vill jag att vi ska vara nyfikna, testa nya angreppssätt och ha egna idéer om hur vi kan använda vår data bättre för att driva affären framåt. För mig är det viktigt med stort eget ansvar och frihet i hur man löser sina uppgifter - Filip Dyrssen, Head of Customer Analytics We are the game I mer än 50 år har vi på ATG levererat spänning och underhållning till svenska folket. Vi drivs av att trygga den svenska hästnäringen och att fortsatt vara ett ansvarsfullt spelbolag i framkant. Vår vision är att leverera världens bästa spelupplevelse. Vi gillar att samarbeta och uppmuntrar varandra att tänka och testa nytt. Självledarskap och kompetensutveckling är viktiga delar för oss. Vi bryr oss om varandra och våra kunder och vi vill så klart också att alla tävlingshästar ska må bra. Hela vårt överskott går till hästnäringen – något som både känns och gör gott. Join the game! Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vår rekryteringsportal antingen med ditt cv eller din LinkedIn-profil – det som är enklast och smidigast för dig. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår karriärsida och tveka inte att höra av dig om du har frågor om tjänsten. Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning och kommer att göra en bakgrundskontroll för denna roll. Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor vid Solvalla, alldeles intill travbanan. Vi har ett flexibelt arbetssätt vilket innebär att du har möjlighet att kombinera distansarbete med arbete från kontoret. Var med och bygg världens bästa spelupplevelse tillsammans med oss!

items.desc: Data & AI Specialist We bouwen met Just Good People een nextgen data & AI team met leuke mensen met sterke data, AI, human & biz skills. Una posición en la que podrás combinar el análisis de datos, la estadística y el Machine Learning con una visión práctica de las necesidades de negocio, participando en diferentes fases de los proyectos y asumiendo responsabilidades
items.desc: En Dive tendrás la oportunidad de participar en proyectos de Data Science e Inteligencia Artificial, aplicando tus conocimientos técnicos a la resolución de problemas reales de negocio. Una posición en la que podrás combinar el análisis de datos, la estadística y el Machine Learning con una visión práctica de las necesidades de negocio, participando en diferentes fases de los proyectos y asumiendo responsabilidades técnicas de forma progresiva. Tu día a día: Participarás en proyectos de Data Science e Inteligencia Artificial, desarrollando soluciones analíticas para diferentes necesidades de negocio. Trabajarás en la recopilación, preparación, análisis y tratamiento de datos. Desarrollarás, entrenarás y evaluarás modelos estadísticos y de Machine Learning. Colaborarás con los equipos de negocio para comprender sus necesidades y traducirlas en objetivos y soluciones de Data Science. Asumirás la resolución de tareas técnicas con autonomía, contando con el apoyo del equipo en los retos de mayor complejidad. Analizarás e interpretarás resultados, identificando conclusiones y oportunidades de mejora. Participarás en la presentación de resultados y recomendaciones a equipos técnicos y de negocio. ¿Qué te ayudará a tener éxito? Formación universitaria en Matemáticas, Estadística, Ingeniería, Física, Economía o disciplinas similares. Conocimientos sólidos de matemáticas, estadística aplicada, Data Science y Machine Learning. Conocimientos de programación y manejo de herramientas utilizadas en el análisis y tratamiento de datos. Familiaridad con bases de datos y fundamentos de ingeniería de datos y desarrollo de software. Experiencia práctica desarrollando proyectos de Data Science, Inteligencia Artificial o analítica avanzada, ya sea en entornos profesionales, académicos o mediante proyectos propios. Capacidad para analizar problemas, plantear soluciones y trabajar con autonomía en tareas técnicas. Habilidades de comunicación, orientación a resultados y trabajo en equipo. Inglés profesional. Valoraremos especialmente Máster o formación especializada en Data Science, Inteligencia Artificial o Machine Learning. Experiencia participando en proyectos de consultoría, especialmente en entornos de datos e Inteligencia Artificial. Familiaridad con el ciclo de vida de los proyectos de Data Science, desde la definición del problema hasta la presentación de resultados. Experiencia trabajando con clientes o equipos de negocio. Conocimiento de herramientas de desarrollo asistidas por Inteligencia Artificial y vibe coding . ¿Qué puedes encontrar en esta posición? La oportunidad de trabajar en proyectos donde los datos y la Inteligencia Artificial se aplican a necesidades concretas de negocio. Un entorno en el que seguir desarrollando tus capacidades técnicas, ampliar tu conocimiento de distintas soluciones analíticas y asumir progresivamente mayor responsabilidad en los proyectos. Si disfrutas resolviendo problemas mediante los datos, te interesa la aplicación práctica de la Inteligencia Artificial y quieres seguir creciendo profesionalmente en este ámbito, nos encantará conocer tu perfil. Igualdad de oportunidades y diversidad En Dive, como parte de ISPD Group, nos encanta conocer a personas que se atreven a dar un paso más. ¿No tienes claro si cumples el 100 % de los requisitos? ¡No te descartes antes de tiempo! Si crees que esta oportunidad encaja contigo y tienes ganas de aportar al equipo, nos encantará conocer tu candidatura. Estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de oportunidades y con la creación de un entorno diverso e inclusivo, donde cada persona pueda ser ella misma. Por eso, te animamos a presentar tu candidatura.

items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we need a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team. This team is the beating heart of Prima. You’ll be joining over 350 engineers across software development, infrastructure, operations and security. Fueled by curiosity, experimentation and collaboration, you’ll help deliver scalable, impactful solutions that shape the future of insurance. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details As a Software Engineer working on our AI/ML Platform, you’ll help build the shared services, APIs and developer tools that enable engineers and data scientists across Prima to experiment, build and operate AI and Machine Learning solutions quickly and reliably. AI and Machine Learning are core to how Prima builds products, makes decisions and operates at scale. You’ll work on foundational capabilities used across the company, helping teams move faster and reducing the complexity of building with AI and ML. What You’ll Do Build and evolve our shared AI/ML platform. Design and own core services, APIs and developer tools that support AI and ML across their lifecycle. Solve engineering challenges around scalability, reliability, observability and developer experience. Understand user needs and turn complex problems into simple, reusable platform capabilities. Work closely with engineers and data scientists, taking ownership from technical design through implementation and operation. What We’re Looking For Software engineering experience with Python. Solid foundations in software design and architecture. Experience designing, building and operating reliable software systems. Strong engineering practices around testing, maintainability and code quality. Ability to tackle complex technical problems, make pragmatic design decisions and take ownership of the solutions you build. Stay curious about how AI is changing software engineering and use AI tools pragmatically to work better. Nice-to-Have Experience building platforms, developer tooling, or production AI systems. Hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies. Familiarity with ML infrastructure and orchestration tools. Experience with GenAI/LLM infrastructure, such as model APIs, gateways, evaluation systems, observability or cost monitoring. You don’t need to be an ML or AI researcher. We’re looking for strong software engineers who are excited about building the technology that enables AI and ML across the full lifecycle — from experimentation and development to deployment, operation and continuous improvement. We’re open to mid-level and senior engineers, with scope and ownership adapted to experience. €55,000 - €85,000 a year Why You’ll Love It Here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

items.desc: Queremos liderar la conversación europea sobre agricultura ecológica y regenerativa con evidencia, no con relato. CrowdFarming es, en su esencia, una empresa tecnológica. Conectamos a 3.500 agricultores de 15 países con más de 500.000 hogares en toda Europa a través de productos que hemos construido nosotros: nuestro marketplace (crowdfarming.com), CrowdSender (nuestro TMS) y Farmeneur, la plataforma donde los agricultores gestionan sus datos agronómicos y acceden a los servicios que les damos. Nuestra misión es hacer la agricultura ecológica y regenerativa posible para los agricultores y accesible para el consumidor. Reportarás al Head of Sustainability & Impact . Serás el/la primer/a ingeniero/a dedicado/a del equipo, trabajando junto a agricultores, agrónomos, y biólogos. Ellos aportan los problemas del campo y la ciencia; tú decides cómo construir las soluciones. También formarás parte del equipo técnico de CrowdFarming . Te integrarás en sus rituales de equipo y tu código pasará por las mismas revisiones y estándares que los de todos los demás. Serás responsable de tus proyectos, pero con todo un equipo de desarrollo respaldándote. Este no es un puesto de IT de back-office a la espera de tickets para cerrar. Asumirás la responsabilidad de los problemas de principio a fin (end-to-end), y construirás productos que los agricultores, nuestro equipo y nuestros socios realmente utilicen. 👉 Lo que estará sobre tu mesa En el equipo de Sustainability & Impact llevamos años construyendo nuestro programa de agricultura regenerativa. Hoy trabajamos con 100 agricultores, con un protocolo científico sólido y datos agronómicos sobre 10.000 hectáreas en 6 países. Necesitamos que construyas y lideres la columna vertebral digital que hace que todo funcione: las herramientas con las que opera el programa, los datos en los que confían nuestros agricultores y la forma en que todo el equipo trabaja con la tecnología, los datos y la IA. 🧩 Los Retos Que Nos Ayudarás a Resolver ¿Cómo transformamos lo que vemos en el campo en decisiones para la finca? Construye las herramientas que simplifiquen y hagan fiable el trabajo de campo de nuestros agrónomos, y que conviertan los datos en planes de acción concretos. Apóyate en la literatura científica existente para automatizar la mayor parte posible de esa toma de decisiones con reglas que los agrónomos puedan entender y discutir, no una caja negra. ¿Qué nos dicen los datos a gran escala? Detecta las tendencias en cientos de fincas y transfórmalas en información clave (insights) para nuestros agricultores, la industria alimentaria y la ciencia de la agricultura regenerativa-orgánica. Haz que nuestros datos sean limpios, trazables y robustos, de manera que cada cifra de impacto que compartamos resista una auditoría rigurosa. ¿Cómo le sacamos más partido a cada dato? Conecta estas herramientas con el resto de nuestros productos digitales para dar un mejor servicio a nuestros agricultores y que los consumidores puedan ver el valor real detrás de lo que compran. ¿Cómo crecemos sin aumentar el papeleo? Construye la plataforma sobre la que se ejecutan nuestros programas, de modo que la planificación, los recordatorios y el seguimiento ocurran dentro de nuestras herramientas y no en las bandejas de entrada, permitiendo que trabajar con más agricultores no implique más horas para el equipo. ¿Cómo integramos la IA en el día a día de un equipo científico? Encuentra dónde la IA realmente ahorra tiempo o mejora las decisiones, intégrala en nuestras herramientas y flujos de trabajo, y acompaña al equipo para que se convierta en nuestra forma habitual de trabajar. 👉 Quién eres La base (trayectoria): Desarrollo full-stack sólido (front y back end) y soltura real con datos: pipelines, APIs e integraciones, análisis y herramientas de BI / dashboarding. Nuestro stack es Angular, Node.js y AWS. La experiencia con estas tecnologías es un plus, no un requisito imprescindible. ADN de creador (Builder DNA): Despliegas cosas que se usan, en lugar de cosas perfectas que se quedan olvidadas en una rama del repositorio. Pragmático/a, autónomo/a y con enfoque de principio a fin (end-to-end). Has construido herramientas para usuarios no técnicos, idealmente para personas que trabajan sobre el terreno. Dominio fluido de la IA: Ya trabajas con herramientas de IA y logras entusiasmar a otros con ellas. Sabes transformar un "podríamos usar IA aquí" en algo que el equipo adopte de forma real. Narrador/a de datos (Data Storyteller): Conviertes un conjunto de datos caótico en algo que un agricultor entiende de inmediato. Un plus que te diferenciará: Interés en biología, agronomía o edafología (ciencia del suelo). Quieres entender por qué importan los datos del suelo y la agronomía para modelarlos bien. Si esto es nuevo para ti, sientes una curiosidad genuina y muchas ganas de aprender: estarás rodeado/a de agricultores, agrónomos y biólogos a los que les encanta explicarlo. items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we need a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team. This team is the beating heart of Prima. You’ll be joining over 350 engineers across software development, infrastructure, operations and security. Fueled by curiosity, experimentation and collaboration, you’ll help deliver scalable, impactful solutions that shape the future of insurance. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details As a Software Engineer working on our AI/ML Platform, you’ll help build the shared services, APIs and developer tools that enable engineers and data scientists across Prima to experiment, build and operate AI and Machine Learning solutions quickly and reliably. AI and Machine Learning are core to how Prima builds products, makes decisions and operates at scale. You’ll work on foundational capabilities used across the company, helping teams move faster and reducing the complexity of building with AI and ML. What You’ll Do Build and evolve our shared AI/ML platform. Design and own core services, APIs and developer tools that support AI and ML across their lifecycle. Solve engineering challenges around scalability, reliability, observability and developer experience. Understand user needs and turn complex problems into simple, reusable platform capabilities. Work closely with engineers and data scientists, taking ownership from technical design through implementation and operation. What We’re Looking For Software engineering experience with Python. Solid foundations in software design and architecture. Experience designing, building and operating reliable software systems. Strong engineering practices around testing, maintainability and code quality. Ability to tackle complex technical problems, make pragmatic design decisions and take ownership of the solutions you build. Stay curious about how AI is changing software engineering and use AI tools pragmatically to work better. Nice-to-Have Experience building platforms, developer tooling, or production AI systems. Hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies. Familiarity with ML infrastructure and orchestration tools. Experience with GenAI/LLM infrastructure, such as model APIs, gateways, evaluation systems, observability or cost monitoring. You don’t need to be an ML or AI researcher. We’re looking for strong software engineers who are excited about building the technology that enables AI and ML across the full lifecycle — from experimentation and development to deployment, operation and continuous improvement. We’re open to mid-level and senior engineers, with scope and ownership adapted to experience. €55,000 - €75,000 a year Why You’ll Love It Here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

items.desc: Aufgaben Willkommen bei der Allianz Die strategische Nutzung von Daten und KI beschleunigt sich weiter und birgt gerade in der Finanzdienstleistungsindustrie enorme Potenziale. Immer mehr KI-Fähigkeiten werden dabei konkret als eigenständige, interagierende Agenten umgesetzt, die über offene Standardprotokolle miteinander und mit Fachsystemen kommunizieren. Die technologische Entwicklung - insbesondere von Protokollen wie MCP (Model Context Protocol) und A2A (Agent2Agent) - führt dazu, dass Unternehmen ihre Agenten-Architekturen ständig weiterentwickeln und professionalisieren müssen. Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir einen KI-Architekt (m/w/d), der KI-Agenten mit starkem Blick auf die Geschäftsprozesse der Allianz Kunde und Markt GmbH konzipiert, baut und den produktionsreifen Betrieb von Anfang an mitdenkt. Diese Rolle ist explizit Business-orientiert - technische Kenntnisse sind Erfolgsvoraussetzung für ein wirkungsvolles Ausfüllen dieser Position. Das erwartet Dich bei uns als KI-Architekt (m/w/d) Du entwirfst und implementierst KI-Agenten und Multi-Agenten-Systeme auf Basis gängiger Standardprotokolle (insbesondere MCP und A2A) und stellst deren Interoperabilität mit internen und externen Systemen sicher. Du konzipierst mehrschichtige Agenten-Architekturen (z. B. Orchestrierungs-, Tool- und Serverebenen), inklusive Tool- und Resource-Design, Authentifizierung / Autorisierung (u. a. OAuth 2.1) und Anbindung an LLM-Provider (z. B. AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI). Du arbeitest eng mit Business Ownern und Experten (m/w/d) der Allianz in Deutschland zusammen, um Anforderungen in konkrete, produktionsreife Agenten-Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du gestaltest Datenarchitekturen im Einklang mit der übergreifenden Datenarchitektur der Allianz in Deutschland und berätst zum Einsatz von agentenbasierten und generativen KI-Lösungen in den Feldern Kundenschnittstelle, Prozessautomation und Versicherungstechnik. Du stellst Betriebsreife sicher: Observability (z. B. OpenTelemetry), Skalierbarkeit und sicheren Cloud-Betrieb (AWS, containerisiert, Infrastructure-as-Code mit Terraform). Du identifizierst bereichsübergreifend Abhängigkeiten und Synergien für KI-Agenten-Lösungen und arbeitest eng mit dem Chief Data Officer (m/w/d), Enterprise- bzw. Facharchitekten (m/w/d) und den verschiedenen AI Governance Funktionen zusammen. Profil Das bringst Du mit als KI-Architekt (m/w/d) Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Data Science, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation durch Berufserfahrung. Du bringst nachweisbare praktische Erfahrung im Bau von KI-Agenten auf Basis gängiger Standardprotokolle mit, insbesondere MCP und A2A, sowie ein gutes Verständnis von Tool-/Resource-Design und Agent-Orchestrierung. Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in mehreren Programmiersprachen (insb. Python und TypeScript) und deren Einsatz in produktiven KI- und Agenten-Umgebungen sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Data-Warehouse- und Analytics-Architekturen (u. a. SQL, Snowflake, Databricks). Du hast fundierte Praxis im Umgang mit Cloud-Plattformen und -Services, insbesondere AWS (z. B. ECS, Bedrock, Glue), sowie mit modernen Data- & AI-Plattformen wie Snowflake und Databricks. Ebenfalls verfügst du über Erfahrung im Design, Aufbau und sicheren Betrieb containerisierter, cloud-basierter Agenten- und Data-&-Analytics-Architekturen (inkl. Auth-Lösungen wie Keycloak / OAuth 2.1). Du denkst visionär und in architekturellen Zielbildern. Dabei behältst Du unsere Business-Prozesse immer stark im Blick. Deine langjährige Erfahrung in agiler Softwareentwicklung sowie im Design und Aufbau moderner CI/CD-Pipelines lässt Dich Zielbilder schnell in die Praxis umsetzen. Du bist ein starker Kommunikator, der Menschen mit unterschiedlichem technischen Wissen von Ideen überzeugen kann. Dabei arbeitest Du transparent, kollaborativ und mit hohem Fokus auf nachhaltig tragfähige Lösungen. Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und kommunizierst ebenso souverän auf Englisch. Wir bieten Unsere Highlights für Dich Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung, Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote sowie Präventionsmaßnahmen legen den Grundstein für körperliche und mentale Gesundheit. Vergütung: Tarifliche Sonderzahlungen, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vermögenswirksame Leistungen und Mitarbeiteraktien machen die Vergütung besonders attraktiv. Außerdem werden Mitarbeiter am Unternehmenserfolg beteiligt. Zeit & Flexibilität: Mit unserem Modell „Neues Arbeiten" können Beruf und Privatleben noch besser vereinbart werden. Wir arbeiten flexibel, hybrid, mobil und vor Ort. Karriereentwicklung: Wir erstellen gemeinsam einen persönlichen Entwicklungsplan und ermöglichen, funktions- und länderübergreifende Erfahrungen zu sammeln. items.desc: About Summary CricViz has established itself as a market leader in the collection, analysis, and dissemination of data across the world’s leading cricket competitions, maintaining the largest and most sophisticated database in world cricket. Our work spans several verticals, including Performance Analysis, Broadcast and Media, and Fantasy and Gaming platforms. Our clients include the BBC, Sky, Sony, the ECB, and IPL-winning franchises like RCB. About the Role We are seeking a talented Data Scientist / Data Engineer with a passion for cricket to join the CricViz team in London. This role focuses on the hands-on development of proprietary metrics, data pipelines, and predictive models derived from high-frequency cricket tracking data. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex data processing and commercial analytics, converting rich tracking datasets into market-leading analytical products. You will combine quantitative modeling and data engineering best practices with a deep, nuanced understanding of the game of cricket to help answer complex performance questions for elite professional clients. Key Responsibilities Metric Development & Data Pipelines: Build and optimize end-to-end data pipelines and algorithms that transform raw ball-tracking and player-tracking data into high-value metrics (e.g., pitch behavior, expected runs/wickets, advanced fielding analysis). Data Engineering & Productionisation: Support the scaling and productisation of predictive models and datasets, ensuring reliable integration into internal tools and client workflows. Bespoke Client Deliverables: Collaborate with senior team members to deliver custom datasets, niche analytics, and predictive modeling for private clients across professional cricket, media, and gaming. Model Validation & Testing: Conduct thorough testing, validation, and optimization of predictive models to maintain high accuracy and data integrity across all operational feeds. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal Product, Engineering, and Broadcast teams to ensure raw feeds and derived insights flow seamlessly into production systems. Cricket & Betting Applications: Work on sports analytics across media, fantasy, gaming, and sports betting applications. Candidates should be comfortable operating in an environment where betting-related data and modeling form part of the commercial landscape. Requirements Education: Degree in Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline. Practical Experience: ~2 years of hands-on experience developing data pipelines and applying statistical/data science techniques in a professional or production environment. Data Science & Engineering Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL . Familiarity with the PyData stack (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, or LightGBM). Experience handling, querying, and structuring structured and semi-structured datasets. Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of cricket, match dynamics, and tactical nuances, with the ability to reason about how data models reflect real-game scenarios. Desirable Tracking Data: Exposure to working with high-frequency spatial, GPS, or tracking data. Software Practices: Knowledge of modern software tools (Git, CI/CD, Docker, or cloud technologies like AWS/GCP). Technical Communication: Ability to explain technical logic and metrics to non-technical stakeholders clearly. Diversity & Inclusion CricViz is committed to building an open and inclusive culture that supports personal development and continuous learning. As part of Ellipse, we believe in equal opportunity in employment regardless of race, colour, nationality, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, age, ethnic or national origin, disability, or gender reassignment. Benefits 25 days annual leave + bank holidays Flexible hybrid working model with regular collaborative days at our London office Company pension scheme Life insurance & eye test contributions Dedicated training and professional development budget About Ellipse CricViz is part of Ellipse, a global leader in sports data and analytics alongside FootballViz, Horse Racing, RugbyViz, and TennisViz. Working with the world’s leading broadcasters, teams, and rights holders, we simplify complex data to tell compelling stories about the sports we love.

items.desc: About The Collective The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) ’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think. We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict , PropensityBench , and Professional Reasoning Benchmark. Why join the HFC HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team. Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions. Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more. Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition. Who should apply Background: PhD, or postdoctoral research experience, in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field; or senior industry experience in Machine Learning or a related field. Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and MLOps tools (Docker) and LLM frameworks (LangChain) is a plus. Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion for applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration. How it works Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement. Work authorization: We do not sponsor visas for Fellows. To participate in the HFC Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the country they reside in. Community Network: Once you’ve received an invitation to join the HFC, you’ll also gain access to our newsletters, discussion channels, virtual sessions, IRL events, and much more. Projects Logistics: Project selection: You’ll regularly get matched to carefully selected projects from our partners. items.desc: Examensarbete, 30 hp: AI-baserad detektion av små objekt i infraröda bilder Är du en student som är ivrig att tillämpa dina teoretiska kunskaper och nya perspektiv på verkliga utmaningar? På Saab tror vi att innovationer växer på nya idéer, och ditt examensarbete kan vara gnistan som tänder vårt nästa tekniska genombrott. Din roll Vi ser det enorma värdet som studenter tillför vårt företag. Din akademiska precision, i kombination med din entusiasm för avancerad teknik, gör att du kan närma dig problem med en unik och insiktsfull lins. På Saab får du möjlighet att samarbeta med erfarna ingenjörer och specialister, få ovärderlig praktisk erfarenhet och samtidigt bidra till vår tillväxt och utveckling. Bakgrund Infraröda sensorer används inom bland annat övervakning, sök- och räddningsinsatser samt omvärldsuppfattning. Att detektera små objekt i infraröda bilder är en utmaning eftersom objekten ofta endast upptar ett fåtal pixlar och saknar tydlig form och struktur. Svag kontrast mot bakgrunden, sensorbrus och störande bakgrundsdetaljer gör det dessutom svårt att skilja relevanta objekt från omgivningen. Beskrivning av examensarbetet Syftet med exjobbet är att undersöka och utvärdera metoder för detektion av små objekt i infraröda bilder. Arbetet kan omfatta traditionella bildbehandlingsmetoder baserade på filtrering och lokal kontrast, samt djupinlärningsbaserade metoder för detektion och segmentering. Beroende på tillgång till videodata kan även tidsinformation från flera bildrutor användas för att förbättra detektionen. Utvalda metoder implementeras och utvärderas på separata tränings- och testdataset. Fokus ligger på detektionsförmåga, falsklarm och robusthet vid varierande objektstorlek, kontrast och bakgrund. Arbetet kan även undersöka sambandet mellan modellkomplexitet, beräkningstid och prestanda, med målet att bedöma metodernas lämplighet för praktisk användning. Exempel på forskningsfrågor Hur presterar djupinlärningsbaserade metoder jämfört med traditionella metoder för att detektera små och svagt framträdande objekt i infraröda bilder? Hur påverkas detektionsförmågan och antalet falsklarm av objektens storlek och kontrast samt av brus och komplexa bakgrunder? Hur väl generaliserar metoderna till andra miljöer och sensorer, och hur kan träningsstrategier och dataaugmentering förbättra robustheten? Vilken avvägning mellan detektionsprestanda, falsklarm och beräkningstid är möjlig för tillämpningar med krav på realtidsbearbetning? Saab Dynamics har en lång tradition inom bildbehandlingsområdet och sektionerna för bildbehandling samt optronik & bildbaserad navigering handleder årligen ett antal exjobbare inom området. I dagsläget är vi drygt 30 personer mellan sektionerna och arbetar med allt från elektrooptiska sensorer till realtidsimplementering av våra bildbehandlingsapplikationer. Din profil Arbetet är lämpligt för 1-2 studenter i slutet av er teknisk fysik- eller datorteknik-utbildning (eller motsvarande) och ska påbörja ert 30 hp examensarbete. Erfarenheter av maskininlärning, datorseende och programmering är meriterande. Samt med intresse för maskininlärning och datorseende. Vi ger dig det stöd och den vägledning du behöver för att omsätta dina teoretiska kunskaper i praktiska lösningar. Bli en drivande kraft bakom Saabs tekniska framsteg! Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut. Kontaktpersoner Marcus Klomark, Sektionschef Bildbehandling marcus.klomark@saabgroup.com 076-8967055 Simon Wold, kontaktperson/handledare Simon.wold@saabgroup.com Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

Work with product teams to identify high-impact opportunities where AI can transform the user experience for millions—and then build these transformative solutions. items.desc: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Build AI-powered product experiences. Work with product teams to identify high-impact opportunities where AI can transform the user experience for millions—and then build these transformative solutions. Drive the process from possibility to production, delivering code that’s robust, reproducible, and built for scale. Amplify your impact with AI. Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability. Master your toolkit. Work across diverse stacks with end-to-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. From monoliths to microservices, gRPC to REST, Kubernetes to Docker, Python to Rust—you’ll apply technologies thoughtfully, focusing on depth and purpose rather than trends. Build software that matters. Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale. Simplify relentlessly. Question every layer of complexity. Improve architectures, pipelines, and codebases to build systems that are simpler, more scalable, and easier to maintain. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. A flexible start date and part-time options. You don't need to wait until graduation to apply. We offer flexible start dates and the possibility to begin part-time, transitioning to full-time as you complete your degree. Many Spooners joined before graduating and progressively took on greater responsibility, with arrangements that allowed them to do so without compromising their education. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time. Location …

items.card: Your Role La risorsa Junior sarà inserita in un team di lavoro, affiancando colleghi senior e occupandosi di: Interpretare proattivamente i bisogni del cliente, individuando metodologie e approcci coerenti Sviluppare iniziative e soluzioni in modo indipendente, raccogliendo ed analizzando dati a supporto dell’elaborazione di soluzioni per i clienti Elaborare teaser e presentazioni per supportare il top management
items.desc: Junior – Artificial Intelligence and Data Stiamo cercando una figura junior da inserire nel team di Artificial Intelligence and Data di Deloitte Consulting nella sede di Roma/Milano , che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid . Nel Team di Artificial Intelligence & Data avrai l’occasione di aiutare, in ambito Analytics, le aziende a valorizzare i dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee trasformandoli in informazioni accurate e immediatamente utilizzabili, elementi indispensabili per quelle aziende che vogliono fare decision-making fact-driven. La Offering Artificial Intelligence & Data è pertanto l’opzione best in class nell’individuazione, progettazione e implementazione di soluzioni di Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning, Data Visualization, Big Data Management, con un approccio agnostico dal punto di vista tecnologico. Your Role La risorsa Junior sarà inserita in un team di lavoro, affiancando colleghi senior e occupandosi di: Interpretare proattivamente i bisogni del cliente, individuando metodologie e approcci coerenti Sviluppare iniziative e soluzioni in modo indipendente, raccogliendo ed analizzando dati a supporto dell’elaborazione di soluzioni per i clienti Elaborare teaser e presentazioni per supportare il top management Individuare potenziali rischi e criticità e condividerli tempestivamente con il resto del team Collaborare efficacemente in team eterogenei ed internazionali What We Offer La retribuzione prevista per la posizione di Analyst è compresa tra EUR 26.500 e EUR 31.000 lordi annui. In caso di stage, è prevista un’indennità di tirocinio. L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi. La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione. Winning Requirements Brillante percorso accademico con laurea specialistica in materie STEM Familiarità con la modellazione e linguaggio di interrogazione dei data base; conoscenza di uno o più linguaggi di accesso al dato e programmazione (Python, R, Java, SQL); ottima conoscenza degli applicativi MS Word, MS Excel e MS Power Point; nozioni accademiche di modelli statistici per l’analisi dei dati Forte propensione/interesse per le nuove tecnologie e per l’informatica Elevata attitudine a lavorare sia autonomamente che in team, capacità analitiche e di problem solving, gestione dello stress, flessibilità, precisione e uno spiccato orientamento al raggiungimento dei risultati Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese; disponibilità a lavorare in trasferta, anche all’estero To Make An Impact That Matters Il network Deloitte, leader nei servizi professionali alle imprese, opera a livello globale in più di 150 Paesi con oltre 460 mila persone. In Italia, Deloitte è presente in 24 città con circa 13.400 persone che assistono i clienti offrendo servizi di Audit & Assurance, Technology & Transformation, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory e Tax & Legal. In qualità di network globale ci impegniamo per affrontare le principali sfide sociali, economiche e ambientali della società di oggi. WordImpact è il nostro programma globale che riunisce tutte le iniziative attraverso cui vogliamo avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, i clienti, l’ambiente e le comunità in cui operiamo. Con I mpact for Italy , la declinazione italiana di WorldImpact, Deloitte ha realizzato progetti che – in collaborazione con istituzioni, realtà del terzo settore, università e altri soggetti – hanno lasciato un impatto concreto e una legacy per il futuro su tutto il territorio nazionale. La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006, il D.lgs. 215/03 e il D.lgs. 216/03 ed è aperta a candidat* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

Du verbindest
items.desc: Stellvertretender Teamleiter für KI-Trainings (m/w/d) Rolle Bist du ein prozessstarkes Organisationstalent mit gutem technischem Verständnis, das Zahlen liebt, aber genauso gerne selbst als Trainer agierst? Bei Agile Heroes GmbH suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Stellvertretung unseres Teamleads. In dieser Rolle bist du ein operativer Motor beim Aufbau und der Skalierung unseres KI-Bereichs . Du verbindest das aktive Halten unserer erstklassigen KI-Manager-Ausbildung mit der effizienten Steuerung, Disposition und datengetriebenen Führung unseres Trainer-Teams. Das ist eine vielseitige Schlüsselposition: Du glänzt als Trainer in unsereKI Manager Ausbildung, behältst im Alltag parallel jedoch voll die operative Exzellenz im Blick und sorgst für die verlässliche Entlastung sowie Vertretung des Leads bei Abwesenheiten. Verantwortlichkeiten Aktive Trainingsdurchführung: Du leitest und moderierst selbst regelmäßig unsere hochwertige KI-Manager-Ausbildung sowie KI-Workshops und digitale Lernformate für Fach- und Führungskräfte. Aufbau & Skalierung des KI-Bereichs: Du arbeitest strategisch und operativ am kontinuierlichen Ausbau des KI-Portfolios von Agile Heroes mit, um uns als Nr. 1 für KI-Weiterbildung in Deutschland zu etablieren. Operative Teamsteuerung & Disposition: Du gestaltest die Einsatz- und Kapazitätsplanung unseres Trainer-Teams so effizient wie möglich, um Leerläufe zu vermeiden und maximale Qualität zu sichern. KPI-Management & Datenanalyse: Du erfasst relevante Kennzahlen (z. B. Trainerauslastung, Kunden-Net-Promoter-Score, Umsatz pro Kurs, Margen), analysierst diese präzise und ziehst daraus die richtigen strategischen Schlüsse für das Management. Ausschreibungsmanagement (Tendering): Du betreust und steuerst eigenverantwortlich Ausschreibungen im B2B-Bereich, bereitest Angebote professionell vor und sicherst uns so strategische Großprojekte bei Konzernen und dem Mittelstand. Entlastung & Vertretung des Leads: Du sicherst das reibungslose Tagesgeschäft, hältst dem Teamlead den Rücken frei und vertrittst die Führungskraft bei Abwesenheit vollumfänglich. Fachliche Führung & Qualität: Du nutzt deine Führungserfahrung fürs Onboarding neuer Trainer, führst Peer-Reviews durch und sicherst das didaktische sowie fachliche Niveau des gesamten Teams. Anforderungen Führungserfahrung: Du bringst bereits nachweisbare, erste Führungserfahrung (fachlich, disziplinarisch oder in der operativen Projektleitung) mit und hast idealerweise schon Teams oder Ressourcen gesteuert. items.desc: Vill du leda en europeisk satsning där AI, flyg och drönare möts, och där företag och offentliga verksamheter får hjälp att ta nästa steg? Hos oss får du ansvaret för Aero EDIH(European Digital Innovation Hub) Ai och håller ihop ett konsortium med Linköpings universitet, Lunds universitet, RISE och Linköping Science Park. Vilka är vi? Hos oss på Norrköping Science Park möts innovation, forskning och samhällsutveckling. Här får du utrymme att växa, påverka och samarbeta i en miljö som bryr sig om både resultat och människor. Vi erbjuder en flexibel arbetsmiljö där professionalism möter nyfikenhet och där ditt engagemang formar både din egen och vår gemensamma resa framåt. Ett av våra viktigaste uppdrag är att skapa förutsättningar för fler företag och arbetstillfällen att födas och växa. Vi driver startupmiljöer och ett stort antal utvecklingsprojekt tillsammans med företag, universitet och offentlig sektor, regionalt och i Europa. Projektet Aero EDIH Ai bygger vidare på Aero EDIH, som vi har lett sedan starten och som överträffade sina mål. Nu tar vi nästa steg med ett tydligare fokus på AI. Projektet handlar om att hjälper företag och offentliga verksamheter att testa AI och ny teknik innan de investerar, bygga kompetens inom AI, data och cybersäkerhet och hitta finansiering till nästa steg, med stöd av ett nätverk regionalt och i Europa. Fokus ligger på flyg- och drönarbranschen och det nedre luftrummet. Vi arbetar också med närliggande sektorer som skog, jordbruk, infrastruktur, energi och logistik, där drönare och AI kan göra stor nytta. Dina arbetsuppgifter Som projektledare har du det övergripande ansvaret för Aero EDIH AI och leder arbetspaketet för projektledning och koordinering. Du håller ihop partnerna, ser till att tjänsterna når ut till företagen och att de håller hög kvalitet, och bygger kontakter med nätverk och AI-infrastrukturer i hela Europa. Du har en akademisk utbildning inom teknik, industriell ekonomi, flygteknik, Ai eller annan akademisk utbildning eller erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. Du har tidigare lett komplexa projekt med internationell koppling, gärna med många olika aktörer och partner i flera länder. Du har lett konsortier eller samarbeten med flera organisationer där du behövt leda utan formellt chefsmandat. Du förstår AI och digitalisering tillräckligt väl för att föra trovärdiga samtal med företag om AI, data och cybersäkerhet. Du behöver inte vara tekniker, men du är beredd att sätta dig in i regelverk som AI Act och NIS2 och hur de påverkar företagen. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att leda EU-finansierade projekt, till exempel inom Digital Europe, Horizon Europe eller Interreg, och känner EU:s regler för ekonomi och rapportering, som Grant Agreement, Consortium Agreement och Funding & Tenders-portalen. items.desc: Founding Robotics Perception Engineer | YC-Backed Physical AI & Robotics Startup | London (Remote) | Full-Time | Up to £150K + Equity About The Company Our client is a Y Combinator-backed (S26) physical AI data company building the foundational human video and motion datasets for leading robotics and embodied-AI teams. Focused on egocentric first-person video and UMI demonstration data, the company turns real-world capture operations into high-precision, versioned data products that foundation-model and VLA teams rely on to train physical robots. Backed by a freshly closed seed round, their core constraint is supply, not demand. They are actively scaling deployment engineering, field operations, and capture hardware to keep up with massive customer demand. The founders are building a three-person founding engineering team to set the technical standards, tooling, and evaluation methodology behind the world's reference dataset for robot learning. About The Role Reporting to the Engineering Lead (with direct collaboration with the Founders), the Founding Robotics Perception Engineer owns hand tracking, motion reconstruction, and capture-device software integration. You will serve as the technical authority on turning raw camera and sensor recordings into accurate, physical 3D trajectories. Your work directly determines whether the motion data is accurate enough for its intended use and sets the company's technical standard for motion data. You will build production pipelines for 3D hand tracking and gripper trajectory estimation, integrate camera SDKs and spatial sensors, and establish the physical accuracy benchmarks and quality flags that give robotics teams total confidence in the data. Key Responsibilities Build, refine, and maintain production pipelines for 3D hand tracking from egocentric video and gripper trajectory reconstruction from UMI recordings. Integrate camera streams, IMUs, and device SDKs into the collection software, ensuring flawless handling of spatial calibration, coordinate frames, timestamps, and units. Develop diagnostic tools to detect occluded hands, lost tracks, motion drift, coordinate discrepancies, dropped frames, and timestamp misalignments, applying automated quality flags for data review. Compare motion estimates against physical reference standards, quantify error and coverage, and maintain automated regression tests to confirm that pipeline changes genuinely improve data accuracy. Test and benchmark newly purchased cameras and capture hardware on representative tasks, evaluating baseline signal quality and reliability prior to wider operational deployment. Skills & Competencies Deep spatial understanding of 3D camera geometry, camera-IMU calibration, coordinate transforms, temporal tracking, and multi-view reconstruction. Hands-on experience with 3D hand tracking, visual odometry, SLAM, or pose estimation using real-world camera and sensor recordings. Strong production programming capabilities in Python (along with C++ and GPU inference where required) backed by practical deep learning implementation skills. Exceptional ability to separate model errors from sensor faults, isolating physical discrepancies, dropped frames, and timestamp drift. Qualifications & Experience Background in hand tracking, motion capture, AR/VR, spatial computing, robotics, autonomous systems, or sensor fusion. Proven track record of taking perception or tracking systems beyond controlled lab conditions to real sensor recordings used by actual applications. Direct experience handling raw device SDKs, coordinate frame conventions, and physical accuracy validation against meaningful ground-truth references. Experience with egocentric video, camera-IMU setups, visual odometry, or multi-view reconstruction is highly valuable. Role Details Timing: Immediate Start Location: London (Remote). Package: Competitive base salary up to £150K + significant founding-engineer equity with total technical ownership over the perception domain.
