items.desc: We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us! As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together. The Role As a Data Scientist, you will be a valued technical contributor in our Data Science Products team and in the Data, Analytics and AI organisation of Arrive. The Data Science Products team ingests billions of complex sensor data points daily to produce advanced machine learning products that help millions of drivers park or charge electric vehicles. For example, we predict the availability of parking in cities across the world and provide drivers with routes that reduce the time they will spend searching for a space near their destination. This is a data science role focused on building and improving production modelling products. We are looking for a skilled data scientist who combines strong mathematical foundations with the ability to deliver high-quality, production-ready solutions. You will contribute to our modelling approaches and work closely with data scientists and engineers to follow good technical practice. How To Make An Impact Develop New Products: Contribute to projects that solve business challenges relevant to parking, EV charging, and journey routing. This includes conducting in-depth analysis of new data sources, and researching, implementing and testing potential modelling approaches. Enhance Existing Products: Build on products already in production, improving their performance through iterative development and rigorous experimentation. Ship Production-Quality Code: Write high-quality code and contribute to the pipelines in our production codebase, deploying scalable products in collaboration with our engineers. Advance Modelling Practices: Develop new skills and enhance our services and ways of working by researching and implementing relevant approaches or technologies, particularly around statistical and machine learning techniques. Collaborate Across the Team: Be a great member of the team - while the work involves a good degree of autonomy, we value collaborating with and supporting colleagues across Data Science, Analytics and Engineering. About You You are a collaborative data scientist who takes pride in delivering real value to customers through well-built, well-reasoned products. You enjoy tackling complex, ambiguous problems with creative solutions while maintaining rigour in your mathematical and statistical approach. You are passionate about building robust, production-grade models and value working in a supportive, learning-focused environment. Your background Minimum of 2 years professional experience, including building statistical or machine learning products in a commercial setting (preferably being involved in their deployment). Strong mathematical and theoretical skills, especially probability theory, such as from an MSc or a highly mathematical undergraduate degree. An ability to understand complex problems and find creative solutions. Proficient in Python with good knowledge of the Python data science ecosystem (e.g. Pandas, Numpy, Scikit-Learn). Good knowledge of statistical and machine learning techniques, and experience using relevant tools. Good software engineering practices. Nice to have: Background in GIS (Geographic Information Systems), or experience working with geospatial data and relevant Python packages (e.g. GeoPandas) Large data sets and big data tools (ideally PySpark) Cloud computing environments (e.g. AWS) This is a hybrid role based in Chișinău, Moldova. About Arrive Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 The 13-week Summer Industrial Placement Programme 
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one?
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for summer placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates.
 We have created a programme across our UK sites that not only increases your technical skills, but gives you the opportunity to work on meaningful real-life projects, alongside experienced engineers and graduates across our business.
 You will receive coaching and support to achieve your personal goals and work in multidisciplinary teams to gain as much experience across the product lifecycle from your time in industry as possible. Our aim is to see you through your undergrad years and successful placements may result in an offer to return for further placements or for an offer on our Graduate Development programme.
 This programme is remunerated £26,228 per annum.
 The programme will run from 1st June- 27th August 2027
 What you’ll do as a Summer Placement Systems Engineer 
 Systems Engineers are involved in all aspects of design and development; from initial product design through to in-service support.
 They look at the big picture, determine how the system needs to operate and collaborate to produce the required overall operational behaviours. They also dive into the deepest level of detail – taking the system piece-by-piece and defining its design to the finest point. Our Systems Engineers can also actively engage in R&D, developing new concepts and conducting fundamental research into our future technologies.
 As a Summer Placement Systems Engineer, you will work on real engineering problems within either the Radar or the Advanced Targeting business area.
 You will have the opportunity to be involved in supporting a wide range of tasks across multiple projects/products, such as:
 The radar for the Typhoon fighter jet
 The radar for the SAAB Gripen fighter
 Our family of Surveillance AESA (Active Electronically Scanned Array) radars
 An IRCM (Infra-Red Counter Measures) system
 Our laser target designator or laser ranging systems
 Core activities within Systems Engineering include:
 Requirements capture, design documentation, verification and validation.
 Algorithm design and test.
 Performance modelling; building physics-based models to test our designs through computer simulation.
 Data analysis; end-to-end systems analysis using synthetic and ‘real world’ data.
 Applied research; from product improvements to blue-sky thinking.
 You will work with an experienced engineer who will provide day-to-day guidance and on-the-job training. You will be introduced to systems engineering processes, methods, technology and tools, with particular emphasis placed on learning practical skills that may not be easily gained or experienced in the academic environment of a university.
 What you’ll bring 
 Be a self-motivated individual, willing to take on new challenges and drive continuous personal development
 Strong communication skills across a variety of mediums i.e. written, verbal, digital, etc.
 The ability to develop effective working relationships with peers and stakeholders
 Adaptable to the ever-changing demands that will be encountered within the role
 Offer novel ideas and methods for solving technical problems, drawing on personal experiences and knowledge learned during academic studies
 Role Requirements 
 All of our Summer Placement roles require you to be currently studying a relevant degree discipline such as Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, or other STEM subject degrees. This should be a minimum of a Bachelors level degree.
 All successful candidates must be returning to university after their Summer Placement, i.e. not in their final year.
 In addition to this, we would be interested in hearing from you if you have experience in:
 Coding/programming.
 Relevant project work and/or placements in industry.
 Applying your science and technology knowledge to solve a real-world problem
 This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.
 Security Clearance 
 At Leonardo, many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five …

 At Leonardo, we’re looking for industrial placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 Leonardo’s Industrial Placement Programme offers you a paid placement to develop your knowledge and skills in our innovative and practical environment. In addition to working with our highly skilled engineers and business professionals, successful completion of an Industrial Placement can often lead to an offer for a permanent graduate position and securing your place on our industry leading Graduate Development Programme.
 This programme is remunerated £26,228 per annum.
 A 6 month – 1 year Industrial Placement Programme 
 Our Industrial Placement Programme is designed to offer you the opportunity to develop the knowledge and skills you require to become an engineering or business professional of the future. On our programme you will engage with challenging and exciting project work, and deliver innovative business or technical solutions as part of a team of subject matter experts. Throughout the programme you will receive coaching and support from your team to achieve your objectives as well as your personal development goals. You will gain a wide array of experience on your placement that you can apply to your academic studies and future career.
 At Leonardo we value individuals who continuously demonstrate a dedication to their personal development. We are looking for highly motivated individuals who are willing to take on a challenge to complete a placement, and we will demand a high degree of customer focus and work performance from you in order to meet our operational challenges. If you are willing to commit to giving your best performance, you will find Leonardo a very rewarding place to work!
 Successful completion of an Industrial Placement with Leonardo may also lead to an offer on our Graduate Development Programme. 
 During your placement, we encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience.

items.desc:
Research Assistant Position on Biomarkers and Pre-emptive Intervention in Infants at-risk for Autism - IT | Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia 
 Research Assistant Position on Biomarkers and Pre-emptive Intervention in Infants at-risk for Autism 
 Italy 
 Commitment & contract: fellow position, collaboration contract 
 Location: Rovereto (TN), CNCS@UniTn - Trento 
 Project: FIRRST: Fostering Infant Responsivity and Reciprocity - Support to Thrive. A Multisite Randomized Control Trial of a Preemptive Telehealth Intervention for Infants with Early Signs of Autism Spectrum Disorders, ” CUP J33C24000910006, funded by the European Union – Next Generation EU – PNRR M6C2 - Investment 2.1 Enhancement and strengthening of biomedical research in the SSN. 
 Step into a world of endless possibilities, together let’s leave something for the future! 
 At IIT, we are committed to advancing human-centered Science and Technology to address the most urgent societal challenges of our era. We foster excellence in both fundamental and applied research, spanning fields such as neuroscience and cognition, humanoid technologies and robotics, artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, and material sciences, offering a truly interdisciplinary scientific experience. Our approach integrates cutting-edge tools and technology, empowering researchers to push the limits of knowledge and innovation. With us, your curiosity will know no bounds.
 We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering diversity in all its forms, creating an inclusive environment. We value the unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives of our people. By embracing diversity, we believe science can achieve its fullest potential.
 THE ROLE 
 The Neurodevelopmental Disorders Research Unit at Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia - IIT ( https://www.iit.it/research/lines/neurodevelopmental-disorders) , led by Dr. Michael Lombardo, is looking for a talented Research Assistant as part of ongoing research partly-funded by a PNRR project (FIRRST) examining pre-emptive intervention in infants screened as at-risk for developing autism. The position will require individuals to be focused on data organization and analyses of EEG and phenotypic data from at-risk infants collected from other collaborative sites working on the project. The Neurodevelopmental Disorders research unit at IIT has the general goal of delineating important distinctions within the population of individuals with autism. The laboratory uses multidisciplinary methods such as observation behavioral methods, neuropsychological testing, eye tracking, EEG, MRI, and fMRI. The successful candidate will aid other lab personnel (PI, post-docs, PhD students, other RAs) in actions relevant to the research program’s aims.
 ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS 
 Possession of a Bachelors or Masters in a discipline related to the work we do in the lab (e.g., psychology, psychiatry, neuroscience, cognitive science)
 Good command of both Italian and English languages and good organizational skills
 Prior research experience working with children and/or adults with neurodevelopmental disorders
 ADDITIONAL SKILLS 
 Training or experience on existing neuropsychological and/or clinical assessments such as IQ assessments and/or the ADOS.
 Computational skills (e.g. statistics, coding skills in MATLAB, R, Python)
 High motivation and ability to work both independently and as part of a team
 Knowledge of the field of autism and neurodevelopmental disorders
 Motivation to pursue a career in academic research
 COMPENSATION PACKAGE 
 A yearly gross salary of about 22,500 €
 Candidates from abroad or Italian citizens who have carried scientific research activity permanently abroad and meet specific requirements, may be entitled to a deduction from taxable income of up to 90% from 6 to 13 years.
 Please submit your application using the online form and including a detailed CV, cover letter explaining your fit and motivation for the position, and 2 referece letters.

items.desc: Alacris Theranostics GmbH is a leader in innovative molecular diagnostics, specialising in personalised oncology. Our cutting-edge solutions combine next-generation sequencing (NGS), advanced bioinformatics, and systems biology to transform scientific insights into enhanced cancer diagnostics and more precise treatment decisions. We collaborate closely with leading research institutions, hospitals, and pharmaceutical partners to drive meaningful and lasting improvements in patient outcomes. Tasks We are seeking an experienced Bioinformatician / Computational Biologist with a strong track record in next-generation sequencing (NGS) data analysis. The successful candidate will be responsible for processing and analysing NGS datasets - including RNA-Seq, whole-exome sequencing (WES), whole-genome sequencing (WGS), and single-cell sequencing - derived from tumour samples. Requirements The ideal candidate will demonstrate excellent programming skills in R and Python, along with proven expertise in NGS data analysis and a solid foundation in human molecular genetics. Knowledge of statistics, high-dimensional data analysis, and cancer genomics is highly desirable. We are looking for a candidate with a genuine interest in precision oncology, a proactive approach to learning, and a commitment to developing new skills. Strong motivation, a collaborative mindset, and excellent communication skills are essential Benefits You will join a multidisciplinary team of bioinformaticians, molecular biologists, and software engineers dedicated to developing innovative analysis pipelines and diagnostic solutions in oncology. We offer a rewarding and challenging role within a dynamic biotech company based in the vibrant city of Berlin. The position comes with a competitive salary and a stimulating working environment. The appointment is available immediately and will initially be for a two-year term, with the possibility of extension. How to Apply? Interested candidates should provide a CV, publication list, details of previous research and work experience, and contact details of three referees as a single PDF file, citing reference ALA-NGSA-0426 . The closing date for applications is April 15, 2026.

items.desc: About Proton Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives! We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top :1% of applicants. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here! The team MSA is a highly multi-disciplinary group started in 2019 to tackle difficult mail delivery, spam, abuse, and account security problems that impact the Proton ecosystem. We built sophisticated systems from scratch that combine big data, human intelligence, machine learning, and AI agents to make tens of millions of realtime or asynchronous decisions each day. Our custom systems have reduced spam filter misclassifications by over 80% and protected millions of users from account compromise by attackers. In order to move fast with limited resources, we are organized into autonomous teams responsible for the whole system, with fullstack expertise across infrastructure, data storage, backend, frontend, machine learning, and AI agents. You can also enjoy working from home up to 30% of the time, while enjoying great company during our three core days in the office. Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals. Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices. Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location. Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us. Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings. Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning. Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs. Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. (www.meetiqm.com) We are looking for a Quantum Error Correction Engineer . In this role, you turn quantum error correction theory into practical building blocks for fault-tolerant quantum computing. You will help design, analyze, and implement error-correcting codes and decoding algorithms that pave the way for scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing architectures. Your work connects theory with hardware reality and plays a central role in shaping how our quantum processors scale reliably. The position is based in Munich, Germany. What will I be doing? Ph.D. in theoretical physics, computer science, applied mathematics, or a similar field Deep knowledge of quantum error-correcting codes, fault-tolerant quantum algorithms, or decoding algorithms At least 2 years of professional experience developing scientific software in Python, C/C++, or Rust A strong publication record, including at least two scientific papers in high-impact journals Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts across interdisciplinary teams A collaborative mindset and comfort working in a team-oriented research and engineering environment At least 3 years of experience in one or more of the following: Designing quantum error-correcting codes under connectivity constraints Multi-qubit logical gate implementations (e.g., lattice surgery) Fault-tolerant quantum algorithms Algorithm-specific error correction (e.g., fermionic simulations) Decoding algorithms (belief propagation, union-find, MWPM) Machine-learning-based decoding methods FPGA-based implementation of decoding algorithms What skills are nice to have? Knowledge of the theory of superconducting qubits Experience working closely with hardware or experimental quantum teams A drive to keep your expertise current and continuously expand your knowledge The ability to create elegant, structured solutions in complex theoretical and technical landscapes Strong ownership of code quality, testing, and documentation An understanding of how to balance immediate project goals with long-term scalability and extensibility What can I expect from IQM? items.desc: The Opportunity As R&D Computational Fluid Dynamics Associate Engineer, you will join our Global Multi-Physic Simulation (GLOMUS) network team in the Technology Center of HITACHI-Energy. You will join a team of CFD analysts as part of a wider group of key people with specific expertise in the fields of electrical, structural, acoustic, thermo-mechanic and fluid-dynamics analyses, simulation and testing. As part of our global R&D community including Technology Centers and Research Centers worldwide, you will contribute to support all factories in the PG Dry, Traction and Distribution Transformers on innovative and challenging research projects. How You’ll Make An Impact You will be responsible for creating and improving analytical tools and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) automations for thermo-fluid dynamic analysis in electrical machines such as transformers and reactors. Propose and provide technical solutions for a variety of transformers and reactors, ensuring that they meet the required standards and performance expectations Actively participate in the creation, updating, and maintenance of technical standards that dictate the management of thermo-mechanical performance of various transformers, including dry, liquid-filled, and traction distribution transformers Work within the GLOMUS network, collaborating with other simulation teams to deliver comprehensive multi-physic finite element methodologies and automations for coupled electromagnetic, structural, and fluid-dynamic problems Design and conduct experimental campaigns to validate the technical solutions and numerical models you or the team propose Provide timely and effective support to factories facing technical challenges and facilitate the transfer of technology and knowledge from R&D to the engineering department through the creation of design rules, training materials, and collaboration with design tools teams Carry out CFD simulations for cooling systems in all types of transformers, run feasibility studies, develop new technical concepts, design new products, and simulate their expected performances to contribute to technology development projects Your Background PhD or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a closely related field, with a strong focus on heat transfer, fluid mechanics, and thermodynamics. Strong hands-on experience in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and thermo-mechanical simulations, applied to complex industrial systems such as transformers or similar thermal-fluid equipment. Advanced proficiency in numerical methods for thermodynamic and heat transfer simulations, including conjugate heat transfer, turbulence modelling, and transient analyses. Practical experience with industry-standard tools such as ANSYS CFX/FLUENT, OpenFOAM, COMSOL and StarCCM+, with demonstrated ability to customize models for internal oil flows, cooling ducts, and heat exchangers. Solid knowledge of programming and scripting for model development, automation, and post-processing, including MATLAB, Python, and Visual Basic. Ability to develop custom thermal or thermal-hydraulic solvers, parameter estimation routines, and data-driven enhancements to physics-based models. Understanding of Fluid–Structure Interaction (FSI) theory, particularly as applied to thermally induced stresses, vibration risks, and deformation in fluid-cooled structures. Experience coupling thermal, hydraulic, and mechanical domains in multiphysics simulation environments. Excellent communication skills, able to convey complex thermal and CFD concepts to multidisciplinary teams. Strong team spirit, with experience in collaborative, international R&D or engineering environments. Innovative, out-of-the-box mindset, contributing to advanced modelling approaches, design optimization, and digitalization initiatives. Willingness to travel and fluency in English are practical requirements for the job that enable collaboration in diverse environments and effective communication in the international arena. items.desc: The University of Vienna is a community of almost 11,000 individuals, including approximately 7,700 academic staff members, who passionately pursue answers to the profound questions that shape our future. They represent individuals driven by curiosity and a relentless pursuit of excellence. With us, they find the space to try things out and unfold their potential. Are you inspired by their passion and determination? We are currently seeking a/an University assistant predoctoral - Project H4DES - haptic 4D printing for enhanced sensemaking 39 Faculty of Computer Science Startdate: 01.11.2026 | Working hours: 30 | Collective bargaining agreement: 48 VwGr. B1 Grundstufe (praedoc) Reference no.: 6337 Explore and teach at the University of Vienna, where more than 7,500 academics thrive on curiosity in continuous exploration and help us better understand our world. Does this sound like you? Then join our accomplished team! Your Personal Sphere Of Influence We are announcing a PhD position in the H4DES (haptic 4D printing for enhanced sensemaking) project at the Faculty of Computer Science, Research Group Visualization and Data Analysis. The H4DES project revolves around exploring how state of the art 3D printing technologies can support people in understanding data. We develop techniques for haptic information encoding using fabrication techniques and study the limits of human perception in the context. Specifically, we target the representation of time-dependent, multidimensional, or multivariate data in a 3D context by controlling the behavior of elastic objects in response to specific stimuli. Additionally, we explore how to create 3D-printed sensing artifacts using conductive materials that allow us to measure deformation, for example, for use in VR simulations. We invite applications from a wide range of backgrounds, such as HCI, fabrication, and beyond. A successful applicant will be supervised by a multidisciplinary team of advisors from the University of Vienna and TU Wien. Applicants should demonstrate creativity, independence, and the ability to conduct independent research in the pursuit of a PhD. The employment duration is limited until the end of 2029, corresponding to the end of the research project. Your Future Tasks As part of the H4DES project, you will contribute to research that integrates fabrication and data visualization. Besides being a member of an active, diverse, and lively research unit, you have the chance to do groundbreaking research on Algorithms to encode data into object behavior. Methods to evaluate multimodal perception of data combining visual and haptic senses. Techniques to sense user interaction with elastic objects. As a PhD student at the University of Vienna, you will also Join the Doctoral School of Computer Science within 12 Months, i.e., we expect you to finalize your dissertation agreement within 12 months. Work on your own dissertation and its completion. You take on administrative tasks in research, teaching, and administration. Help with administrative and organizational tasks in the group. Have access to courses for academic and personal development. This Is Part Of Your Personality Candidates are expected to have the following qualifications: Strong interest in interdisciplinary research at the intersection of fabrication and HCI. Ability to work independently and as part of a research team in a collaborative environment. Management of complex projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines. Excellent verbal communication skills for interdisciplinary collaboration and presenting research findings. Excellent English skills, both written and spoken. In addition, the following specific skills are required/advantageous for this position: Relevant Master’s degree in Computer Science (with a specialization in, e.g., HCI, Data Visualization, Digital Fabrication, Computer Graphics, or related). Programming skills in state-of-the-art technologies, i.e., Python, C++, CUDA, WebGL, Vulcan, etc. Experience with fabrication tools, especially 3D printers. Knowledge of quantitative and qualitative research methods, e.g., study design, thematic analysis, etc. Knowledge of statistical data analysis (e.g., R, Stata, SPSS) or mixed-methods approaches. Experience with academic writing and familiarity with publishing processes. Curiosity and creativity. What We Offer Work-life balance: Our employees enjoy flexible working hours. Inspiring working atmosphere: You are a part of an international academic team in a healthy and fair working environment. Good public transport connections: Your workplace is easily accessible by public transport. Internal further training & Coaching: Opportunity to deepen your skills on an ongoing basis. There are over 600 courses to choose from – free of charge. Fair salary: The basic salary of EUR 2.832,10 (for 30 hours/week) increases if we can credit professional experience. items.desc: Linguists to build the language analysis scenarios frontier AI labs use to test model judgment on syntax, semantics, and phonology. AfterQuery builds the expert evaluation data that frontier AI labs use to measure and improve their models. We're hiring linguists as contractors to author and grade the language analysis scenarios those evaluations run on. Models are made of language, and linguists are unusually well placed to find where their command of it breaks. What you'll actually do Author linguistic scenarios that test real analysis, from syntactic ambiguity to semantic entailment to phonological pattern. Write reference analyses with the argumentation behind each judgment, the data, the generalization, the exceptions. Grade model output for analytical accuracy and honest handling of the data. Flag analyses that read plausible but misparse the sentence or mislabel the phenomenon. Who this is for Linguists with an advanced degree and at least two years of research, teaching, or applied work. Specialists in any subfield, syntax, semantics, phonology, morphology, sociolinguistics, psycholinguistics, and beyond. Analysts who reason from data to generalization and can say what would falsify their own account. People with strong written English who can make technical analysis clear without flattening it. Contract and pay $50 to $100/hr, paid weekly via Stripe. Your rate is set from your experience, not negotiated down after you start. Remote and async: fully remote, fully async. No fixed hours. Minimum 10 hours per week, no maximum. Scale up or down week to week. No screen recording, no keystroke monitoring, no idle timers. Independent contractor. Ongoing project work rather than single task batches. How our hiring process works Apply at /apply/linguistics-expert. About five minutes. Resume plus a few structured questions. Resume review. Every application gets read against a published rubric and gets a decision. Written assessment. You may be asked to take a written assessment for further placement. Onboarding. Sign the contractor agreement, connect Stripe, and get platform access. Project match. You're matched to live work in your specialty, usually within a week of onboarding. About AfterQuery AfterQuery is an expert data lab. We build the evaluation and training data that frontier AI labs use to measure what their models can and can't do in real professional work. Our contributors are practicing professionals, not annotators, and the work is credited, reviewed, and paid at professional rates. Responsibilities Author linguistic scenarios that test analysis across syntax, semantics, and phonology Write reference analyses with the argumentation behind each judgment Grade model output for analytical accuracy and data handling Flag analyses that read plausible but misparse the data or mislabel the phenomenon Required Qualifications Advanced degree in linguistics or a closely related field 2+ years of research, teaching, or applied linguistics work Depth in a subfield such as syntax, semantics, phonology, or sociolinguistics Clear written English for documenting linguistic analysis Able to commit at least 10 hours per week Preferred Qualifications PhD and peer reviewed publications Computational linguistics or corpus methods experience Fieldwork or documentation of understudied languages Why apply Work stays in your specialty, judged on rigor rather than output volume Set your own hours and scale up or down week to week Weekly pay via Stripe at a rate set from your experience Your judgment shapes how the next generation of AI handles language itself

items.desc: Rejoindre Davidson, ce n’est pas seulement intégrer un groupe de 3000 consultants dans 6 pays et 2 continents, c’est intégrer LA société qui a été élue par ses salariés Great Place To Work France et Europe pendant 4 ans mais aussi une des plus grandes B Corp de France, nommée Best of the World dans la catégorie “collaborateurs” en 2022 ! (Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde). Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts : Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté. Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme. Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone… Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Sur ce dernier point une précision d’importance : le bien-être au travail est un luxe qu’il faut pouvoir s’offrir en étant une entreprise “solide”. Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. Et cela nous incite à chercher à recruter des personnes… meilleures que nous… Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques. Profil / Mission En tant que consultant(e) spécialisé(e) en télécommunications, tu souhaites être au plus proche des innovations et être un acteur(rice) de l’avenir des technologies de la communication. Tu Rejoins Une Équipe D’experts Et Un Projet Innovant De Recherche, D’amélioration Ou De Déploiement Pilote De La 5G Assurer la relation avec la R&D End to End (RAN, CORE, DEVICES) : suivi de roadmap, identification des fonctionnalités en amont Participer aux revues de spécification, code et architecture Réaliser le design des nouveaux réseaux d’accès radio Assurer les optimisations sur des zones expérimentales, les évaluations des gains, la qualification de la QoS/QoE Assurer la coordination avec les autres entités pour l’introduction des fonctionnalités sur le réseau et l’interface avec les autres équipes RD pour permettre une amélioration de la solution Compétences requises ou à acquérir 4G & beyond Modèles de propagation, protocoles, radio MU-MIMO, SCMA, F-OFDM, ondes millimétriques CRAN, Cloud, Big Data Standards 3GPP, call flow, KPI Scripts et langages de programmation C++, Python ou Perl Aptitudes / Savoir-être Esprit d’équipe et de partage Curiosité Rigueur Anglais Description du pôle Métiers des télécommunications Davidson est un des leaders du conseil en Telecoms en France et en Europe. Fort de ses experts et chefs de projets qui s’appuient sur l’ensemble des moyens internes : Institut de formation (5G, IoT, PMP, FTTx, Virtualisation, etc.), salles dédiées à l’idéation et aux meetups (Singular), département R&D (porteur de multiples partenariats et financements parmi lesquels : INRIA, Telecom SudParis, ESEO/ENSTA Bretagne, Eurecom), pôle suivi de normalisation / standardisation (à qui l’on doit la publication de “réseaux 5G” aux éditions Eyrolles). Grâce à cela, nous intervenons sur des missions d’expertise ainsi que de management de projets. Aussi bien en assistance technique, qu’en centres de services et forfaits avec engagements de résultats. Exemples De Missions Accompagner de clients dans le cadre d’expérimentations IoT & 5G Due diligence technologique Audit et organisation d’un programme de déploiement Bid Management Radio / Core / PF de services Architecture protocolaire Validation d’équipements réseaux et smartphones Dimensionnement de réseaux Pilotage de projets de déploiement HW/SW Ingénierie détaillée et paramétrage QoS Radio, QoS IP, QoE, Métrologie applicative Le prochain projet que nous réaliserons ensemble …

Your responsibilities are diverse, covering various topics from the fields of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, hydraulics, materials science, and fault diagnosis. We are looking for technically skilled and motivated team players with intercultural
items.desc: The Opportunity In this role, you will be part of a team of R&D Engineers within a global organization, focusing on the global product support of high voltage products. Your responsibilities are diverse, covering various topics from the fields of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, hydraulics, materials science, and fault diagnosis. We are looking for technically skilled and motivated team players with intercultural competence. If your work style is structured, creative, responsible, and flexible, we look forward to your application! How You’ll Make An Impact Provide global product support for high voltage products produced in feeder factory BG (Sevlievo): Production Process Support Provide technical support to industrial engineering during introduction of new products into existing lines and the setup of new production lines. Participate in the definition and optimization of production processes. Know-How transfer from R&D to production staff during implementation of new products and ongoing operations. Quality and Audit Support Participate in internal audits of the factory in Sevlievo and provide support to implement required changes resulting from audits. Support root cause analysis led by quality department and implement changes to product data following the defined change management process. Supplier Support Perform R&D related tasks for qualification of new parts or new suppliers (PPAP). Cost Reduction Activities Engage in Design-to-Value and cost reduction activities, releasing changes to product data as needed. Your Background Excellent academic degree in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Hydraulics, Physics or related Engineering field. Several years of professional experience, preferably in R&D or field closely related with new product introduction. Experience with quality tools, such as DFM, FMEA and problem-solving methods (8D & Ishikawa). 3D design Software and SAP experience is an advantage. High technical understanding and interest in business and process workflows. Fluent in English both spoken and written. Fluent Bulgarian is an advantage. Willingness for business travel to Sevlievo on weekly basis. Class B driving license. What We Offer Working locations: Sofia (main office) and Sevlievo (feeder factory); 13th salary; Monthly food vouchers; Supplementary health insurance; Additional bonuses. More About Us Join Hitachi Energy and work in a team that is dedicated to creating a future where innovative digital technologies allow greater access to cleaner energy! Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don’t delay – apply today! Publication date : 2026-10-16

items.desc: Du bist interessiert an der Stelle als Software Engineer (w/m/d) – Data Platforms bei smartclip Europe GmbH ? Auf Instaffo kannst du dich für diesen und weitere Jobs ohne großen Aufwand bewerben. Erstelle dein Profil in unter 2 Minuten und starte den Bewerbungsprozess mit nur wenigen Klicks. Anforderungen Bitte beachte, dass für diese Stelle eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland erforderlich ist. Sprache: Deutsch - Fließend (C1), Englisch - Fließend (C1) Deine Skills Du bist Software Engineer durch und durch und liebst die Herausforderung riesiger Datenmengen. Du verwandelst die Komplexität von Terabytes an Daten in eleganten und effizienten Code. Engineering-Erfahrung: Bring fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit, idealerweise mit einem starken Fokus auf JVM-Sprachen wie Scala oder Java und/oder Python. Big-Data-Know-how: Arbeite sicher mit Spark, Hadoop oder vergleichbaren verteilten Systemen. Erfahrung mit Trino, Flowman oder Delta Lake ist ein zusätzliches Plus. Infrastruktur-Know-how: Kenne dich mit CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes und AWS aus und setze diese Technologien sicher ein. Qualitätsanspruch: Liefere keinen Code ohne Tests aus. Setze auf Effizienz, eine saubere Architektur und pragmatische Lösungen. Open-Source-Fan: Schätze die Freiheit und Transparenz von Open-Source-Software. Bei uns findest du keine Closed-Source- oder Microsoft-Stacks. Mindset: Bring eine „Wir finden eine Lösung“-Mentalität, Hands-on-Mentalität sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit. Tätigkeiten Deine Mission Entwickle skalierbare Plattformen: Entwirf und implementiere technische Lösungen für Big-Data-Anwendungen in einem agilen, leistungsorientierten Umfeld. Optimiere Datenflüsse: Entwickle unsere Daten-Aggregations-Pipelines für TV-Daten, Werbung und Forecasting kontinuierlich weiter und optimiere sie – hauptsächlich auf Basis von Spark und Scala. Setze Cloud-Native-Lösungen um: Betreibe, verwalte und skaliere deine Lösungen mit Docker und Kubernetes in der AWS-Cloud. Setze auf Qualität: Treibe Testautomatisierung konsequent voran – von Unit Tests bis hin zu komplexen Integrationstests. Für uns ist Test Driven Development (TDD) der Weg, um zuverlässige Systeme zu bauen. Erkunde neue Technologien: Bewerte neue Frameworks und Tools, teile deine Erkenntnisse mit dem Team und hilf uns dabei, technologisch an der Spitze der Big-Data-Entwicklung zu bleiben. Team Was dich bei uns erwartet Remote Work mit gezielten Treffen: Wir arbeiten überwiegend remote und kommen gelegentlich für Workshops, Team-Sessions und den gemeinsamen Austausch in unserem Tech-Office in Berlin zusammen. Außerdem veranstalten wir über das Jahr verteilt Team-Events, darunter unser jährliches Company Offsite, das jedes Jahr an einer anderen Location in Deutschland stattfindet. Die Bereitschaft, für diese Treffen anzureisen und daran teilzunehmen, gehört zur Rolle. Eigenverantwortung statt Mikromanagement: Übernimm Verantwortung für deine Themen und bringe sie selbstständig voran. Build > Talk: Früh ausprobieren, früh danebenliegen, früh dazulernen. Hohe Ansprüche, wenig Ego: Wir geben direktes Feedback und arbeiten offen und respektvoll zusammen. Weiterentwicklung: Nutze Hackathons, Konferenzen und Community-Austausch, um fachlich dazuzulernen. Und natürlich stimmen auch die Rahmenbedingungen: 30 Urlaubstage plus frei am 24. und 31. Dezember, Smart Fridays mit der Möglichkeit einer Vier-Tage-Woche, Deutschlandticket und JobRad, Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote, Unterstützung für die mentale Gesundheit, Corporate Benefits, Zugang zu RTL+ und vieles mehr. Über das Unternehmen About Smartclip smartclip is the adtech development unit of RTL Group — Europe’s leading free-to-air broadcaster group. Our proprietary advertising technology is custom-built for the needs of European broadcasters and publishers — enabling media owners to implement smarter monetisation strategies. We are committed to delivering the most innovative ad experiences spanning in-stream, out-stream, addressable TV, connected TV, audio, and gaming — ultimately empowering brands with true cross-screen storytelling opportunities on all devices. For more information: Please visit www.smartclip.tv and follow us on LinkedIn. Klicke auf "Bewerben" für Details zu den Benefits, dem Team und dem Bewerbungsprozess.

items.desc: AfterQuery is seeking Real Estate Experts to create and refine real estate reasoning challenges for our AI training modules. In this remote, flexible role, you will design and evaluate real estate scenarios that test the AI's ability to interpret and apply complex real estate principles, ensuring that our models can navigate real-world property transactions and market dynamics with precision and practical insight. Your expertise will help bridge the gap between proven real estate practice and innovative AI solutions, making a tangible impact on the future of property technology. Responsibilities Develop high-quality real estate questions and case studies that challenge AI models on topics such as property valuation, contract negotiation, market analysis, financing structures, zoning regulations, property management, and more. Evaluate and validate model responses, offering detailed feedback to ensure accuracy and adherence to real estate best practices and regulations. Collaborate with a team of real estate and technical experts to fine-tune question difficulty and ensure content is both challenging and educational. Required Qualifications Active real estate license in good standing. Proven experience in real estate practice, brokerage, or property management with a robust understanding of various aspects of real estate transactions and markets. Exceptional analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with a keen eye for detail. Preferred Qualifications Multiple years of real estate practice or substantial industry experience, ideally across diverse property types and market segments (residential, commercial, investment, etc.). Prior involvement in real estate publications, industry associations, or proptech initiatives. Additional designations (CRS, GRI, CCIM, CPM, etc.) or specialized training is a plus. Familiarity with AI or technology-driven real estate applications is a plus. Why apply Competitive Compensation: Benefit from attractive hourly rates that reward your specialized real estate expertise. Innovative Impact: Work with a YC-backed startup revolutionizing AI with high-caliber real estate content and insights. Flexible Engagement: Enjoy the freedom of a remote, asynchronous role that allows you to integrate your real estate expertise into pioneering projects on your own schedule.

items.desc: Chaque moment compte. Surtout ceux que vous vivez à fond. Bienvenue chez Consort Group. Consort Group, accompagne depuis plus de 30 ans les entreprises dans la valorisation de leurs données et infrastructures. Elle s'appuie sur deux leaders, Consortis et Consortia, et place l’humain et la responsabilité sociétale au cœur de ses valeurs. C’est votre future équipe Mobilisée pour la réussite de ses clients, l’équipe de Consort Belgium incarne les valeurs et partage les expertises de Consort Group à Bruxelles, dans ses environs, et sur l’ensemble du territoire belge. Forte de 45 collaborateurs, elle propose depuis 2016 une offre de services en Infrastructures et Solutions Applicatives, portée par des équipes locales et appuyée, lorsque nécessaire, par les compétences et ressources du groupe. Analyste Intégration Sénior H/F C’est votre mission Vous êtes passionné·e par les API, les architectures d’intégration et la fiabilité des échanges de données ? Ce poste est fait pour vous. En tant qu’ Analyste Intégration Senior , vous jouez un rôle clé dans la conception, la validation et l’évolution des flux d’intégration. À l’interface entre les équipes métier, les architectes et les développeurs, vous transformez les besoins en spécifications techniques claires et garantissez la qualité des échanges de données, de l’analyse jusqu’à la mise en production. Côté build : Recueillir et analyser les besoins d’intégration auprès des équipes métier, des Product Owners et des partenaires. Rédiger les spécifications d’interface (IDD), incluant les contrats d’API, les mappings de données et les règles de transformation. Analyser et revoir les contrats d’API REST (OpenAPI) et SOAP (WSDL/XSD). Définir les modèles d’échange adaptés : synchrones, asynchrones, événementiels, batch ou publish/subscribe. Contribuer à l’analyse et à la migration des flux d’intégration vers des solutions cibles adaptées. Concevoir et exécuter les tests d’API, fonctionnels, de contrat et de non-régression avec Postman. Participer à l’automatisation des tests et à l’intégration des contrôles qualité dans Azure DevOps. Côté run : Analyser et diagnostiquer les anomalies d’intégration, notamment les erreurs HTTP, les problèmes d’authentification et les incohérences de données. Assurer le suivi des incidents de niveau 2 et 3 en collaboration avec les équipes techniques. Exploiter les logs et les outils de monitoring pour identifier les causes des dysfonctionnements. Valider la qualité, la performance et la non-régression des flux avant leur mise en production. Participer aux décisions de mise en production (Go/No-Go) et au suivi des anomalies. Maintenir à jour la documentation technique, les catalogues d’API, les mappings et les procédures d’exploitation. Veiller au respect des standards d’architecture, de sécurité et de gouvernance des API. C’est votre parcours Vous disposez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience en analyse d’intégration, analyse d’API et/ou tests d’API . Vous avez participé à des projets d’intégration de bout en bout, de l’analyse des besoins jusqu’à la mise en production. Vous aimez comprendre les problématiques métier, traduire les besoins en solutions techniques et garantir la fiabilité des échanges de données. Vous recherchez un environnement où votre expertise, votre autonomie et votre sens de la qualité contribuent directement à la réussite des projets. C’est votre expertise : Vous maîtrisez les API REST et SOAP, les contrats OpenAPI et WSDL/XSD, ainsi que les formats JSON et XML. Vous possédez une solide expérience de Postman et des tests d’API, incluant les tests fonctionnels, les tests de contrat et la non-régression. Vous connaissez les mécanismes de sécurité des API : OAuth2, JWT, TLS/mTLS et gestion des certificats. Vous avez travaillé avec une plateforme d’intégration telle qu’Azure Integration Services, MuleSoft, BizTalk ou Boomi. Vous maîtrisez SQL pour vérifier la cohérence des données et contribuer au diagnostic des anomalies. Une expérience d’Azure DevOps, d’Application Insights, de Log Analytics/KQL et des architectures événementielles constitue un atout. Une connaissance de MuleSoft, de DataWeave et des projets de migration vers Azure Integration Services sera particulièrement appréciée. C’est votre manière de faire équipe : Vous faites preuve d’un esprit analytique et d’une grande rigueur dans l’analyse des besoins, la rédaction des spécifications et la validation des interfaces. Vous êtes autonome, proactif·ve et orienté·e solutions, avec le souci constant de la qualité et de la fiabilité. Vous communiquez efficacement avec des interlocuteurs métier et techniques et appréciez le travail collaboratif ainsi que le partage de connaissances. C’est notre engagement Chez Consort Group, vous êtes un·e expert·e qu’on accompagne pour que chaque mission devienne une étape qui compte. Un onboarding attentif et humain Une vraie proximité managériale Des formations accessibles en continu Des engagements concrets : inclusion, égalité, …

items.desc: Sei una persona appassionata di AI Generativa , Microsoft Copilot e innovazione dei processi aziendali ? Per il nostro cliente, un rinomato gruppo industriale agroalimentare italiano , siamo alla ricerca di una figura di AI Functional Analyst che agisca come consulente interno, guidi l'adozione dell'AI e sviluppi soluzioni operative al fianco dei vari reparti aziendali. Il ruolo: Cerchiamo un profilo funzionale, che riportando direttamente all' IT manager di gruppo, con forte autonomia pratica capace di analizzerà le esigenze di business, configurerà strumenti e guiderà le persone nell'uso quotidiano dell'AI. Sperimentazione & Adozione Copilot: Seguirai verticalmente l'utilizzo delle licenze Microsoft 365 Copilot , affiancando gli utenti e proponendo nuovi spunti/casi d'uso per migliorare la produttività quotidiana. Creazione di Agenti AI e Chatbot: Progetterai e configurerai direttamente agenti virtuali e bot conversazionali su MS Teams (es. per processi HR, FAQ interne, automazione documentale). Analisi di Processo & Business Partnering: Raccoglierai le esigenze dei reparti aziendali (HR, Finance, Operations) e le tradurrai in soluzioni pratiche, valutando la fattibilità e l'integrazione con i nostri sistemi (ERP, Data Center locale). AI Governance & Sicurezza del Dato: Collaborerai con il team IT per garantire la corretta gestione del dato e l'allineamento con le policy interne e normative vigenti (es. AI Act). Collaborazione a 360°: Sarai l'interfaccia tra gli utenti interni, il team IT e i fornitori/partner esterni per i progetti più complessi, partecipando attivamente anche ad altre iniziative digitali dell'area IT. Requisiti: Esperienza 2-4 anni in ruoli di Analista Funzionale IT, Consulente M365, PM o Junior AI Product Specialist. Ottima conoscenza dell'ecosistema Microsoft 365 , di Microsoft Copilot e strumenti come Copilot Studio / Power Platform . Padronanza delle logiche di Prompt Engineering, conoscenza del funzionamento di LLM e chatbot conversazionali. Buona comprensione delle dinamiche di integrazione tra architetture Cloud (M365) e sistemi aziendali tradizionali (ERP / Data Center On-Premise). Capacità di muoverti in autonomia nell'ambiente IT per creare prototipi, verificare flussi e testare soluzioni senza dipendere esclusivamente da partner esterni. Luogo di lavoro: provincia di Vicenza Retribuzione annua lorda: 35.000-40.000 euro Summary On-site Permanent Camisano Vicentino

items.desc: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: €34.000,00 - €62.000,00 Location: Treviso,ITA You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . We are seeking multiple Equipment Trainer Engineer to deliver high‑quality training to our Field Service Engineers on installation, start‑up, maintenance, and commissioning of advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This role combines technical expertise, classroom and hands-on instruction, global collaboration, and project leadership. The ideal candidate brings deep technical knowledge, strong communication skills, and a passion for developing others in a high‑tech environment. General Profile We offer selected candidates advanced training pathways, including comprehensive hands‑on and classroom learning experiences delivered worldwide. In this position, after training, you will deliver both theoretical and hands‑on courses, support global training initiatives, and maintain expert-level knowledge of our semiconductor equipment. You will work independently with minimal guidance, solve complex technical and instructional challenges and serve as a key technical resource for colleagues worldwide. Key Responsibilities Deliver high-quality technical training classes—both theoretical and hands‑on—on advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment at our Global Technical Learning Center in Treviso, Italy. Collaborate with the global technical training team to develop, implement, and maintain training and certification programs, as well as ongoing learning activities. Leverage modern learning technologies to enhance both online and in‑person training experiences. Support the installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of training lab equipment and tools at the local site. Manage day-to-day operational activities related to the training organization at the Treviso facility. Deliver technical training both in-house and at customer sites, with a focus on specialized and customized courses; this includes domestic and international travel, as well as occasional off‑shift or weekend training as required. Stay current with internal technology advancements and partner with business units to ensure the latest systems, tools, and processes are incorporated into all training programs. Lead and manage multiple projects with diverse scope and complexity, including coordination of project team members. Collaborate with Technical Publications and Product Business Groups to optimize technical documentation; create or enhance documentation to address gaps; evaluate instructor performance; and train others in standard course development processes, including Instructional System Design (ISD). Provide advanced technical expertise and troubleshooting support for system repairs; ensure training systems meet course requirements and adhere to all safety retrofits and standards. Maintain deep technical knowledge of assigned products to prepare and deliver product-specific courses; share new information with the training team; complete and maintain certifications across multiple platforms and processes, including safety modules; and participate in certifying others. Review published training materials and recommend updates or revisions to maintain accuracy and relevance. Provide coaching, leadership, and mentorship to other instructors; support their technical development, classroom delivery, and certification; and proactively address customer satisfaction issues. Du kannst deine Methodenwahl begründen und Ergebnisse kritisch bewerten. Verständnis für AI: Du musst keine Modelle in PyTorch trainieren. Du kannst aber den Unterschied zwischen Prefill und Decode erklären und wie dieser für Latenz und Kosten relevant ist. Eigenständiges AI-native Development: Nutze Coding-Agenten, um schneller zu entwickeln. Validiere den generierten Code, teste die Ergebnisse und verstehe, wie deine Anwendung und ihre Komponenten funktionieren. Strukturiertes Experimentieren: Formuliere klare Specs, definiere eine Definition of Done und prüfe mit passenden Tests und Evaluationen, ob deine Umsetzung das richtige Problem löst. Offene Zusammenarbeit: Teile Wissen, diskutiere technische Entscheidungen und gib respektvolles, direktes Feedback. Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erfahrung mit NLP/Computerlinguistik, Agentic Retrieval oder der Entwicklung von LLM-Agenten. Tätigkeiten Deine Mission Eine Stelle, zwei Schwerpunkte. Ob du einen vertiefst oder beide, entscheiden dein Können und deine Vorlieben. AI gehört immer dazu. Knowledge Agents & Agentic Retrieval Wie beantwortet ein Agent eine Frage, deren Antwort über Tausende Dokumente verteilt ist? Wie erkennt er Widersprüche zwischen Entwürfen und finalen Fassungen? Und wie belegt er seine Antworten zuverlässig? Entwickle Agenten, die Informationen über große Dokumentbestände hinweg erschließen. Untersuche, wie sich Vollständigkeit, Widersprüche und die Qualität von Quellen bewerten lassen. Sorge dafür, dass Antworten nachvollziehbar bleiben und Unsicherheiten sichtbar werden. Machine Learning at Scale Wir messen das Werbegeschehen bei mehr als 150 TV-Sendern in Europa. Unser Ziel: lineares Fernsehen so planbar und messbar machen wie digitale Werbung. Entwickle Prognosemodelle für die Leistung von Werbeblöcken. Bewerte Unsicherheiten, Messfehler und die Aussagekraft deiner Modelle. Verarbeite große Datenmengen mit Spark auf unserem Cluster und untersuche, wo Datenqualität oder Verarbeitung die Ergebnisse beeinflussen. In beiden Bereichen machst du aus einer guten Frage etwas, das läuft: Experimentiere und evaluiere: Formuliere Hypothesen, entwirf aussagekräftige Tests und lerne aus Ergebnissen, auch wenn diese nicht deine Erwartungen erfüllen. items.desc: About The Role We already run two kinds of agent alongside our teams. AI agents diagnose performance problems and tell people the root cause. Rule-based agents recommend marketing actions to our advertising teams. The quality of their decisions shows up directly in our revenue. Next, both take a greater role in the day-to-day running of our lead generation business, moving from recommending, to acting with a person's approval, to acting on their own where it is safe. We need an engineer to build agents that are dependable in production, measurable, and safe to trust with more. This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll own agents end to end, from understanding the workflow to running them in production, alongside our existing AI engineer, data scientists, product managers and the people who use the agents every day. Today we use Claude and open-weight models such as GLM, chosen per task on quality and cost, on an agent framework we build ourselves. What You'll Do Build agents Start from the workflow. Sit with the operators, map how the work is actually done, and build for that, not for the process as documented. Build on shared rules. Rule-based and LLM agents that call shared, versioned rules and tools, not logic hard-coded inside each agent. Connect them to the business. Using our data warehouse, internal services, and the APIs into the systems agents act in. Turn outputs into results people trust. Structured outputs, validation and clear application logic. Make them safe to trust Log every decision. Each action records its context, what was chosen, and whether a person accepted or overrode it, so agents can be evaluated and improved. Build the path to autonomy. Per decision, agents move from recommend, to act with approval, to act alone. Our data scientists propose the bar from agreement and override data and point people in the business sign it off; you build the mechanism that enforces it on our shared agent framework, with permissions and guardrails in the code, not the prompt. Evaluate behaviour, not just code. Test sets, agreement with expert operators, and evaluation before and after every change. Run what you ship. Tracing, failure handling, and tracking quality, latency and cost. There's no on-call rota. LLM engineering: tool calling, structured outputs, context management, and evaluating agent behaviour on representative test sets. Integration and operations: SQL, HTTP APIs, containers, CI/CD and a cloud platform, and debugging from logs and traces. Nice to have Agents used daily by operators, with a feedback loop. AWS SageMaker, AWS ECS/Fargate, Terraform and CircleCI. Snowflake and dbt. Event logging for analytics or machine learning. Lead generation or ad tech. How You'll Work Commercial impact. You understand how the business creates value and use that to make better choices about what gets built, prioritised or stopped. You define the intended impact before starting, consider the cost of the work and evaluate what happened afterwards. Delivery and ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes and move at a pace matched to the cost of delay. You follow work through until it is delivered, handed over or deliberately stopped, and remain accountable for what happens after delivery. Candour and communication. You create lasting improvement in other people's and the team's work through teaching, feedback or challenge, and take challenge on your own work as readily as you give it. Growth and mastery. You deepen your capability through deliberate practice, feedback and experience, build the skills the work will need next, and change established practices …

items.desc: About The Role We are looking for an AI Engineer to help build Blue Yonder's next generation of AI-powered products. As part of Blue Yonder's Autonomy Labs, you will work with experienced software engineers, model-training teams, data engineers, researchers, and product owners to develop agents that operate within real supply chain and retail workflows. You will contribute to the services, APIs, evaluation systems, data flows, and development environments that allow us to train, test, deploy, and continuously improve these systems. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for a software engineer who wants to work close to the model-development lifecycle. You do not need to be a model-training researcher, but you should be curious about how model behavior, evaluation results, traces, and data can be used to build better models and more reliable products. Your Mission Help turn capable AI models into dependable software. You will implement and improve well-defined parts of our agent systems, contribute to technical design, and work with teammates to understand how agents behave in realistic workflows. The challenge is not simply to make a model produce a convincing response. It is to build agents that can use tools, interact with APIs, follow business constraints, manage failures, and complete useful work reliably. What You'll Do Build and maintain backend services, APIs, tools, and integrations used by AI agents and model-development workflows. Contribute to training and evaluation environments that represent realistic business workflows through APIs, simulations, test scenarios, and reproducible state. Implement pipelines and application components that collect and process agent traces, tool calls, workflow outcomes, evaluation results, and user feedback. Develop automated evaluations and verification checks for model and agent behavior, including task completion, tool-use correctness, and regression testing. Review agent traces and test results to identify failure modes, reproduce issues, and help determine whether improvements are needed in software, tools, data, prompts, or models. Work with model-training teams to integrate and assess new models and turn observed behavior into useful engineering feedback. Write clean, tested, maintainable Python code and contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, and team engineering practices. Improve the reliability and operability of services through logging, monitoring, automated testing, error handling, and support for safe deployments. Collaborate with senior engineers on system design and take ownership of scoped components from implementation through testing and operation. Learn quickly, share findings, and contribute practical ideas as the team develops new approaches to agent training, evaluation, and production use. What We're Looking For Around three or more years of software engineering experience, or equivalent practical depth, building and maintaining production software. Strong Python skills and experience with backend development, including APIs, data processing, automated testing, and service integration. Hands-on experience developing with LLMs, AI agents, machine learning systems, or other data-intensive software. Familiarity with tool calling, prompt and context management, retrieval, structured outputs, or agent orchestration. A practical understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including maintainability, testing, version control, observability, and secure development. Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP and familiarity with containers and CI/CD workflows. The ability to investigate unfamiliar systems, break down problems, incorporate feedback, and deliver reliable work within a larger technical design. Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with engineers, researchers, data specialists, and product teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience creating evaluation cases, reviewing model traces, diagnosing agent failures, or testing nondeterministic systems. Familiarity with model-training or post-training concepts such as supervised fine-tuning, preference data, reinforcement learning, reward or verifier design, or checkpoint evaluation. Experience with data pipelines, dataset preparation, synthetic data, experiment tracking, or model deployment workflows. Experience building simulations, test harnesses, developer tools, or integrations with complex enterprise systems. Experience with supply chain, retail, or other environments involving multi-step workflows, permissions, business constraints, and human approvals. What Makes This Role Different This role offers the opportunity to develop as a software engineer at the intersection of model development and production AI. You will contribute to real systems that make agent behavior measurable and improvable, while working closely with engineers and model-training specialists on problems that span APIs, data, …

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience designing research experiments, running benchmarks and ablation studies , analyzing model behavior, and conducting research in areas such as robustness, interpretability, evaluation, or statistical machine
items.desc: Role: Machine Learning Research Scientist Engagement: Remote | Contract / Freelance Experience: 4+ years hands-on research experience; 5+ years preferred Education: Master’s degree or higher About the Role We are looking for experienced Machine Learning Research Scientists focused on experimental ML research rather than production ML engineering. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience designing research experiments, running benchmarks and ablation studies , analyzing model behavior, and conducting research in areas such as robustness, interpretability, evaluation, or statistical machine learning . Key Responsibilities Design and execute rigorous machine learning research experiments. Develop and run benchmarks, baselines, and ablation studies . Evaluate model performance using statistically sound methodologies. Investigate model robustness, interpretability, generalization, and failure modes . Formulate research hypotheses and validate them experimentally. Conduct quantitative analysis of experimental results using Python and statistical methods. Compare models and methodologies using reproducible experimental frameworks. Document research findings, assumptions, limitations, and conclusions. Required Qualifications 4+ years of hands-on ML research experience; 5+ years preferred. Master’s degree or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a closely related field. Strong proficiency in Python and statistics . Hands-on experience conducting ML experiments and research. Experience with benchmarking and ablation studies . Strong understanding of statistical evaluation and experimental design. Experience in one or more areas such as: Robustness Interpretability Model evaluation Generalization Statistical machine learning Experimental ML research Active and credible professional LinkedIn profile. Preferred Background Research Scientist, ML Research Scientist, Applied Research Scientist, Researcher – Machine Learning, or Statistical ML Researcher. Important: This is a research-focused position, not an ML Engineering role .

items.desc: På Sogeti tror vi att det bästa finns inom var och en av oss. Genom vår gemensamma passion för teknologi, AI-drivna ansats, start-up-kultur och fokus på kontinuerligt lärande, ger vi dig förutsättningarna att nå din fulla potential och skapa värde för våra kunder. Med en stark drivkraft för kvalitet och agilitet stöttar vi dig genom hela din karriär så att du kan göra allt större avtryck och bli den bästa versionen av dig själv. Om rollen Vill du vara med och definiera nästa generation av kvalitetssäkring, testning och AI-drivna leveranser? Som Quality AI Engineer hos Sogeti arbetar du i skärningspunkten mellan kvalitet, affärsutveckling och artificiell intelligens. Du hjälper våra kunder att gå från traditionell kvalitetssäkring till intelligenta, skalbara och datadrivna kvalitetsprocesser där AI-agenter, automation och moderna plattformar blir en naturlig del av leveransen. Du arbetar nära verksamhet och teknik för att förstå affärsutmaningar, identifiera värdeskapande möjligheter och omsätta dem till lösningar som ger mätbara resultat. Du blir en strategisk rådgivare, teknisk expert och förändringsledare i ett. I den här rollen spelar du en nyckelroll i: Designa och implementera AI-first-strategier för kvalitetssäkring, testautomation och kontinuerlig kvalitet i komplexa kundmiljöer. Arbeta nära kunder för att identifiera affärsutmaningar och omsätta dem till värdeskapande lösningar med hjälp av Agentic AI, automation och moderna kvalitetsplattformar. Leda och driva initiativ där AI-agenter förstärker testning, analys, kravvalidering och kvalitetsarbete genom hela utvecklingslivscykeln. Skapa återanvändbara ramverk, acceleratorer och assets som möjliggör skalbar leverans över flera kunder och branscher. Samverka med utvecklare, produktägare, verksamhetsrepresentanter och ledare för att driva förändring och skapa långsiktigt kundvärde. Din profil Vi söker dig som har en stark grund inom kvalitetssäkring och testning och som vill leda utvecklingen mot AI-first Quality Engineering genom Agentic AI, automation, datadrivna arbetssätt och skalbara lösningar. Flera års arbetslivserfarenhet inom testning, kvalitetssäkring och/eller testautomation i konsultuppdrag hos kunder i varierade branscher. Dokumenterad förmåga att kombinera teknisk förståelse med stark affärsförståelse och problemlösning. Erfarenhet av AI-lösningar, inklusive arbete med Agentic AI, AI-agenter eller liknande intelligenta arbetsflöden. Erfarenhet av att driva förändring, påverka intressenter och skapa resultat i komplexa organisationer. Du tar naturligt ägandeskap, driver utveckling framåt och har förmågan att omsätta idéer till skalbara lösningar, återanvändbara assets och långsiktigt affärsvärde. Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas Du får vara med och forma framtidens Quality Engineering där AI och mänsklig expertis samverkar för att skapa helt nya arbetssätt. Du blir en del av en organisation som investerar stort i AI-kompetens, lärande och utveckling för att ligga i framkant av den tekniska utvecklingen. Du omges av inkluderande team med hög kompetens där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och kontinuerligt lärande är centrala delar av kulturen. Ansökan Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov. Om Sogeti Sogeti Sverige, en del av Capgemini Group, med 19 kontor och 1200 medarbetare, gör teknologi enkelt och värdeskapande. Vi är specialiserade på AI-drivna lösningar inom quality engineering & testing, data och cloud och förvandlar snabbt idéer till handling. Sogeti levererar konkreta resultat, hjälper organisationer att innovera med självförtroende och skapar värde från dag ett. Vi är agila, snabbrörliga och drar nytta av starka partnerskap. Våra lokala team arbetar sida vid sida med våra kunder och bygger nära relationer genom att förstå deras verklighet. Tillsammans med Capgemini-koncernens globala styrka och branschexpertis skapar vi skalbara resultat. Right here. Right now . | www.sogeti.se
