items.desc: Position Details Department of Applied Health Sciences, School of Health Sciences, College of Medicine and Health Location: University of Birmingham, Edgbaston, Birmingham UK Full time starting salary is normally in the range £47,389 to £56,535 with potential progression once in post to £63,606 Grade: 8 Part time (22.5 hours per week) Fixed Term contract up to July 2030 Closing date: 8th November 2026 UK travel may be required for this role Background The National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR) Inequalities Challenge: Maternity Disparities Consortium is a £50million national programme which brings together a diverse range of organisations with expertise in research, capacity building and working with people and communities to deliver a step change in maternity and neonatal outcomes. The research carried out by the consortium focuses on inequalities before, during and after pregnancy. The programme is underpinned by an innovative and transformative capacity building programme of career development awards and opportunities, linked and embedded within the consortium’s research areas to support the next generation of researchers working to address maternity inequalities. We are seeking a mixed-methods researcher who thrives in multidisciplinary environments to play a pivotal role in improving health outcomes and reducing maternal inequalities. The Evaluation & Impact Fellow at the University of Birmingham will lead the design, coordination and delivery of the programme-level evaluation of the NIHR-funded Maternity Disparities Consortium (MDC), assessing implementation, research outputs, outcomes, equity, influence, environmental sustainability and wider real-world impact. The fellow will work in close collaboration with the Evaluation & Impact Fellow at Newcastle University. In Newcastle, the fellow will evaluate the capacity development programme, and the impact of our work in PPIE and co-production, research inclusion and engagement with and impact on policy makers. In Birmingham, the fellow will evaluate scientific and programme impact, implementation and integration across themes, intervention progression, methodological innovation, adoption and scale-up, NHS and service influence, environmental sustainability, external leverage and the Consortium’s contribution to reducing maternity inequalities. You will co-design evaluation frameworks and apply a full range of mixed-methods approaches, including realist and other theory-driven evaluation methods, rapid evidence reviews, qualitative and quantitative data collection and analysis, and synthesis of findings into clear, actionable insights. You will lead the development of the Consortium-wide Evaluation and Impact Framework, including programme theory, logic models, theory of change processes, common programme-level indicators and approaches to assessing the added value of the Consortium model. You will synthesise evidence across themes, workstreams and core functions to identify what works, for whom, in which contexts and why, and support evidence-informed decisions about what should continue, change, stop or scale. You will also contribute to drafting high-quality reports, peer-reviewed publications, horizon-scanning and developing competitive research and evaluation proposals. The Fellow will contribute to the MDC Innovation strategy and engagement with industry partners, including identifying opportunities for responsible adoption, scale-up and wider impact. You will bring substantial experience of mixed-methods, theory-driven and/or implementation-focused evaluation, with the ability to integrate quantitative and qualitative evidence from multiple sources. Experience of realist evaluation, programme evaluation, impact evaluation, sustainable healthcare or environmental impact assessment, and engagement with industry or other external partners would be advantageous. items.desc: R&D: Analog Designer & Data Scientist – Spaceman Divisione Move Silicon – Move S.p.A. Chi siamo Move Silicon è la business unit di Move S.p.A. dedicata allo sviluppo di chip integrati per il mercato dei semi-conduttori. Parallelamente alla progettazione micro-elettronica classica stiamo sviluppando Spaceman, una piattaforma di Electronic Design Automation basata su tecniche di machine-learning per supportare i progettisti analogici nella generazione, ottimizzazione e verifica automatica di circuiti integrati. Spaceman si integra nei principali ambienti EDA, tra cui Cadence, Synopsys e Siemens, e ha l’obiettivo di trasformare specifiche circuitali in blocchi analogici ottimizzati e verificati, riducendo drasticamente il tempo necessario per progettare IP analogiche. Tutte le sezioni del software, compresa quella algoritmica sono state progettate in-house ad hoc per la specifica applicazione. La nostra visione è ambiziosa: contribuire a portare AI, automazione e generative design nel cuore del processo di progettazione analogica dei semiconduttori, un campo rimasto praticamente incontaminato da questi sviluppi a causa di peculiari difficoltà dell’ambito. La posizione A seguito di PoC con esiti positivi con importanti player del mercato dei semiconduttori, Spaceman sta entrando in una fase di evoluzione da piattaforma R&D a prodotto vendibile. Allo stesso tempo, la piattaforma presenta ancora numerosi temi di ricerca da approfondire ed estendere: architetture di reti neurali per modellare dataset elettrici, strategie di campionamento in spazi di variabili ad alta dimensionalità, tecniche per migliorare la convergenza delle simulazioni, metodi di ottimizzazione più efficienti e approcci per sfruttare in modo strutturato gli insight circuitali sulle topologie in esame. Cerchiamo una figura con background in microelettronica e forte interesse per data science, machine learning, statistica, AI e ottimizzazione applicate a problemi CAD/EDA. Il ruolo è pensato per un ingegnere elettronico con attitudine multidisciplinare, capace di comprendere il problema applicativo in profondità e contribuire allo sviluppo di soluzioni algoritmiche ad hoc. La figura lavorerà all’interno del team R&D, composto da profili con background eterogenei, contribuendo alla prototipazione di nuove tecniche, algoritmi e strategie. Le soluzioni più promettenti potranno poi essere trasferite nel prodotto. Tra i temi futuri di interesse rientrano anche l’estensione dell’approccio a IP di maggiore complessità, l’uso di agentic AI per la composizione di blocchi generati da Spaceman e, in prospettiva, attività legate al layout, come la stima di reti parassite per simulazioni post-layout e il layout automatico. Per questo ruolo sono fondamentali curiosità scientifica, capacità di studio autonomo, pensiero critico, problem solving e propositività. Cerchiamo una persona che voglia pensare, studiare, capire e progettare soluzioni nuove per problemi complessi, collaborando in modo profondo con gli altri membri del team. Responsabilità principali Contribuire alla ricerca e allo sviluppo di nuove tecniche per l’automazione del design analogico. Proporre idee, modelli e strategie per affrontare i problemi R&D legati a Spaceman. Realizzare PoC e prototipi per validare nuove soluzioni algoritmiche. Lavorare su temi di modellazione, ottimizzazione, campionamento, convergenza delle simulazioni e sfruttamento degli insight circuitali. Valutare robustezza, generalità e scalabilità delle soluzioni proposte. Studiare e approfondire autonomamente nuove metodologie utili alla risoluzione dei problemi affrontati. Collaborare con membri del team R&D con background eterogenei per giungere ad una soluzione soddisfacente. Interfacciarsi con il team software per valutare la mantenibilità e l’implementabilità delle soluzioni sviluppate. Contribuire al trasferimento delle tecniche R&D più promettenti verso il prodotto. Solido background scientifico e capacità di affrontare problemi complessi in modo rigoroso Forte attitudine al problem solving, pensiero critico e capacità di apprendimento. items.desc: When the quantum engineering technology meets the real word impact. Based in the heart of the French Alps, Quobly is the result of more than 15 years of research into quantum computing. At Quobly we made the choice of practical and scalable quantum technology. Quobly offers you the opportunity to participate in the future of quantum computing; become a member of our science and innovation team as a Cryo-CMOS Design Research Engineer to turn scientific breakthroughs into products that matter. Your main mission will be to generate new ideas, open up new avenues for the control, the addressing and the readout of large-scale quantum processors. items.desc: Coherent Solutions is a digital product engineering company focused on empowering business success. Our global team of 1700+ talented professionals collaborate seamlessly to deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable business impact. Headquartered in Minneapolis, USA, the company’s core competencies across 10 locations worldwide include product software development, IT consulting, data and analytics, machine learning, mobile app development, DevOps, Salesforce, and more. Project Description You will work with senior engineers on internal classical machine learning initiatives. The role combines structured learning, practical delivery, and gradual ownership of increasingly complex tasks. Technologies Python, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter SQL XGBoost, LightGBM MLflow FastAPI Git, Docker, pytest What You'll Do Prepare and validate structured datasets for machine learning tasks, including cleaning, transformation, encoding, scaling, and missing-value handling; Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, data quality issues, and opportunities for modeling; Build, test, and compare ML models for tasks such as regression, classification, clustering, dimensionality reduction, and anomaly detection; Develop and select features with guidance from senior engineers; Run experiments, tune model parameters, and evaluate results using appropriate validation approaches and metrics; Help maintain reproducible ML pipelines, notebooks, experiment tracking, and technical documentation; Write and maintain automated tests for data and model-related code; Support the delivery of models through REST APIs or batch-processing workflows; Document model assumptions, results, limitations, and technical decisions; Work closely with senior engineers, incorporate feedback, and gradually take ownership of more complex tasks; Job Requirements 1+ year of hands-on Python development experience, including experience with pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and Jupyter; A strong foundation in statistics, probability, and linear algebra, plus exploratory data analysis skills; An understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, and practical experience with regression, classification, clustering, dimensionality reduction, and anomaly detection; Experience preparing structured datasets, including cleaning, transformation, encoding, scaling, and missing-value handling, plus practical feature engineering and feature-selection skills; An understanding of train/validation/test splits, cross-validation, data leakage, overfitting, and regularization; the ability to select appropriate evaluation metrics, compare models, and perform error analysis; Familiarity with hyperparameter tuning and reproducible ML pipelines; SQL skills for data extraction and analysis; The ability to expose models through REST APIs or batch-processing workflows; Familiarity with Git, automated testing, Docker, and basic model monitoring; The ability to explain model behavior, assumptions, limitations, and results; English at B2 level or higher; Nice To Have XGBoost, time-series analysis, recommendation systems, MLflow, model interpretability, cloud services, production ML monitoring, and GenAI, LLM, RAG, prompt-engineering, or agent-development experience; What Do We Offer The global benefits package includes: Technical and non-technical training for professional and personal growth; Internal conferences and meetups to learn from industry experts; Support and mentorship from an experienced employee to help you professional grow and development; Health insurance; Sports activities to promote a healthy lifestyle; Flexible work options, including remote and hybrid opportunities; Referral program for bringing in new talent; Work anniversary program and additional vacation days. If this opportunity excites you, send us your resume! Please, note, that we will consider all the applications with due respect, but only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. items.desc: About the Role We have an exciting opportunity for a permanent position as a Power Systems Research Engineer/Scientist to join the Power Networks Team within NPL’s Electromagnetic Technologies Group. This role is suitable for an early-career engineer, physicist, applied scientist or post-doctoral researcher who is looking to apply and develop their expertise in power systems, measurement science, instrumentation, data analysis and grid monitoring within a collaborative research environment. The Power Networks Team conducts research and development in advanced measurement methods and instrumentation to enable intelligent monitoring of electricity grids. The UK electricity grid is undergoing a major transformation as it prepares to operate with zero carbon emissions by 2030. While new technologies such as wind and solar generation, batteries, electric vehicle charging stations and heat pumps bring major environmental benefits, they also introduce new technical challenges for maintaining grid stability and power quality. Power grid operators therefore need new and improved monitoring tools to gain a deeper insight and run the grid reliably and efficiently. The Power Networks Team at NPL works with UK industry partners, as well as national and international research organisations to ensure that next-generation grid measurement solutions are fit-for-purpose. You will be closely collaborating with the team to support activities including: Setting up and safely operating laboratory testbeds for electrical measurements related to various power grid phenomena (e.g. harmonics, frequency deviations) Developing software for automatic hardware configuration and data analysis Designing, developing and testing new measurement methods and instrumentation for power quality and grid stability monitoring Preparing and deploying instrumentation for field measurement campaigns at locations across the UK and Europe Collaborating with international research organisations and universities within R&D projects Communicating research outcomes through publications, reports, posters and oral presentations at events such as symposia and international conferences This role is an opportunity to work with a team of researchers to address cutting-edge measurement challenges in electricity networks. The work combines applied physics, metrology, instrumentation, data analysis and power systems, and is project-based and varied. This means that we continually adapt our skills and capabilities to solve new problems. The successful candidate will be highly self‑motivated, comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, and able to adapt quickly to new and evolving technical challenges. Please note, this role is known internally as Higher Scientist/Engineer. About You To be successful in this role, we require: A degree in a STEM discipline, preferably in electrical/electronic engineering or the physical sciences Experience in electrical/electronic engineering, applied physics, instrumentation, measurement science or a related technical field, gained through advanced research (such as a PhD) or equivalent experience Experience in one or more of the following: power system analysis, modelling, power quality, phasor measurements, power -electronics, control systems, applied physics, instrumentation, signal processing, uncertainty analysis, or practical laboratory work involving measurement systems, sensors, electronics or experimental physics Experience of working on research or innovation projects, including independently delivering work to a high standard and within set timeframes, for example leading a substantial task or work package Experience in at least one of the following programming languages including but not limited to: Matlab, LabView, C/C++ Experience of scientific writing such as reports and publications Experience of working and communicating effectively within a team and with external project collaborators or customers Curiosity and problem-solving skills Ability to work independently and be pro-active Ability to cope with change and ambiguities Willingness to travel occasionally to locations across the UK and internationally for field measurement campaigns, partner meetings and conferences The following experience is a valuable asset: Data analysis and/or digital signal processing, e.g. Fourier Transform, filters Planning, delivering and documenting laboratory or field experiments Measurement, calibration and/or uncertainty analysis Presenting research results through posters and oral presentations at symposia and international conferences Mentoring junior team members Working with electricity system stakeholders, such as distribution system operators, transmission system operators items.desc: Amaris Consulting, part of Mantu est une société indépendante de conseil et de technologies au service des entreprises. Avec plus de 1000 clients dans le monde, nous déployons des solutions pour les plus grands projets depuis plus d'une décennie - tout ceci est rendu possible par une équipe internationale de 7 600 talents répartis sur les 5 continents et dans plus de 60 pays. Nos solutions sont axées sur quatre domaines d'activité différents : Les systèmes d'information et le digital, la télécommunication, les sciences de la vie et l'ingénierie. Nous cherchons à créer et à développer une communauté de talents où tous les membres de notre équipe peuvent réaliser leur plein potentiel. Amaris est votre « stepping stone » pour traverser les rivières du changement, pour relever les défis et pour réaliser tous vos projets avec succès. Chez Amaris, nous avons à cœur d'offrir à nos candidats la meilleure expérience de recrutement possible. Nous cherchons à mieux connaître et comprendre nos candidats, à les challenger et à leur faire part de nos impressions le plus rapidement possible. Voici à quoi ressemble notre processus de recrutement : Premier contact : Notre processus commence généralement par une brève conversation virtuelle/téléphonique pour en savoir plus sur vous ! L'objectif ? Apprendre à vous connaître, comprendre vos motivations et veiller à ce que nous vous proposions le poste qui vous correspond le mieux ! Entretiens (en moyenne, le nombre d'entretiens est de 3 – il peut toutefois varier en fonction du niveau d'ancienneté requis pour le poste). Au cours des entretiens, vous rencontrerez les membres de notre équipe : votre futur manager bien sûr, mais aussi d'autres personnes avec lesquelles vous serez amené à travailler. Ces entretiens nous permettront d'en apprendre davantage sur vous, votre expérience et vos compétences, mais aussi sur le poste et ce que l'on attendra de vous. Bien entendu, vous apprendrez également à connaître Amaris : notre culture, notre histoire, nos équipes et vos opportunités de carrière ! Étude de cas : En fonction du poste, vous serez peut-être appelé à passer un test. Il pourra s'agir d'un jeu de rôle, d'une évaluation technique, d'un scénario de résolution de problème, etc. Comme vous le savez, chaque personne est différente et il en va de même pour chaque rôle dans une entreprise. C'est pourquoi nous devons nous adapter en conséquence, si bien que le processus peut parfois être quelque peu différent pour chacun. Cela dit, nous nous mettons toujours à la place du candidat pour lui offrir la meilleure expérience possible. Nous avons hâte de vous rencontrer ! Responsabilités : Accompagner les équipes métiers dans la définition d’objectifs réalistes à partir des besoins exprimés et des données disponibles. Réaliser des analyses exploratoires, statistiques et visualisations de données. Concevoir, entraîner et déployer des algorithmes et modèles de data science et d’IA. Évaluer les performances des modèles et mettre en œuvre des actions d’amélioration continue. Intégrer et déployer les modèles en production dans un cadre sécurisé. Garantir la qualité des données utilisées pour l’entraînement, l’évaluation et l’exploitation des modèles. Présenter clairement les résultats, limites et recommandations aux parties prenantes. Contribuer à la gestion des risques liés aux modèles, aux données et à leur exploitation opérationnelle. À propos de vous : Expérience de 5 ans minimum en data science, machine learning, deep learning ou intelligence artificielle. Très bonnes connaissances de Python, Jupyter, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Conda et Scikit-learn. Très bonnes connaissances du traitement du langage naturel, du Machine Learning et du Deep Learning. Très bonnes connaissances de la qualité des données et bonnes connaissances des technologies de gestion des bases de données. Bonnes connaissances de l’approche ITIL. Autonomie dans la réalisation et le déploiement d’algorithmes et modèles de data science et d’IA. Formation supérieure en data science, intelligence artificielle, statistiques, informatique ou domaine connexe. Français et anglais courants. Capacité à travailler en équipe, à partager les connaissances, à prendre des décisions et à gérer les risques. Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, de synthèse et de présentation. Ce que nous offrons : Une communauté internationale réunissant plus de 110 nationalités Un environnement où la confiance est centrale : 70 % de nos leaders ont débuté au premier niveau de responsabilités Un système de formation solide avec notre Academy interne et plus de 250 modules, incluant des certifications Un lieu de travail dynamique avec des événements internes réguliers (afterworks, team buildings, etc.) Jours de congé supplémentaires selon l’ancienneté Possibilité de télétravail selon la politique locale Carte restaurant adaptée au marché suisse Engagement fort en matière de durabilité et d’impact social via le programme WeCare Together Amaris Consulting est …

items.desc: Be your best with bechtle Avec plus de 16 000 employés, nous sommes l'une des entreprises informatiques les plus prospères et les leaders du marché dans notre secteur. L’association de la vente directe de produits informatiques et d'une gamme complète de prestations de services proposée par les différentes sociétés de services informatiques fait de nous un partenaire informatique fort et porteur d’avenir (« zukunftsstark ») pour les entreprises moyennes, les grands groupes et le secteur public. Nous sommes chez nous dans toute l’Europe et toujours près de chez vous. Data Scientist (f/m/d) Pour le compte de notre client basé à Genève, nous recherchons un Data Scientist (f/m/d) chargé de concevoir, développer, évaluer et déployer des modèles de data science et d’IA à partir de données issues de sources variées. Ta mission Collecter, préparer, nettoyer et analyser des données provenant de sources variées, en automatisant lorsque nécessaire leur extraction, leur intégration et leur mise à jour. Réaliser des analyses exploratoires afin d’identifier les structures, tendances et relations pertinentes dans les données à l’aide de méthodes statistiques et de visualisation. Concevoir, développer et améliorer des algorithmes et modèles de Machine Learning, Deep Learning et intelligence artificielle, notamment dans le domaine du traitement du langage naturel. Évaluer la performance, la précision et la capacité de généralisation des modèles, puis ajuster les approches retenues en fonction des résultats obtenus. Assurer l’intégration et le déploiement sécurisé des modèles en production, en collaboration avec les équipes techniques, et présenter les résultats de manière claire aux parties prenantes. Ton profil Master ou formation équivalente en Data Science ou dans un domaine comparable, avec au minimum 5 ans d’expérience en Data Science et intelligence artificielle. Très bonne maîtrise de Python et Jupyter, ainsi que des principales bibliothèques de Data Science et Machine Learning, notamment PyTorch, TensorFlow, Conda et Scikit-learn. Très bonnes connaissances en Machine Learning, Deep Learning et traitement du langage naturel, avec une expérience concrète dans le développement et l’évaluation de modèles avancés. Très bonne maîtrise des problématiques de qualité des données et bonnes connaissances des technologies de gestion de bases de données. Capacité à travailler en autonomie, à challenger les besoins métiers, à définir des objectifs réalistes à partir des données disponibles et à prendre des décisions en maîtrisant les risques. Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, de synthèse et de présentation, avec une forte aptitude au travail en équipe, au partage des connaissances et à l’adaptation à des environnements complexes. Notre proposition Conditions de travail avantageuses : 6 semaines de vacances par an et un plan de prévoyance attractif Développement et mise en valeur du potentiel : vaste gamme de formations professionnelles et personnelles proposées par l'Académie Bechtle Diversité : des tâches intéressantes et changeantes dans un secteur tourné vers l’avenir #BechtleCH-FR Numéro d'emploi : EMXKY454 Kevin Brosse | +41 22 308 85 00 | recrutement.suisseromande@bechtle.com Bechtle Suisse SA Bechtle Suisse SA dispose de compétences certifiées dans les domaines stratégiques : Infrastructure IT, Virtualisation, Information Management, Managed Services, Skills Management, Data& Analytics, Printing Solutions et E-Commerce. Grâce à ces compétences et à de solides et durables partenariats avec les principaux acteurs du marché, nous proposons une gamme modulaire et parfaitement cohérente de produits et de services pour couvrir l’ensemble des besoins de nos clients. Notre proximité, notre vision globale de l'infrastructure et de la gestion de projets font de nous un acteur incontournable du marché. Nos 1000 collaborateurs motivés sont nos meilleurs atouts pour assurer rapidité, flexibilité et expertise. items.desc: The University of Law is looking for an AI Developer in Education to join our Technology Enhanced Learning and Teaching team and play a hands-on role in shaping how AI is used across the University. We’re looking for someone who can look at a problem, understand what we are trying to achieve, and then work out whether AI is the right solution and, if it is, build it, test it, improve it and make it work at scale. You’ll sit at the intersection of AI development, software engineering and education , working closely with our academic and learning design teams to turn ideas into practical AI-powered tools and experiences. You’ll also work directly with our key AI technology partners, helping to shape development priorities, troubleshoot issues and make sure we are getting real value from the technology we invest in. This is an opportunity to join a University that is actively exploring what AI can do for education, while having the technical expertise and influence to help determine what should actually be built and how it should work. What will you be doing? Education You’ll take technical ownership of the development, configuration and optimisation of AI tools used across our educational provision. This will include: Designing, developing and maintaining Topics, Agents and Workflows within our generative AI platform, turning educational and business requirements into functional solutions. Building, testing and refining AI-powered learning experiences, using user feedback and evidence to continually improve them. Exploring emerging AI technologies and leading technical pilots and proof-of-concept projects — assessing not just whether something can be done, but whether it delivers meaningful value. Integrating AI platforms with University systems, including Blackboard Ultra, student information systems and other digital learning technologies. Working with APIs, LLMs and data integrations to create solutions that are secure, reliable and fit for purpose. Acting as a technical expert for our key AI platforms and technology partners, understanding their capabilities, limitations and development roadmaps. Troubleshooting technical issues and identifying practical ways to improve the performance, usability and reliability of our AI tools. Helping successful ideas move beyond experimentation and into sustainable solutions that can be used across the University. Producing clear technical documentation and guidance that can be understood by both technical and non-technical colleagues. Working closely with academic, learning design and professional services teams to understand their needs and translate them into effective technical solutions. Ensuring our AI development meets the University's requirements around security, accessibility, data protection and academic integrity. What are we looking for? We’re looking for someone with a strong technical foundation who is genuinely curious about what AI can do and equally interested in whether it should be used and what difference it will make. You’ll Have Demonstrable experience developing, configuring and maintaining AI tools or software applications. Strong programming skills in one or more relevant languages, such as Python or JavaScript, alongside experience working with AI/ML technologies. Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering and AI platforms, including chatbot or agent-based frameworks. Experience working with APIs, system architecture and data integration. Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate, test and resolve complex issues. Experience communicating technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences and working effectively with a wide range of stakeholders. Experience producing clear, practical technical documentation. A strong understanding of data security, GDPR and technical compliance. A willingness to experiment with emerging technology, while applying sound judgement about what is genuinely useful and scalable. Experience working within higher education would be valuable, as would experience in a legal education environment, but we are particularly interested in people who can demonstrate strong technical development experience and a track record of turning new technology into practical solutions. To view the full job description click here and its associated roles and responsibilities Why this role? AI in education is moving quickly. This role gives you the opportunity to be right in the middle of that change. You’ll have the freedom to explore new technologies, work with AI platforms and technology partners, and collaborate with people across the University to solve real problems. At the same time, you’ll have the opportunity to influence how AI develops beyond individual projects helping us understand what works, what doesn’t, and how successful solutions can be taken further. items.desc: A Devoteam Cyber Trust é a unidade especializada em cibersegurança do Grupo Devoteam. Com mais de 800 especialistas localizados na região EMEA, o nosso objetivo é estabelecer a cibersegurança como um facilitador do sucesso dos negócios, em vez de um obstáculo. Utilizamos uma abordagem abrangente de Resiliência Cibernética, Segurança Aplicada e Gestão de Serviços de Segurança para proteger a jornada tecnológica de empresas de grande e média dimensão de todos os setores e indústrias. Desde 2009, anteriormente com a denominação INTEGRITY, a nossa equipa sediada em Portugal é especializada em fornecer Serviços Geridos de Segurança de ponta, que combina a sua expertise e tecnologia proprietária para reduzir de forma consistente e eficaz o risco cibernético dos nossos clientes. A ampla gama de serviços abrange Testes Persistentes de Intrusão, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, Consultoria e Soluções de GRC e Gestão de Riscos de Terceiras Partes. Certificados em ISO 27001 (Segurança da Informação) e ISO 9001 (Qualidade), PCI-QSA e membros da CREST e CIS - Centro de Segurança na Internet, prestamos serviços a um número considerável de clientes, operando em mais de 20 países. The platform aims to automate significant parts of the pentesting lifecycle, aligned with methodologies such as the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG), leveraging agents, LLMs, and integrations with existing security tooling. This is not an isolated experimental initiative. It is a production-oriented capability with direct application in delivery environments. Responsibilities Define and evolve the architecture of autonomous pentesting agents Develop controlled execution pipelines (tasking, tool usage, feedback loops) Design and improve mechanisms for: Planning State management Tool usage orchestration Validation and control of agent execution Integrate and optimize LLM-based systems within agent workflows Define and validate tool-calling interfaces and integrations with pentesting tools Ensure alignment with established methodologies (e.g., OWASP WSTG) Test and validate agent behavior in real-world scenarios Identify, analyze, and mitigate system failures and edge cases Contribute to internal standards, engineering practices, and design patterns Qualifications Technical Skills: Required Strong proficiency in Python Experience with APIs and distributed systems Practical experience with LLMs (usage, integration, limitations) Understanding of agent-based systems Highly Important Ability to design complex, non-deterministic systems Experience with: Task decomposition and planning State management and execution continuity Tool orchestration Output validation and evidence handling Strong debugging capability (deep system-level items.desc: About Teamwill Consulting Putting domain expertise and artificial intelligence at the heart of the decisions that finance millions of projects, vehicles, and equipment around the world is the core of what we do. For more than 20 years, Teamwill Consulting has been supporting leading players in banking, consumer finance, and mobility through their strategic and technological transformations. Operating in 11 countries and bringing together more than 800 professionals, the Group combines deep industry expertise, close client relationships, and the ability to deliver on a global scale. Artificial intelligence is a cornerstone of our growth strategy. To carry that ambition, we are strengthening our technology, engineering, and data teams. Role Summary Teamwill Consulting’s CTAIO function builds and operates the firm’s reusable artificial intelligence (AI) engineering assets, then deploys them into some of the firm’s most demanding engagements. As an Applied AI Engineer, you design, build, and operate production AI systems that combine managed large language models (LLM) with managed or self-hosted, proprietary or open-weight models, under real infrastructure constraints. You turn an AI capability from a working prototype into something an engineering organization can trust in production: tested, observable, and safe to change. Key Responsibilities Design, build, test, and operate agentic systems and pipelines that call one or more LLMs to complete multi-step tasks. Contribute to clarifying requirements with Product Owners, Product Managers, Business Analysts, and Subject Matter Experts, and to formalizing non-functional requirements (e.g., application reliability, security, performance…). Start with the simplest composition that works (typically applying the KISS (keep it simple and stupid) software craftsmanship principle): a direct model call or a short chain, moving to a more autonomous, tool-using agent design once a simpler one is shown to fall short. Favor a lightweight, provider-agnostic integration approach over a heavyweight orchestration framework whenever possible. Integrate managed, application programming interface (API)-based models and self-hosted, proprietary and open-weight models into the same application, including the operational work specific to self-hosting: inference optimization and request scheduling under constrained graphics processing unit (GPU) capacity. Build and maintain the retrieval pipelines that ground models via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in the client’s or firm’s knowledge bases: turning source documents into a well-structured, versioned, and access-controlled form a model can retrieve from reliably. Build and maintain evaluation (“eval”) suites that gate every change before it reaches production (capability, safety, regression, and cost/latency thresholds). Implement guardrails (secret redaction, content-safety filtering, and fallback behavior), and instrument every AI-powered service for observability (token usage, latency, tool-call errors, and output quality) so a production issue can be diagnosed from data. Package AI components as containerized, deployable services with documented interfaces (API, command-line interface (CLI), Model Context Protocol (MCP)), so they can be integrated into a client’s systems. Use AI coding agents (for example Claude Code, Cursor, or OpenCode) as part of your own engineering workflow: maintain the standing context documentation a project keeps for its agents, and review agent-produced code with the same combination of automated checks and human review as code anyone else on the team writes Work closely with clients, Data Engineers, Platform Engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to move an asset from prototype to a client-ready, secure, and monitored deployment, and contribute field learnings back into Teamwill’s shared asset portfolio, so a solution built for one engagement strengthens every future one. What You’ll Work On Your primary engagement sits inside a large, regulated financial-services environment where AI adoption is real and accelerating. Some workloads run against managed, proprietary models under a strict data-governance agreement; others run entirely on infrastructure the client controls, using open-weight models, to meet data-residency and regulatory requirements. Both paths are rich engineering challenges: the managed path calls for rigorous prompt, cost, and safety engineering, and the self-hosted path for model serving and capacity planning in a market where GPU capacity is scarce. You will have the opportunity to build expertise in both. The work is international: you will collaborate with teams and clients across Teamwill Consulting’s geographies. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin. About The Role We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Fospha's Data Science team in London. Fospha builds marketing measurement products for ecommerce brands — attribution, marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing, and brand impact measurement. Our Data Science team owns the models behind all of it, from methodology through to production code. You will work across our technical stacks and own maintaining and growing the codebases that power our product and solutions. This role suits an established data scientist who wants to own things properly. You'll lead larger production projects, choose the modelling approach rather than being handed it, and talk to clients as the modelling expert in the room — supported by a team that reviews each other's work seriously, and a company that rewards high agency with ownership. Team: Data Science Level: Career (Data Science Career Development Framework) Location: London What you'll do Lead larger production projects end to end — scoping, building, and shipping production-level code, rather than working through tickets someone else has specified Choose the modelling approach — independently selecting and applying the right method within our suite, across attribution, marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing, and brand impact. You will be given time to keep up-to-date on the latest methodologies in the industry Resolve bugs and queries independently — including in parts of the codebase you didn't write, without needing to route them upwards Use AI as leverage, not as a crutch — solving coding tickets quickly, unblocking yourself on product and engineering dependencies, and building automation workflows that save the team time Work with QA properly — using our automated tooling efficiently and flagging the gaps in it rather than working around them Communicate as a modelling expert — confidently and independently, with clients and with colleagues, including when the message is that a number they like is wrong Help develop the people around you — code review, methodology critique, and hands-on support for less experienced colleagues. Breaking down tickets and helping those more junior is essential What we're looking for Essential Solid commercial data science experience — typically 3–5 years, with a track record of shipping models into production Strong ML knowledge across multiple algorithm families, and the judgement to pick the right approach for the problem rather than the one you know best Strong Python and SQL, with the ability to lead on production-level code and set the standard others work to Able to debug and resolve issues independently across unfamiliar repositories, using AI tooling to accelerate rather than to guess, while still understanding the problem fully Strong AI fluency — you solve tickets quickly with it, you unblock cross-department dependencies with it, you build automation workflows with it, and you never send AI-assisted output without checking it Confident, independent communication with clients and stakeholders as the technical authority on the work Emerging mentorship — you're ready to develop junior colleagues, and you want to Initiative in accepting and planning your own work, rather than waiting to be allocated it Genuine attention to detail — much of this work involves noticing when a number is wrong Nice to have Bayesian modelling experience, particularly hierarchical models Experience with AWS or comparable cloud tooling Familiarity with automated QA tooling and test coverage practices Experience with marketing, ecommerce, or advertising data Not required Experience with attribution methodology, MMM, incrementality testing, or Bayesian modelling is genuinely an advantage at this level — but it isn't a filter. Our stack takes time to learn regardless of what you arrive with, and we'd rather hire strong modelling judgement and teach the domain. items.desc: Deine Aufgaben Du willst KI nicht nur ausprobieren, sondern damit unser gesamtes Company Setup smarter machen? Als Junior AI Engineer (m/w/d) entwickelst du AI-Automationen für unsere internen Prozesse, von Customer Service über Supply Chain bis Reporting, und bringst sie vom Prototyp bis in den produktiven Betrieb. Du verbindest unsere Systeme über APIs mit unserem Data Warehouse, machst Daten nutzbar und verbesserst deine Use Cases messbar. Dabei denkst du nicht in Einzelprojekten, sondern betrachtest Prozesse ganzheitlich, erkennst selbst, wo es Potenzial gibt, und arbeitest eng mit unseren Business-Teams zusammen. Wenn du ein gutes Verständnis für Python, SQL und Cloud-Architekturen mitbringst, schon selbst etwas mit LLMs gebaut hast und dich schnelle Veränderungen eher anspornen als abschrecken, dann suchen wir genau dich! Deine Aufgaben AI-Automationen: Du entwickelst und betreibst AI-Automationen für interne Prozesse wie Customer Service, Supply Chain und Reporting und begleitest sie vom ersten Prototyp bis in den produktiven Betrieb. System-Integration: Du verbindest interne und externe Systeme über APIs (z. B. Shopify, Zendesk/Resolvia, Sage/Anvyl, Klaviyo), bindest sie an unser Data Warehouse an und stellst die Daten unseren AI Agents zur Verfügung. Prompt & Agent Engineering: Du setzt Use Cases um, testest die Ergebnisse systematisch und verbesserst sie messbar in Qualität, Kosten und Latenz. Prozessoptimierung: Du verstehst unsere Prozesse im Detail, verbesserst sie und entwickelst neue interdisziplinäre Abläufe. Dein Ziel ist dabei immer, unser Company Setup als Ganzes weiterzuentwickeln. Projektverantwortung: Du identifizierst eigenständig neue Projekte und Verbesserungspotenziale, nimmst aber auch Anfragen aus den Teams auf. Im Schnitt steuerst du drei Projekte parallel und behältst sie über ein klares Meilenstein-Setup im Griff. Enablement: Du unterstützt unsere Business-Teams, baust interne Tools, dokumentierst Ergebnisse und hilfst deinen Kolleg:innen dabei, die Automationen selbstständig zu nutzen. Dein Profil Studium & Ausbildung: Du hast ein Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Informatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich abgeschlossen. Ein starkes Portfolio (eigene Projekte, GitHub, Open Source) oder ein Quereinstieg mit nachweisbarer Praxiserfahrung zählt für uns genauso viel, der Abschluss ist also kein Muss. Python & SQL: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Python (APIs/REST, Git, methodisches Debugging) und SQL und idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit BigQuery oder einem vergleichbaren Cloud Data Warehouse. LLMs & AI Tooling: Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs und AI Tools (Claude/OpenAI APIs, Agents, MCP, Cursor/Claude Code) und hast damit nicht nur gearbeitet, sondern schon eigene Lösungen entwickelt. Cloud & Tools: Du kennst dich mit Enterprise Cloud (z. B. Google Cloud oder AWS) und Deployment aus, inklusive Container und CI/CD. Erfahrung mit Shopify ist ein Plus. Systemverständnis: Du erfasst schnell, wie Datenflüsse laufen und Systeme zusammenhängen. Eigeninitiative: Du bringst eine Hands-on-Mentalität mit, nimmst offen formulierte Probleme selbst in die Hand und lieferst eine erste funktionierende Lösung. Lernbereitschaft: Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bringst dir neue Themen gerne selbst bei, technisch genauso wie in den Business-Bereichen. In diesem Feld ändert sich jeden Monat etwas, deshalb zählt deine Lernfähigkeit für uns mehr als das, was du heute schon weißt. Kommunikation & Stakeholder Management: Du verstehst, was unsere Business-Teams wirklich brauchen, und erklärst technische Ergebnisse klar und ehrlich, auch dort, wo KI an ihre Grenzen stößt. Sprache: Du fühlst dich sicher in der englischen Kommunikation mit deinem Team (mind. C1 Level), bringst aber auch Deutsch-Kenntnisse (mind. B1 Level) mit. Warum wir? Dich erwartet ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Du-Kultur von Tag eins. Wir glauben an flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsmethoden. Unsere Teams bestehen aus motivierten Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen. Goodies für dich: Von Jobrad-Leasing über Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket bis hin zu betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (Arbeitgeberzuschuss 50%) - bei uns profitierst du von vielen Extras. On top gibt’s Mitarbeitenden-Rabatt in unserem Snocks Coffee und einen steuerfreien Sachbezug (50€ / Monat), den du flexibel für deinen Wocheneinkauf oder z.B. eine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club einsetzen kannst. Arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt: Du arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist. Remote ist Standard, aber wenn du doch mal Lust hast, ins Büro nach Mannheim, Hamburg oder Berlin zu kommen, gibt’s dafür ein Monatsbudget. Echte Flexibilität: Ob Workation mit Freund:innen oder Kolleg:innen, morgendliches Yoga oder eine Sport-Session mittags – bei uns kannst du Arbeit und Privatleben easy miteinander verbinden. Onboarding: Du startest nicht mit leeren Händen, sondern bekommst top Hardware, alles was …

items.title: MLOps Engineer, Deep Learning
items.card: In this role, you will help shape how deep learning development works across Zenseact. You will join a team that connects deep learning development with reliable operations. Your work will support a continuous flow of trained and evaluated models, while giving engineers and decision-makers clearer information about performance. Apply today, no CV needed at first stage, only contact information, we'll cover the rest
items.desc: Would you like to help deep learning engineers spend more time solving meaningful problems and less time managing complex workflows? Are you interested in automation, evaluation, observability, and the practical use of agentic AI? In this role, you will help shape how deep learning development works across Zenseact. You will join a team that connects deep learning development with reliable operations. Your work will support a continuous flow of trained and evaluated models, while giving engineers and decision-makers clearer information about performance. Apply today, no CV needed at first stage, only contact information, we'll cover the rest later. Insights from the team You will join team DLFlow within our MLOps unit. Our MLOps teams create the systems and workflows that bring deep learning development together, enabling the end-to-end deep learning development; including training, evaluating, and deploying hardware-optimized models into the product code. Zenseact’s deep learning teams explore what needs to be solved and develop new ways to solve it. Our team helps turn those advances into a smooth, repeatable process for training, evaluating, and integrating models. We work closely with deep learning developers and other stakeholders across Zenseact to create an efficient AI factory. The work sits at the intersection of deep learning and operations. We draw on ideas from CI/CD but adapt them to the needs of machine learning. Our focus is to make development more efficient and help deep learning engineers spend most of their time on deep learning itself. Automation, evaluation, and observability are central to what we deliver. Your role and day-to-day tasks Your role is to improve the way deep learning models move through development, evaluation, and delivery. You will create reliable workflows that make complex work easier to repeat, understand, and improve. You will also help teams decide which metrics matter and present results in a way that supports sound decisions. A key part of the role is pushing the boundaries of how agentic AI can be integrated into the development cycle itself, rather than remaining a separate tool developers invoke as needed. You will explore new approaches, test them in practice, assess where they create real value, and turn the most promising ideas into dependable working methods. Typical Tasks Include Build and improve automated workflows for training, testing, and evaluating deep learning models. Develop observability tools that make model performance easier to understand. Turn large sets of metrics into clear insights for engineers and decisionmakers. Explore how agentic AI can improve deep learning development processes. Apply CI/CD principles to deep learning and machine learning workflows. Work with deep learning teams to understand their routines, pain points, and technical needs. Discuss priorities and solutions with stakeholders, then help establish sustainable ways of working. What’s In It For You You will work on an engineering challenge that does not come with a ready-made answer. You will have room to bring in lessons from other environments while learning from people who work directly with deep learning every day. Your contribution will give other engineers more space to focus on their core work. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to help shape how new technology, including agentic AI, is introduced thoughtfully into development processes. You will work across team boundaries and help ideas become reliable practices. Qualifications & Experience We believe you have practical knowledge of deep learning and understand what a typical development cycle looks like. You know the common pain points and can communicate effectively with deep learning engineers. Your interest goes beyond creating model improvements yourself. You are motivated by building the systems and procedures that help an entire development organization work effectively. You follow new developments in deep learning and agentic AI, with a focus on what they can enable in practice. You combine curiosity with sound judgement and can recognise which emerging ideas have the potential to create real value. You are comfortable discussing ideas and trade-offs with stakeholders and working together to find practical ways forward. Essential Experience A master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field. Practical experience with deep learning and a good understanding of its development workflows and challenges. Experience with automation, model evaluation, observability, or related MLOps practices. Understanding of CI/CD and devOps concepts and how they can be adapted to machine learning. Ability to turn technical results and metrics into clear, decision-friendly information. Ability to communicate and work effectively with engineers and other stakeholders. Nice to have, but not crucial Hands-on experience integrating AI agents into …

items.desc: About Edra Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations. We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. We're a deeply technical team of engineers, AI researchers, and strategists with a high bar for talent and a shared belief that exceptional people are the foundation of everything great we'll build. The Role We're building a learning system that teaches AI agents how enterprises actually work. Our system ingests knowledge bases, conversations, tickets, and system logs, then produces written instructions that agents can execute–with confidence scoring to know when to automate and when to seek human input. We're looking for Forward Deployed AI Engineers who have built complex, production LLM-based systems, and want to work directly with our enterprise customers. Whether you've scaled LLM workflows handling millions of requests, built multi-agent systems in production, or designed evaluation frameworks for enterprise deployments, we want people who bring intensity and self-direction to their craft. You’ll own the full technical journey: understanding how an operation works, identifying the right problem, designing and building the solution, shipping it to production, driving adoption, and expanding its impact. This is an engineering role: you’ll write production code, make architectural decisions, build agentic systems, and take responsibility for the outcome. What You'll Do Work directly with enterprise customers to identify new problems, prototype solutions, and ship them to production Own customer engagements from discovery and solution design through production, adoption, and expansion. Design and implement LLM-powered systems and agentic workflows from concept to production Use and extend our core context-learning library to solve customer problems, contributing reusable capabilities and lessons back into the platform. Build agentic features for knowledge management–think agents that can edit, update, and maintain large knowledge bases autonomously Build reliability and confidence systems–evaluation frameworks, confidence scoring, and logic for when to automate vs. when to escalate to a human Architect async, scalable systems that handle complex AI orchestration What We’re Looking For You've built complex, production LLM-based systems with real depth–something with multiple layers of engineering decisions you can walk through in detail You've shipped something meaningful to production and can explain how it evolved You're excited by open-ended problems where the solution might not exist yet You have experience with (or strong interest in) how systems learn and improve over time: human-in-the-loop feedback, prompt optimization and context engineering You have experience building agents and autonomous systems You can navigate between research papers and production code with equal comfort You bring customer empathy and commercial judgment, and remain effective when requirements, data, or expectations are unclear. You're a strong communicator who can clearly explain your work to teammates and customers You have 3+ years of professional experience Don’t meet all of the above traits? We’d still love to hear from you. We’re looking for exceptional people with unique skills and interests, and we know that great people have different backgrounds and skillsets. Learn More About Edra Watch our Series A announcement video Read our blog post from our launch Learn more about what we're building Our founders point of view on the market Compensation & Benefits Edra offers generous compensation and benefits in both New York & London: Competitive base salary & meaningful equity Top tier health, dental, & vision plans: Top plans with 100% premium coverage in the US (and a One Medical membership) Private medical & dental coverage in the UK Flexible paid time off Lunch provided in office most days, snacks & drinks too A stipend to set up your workspace A Few Details We work together in person five days a week from our offices in the West Village (New York) and Holborn (London). items.desc: Job Description About the role At Bluecrux, we turn AI ideas into solutions people can actually use. As an AI Engineer, you will build AI applications, agents and integrations for our internal teams and clients. We welcome both medior and senior candidates. Your responsibilities will match your experience. You Will Build and deploy LLM applications, AI agents and automations. At senior level, you will lead solutions end to end, make architecture decisions and guide colleagues and clients. This is a hands-on engineering role for people who want to build and deliver, not a research or data science position. Help shape Bluecrux’s growing AI capability. Work on internal initiatives and high-impact solutions for global clients. Enjoy ownership, visibility and room to explore new technologies. Collaborate with experts across technology, product and consulting. Benefit from a flexible hybrid environment, growth opportunities, a competitive salary, bonus and electric company car. items.card: You will be responsible for building and maintaining the backend systems that support the development, testing, deployment, and scaling of our Machine Learning and LLM‑based tools, and for helping to transform these into robust, market‑ready products. We have ambitious plans to grow the AI team significantly over the next few years as we expand our internal capabilities and commercialise our technology externally.
items.desc: Location: Hybrid – primarily remote, with in‑person collaboration once per month in Manchester or Liverpool, option for more in-person and growing London presence We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our expanding AI team at Fletchers Solicitors. This role sits within a fast‑paced, high‑autonomy environment where we are rapidly prototyping, iterating, and deploying state‑of‑the‑art AI products for use across Fletchers and the wider legal sector. The team operates as a start‑up‑style unit within the wider business, reporting directly to the executive team, with a clear mandate to move quickly from idea to production. You will be responsible for building and maintaining the backend systems that support the development, testing, deployment, and scaling of our Machine Learning and LLM‑based tools, and for helping to transform these into robust, market‑ready products. We have ambitious plans to grow the AI team significantly over the next few years as we expand our internal capabilities and commercialise our technology externally. About Fletchers Solicitors & The AI/Data Science Team Fletchers is a fast-growing consumer law firm specialising in personal injury and clinical negligence, and with a growing practice in family and private client. Fletchers was one of the first consumer law firms to deploy a machine learning tool for legal work (a decision support system for screening incoming cases, launched in 2017) and was one of, or the first, law firm to have a dedicated AI department, which started in August 2023. Since then, we have been experimenting with a broader range of ML techniques, extending those tools already in use, and productionising new ones through our growing data science & engineering teams. We believe that we are well positioned to leverage Fletchers’ unique legal-medical dataset and industry expertise to build AI tools that will shape the future of consumer law. We are well funded through our Private Equity backers, which allows us to invest heavily in the development of sector-specific AI tools that assist, automate, and augment our specialist legal work. Tools we have built range from simple behind-the-scenes custom model inference, to agentic-AI pipelines for ‘always on’ monitoring, to the core user interface that some of our colleagues work on for 90%+ of their day. We’re also commercialising these tools so that other specialist law firms can leverage Fletchers legal and AI expertise, and have an ambitious agenda for external growth for the next 18 months. The Role As a Software Engineer within the AI team, you will support the design, development, and ongoing evolution of our core backend services and data processing pipelines. You will play a key role in enabling rapid experimentation while ensuring that successful prototypes can be hardened and scaled into production‑grade systems. You will work closely with product stakeholders, data scientists, and clients across multiple projects in parallel. This is a role suited to someone who is comfortable working close to the user, taking ownership of systems end‑to‑end, and making pragmatic engineering and architectural decisions in a fast‑moving environment. We are open to candidates of all experience levels. The scope of responsibilities can flex depending on proficiencies and interests, with clear opportunities for rapid progression and significant professional growth for motivated candidates as the team and product portfolio grow. Exceptional candidates who don’t meet all of the requirements below are still encouraged to apply Main Responsibilities Take ownership of backend services that support the development, testing, deployment, and monitoring of ML‑enabled products Contribute to infrastructure and architecture decisions by developing a strong understanding of business and product needs Maintain and extend existing, and build new APIs and data processing pipelines to support evolving product requirements Collaborate closely with product and data science teams to deliver end‑to‑end solutions Work directly with internal users and stakeholders to scope, prioritise, and resolve issues and bugs Enable ML development through efficient and scalable data integrations from diverse sources, including case management systems, unstructured documents (Word, PDF), and SQL databases Essential Skills and Experience: Strong degree qualification(s) in a STEM subject from a top-tier university Strong proficiency in Python, with experience designing and building backend systems and web apps (proficiency with at least one Python web framework is desirable) Comfort operating in a fast‑paced production environment where deployments have direct user impact Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, demonstrating strong ownership, prioritisation, and delivery focus Strong communication skills and sound engineering judgement Based in the UK, with the ability to attend in‑person team meetings at least approximately once or twice per month …

items.desc: Apify is a marketplace of ready-to-run tools for AI that automate work on the web. Thousands of Actors get web data, generate leads, monitor social media, track competitors, and integrate with existing apps and agents. Actors are created by a global community of builders who earn from them, while Apify manages infrastructure, billing, and distribution. Join us to help people put the web to work. Apify can find missing children, protect consumers from fake discounts across the EU, and feed data to AI chatbots. Working on our mission to build the largest marketplace of tools for AI, we're becoming one of the pioneers in MCP dynamic tool discovery and agentic payments via Coinbase's x402 standard, letting autonomous agents discover the right tools and pay for them on their own. Because we serve both humans and machines, we're also making natural language a first-class interface to the platform. We stay close to where this is happening: we show our work at conferences like the AI Engineer World's Fair, where we spoke on the emerging agentic economy, and the MCP Dev Summit; we host our own Prague Crawl, where Jan Curn made the case that "MCP doesn't suck, your agent does"; and we regularly rotate people through San Francisco. We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build all of this. It's a small team with a lot of surface area, so you'll own real problems end-to-end. What You'll Be Working On Build and maintain the Apify MCP Server, turning tens of thousands of Actors into tools that agents can reliably call. Keep the server ahead of a protocol that changes fast and often breaks: stateless transports, authorization hardening, and tool discovery. Shape the agent behind Apify AI, from the runtime it runs on to the tools it reaches and the rough edges that surface when it runs a full task end-to-end. Help autonomous agents discover and pay for Apify tools. Build evals that turn real production traces into tests, catch regressions in CI, and tell us whether a change made the product better or worse. Who We're Looking For 3+ years building real software, with backend experience in Node.js/TypeScript or Python. You've built something on top of LLMs and know the pain firsthand: tools the model calls wrong, context that balloons, agents that confidently do the wrong thing. Curious and self-directed: comfortable with loosely defined problems and keeping up with a field that changes every week. You use the Apify platform, or want to, and care about building tools other people enjoy using. Good communication skills in English. Our Tech Stack Frontend: React.js, styled-components, Storybook, Chromatic, Cypress, Playwright Backend: TypeScript/Node.js, Nest.js, Next.js, Docusaurus, Vitest Infra: AWS Compute (Kubernetes (EKS), EC2, Lambda), Helm, Terraform, CloudFormation, MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB, S3, GitHub Actions Monitoring: Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Mezmo, Sentry, PagerDuty Tools: GitHub, Notion, Google Workspace, Slack OS, code editor, and AI assistant of your choice (Claude premium with unlimited tokens, GH Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, or JetBrains AI) Process: two-week sprints, code reviews, tests, automating whatever we can, and deploying multiple times per day. Why should you work at Apify? Space, support, and autonomy for personal growth, with a direct impact on Apify's success Full-time position in our amazing offices in Prague (100Yards) or Brno (Titanium) 🏰 Flexible working hours (perfect for both night owls 🦉 and early birds 🐥) Nobody counts holidays as long as the work gets done 💪 Unlimited Claude for every Apifier. We don't count tokens. Just use them well 🤖 Stock options and profit sharing 💰 Free Apify credits for your friends and family to try the platform 🎁 We welcome pets, kids, and bikes at the office 🐕👨‍👧 Epic team buildings and offsites 🚢 with biking, canoeing, and other adventures 🪂 Solid education and training budget, conference tickets, internal “Eat & Learn” sessions, and the possibility to work across teams 👩🏼‍💻👨🏽‍💻 Generous hardware budget 💻 Free lunches every day when you're in the office 🌮🍱🍜🍕🥡 Unlimited supply of ☕ & 🍺 and snacks Free entry to the wonderful Prague Zoo 🐘 Free Multisport card 🏋 Regular massages in the Prague office, mostly covered by Apify 💆 Ping-pong, chess, PS5, foosball league after lunch. For more details about Apify and what it's like to work with us, see our Careers page .

items.desc: Job Description What you bring You have several years of hands-on experience in software architecture and development, ideally in the utilities or energy industry. You have a deep understanding of the technical landscape — from message exchange to smart meter gateway integration — and you stay informed about relevant regulatory and technology trends. Based on your architectural expertise, your knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and your strong analytical skills, you design solutions that are both technically sound and valuable to customers. What You’ll Build As part of the Industry AI unit for Energy and Natural Resources, your focus will be on the architecture, design, and technical delivery of solutions and agents in the area of metering concept management/distributed energy resources. Working side by side with a dedicated team of Product Experts who define the scope, you will translate product requirements into scalable, cloud-native software architectures and guide your development team from design to production. You will own the end-to-end technical solution and new agentic use cases, ensuring that system design decisions balance correctness, performance, and maintainability. You drive architectural governance, evaluate technology choices, and act as the primary technical point of contact for all development teams on a day-to-day basis. Direct engagement with customers on technical requirements and solution design is an important and integral part of your work. This role requires a combination of deep technical expertise, systems thinking, and strong communication skills in English. Required Skills & Experiences Design and deliver software solutions for utility customers. Translate product requirements and regulatory changes into concrete technical designs, implementation plans, and actionable engineering tasks. items.desc: Après des années de développements dans les centres de recherche, la photonique silicium suscite un intérêt toujours croissant des industriels, mais aussi pour son intégration aux ordinateurs quantiques. Porté par de nombreux projets nationaux, européens et industriels, ce recrutement vise à renforcer la capacité du laboratoire en conception de composants photoniques pour les applications quantiques. En particulier il s’agit de concevoir des composants photoniques dédiés pour les domaines des communications et du calcul quantiques. Au sein du laboratoire, vous rejoindrez un environnement de recherche et d’innovation au cœur des technologies de photonique intégrée. Vous contribuerez à la conception de composants et circuits photoniques répondant aux spécifications de différents projets, notamment dans les domaines de la cryptographie quantique et du calcul quantique. À ce titre, vous serez amené·e à : Concevoir et optimiser des composants photoniques intégrés, notamment des composants passifs tels que des coupleurs directionnels, afin de répondre aux exigences spécifiques des applications quantiques. Réaliser des simulations et le layout des composants à l’aide des outils disponibles au laboratoire, notamment Lumerical (simulations EME et FDTD) et le langage Skill (Cadence). Collaborer avec les équipes de technologues et de caractérisation afin d’assurer le développement et la validation des composants et circuits. Participer à la validation expérimentale des composants après fabrication, notamment à travers des tests optiques sur prober et l’analyse des données de mesure. Assurer, lorsque nécessaire, l’interface avec les équipes de packaging pour les circuits complexes. Être force de proposition dans le développement de nouveaux composants, circuits de démonstration et preuves de concept reposant sur les plateformes de photonique silicium du LETI. Valoriser les résultats obtenus à travers des publications scientifiques (conférences et revues) et des propositions de brevets. Vous évoluerez ainsi dans un environnement pluridisciplinaire et collaboratif, au contact d’experts couvrant l’ensemble de la chaîne de développement, de la conception à la caractérisation des composants photoniques. #Quantum #Photonique #Nanotechnology Profil du candidat Le candidat recherché (H/F) devra être diplômé à minima d'un Bac +5 (école d'ingénieur ou Master 2) en Physique, Optoélectronique ou domaine équivalent. Un doctorat dans un domaine associé serait un plus. Expérience : 1 à 2 ans d'expérience souhaités. Un doctorat serait apprécié. Débutants acceptés. Analyse de données. Capacité à capitaliser les travaux dans des rapports de synthèse. Des connaissances en optique quantique seraient un plus. Qualités attendues : Rigoureux(se) et à l'écoute, vous saurez organiser votre travail afin de répondre aux besoins des projets, dans lesquels différents travaux théoriques, analytiques et numériques devront être pris en charge. La communication avec l'équipe projet ainsi qu'avec les équipes en charge de la fabrication en salle blanche constitue un point clé afin de garantir que les conceptions réalisées soient compatibles avec les contraintes de fabrication et de testabilité, et que la méthodologie employée soit explicite et réutilisable. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Nous vous proposons : Un écosystème de recherche à la pointe, unique en son genre et dédié à des thématiques à fort enjeu sociétal. Un cadre de travail agréable et une équipe engagée. Un poste au cœur de la métropole grenobloise, facilement accessible via la mobilité douce encouragée financièrement par le CEA. Une rémunération adaptée prenant en compte votre profil et votre expérience professionnelle. Une épargne entreprise abondée par le CEA. Une politique diversité et inclusion. Un environnement propice aux évolutions professionnelles grâce aux formations et à l'accompagnement à la mobilité. Un CSE actif en matière de loisirs et d'activités extra-professionnelles. items.dept: Artificial Intelligence, Enterprise Engineering, Facebook, Generative AI
items.desc:
Meta is seeking Security Engineers with Privacy and Data protection expertise to join our Applied Artificial Intelligence (AAI) organization. You will apply deep privacy engineering expertise to hard, real-world problems in how systems collect, use, retain, expose, and delete data. Your work is AI-augmented from day one: you leverage AI tools and agents to accelerate your impact, and where the models fall short, your expertise directly drives their improvement.
The problems that matter here are the ones a capable engineer cannot solve by reading the code in front of them: which jurisdiction's deadline applies to a deletion request, whether a derived dataset clears an anonymity threshold, where a deletion has to cascade. Models already handle the privacy obligations that are stated as ordinary good engineering practice, so the work is the obligation they cannot derive.
This role is for privacy engineers who want to operate at the intersection of deep privacy expertise and frontier AI, not just applying AI to privacy work but shaping what it is capable of.
Identify and solve ambiguous problems within the privacy and data protection space where the solution and requirements are initially unknown, driving solutions that affect multiple teams Architect privacy capabilities and evaluation infrastructure that sets the standard across teams; drive platform-level decisions for AI-driven privacy solutions at Meta's scale Lead the strategy and methodology for the privacy problems AI cannot yet reason about: jurisdictional and regulatory obligations, de-identification standards, data lifecycle controls, and data access reasoning Shape how privacy expertise translates into AI capabilities: define the methodologies that make model improvement systematic and scalable Drive cross-organizational partnerships that define how privacy and AI intersect: influence technical direction beyond the immediate team Break down problems into smaller scoped work streams, owning the most technically complex pieces while enabling others to execute against the overall solution Mentor other engineers across the organization, build a community, and act as a role model for privacy engineering practices and Meta values Disseminate findings through internal publications, knowledge sharing, and contributions to the broader privacy and security community
B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field, or equivalent experience 8+ years of hands-on engineering experience in technical privacy, data protection, or privacy-adjacent security engineering Deep expertise in at least one privacy subdomain with demonstrated ability to advance the state of the art: purpose limitation, retention and deletion, data access control, jurisdictional obligations, de-identification, consent, or ML and model privacy Experience implementing privacy obligations in production systems, in addition to reviewing or advising on them Software engineering proficiency, including code review and maintenance, with experience coding in Python, PHP, Java, C/C++, or an equivalent language Track record of architecting privacy systems, controls or programs that operate at scale and influence how others build Demonstrated ability to define and drive complex, ambiguous problem spaces with group-level impact Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) Experience improving AI model performance through expert feedback, red teaming, or evaluation design Experience with pseudonymization lifecycle, including deletion of the user-to-pseudonym mapping Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies Experience implementing obligations conditioned on jurisdiction, age band, or cohort: regional carve-outs, regulatory deadlines, minor and parent-initiated request handling Contributions to the privacy or security community (original research, tools, conference presentations, publications) Experience applying differential privacy, k-anonymity, or other formal de-identification techniques in production rather than in research only Experience with privacy review or privacy incident response at scale Background in ML and model privacy: memorization, membership inference, training-data extractability, disclosure through model outputs
