items.desc: About Edra Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations. We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. We're a deeply technical team of engineers, AI researchers, and strategists with a high bar for talent and a shared belief that exceptional people are the foundation of everything great we'll build. The Role We're building a learning system that teaches AI agents how enterprises actually work. Our system ingests knowledge bases, conversations, tickets, and system logs, then produces written instructions that agents can execute–with confidence scoring to know when to automate and when to seek human input. We're looking for AI Engineers who have built complex, production LLM-based systems. Whether you've scaled LLM workflows handling millions of requests, built multi-agent systems in production, or designed evaluation frameworks for enterprise deployments, we want people who bring intensity and self-direction to their craft. You’ll spend most of your time advancing our core learning library and building the harness that powers our platform’s agents across all customers. The work spans continuous learning systems, agentic features, human-in-the-loop feedback loops, and agent orchestration. What You'll Do Build and extend our core context-learning library, turning customer-informed problems into reusable platform capabilities. Design and implement LLM-powered systems and agentic workflows from concept to production Build agentic features for knowledge management–think agents that can edit, update, and maintain large knowledge bases autonomously Build reliability and confidence systems–evaluation frameworks, confidence scoring, and logic for when to automate vs. when to escalate to a human Architect async, scalable systems that handle complex AI orchestration Contribute to the direction of our AI strategy and product capabilities What We’re Looking For You've built complex, production LLM-based systems with real depth–something with multiple layers of engineering decisions you can walk through in detail You've shipped something meaningful to production and can explain how it evolved You're excited by open-ended problems where the solution might not exist yet You have experience with (or strong interest in) how systems learn and improve over time: human-in-the-loop feedback, prompt optimization and context engineering You have experience building agents and autonomous systems You can navigate between research papers and production code with equal comfort You're a strong communicator who can clearly explain your work to teammates and customers You have 3+ years of professional experience Don’t meet all of the above traits? We’d still love to hear from you. We’re looking for exceptional people with unique skills and interests, and we know that great people have different backgrounds and skillsets. Learn More About Edra Watch our Series A announcement video Read our blog post from our launch Learn more about what we're building Our founders point of view on the market Compensation & Benefits Edra offers generous compensation and benefits in both New York & London: Competitive base salary & meaningful equity Top tier health, dental, & vision plans: Top plans with 100% premium coverage in the US (and a One Medical membership) Private medical & dental coverage in the UK Flexible paid time off Lunch provided in office most days, snacks & drinks too A stipend to set up your workspace A Few Details We work together in person five days a week from our offices in the West Village (New York) and Holborn (London). Edra is an equal opportunity employer and we encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. Edra does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

items.desc: Job description: In the challenging world of specialty fertilizers, a company striving to keep the lead like ICL Growing Solutions needs rapid adaptation to market requests and continuous introduction of new products while keeping high quality and strict compliance with regulations. In this dynamic environment you, as R&D process engineer, will use your innovative thinking and engineering skills to adapt and improve existing processes and develop novel technologies for the polymer coating of fertilizers. You will be part of the R&D Engineering group in Heerlen (The Netherlands) which is part of the global ICL Growing Solutions, with possible assignments to different locations worldwide. Position and key responsibilities ▪ Participate in several R&D projects (with leading role ins some) as engineering and scale up partner. ▪ Contribute to the needed experiments in the lab and scale up to pilot and full-scale trials. ▪ Be the R&D partner in the engineering of production lines (modifications and building of new) from the conceptual design of new process to support all engineering stages to construction and start-up. ▪ Support production engineering department in troubleshooting of the manufacturing lines. ▪ Collect and process experimental data to be able to draw conclusions on engineering and scale up aspects of a project. ▪ Communication with different stakeholders to keep alignment of the project. items.desc: About Board Of Innovation BOI partners with large, ambitious organizations to design and build applied AI products that create measurable business impact. We help enterprise and scale-up clients move beyond experimentation by embedding AI directly into their operations, decision-making, and products. Our work spans industries, but always centers on production-ready AI, strong engineering, and real-world adoption. About The Role We're looking for an AI Engineer to design and build the AI systems behind real, production-grade applications. This is applied engineering work: building agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines, and orchestration layers that integrate into business-critical environments and stand up to real-world use. You'll take AI capabilities from idea to deployment, owning the full path including evaluation, observability, and the operational concerns that determine whether a system survives contact with users. What You'll Do You'll design, implement, and ship AI systems that automate work, support decisions, and unlock new workflows for enterprise clients. Day-to-day, that means building multi-step agents and tool-using LLM systems, wiring them into structured and unstructured data sources, and packaging them into services that other engineers and applications can consume safely. You'll also own how we know our systems work. That includes evals, observability, and the feedback loops that let us iterate with confidence rather than guesswork. You'll work closely with engineers, strategists, and designers, and you'll be in client conversations from early scoping through delivery. What You Bring You have 3+ years of experience shipping AI-powered systems in production, and a background in computer science, math, physics, engineering, or another technical or scientific field. You're strong in Python and fluent in the patterns of modern LLM engineering: agents, MCP, skills, tool use, retrieval, structured outputs, and evals. You're also a real software engineer underneath. CI/CD, testing, version control hygiene, and code quality matter to you, because they're what let you keep moving fast without things falling over. You understand how to balance accuracy, latency, cost, and maintainability, and you've debugged enough production systems to have opinions about it. You're comfortable wrapping AI logic into services that other engineers can consume without surprises. How You Work You treat AI as an engineering discipline. You care about observability, maintainability, and the underlying engineering that makes the interesting parts possible. You're at home in a consulting environment, where each engagement brings a new domain and a new set of constraints. At BOI, you will work a lot with strategists, designers, and consultants, and most of your clients aren't technical. You're comfortable translating between business problems and technical solutions, and you can hold your own in a client room without a project manager running interference for you. The field moves quickly, and so do we. New models, new tools, and new patterns show up constantly. You enjoy that pace, actively pull in what's useful, and bring it back to the team. You push back when something doesn't make sense, and you care about building systems that get used long after the kickoff energy fades. Contract & Setup We are open to both permanent employment and long-term contractor arrangements. The final setup will depend on your location, work authorization status, and local compliance requirements. Interested? If this sounds like a fit, apply with your CV and a short note on a system you've built that you're proud of. Bonus points for something we can actually look at!

items.desc: Job Description About the role At Bluecrux, we turn AI ideas into solutions people can actually use. As an AI Engineer, you will build AI applications, agents and integrations for our internal teams and clients. We welcome both medior and senior candidates. Your responsibilities will match your experience. You Will Build and deploy LLM applications, AI agents and automations. Develop reliable Python services, APIs, connectors and tool-calling integrations. Translate business needs into practical technical solutions. Build reusable AI components and delivery accelerators. At medior level, you will own defined solutions with support from experienced colleagues. At senior level, you will lead solutions end to end, make architecture decisions and guide colleagues and clients. This is a hands-on engineering role for people who want to build and deliver, not a research or data science position. You have strong hands-on Python development experience. You have built and delivered applications using generative AI, LLMs or AI agents. You have experience with APIs, integrations and tool calling. You understand AI testing, security, privacy and maintainability. You have Experience with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry or Key Vault. You can translate business needs into technical solutions and explain your decisions clearly. You are fluent in English. You show a willingness to travel globally and to work in a hybrid working model. You have a valid driver’s license, or you will obtain this in the next 6 months. You hold a relevant master’s degree. You learn quickly, take initiative and connect with our values: dig deep, own it, come together, move fast and be kind! Help shape Bluecrux’s growing AI capability. Work on internal initiatives and high-impact solutions for global clients. Enjoy ownership, visibility and room to explore new technologies. Collaborate with experts across technology, product and consulting. Benefit from a flexible hybrid environment, growth opportunities, a competitive salary, bonus and electric company car. About Us At Bluecrux, we transform supply chains into smart, efficient value chains through a blend of expert consulting and cutting-edge technology. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more - creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we're committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

items.desc: SmallClaims is a legal tech company that recovers small, valid claims of up to €25,000 through the courts. Claims that businesses write off today because pursuing them costs more than they are worth. Our AI agents run the whole process, from legal assessment and settlement to filing, judgment and enforcement, while our in-house lawyers quality-assure the work and appear in court. That has cut manual case handling from over 15 hours to about 1.5 hours per case. We have handled 5,000+ cases, win 90%+ in court and serve 500+ Danish customers. Case intake has grown more than 370% since 2023, and we have just raised €2M from Vendep Capital to grow in Europe. Now we are growing the engineering team. THE ROLE You take ownership of your own areas within our AI service (Python/FastAPI, LLM pipelines) and our back-office platform, the tool our case managers and lawyers run the operation on. Ideas take form together with the team, product specialists and the CTO. You take them from there, end to end across the stack: shape, build, ship, verify, follow up. What You’ll Work On Own parts of and build features in our AI service: LLM orchestration with structured outputs, tool calling, and complex agentic workflows. Build the back-office platform our case managers and lawyers use every day, and talk to them to find out what they really need. Set up and improve evals and observability, so we know our agents are right before we scale them. Ship and run what you build, from staging to production on AWS, with tests and CI as a habit. What We Work With Stack: Laravel/PHP, Next.js, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, Google. How we build: Coding agents are part of daily work here. We expect you to be ahead of the curve on building with AI, not catching up to it. Who You Are 3+ years building and operating software in production, from a startup, a bigger company, open source or other serious project. You think like a product owner. You want responsibility and ownership, and you take a complicated problem to a shipped feature. You are good with data: you understand complex data sets and data pipelines, and you can build with them, visualise them and explain them. You hold strong opinions lightly. You are direct in disagreement, but easy to work with after the decision. You communicate directly and are honest about mistakes. You can talk to real users and are comfortable with shifting priorities. You love building, love learning, and are curious about the domain itself: the legal process, not just the tech. Experience And Skills Must have Strong backend development, incl. background jobs, auth models and API design. Solid relational database experience (Postgres/SQL or similar): schema design, migrations, performance. Hands-on LLM building in production, not just demos: orchestration, structured outputs, tool calling, evals, tracing, prompt design, injection. Works daily with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode or similar), knows their strengths and limits, and stays up to date. Testing as a habit: feature and end-to-end tests, CI, verifying your own work through staging to production. Cloud and deployment literacy (AWS or similar, Docker, CI/CD). You can operate what you ship. Nice to have Python/FastAPI, Laravel/PHP or Next.js specifically. Production migration: third-party service changes, database moves, major-version upgrades, data backfills. Operating AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and Linux servers hands-on. Eval or observability tooling for agentic workflows. Integrations where no documented API exists: webhooks, browser extensions, automation, scraping. Legaltech, fintech or another regulated domain. What We Offer Real ownership of core parts of the AI platform in a small team that ships every week. Close work with the CTO, product specialists and the lawyers who use what you build. Our base is the office in Copenhagen, but regular remote work is fine How To Apply Apply via The Hub with a short intro, your CV, GitHub and links to things you have built: apps, side projects, something you shipped at work. Next, we send you our skills checklist as a self-assessment plus a few short written questions, then interviews with the team, then an offer. We keep the process short and give you a clear answer at every step.

items.desc: We are DEUS EX MACHINA, a cutting-edge AI Systems company specializing in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Analytics for the food, nutrition, and life sciences industries. We leverage Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), knowledge graphs, and first-principles simulation to accelerate how products are discovered, formulated, and manufactured, contributing breakthroughs in nutrition, healthcare, and petcare. At the core of our successful track record are our people, our commitment to clients, Fortune 100 organizations and startups, and our desire to make a positive impact through a creative, focused, and collaborative mindset. About the role Our products depend on more than a model or a backend service. They require data pipelines, APIs, knowledge systems, agentic workflows, cloud infrastructure, and production software to work as one system. The AI Systems Engineer is responsible for designing and building that system end to end. You will make decisions, write production code, integrate data and AI components, and work on the whole path from raw data to a reliable application. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can move across backend, data engineering, AI systems, and architecture without treating them as separate silos. What you will do Build agentic AI systems using LLMs, retrieval, tools, memory, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop patterns; make explicit decisions about when agents are appropriate and when deterministic software is better. Work on the implementation of production AI systems across backend services, data infrastructure, agentic workflows, and cloud components. Design and build reliable APIs, services, event-driven workflows, and distributed components that connect our applications, models, and data. Build and operate data pipelines for structured, unstructured, scientific, and external data, including ingestion, transformation, indexing, lineage, and quality controls. Design retrieval and knowledge architectures using relational databases, vector stores, search systems, knowledge graphs, and other data stores as appropriate. Turn prototypes into production systems: define interfaces, failure modes, observability, testing, security, performance, and deployment strategy. Make and document architectural decisions, including tradeoffs in cost, reliability, maintainability, scalability, and model performance. Work directly with data scientists, bioinformaticians, product managers, and other engineers while remaining responsible for the technical integrity of the complete system. What we are looking for Solid software engineering fundamentals and at least 2 years of hands-on experience building production systems in Python, or a comparable language. An appetite for simplicity and results-oriented approach to delivery. Actual experience working with backend systems, APIs, microservices, and data-intensive applications. You should be able to understand the architecture, not only implement tickets. Practical experience building with modern AI systems, including LLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, tool use, agentic workflows, evaluation, and production integration. Experience utilizing AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate coding, debugging, and refactoring workflows. Hands-on experience working with data engineering tasks: SQL, data modeling, ETL/ELT, pipeline orchestration, data quality, and working with large or heterogeneous datasets. Strong English and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineering, product, and scientific teams. Strong pluses Experience with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask; PostgreSQL and one or more NoSQL, vector, graph, or search technologies. Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; Docker and containerized deployments; Kubernetes or other orchestration platforms. Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic search, ontology-driven systems, scientific data platforms, or bioinformatics applications. Experience evaluating and operating LLM/agent systems in production, including tracing, guardrails, model routing, prompt/version management, and cost/latency optimization. Solid understanding of system design: queues, caching, concurrency, storage choices, service boundaries, fault tolerance, observability, and cloud deployment. What success looks like You deliver on major systems from feature ideation through production operation, with few handoffs between backend, data, and AI teams. New AI capabilities reach production quickly without sacrificing reliability, testability, security, or maintainability. Data, models, agents, and application services behave as one coherent system rather than a collection of disconnected components. What it's like to work with us: DEUS EX MACHINA will provide you with the resources and advanced tools necessary to deliver best-in-class results for our clients, in a workplace that inspires collaboration and creativity. …

items.desc: About Planet Planet is a global provider of integrated technology and payments solutions for retail and hospitality customers. We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day. Planet empowers its customers to deliver great customer experiences by combining payments and software in ways that drive greater loyalty, increase revenue and save time. Founded over 35 years ago and with our headquarters in London, today we have more than 2,500 employees located across six continents serving our customers in more than 120 markets. Role Overview This is a long-term fixed-term contract designed to support Planet’s AI-first engineering scale-up project. This role owns the design, delivery, and ongoing behaviour of production AI workflows that automate and augment work across Planet’s internal systems — HR, Finance, Operations, and CRM. You will be accountable not only for shipping the technology, but for the quality of the decisions it makes: building agents, prompts, and retrieval pipelines that business users can trust, and improving them over time through measurement and real-world feedback. The impact is direct — reliable, auditable AI that reduces manual effort and raises the quality and speed of everyday decisions across the business. What You Will Do Design and build production-grade AI workflows that integrate across internal systems (HR, Finance, Operations, CRM). Implement the orchestration logic — triggers, retries, fallbacks, and human-in-the-loop patterns — so workflows run reliably, observably, and auditably. Develop and maintain the AI agents, prompts, retrieval pipelines, and decision logic that power those workflows. Own model behaviour in production: accuracy and usefulness, failure modes, and edge-case and ambiguity handling. Iterate on model performance using evaluation frameworks, feedback loops, and real-world usage data. Take accountability for decision quality and outcomes — not just technical execution — defining and tracking success metrics such as accuracy, resolution rate, and time saved. Diagnose cases where systems are technically “working” but producing poor outcomes, and close the gap. Partner with Data Engineering on shared platforms (infrastructure, CI/CD, data pipelines, security and governance) and contribute to shared standards, schemas, and best practices for AI systems. Who You Are Strong software engineering background (Python or similar), with a track record of building production systems — not just prototypes. Hands-on experience with AI / ML systems (LLMs, classifiers, decision models, or similar). Experience integrating APIs and working with distributed systems. Experience designing prompts, retrieval pipelines, or ML inference workflows. Solid understanding of model evaluation, monitoring, and feedback loops; comfortable working with both structured and unstructured data. Product-oriented — cares about outcomes, not just shipping code; pragmatic about AI and focused on what works in production. Comfortable owning ambiguity and making trade-offs. Languages: English A plus, but not required: workflow orchestration tools (Temporal, Airflow, Step Functions); experience building internal tools or agents; familiarity with regulated or enterprise environments; exposure to MLOps or AI evaluation frameworks. Why Planet Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce. We would love to hear from you – Apply now . At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office. Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.

items.desc: Quem somos Quando pensas num restaurante cheio ou numa loja com fila à porta, talvez não penses no software e nas soluções de gestão que estão por trás de cada venda. Mas, na SDILAB, é exatamente aí que está o nosso foco. Parte do Grupo José Pimenta Marques, somos a software house que desenvolve o ETPOS, uma solução de faturação e ponto de venda em modelo SaaS (Software as a Service) que todos os dias ajuda negócios na restauração e no retalho a operar de forma mais eficiente. Com mais de 50.000 postos de venda ativos e presença em 30 países, fizemos da evolução constante a nossa forma de estar: atualizações frequentes, novos módulos e apps que transformam dados em decisões. À volta do ETPOS construímos um ecossistema digital completo. Desenvolvemos ferramentas de gestão remota que permitem acompanhar vários pontos de venda a partir de qualquer lugar, módulos de inteligência artificial que dão aos negócios monitorização em tempo real e maior previsibilidade de vendas. E agora precisamos que te juntes a nós neste caminho. Como parte do grupo da Balanças Marques, vais trabalhar com pessoas das nossas instalações em Braga e Lisboa (Portugal), Bilbao, Valencia e Vitória (Espanha), Orleães (França) e Ningbo (China). Junta-te a uma equipa que trabalha todos os dias para pôr a tecnologia ao serviço de cada negócio, para que possa crescer e desenvolver todo o seu potencial. We're ready to scale up your career. Are you? O que procuramos Não procuramos alguém que utilize AI apenas para escrever código mais depressa. Procuramos alguém que queira ajudar-nos a redefinir a forma como o software é desenvolvido. Estamos a construir e evoluir um AI-Native Software Engineering Framework, onde agentes especializados colaboram ao longo de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento: Business Problem → Requirements → Architecture → Implementation → Testing → Validation → Delivery O objetivo é transformar este processo num workflow agentic, estruturado e progressivamente automatizado, mantendo intervenção humana onde esta realmente acrescenta valor. O que vais fazer Desenhar e experimentar agentic development workflows; Criar e orquestrar agentes especializados para diferentes fases do desenvolvimento; Definir mecanismos de comunicação, contexto, memória e delegação entre agentes; Implementar guardrails, quality gates e mecanismos de validação; Explorar modelos de human-in-the-loop e autonomous execution; Integrar agentes com ferramentas de desenvolvimento, APIs, repositórios e CI/CD; Avaliar e melhorar a qualidade, consistência e fiabilidade dos outputs. Quem tu és Formação superior (obrigatório) na área de Engenharia Informática ou similar (preferencialmente); Experiência mínima de 5 anos (obrigatório); Forte experiência em Software Engineering e interesse prático em AI/LLMs e Agentic Development; Valorizamos experiência com: Multi-agent systems e agent orchestration; AI coding agents e agentic workflows; Prompt e context engineering; MCP e tool integration; Automated testing, validation e evaluation frameworks; Guardrails e quality gates; CI/CD e autonomous/semi-autonomous development pipelines; Software architecture e requirements engineering; Large existing codebases. Experiência com Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, OpenRouter ou outras plataformas semelhantes é valorizada; Bons conhecimentos de inglês (falado e escrito); Forte sentido de responsabilidade; Espírito de equipa. O que podes esperar de nós: Uma carreira com espaço para crescimento pessoal e profissional Um bom ambiente com uma equipa que sabe tudo sobre tecnologia Uma empresa inclusiva e em franco crescimento Um salário de acordo com o teu nível de experiência Prémio pelo nascimento de filhos Descontos e outros benefícios do Grupo José Pimenta Marques Caso te identifiques connosco e consideres que correspondes ao perfil solicitado, envia a tua candidatura no formulário abaixo ou por email com a referência SDI-AINE-2026 no assunto para: recrutamento@grupojpm.pt

items.desc:
Huawei's Ohm Research Center (Nuremberg) is responsible for Advanced Technology Research, Architecture Evolution Design and Strategic Technology Planning. 
 The Power Conversion Technology Laboratory within the Huawei Ohm Research Center (Nuremberg) is responsible for Advanced Digital Power Technology Research, Architecture Evolution Design and Strategic Technology Planning, and plays an important role in the Huawei Digital Power business in the design and development of power converters and control systems for applications such as PV Solar & Battery Energy Storage Field, Data Centers, Electric Vehicle, and Embedded Power Supply. 
 Join us as a
 Expert – Medium Voltage Power Conversion System & Control Architecture (m/f/d) 
 Your mission 
 Lead the research and development of control system architectures for next-generation medium-voltage power conversion systems, targeting applications in data centers, solar PV, energy storage and other emerging energy scenarios, including SST, STATCOM and E-STATCOM technologies. 
 Define the system-level control hierarchy and functional architecture, covering supervisory control, power control, converter-level control, protection, monitoring and fault management. 
 Architect the control hardware and software platforms, including centralized and distributed controllers, functional partitioning, computing resources, real-time execution and system interfaces. 
 Design the communication and synchronization architecture across controllers, power cells, converter modules and system-level equipment, ensuring deterministic operation, reliability and scalability. 
 Define system-level protection, fault handling, redundancy and fault-tolerant operation strategies, including coordination between control, communication, power electronics and protection hardware. 
 Guide the development and integration of key control functions, including active/reactive power control, voltage/current regulation, energy and capacitor balancing, multilevel modulation and grid synchronization. 
 Evaluate system-level dynamic performance, stability and interactions between converter modules, control layers, communication networks and external power systems. 
 Lead system integration and validation from architecture design, simulation and HIL testing through prototype commissioning, product qualification and field deployment. 
 Drive technical decisions and establish reusable control architectures, design guidelines and engineering methodologies across multiple medium-voltage product platforms. 
 Your areas of expertise 
 Deep expertise in system-level control architecture for medium-voltage or high-power conversion systems, with a strong understanding of hierarchical and distributed control concepts. 
 Strong knowledge of converter control systems, including supervisory control, power regulation, multilevel converter control, synchronization, energy balancing and coordinated system operation. 
 Proven experience in control hardware and embedded software architecture, including controller platform selection, functional partitioning, real-time scheduling and hardware-software interfaces. 
 Solid understanding of industrial real-time communication, distributed synchronization, communication latency, reliability and fault-tolerant system design. 
 Strong knowledge of system-level protection coordination, redundancy, fault detection, isolation, recovery and degraded-mode operation. 
 Practical experience in system modelling, control architecture validation, HIL testing, power prototype commissioning and troubleshooting of complex converter systems. 
 Ability to lead cross-disciplinary technical decisions involving power electronics, control algorithms, embedded software, controller hardware, communication and system engineering. 
 Demonstrated ownership of the control system architecture of at least one relevant industrial product, from architecture definition and system integration through validation and field deployment or series production. 
 Experience with SST, STATCOM, E-STATCOM, HVDC, medium-voltage drives, utility-scale energy storage PCS or comparable modular power conversion systems is highly preferred. 
 Hands-on experience with distributed control platforms, industrial real-time communication, redundancy design and system-level commissioning is highly valued.

 Our culture is characterized by innovative power and team spirit as well as the intensive exchange of knowledge and experience within our global network.
 We offer healthy meals ranging from traditional Chinese to western delicacies in our famous company canteen.
 To keep your development ongoing, you will find a broad range of training opportunities. Many online and face-to-face training programs incl. language courses in German and Mandarin.

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
As an Engineering Maintenance Technician, you will join our Cheltenham based Facilities and Maintenance team on a 3.5-year level 4 apprenticeship rotational scheme that will enable you to understand and get hands on experience across all aspects of the Facilities and Maintenance programme. You will do this whilst studying a Level 4/5 HNC/HND in General Engineering. This apprenticeship aligns with the Institution of Engineering and Technology for Engineering Technician (EngTech). The role is heavily electrical and mechanically focussed. Our apprenticeship is focused on supporting your personal and professional development and is an opportunity to begin a career as part of a global business within the aerospace industry. 
 Job Description 
 About GE Aerospace 
 Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!
 With over 1,700 employees, GE Aerospace based in Cheltenham is one of the largest sites outside the USA and a major contributor to the local economy. 
 Our heritage dates back to 1940 yet our technology is cutting-edge. Located in the heart of Gloucestershire, the Power Distribution & Controls (PD&C) site focuses on the design, development and manufacture of state-of-the-art aircraft power distribution and avionics systems for the global aviation industry. Our customers include all major aerospace manufacturers - covering commercial, business jet and military applications. The scale and complexity of engineering projects offer our employees unique opportunities to work on major international projects, developing critical aircraft systems that will be relied on by many people for decades to come. 
 At GE Aerospace we strive to be an employer of choice by offering internships, apprenticeships, mentoring and staff development programmes that create a workplace where everyone can be themselves and achieve their full potential. 
 Innovation, a commitment to engineering excellence and leadership development places GE Aerospace based in Cheltenham as a pioneering force in building the future of flight. 
 Role Description 
 As an Engineering Maintenance Technician Apprentice, you will be based within our Facilities and Maintenance team at our 1800 employee Campus in Bishops Cleeve, Cheltenham. Throughout your 3.5-year apprenticeship, you will be supported through, and study, a Level 4 Engineering Maintenance Technician Apprenticeship, completing an HNC/D with Gloucestershire Engineering Training (GET), based at their Gloucester campus. Teaching is typically delivered via 1-day college release, every week during term time for the duration of the course. 
 The Engineering Maintenance Technician is responsible for ensuring the continuous operation, safety, and reliability of all plant machinery, production equipment, and facilities infrastructure. You will perform routine preventative maintenance (PPM), rapid reactive repairs, and system improvements to minimize production downtime and support operational targets.
 A heavy focus of the role will be to support fault finding and maintenance of environmental stress screening test equipment.
 We want to support your personal and professional development, which is why you will be given the opportunity build your network and develop soft skills. At GE Aerospace we see personal development as a key driver of success at a business level. Apprentices are also given additional time to complete ‘off the job learning’ when on site. We aim to arrange team building activities during non-teaching time to help continue to develop your skills.
 Our apprentice community partake in, and often lead enrichment teams and activities that help to connect apprentices across different schemes. This is with a view to giving back to the business and local community. You will have access to mentors and may wish to join one of GE Aerospace employee resource groups, such as Women’s network, STEM, Pride Alliance, Including & Diversity, and more.
 You will be supported by your Apprentice Manager, Rotation Managers, experienced maintenance personnel and the wider apprentice network, to ensure you are meeting the requirements of your course and getting the most out of your apprenticeship. Apprentices who complete this scheme have the transferable skills needed to work in facilities, maintenance and test equipment departments; therefore, roll-off opportunities are not limited to a specific business unit.
 This apprenticeship is new to the GE Aerospace campus and has been established based on the long-term need for, and opportunity for, this …

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one? 
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for summer placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary —shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates. 
 Our Summer Placement Programme 
 Our 13 weeks Summer Placement Programme gives you the chance to work in the Materials Testing Laboratory; a lab that supports the production of our world leading radar and electro-optic products. Working under the guidance of experienced Material Engineers, you will be introduced to state-of-the-art methods, technology and equipment used to characterise materials and analyse failures. You will explore all aspects of the materials test lifecycle, which may include requirements analysis, design of samples, implementation of new processes, sample testing, and product support.
 Throughout your placement, you’ll receive coaching and support from a dedicated team, with the potential to return for future placements or progress onto our Graduate Development Programme. 
 The programme will run from 01/06/2027 to 27/08/2027.
 We expect you on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience with the laboratory equipment. 
 As a Summer Placement Mechanical Engineer you will: 
 · Be immersed in a busy materials laboratory environment, gaining practical experience across a wide range of material characterisation and testing activities that support critical engineering programmes. You will contribute directly to cutting-edge failure analysis on various materials, components and hardware. Including, additively manufactured metallic materials; where you will help to develop sample preparation techniques and document new laboratory processes.
 · Gain a broader understanding of the Materials & Processes Department; working alongside experienced engineers and scientists to see how materials engineering influences the performance, safety and reliability of advanced aerospace systems.
 · Have the chance to gain a wider knowledge of the business through various awareness sessions.
 · Be given responsibility for delivering a specific project task, providing an excellent opportunity to develop your technical, project management and soft skills.
 What you’ll bring 
 · Be enrolled on a Bachelor’s/Integrated Masters degree from an accredited degree course.
 · Relevant engineering or science work experience, such as summer placements or internships.
 · Experience with technical writing and project planning.
 · Strong analytical, modelling skills and laboratory skills.
 · Evidence of successfully working in a team.
 · Experience of working in a laboratory and following laboratory procedures is desirable.
 For the Summer Placement Mechanical Engineer role, the acceptable degree programmes are typically:
 · Engineering Materials
 · Materials Science
 · Mechanical Engineering
 · Chemical Engineering
 · Aerospace Engineering/Manufacturing/Technology
 · Physics
 · Applied Physics
 · Engineering Physics
 · Engineering Management
 This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.
 Security Clearance 
 Many of our roles are subject to security requirements and, where applicable, export control restrictions arising from UK Government requirements and customer obligations many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 
 For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

Job Description: 
 Your Impact 
 Do you want to work on real-time projects alongside leading Scientists and Engineers within a globally renowned company?
 The role requires an enthusiastic individual who has a passion for overcoming technical challenges. As an Electronics Summer Placement you will form part of a multi-discipline Team of Engineers undertaking the collective objective of advancing our World leading products in the Defence domain.
 The 13-week Summer Placement Programme 
 The placement will not only increase your technical skills, but gives you the opportunity to work on meaningful real life projects, alongside experienced engineers and graduates across our business.
 You will receive coaching and support to achieve your personal goals and work in multidisciplinary teams to gain as much experience across the product lifecycle from your time in industry as possible. Our ultimate aim is to see you through your undergrad years and successful placements will result in an offer to return for further placements or for an offer on our Graduate Development programme.
 What you’ll do as a Summer Placement Electronics Engineer: 
 You will be responsible for:
 Building the skills required to work effectively within a Professional Engineering environment.
 Support the design and development of our world leading electro-optical, communications and information system products under the guidance of experienced Electronics Engineers
 You will interface with engineers from other disciplines including Mechanical, Software, Systems, Supportability and Design Integrity. Electronics Engineers design, document, build and test electronics circuits and firmware designs to go into our various systems.
 There will be opportunities to develop expertise in the design of circuits, FPGAs and subsystems at various stages in the product lifecycle. This will include requirements capture, performance analysis, design, code, verification, validation and support to integration and qualification. You will gain exposure to other engineering disciplines and business areas.
 What we need from you: 
 Skills, Qualifications and Experience:

 You will support the design and development of our world leading electro-optical, communications and information system products under the guidance of experienced Electronics Engineering Leads.

 There will be opportunities to develop expertise in the design of circuits, FPGAs and subsystems at various stages in the product lifecycle. Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one?
 At Leonardo Newcastle, we’re looking for summer placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates.
 Leonardo’s Summer Placement Programme offers you a paid opportunity (£26,228) to develop your current skillset in an innovative and practical environment that can lead to a place on our award-winning Graduate Development programme.
 Come and join one of our multi-disciplinary integrated project teams, in Newcastle and contribute to the solving of real-life engineering problems on state-of-the-art avionics sensor systems, such as: the radar for the Typhoon fighter jet; the radar for the SAAB Gripen fighter; one of our family of Surveillance AESA Radars (Active Electronically Scanned Array); an IRCM (Infra–Red Counter Measures) system; or perhaps on one of our laser target designator or laser ranging systems.
 The 13-week Summer Placement Programme 
 We have created a programme across our UK sites that not only increases your technical skills but gives you the opportunity to work on meaningful real-life projects, alongside experienced engineers and graduates across our business.
 You will receive coaching and support to achieve your personal goals and work in multidisciplinary teams to gain as much experience across the product lifecycle from your time in industry as possible. Our ultimate aim is to see you through your undergrad years and successful placements may result in an offer to return for further placements or for an offer on our Graduate Development programme.
 The programme will run from 1st June 2027 to 27th August 2027.
 As a Summer Placement Software Engineer you will: 
 1. Provide support to real projects.
 2. Be required to apply knowledge gained while studying in a practical way.
 3. Undertake activities including designing, testing, qualifying and supporting technology across our range of products. The challenging tasks will involve communicating with other team members to gain information before completing objectives and examining outcomes.
 4. Working as part of an established engineering community, and supported by a team of experienced engineers, you will be responsible for:
 Delivering small packages of work to time, cost and quality.
 Working within a team to achieve project targets, collaborate across multiple disciplines and solve problems.
 Communicating with team members to share knowledge.
 Completing tasks to a high standard in accordance with appropriate processes and procedures.
 Using the opportunity to develop engineering skills. A supervisor will be available to provide mentoring whilst working as a fully integrated member of the team.
 At the start of your placement, prepare a short presentation to introduce yourself and discuss what you will be working on to the Head of Software and the wider team.
 At the end of your placement, showcase what you have learned and achieved during your time at Leonardo to the Head of Software and the wider team.
 Particular emphasis will be placed on learning practical skills that may not be easily gained or experienced in the academic environment of a university.
 What you will bring 
 Our Summer Placement roles require a minimum of a predicted 2:2 grade in a relevant degree discipline e.g. Software Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics or Electronic Engineering (BSc (Hon) / BEng (Hon) / MEng) to have the opportunity to experience a 13-week paid industrial placement working as a Software Engineer within Leonardo.
 Competencies we look for: 
 You should demonstrate an interest in Software Engineering in the area of real time development for avionic systems.
 You should have some experience of computer programming and be enthusiastic and passionate about designing software and writing code.
 Experience of an object-oriented programming language such as C++ and knowledge of UML (Unified Modelling Language) is an advantage but not essential.
 A full statement of courses and projects studied at university and corresponding grades/marks/percentage should be included in your CV.
 Applications are also welcomed from candidates who have completed a first degree and are looking to gain industrial experience prior to commencing a relevant higher degree (i.e. PhD, MSc).
 Personal Attributes: 
 Self-motivated with lots of drive and enthusiasm.
 Able to use own initiative to achieve overall objectives.
 Able to work under pressure and achieve challenging deadlines within an environment of changing priorities.
 Highly responsive with strong customer focus.
 Thorough, seeing job through to completion while maintaining high standards.
 Able to work …

 Maintain internal guidelines and standard operating procedures so they remain accurate, clear, and aligned with current data management processes. 
 Contribute to transformation and continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring issues, supporting analysis, and helping improve efficiency, consistency, and service quality.

items.desc:
PLC Specialist – permanent night shift
 The future of moblity for us. Professional excellence for you. 
 At the BMW Group, everything starts with passion. It turns a profession into a vocation. It drives us to keep reinventing mobility and bring innovative ideas onto the roads. Enthusiasm for joint projects turns a team into a strong unit where every opinion is valued. It is only when expertise, highly professional processes and enjoyment of work unite that we can shape the future together. All employees can and should contribute with their special skills to the unique culture of the BMW Group. We're searching for people who are as passionate as we are. Your expertise, your skill set, your motivation, and your individuality are what drive us forward.
 As a PLC Specialist at BMW Group Plant Debrecen, you will be responsible for the production-related support of all control technology scopes of our production systems in the Assembly.
 What awaits you? 
 Work environment – a highly automated production area equipped with robots, PLC controls, which our team sets up, operates, and maintains to ensure the required quality.
 Team – you will join our Maintenance team in the Assembly.
 System Optimization & Fault Elimination – you support operations in long-term fault elimination and lead projects aimed at improving system availability, safety, and efficiency.
 Project Execution – you ensure the timely delivery of production area projects (modifications, optimizations, and replacements) while managing suppliers within a standard project management framework.
 Problem Solving - you coordinate all on-site control systems and assist suppliers with emerging technical issues.
 IT System Support - you utilize various production-related IT systems in your daily routine.
 Strategic Planning - you apply electrical standards and contribute to the development of new control technologies and systems up to series production . 
 Administration - you prepare inquiry and RFP (Request for Proposal) documents to round off your scope of work.
 What should you bring along? 
 Education background - vocational/high-school degree in a relevant field (electrical, electronics); university degree would be an advantage.
 Work experience – Minimum 2 years of experiences in the commissioning of PLC controls.
 Technical knowledge - knowledge of drive, control and automation technology, PLC programming (Trainings on how to programme SW, but not developed), S7 Classic and TIA Portal, SEW and SINAMICS drive technology. Advanced knowledge of creating/editing visualizations in WinCC, network technology and bus systems (Ethernet, ProfiNet) and knowledge of Kuka robot programming.
 Language skills - communicational level of English and Hungarian is needed, German would be an advantage.
 Work schedule - willingness to work in permanent night shift (00:00-6:00).
 Soft skills - team spirit and joy to working independently or in a structured manner. Proactivity and good analytical mindset and problem-solving skills.

 Our goal is to motivate our employees and recognize their performance, which is why our benefits package includes the following elements in addition to the base salary:
 Bonus – performance-based bonus calculated based on corporate and personal results.

 Private Health Insurance – after probation time, all associates entitled for health insurance, which contains outpatient care, laboratory- and diagnostics tests, outpatient and one-day surgery, screening tests, patient transport.

 Employee car rental programme .

¿QUÉ ES TELEFONICA TECH? 
 Telefónica Tech es la compañía líder en trasformación digital del Grupo Telefónica. Contamos con una amplia oferta de servicios y soluciones tecnológicas integradas de Ciberseguridad, Cloud, IoT, Big Data, Inteligencia Artificial y Blockchain, con la que acompañamos a nuestros clientes en su transformación digital. 
 Somos un grupo de más de 6200 personas valientes que trabajamos a diario desde distintos puntos del mundo para alcanzar la excelencia, a través de un liderazgo basado en la transparencia y en el espírItu de equipo. Si te identificas con nuestros pilares, ¡estamos deseando conocerte! 
 www.telefonicatech.com 
 ¿QUÉ HACEMOS EN EL EQUIPO? 
 En la unidad de Seguridad Ofensiva de Telefónica Tech tenemos por objeto proporcionar a las organizaciones una postura de seguridad precisa y real que nos permiten ofrecer a nuestros clientes descubrir vulnerabilidades críticas en su entorno y ayudar a priorizar y abordar los riesgos en función de su explotabilidad e impacto. 
 En nuestro equipo nos encargamos de gestionar las vulnerabilidades de los sistemas, redes y aplicaciones de organizaciones. Lo que hacemos es identificar, evaluar y priorizar las posibles amenazas y debilidades de seguridad para asegurarnos de que todos los activos digitales estén protegidos de posibles riesgos. Utilizamos herramientas especializadas y métodos de pruebas para detectar vulnerabilidades, luego analizamos su nivel de gravedad y trabajamos en su mitigación a través de parches, configuraciones de seguridad y otras medidas preventivas. 
 ¿CÓMO SERÁ TU DÍA A DÍA? 
 Tu misión será la gestión del ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades. 
 Tu día a día será el siguiente: 
 Alta y provisión de activos en herramientas de gestión de vulnerabilidades. 
 Análisis de las vulnerabilidades reportadas de manera continua con el fin de evaluar la probabilidad e impacto reales para ajustar la criticidad/severidad, así como la revisión y limpieza de falsos positivos. 
 Soporte en la definición de planes de remediación priorizados. 
 Generación de informes mensuales y KPIs. 
 Instalación de sondas de escaneo de vulnerabilidades. 
 Revisión y mejora de los perfiles de escaneo. 
 Apertura y gestión de solicitudes de cliente en plataforma de ticketing. 
 Reuniones de seguimiento del servicio. 
 Realizar automatizaciones mediante scripts. 
 Y PARA ELLO, CREEMOS QUE SERÍA IDEAL QUE CONTARAS CON… 
 Experiencia 
 Experiencia mínima de 1 año y medio en proyectos de gestión del ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades. 
 Formación 
 Formación universitaria, título de FP grado medio/superior o experiencia profesional equivalente. 
 Deseable: 
 Estar en posesión de certificaciones relativas a los fabricantes Tenable o Qualys. 
 Conocimientos técnicos 
 Conocimiento técnico en herramientas de escaneo de vulnerabilidades (Nexpose/Nessus Professional/Tenable/Qualys/Nuclei/etc..). 
 Lenguajes de programación y scripting en Python, bash, powershell, etc... 
 Para desempeñar el rol, las skills que encajarían con el equipo y el proyecto serían : 
 Apasionado por la tecnología y la seguridad ofensiva. 
 Creatividad y con instinto hacker. 
 Proactividad, capacidad para asumir retos. 
 Capacidad de transmitir ideas técnicamente complejas a audiencia no técnica. 
 Capacidad de trabajo en equipo. 
 Idiomas 
 Necesario: 
 Español nativo. 
 Ingles B2

 • Medidas de conciliación y flexibilidad horaria.
• Formación continua y certificaciones.
• Modelo híbrido de teletrabajo.
• Atractivo paquete de beneficios sociales.
• Excelente ambiente de trabajo dinámico y multidisciplinar.
• Programas de voluntariado.

items.desc:
VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 1 500 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 300 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 200 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 700 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Čo od vás očakávame 
 Ak Ťa zaujíma svet bankovníctva, si komunikatívny/komunikatívna a máš prax v práci s hotovosťou, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku vo VÚB!
 Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
 Okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Vítame u nás skúsených bankárov, ale ak ešte bankovú prax nemáš, nevadí. U nás vo VÚB Ťa na to pripravíme celkom od začiatku.
 ČO TI DÁME NA ÚVOD?
Vďaka silnej podpore manažérov pobočky, nápomocným kolegom a priateľskému prístupu našich lektorov sa:
postupne začneš orientovať vo VUB bankových produktoch a službách,
naučíš pracovať s klientom a zlepšíš svoju komunikáciu a schopnosť argumentovať, čo sa Ti zíde aj v osobnom živote.
 PREČO SA TI PRÁCA VO VÚBKE BUDE PÁČIŤ?
 Budeš pracovať v jednej z najväčších a najvýznamnejších bánk na Slovensku.
 Na pobočke ste jeden tím – obchodné plány plníte spoločne a vzájomne sa podporujete.
 Rozširuješ si odbornosť a získavaš skúsenosti, ktoré využiješ v Tvojej kariére.
 Pri práci s klientom sa zlepšuješ v mnohých oblastiach, ktoré oceníš aj v osobnom živote.
 TVOJOU ÚLOHOU AKO PORADCU KLIENTA BUDE:
 podieľať sa na podpore predaja a spolupracovať s tímom,
 hľadať príležitosti pre predaj všetkých bankových produktov a služieb,
 poskytovať informácie a odborné poradenstvo klientom,
 vykonávať pokladničné a zmenárenské operácie,
 vykonávať servisné klientske operácie, zodpovedne pracovať s hotovosťou,
 podieľať sa na administratívnych činnostiach,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov!
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Prax na pozícii/v oblasti
 prax v práci s hotovosťou
 Počet rokov praxe: 1
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máš minimálne SŠ vzdelanie s maturitou,
 máš minimálne 1 rok praxe v práci s hotovosťou,
 Ťa baví komunikovať,
 si priateľský/á a vieš pracovať individuálne aj v tíme,
 máš v sebe ducha obchodníka,
 si dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,
 si ochotný/á na sebe pracovať a rozvíjať sa.
 ... všetko ostatné Ťa naučíme my :)
 Informácie o výberovom konaní
Ak Ťa tento popis zaujal a chceš sa stať naším novým VÚBkárom, stačí už len kliknúť na „Reagovať na ponuku" a my sa Ti ozveme. Všetko dôležité o práci vo VÚB si povieme na osobnom/online stretnutí.

 Viši/Glavni analitičar (m/ž) na poslovima razvoja kreditnih politika, procesa i pravila kreditiranja 
 (mjesto rada Zagreb) 
 Radno mjesto obuhvaća operativno sudjelovanje u procesu razvoja politike upravljanja kreditnim rizikom, uređenju kreditnih procesa i ključnih elemenata poslovnog odlučivanja te unaprjeđenja sustava unutarnjih kontrola. 
 Radni zadaci uključuju: 
 analizu i dizajn procesa i pravila odobravanja plasmana , te razvoj i održavanje dijelova aplikacija koji podržavaju navedeni proces 
 razvoj sustava automatskog odlučivanja temeljem internih modela 
 aktivno sudjelovanje na projektima vezanim uz digitalizaciju i optimizaciju procesa odobravanja kredita u skladu s najnovijim trendovima digitalnog poslovanja 
 dohvat i analizu podataka o klijentima i kreditnim proizvodima, s ciljem identifikacije „clustera“ povećanog rizika te praćenja uspješnosti pravila odlučivanja 
 sudjelovanje u razvoju internih modela za kreditni rizik (PD), dizajn procesa dodjele internih kreditnih rejtinga te implementaciju internih modela u kreditne procese 
 specifikaciju zahtjeva i funkcionalnosti za implementaciju novih, kao i unaprjeđenje postojećih aplikativnih rješenja, osiguravanje kvalitete IT isporuka te razvoj i testiranje centralnog sustava za podršku odlučivanju i aplikacija koje se koriste u kreditnom procesu 
 pisanje i održavanje procedura i uputa procesa odobravanja i praćenja kreditnog rizika 
 Formalni uvjeti koje svi kandidati moraju zadovoljavati su: 
 VSS (prednost informatički ili matematički smjerovi) 
 minimalno 3 godine relevantnog radnog iskustva 
 poznavanje kreditnog procesa i/ili modela mjerenja kreditnog rizika 
 iskustvo rada s bazama podataka (poželjno znanje SQL-a ili rada u SAS alatima) 
 napredno poznavanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu 
 napredno korištenje MS Office-a

 izražene analitičke sposobnosti i orijentiranost na finalni rezultat 
 samostalnost, sistematičnost i odgovornost u radu 
 sposobnost brzog snalaženja u različitim poslovnim situacijama

 sigurnost i proaktivnost u nastupu

 Mogućnost napretka u karijeri i profesionalno usavršavanje 
 dinamično i motivirajuće okruženje 
 izazovni projekti 
 stručni tečajevi, seminari, interni razvojni moduli 
 Ravnotežu poslovnog i privatnog života te brigu za zaposlenike

VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 5 500 EUR/mesiac
 Ponúkame diskusiu o mzde začínajúcu na tejto sume. Finálna úroveň mzdy závisí od profesijnej kvalifikácie a skúseností. Ročné odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 40% v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj skupinových cieľov.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Do nášho tímu hľadáme skúseného lídra/líderku, ktorý/ktorá prevezme zodpovednosť za riadenie obchodných aktivít v rámci príslušného regiónu. 
 Hľadáme strategicky mysliacu osobnosť s výbornými obchodnými schopnosťami, skúsenosťami s vedením tímov a schopnosťou ovplyvňovať rozvoj firemného bankovníctva. 
 Ponúkame Vám: 
 príležitosť viesť obchodnú sieť v rámci regiónu stredné a východné Slovensko a ovplyvniť jej rozvoj,
 možnosť formovať obchodnú stratégiu a rozvoj SME segmentu,
 motivujúce finančné ohodnotenie a atraktívne benefity,
 podporu profesionálneho rastu a rozvoja líderských zručností.
 Vašou úlohou bude:
 riadiť obchodné aktivity v rámci regiónu stredné a východné Slovensko a zabezpečiť plnenie obchodných cieľov a KPI’s,
 viesť a rozvíjať tím riaditeľov 5 firemných obchodných centier,
 prijímať rozhodnutia v oblasti obchodných aktivít, optimalizácie obchodnej siete a efektívnosti obsluhy klientov,
 vypracovávať návrhy pre koncepciu rozvoja a zmien firemnej obchodnej siete v regióne,
 analyzovať dynamiku vývoja regionálneho trhu, sledovať trhové trendy, konkurenciu a vývoj klientskych segmentov,
 nastavovať a realizovať obchodnú stratégiu v súlade s cieľmi banky,
 aktívne budovať a udržiavať vzťahy s kľúčovými firemnými klientmi,
 pripravovať a predávať špeciálne ponuky produktov a služieb banky a jej finančnej skupiny definovanému segmentu klientov,
 spolupracovať s ostatnými oddeleniami banky na zlepšovaní klientskych riešení a procesov,
 prezentovať úverové návrhy pre klientov na úverovom výbore banky.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov! 
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 vysokoškolské II. stupňa (ekonomický smer výhodou)
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máš vysokoškolské vzdelanie II. stupňa (ekonomický smer výhodou),
 máš minimálne 7 rokov skúseností v oblasti firemného bankovníctva, ideálne v SME segmente,
 máš preukázateľnú skúsenosť s vedením väčších tímov alebo riadením obchodnej siete,
 máš schopnosť analyzovať finančné výkazy (súvaha, výsledovka, cash-flow),
 máš znalosť bankových produktov a potrieb firemných klientov,
 ovládaš anglický jazyk na úrovni B2 a vyššie,
 máš vodičský preukaz skupiny B – aktívny vodič,
 máš výborné komunikačné a prezentačné schopnosti, orientácia na výsledky, strategické myslenie.

Ak Ťa tento popis zaujal a chceš sa stať naším novým VÚBkárom, stačí už len kliknúť na „Reagovať na ponuku" a my sa Ti ozveme. Všetko dôležité o práci vo VÚB si povieme na osobnom/online stretnutí.

items.desc: You'll join a small applied-AI team and own the ML behind Hirivo. That covers the job-matching and ranking models, the LLM agents that read job adverts and fill application forms, and the systems that tell us whether they're working. You'll take features from prototype to production, then measure and monitor them. What you'll do Build and improve LLM-powered agents that read job adverts and application forms and complete them accurately from a candidate's profile and CV (tool use, multi-step workflows, handing questions to the candidate when needed). Build job-to-candidate matching and ranking using embeddings, retrieval (RAG) and vector search, behind the campaign match score. Create evaluation sets and automated evals for form-fill accuracy, match quality and agent success rate, then iterate on prompts, models and fine-tunes. Train, fine-tune and benchmark models (PyTorch), for example to parse CVs and job descriptions and to classify job fit. Deploy models and agents as scalable APIs and services on the cloud (AWS/GCP) with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD, integrated with our Node backend. Add observability : tracing of agent runs, latency/cost dashboards, failure and drift monitoring. Build data pipelines that collect and clean job listings from many sources. Work with product and with candidates to turn real job-seeker problems into shipped features, and care about responsible AI : candidates' data, fairness and accuracy. Essential Strong Python and solid software-engineering fundamentals (APIs, backend services, testing). (Python appears in 64% of the sampled postings; APIs/backend in 54%.) Hands-on experience building with LLMs: OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, prompting, agents or RAG. (LLMs 60%, agents 69%.) Experience shipping ML or AI systems to production and running them at scale. (Production 63%, scale 67%.) Experience training and evaluating models, plus familiarity with PyTorch. (Training/experimentation 48%.) Cloud experience (AWS, GCP or Azure) plus Docker/Kubernetes. (Cloud 40%.) A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. A product mindset: you care about users and measurable impact. (36%.) Desirable Building LLM evaluation frameworks (evals, benchmarks, LLM-as-judge). (40%) Monitoring and observability tooling (e.g. Datadog, OpenTelemetry, LangSmith). (55%) Open-source contributions or a public portfolio of AI projects. (36%) A second language such as TypeScript, Go, C++ or Rust. (TypeScript/JS 31%, Go 16%) GPU / CUDA / inference-performance optimisation. (22%) Fine-tuning (LoRA, RLHF/DPO). (18%) Familiarity with AI safety or responsible AI. (21%) Recommender/ranking systems, MLOps tooling (MLflow, model registry), web scraping/data pipelines. (13-15% each) Pay: £35,000.00-£45,000.00 per year Benefits: Additional leave Gym membership Language training provided On-site parking Relocation assistance Work from home Work Location: Hybrid remote in London

items.desc: Askara est une start-up SaaS en forte croissance qui développe un logiciel basé sur l'intelligence artificielle et piloté à la voix pour les dentistes. Notre mission : simplifier le quotidien des dentistes en automatisant leurs tâches administratives , de la dictée vocale à la rédaction de documents médicaux complexes. Aujourd'hui, plus de 4 000 praticiens utilisent notre solution, nous avons généré plus de 400 000 documents , et nous traitons plusieurs dizaines de milliers d'heures d'audio chaque mois. Nous avons une équipe qui écoute les besoins des praticiens et construit le produit. Il nous manque la personne dont le métier est de le faire tourner . Vos missions Nous recherchons un(e) Technical Operations Engineer (TechOps) , dont la mission tient en une phrase : Askara marche, de façon fiable et sûre . Concrètement, vous prenez la responsabilité de tout ce qui fait qu'un produit livré reste un produit qui fonctionne : la sécurité , l' IT interne, la qualité et les tests , la réponse aux incidents . Ce poste est une création . Aujourd'hui, ces sujets sont portés par le CTO, en parallèle du reste. Vous n'héritez donc pas d'une page blanche (ISO 27001 obtenue, EDR déployé, CI/CD en place, tests Playwright, monitoring Sentry, procédure d'incident formalisée) mais d'un périmètre réel, éclaté, qui n'a jamais eu de propriétaire à plein temps. Vous serez le pivot entre : la tech le support la conformité la direction Un mot d'honnêteté sur la nature du poste : c'est un rôle très opérationnel et très interne . On y écrit des procédures, mais surtout on les applique. On y rédige un plan de test, puis on le joue. On y documente une politique d'accès, puis on va révoquer les comptes un par un. Si vous cherchez un poste de méthodologie pure, ce n'est pas celui-là. Si vous aimez que les choses soient carrées et que ça se voie, c'est exactement celui-là. Qualité produit et tests (environ 40% du temps) Prendre la stratégie de test de bout en bout : plans de test, tests automatisés (Playwright), smoke tests, tests de non-régression Définir les critères de sortie d'une release : ce qui bloque un déploiement, ce qui ne le bloque pas Jouer la QA sur les parcours critiques avant chaque livraison web, desktop et mobile Fiabilité et incidents (environ 30% du temps) Faire vivre la procédure d'incidents : niveaux de gravité, playbooks, status page, communication client Être Incident Lead sur les cas sérieux, et garantir que l'information circule vite et juste Animer les post-mortems sans recherche de coupable, et surtout s'assurer que les actions correctives sont livrées Entretenir le monitoring et l'alerting Cybersécurité opérationnelle (environ 20% du temps) Faire vivre au quotidien notre dispositif de sécurité : EDR, MFA, gestion des vulnérabilités, durcissement des postes Piloter les revues d'accès périodiques et en produire les preuves Organiser la sensibilisation de l'équipe : campagnes de phishing, rappels, formation à l'arrivée ️ IT interne et parc (environ 10% du temps) Gérer le parc de postes (macOS et Windows) et de téléphones : achat, préparation, chiffrement, mises à jour, inventaire, remplacement Industrialiser l' onboarding et l'offboarding : matériel prêt le jour J, accès ouverts au bon niveau, tout coupé et récupéré au départ Administrer les comptes et les accès sur l'ensemble de nos outils : SSO, MFA, gestionnaire de mots de passe, droits par rôle ️ Environnement Cloud : AWS, Terraform Produit : application web (React), API (PHP / Symfony), Electron (Windows / macOS) Tests : Playwright, CI GitHub Monitoring : Sentry, UptimeRobot Data / BI : Metabase, SQL Suivi et doc : Linear, Notion, Slack Support : Intercom IA : Claude, agents et automatisations internes (MCP, scripts) Conformité : ISO 27001, SOC 2, HDS, RGPD Vous n'avez pas besoin de savoir développer une feature, mais vous devez être capable de lire du code, comprendre une architecture et débugger sans dépendre de quelqu'un . Sans ça, le poste devient de la coordination, et ce n'est pas ce qu'on cherche. Vos compétences Profil polyvalent et autonome , qui aime prendre un sujet en friche et le rendre carré Une expérience en IT / sysadmin, QA, DevOps, support technique Solide sur au moins deux de ces axes, curieux(se) sur les autres : IT interne et sécurité : gestion de parc, comptes et accès, bonnes pratiques qualité et tests : plans de test, automatisation, non-régression fiabilité : monitoring, incidents, diagnostic À l'aise avec l' IA comme outil de travail : vous l'utilisez déjà tous les jours et vous avez envie d'aller plus loin que le chat Capable de dire non à une release, et de l'expliquer sans braquer l'équipe Sang-froid en situation d'incident, et goût pour le concret : on mesure ce poste à ce qui est en place, pas à ce qui est prévu Bonus : expérience en santé numérique, en environnement audité (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HDS), ou en application desktop distribuée Avantages CDI basé à Strasbourg, ouvert au remote (hybride idéal) Rémunération : 45 à 55k€ …
