items.desc: Location: Bucharest, Romania The Network Engineers goal is to support the company in the daily management of the IS/IT function by delivering high-availability network infrastructure in order to sustain the users' online and on-site information technology activities. To do so, the Network Engineers work hand in hand with other IS/IT professionals (architects, security engineers …). On a daily basis, the Network Engineers design and implement network configurations, troubleshoot performance issues, carry out network monitoring and configure network systems such as routers, switches, and wireless infrastructure. They have to make sure that operations’ workflow, practices, and server maintenance are working effectively and efficiently to aid the improvement of performance, security system, and availability of systems and dependent ecosystems. Network Engineers interface with various stakeholders, within the company and throughout IS/IT Function, in order to deliver stakeholders satisfaction by managing capacity and carrying out remote and/or on-site support. COMPETENCIES: You are able to maintain and control computer networks and related computing environments together with structures software, programs software, hardware, and configurations. You can carry out the configuration of network and security infrastructure equipment. You have experience in monitoring network performance by troubleshooting, diagnosing and resolving software, hardware, and other network and system problems. You have the ability to define the detailed functional behavior of infrastructure building blocks. You have the ability to prevent service interruption, data loss and/or other technical disasters. You have experience in managing complex recovery operations. You can stay value driven, propose smart ideas, be disruptive, take smart risk You have the creativity to lay out smart designs, think out of the box You have the ability to implement new solutions for your users’ satisfaction. You contribute on purchase process in way to describe requirement, analyse & challenge offers and advise on tenderer’s selection. You are able to define a product roadmap and norms & standards You are autonomous, organized, dynamic and can be an actor of change management, promote teamwork You have the strong ability on writing of technical document TECHNICAL SKILLS: You can define and implement networking requirements in a variety of production processes. You have good analytic skills and provide a real expertise on level 3 support. You can configure network and security devices and other IT assets like: Firewalls: Juniper, Palo Alto, FortiGate, Stormshield, Checkpoint, L3/L4 Filtering, User-ID, App-ID. Proxies: zScaler, SSL inspection, WL/BL, URL categorization, web filters, content filter, CAS Gateway VPN: Cisco Firepower, Any Connect client Load balancer: F5 (LTM, APM), VMware NSX. Radius: Cisco ISE PSN, PAN, Dot1.x You have a good knowledge on transversal infrastructure and security domain like : Directories: Active Directory, LDAPS. IAM: Kerberos, SAML, Single Sign On, MFA, etc. PKI: x509 certificate, CMS, AEP. Cloud computing: SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, Infra as Code, and Automation with scripts development (Python/Shell). Cloud security: Zero Trust Network Access, SASE. Virtualized environment (ESX and VMs). SOFT SKILLS: You have strong communication and documentation skills. You are proactive and self-motivated with a problem-solving mindset. You have the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative agile environment. You are independent and self-organizing. At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world. Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of defence and security, aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. In Romania, we are advancing innovation through software engineering, research and development, delivering solutions in key markets in which Thales Group operates. Our engineers design, develop and integrate solutions that impact global industries – from fully operational systems and subsystems for naval warfare and maritime security operations, to air traffic management systems, satellite-based solutions, tactical indoor simulations, identity and biometric technologies and more.

items.desc: About the role Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for a skilled Data Engineer to join an exciting technology-driven assignment focused on building scalable data solutions and backend services. You will work with modern data technologies and backend frameworks to ensure reliable access to data and efficient data workflows. You will collaborate closely with other engineers, provide technical guidance where needed, and help drive continuous improvements across the team's data engineering capabilities. Build backend APIs and services to enable efficient and reliable access to data. Provide technical support and share knowledge with colleagues on data engineering topics. Identify opportunities for technical improvements and drive initiatives from idea to implementation. Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to design practical, scalable solutions. Skills Python Scala Java Skills & requirements ✅ Required Skills & Qualifications Professional experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role. Strong programming skills in Python and Java or Scala. Solid backend development experience, ideally with Scala Play Framework or an equivalent framework. Strong general software engineering and problem-solving skills. Experience developing and maintaining software solutions and data-processing workflows. A bachelor's degree in a relevant field; a master's degree is a strong advantage. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to work independently, take responsibility, and drive tasks forward. A collaborative mindset with a willingness to share knowledge and support colleagues. Ability to work on-site at the client's office in Malmö three days per week. ⭐ Nice-to-Have Skills & Technologies Experience with one or more of the following technologies will be an advantage: Apache Spark and Apache Flink for distributed data processing. Apache Iceberg for modern data lake architectures. Microservices deployed on Kubernetes. Snowflake for cloud data warehousing. Apache Kafka for event streaming and data integration. Our Ideal Candidate You thrive in an environment where you are trusted to take ownership and make independent decisions. You balance technical innovation with practical delivery and continuously look for ways to improve existing systems and workflows. Interested in This Opportunity? If you have strong Python and Java/Scala skills, backend development experience, and an interest in scalable data engineering, we’d like to hear from you. Send us your updated CV highlighting your data engineering projects, programming expertise, backend experience, and relevant technologies.

You will develop tools to determine whether a robot design can perform real-world tasks before committing to hardware . Your
items.desc: Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‑01 - our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments - and we’re growing the team to take it even further. About The Role We design robots in simulation before building them in hardware . As a Robotics Simulation & RL Engineer , you will help design and validate future generations of our robotic platforms - including bipedal and wheeled systems - using physics simulation and reinforcement learning. You will develop tools to determine whether a robot design can perform real-world tasks before committing to hardware . Your work will directly inform robot architecture, actuator selection, sensor placement, and control strategies . A key responsibility of this role is owning and validating the canonical robot models (URDF and simulation assets) used across simulation and control stacks. What You’ll Do Design and evaluate new robot platforms using physics simulation; Analyze robot capabilities including workspace, manipulability, dynamic balance, and torque limits; Use reinforcement learning to stress-test robot designs and explore capability limits; Own and maintain URDF models of current and future robot platforms; Maintain the CAD URDF simulation pipeline; Develop tools and benchmarks to evaluate locomotion, manipulation, and platform robustness; Provide quantitative feedback to hardware teams on actuator sizing, joint placement, mass distribution, and sensor layout; Collaborate with mechanical, control, and perception teams to guide platform design decisions. What We're Looking For M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Control, or a related field; Strong foundation in robot kinematics and dynamics; Experience with robot simulation environments (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or similar); Experience with reinforcement learning in robotics or physics-based simulation; Experience working with URDF or similar robot description formats; Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++; Experience training RL locomotion or manipulation policies. Nice to have: Experience with legged, humanoid, or wheeled robots; Experience with whole-body control or torque-controlled robots; Experience with simulation-driven hardware design; Experience building large-scale RL training pipelines. What We Offer Competitive equity: stock options with meaningful upside as we scale. 30+ paid days off, including 23 days of annual leave, all UK bank holidays, and additional company closure days (including Christmas–New Year shutdown). Private healthcare, including virtual and in-person care. Pension scheme with 8% total contribution (5% employee, 3% employer) on full earnings. Free daily breakfast, catered lunch, and snacks in-office. Work at the frontier - collaborate daily with world-class engineers, researchers, and product experts building the next generation of AI and humanoid robotics. Real ownership - direct access to founding leadership, meaningful input on product direction, and the ability to drive key initiatives from day one.

items.desc: DESCRIPTION Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account. AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it. You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver. Key job responsibilities Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified. Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil. Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work. Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes. Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability. Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers. Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices. A day in the life You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place. You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written. On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur. You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back. You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap. About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Why Amazon Security? At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. You will own the analytical models and frameworks that connect product behavior to business outcomes across acquisition, activation, adoption, expansion, and renewal. experience with data modelling and pipeline tools (dbt, Airflow, Dagster) Deep expertise in predictive modelling, causal inference, survival analysis, and experimentation (A/B, diff-in-diff, instrumental variables) Experience working directly with product telemetry and event-stream data at scale Solid understanding of SaaS lifecycle mechanics (ARR, NRR, LTV, PQLs, activation funnels) Ability to translate statistical findings into product and commercial strategy for non-technical stakeholders Degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or equivalent) Desired Skills And Competencies Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field Cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Azure Synapse) Product analytics instrumentation experience (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, or custom event pipelines) MLOps — model deployment, monitoring, and retraining in production Experience building propensity or scoring models that integrate into CRM/CS platforms Familiarity with industrial software or enterprise SaaS contexts UK Benefits include: Flexible benefits fund, emergency leave days, adoption leave, 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), pension, life cover, private medical insurance, parental leave, education assistance program. Épargne salariale attractive (abondement sur PEG et PERCOG). Un environnement de travail agréable et un accès au restaurant d'entreprise avec une participation employeur. Profil ET VOUS ? Vous comprenez les enjeux d’une plateforme mutualisée : vous aimez construire des outils et mettre en place des services robustes qui servent à d’autres produits et équipes techniques. Colaborar con los equipos de desarrollo para remediar los hallazgos y reforzar las prácticas de código seguro. Mejorar cómo se validan, priorizan y remedian las vulnerabilidades que llegan por bug bounty, por pruebas internas, por herramientas automatizadas y por revisiones externas. Detectar patrones recurrentes o heredados de vulnerabilidades a partir de la causa raíz, incidentes anteriores y hallazgos de seguridad. Construir y mejorar automatizaciones, agentes, skills y checks de CI/CD que ayuden a los equipos de ingeniería a detectar y corregir problemas antes. Ayudar a asegurar el uso de IA en productos y flujos internos: LLMs, agentes, acceso a datos, herramientas, permisos y escenarios de abuso. Contribuir al desarrollo de las herramientas, automatizaciones e infraestructura de seguridad. Estar al día en investigación, amenazas, técnicas de ataque y riesgos emergentes de seguridad en IA. Qué buscamos Imprescindible 4+ años de experiencia profesional en seguridad de aplicaciones, seguridad ofensiva o pentesting. Es obligatoria la experiencia en pentesting de aplicaciones web. Formación en Ingeniería o Informática y buen conocimiento de aplicaciones web, bases de datos, protocolos de red y sistemas operativos. Fundamentos sólidos de ciberseguridad, CVSS, metodologías de pruebas y herramientas. Fluidez con scripting o lenguajes de programación para automatizar la seguridad, como Python o Bash. Perfil técnico y curioso, cómodo moviéndote entre distintas áreas de seguridad en lugar de especializarte solo en una. Inglés fluido. Valorable Curiosidad y ganas de aprender sobre seguridad de IA: inyección de prompts en LLMs, agentes, exposición de datos, permisos de herramientas, seguridad de RAG y adopción de IA. Certificaciones como BSCP o eWPTX. Experiencia con aplicaciones Ruby / Ruby on Rails. Te gusta atacar sistemas, pero también construir herramientas, automatizaciones, guardarraíles y soluciones prácticas que hagan la seguridad escalable. No hace falta ser experto en todo: buscamos a alguien que razone con criterio, aprenda rápido, use bien la IA y proponga soluciones pragmáticas. We partner: decidimos como equipo y confiamos unos en otros. We grow fast: actuamos rápido y aprendemos de cada resultado. Beneficios Entorno colaborativo, multicultural y de alto crecimiento. Seguro médico privado. Acceso a gimnasio, piscinas y programas de bienestar. Ahorro en gastos y clases de idiomas. Desayunos y fruta ecológica en la oficina, descuentos en comidas, café y té gratis. items.desc: Wil jij onderzoek doen dat niet op de plank blijft liggen, maar direct wordt toegepast in duurzame energieprojecten? In deze rol werk je aan de ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van complete energiesystemen en warmtepompoplossingen. Je combineert theoretische diepgang met praktische toepassing en krijgt veel vrijheid om jouw ideeën uit te werken. Wat ga je doen? Als R&D Specialist Duurzame warmte werk je aan het modelleren, simuleren en optimaliseren van energiecentrales en warmtepompsystemen. Je onderzoekt vanuit een sterk theoretisch kader, maar altijd met de praktijk als uitgangspunt. Jouw werk helpt om snel te bepalen welk energieconcept technisch en energetisch het beste past bij een project. Je houdt je bezig met process design, thermodynamica en het ontwikkelen van modellen waarmee complete systemen kunnen worden doorgerekend. Daarbij werk je onder andere met simulatiesoftware zoals EES. Je kijkt niet alleen naar één onderdeel van een installatie, maar juist naar het totaalplaatje en de samenhang tussen verschillende technieken. Het interessante aan deze omgeving is dat onderzoek en uitvoering dicht bij elkaar liggen. Ideeën die jij ontwikkelt, kunnen relatief snel worden getest en toegepast binnen echte projecten. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met engineers en andere technische specialisten. Wat wordt er van je verwacht? Je hebt een universitaire technische opleiding afgerond, bij voorkeur in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt een sterke interesse in warmtepomptechniek, thermodynamica en process design en wordt enthousiast van modelleren, simuleren en technisch complexe vraagstukken. Tegelijkertijd ben je praktisch ingesteld. Je wilt niet alleen onderzoeken waarom iets technisch zou moeten werken, maar ook zien wat er gebeurt wanneer een oplossing daadwerkelijk wordt toegepast. Je werkt gemakkelijk samen met verschillende technische disciplines, communiceert helder en kunt ook onder druk creatief blijven zoeken naar een goede oplossing. Wat kun je verwachten? Je komt terecht binnen een technisch familiebedrijf met korte lijnen, weinig bureaucratie en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Je krijgt vrijheid in de manier waarop je jouw werk organiseert en kunt vanuit jouw expertise daadwerkelijk invloed uitoefenen op de technische keuzes die worden gemaakt. Daar staat een goed salaris tot € 5.500,- bruto per maand, aangevuld met een pensioenregeling en winstuitkering. Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen en er is volop ruimte voor opleidingen, trainingen en verdere inhoudelijke ontwikkeling. Daarnaast werk je vanuit een moderne werkomgeving en krijg je de middelen die je nodig hebt om jouw werk goed uit te voeren. Reiskosten worden vergoed en afhankelijk van de functie kan een leaseauto tot de mogelijkheden behoren. Ook kun je gebruikmaken van een fietsleaseplan. Na je proeftijd ontvang je bovendien een welkomstbonus van 50% van één bruto maandsalaris. Zoek jij een R&D-omgeving waarin je technische diepgang kunt combineren met zichtbare impact in de praktijk? Dan is dit een interessante volgende stap. To our foreign friends, speaking Dutch is a must for this role. Please don’t apply if you’re not fluent in Dutch.

Om tjänsten Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut arbetar tillsammans med förvars-, beredskaps- och sjukvårds­myndig­­heterna för att säkerställa att Sveriges vårdsystem är robust i
items.desc: Söker du en meningsfull sysselsättning där du som forskare kan bidra till samhällskritiska funktioner? Söker du en plats där dina modeller och beräkningar kan bidra till att rädda liv? I så fall kanske FOI är din nästa arbetsgivare! Om tjänsten Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut arbetar tillsammans med förvars-, beredskaps- och sjukvårds­myndig­­heterna för att säkerställa att Sveriges vårdsystem är robust i händelse av kris och krig. Det innebär bland annat prognosering av förväntade skadetyper från masskadehändelser, estimering av det resulterande vårdbehovet samt dimensionering av sjukvårdsresurser och logistikkedjan som behövs för att möta detta behov. I den här tjänsten blir du en del av det team som för hela Sveriges räkning utför forskning, modellering och beräkningar till detta samhällskritiska arbete. Som forskare inom skadeverkan på människor och sjukvårdsbehov kommer du tillsammans med andra drivna forskare inom ämnet arbeta med att utveckla modeller, prognoser och beräkningar för dessa ändamål. Forskningen kommer att delas mellan områdena skadeverkan på människa och sjukvårdsbehov, men alltjämt med det explicita syftet att stödja den svenska sjukvårdsberedskapen med beräkningar, modellering och analys. Om enheten Du kommer att ingå i enheten för befolkningsskydd som tillhör avdelningen försvarsanalys. Befolkningsskydd är en tillväxtsenhet med inriktning på det civila försvaret och i synnerhet skydd av civilbefolkningen. Läs gärna mer om vad vi gör på FOI:s hemsida: Försvarsanalys. Delar av tjänsten delas med enheten för verkansvärdering på avdelningen för vapen skydd och säkerhet, men tjänsten är förlagd till Kista. Har du den kompetensprofil vi behöver? Krav Doktorsexamen inom relevant område (exempelvis fysik eller matematik), alternativt masterexamen i kombination med relevant arbetslivserfarenhet. Goda kunskaper inom matematisk modellering. Erfarenhet av att arbeta med komplex, ofullständig eller på annat sätt rörig data. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Arbetet är i sitt fundament tvärvetenskapligt och komplext. Förmågan att analysera komplex data och att skapa förenklade modeller baserat på sådan data är avgörande för att bli framgångsrik i denna tjänst. Du är också kreativ och kommer ofta med idéer och nya angreppssätt. Eftersom du kommer att vara en del av ett multidisciplinärt team bestående av scenariokonstruktörer, modellerare och mjukvaruutvecklare, kommer framgången att vara avhängig en god samarbetsförmåga. Vi ser även att du är självgående och tar ansvar för ditt arbete som du genomför på ett strukturerat sätt för att leverera efterfrågade resultat i tid. Vidare ser vi att du har god kommunikativ förmåga som gör att du kan beskriva komplexa idéer och problem på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper. Meriterande Dokumenterade forskarerfarenheter. Kunskaper inom anatomi, fysiologi eller sjukvård med särskilt vikt på traumavård. Vana av att utföra kvantitativa analyser. Vad erbjuder vi dig? Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut (FOI) är en statlig myndighet som bedriver världsledande forskning inom försvar och säkerhet till stöd för Sveriges militära och civila försvar. Vi erbjuder en unik arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta med det som är viktigt för totalförsvaret och hela samhället. Forskningen tillämpas både inom försvarsmyndigheter och hos civila aktörer och spelar en avgörande roll i att bygga en relevant och effektiv försvarsförmåga. Vi arbetar medvetet för en god arbetsmiljö med en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Utöver detta erbjuder vi en rad förmåner. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss: https://www.foi.se/jobba-hos-oss.html Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Vill du vara med och söka svaren för en säkrare värld? Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV och personligt brev via ansökningsknappen senast den 18 oktober 2026! För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta enhetschef David Andersson. Fackliga företrädare är Monia Lougui (Saco-S) och Lisa Bergsten (OFR/S – ST). Samtliga nås på 08-555 030 00. Då anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585). Inför säkerhetsprövning efterfrågas vidimerade kopior på de utbildningar och tjänstgöringsintyg som är relevanta för tjänsten. FOI är en myndighet varmed inlämnade ansökningshandlingar blir allmän handling som på begäran kan lämnas ut till utomstående enligt offentlighets- och sekretesslagen. Erbjudanden från rekryteringsföretag undanbedes.

items.desc: Wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiterin bzw. wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) am Munich Center for Space Communications (Entgelt bis in die Entgeltgruppe 14 TVöD) Die Stelle ist zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Voll- oder in Teilzeit zu besetzen. Die Universität der Bundeswehr München ist in der nationalen wie auch internationalen Forschungslandschaft fest verankert. Als Campusuniversität mit sehr guter Grundausstattung bietet sie beste Voraussetzungen für hochqualitative Lehre und Forschung. In unserem Selbstverständnis verstehen wir uns als familienorientierte Einrichtung, die für Gleichstellung, Vielfalt und Chancengerechtigkeit steht. Das Munich Center for Space Communications (MCSC) am Lehrstuhl für Informationsverarbeitung betreibt eine der technisch leistungsfähigsten universitären Experimental-Satellitenbodenstationen Europas. Die Anlage umfasst mehrere nachgeführte Tracking-Antennensysteme für LEO-, MEO- und GEO-Satelliten, HF-Frontends vom UHF-Bereich über S-, X- und Ka-Band bis hin zu Q/V-Band, sowie eine optische Bodenstation für Freiraumlaserkommunikation. Diese Infrastruktur dient der experimentellen Analyse, Verifikation und Demonstration neuartiger Übertragungsverfahren in realen Weltraumkommunikationskanälen. Die ausgeschriebene Position verbindet wissenschaftliche Forschung im Bereich fortgeschrittener Signalverarbeitung und Satellitenkommunikation mit der technischen Weiterentwicklung und dem Betrieb dieser Infrastruktur. Eine Weiterqualifizierung zur Promotion wird angestrebt, ist jedoch keine zwingende Voraussetzung. Aufgaben Sie führen experimentelle Forschung durch, zur Charakterisierung und Nutzung höherer Frequenzbänder in der Satellitenkommunikation, z. B. Q/V-Band und darüber hinaus, einschließlich Untersuchung atmosphärischer und sonstiger Kanaleinflüsse. Sie entwickeln und bewerten neue Wellenformen, Modulations-, Codierungs- und Signalverarbeitungsverfahren unter realen Kanalbedingungen. Sie arbeiten an der Gewinnung, Analyse und Modellierung von Messdaten aus Echtzeit-Experimenten an der Bodenstation; Ableitung robuster Kanalmodelle. Sie sind zuständig für die Konzeption und Umsetzung von experimentellen Messkampagnen, einschließlich Multi-Orbit-Szenarien (LEO, MEO, GEO). Sie verfassen wissenschaftliche Publikationen und Beiträge für Konferenzen; Mitwirkung in Drittmittelprojekten und Forschungskonsortien. Sie sind verantwortlich für den Betrieb, die Überwachung und die Weiterentwicklung der Satellitenbodenstation, einschließlich HF-Subsysteme sowie benötigter Messgeräteausstattung. Sie arbeiten am Aufbau, der Integration und der Inbetriebnahme von experimentellen Komponenten für neue Frequenzbänder oder Messsysteme. Sie entwickeln Softwaretools (Python, MATLAB etc.) zur Automatisierung, Steuerung, Datenerfassung und Analyse. Sie betreiben die Fehlerdiagnose und die Wartung der technischen Systeme sowie Dokumentation der Infrastruktur. Fähigkeit zur strukturierten Fehleranalyse und zum Betrieb komplexer technischer Anlagen. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Det första av dessa perspektiv studerar vilken direkt eller indirekt
items.desc: Söker du en tjänst inom hälsa och sjukvård utöver det normala? Vill du använda dina färdigheter inom anatomi, fysiologi och medicin för att främja beredskap och stödja totalförsvaret? I så fall kanske FOI är din nästa arbetsgivare! Om tjänsten Ur ett medicinskt perspektiv studerar FOI människan från två perspektiv: vapenverkan och vårdbehov. Det första av dessa perspektiv studerar vilken direkt eller indirekt skadeverkan som åsamkas människor efter bekämpning med något vapensystem, såsom penetrativt och trubbigt våld eller tryckskador. Det andra perspektivet rör vilka vårdinsatser och vårdresurser som krävs för att omhänderta personer som åsamkats sådana skador. Den här tjänsten rör båda dessa perspektiv. FOI utför analyser om, förmedlar metodstöd för, och skapar matematiska modeller av vapenverkan och vårdbehov för såväl den civila som den militära sjukvårdens räkning. Den här tjänsten handlar om att bistå denna verksamhet. Den framgångsrika kandidaten förväntas göra detta på tre sätt: 1. Genom att bedriva forskning inom dessa områden. 2. Genom att bidra med sakkunskap till övriga på myndigheten som arbetar inom dessa områden. Samt 3. Genom att arbeta med att främja att resultat som presteras inom dessa områden nyttas på bästa sätt hos våra slutanvändare (företrädelsevis hälso- och sjukvårdsmyndigheter, regioner och försvarsmyndigheter). Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans i en kompetensintensiv miljö tillsammans med kollegor med företrädelsevis en naturvetenskapligt kvantitativ bakgrund, för att tillsammans möta de utmaningar som våra sjukvårdskedjor och -system kommer att ställas inför i händelse av krig och kris. Om enheterna Du kommer att ha hemvist på enheten för befolkningsskydd som tillhör avdelningen försvarsanalys i Kista. Befolkningsskydd är en tillväxtsenhet med inriktning på det civila försvaret och i synnerhet skydd av civilbefolkningen. Därutöver kommer du att stödja enheten för verkansvärdering på avdelningen för vapen skydd och säkerhet. Har du den kompetensprofil vi behöver? Krav Läkar- eller sjuksköterskelegitimation. Fördjupade kunskaper inom en för tjänsten relevant medicinsk disciplin, såsom traumatologi, anatomi eller fysiologi. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Som medicinsk forskare och sakexpert i ett team med en stark bas i modellering och kvantitativa analyser kommer tjänsten att ställa stora krav på vara självgående , att ha hög samarbetsförmåga , samt att pedagogiskt kunna kommunicera komplexa idéer. Vi ser även gärna att du är kreativ och har en problemlösande analytisk förmåga , vilket kommer att hjälpa dig att bidra forsknings- och utvecklingsarbetet som bedrivs på myndigheten. Meriterande Disputerat inom ett för tjänsten relevant område. Kunskaper inom matematisk modellering. Erfarenhet av programmering. Vana av att arbeta med kvantitativa data. Erfarenhet av prehospital sjukvård. Vad erbjuder vi dig? Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut (FOI) är en statlig myndighet som bedriver världsledande forskning inom försvar och säkerhet till stöd för Sveriges militära och civila försvar. Vi erbjuder en unik arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta med det som är viktigt för totalförsvaret och hela samhället. Forskningen tillämpas både inom försvarsmyndigheter och hos civila aktörer och spelar en avgörande roll i att bygga en relevant och effektiv försvarsförmåga. Vi arbetar medvetet för en god arbetsmiljö med en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Utöver detta erbjuder vi en rad förmåner. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss: https://www.foi.se/jobba-hos-oss.html Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Vill du vara med och söka svaren för en säkrare värld? Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV och personligt brev via ansökningsknappen senast den 18 oktober 2026! För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta enhetschef David Andersson. Fackliga företrädare är Monia Lougui (Saco-S) och Lisa Bergsten (OFR/S – ST). Samtliga nås på 08-555 030 00. Då anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585). GE Aerospace combines unrivalled strength in the Aviation domain with digital capability to provide business changing outcomes. Our Data Science projects include working with GE Commercial Engines to support all aspects of the engines business from in-service deployment, fleet monitoring and management to repairs, supply chain and financial operations. A typical Data Science project starts with a problem statement and dataset, and our job is to work alongside our internal GE customers to develop, test and deploy analytics which solve their problems or provide significant insights to improve to their business impact. We also develop custom in-house analytic tools which help us deliver our projects efficiently and effectively. Every project is different and gives the opportunity to learn something new. Every project is different and gives the opportunity to learn something new. Our Data Science projects vary from site to site, specific project details will be provided at the interview stage You will be guided by structured goals and objectives and will have responsibility to deliver on inspiring projects supported by your People Leader and team around you. We will guide you throughout the year to ensure you make the best of your GE Aerospace experience. Your People Leader will offer coaching and mentoring, and you will be provided with the opportunity to connect with other placement students across the UK. This opportunity is offered in our Eastleigh site. GE Aerospace, Eastleigh is a small, friendly office (c 65 employees) located in Chandlers Ford, within easy walking distance of local railway and bus links. With a deep history of developing and supplying condition monitoring technology and products to the aerospace sector, GE Aerospace Eastleigh combines unrivalled strength in the Aviation domain with digital capability to provide business changing outcomes. We are seeking highly motivated individuals to contribute to our digital future and have been successfully running internships since 2018. The site has opportunities in Data Science. We also develop custom in-house tools to help us deliver our projects efficiently and effectively. We support a wide range of customers both internal and external to GE. Every project is different and gives the opportunity to learn something new. This placement role is an intended pipeline for our Digital Technology Leadership Programme (DTLP) based in Cheltenham. Towards the end of the placement year, we will open graduate applications for our current placement students with an aim to secure a role prior to the end of their placement year. Meaning, you can head back into your final year at university with a graduate job offer in hand. All you need to do is secure a 2,1 degree or above! If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us! Job Summary Lumentum d.o.o. – Optična vlakna is looking for an early-career engineer to help develop new equipment for the automated manufacture of high-precision optical assemblies. The role combines mechanical and mechatronic design, precision positioning, sensing, software and process automation. You will design equipment, build and test prototypes, integrate hardware and develop the control sequences needed to turn a laboratory process into a reliable production capability. This is a hands-on engineering role with broad technical ownership. You will work closely with optical, process and manufacturing engineers while taking the equipment from initial concept through detailed design, integration and validation. Key Responsibilities Develop mechanical and mechatronic equipment for precision optical assembly. Create concepts, detailed CAD models, drawings and specifications for mechanisms, fixtures and machine assemblies. Select and integrate motion stages, actuators, cameras, sensors, optics and other equipment components. Design for positioning accuracy, repeatability, mechanical stability, accessibility and manufacturability. Develop automated sequences for component loading, positioning, alignment, processing and verification. Create software for equipment control, instrument communication, data collection and process reporting. Develop calibration methods and quantify system accuracy, drift, backlash and other sources of variation. Build, commission and troubleshoot prototypes, identifying whether problems originate in mechanics, controls, sensing, software or the process itself. Work with process engineers to translate laboratory requirements into practical equipment specifications. Support equipment validation and transfer into manufacturing. What We Are Looking For Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to apply them to real machines and hardware. Practical experience with CAD and an understanding of mechanisms, tolerances, materials and manufacturing methods. Interest or experience in automation, robotics, motion control, sensing or machine development. The ability to break a complex system into manageable functions, identify the main technical risks and test proposed solutions. Programming experience in Python, C++, C#, LabVIEW, PLC environments or a similar engineering platform. A hands-on approach to building, testing and improving equipment. Clear communication and the ability to work across mechanical engineering, software, optics and manufacturing. Suitable backgrounds include mechanical engineering, mechatronics, automation, robotics, electrical engineering, applied physics and related fields. We welcome exceptional graduates and early-career engineers. University projects, internships, technical competitions, previous employment and serious personal projects all count as relevant experience. Additional Experience We Value Experience with precision mechanics, optomechanical design, machine vision, active alignment, motion systems, laboratory equipment or production automation would be useful. Evidence of Technical Ability With your application, please include one example of a technically demanding system, machine or device that you designed, built, programmed or improved. It may come from your studies, previous employment, an internship, a competition or a personal project. Tell us what the problem was, what you personally contributed, the main engineering decisions you made and how you verified the result. Links to drawings, photographs, code, reports or test data are welcome. We will discuss this work with you during the technical interview. What You Can Expect From Us You will work on a core development problem with direct access to experienced engineers, laboratory equipment and manufacturing feedback. As your understanding grows, so will your ownership of the technology. We also offer a competitive compensation package, including base salary, performance bonus, equity participation and a broad range of employee benefits. items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As an Embedded Software Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to own the embedded software stack on the compute modules used across our platforms. You will take a new module from bare board to a maintained, securely booting Linux platform, covering the boot chain, kernel, drivers, and the verification around them. This is a high impact role that combines deep Linux and kernel work with hands on bring up on new hardware, taking a board from first power up through to flight. Responsibilities BSP and Reference Images: Build and maintain the BSP layer, device trees, and the reference images for each board, including custom layers and SDK generation, and carry them forward across kernel upgrades and silicon revisions. Boot Chain and Secure Boot: Own the boot chain, including bootloader porting, signed boot, verified rootfs, and A/B system update. Drivers and Low Level Interfaces: Develop and validate Linux device drivers across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI, including camera and sensor interfaces. Board Support on MCU Targets: Provide startup, clock, and peripheral support on the microcontrollers of boards the team designs. Board Bring Up and Hardware Validation: Lead software bring up on new hardware, take part in design reviews, and debug system level issues across the hardware and software boundary. Verification and Documentation: Define verification test plans and acceptance criteria, automate boot and peripheral test on real targets, and document each milestone. Cross Functional Collaboration: Work with the hardware team on new boards, and with Systems and Embedded Software Platform on interfaces and integration. items.desc: Digital Design Engineer – High-Speed Communications / ASIC Lausanne, Switzerland | UK options available CHF 120,000–130,000 + benefits What if the architecture wasn’t already decided before you joined? I’m recruiting Digital Design Engineers for a small advanced semiconductor R&D team exploring new approaches to high-speed communications silicon. This is not simply a role where you receive a finished specification and spend the next year implementing one RTL block. The team is working on new digital and mixed-signal architectures, with the freedom to question existing approaches, investigate new ideas and help turn the strongest concepts into production silicon. What you’ll work on You’ll contribute to the digital architecture and RTL development of advanced communications ICs, working closely with analog, architecture and wider design teams. The Work Can Include RTL design and microarchitecture High-speed digital design SerDes and high-speed interfaces Mixed-signal digital blocks Digital communications architectures Design exploration and architectural trade-offs Taking new concepts from R&D towards implementation in silicon The projects have a 2–4 year R&D horizon, so there is genuine room to investigate new approaches rather than simply following an existing standard or product roadmap. Who they’re looking for You’ll Likely Come From An ASIC / Digital IC Design Background With Strong RTL Experience And Exposure To At Least Some Of The Following High-speed digital design SerDes Mixed-signal ICs Communications silicon Advanced digital architectures You don’t need to tick every box. More important is that you enjoy solving problems where the answer isn’t already written in the specification. Why it’s interesting The team is deliberately small and collaborative. You’ll be working closely with experienced engineers, discussing ideas at architecture level, whiteboarding solutions and having considerably more influence over the direction of the design than you might get in a larger organisation. The objective is also very clear: this is exploratory engineering intended to become real silicon, not research that disappears into a presentation deck. The primary R&D team is based in Lausanne, with engineers typically onsite around three days per week. There is also some location flexibility for the digital positions, including opportunities in the UK. If you’re a Digital Design Engineer who enjoys asking “could we build this differently?”, I’d be very interested in speaking with you please contact Steph Hutchinson.

L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Laboratoire Interdisciplinaire des Sciences du Numérique Type de Contrat Chercheur en contrat CDD Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 91190 GIF SUR YVETTE Durée du contrat 6 mois Date d'Embauche 01/02/2027 Rémuneration Entre 3131,32 et 3569,85€ brut mensuel Postuler Date limite de candidature : samedi 7 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions Ce projet postdoctoral vise à faire avancer la compréhension de la variation socio-phonétique chez des communautés peu étudiées, ici les micro-travailleurs d’Amérique latine et du Brésil, en développant des méthodes hybrides intégrant des hypothèses linguistiques avec des approches d’apprentissage automatique supervisé et non supervisé. Le projet s’inscrit dans une initiative interdisciplinaire à l’intersection de la linguistique, de la sociologie du travail et des technologies de la parole, avec un accent sur les inégalités dans le travail numérique et leur lien avec les pratiques linguistiques. L’étude exploite un corpus unique d’environ 70 entretiens en espagnol latino-américain avec des micro-travailleurs interrogés par des sociologues dans plusieurs pays, ainsi que 50 enregistrements en portugais brésilien. Ce corpus est richement annoté avec des métadonnées sociodémographiques (sexe, pays, revenu, niveau d’éducation, etc.), ce qui est rare dans les corpus sociolinguistiques traditionnels, où les annotations se limitent généralement à des variables bien étudiées comme la région ou le genre. La multiplicité des variables sociodémographiques offre à la fois une opportunité et un défi : si elle permet des analyses plus approfondies, elle réduit également la taille effective des échantillons pour chaque sous-ensemble de variables, nécessitant des méthodes adaptées aux petits jeux de données. À ces données s’ajoutent des corpus comparables composés de données préexistantes en espagnol et en portugais (par exemple, les corpus sociolinguistiques publics comme PRESEEA (2014-) et les grands corpus disponibles au LISN via des projets antérieurs en technologies de la parole et en linguistique de corpus (Vasilescu et al. 2018, Vasilescu et al. 2020)). L’objectif principal est d’étudier les interactions entre les patrons de variation linguistiques ( de la phonétique acoustique au niveau sémantique) et les profils sociodémographiques, en allant au-delà des méthodes linguistiques quantitatives traditionnelles grâce à l’intégration d’approches d’apprentissage automatique supervisé et non supervisé. Job Description About GE Aerospace Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world! Digital Technology Be a part of an exciting data transformation journey within GE Aerospace. On our Digital Technology team, you’ll have a hand in designing, deploying, and maintaining technologies and systems to address the ever-changing needs of our customers and business. Roles And Responsibilities In the 12-month placement in Digital Technology (DT) you’ll gain hands-on experience in IT operations, project management, data analytics, and software development. You’ll work on exciting projects to improve business processes, support IT systems, and drive digital transformation. We have different types of roles in this area; here is a brief snapshot into each: Digital Technolog y (Cardiff) - you will play a key part in developing a Digital Toolset to drive productivity within the business functions. You will lead various projects utilising applications from the GE Toolset and new Analytics Tools. You will partner with these business functions to understand requirements and translate these into Operational Tools. Digital Technology (Caledonian) - Development of prototype local applications for SQDIP improvements. DT Technology and Operations Team (Cheltenham) - providing support for iPhone and iPad devices, including setup, upgrades, compliance, and issue resolution. You will manage requests for new network port installations, remote access, and GUEST WiFi changes, while assisting users with supply chain applications. Responsibilities also include managing a Raspberry Pi-based signage solution, covering procurement, build, and configuration of devices. Project activities may involve supporting application deployments and upgrades, as well as managing small-scale equipment deployments and installations. Digital Technology ( Dowty) - improving how the business uses data and digital technologies to drive better decisions and performance. You will help enhance data maturity by improving data quality, structure, standardization, governance, and accessibility, and work with business and digital teams to understand reporting needs and develop dashboards and visualizations for key metrics. The position involves gathering, cleaning, validating, and analyzing data to support operational and strategic decisions, while identifying opportunities where AI can create business value and building clear business cases for adoption. You will research digital and AI trends and best practices, help evaluate AI use cases for impact, feasibility, risks, and data readiness, and lead or coordinate a digital technology project from scope definition through milestone tracking and stakeholder communication. In addition, you will support cross-functional collaboration to ensure solutions align with user needs, prepare presentations and updates for reviews, and contribute to process improvements that enhance efficiency, visibility, and decision-making. Cyber Security (Cheltenham) - you will work across five key cyber security areas: Intelligence, Enterprise Vulnerability Management, Insider Threat, External Threat, and Digital Forensics. The student will spend two months in each area, gaining an understanding of daily operations by working with key staff and delivering a small project to showcase what they have learned. In the final two months, the student can choose one of these areas to focus on. Throughout the placement, they will receive training and hands-on experience with cyber tools used by the UK Cyber Team, explore topics aligned to their course such as malware analysis and networking, and have opportunities to participate in Cyber Capture the Flag events during the year. Vi jobber aktivt med AI-assistert utvikling, kodegenerering, agentbaserte løsninger og bruk av LLM-er i både nye og eksisterende systemer. Hos Accelerate kombinerer vi fordelene ved et mindre selskap med tryggheten og mulighetene som følger av å være en del av det nordiske IT-konsernet Iver. items.desc: Introduction In order to make an application, simply read through the following job description and make sure to attach relevant documents. Saab UK is part of Scandinavia's largest defence company, bringing together the best of Swedish and British innovation. Saab offers world-leading solutions and services in defence, aviation, space, and civil security to keep people and society safe. Our UK presence has been growing at pace, meaning we can offer a wide range of opportunities for personal fulfilment and career growth. We currently employ over 600 people across eight sites in the UK, and our specialisations include software engineering, underwater robotics, radars, AI, and armed forces training. The Role This role is part of Saab Bluebear Business in Bedfordshire. It will be reporting into the Head of Digital Systems Engineering. In this exciting, dynamic role you will support a mixture of R&D and product development activities within a leading autonomy and unmanned systems company. Blue Bear continuously innovates within the core area of Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS/UAV) such as flight management systems, autopilots, mission systems, ground control stations, and all supporting systems and infrastructure. Your role as a Flight Control Systems Engineer will involve developing, maintaining and testing safety critical software that contribute to the flight systems of our aircraft. You will contribute to requirements definition, and use MATLAB/Simulink tools to generate software such as novel flight control laws and data manipulation algorithms. After verification and validation performed using bespoke simulations, you will then be expected deploy the software on to the target hardware, and conduct real world flight testing at our test facility less than 1km from the office. You may be asked to present the findings of the testing in reports or customer facing presentations. As well as undertaking technical tasks, you will be expected to take an active role in the team. This will include contribution to the development of standard operating processes, continuous improvement of methods and techniques, and ensuring quality targets are satisfied. Working as part of a team in a multidisciplinary environment you will have good communication skills. A can-do attitude and a genuine passion for innovative technology. The opportunity will enable the successful candidate to gain knowledge of cutting-edge autonomous systems and offer a large scope for career development. Essential Qualifications & Skills: Degree in aerospace engineering or similar. Understanding of aerodynamics and flight mechanics, and their impact on flight control. Experience in using MATLAB/Simulink for developing algorithms and control laws. Hands-on experience in designing and commissioning control systems. Existing SC Clearance. Desirable Experience designing and implementing guidance, navigation and control algorithms for fixed and/or rotary wing vehicles. Knowledge of state-of-the-art for sensing systems. Hands-on experience with small UAS. Mathworks' Stateflow, Simulink Coder and Embedded Coder packages. Experience developing mathematical algorithms e.g. Data fusion, state estimation etc. Experience working with embedded systems, real-time systems, safety critical systems. Knowledge of communication systems. Version control systems e.g. git. C++, Java, Python development skills. Experience with quality standards for software (e.g. DO-178, ED-20x). As a National Security Vetting clearance is required for this role, applicants will be required to hold National Security Vetting clearance to SC level or have the ability to gain it. By submitting an application to Saab UK you consent to undertaking workforce screening activities that may include but are not limited to: Baseline Personnel Security checks, National Security Vetting, reference checks, verification of working rights and in all circumstances preferred candidates will be placed through a security interview

items.title: Software Verification Engineer
items.card: You will work closely with software and hardware engineers to compare implementation outputs against trusted reference models, investigate numerical discrepancies, and improve the robustness of verification processes across the development lifecycle. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer with strong C++ programming skills, a background in mathematical modelling or digital signal processing, and a passion
items.desc: Software Verification Engineer Location: Delft, Netherlands | Hybrid – 2 days per week on-site Salary: Up to €90,000 per annum (Visa sponsorship is offered for candidates who are already based in the Netherlands) We are looking for a Software Verification & Modelling Engineer to join an innovative deep-tech engineering team developing advanced technology at the intersection of software, signal processing and hardware. This role will focus on developing and validating software models, building automated verification frameworks, and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of complex algorithms and software implementations. You will work closely with software and hardware engineers to compare implementation outputs against trusted reference models, investigate numerical discrepancies, and improve the robustness of verification processes across the development lifecycle. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer with strong C++ programming skills, a background in mathematical modelling or digital signal processing, and a passion for software quality, numerical accuracy and automated testing. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain and debug software verification frameworks using C++ and Python. Build and validate mathematical and behavioural reference models to verify software implementations. Perform golden-reference comparisons and numerical error analysis to identify discrepancies and ensure implementation accuracy. Design and maintain automated testing frameworks and continuous integration (CI) regression tests. Analyse algorithm behaviour, numerical precision and error propagation across complex processing chains. Investigate fixed-point arithmetic, quantisation effects and numerical accuracy where applicable. Develop reference models using Python libraries such as NumPy and SciPy, or MATLAB/Simulink. Implement testing strategies incorporating property-based testing, randomised test cases and automated regression analysis. Collaborate with software, FPGA and hardware engineers to validate models and investigate system-level issues. Contribute to the development of reliable, maintainable and scalable verification processes. Requirements Strong C++ programming and debugging skills. Professional experience in software testing, verification or test automation. A solid understanding of digital signal processing (DSP), mathematical modelling or numerical methods. Experience with reference models, numerical comparisons, algorithm validation or numerical error analysis. Proficiency in Python for verification, testing or automation. Experience developing or maintaining automated tests and CI regression pipelines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues. A relevant degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics or a related technical discipline. Desirable Experience Developing reference models using MATLAB/Simulink, NumPy or SciPy. Fixed-point arithmetic, quantisation analysis and numerical precision. Stateful DSP processing chains, including numerically controlled oscillators (NCOs), mixers and filters. Property-based testing and randomised verification techniques. FPGA or ASIC verification and digital hardware development. Hardware/software co-simulation, SystemC or cycle-accurate modelling. Validating software models against measurements from physical hardware.

items.desc: Our Capability Development team develops bespoke software for our clients in the Cyber Security domain. We may be building assured software that prioritises engineering rigour and reliability, rapid cyber solutions that stitch together tooling for high‑impact results, or blended operational systems that address real-world challenges in the field. Common to all is commitment to technically led decisions, to meaningful technical challenge, and to engaging career paths where your work makes it off the shelf and into the hands of our customers. All of our roles demand strong technical expertise, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering robust, dependable solutions that our clients can rely on when it matters most. Across our projects, we work on a variety of platforms; typically iOS, Android, and Linux, with opportunities on embedded systems and other specialised platforms. Our bread and butter is C, C++, and Java, but we're comfortable in Python, Rust, and JavaScript. We emphasise having a comprehensive understanding of the programming languages, platforms, and tooling we rely on. That deep technical knowledge has helped us earn a reputation for writing novel, robust, and maintainable solutions to our client's challenging and fascinating problems and we regularly see the direct impact of our work. We're led by engineers and empowered to optimise our (lightweight!) development processes with the knowledge gained from each project. We are looking for a candidate who holds an active Developed Vetting security clearance to join our team. Key Responsibilities Designing a new clean-slate product with complete autonomy over its architecture. Adding new capabilities to, or replacing a core component of, an existing product. Throwing together a quick-and-dirty prototype to confirm the feasibility of a proposed technical approach; iterating until it meets requirements. For this role you'll be hands-on in the day-to-day delivery of projects. Typically, this will see you working with one or two other colleagues at a time. In addition, you'll take an active role in unlocking the potential of junior colleagues: encouraging idiomatic code, demonstrating engineering rigour, and sharing hard-won knowledge with your peers. You’ll also help drive our engineering processes to maintain code quality while balancing realistic delivery timescales and client requirements. Desirable Skills Professional experience in the design and implementation of complex projects, ideally both clean-slate projects and updates to legacy code bases. Comfortable with platform APIs, development environments and native debugging approaches. Experience leading a team of developers through a complete project lifecycle, engaging in requirements capture, design review, implementation, and assurance. Commitment to code correctness and quality assurance through static analysis, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration. This vacancy is for experienced software engineers and will require skills and experience in several of the areas listed as well as the ability to lead technical projects. Work Benefits Promotions are based on technical excellence and reviewed regularly. 25 days holiday per year (with bank holidays on top), option to buy up to 5 days per year. Level up with an extra day of holiday per year, up to an extra 5 days, starting from 2 years' service. We offer financial support to cover HMRC allowable costs of relocating if you’re moving to the area. Training and development opportunities to support your career aspirations O'Reilly books subscription which provides access to huge range of technical books Regular events including internal technical conferences, company socials and pizza-fuelled lunchtime seminars. Free seasonal fruit, tea, coffee, milk, squash and hot chocolate. Health Benefits - Private Medical Including Access To Private online GP, and a helpline to speak with various healthcare professionals. Physiotherapists, osteopaths or chiropractors for muscle, bone, and joint pain. Mental health - counselling, and specialist consultations and treatment with psychologists and cognitive behavioural therapists. Annual Health assessment. Financial Benefits A company bonus scheme so that everybody is rewarded for company success. This is an annual award that is based on the company hitting its targeted forecast. We have achieved this every year to date. 8% company contribution to pension with no minimum requirement for employee contribution. Death in Service cover of 4x base salary. Lifestyle Benefits Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption leave: 12 weeks maternity leave at full pay as soon as you join, further enhanced to 20 weeks full pay from 2 years’ service. 2 weeks paternity leave at full pay as soon as you join, further enhanced to 4 weeks full pay from 2 years’ service. Enhanced cycle-to-work scheme including the ability to purchase a bike over £1,000 (e-bikes, specialist cycles and trikes allowed). …

items.desc: Wir entwickeln bei AI CORN die Steuerungseinheit für die Digitale Automatische Kupplung (DAK). Das System verändert den europäischen Güterverkehr und läuft schon im echten Betrieb. Dafür suchen wir eine:n Softwareentwickler:in, die/der das Produkt von Embedded bis Cloud weiterentwickelt und mit uns skaliert. Aufgaben In a Nutshell: Du baust die Software, die mit der Bahn durch die Gegend fährt. Vom Sensor im Fahrzeug bis zum Datenstrom im Backend. Wir suchen jemanden, der: Embedded Linux und Cloud zusammen denkt, nicht nur einen der zwei Layer beherrscht Schnittstellen sauber implementiert (TRDP, MQTT, REST) und auch real beim Kunden zum Laufen bringt Bugs nicht eskaliert, sondern in Logs und Code reingeht, bis sie verstanden sind Verantwortung für das Gesamtsystem übernimmt, nicht nur für „seinen Task" in Datenflüssen denkt, nicht in Tickets Und etwas ausführlicher. Du arbeitest an: Fahrzeugintegration & Embedded Linux: Softwarekomponenten auf Embedded-Plattformen (Linux-basiert) für Datenaufnahme, Verarbeitung und Weiterleitung Backend & Datenverarbeitung: Verarbeitung, Speicherung und Visualisierung von Betriebsdaten für Statistik, Diagnose und Monitoring Schnittstellen & Standards: Implementierung und Test gegen TRDP, MQTT, REST. Anpassung an Fahrzeug- und Kundenumgebung. Softwaretests & Qualität: automatisierte Tests, Debugging, CI/CD, Container und virtuelle Test-Umgebungen, Versionskontrolle. Stabilität ist Standard, nicht Ausnahme. Hardware-Schulterschluss: enge Zusammenarbeit mit Hardware-Entwicklern und externen Partnern, vom Sensor bis zur Cloud Anleitung & Mentoring: du strukturierst Arbeitspakete für Werkstudent:innen und Praktikant:innen und entwickelst sie fachlich weiter Softwareprojekt-Lead (je nach Erfahrung): Planung, Aufwandsschätzung und technische Verantwortung für Software-Teilprojekte, von Anforderung bis Rollout Qualifikation Das passt zu dir, wenn: ✅ Du in Python produktiven Code schreiben kannst und in C/C++ tief genug bist, um auf Embedded-Layer-Bugs einzusteigen ✅ Du Embedded Linux, Datenbanken und Backend-Technologien (z. B. Flask oder Node.js, dazu MQTT, REST) zusammenführen kannst. Full-Stack vom Sensor bis in die Cloud. ✅ Du schon Verantwortung für ein Software-Stück bis in den Produktivbetrieb übernommen hast, nicht nur Features rausgeschoben ✅ Du Probleme nicht eskalierst, sondern löst. Auch wenn du dich erst reindenken musst. ✅ Du beim Kunden vor Ort genauso souverän bist wie im technischen Deep Dive ✅ Du Entscheidungen triffst, auch wenn nicht alle Informationen da sind, und sie bei neuen Erkenntnissen anpasst ✅ Du kleinere Teams oder Werkstudent:innen anleiten kannst und Lust hast, andere fachlich weiterzuentwickeln ✅ Bonus , aber kein Muss: Containerisierung und Virtualisierung (Docker, KVM, leichte Hypervisor-Erfahrung), Fahrzeugprotokolle (TRDP, CAN), Echtzeitdaten, Performance-Optimierung. Tech-Lead-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, perspektivisch besetzen wir die Lead-Rolle nach. ✅ Formales: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Informationstechnik, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbare Ausbildung. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch ab B2. Wohnsitz Karlsruhe oder Umzugsbereitschaft. Die Stelle ist hands-on und nicht vollständig remote. Benefits 📍 Performance Bonus 📍 Echtes Produkt, echte Kunden, echter Betrieb. Kein Proof-of-Concept. 📍 Direkter Zugang zu Fahrzeugen, Werkstätten und Kundenprojekten 📍 Schnelle Entscheidungen, wenig Bürokratie 📍 Setup steht: Kunden, erfahrenes Entwicklerteam, starker Experten-Support aus dem Codewerk-Netzwerk AI CORN entwickelt Steuerungssysteme und Cloud-Lösungen für den Schienenverkehr. Herzstück ist die Steuerungseinheit der Digitalen Automatischen Kupplung (DAK). Wir sind eine Ausgründung aus der Codewerk GmbH und verbinden Start-up-Tempo mit über zehn Jahren Erfahrung aus 150+ Bahnprojekten. Wenn du Lust hast, Software zu bauen, die wirklich fährt: Verantwortung statt Tickets, Code statt Folien. Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Bitte häng passende Zeugnisse (Arbeit, Studium, Ausbildung, höchster Schulabschluss) an.

items.desc: The group you’ll be a part of In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry. The impact you’ll make As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomic precision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your role involves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware to meet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements to ensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial role our customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductor breakthroughs. What You’ll Do Responsible for performing professional process engineering research, development and evaluation in semiconductor environment Reviews processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture, fabrication and evaluation of products including in-house lab demonstrations Conceives and plans projects involving definition and selection of new concepts and approaches Works with customer and senior engineers cross functionally to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements and business issues/ challenges. Acts as customer technology manager in the planning, data collection, analysis and reporting Acts as single point of contact accountable for process related customer requests Drives introduction and evaluation of new technologies at customer sites including new tool qualification Other Job Responsibilities Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements Works with cross-functional teams to get information and results needed Flexibility to travel to meet business requirements ( Who We’re Looking For MSc in in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering or Physics with with no previous professional experience; or equivalent experience preferably in the field of wet clean/advanced packaging Familiarity with working in a chemical laboratory, having experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques In-depth understanding and experience in Statistical Process Control (SPC) and Design of Experiments (DOE) Excellent social skills with ability to work within diverse teams Creative thinking and strong problem-solving capabilities, able to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment with competing priorities Excellent oral and written communication skills and presentation skills in English What We're Offering This position is subject to the Austrian Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) for Employees in the Metal Technology Industry in the occupation group F depending on educational background. A higher payment is negotiable depending on education, expertise and skills. The monthly salary is paid 14 times per year. items.title: Air Combat Simulation Engineer
items.card: The Role This role is part of Saab BlueBear in Bedfordshire. You will work as part of the Air Combat Simulation team supporting customers in the modelling and simulation of aircraft and associated systems, including the development and V&V of models and analysis tools. Key Responsibilities Work collaboratively as an integral part of a small team delivering a customer focused task-based modelling and simulation
items.desc: Introduction Have you got what it takes to succeed The following information should be read carefully by all candidates. Saab UK is part of Scandinavia's largest defence company, bringing together the best of Swedish and British innovation. Saab offers world-leading solutions and services in defence, aviation, space, and civil security to keep people and society safe. Our UK presence has been growing at pace, meaning we can offer a wide range of opportunities for personal fulfilment and career growth. We currently employ over 600 people across eight sites in the UK, and our specialisations include software engineering, underwater robotics, radars, AI, and armed forces training. The Role This role is part of Saab BlueBear in Bedfordshire. You will work as part of the Air Combat Simulation team supporting customers in the modelling and simulation of aircraft and associated systems, including the development and V&V of models and analysis tools. Key Responsibilities Work collaboratively as an integral part of a small team delivering a customer focused task-based modelling and simulation support service. Develop Requirements from initial customer brief. Build models and analysis tools to meet the customer requirements. Update, debug and V&V of models and simulation tools. Analyse results from model integration and simulation development to provide understanding of the component models performance and their interactions. Develop and maintain tools for the translation of data files between formats in use within the community. Develop Simulink models of aircraft and aerospace systems and auto-code to C/C++ and dll. Integrate Models (Simulink and dll) into System-of-Systems models. Undertake simulation development, testing and application with results analysis to provide understanding of component models and their interactions. Develop and test models for integration into Distributed Simulations. Extend the Distributed Simulation capabilities and functionality. Sanity checking model performance and simulation results through cross-checking with other sources of information and engineering estimates. Validation and Verification of model performance and simulation results against requirements. Review documentation for accurate technical content and quality to ensure it meets the required high standards. Investigate modelling and simulation tools to support new customer requirements. Generate documentation (User Guides, Interface Control Documents, Delivery Notes, Verification and Validation reports) for models, simulations and applications developed by the team at an appropriate level for the expected end user's technical ability. Report on technical issues encountered with 3rd party provided models and simulations covering the issues, significance and potential resolutions. Qualifications And Skills Degree Educated - Engineering degree in relevant subject. Matlab and Simulink (and Stateflow), Auto-coding to C/C++ and DLL Programming languages (Preferably C++, C#, Delphi) Flight Dynamics and aircraft performance modelling Pilot modelling Modelling of Sensors and Signatures (RF and EO/IR) Knowledge of Earth coordinate systems (Flat, spherical, WGS-84) Distributed Simulation (DIS, HLA) & Source Control (Git) Solving optimisation problems. Model integration into e.g. system-of-systems models and distributed simulations Dealing With Aerospace Vehicle And System Models Including Flight performance multiple degree-of-freedom (3+) equations of motion transformations between multiple frames of reference using Euler angle and quaternions Sensors and signatures Solving optimisation problems Investigate, Understand And Resolve Problems With Simulink model development Model integration into e.g. system-of-systems models and distributed simulations As a National Security Vetting clearance is required for this role, applicants will be required to hold National Security Vetting clearance to SC level, or have the ability to gain it. By submitting an application to Saab UK you consent to undertaking workforce screening activities that may include but are not limited to: Baseline Personnel Security checks, National Security Vetting, reference checks, verification of working rights and in all circumstances preferred candidates will be placed through a security interview
