items.desc: In Capgemini Engineering , leader mondiale nei servizi di ingegneria, uniamo un team globale di talenti dell’ingegneria, scienza e tecnologia per aiutare le aziende più innovative del mondo a liberare il loro potenziale. Dai veicoli autonomi ai robot salva-vita, le nostre persone esperte in tecnologia digitale e software pensano fuori dagli schemi, offrendo servizi unici di ricerca e sviluppo e ingegneria in tutti i settori. Unisciti a noi per una carriera ricca di opportunità, dove potrai fare la differenza, in un ambiente in cui ogni giorno è unico. IL TUO RUOLO Come Software Model-Based Desing Engineer presso Capgemini Engineering ti occuperai di modellazione, simulazione, validazione e generazione automatica del codice per sistemi di controllo. In questo ruolo sarai un elemento chiave nelle seguenti attività : Creazione e manutenzione di modelli MATLAB/Simulink e logiche di controllo tramite Stateflow. Applicazione di principi di model-based design e model-based definition per la definizione funzionale del software. Generazione automatica del codice con Embedded Coder e Simulink Coder. LE TUE CARATTERISTICHE Laurea in Ingegneria (Elettronica, Meccatronica, Telecomunicazioni, Informatica o affini). Ottima conoscenza di MathWorks MATLAB e Simulink, Stateflow e del linguaggio C. Esperienza con Embedded Coder / Simulink Coder per generazione automatica di codice. Competenza in Fixed-Point Designer e modellazione per sistemi embedded. Esperienza con MIL testing e validazione di funzioni di controllo. Conoscenza delle best practice MBD e dei flussi di integrazione software. Padronanza della lingua italiana e dell’inglese (documentazione tecnica, review, presentazioni). PERCHÉ TI PIACERÀ LAVORARE CON NOI Riconosciamo l’importanza di soluzioni di lavoro flessibili per offrirti supporto. Che si tratti di lavoro da remoto, orari flessibili o entrambi, troverai un ambiente che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita privata e vita lavorativa; Al centro della nostra missione c'è la tua carriera, attraverso percorsi di crescita professionale pensati per supportarti nell'esplorare un mondo di opportunità; Ci impegniamo a promuovere la responsabilità sociale creando un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, dove talenti diversi sono valorizzati. La diversità è un pilastro della nostra cultura aziendale, arricchendo il nostro lavoro attraverso esperienze, culture, etnie, stili di comunicazione e comportamenti. Avrai l’opportunità di sviluppare software embedded per sistemi ad alta complessità tecnologica, lavorando su tecnologie come C/C++, CUDA, Model-Based Design e Qt in contesti innovativi e sfidanti. Potrai confrontarti con sistemi real-time, architetture avanzate e soluzioni ad alte prestazioni, sperimentare nuovi strumenti e metodologie di sviluppo e accedere a percorsi di certificazione dedicati che ti permetteranno di crescere rapidamente come professionista, dalla specializzazione tecnica fino a possibili evoluzioni verso ruoli di Tech Lead, Software Architect o System Architect. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team bringst du Data-Science, Data-Engineering und Cloud Know-How zusammen um End-To-End Datenlösungen für unsere Kunden zu bauen die wirklich auf die Straße kommen und nicht in der Schublade enden. Aufgabenbereiche Bei uns sind die Aufgabenbereiche breit gestreut und wir haben kein festes Rollenbild, darum bewirb dich einfach und wir schauen gemeinsam welches Portfolio am besten zu dir und deinen Stärken passt. Azure Cloud Entwicklung Beratung Python Entwicklung Data Pipelines / Data-Engineering API-Entwicklung Databricks / Fabric Qualifikation Qualifikationen Wir sind flexibel was Hardskills angeht und suchen vor allem talentierte und wissbegierige Menschen, die dazu noch kommunikationsstark sind. Ein großer Bonus ist wenn du bereits nachweisbare Erfahrung in folgenden Bereichen hast: Enterprise Python Entwicklung REST-APIs Azure Cloud Confluent / Kafka Databricks Data-Science / KI Use-Cases Benefits Wir sind ein kleines und familiäres Unternehmen mit 15 Mitarbeitern. Das besteht aus einem Geschäftsführer, einem Vertriebler und einem Assistenten. Der Rest sind Techies. Bei uns wirst du sehr eigenverantwortlich Themen Vorantreiben. Die Geschäftsführung ist vor allem Sparringspartner, der dir den Rücken Freihält und dich coached. Wir legen viel Wert auf Servant-Leadership und eigenbestimmtes Handeln und Arbeiten. Dadurch finden sich bei uns vor allem Kollegen wieder, die eigenständig kreative Lösungen finden und ausarbeiten können. Bewerbungsprozess 1. Erstes Interview mit Geschäftsführung um dir zu zeigen, was dich bei Ailio hinter den Kulissen erwartet & sicherzustellen, dass du gut ins Team passen würdest 2. Probeaufgabe ( Scope etwa 2-4 Stunden ) 3. Tech Interview Feedback gibts spätestens 24 Stunden nach Tech Interview, theoretisch kann der Prozess in 3-4 Tagen durch sein, wenn du die Probeaufgabe zügig erledigst.

items.desc: Job Description About Altium Altium is transforming the way electronics are designed and built. Our cloud platform, Altium 365, enables distributed teams to collaborate seamlessly across the entire electronics development lifecycle - from design to manufacturing. By connecting people, processes, and data, Altium 365 helps teams move faster, reduce errors, and deliver high-quality hardware products at scale. We are looking for a UX Researcher to shape end-to-end experiences across Altium 365. You'll be the person who keeps our product decisions connected to real users. You'll run the conversations, test the ideas before we build them, and make sure everything we learn stays findable instead of getting lost in old Slack threads and someone's notebook. You'll work closely with designers, PMs, and engineers throughout the whole cycle, from early problem framing to post-launch validation. This is a hands-on role with a lot of autonomy. You'll own the research practice rather than execute someone else's plan. What You'll Do Talk to users, regularly Own the participant pipeline: recruiting, screening, scheduling, incentives, consent Run interviews, contextual inquiries, diary studies, and surveys Build a steady cadence of user contact so the team is never more than a couple of weeks from fresh input Validate ideas and prototypes Partner with designers and PMs to turn open questions into research questions Run usability tests and concept tests on wireframes, prototypes, and live features Choose the right method for the decision at hand, including quick, scrappy studies when speed matters more than rigor Deliver findings that clearly state what to change and what the trade-offs are Build and maintain the insights repository Set up and curate a searchable database of findings, tagged by product area, user segment, and theme Connect new findings to old ones so patterns surface over time Make it genuinely usable for the rest of the team, not just an archive Track which insights led to which decisions, and revisit assumptions that haven't held up Raise the team's research literacy Coach designers and PMs to run their own lightweight studies well Share findings in formats people actually read and watch: short readouts, highlight reels, workshops Push back when a decision is being made on opinion where evidence is available or cheap to get Qualifications What we're looking for 3+ years in UX/product research, or a closely adjacent role with substantial hands-on research work Solid command of qualitative methods, plus enough quantitative literacy to design a survey and interpret product analytics Experience testing prototypes at different fidelities and knowing what each stage can and can't tell you Clear communication: you can make findings land with a skeptical stakeholder in five minutes Comfort working in ambiguity and scoping research to fit real timelines Familiarity with research ops tooling (Dovetail, Condens, Maze, UserTesting, or similar) English at a professional level Nice to have Experience setting up an insights repository from scratch Background in our domain: Engineering, PCB design or other complex domain Basic familiarity with Figma and design workflows Additional Information Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development. From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

items.desc: What We Do At Blykalla Blykalla is developing the next generation of nuclear technology with our Small Modular Reactor (SMR) based on innovative fuel, materials, and reactor designs. As Sweden’s only SMR developer, we are on a mission to decarbonize industries and enable safe, scalable, and sustainable energy solutions. Our technology uses uranium nitride fuel and lead coolant, creating novel challenges and opportunities for the fuel cycle and supporting systems. What You’ll Get To Do We are seeking a dynamic Materials Engineer with powder expertise to join our Materials team. This role is pivotal in advancing our materials knowhow, focusing on the development, qualification, and industrialization of powder materials and additive manufacturing crucial for our SMR technology. Key Responsibilities: Materials Expertise and Advancement: Drive the transition of new powder materials from concept to industry, navigating challenges from lab to application. Harness deep knowledge in alloying concepts, powder steel production processes, and additive material processes such as 3d printing and HIP, to guide material qualification and industrialization. Strategic Qualification Planning and Execution: You will spearhead the strategic planning and meticulous execution of technical material qualifications in collaboration with our suppliers and partners. Your leadership in this area will ensure that our material development efforts are not only innovative but also compliant and tailored to meet the exacting demands of our projects. Regulatory Compliance: Apply an in-depth understanding of nuclear industry regulations to the material qualification process, ensuring compliance and translating regulatory requirements into actionable company-specific steps. Collaborative Cost Management: Work closely with the supply Chain team to maintain a Design-to-Cost approach throughout development and industrialization, balancing cost efficiency and quality assurance. Stakeholder Engagement: Provide regular updates to the Team Manager and other projects you are involved in, on progress, challenges, and any issues, ensuring transparent communication and stakeholder involvement. Who You Are You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personal chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help in order for you to succeed in this role, these are: Functional Experience: Proven track record in technical project management, material engineering, or production quality, preferably within highly regulated industries such as nuclear, automotive, aviation, or space. Experience within the steel industry preferably in product development and industrialization. Qualifications: Engineering degree with specialization relevant to material science. Background in advanced steel alloys, corrosion, testing, welding and additive manufacturing. Experience in the steel industry working closely with suppliers on material development and a practical understanding of material qualification processes. Fluency in Swedish and English, spoken and written. Location This position is for our office in Stockholm. We do not offer any relocation support for this role. So, what do you think? Don't miss the chance to be at the forefront of revolutionizing nuclear power. Join our team and help shape the energy landscape of tomorrow. Apply today with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and achievements. We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about power supply!

items.desc: Die Freigabe in kerntechnischen Anlagen entscheidet darüber, wann Stoffe, bewegliche Gegenstände aber auch ganze Gebäude oder Bodenflächen aus der atom- und strahlenschutzrechtlichen Überwachung entlassen und damit auf konventionellem Weg wiederverwendet, entsorgt oder recycelt werden können. Das ist ein wichtiger Prozess, um unsere Sanierungs- aber auch Rückbau- und Neubauprojekte in der Praxis voranzubringen und dabei das Volumen radioaktiver Abfälle für das Endlager so gering wie möglich zu halten. Somit ist die Freigabe nach innen und außen ein wichtiges Bindeglied, um unsere Unternehmensziele zu erreichen. Das Team Freigabeverfahren übernimmt die verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe, eine effiziente und trotzdem sichere und gesetzeskonforme Freigabestrategie für die einzelnen Projekte zu entwickeln und deren Umsetzung zu planen und durchzuführen. Die Kerntechnische Entsorgung Karlsruhe GmbH (KTE) übernimmt Aufgaben von nationaler Bedeutung: Den sicheren Rückbau der stillgelegten kerntechnischen Anlagen am Standort Karlsruhe. Mit rund 700 Mitarbeitenden schaffen wir eine sichere Zukunft. Unser Fundament sind dabei das Know-how, der hohe Sicherheitsanspruch und der starke Zusammenhalt unserer Teams. Die Vergütung der ausgeschriebenen Position richtet sich nach den für uns einschlägigen Tarifverträgen der chemischen Industrie Baden-Württemberg. Die Stelle ist nach dem Bundesentgelttarifvertrag der chemischen Industrie Baden-Württemberg in einer Spanne zwischen den Entgeltgruppen E 9 T - E 11 T eingeordnet. Aufgaben Sie erstellen in enger Abstimmung mit den internen Nahtstellen komplexe und wissenschaftlich fundierte Konzepte zur Ermittlung spezifischer Nuklidverhältnisse unter Berücksichtigung der messtechnischen Anforderungen für unsere vielfältigen Freigabeprojekte. Sie entwickeln standhafte Konzepte zur repräsentativen Probenahme und dokumentieren diese sowie deren Messergebnis-Bewertung in methodischer und wissenschaftlicher Arbeitsweise zum Zweck der Nuklidverhältnisermittlung im Rahmen der Freigabe. Sie planen die Konzepte so, dass diese möglichst wenig Einfluss auf den Fortschritt des Rückbaus bzw. auf den Anlagenbetrieb haben und auf die örtlichen sowie radiologischen Besonderheiten der jeweiligen Anlage abgestimmt sind. Sie vertreten die Plausibilität Ihrer Konzepte in Fachgesprächen mit den Behörden und Sachverständigen und organisieren die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Messlaboren. Sie erstellen plausible und aussagekräftige Berichte und entwickeln übergreifende Standards und Mindestanforderungen an die Erstellung von Nuklidvektoren im Rahmen der Freigabe. Gemeinsam mit den internen Nahtstellen sorgen Sie für einen sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelnden anlagenübergreifenden Wissenstransfer. Sie entwickeln statistische Modelle und Unsicherheitsbetrachtungen in Bezug auf die Freigabe in der KTE und überführen diese in Regelwerke. Profil Sie haben einen Hochschulabschluss in einer naturwissenschaftlichen Fachrichtung mit Vertiefung im kerntechnischen Bereich (z.B. Kernphysik, Radiochemie). Sie konnten bereits Erfahrung im Strahlenschutz einer kerntechnischen Anlage sammeln und bringen im Idealfall bereits fundierte Kenntnisse in der Freigabe mit. Sie sind sehr gewissenhaft, sind es gewohnt wissenschaftlich zu arbeiten und entsprechende statistische Methoden sowie mathematische Gesetzmäßigkeiten in Ihre Arbeit einzubeziehen und zu dokumentieren. Sie agieren souverän und selbstbewusst in fachlichen Diskussionen und können Ihren fachlichen Standpunkt vertreten und durchsetzen. In der Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern (m/w/d) besitzen Sie diplomatisches Geschick und können so zwischen den Anforderungen unserer Anlagenverantwortlichen (m/w/d) und der Vertreter (m/w/d) der Aufsichtsbehörden vermitteln. Sie verfügen über Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf C1-Niveau und sind ausdrucksstark im Gesprochenem sowie im Geschriebenen Die arbeitsmedizinische Eignung für Tätigkeiten in Strahlenschutzkontrollbereichen setzen wir voraus. Wir bieten Auf Vollzeitbasis ergibt sich daraus derzeit ein voraussichtliches Bruttojahresentgelt, das zwischen ca. 57.295 EUR bis 87.585 EUR liegt. Dieser Betrag umfasst 12 tarifliche Monatsentgelte sowie die tarifliche Jahresleistung und das tarifliche Urlaubsgeld. Die konkrete Zuordnung der Eingruppierung erfolgt nach den einschlägigen tariflichen Vorgaben. Darüber hinaus bietet die KTE ein attraktives Gesamtpaket mit vielen weiteren tariflichen und betrieblichen Leistungen. Die jeweiligen Voraussetzungen und Einzelregelungen erläutern wir Ihnen gerne im weiteren Verfahren. Sinn & Sicherheit: Eine Aufgabe mit echtem gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert und ein krisensicherer, langfristiger Arbeitsplatz bis weit über das Jahr 2060 hinaus. Heute schon an morgen denken: Mit der tariflichen Altersvorsorge unterstützen wir Ihre finanzielle Sicherheit – auch für die Zukunft. Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten (wo möglich), freie …

By connecting people, processes, and data, Altium 365 helps teams move faster, reduce errors, and deliver high-quality hardware products at scale. We are
items.desc: Job Description About Altium Altium is transforming the way electronics are designed and built. Our cloud platform, Altium 365, enables distributed teams to collaborate seamlessly across the entire electronics development lifecycle - from design to manufacturing. By connecting people, processes, and data, Altium 365 helps teams move faster, reduce errors, and deliver high-quality hardware products at scale. We are looking for a UX Researcher to shape end-to-end experiences across Altium 365. You'll be the person who keeps our product decisions connected to real users. You'll run the conversations, test the ideas before we build them, and make sure everything we learn stays findable instead of getting lost in old Slack threads and someone's notebook. You'll work closely with designers, PMs, and engineers throughout the whole cycle, from early problem framing to post-launch validation. This is a hands-on role with a lot of autonomy. You'll own the research practice rather than execute someone else's plan. What You'll Do Talk to users, regularly Own the participant pipeline: recruiting, screening, scheduling, incentives, consent Run interviews, contextual inquiries, diary studies, and surveys Build a steady cadence of user contact so the team is never more than a couple of weeks from fresh input Validate ideas and prototypes Partner with designers and PMs to turn open questions into research questions Run usability tests and concept tests on wireframes, prototypes, and live features Choose the right method for the decision at hand, including quick, scrappy studies when speed matters more than rigor Deliver findings that clearly state what to change and what the trade-offs are Build and maintain the insights repository Set up and curate a searchable database of findings, tagged by product area, user segment, and theme Connect new findings to old ones so patterns surface over time Make it genuinely usable for the rest of the team, not just an archive Track which insights led to which decisions, and revisit assumptions that haven't held up Raise the team's research literacy Coach designers and PMs to run their own lightweight studies well Share findings in formats people actually read and watch: short readouts, highlight reels, workshops Push back when a decision is being made on opinion where evidence is available or cheap to get Qualifications What we're looking for 3+ years in UX/product research, or a closely adjacent role with substantial hands-on research work Solid command of qualitative methods, plus enough quantitative literacy to design a survey and interpret product analytics Experience testing prototypes at different fidelities and knowing what each stage can and can't tell you Clear communication: you can make findings land with a skeptical stakeholder in five minutes Comfort working in ambiguity and scoping research to fit real timelines Familiarity with research ops tooling (Dovetail, Condens, Maze, UserTesting, or similar) English at a professional level Nice to have Experience setting up an insights repository from scratch Background in our domain: Engineering, PCB design or other complex domain Basic familiarity with Figma and design workflows Additional Information Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development. From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

items.desc: Overview About Certara Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries. Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization. About Chemaxon Chemaxon is an industry-leading cheminformatics software company helping early-stage drug discovery and chemistry research for more than 20 years. Our clients are top pharmaceutical companies, innovative biotech startups, and leading academic institutions. We are agile, innovative and friendly, offering compelling opportunities for frequent collaboration and cross-training with teammates and stakeholders. We have recently been acquired by Certara, a US-based model-informed drug development services and software company. We are in an exciting time of organizational and business growth, so now is the perfect time to join our team! About The Role We are mainly looking for a seasoned scientist eager to transition into UX research, ready to move from doing science to studying how scientists use the tools built for them. To make that leap possible, we offer a structured onboarding program where you'll learn everything you need for the transition. Our hiring priority for this role is domain expertise plus curiosity and coachability, not existing UX credentials. If you're already an experienced UX researcher with an interest in complex, data-heavy B2B tools, we'd also love to hear from you. We work daily with scientists, which is challenging and super exciting at the same time. About The Team Our UX team engages with complex and inspiring projects with a strong mix of expertise. Of our eight team members, some focus exclusively on UX research while others focus on UX design. Our team spends most of its time in cross-functional product teams, but we also work on horizontal UX operational tasks. We also use AI tools as part of our everyday workflow for almost every step of UX research, from creating custom research tools and product prototypes, to research data analysis and synthesis, to pattern-finding across studies. We use AI to speed up the busywork, so more time goes toward talking to scientists and generating insight. About The Product The product you will work on is a chemical drawing tool. It's exciting, complex, and B2B. It may sound cliché, but there needs to be chemistry between us and our users. This doesn't mean that you must comprehend this science to the level of a scientist, but you should be willing to learn about it. The dynamic team working on this is quite mature from a UX perspective. Research is an integral part of their operation, so you can expect that your work will have a significant impact here. Responsibilities Define the scope of research plans: Collaborate with stakeholders to define main research questions, objectives that bring the most value based on business goals Plan research studies: prioritize needs, define methodologies, and estimate possible deadlines for delivering the study results Conduct diverse product research activities such as competitor analysis, interview, usability test, user journey mapping, co-creation workshops, target audience segmentation Analysis & synthesis research results (both qualitative and quantitative) into product insights Communicate the research insights in an understandable and transparent way both on team and cross-team level Advocate a research-based culture across the company Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or a related field The ideal candidate will possess an energetic personality with excellent communication skills, attention to details, and patience Candidate must be able to excel in a dynamic, hands-on and creative environment Collaboration skills working across UX team, product owners and domain specialists Communication skills to distill insights from research Experience with a broad range of user research methods Knowledge of when to apply which techniques and how to combine them to answer complex questions Ability to translate complex research findings into actionable insights Basic knowledge of agile development processes Highly proficient in spoken and written English What We Offer Hybrid-way of working (8 days/month home office) Private health insurance (Medicare) Daily entry into Life1 Fitness Clubs We work with global Top500 companies (R&D) and leading …

Developing embedded software in C, C++, and Rust for high-tech systems Building and optimizing applications on real-time platforms Contributing to the design of modular software architectures with a strong focus on quality and maintainability Debugging and analyzing complex embedded systems Collaborating with electronics and mechatronics engineers within multidisciplinary teams Contributing to technical decision-making and system architecture discussions Sounds good so far? We also find it important to have fun together. You will be working at a prime location in a green, wooded environment, close to the Veluwe National Park. The perfect base within the triangle of Enschede, Zwolle, and Nijmegen. High Tech & High Fun We can tell you all about the typical Sioux-culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As an Embedded Software Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to own the embedded software stack on the compute modules used across our platforms. You will take a new module from bare board to a maintained, securely booting Linux platform, covering the boot chain, kernel, drivers, and the verification around them. This is a high impact role that combines deep Linux and kernel work with hands on bring up on new hardware, taking a board from first power up through to flight. Responsibilities BSP and Reference Images: Build and maintain the BSP layer, device trees, and the reference images for each board, including custom layers and SDK generation, and carry them forward across kernel upgrades and silicon revisions. Boot Chain and Secure Boot: Own the boot chain, including bootloader porting, signed boot, verified rootfs, and A/B system update. Drivers and Low Level Interfaces: Develop and validate Linux device drivers across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI, including camera and sensor interfaces. Board Support on MCU Targets: Provide startup, clock, and peripheral support on the microcontrollers of boards the team designs. Board Bring Up and Hardware Validation: Lead software bring up on new hardware, take part in design reviews, and debug system level issues across the hardware and software boundary. Verification and Documentation: Define verification test plans and acceptance criteria, automate boot and peripheral test on real targets, and document each milestone. Cross Functional Collaboration: Work with the hardware team on new boards, and with Systems and Embedded Software Platform on interfaces and integration. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, mentor junior embedded engineers. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: MSc in engineering (electrical, computer, or a related field). PhD a plus. A hands on bring up record matters more than the specific degree. Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded software, with BSPs owned through their lifecycle and kept reproducible as the hardware evolved. Build Systems: Strong command of an embedded Linux build system such as Yocto or OpenEmbedded, across custom layers or packages, BSP integration, image build, and SDK generation. Experience with in house or non standard build systems is an advantage. Technical Expertise: Kernel space driver development on ARM targets, validated against real peripherals across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI. Device tree work on new boards and hardware revisions. Board bring up from first power up to a booting Linux image. Boot and Update: Bootloader porting, kernel configuration, signed boot, and firmware update mechanisms on production hardware, with security conscious and deterministic engineering practice throughout. Programming: Strong C and C++, including kernel space coding, and strong Python scripting skills, with solid version control practice (Git). Debugging Expertise: Able to isolate whether a fault sits in the driver, the kernel configuration, or the board, using GDB, JTAG, OpenOCD, kernel tracing, ftrace, and perf. Professional Attributes: Rigorous, structured, and systematic, able to work autonomously, unfazed by a board that will not boot. Excellent communication and documentation skills, able to present platform and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Additional Skills: Bare metal or RTOS firmware on microcontroller targets, experience enabling hardware accelerators on embedded SoCs including VPU and NPU drivers and runtimes, familiarity with the perception or control workloads that run on the module, and UAS, drone, or defense experience are strong advantages. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.desc: About Neo4j Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data. As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. The Team Neo4j's managed cloud offering, Aura, brings the power of graph databases to the cloud. We're forming a new Product Analytics Platform team. As Neo4j Aura’s platform and product surface area have grown, so has the need for a consistent, purpose-built way to capture what's happening across them. Today, each product tracks its own data, but retrieving it can be difficult. This team will own the Analytics API and infrastructure that collects raw product analytics events from across Neo4j's products so every team integrates with one contract instead of inventing their own. The Role In this role you’ll be one of the founding members of the Product Analytics Platform team. You’ll help define the technical foundations for how product analytics data is captured across Aura, building the Analytics API and underlying infrastructure that provides a consistent integration point for engineering teams across Neo4j. You’ll have significant ownership over the design of the API, balancing the needs of multiple product teams with the long-term maintainability of the platform. You’ll work closely with Product Management and other engineering teams to shape the solution, drive adoption, and evolve it as the platform grows. Primary Responsibilities Design, build, and operate the Analytics API and the underlying infrastructure, defining the schema and integration contract used by teams across Aura. Make pragmatic architectural decisions around event ingestion, data contracts, reliability, and scalability as the platform grows. Build a simple, well-defined integration layer that makes it easy for product teams to send analytics events without coupling them to the underlying data infrastructure. Drive adoption across the Engineering organisation, working with teams to integrate with the API and providing the guidance and documentation they need. Keep product analytics and billing concerns cleanly separated, even where the underlying data flows or infrastructure may be similar. Evaluate build vs. buy across the existing analytics and data stack, including tools such as Segment and BigQuery, keeping the API focused on collection rather than reimplementing downstream capabilities. Partner closely with the team building the downstream data pipeline to ensure raw events are reliable, well-structured, and usable for analytics. Define and evolve the platform through RFCs, technical documentation, and close collaboration with Product Management and other engineering teams. What You'll Need Strong backend software engineering experience, with Go as your primary language, building and operating APIs, services, or ingestion systems that other teams depend on. Experience designing well-defined APIs and integration contracts, including thinking about schemas, backwards compatibility, validation, and how other engineering teams will consume them. Experience building production services in Go, from smaller utilities and scripts through to larger, long-running services or microservices. Some experience with TypeScript or JavaScript and an ability to work comfortably in a codebase that spans backend and frontend technologies. This is primarily a backend role — you won't be responsible for UI development. Familiarity with event-driven systems, data ingestion, or data pipeline tooling such as Segment, BigQuery, or similar. Ability to work independently in a new area, make pragmatic technical decisions, and drive work forward with limited direction. Comfortable writing RFCs and technical documentation, and working across teams to establish and drive adoption of a new integration point. Clear, concise communication — a lot of this role involves defining contracts, documenting decisions, and helping other engineers integrate with what you build. What's Nice To Have Experience with …

items.desc: Lieu : Toulouse, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 81 000 collaborateurs dans 68 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée Un package de rémunération attractif Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu Votre quotidien Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol. Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants. VOTRE QUOTIDIEN L’évolution du marché des télécommunications par satellite conduit Thales Alenia Space à proposer de plus en plus de charges utiles dites flexibles (allocation fréquences ou/et formes d’onde ou/et couverture géographique) et reprogrammables en vol (Software Defined Radio, incluant la reprogrammation logiciel et bitstream des FPGA). Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons des ingénieurs charge utile Télécom numérique (connaissances HW et SW) pour rejoindre les équipes d’ingénierie Payload. Au sein d’une équipe Payload & Système d’environ 20 personnes, amenée à grossir, les enjeux porteront sur l’affermissement de la solution technique charge utile en très étroite collaboration avec l’ensemble des acteurs et la fixation des exigences majeures permettant d’engager à tous les niveaux les activités de développement et derisking appropriées. En nous rejoignant, vous vous verrez confier les missions suivantes : Spécifier des équipements bord, Suivre le développement et l’acceptation technique des équipements. Etablir les bilans gains/niveaux répéteur en cohérence avec les équipes d'implantation, Réaliser des prédictions de performances de la charge utile à l’occasion des revues client PDR, CDR, puis pour les différentes phases de tests. Définir et suivre les tests AIT (Assemblage Intégration et Tests) des Charges Utiles. Interfacer avec divers spécialistes et experts intervenant dans des domaines techniques pointu (RF, EMC, thermique, etc) Enfin, vous pourrez aussi être appelé pour du support dans des domaines aussi variés que les investigations pour la résolution de problèmes pouvant apparaître sur les charges utiles les analyses de Non-Conformité et les présentations clients les équipes Offre client, système ou mission chaque fois que pertinent la modélisation fonctionnelle de système complexe VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes Ingénieur Télécom ou Doctorant, passionné par la radiofréquence et curieux de relever des défis techniques et humains ? Avez-vous des compétences en traitement du signal , une bonne maîtrise de Python, Matlab ou C++ , et une capacité à modéliser des systèmes électroniques (type ADS ) ? Une expérience en conception de charge utile, TCR ou transmission serait un atout ! Parlez-vous anglais au niveau technique et êtes-vous prêt à collaborer avec des équipes multimétiers et multiculturelles , sur des projets innovants et variés ? Souhaitez-vous contribuer à des travaux en co-ingénierie , en lien avec des clients et fournisseurs , et participer à des phases de test hors site , notamment en dehors de Toulouse ? Vous trouvez stimulant de collaborer avec des clients , des partenaires techniques et des experts métier ? Vous avez le goût du travail en équipe, du challenge et de l’innovation ? Vous parlez anglais ? Vous vous reconnaissez ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! LE MOT DE L’EQUIPE « Rejoignez une équipe passionnée qui va façonner l'avenir de notre secteur en relevant des défis technologiques majeurs, tout en bénéficiant d'opportunités uniques de développement personnel et professionnel ! » Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc: About Chyron Chyron is a global leader in products, services, and solutions for professional broadcast and live production. Our products help create content viewed by audiences around the world every day across television, news, sports, corporate, government, house of worship, esports, and education markets. Product Summary Chyron Video Core is a new, largely greenfield application providing shared video I/O, routing, synchronization, switching, and compositing capabilities across the company’s product portfolio. Its modern, extensible architecture will create a common foundation for integrating video hardware, network streams, and external rendering engines. This will help standardize video workflows across a diverse range of company products while supporting reliable, frame-accurate, low-latency operation on Windows and Linux. Role Summary We are looking for a technically experienced Product Owner who will guide the development of Video Core while also contributing directly to its C++ implementation. The role will be more focused on product ownership—understanding the needs of internal product teams, defining requirements, maintaining priorities, and coordinating delivery. The remaining capacity will involve hands-on C++ development, prototyping, technical investigation, and code review. You will work closely with Product Management, your development and QA team, and development teams that will integrate Video Core into their products. The role is suited to someone who can connect product needs with engineering realities, make practical scope and priority decisions, and remain technically involved in the solution. Regular onsite presence is required to work with SDI hardware and laboratory-based testing setups. Responsibilities Own, maintain, and communicate the roadmap and development priorities for Chyron Video Core as a shared internal platform, balancing the needs of consuming products with architectural, technical, and operational requirements. Understand the video I/O, processing, and integration needs of product teams across the company. Translate product goals and technical use cases into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development priorities. Own and maintain the product backlog, ensuring that upcoming work is sufficiently understood and ready for implementation. Define practical delivery phases, including prototypes, foundational capabilities, integration milestones, and production-readiness objectives. Balance feature value, technical complexity, product dependencies, platform consistency, and long-term maintainability. Coordinate requirements, API contracts, and expectations among engineering, SQA,, and integrating product teams. Review development progress, validate completed functionality, and ensure that delivered capabilities address the intended use cases. Identify product, integration, capacity, timing, and hardware-related risks early and help drive them toward resolution. Support the adoption of Video Core by other product teams through clear integration guidance and technical communication. Contribute hands-on to the implementation of Video Core using modern C++. Develop prototypes and selected production components related to video I/O, routing, synchronization, switching, or compositing. Participate in architectural discussions, technical investigations, debugging, testing, and code reviews. Work with SDI, NDI, SMPTE ST 2110, streaming, external-rendering, and hardware-based workflows as the product evolves. Must Haves Professional experience as a Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, product-focused technical lead, or in a comparable role. Ability to understand stakeholder needs and translate them into clear, actionable engineering requirements. Strong prioritization skills and the ability to make practical decisions involving scope, value, risk, and technical complexity. Professional software development experience with modern C++ and the ability to contribute to production code. Understanding of multithreading, synchronization, and thread safety. Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. Clear written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical teams. Ability to work independently, organize work proactively, and maintain focus across both product and development responsibilities. Willingness to work with hardware-connected workflows, existing components, and onsite testing environments. items.desc: Description The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon’s global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon’s business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions. The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems. The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business. Key job responsibilities Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions. Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... ) Supporting the improvement of the automated audit workflow system: integrating new audits and providing input on the future developments/roadmap Developing dashboards and insight products Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics Basic Qualifications Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared) Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R) Experience with SQL Experience in the data/BI space Preferred Qualifications Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. items.desc: Description Come and build innovative services that protect our cloud from advanced security threats! As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you’ll help build and manage services that detect and automate the mitigation of cybersecurity threats across Amazon’s infrastructure, including advanced persistent threats. You’ll work with security engineers, data scientists, and other software development engineers across multiple teams to develop innovative security solutions at a massive scale. Our services protect the AWS cloud for all customers and help preserve our customers’ trust in us. You’ll get to use the full power and breadth of AWS technologies to build services that proactively protect every single AWS customer, both internally and externally, from security threats – not many teams can say that! We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers. We want someone who will help us amplify the positive and inclusive team culture we’ve been building. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice. items.desc: Introductie Erasmus School of Law (ESL) is op zoek naar een getalenteerde en gemotiveerde onderzoeker en docent voor een zesjarige aanstelling als docent/onderzoeker binnen de afdeling Law & Markets. De kandidaat zal onderwijstaken combineren met promotieonderzoek naar de privaatrechtelijke aansprakelijkheid van Europese havens. De beoogde startdatum is 1 januari 2027. De functie combineert onderwijs (60%) met promotieonderzoek (40%). De onderzoekstijd van 40% is gegarandeerd en bedoeld om het hieronder beschreven promotieproject tot een goed einde te brengen. Functieomschrijving Het onderwijsgedeelte wordt ingevuld binnen het brede werkterrein van Law & Markets en zal nader bepaald worden op basis van de expertise van de kandidaat en de onderwijsbehoeften van de afdeling. In eerste instantie wordt verwacht dat een aanzienlijk deel van het onderwijs plaatsvindt in de Master Commercial Law. Als richtlijn kan aangegeven worden dat de onderwijsverplichtingen zich zullen richten op een beperkt, samenhangend pakket van vakken; deze verplichtingen kunnen ook werkcolleges, het nakijken van tentamens en scriptiebegeleiding omvatten, dit alles onder begeleiding van ervaren collega’s. De verantwoordelijkheden worden afgestemd op de ervaring en ontwikkelingsfase van de kandidaat; zelfstandige cursuscoördinatie en substantiële onderwijsontwikkeling worden in het begin niet verwacht. De precieze verdeling kan van jaar tot jaar variëren in overleg met de afdeling, waarbij de 60/40 balans tussen onderwijs en onderzoek gehandhaafd blijft. Promotieonderzoek Het promotieonderzoek ziet op de privaatrechtelijke aansprakelijkheid van Europese zee- en binnenhavens in het kader van de digitale transitie. Havens opereren in toenemende mate op het snijvlak van particuliere ondernemingen, openbare infrastructuur en Europese regelgeving. Zij zijn onderworpen aan steeds verdergaande regelgevende en wettelijke verplichtingen op het gebied van cyberveiligheid, digitalisering, kritieke infrastructuur, gegevensbeheer en duurzaamheid. Deze verplichtingen kunnen niet altijd eenduidig worden gecatalogiseerd als publiekrecht of privaatrecht. Sommige van deze verplichtingen krijgen vorm in privaatrechtelijke relaties, bijvoorbeeld via contractuele afspraken over de beveiliging van de toeleveringsketen. Havens organiseren ook veel van hun activiteiten via privaatrechtelijke instrumenten, zoals toegangsovereenkomsten, terminalcontracten, regelingen voor het delen van gegevens en contractuele aansprakelijkheidsbeperkingen. De centrale vraag is hoe deze verplichtingen doorwerken in privaatrechtelijke relaties en privaatrechtelijke zorgplichten, aansprakelijkheidsnormen, handhaving en de contractuele toewijzing of beperking van risico’s beïnvloeden. Het onderzoek zal onder meer de relevantie onderzoeken van de EU-verordening inzake havendiensten, het NIS2-raamwerk en aanverwante Europese en nationale regels inzake cyberbeveiliging en kritieke infrastructuur, waaronder de Nederlandse Cyberbeveiligingswet. Bijzondere aandacht zal worden besteed aan de mate waarin wettelijke verplichtingen open privaatrechtelijke normen en contractuele relaties vormgeven, en aan de juridische doeltreffendheid van bepalingen die erop gericht zijn om de risico’s van cyberincidenten te toe te wijzen aan de betrokken partijen. Het project heeft betrekking op zowel zee- als binnenhavens en zal geselecteerde Europese rechtssystemen en havens ter vergelijking gebruiken. Ook zal worden onderzocht of, en zo ja hoe, het vaak publieke karakter van havenbedrijven van invloed is op de verhouding tussen publiekrecht en privaatrecht en de daaruit voortvloeiende aansprakelijkheidspositie. De belangrijkste methode is juridisch-doctrinair onderzoek op het snijvlak van privaatrecht, handels- en zeerecht, publiekrecht en EU-recht, aangevuld met een functionele vergelijkende analyse. Indien nuttig en haalbaar kan de juridische analyse worden onderbouwd met interviews met relevante belanghebbenden, met inachtneming van de geldende vereisten inzake onderzoeksintegriteit en privacy. Het project draagt in de eerste plaats bij aan de onderzoeksprioriteit „Digitalisering“ van ESL. Binnen deze thematische prioriteit brengt het expertise op het gebied van privaatrecht, zeerecht en publiekrecht samen om te onderzoeken hoe digitale haveninfrastructuur en datagestuurde activiteiten de zorgplichten en de contractuele risicoverdeling hervormen. Het onderzoek naar cyberveiligheid, kritieke infrastructuur en de juridische toewijzing van digitale risico’s sluit tevens aan bij de prioriteit „Veiligheid, rechtsstaat en maatschappelijke veerkracht“. De voorgestelde begeleidingsteam bestaat uit prof. Jolien Kruit als eerste promotor, dr. Frank Stevens als medepromotor en prof. Pim Jansen als tweede promotor, die in het bijzonder verantwoordelijk is voor het raakvlak tussen publiekrecht en privaatrecht. items.desc: Job Description About Altium Altium is transforming the way electronics are designed and built. Our cloud platform, Altium 365, enables distributed teams to collaborate seamlessly across the entire electronics development lifecycle - from design to manufacturing. By connecting people, processes, and data, Altium 365 helps teams move faster, reduce errors, and deliver high-quality hardware products at scale. We are looking for a UX Researcher to shape end-to-end experiences across Altium 365. You'll be the person who keeps our product decisions connected to real users. You'll run the conversations, test the ideas before we build them, and make sure everything we learn stays findable instead of getting lost in old Slack threads and someone's notebook. You'll work closely with designers, PMs, and engineers throughout the whole cycle, from early problem framing to post-launch validation. This is a hands-on role with a lot of autonomy. You'll own the research practice rather than execute someone else's plan. What You'll Do Talk to users, regularly Own the participant pipeline: recruiting, screening, scheduling, incentives, consent Run interviews, contextual inquiries, diary studies, and surveys Build a steady cadence of user contact so the team is never more than a couple of weeks from fresh input Validate ideas and prototypes Partner with designers and PMs to turn open questions into research questions Run usability tests and concept tests on wireframes, prototypes, and live features Choose the right method for the decision at hand, including quick, scrappy studies when speed matters more than rigor Deliver findings that clearly state what to change and what the trade-offs are Build and maintain the insights repository Set up and curate a searchable database of findings, tagged by product area, user segment, and theme Connect new findings to old ones so patterns surface over time Make it genuinely usable for the rest of the team, not just an archive Track which insights led to which decisions, and revisit assumptions that haven't held up Raise the team's research literacy Coach designers and PMs to run their own lightweight studies well Share findings in formats people actually read and watch: short readouts, highlight reels, workshops Push back when a decision is being made on opinion where evidence is available or cheap to get Qualifications What we're looking for 3+ years in UX/product research, or a closely adjacent role with substantial hands-on research work Solid command of qualitative methods, plus enough quantitative literacy to design a survey and interpret product analytics Experience testing prototypes at different fidelities and knowing what each stage can and can't tell you Clear communication: you can make findings land with a skeptical stakeholder in five minutes Comfort working in ambiguity and scoping research to fit real timelines Familiarity with research ops tooling (Dovetail, Condens, Maze, UserTesting, or similar) English at a professional level Nice to have Experience setting up an insights repository from scratch Background in our domain: Engineering, PCB design or other complex domain Basic familiarity with Figma and design workflows Additional Information Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development. From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 
 The Position
 The Position
 Field Service Engineers - Carlisle, Dumfries, South West Scotland 
Are you an experienced field service engineer seeking a meaningful role in the healthcare industry?
 Are you excited about the prospect of joining a forward-thinking, high-tech business that is passionate about improving patients' lives?
 If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you at Roche Diagnostics, the world's leading provider of diagnostic equipment. Roche covers territories throughout the UK, Scotland, Ireland and Wales England
 The Role 
As a field service engineer with experience in diagnosing and repairing electro-mechanical, fluidic, and electronic systems. Applicants with a background in biomedical engineering, industrial engineering, automation, or aerospace (to name a few) are encouraged to apply. If you have a strong foundation in troubleshooting at the component level and have progressed to systems-level expertise, we want to hear from you.
In this important position within the Technical Services group, you will provide technical support for a variety of medical equipment. With exciting product launches and significant R&D investment in our portfolio, you will have the chance to support the growth of key business accounts across your territory and the UK. You will report to a Regional Technical Manager and be responsible for preventative, corrective, modification, installation, and out-of-hours support for specified products ranging from large to medium-sized equipment.
 Who You are 
To be considered for this role, you should have an engineering or electrical qualification and be able to confidently represent the company at client sites. You should have good previous field service experience with high-value capital equipment and be able to build productive customer relationships in a complex environment. You may be required to travel throughout the UK on occasion.
At Roche Diagnostics, we are committed to investing in our people as well as our business. In addition to a competitive salary and benefits package, we offer a recognized product training program and continuous support to help you develop your knowledge, skills, and potential. If you are ready to take the next step in your professional development and make a positive impact in the healthcare industry, we encourage you to apply for this exciting field service engineer opportunity.
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

items.desc:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
 A Day in the Life 
The Credit Services function supports Medtronic’s order-to-cash operations by partnering with customers and internal stakeholders to manage credit and collections activities, resolve account issues, and support healthy cash flow. The team operates within a modern shared-services environment that leverages digital workflows, data-driven decision-making, and AI-enabled tools to deliver efficient and compliant customer outcomes. 
We are seeking graduates and early-career professionals with professional proficiency in Slovak and Czech language support customers across our EMEA markets. As an Associate Credit Services Representative, you will support credit and collections activities for assigned customer accounts while developing expertise in customer engagement, financial operations, and digital service delivery. You will collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve outstanding balances, maintain accurate account records, and contribute to operational excellence within a technology-enabled Credit Services organisation.
 Primary Responsibilities 
 Manage assigned customer accounts and perform collection activities to support timely payment of outstanding balances.
 Communicate with customers by phone and email in English and the required market language to resolve payment issues, clarify account information, and support payment arrangements.
 Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, account activities, and collection outcomes within designated systems.
 Partner with Finance, Customer Service, and other internal stakeholders to investigate and resolve account discrepancies.
 Escalate complex customer, account, or workflow issues in accordance with established policies and procedures.
 Follow documented processes, controls, and compliance requirements to ensure accurate and consistent service delivery.
 Utilise approved digital and AI-enabled tools to support workflow execution, information gathering, prioritisation, and customer communications.
 Contribute feedback on recurring issues, process gaps, workflow improvements, and automation opportunities to support continuous improvement initiatives.

items.desc:
Location: Bucharest, Romania The Network Engineers goal is to support the company in the daily management of the IS/IT function by delivering high-availability network infrastructure in order to sustain the users' online and on-site information technology activities. To do so, the Network Engineers work hand in hand with other IS/IT professionals (architects, security engineers …). 
 On a daily basis, the Network Engineers design and implement network configurations, troubleshoot performance issues, carry out network monitoring and configure network systems such as routers, switches, and wireless infrastructure. They have to make sure that operations’ workflow, practices, and server maintenance are working effectively and efficiently to aid the improvement of performance, security system, and availability of systems and dependent ecosystems. 
 Network Engineers interface with various stakeholders, within the company and throughout IS/IT Function, in order to deliver stakeholders satisfaction by managing capacity and carrying out remote and/or on-site support. 
 COMPETENCIES: 
 You are able to maintain and control computer networks and related computing environments together with structures software, programs software, hardware, and configurations. 
 You can carry out the configuration of network and security infrastructure equipment. 
 You have experience in monitoring network performance by troubleshooting, diagnosing and resolving software, hardware, and other network and system problems. 
 You have the ability to define the detailed functional behavior of infrastructure building blocks. 
 You have the ability to prevent service interruption, data loss and/or other technical disasters. 
 You have experience in managing complex recovery operations. 
 You can stay value driven, propose smart ideas, be disruptive, take smart risk 
 You have the creativity to lay out smart designs, think out of the box 
 You have the ability to implement new solutions for your users’ satisfaction. 
 You contribute on purchase process in way to describe requirement, analyse & challenge offers and advise on tenderer’s selection. 
 You are able to define a product roadmap and norms & standards 
 You are autonomous, organized, dynamic and can be an actor of change management, promote teamwork 
 You have the strong ability on writing of technical document 
 TECHNICAL SKILLS: 
 You can define and implement networking requirements in a variety of production processes. 
 You have good analytic skills and provide a real expertise on level 3 support. 
 You can configure network and security devices and other IT assets like: Firewalls: Juniper, Palo Alto, FortiGate, Stormshield, Checkpoint, L3/L4 Filtering, User-ID, App-ID. 
 Proxies: zScaler, SSL inspection, WL/BL, URL categorization, web filters, content filter, CAS 
 Gateway VPN: Cisco Firepower, Any Connect client 
 Load balancer: F5 (LTM, APM), VMware NSX. 
 Radius: Cisco ISE PSN, PAN, Dot1.x 
 You have a good knowledge on transversal infrastructure and security domain like : Directories: Active Directory, LDAPS. 
 IAM: Kerberos, SAML, Single Sign On, MFA, etc. 
 PKI: x509 certificate, CMS, AEP. 
 Cloud computing: SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, Infra as Code, and Automation with scripts development (Python/Shell). 
 Cloud security: Zero Trust Network Access, SASE. 
 Virtualized environment (ESX and VMs). 
 SOFT SKILLS: 
 You have strong communication and documentation skills. 
 You are proactive and self-motivated with a problem-solving mindset. 
 You have the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative agile environment. 
 You are independent and self-organizing.

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring our first Product Enablement specialist. You will join the Product & Technical Enablement team and help our go-to-market teams get ready for every product launch, across Agents, APIs, and Creative.

You will support our global go-to-market teams. Your mission: help sellers understand, demo, and sell each new launch with confidence, with preparation that starts well before launch day.

What sets this role apart: we’re looking for someone who knows our products well enough to demo them and sell them. You have used agents, APIs, or creative tools hands-on, and you can explain how they work and why they matter to customers. You blend that with sales, solutions engineering, or product marketing experience, so you can teach sellers how to use a product, how to demo it, and how to pitch it.

This role sits within GTM Enablement and reports to the Product & Technical Enablement Lead. You will work in close partnership with:

 - Product marketing and engineering teams (keeping content accurate as the platform ships)

 - GTM enablement (aligning on shared onboarding infrastructure)

You will support product enablement for our go-to-market teams across Agents, APIs, and Creative, with the most day-to-day focus on API and Creative launches. This is a full-stack role on a lean team: you’ll build content, deliver training, design practice environments, and flex across products as needed.



What you’ll do

 - Support new product launches: get an early heads-up from product marketing, research, and engineering, follow releases from alpha through GA, and have training ready before launch day, not the week of

 - Build launch workshops: go beyond what shipped and why it matters, with hands-on workshops on how to use the product, how to demo it, and how to pitch the value

 - Support competitive enablement: turn product marketing battlecards into trainings, simulations, and demo workshops, so sellers can answer parity, differentiation, and value questions with confidence

 - Support product certification: help define what “product certified” means for GTM teams, and build the playbooks and training content that raise product confidence across the whole field, not only new hires

 - Support everboarding and onboarding: keep training tied to new releases and capabilities, and keep content …

Robert Bosch is hiring a Maintenance Technician in Florence, KY. As a Maintenance Technician, you will troubleshoot, repair, and perform preventative maintenance on electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and robotic systems, while supporting manufacturing operations through equipment reliability, PLC programming, and continuous improvement initiatives. This is a direct-hire opportunity. 
 Shift Information 
 Second & Third Shift Available
 Principal Responsibilities of the Maintenance Technician 
 Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and mechanical systems
 Perform preventative maintenance activities, including inspections, oil changes, lubrication, and equipment cleaning
 Maintain and improve the performance and precision of robotic and automated systems
 Diagnose issues with sensors, actuators, servo drives, and control systems
 Operate machine shop equipment such as lathes, grinders, and welding tools as needed
 Utilize diagnostic tools (multimeters, oscilloscopes, etc.) to identify and resolve equipment issues
 Support and implement PLC programming updates and system improvements
 Read and interpret blueprints, schematics, and technical documentation to support repairs and installations
 Monitor equipment performance and document maintenance activities and findings
 Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to improve system reliability and efficiency
 Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment in compliance with safety standards
 Working Conditions & Physical Requirements 
 Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to moving equipment and industrial conditions
 Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and perform repetitive movements such as bending, twisting, and lifting
 Ability to lift up to 45 pounds independently and move heavier items with assistance or lifting equipment
 Occasional work at heights and use of ladders
Required Qualifications 
 Associate degree in Industrial Maintenance, Mechatronics, Electrical Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)
 Experience troubleshooting and repairing electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and mechanical systems in a manufacturing environment
 Working knowledge of PLC programming (Ladder Logic, STL, or similar)
 Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, blueprints, and technical manuals
 Experience with servo systems, robotics, and automated equipment
 Familiarity with industrial electrical systems, including AC/DC circuits, motor wiring, and control wiring
 Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement solutions
 Experience using diagnostic tools such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and other testing equipment
 Strong mechanical aptitude and experience with preventative maintenance programs
 Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and manage multiple priorities
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with Siemens PLC systems (Step 7, TIA Portal, or similar platforms)
 Experience working with servo-hydraulic and electro-mechanical systems
 Familiarity with robotic systems and precision alignment processes

items.card: ¡Hola! Soy Mariana, recruiter de esta posición.
