items.desc: Your mission We help SME's get paid with the same certainty as large corporates. Our Business Operations & Collections team plays a key part in keeping that promise, and you’ll be part of it. You make sure invoices are paid on time, and when they aren’t, you find a fair solution. You’re also a first point of contact for our merchants and their customers. Every business you call is our customer’s customer, so how you communicate matters as much as what you collect. We’re looking for someone who wants to become an excellent collector: firm on outcomes, fair with people, and service-minded at heart. You’ll learn the full receivable lifecycle, from approval through payment to dunning, and through dunning when a payment doesn’t come in. What you will do Be the first point of contact for merchants and debtors by phone, email and ticket, and resolve their questions quickly and reliably Call overdue debtors, find out why payments are late, and agree realistic payment dates or instalment plans Follow up on agreements and move cases through our dunning process when they slip Reconcile incoming payments daily and resolve disputes and invoice corrections with merchants Approve receivables within defined guardrails and escalate edge cases to the risk team Use AI tools to work faster: summarising cases, preparing calls, drafting messages Over time, take on complex cases and prepare handovers to our collection partners and lawyers Your profile First professional experience in customer service, collections, accounts receivable or accounting. A commercial apprenticeship or a business degree is a good starting point too. You’re ambitious and enjoy being measured on clear results, such as collected amounts and resolved cases. Your German is excellent (C1 or higher), spoken and written. You build trust quickly on the phone and get complex topics across clearly. You stay friendly and firm in tense conversations, and you know when to be flexible and when to hold the line. You enjoy helping people, and you want every merchant and debtor to end the conversation with a clear next step. You work in a structured, detail-oriented way and are comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets. AI tools are already part of how you work, and you know where they save time and where they need a human check. Your English is at B2 level or higher, for working in our international team and handling international debtors. Bonus Points Experience with dunning (Mahnwesen), Inkasso or the court dunning procedure (gerichtliches Mahnverfahren) A background in factoring, B2B lending or trade credit Why us? We expect nothing less than changing the way mid-sized B2B companies get paid. This is an invitation to an exciting journey, with complex challenges, hard work and the support you need to succeed with us as a team. Real responsibility from day one in a small, fast-moving team 28 days of holiday per year (based on a 5-day working week) Hands-on training from an experienced collections lead A clear path to Senior Collections Specialist Steep growth opportunities in a rising fintech €40 monthly benefits budget via Spendit Regular company offsites Berlin office with our own barista Dedicated personal development budget Referral bonus for bringing in new colleagues Tilta swag About us Tilta was founded in Berlin in 2022 by experienced fintech entrepreneurs. Our growing team of industry experts shares one mission: to modernise how B2B companies get paid. We provide AI-based receivables management for mid-sized companies. Our platform combines risk assessment, customer communication, financing, payment and collections in one service. This gives our clients maximun flexibilty and control over their cash flow. Tilta is an equal-opportunity employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to create a culture in which all individuals can reach their full potential regardless of their differences so that our team can thrive together through collaboration and mutual respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities without discrimination based on race, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion age disability marital status, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by the applicable law.

items.desc: Vacature Solliciteer nu Als Data Engineer bouw je mee aan de datafundamenten van organisaties. Je zorgt ervoor dat data betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en toegankelijk is, zodat klanten betere beslissingen kunnen nemen en echt datagedreven kunnen werken. Jouw DNA ontmoet ons DNA Bij Alistar draait alles om vooruitgang, menselijk en technologisch. We verbinden mensen, data en technologie om samen slimmer te werken en verder te kijken. We zijn nieuwsgierige doeners die niet bang zijn om te ontdekken, te proberen en te groeien. Want leren doe je door te doen en fouten horen daar gewoon bij. Onze blik? Gericht op de toekomst. Ons hart? Dicht bij elkaar. We dromen groot, maar blijven met beide voeten op de grond. Hier krijg je de ruimte om jezelf uit te dagen, initiatief te nemen en mee te bouwen aan iets dat beweegt. Brave yourself for progress, samen maken we groei echt menselijk. Van uitdaging naar oplossing Je werkt aan data platform trajecten bij klanten en helpt hen om hun dataomgeving naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je ontwerpt en bouwt moderne data platformen in Azure Je ontwikkelt en optimaliseert data pipelines en datastromen Je vertaalt businesslogica naar schaalbare datamodellen en transformaties Je integreert verschillende databronnen (o.a. via API’s) Je zorgt voor een vlotte en betrouwbare deployment naar productie Je werkt nauw samen met stakeholders zoals data-analisten, data scientists en business teams Je denkt actief mee over performantie, structuur en toekomstbestendigheid Wat jij kan, maakt het verschil Je hebt een bachelor of master· Je beschikt over minstens 2 jaar ervaring in data engineering of data platform projecten Je hebt ervaring met SQL en ETL-processen Je hebt kennis van cloud (bij voorkeur Azure, maar ook AWS, GCP of Snowflake is relevant) Je hebt ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python, Scala, Java of C# Je bent vertrouwd met datamodellering en concepten zoals data lakehouse Je werkt graag in een agile / DevOps omgeving Je communiceert vlot en schakelt goed met verschillende stakeholders Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands Investeren in jou, investeren in groei Bij Alistar draait alles om vooruitgang, ook voor jou. We willen dat je groeit, je goed voelt en trots bent op wat je doet. Daarom zorgen we voor voordelen die echt iets betekenen: Verhaal van Alistar Vooruitgang zit in ons DNA. Wat in 1999 begon als een klein IT-bedrijf, groeide uit tot een dynamische internationale organisatie met één ambitieus doel: bedrijven slimmer laten werken door mensen, data en technologie met elkaar te verbinden. Door de jaren heen zijn we gegroeid, kwamen er nieuwe bedrijven bij en evolueerde de technologie razendsnel. Maar één iets bleef altijd hetzelfde: ons DNA. We zijn nieuwsgierige doeners. Challengers. Dromers die het ook écht waarmaken. Voor ons is technologie geen buzzword, maar een hefboom voor vooruitgang bij onze klanten, binnen onze teams en in onze eigen werking. We denken tech, maar spreken human. Vandaag bouwen we als één Alistar verder aan onze ambitie: uitgroeien tot een toonaangevende, klantgedreven IT-solutions advisor in West-Europa. Dat doen we door talent en expertise te bundelen binnen onze Business Units, volop te investeren in kennis, AI en innovatie, en door onze organisatie zo te structureren dat kleine teams grootse resultaten kunnen realiseren.

items.desc: Over de functie Als Testcoördinator zorg je ervoor dat het testwerk binnen de Scrum-teams goed georganiseerd is. Je schuift al aan bij de refinement, stelt kritische vragen over user stories en acceptatiecriteria, en brengt risico’s in beeld voordat er een regel code is geschreven. Je zet geautomatiseerde tests op in Playwright en houdt ze goed onderhouden. Daarnaast test je handmatig waar dat nodig is, met extra aandacht voor edge cases en situaties onder hoge belasting. Je bewaakt de CI/CD-pipelines en zorgt dat testresultaten snel en duidelijk bij het team terechtkomen. Je kijkt niet alleen naar het product, maar ook naar het proces. Waar kan het slimmer, sneller of betrouwbaarder? Je stelt verbeteringen voor in teststrategie, testdata en werkwijze, en je zet nieuwe tools in, ook AI, om het team verder te helpen. Jouw kwaliteiten Je bent kritisch en nauwkeurig, en je denkt in mogelijke problemen in plaats van alleen in oplossingen. Je verbetert processen uit jezelf en vindt het leuk om met developers te sparren. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technieken en tools. Wat je meebrengt: HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau Ervaring met testautomatisering, bij voorkeur met Playwright Kennis van C# / .NET en JavaScript Analytisch sterk en oog voor detail Proactief in het verbeteren van processen en werkwijzen Vaardig in het inzetten van tools, waaronder AI-tools, om het testen te ondersteunen Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal Pré: ervaring met browsertools voor testrecording die naar Playwright exporteren Pré: kennis van end-to-end testautomatisering voor mobiele apps De voordelen Goed werk verdient een goed pakket. Wat je krijgt: Salaris tussen €4.000 en €5.500 op basis van je kennis en ervaring 25 vakantiedagen Reiskostenvergoeding Goede pensioenregeling Flexibele werktijden Afwisselend thuis en op kantoor werken Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en groei in je vakgebied Mogelijkheid om 32 tot 40 uur per week te werken Gezelligheid hoort er bij deze organisatie gewoon bij. Met wekelijkse borrels, gevierde verjaardagen en regelmatig een uitje voel je je snel thuis. Leer de organisatie kennen In de tuinbouw draait alles om efficiëntie: elke medewerker, elk uur en elk seizoen telt. Tuinbouwbedrijven vertrouwen daarom op software die hun personeel en processen nauwkeurig vastlegt. Deze organisatie ontwikkelt die software al jaren en bouwt daarnaast aan nieuwe oplossingen in de cloud. Je komt terecht in een organisatie waar collega’s elkaar kennen en de lijnen kort zijn. Development, support en sales zitten dicht op elkaar, en elke twee weken deelt het ontwikkelteam met het hele bedrijf wat er nieuw is. Iedereen weet waar de ander mee bezig is. Je krijgt de ruimte om je eigen ideeën uit te voeren en te groeien in je vak. Daarnaast is er genoeg gezelligheid, met een wekelijkse borrel, gevierde verjaardagen en regelmatig een bedrijfsuitje. items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Oslo Søknadsfrist 8.11.2026 Sektor Privat Bli med som vår nye Senior Quality Assurance Engineer Hos Stingray utvikler vi undervannsroboter som overvåker og forbedrer fiskevelferden i oppdrettsanlegg ved hjelp av sensorer, kameraer, maskinsyn og laser. For å støtte alt fra produksjon og logistikk til service og økonomi utvikler vi også våre egne interne systemer. Nå ser vi etter en Senior Quality Assurance Engineer som vil være med på å sikre kvaliteten i vårt ERP-system. Dette er en sentral rolle for deg som motiveres av kvalitet og forutsigbarhet i systemer som brukes hver eneste dag av kolleger på tvers av Stingray. Arbeidsoppgaver – hva skal du gjøre? Som QA Engineer vil du ha en sentral rolle i arbeidet med å sikre kvaliteten i ERP-systemet og bidra til at det fungerer godt for brukerne som er avhengige av det i sitt daglige arbeid. Rollen kombinerer praktisk testing med ansvar for teststrategi, arbeidsmetoder og kontinuerlig forbedring. Du vil jobbe tett med utviklere, produkteiere og brukere for å sikre at nye funksjoner og forbedringer holder høy kvalitet før de tas i bruk. Du vil blant annet: Utarbeide og videreutvikle teststrategier, testplaner og QA-prosesser Gjennomføre funksjonell og ikke-funksjonell testing av nye funksjoner og endringer Utvikle og vedlikeholde testdokumentasjon, testscenarier og testcases Følge opp feil, avvik og kvalitetsmålinger gjennom utviklingsløpet Bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring av arbeidsmetoder og beste praksis innen kvalitetssikring Hvem ser vi etter? Vi ser etter deg som har høyere utdanning innen informatikk, programvareutvikling, informasjonsteknologi eller tilsvarende, og som har solid erfaring med kvalitetssikring av programvare. Du har gjennom flere år hatt en sentral rolle i testing og kvalitetssikring av komplekse systemer, og er komfortabel med å ta ansvar for både teststrategi, testgjennomføring og videreutvikling av arbeidsmetoder. For å lykkes i rollen er det et krav at du har erfaring med testing av ERP- eller CRM-systemer. Du vil jobbe med kvalitetssikring av et ERP-system som brukes på tvers av Stingray, og erfaring fra tilsvarende systemer er derfor nødvendig. Du trives med å kombinere detaljfokus med et helhetlig ansvar for kvalitet, og motiveres av å jobbe tett med utviklere, produkteiere og brukere for å sikre stabile og pålitelige løsninger. Rollen passer for deg som liker å etablere struktur, forbedre prosesser og bidra til en sterk kvalitetskultur i teamet. For å lykkes i rollen tror vi også at du har: Erfaring med testing av web- og mobilapplikasjoner Erfaring med API-testing, for eksempel ved bruk av Postman Erfaring med testdokumentasjon og testdesign God forståelse for Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) Erfaring med Git eller tilsvarende versjonskontrollsystemer Vi tror også at du er analytisk og kvalitetsbevisst. Du kommuniserer godt med både utviklere og brukere, samarbeider godt med andre og tar eierskap til kvaliteten i løsningene som leveres. Rollen krever gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk. Hva tilbyr vi? Hos Stingray får du en nøkkelrolle i utviklingen av et system som brukes hver eneste dag på tvers av selskapet. Du får muligheten til å påvirke både kvalitet, arbeidsmetoder og hvordan vi jobber med testing fremover. Du blir en del av et kompetent utviklingsmiljø med korte beslutningsveier, høy faglig kvalitet og stor grad av tillit. Her får du jobbe tett på både teknologi og brukere, og se hvordan arbeidet ditt bidrar til stabile løsninger og en mer effektiv hverdag for kollegene dine. Arbeidsmiljøet preges av samarbeid, høy kompetanse og kontinuerlig utvikling. Vi gir våre ansatte tillit, ansvar og mulighet til å påvirke både teknologi, arbeidsmetoder og produkter. Vi legger også stor vekt på det sosiale, med samlinger, arrangementer, turer, kantineordning og treningsmuligheter, inkludert eget treningsrom. Team Stingray har sitt utspring under overflaten, der menneskene, lidenskapen og ulikhetene knytter oss sammen. items.desc: Job title: Medical Science Liaison – Rhinology & Gastroenterology Location: field, Poland About the job As a Medical Science Liaison – Rhinology & Gastroenterology within our Specialty Care team, you'll build lasting, trusted partnerships with healthcare professionals and institutions, sharing scientific insights that matter to patients. Ready to get started? Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs. About Sanofi: We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Main responsibilities: Engage healthcare professionals and institutions proactively and reactively with accurate, balanced scientific information. Organize and run scientific meetings, webinars, and discussions with key opinion leaders and healthcare professionals. Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships through scientific exchange in a fast-changing healthcare environment. Communicate the clinical value of our therapeutic area products within the regulatory and ethical framework. Respond to unsolicited medical questions and support investigator-initiated research and local advisory boards. Develop and deliver individual stakeholder engagement plans aligned with the medical strategy. Report adverse events and product quality complaints promptly, in line with local procedures. About you Degree in a scientific discipline. Experience in stakeholder strategy, planning, and engagement. Disease and therapeutic area knowledge in rhinology and/or gastroenterology. Strong impactful scientific communication skills, across multiple channels and formats. Fluent in Polish and English, spoken and written. Strategic thinking, business acumen, and strong interpersonal and collaboration skills. Experience using CRM tools is an asset. Why choose us? Be part of a pioneering biopharma company where patient insights shape how we develop and deliver treatments. Work at the forefront of AI-powered science that accelerates discovery and improves patient outcomes. Collaborate beyond your expertise with diverse, multidisciplinary teams across medical, scientific, and commercial functions. Explore bold career paths, with opportunities to grow through scientific, leadership, and cross-functional moves. Make a real difference in the rhinology and gastroenterology community, helping bring meaningful care to patients with high unmet needs. Enjoy a supportive, flexible work environment with comprehensive healthcare, well-being programs, and access to learning and development. Pursue Progress . Discover Extraordinary . Join Sanofi and step into a new era of science - where your growth can be just as transformative as the work we do. We invest in you to reach further, think faster, and do what's never-been-done-before. You'll help push boundaries, challenge convention, and build smarter solutions that reach the communities we serve. Ready to chase the miracles of science and improve people's lives? Let's Pursue Progress and Discover Extraordinary – together. At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

items.card: Your role Key responsibilities in your new role As a UX/UI Designer in our Corporate Customer and User Experience Design team, you'll turn findings, user needs and requirements into visually appealing digital solutions, always thinking in end-to-end flows rather than isolated screens. Design intuitive, visually polished end-to-end user journeys , interfaces and interaction flows . From single features to complete
items.desc: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone’s life Behind every success, there is a plan: your strategic thinking, creative skills, and ability to communicate with others will drive innovation and turn ideas into impact. As a UX/UI Designer on our Corporate team, you’ll play a vital part in building the frameworks, relationships, and processes that keep Infineon’s Business thriving. Are you in? Your role Key responsibilities in your new role As a UX/UI Designer in our Corporate Customer and User Experience Design team, you'll turn findings, user needs and requirements into visually appealing digital solutions, always thinking in end-to-end flows rather than isolated screens. Design intuitive, visually polished end-to-end user journeys , interfaces and interaction flows . From single features to complete applications, thinking in full flows and journeys, not isolated screens Translate findings, user needs, requirements and demands into clear design solutions : user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes and interaction patterns, and high-fidelity UI designs Apply strong visual design craft : typography, hierarchy, spacing, layout, composition and color, together with accessibility and inclusive-design principles Work confidently with our enterprise design system and help evolve it : recognize when existing patterns don't solve the problem and contribute reusable improvements Look beyond the brief : understand the problem behind a request, constructively challenge assumptions or ideas when evidence or UX principles point to a better approach, and develop your own solution rather than simply executing instructions Explore design alternatives and form a clear point of view : recommend the solution you believe works best rather than simply presenting options, and explain the rationale behind your decisions Work as part of a cross-functional team , collaborating openly with UX researchers, product managers, developers and fellow designers, and integrating feedback, research findings, analytics/data and critique throughout the design process. Explore new tools and ways of working , including AI-assisted design, with curiosity and clear intent Your profile Qualifications and skills to help you succeed Professional experience in UX/UI, visual or product design, two to five years ; a relevant degree (Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Product Design, Information Design, or a related discipline) is welcome, but a strong portfolio can take its place . Bonus points for experience in B2B, enterprise software, industrial, semiconductor, engineering, or another complex digital environment A portfolio that shows both the quality of your final designs and your thinking : user flows, wireframes, prototypes, polished interfaces and the reasoning behind your decisions A strong eye for visual quality and a reliable, confident approach to typography, hierarchy, spacing, layout, composition, and color Sound understanding of UX and interaction-design principles , with experience designing responsive/adaptive experiences and complete user journeys rather than single screens Proficiency with Figma or c omparable design and prototyping tools , and experience working with component-based design or design systems Experience working in cross-functional teams and using research findings and analytics/data to inform decisions . Ability to explain your design rationale, present a recommended solution with alternatives, and give and receive constructive feedback Fluency in English Please send us your CV in English and include a portfolio or case-study collection showing your design process. #WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization. As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener. Are you in? We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone. We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process. Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon. Luis Oliveira, https://www.linkedin.com/in/luis-oliveiraa/

items.desc: Join Our Team at Oracle! Are you a talented problem-solver with a passion for financial analysis? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment and enjoy the challenge of financial recovery? If you are fluent in Portuguese and English and have experience in collections, credit analysis, or a similar role, we want to hear from you! Fluency in Portuguese & English is mandatory. Familiarity with ERP systems. Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret financial data and make informed decisions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with customers and internal teams. Negotiation skills, with the ability to handle difficult conversations and resolve conflicts. High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all aspects of work. Ability to work collaboratively with team members and other departments. Flexibility to adapt to changing business needs and priorities. What We Will Offer: A competitive salary with exciting benefits. Learning and development opportunities to advance your career. An Employee Assistance Program to support your mental health. Employee resource groups that champion our diverse communities. Core benefits such as life insurance, and access to retirement planning. An inclusive culture that celebrates what makes you unique. Ready to Shape the Future of Collections? If you're enthusiastic about taking on a challenging role and driving success in a dynamic environment, apply now and join us at Oracle! What You Will Do: As a Collections Analyst, you'll dive deep into customer accounts, leveraging your keen eye for detail and exceptional problem-solving skills to identify trends, assess credit risks, and implement effective collection strategies. Conduct thorough analysis of customer accounts to determine collection strategies and prioritize collections efforts. Engage with customers via various channels, including phone and email, skillfully negotiating payment terms and resolving outstanding issues. Resolve disputes related to customer payment on delinquent account. Identify root causes of problems and assign the issue towards the responsible department in order to resolve and follow up internally to ensure timely resolution and to increase customer satisfaction. Showcase your innovative mindset by identifying opportunities for process enhancements and streamlining collections workflows. #LI-DNI

items.desc: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your role Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization. Experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely. In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data. What you will do Maintain Performance •Prevent decay and find efficiencies: Monitor the architecture and identify opportunities to optimize code to maintain and enhance mainframe performance. Debug and Test •Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission-critical applications running. Develop for the Future •Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud-based services. Who You Are Required skills and experience •Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects. •Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills. •Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software. •Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services. •Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues. •Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns. Preferred skills and experience •Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. •Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl. •Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

items.desc: Vi på Riksbanken befinner oss i en omfattande förändringsresa inom IT-utveckling, Data-, AI-, Integration och säkerhet. Nu söker vi en Platform Engineer som vill forma framtidens data- och AI-förmåga. Vår moderna Data- och AI-plattform ger analytiker och ekonomer verktygen att fatta datadrivna beslut, arbeta smartare och utforska vad AI kan göra för verksamheten. Din uppgift är att göra plattformen ännu enklare, stabilare och säkrare att använda. Välkommen till en spännande miljö där du med din kompetens bidrar till samhällsutvecklingen. DET HÄR GÖR DU HOS OSS Som en del av plattformsteamen inom data och AI kommer du vara med och driva utveckling och underhåll av Riksbankens egenutvecklade plattformar. Vår teknik-stack är modern med Kubernetes, S3-baserad objektlagring, Python, och AI-hjälpmedel som viktiga komponenter. Plattformarna är primärt on prem i våra serverhallar men möjlighet erbjuds att även arbeta med Azures moln för valda komponenter. Det pågår många initiativ och satsningar, bland annat en Kubernetesmigrering och en uppskalning av arkitekturen med en query engine för frågor direkt mot datasjön. Här är du med och påverkar riktningen. Rollen handlar dock om mer än teknik. En viktig del av uppdraget är att aktivt driva användning och adoption av plattformen genom nära dialog med verksamheten och de huvudsakliga användarna. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: Underhålla och vidareutveckla plattformens tjänster och komponenter. Automatisera bygg-, test-, leverans- och driftsflöden. Utveckla och förvalta containeriserade applikationer och tjänster. Integrera plattformens olika komponenter med datakällor och stödsystem. Felsökning, problemlösning och förbättring av plattformens stabilitet, prestanda och användbarhet. Samarbeta nära användare och datateam och omsätta deras behov i tekniska lösningar. Påverka tekniska vägval, design och den fortsatta utvecklingen av utvecklingsmiljön. DITT TEAM Både Data- och AI plattformsteamen är agila team som ingår i tvärfunktionella verksamhetsområden som Data & Statistik och AI-Huben. Du samarbetar med flera olika datateam på verksamhetssidan, produktledningar och andra möjliggörande team, till exempel DevSecOps, Integration och IT-infrastruktur. Även med arkitekter, infrastrukturspecialister och säkerhetsexperter i en miljö som värdesätter teknisk excellens och kunskapsdelning. Plattformsteamen tillhör Avdelningen för IT- och Digitalisering samt är en del av enheten IT-utveckling och Dataplattform, som förutom gemensamma applikationsplattformar, även ansvarar för egenutvecklade verksamhetsapplikationer. MER OM DIG Skallkrav : För att vara framgångsrik i rollen behöver du vara förtroendeingivande och bra på att bygga relationer. Du hanterar många kontaktytor och har användarnas behov i fokus. Samarbete och kommunikation är centrala delar av rollen. Du vet att stabil drift och effektiv förvaltning är grunden för allt. Du är strukturerad, tar ansvar och är van vid att driva frågor från idé till implementation. Vidare har du en relevant högskoleutbildning inom exempelvis datavetenskap, systemvetenskap, eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Du har även flerårig arbetslivserfarenhet av: Programmering i modernt språk (Python, Go, JavaScript osv) Utveckling av CI/CD-pipelines (Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions) Containeriserade applikationer (Docker eller Podman) Utveckling i Linux-miljöer Arbete enligt DevOps-modellen, you build it, you run it Goda kunskaper i både engelska och svenska är krav för tjänsten. Meriterande är erfarenhet av: Orkestrering av dataflöden (Dagster, Prefect, Airflow eller liknande) Kubernetes (ArgoCD, Helm, Kustomize) Datamodellering och dataintegrationer, gärna med R och SQL Data lake- och lakehouse-lösningar (S3, Parquet, Iceberg, Delta Lake) Produktionssättning i Linux-servermiljöer och Bash-skriptning Nätverk och nätverksrelaterad felsökning Förståelse och erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt MER OM TJÄNSTEN Tillträde: Omgående eller enligt överenskommelse Anställningstyp: Tillsvidareanställning, provanställning kan komma att tillämpas Placering: Kontor i centrala Stockholm Arbetstid: Förtroendearbetstid Möjlighet att jobba distans: 1 eller 2 dagar i veckan Förmåner: Bland annat generösa semestervillkor, löneväxling till pension, friskvårdsbidrag och tillgång till träningsmöjligheter. Tjänsten kan komma att placeras i säkerhetsklass och en säkerhetsprövning innefattande registerkontroll, säkerhetsprövningssamtal och särskild personutredning görs då för slutkandidaten. För vissa tjänster ställs krav på svenskt medborgarskap. ANSÖK I denna rekrytering samarbetar Riksbanken med rekryteringsföretaget Computer Sweden Recruitment. items.desc: Vill du vara med och bygga framtidens datadrivna lösningar? Datamängder växer snabbt och kraven på hur organisationer hanterar, strukturerar och nyttjar data ökar i samma takt. Samtidigt förändrar AI hur vi bygger system, men det ställer också högre krav på kvalitet, struktur och förståelse. Därför söker vi nu en Data Engineer som vill arbeta med moderna dataplattformar och skapa lösningar med verkligt affärsvärde. Hos bolaget får du möjlighet att arbeta i en miljö där tekniskt hantverk, datakvalitet och långsiktighet står i fokus. Du blir en del av ett team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och kontinuerlig utveckling är centrala delar av kulturen, samtidigt som du arbetar nära kund och bidrar till affärskritiska lösningar. OM FÖRETAGET Vår kund är ett modernt konsultbolag inom tech med fokus på att utveckla hållbara, skalbara och affärskritiska system. Genom att kombinera djup teknisk kompetens med förståelse för kundens verksamhet skapas lösningar som håller över tid. Bolaget arbetar med att designa och utveckla robusta dataplattformar, pipelines och arkitekturer som hjälper organisationer att omvandla data till insikter och affärsvärde. Arbetet sker i moderna datamiljöer med fokus på skalbarhet, säkerhet och långsiktig förvaltning. Teknikstacken omfattar bland annat Python, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Apache Spark och dbt, samt molnbaserade plattformar och AI-stödda arbetsflöden. Organisationen är grundad av erfarna entreprenörer och tekniska ledare, vilket ger en stabil grund samtidigt som det finns stort utrymme att påverka och utveckla verksamheten framåt. Kulturen präglas av samarbete, nyfikenhet och respekt. Här uppmuntras lärande och utveckling, och man tror på att starka team bygger starka system. OM ROLLEN Som Data Engineer arbetar du med att designa, bygga och vidareutveckla dataplattformar och pipelines hos bolagets kunder. Rollen innebär ett helhetsansvar där du arbetar nära både teknik och affär. Du kommer bland annat att: Designa, utveckla och underhålla skalbara datapipelines och dataplattformar Säkerställa hög datakvalitet, säkerhet och långsiktig hållbarhet Arbeta med moderna datateknologier och molnbaserade lösningar Samarbeta nära kund för att omsätta affärsbehov till tekniska lösningar Bidra till arkitektur- och designbeslut inom dataplattformar Använda AI-verktyg för att effektivisera utveckling, med bibehållen kvalitet Delta i kunskapsdelning och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling Du arbetar i konsultuppdrag, vilket innebär variation, kundkontakt och möjlighet att påverka lösningar i olika typer av organisationer. VI SÖKER DIG SOM Har minst 4–5 års erfarenhet som Data Engineer, Backend Developer eller liknande Har starka kunskaper i Python och SQL Har erfarenhet av att bygga datapipelines och arbeta med moderna dataplattformar Har förståelse för systemarkitektur, datamodellering och skalbara lösningar Talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska och engelska Har en relevant akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis datateknik eller systemvetenskap EXTRA MERITERANDE OM DU Har erfarenhet av verktyg som Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Apache Spark eller dbt Har arbetat i molnmiljöer (t.ex. AWS, Azure eller GCP) Har erfarenhet av konsultrollen och kundnära arbete Har arbetat med datadrivna organisationer eller analysplattformar Har intresse för AI och moderna utvecklingsverktyg Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och söker dig som: Har ett starkt kvalitetstänk och förstår vikten av korrekt och tillförlitlig data Är tekniskt nyfiken och vill utvecklas inom dataområdet Har förmågan att kritiskt granska lösningar, inklusive AI-genererad kod Trivs i en samarbetsorienterad miljö och delar gärna kunskap Har ett långsiktigt och hållbart synsätt på systemutveckling ÖVRIG INFORMATION Omfattning: Heltid Start: Enligt överenskommelse Lön: Fast lön + förmåner Arbetstider: Kontorstider Plats: Centrala Stockholm REKRYTERINGSPROCESS Detta är en direktrekrytering vilket innebär att kandidaten som får tjänsten blir anställd direkt hos bolaget. Vi intervjuar löpande så varmt välkommen med din ansökan snarast. Tyvärr har vi inte möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via mejl. Glöm inte att följa vår LinkedIn för att ta del av spännande uppdrag och karriärmöjligheter - Klicka här (https://www.linkedin.com/company/nordicrule) för att följa. PS. För att säkerställa en trygg och säker hantering av dina personuppgifter tar vi inte emot ansökningar via e-post. Skicka därför in din ansökan genom att klicka på ”Ansök nu”. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan, lycka till!

Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

items.desc: Due to internal promotion, we are now looking for a Medical Advisor to join our team! Bring your scientific expertise to a role where your insights, relationships, and ideas can help shape oncology care in Sweden. As a trusted scientific partner to healthcare professionals, you will focus on solid tumours, particularly gynaecological oncology, with the potential to expand into other tumour areas as our pipeline evolves. You will connect emerging evidence with clinical needs, turn insights into medical strategy, and collaborate with internal teams and external experts to advance patient care. If you are curious, collaborative, and motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is an opportunity to grow your expertise while uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together. We create a place where people can grow, be their best, be safe, and feel welcome, valued and included. Discover more about our company wide benefits and life at GSK on our webpage Life at GSK | GSK In this role you will Build and strengthen trusted, peer-to-peer scientific relationships with oncology healthcare professionals and key stakeholders in solid tumours, with a particular focus on gynaecological oncology. Lead balanced, evidence-based scientific exchange, translating complex and emerging data into clear discussions that support informed clinical decisions and patient care. Identify unmet clinical needs, gather and document actionable insights, and translate them into recommendations for medical strategy. Contribute to clinical development by identifying and qualifying potential investigators and clinical sites. Represent GSK at scientific meetings, congresses, and expert forums, fostering scientific dialogue and bringing relevant knowledge back to the organisation. Partner with cross-functional colleagues on approved scientific education, medical projects and initiatives that address clinical needs. Why you? Basic Qualifications & Skills: We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals: Advanced degree in medicine, pharmacy, life sciences or a related field, such as MD, PhD, PharmD or equivalent. Pharmaceutical-industry experience in Medical Affairs, Medical Science Liaison or a related scientific role. Strong knowledge of solid-tumour oncology clinical practice, treatment options and the evolving treatment landscape. Ability to make complex scientific information clear, relevant, and engaging for healthcare professionals. Demonstrated experience in building trusted, peer-to-peer relationships with oncology experts and healthcare teams. Ability to work independently, take initiative, and organise priorities effectively while complying with relevant regulations and standards. Fluent in Swedish and English both written and spoken. Preferred Qualifications & Skills: Please note the following skills are not necessary, just preferred, if you do not have them, please still apply: Clinical experience in oncology or direct patient care environments related to solid tumours, preferably gynecological cancer. Experience supporting clinical trials, investigator-initiated studies, or real-world evidence projects. Familiarity with the Swedish healthcare system, including hospitals and reimbursement processes. Strong presentation and facilitation skills that encourage meaningful scientific discussion and learning. Proven ability to identify and engage key opinion leaders and academic experts in oncology. A collaborative mindset, enthusiasm for continuous learning, and a commitment to contributing within cross-functional teams. Work model and travel This role is based in Sweden with hybrid working flexibility, combining remote work with regular, in-person engagement with healthcare professionals across your assigned territory. Travel within the region is expected, at 50% of your time. Ready to turn scientific expertise into meaningful impact? Bring your curiosity, ideas, and passion for oncology to a role where you can contribute to patient care today and develop your expertise as our pipeline evolves. items.desc: At UBDS, we help organisations transform through cloud, cyber security, AI and digital innovation. As our Managed Services capability continues to grow, we're looking for an experienced Cyber Incident Response Consultant to join our Security and Infrastructure Operations Centre (SIOC), based in either London or Manchester. This is a hands-on, customer-facing consultancy role focused on investigating, responding to and recovering from cyber security incidents across complex customer environments. You will support and lead incident response engagements, conduct digital forensic investigations and advise customers on strengthening their cyber resilience and incident response capabilities. You will work primarily across Microsoft and AWS environments, alongside SIEM, EDR and digital forensic tooling. What You'll Do Lead or support customer-facing cyber incident response engagements, from initial investigation through containment, eradication, recovery and reporting. Investigate security incidents including ransomware, malware, phishing, account compromise and unauthorised access. Conduct digital forensic investigations across endpoints, servers, cloud environments and network infrastructure. Analyse security logs, endpoint telemetry, forensic artefacts and indicators of compromise to establish incident scope and root cause. Use EDR, SIEM and forensic tooling to investigate suspicious activity and reconstruct attack timelines. Advise customers on containment decisions, remediation priorities and recovery approaches. Support eradication and recovery activities, validating remediation and identifying any remaining security risks. Collect, preserve and document digital evidence, following appropriate forensic procedures and chain-of-custody requirements. Produce professional incident investigation reports, including findings, timelines, root cause and remediation recommendations. Present investigation findings and recommendations to technical teams, customers and senior stakeholders. Support threat hunting, detection engineering and improvements to security monitoring capabilities. Develop and improve incident response playbooks, processes and procedures. Design and support cyber incident exercises, including tabletop scenarios, simulated incidents and response workshops. Facilitate or contribute to exercises, evaluating response effectiveness and producing post-exercise recommendations. Work closely with SIOC analysts, security engineers, cloud specialists and wider Managed Services colleagues during incidents. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to less experienced security professionals. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone with strong incident response experience, practical forensic investigation skills and the confidence to engage directly with customers. Experience working within Cyber Incident Response, DFIR, SOC/SIOC or a similar cyber security environment. Hands-on experience investigating and responding to cyber security incidents. Experience supporting or leading customer-facing incident response engagements. Strong experience with EDR tooling, SIEM platforms and security log analysis. Understanding of incident response processes, including containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned. Practical knowledge of digital forensic techniques, including endpoint, memory, network or cloud forensics. Experience collecting and preserving digital evidence, with an understanding of chain-of-custody principles. Ability to analyse attacker activity, indicators of compromise and common attack techniques. Good understanding of Windows, Linux, networking and cloud security. Experience investigating security incidents within Microsoft and/or AWS environments. Experience producing technical investigation reports and presenting findings to customers. Strong analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and consultancy skills. Desirable Experience Experience across some of the following would be beneficial: Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Sentinel. AWS security services, logging and incident investigation. Digital forensic tooling such as Velociraptor, KAPE, Autopsy, Volatility or equivalent. Malware analysis, reverse engineering or network forensics. Threat intelligence, threat hunting and MITRE ATT&CK. Experience supporting ransomware investigations and complex security incidents. Designing and facilitating cyber incident tabletop exercises. Developing realistic incident scenarios, injects and exercise objectives. Evaluating exercise performance and producing post-exercise reports and recommendations. Red Team, penetration testing or adversary simulation experience. Python, PowerShell or scripting for investigation and automation. Experience delivering cyber security consultancy services to external customers. We deliver extensive physical health services too, from urgent community response teams helping frail and older patients remain safely at home, to hospitals at home teams providing acute-level care in familiar surroundings. Imagine contributing to projects that help move millions of people every day? At Siemens Mobility, we're developing innovative transport solutions that are transforming the future of rail and making travel more sustainable. Start your career at the heart of that journey! Join a two-year graduate journey that combines hands-on experience with structured development. Through technical and professional training, graduate workshops, mentoring and leadership exposure, you'll build your skills while working on meaningful projects. You'll collaborate with fellow graduates across the business, present your achievements and deliver a Business Impact Project with real business value, developing the confidence, experience and connections needed to accelerate your career at Siemens Mobility. Siemens Rail Electrification powers electric trains, trams, and metros worldwide by designing, installing, and maintaining all the necessary equipment, like substations and overhead lines. Their work ensures these vehicles get the electricity they need to run safely and efficiently, supporting modern electric transport and helping to reduce its environmental impact. Year 1: Three 4 month rotations across key functions, starting off with 1 month in your home team. Year 2: Transition into your substantive team to develop deeper expertise and to prepare for your role beyond the graduate programme. Note - Some business areas may continue rotations into year 2. Job Purpose: The Protection and Control (P&C) Team within the Electrification Business Unit of Siemens Mobility, Rail Infrastructure are responsible for the development of cutting edge protection and control schemes and the implementation of digital substation solutions to allow the railways in Britain to be safer, greener and more cost effective! We are at the very cutting edge of electrical protection design and you will be working within a dynamic and driven team which delivers electrification on all major UK projects. During your 2-year graduate scheme, you will have the opportunity to gain experience in other teams within the Electrification business unit, previous examples of which have been high voltage design, overhead line design and protection system design. Depending on the placement, you may be working away from your contracted location for a period of up to six months (funded by Siemens). For the duration of the graduate scheme, you will take part in technical and professional training, with technical training delivered by the top engineers in the business over the course of several weeks. During these training weeks you will also have a chance to meet and challenge other early career professionals across Siemens Mobility and discuss different experiences, building connections for your burgeoning career. It is an exciting time to be joining the railway in the UK as new electrification projects are authorised and a new generation of protection and control systems for the electrification network are being developed. Siemens are at the forefront of these new technologies as a manufacturing business giving you the opportunity to learn from the subject experts. The work will include undertaking outline and detailed design of railway electrification systems, initially under the supervision of experienced engineers but rapidly taking on more responsibilities. These projects support the growth and transformation of the railway for a greener future, with typical clients being Network Rail, London Underground and Docklands Light Railway, to name a few. The work involves, site investigations, outline and detailed designs, commissioning support, and liaison with clients, stakeholders, suppliers and external third parties. Knowledge, Skills, Qualifications and Experience: The candidate would be expected to a have strong academic background in engineering, ideally in power distribution. Principal Accountabilities: Undertake all design calculations (from first principles if required) for assigned projects within the Rail Electrification portfolio.  Schimbă lumea de mâine împreună cu noi. 
 Unitatea noastră de afaceri Siemens Motion Control (DI MC) este unul dintre liderii mondiali în furnizarea de produse, sisteme, soluții și servicii în domeniul controlului mișcării. Aceasta include aproximativ 20.000 de angajați și patru segmente de business. Cu locații globale de producție, cercetare și dezvoltare (R&D) și servicii, MC este aproape de clienții săi și activă într-o gamă largă de industrii. 
 În rețeaua noastră de fabrici, Siemens AG dezvoltă și produce motoare electrice pentru piața globală. Clienții noștri țintă activează în domeniul tehnologiei de automatizare, în industria auto și în domeniul intra-logisticii. Pentru a susține creșterea noastră de succes, vom extinde locațiile noastre într-un mod direcționat în următorii ani. Digitalizarea și simulările ne sprijină în planificarea viitorului și în implementare. 
 In prezent cautam noi colegi pe rolul de Failure Room Analysis Technician care sa se alature echipei de Calitate. Vei fi responsabil pentru investigarea și analiza produselor neconforme provenite din producție, reclamații clienți (RMA) sau audituri interne, în vederea identificării modurilor de defectare și a cauzelor rădăcină. Acesta oferă suport tehnic echipelor de Calitate, Producție și Inginerie pentru implementarea acțiunilor corective și preventive. 
 Responsabilități principale: 
 - Recepționează și înregistrează probele trimise pentru analiză. 
 - Efectuează inspecții vizuale, măsurători și teste funcționale asupra produselor neconforme. 
 - Realizează analize de defect folosind echipamente și metode specifice laboratorului. 
 - Identifică și clasifică modurile de defectare. 
 - Colectează și documentează dovezi tehnice (fotografii, măsurători, rapoarte de testare). 
 - Întocmește rapoarte de analiză și concluzii tehnice. 
 - Participă la investigații de tip 8D, 5 Why și Ishikawa. 
 - Colaborează cu departamentele de Calitate, Producție, Inginerie Proces și Logistică pentru identificarea cauzelor rădăcină. 
 - Menține trasabilitatea probelor și arhivarea documentației aferente. 
 - Respectă procedurile de siguranță, calitate și mediu aplicabile în laborator. 
 - Asigură ordinea și buna funcționare a echipamentelor din Failure Analysis Room. 
 Cerințe 
 - Studii medii tehnice sau studii superioare în domeniul tehnic 
 - Experiență în domeniul calității, producției sau analizelor tehnice constituie avantaj. 
 - Experiență în utilizarea echipamentelor de măsurare și testare. 
 Cunoștințe și competențe: 
 - Interpretarea desenelor tehnice și a specificațiilor produselor. 
 - Utilizarea instrumentelor de măsură (șubler, micrometru, comparatoare, multimetru etc.). 
 - Cunoștințe de bază privind metodologiile de rezolvare a problemelor (8D, 5 Why). 
 - Cunoștințe Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). 
 - Atenție la detalii și gândire analitică. 
 - Abilități de comunicare și lucru în echipă. 
 - Cunoștințe de limba engleză la nivel tehnic. 
 Ce iti oferim: 
 Pe lângă oportunități de muncă atractive, punem un accent deosebit pe un echilibru sănătos între viața profesională și cea personală; învățarea continuă și dezvoltarea angajaților noștri sunt foarte importante pentru noi – credem că acestea sunt cheia succesului nostru. 
 Lasă-ți amprenta în lumea noastră captivantă alături de Siemens! 
 Diversitatea la Siemens este sursa noastră de creativitate și inovație. Existența unor tipuri diferite de talente și experiențe ne face mai orientați spre rezultate și mai bine pregătiți să răspundem eficient cerințelor societății. Prin urmare, apreciem candidații care reflectă diversitatea de care ne bucurăm în compania noastră.

 Lehetőséget a projekttel kapcsolatos nemzetközi utazáson való részvételre.

Hva vil du jobbe med? Som AI Engineer hos oss vil du: Designe, utvikle og sette i drift AI‑ og ML‑løsninger Jobbe med hele verdikjeden: fra datainnsamling og modellering til produksjon og forvaltning Utvikle løsninger innenfor blant annet maskinlæring, computer vision, generativ AI og automatisering Samarbeide tett med kunder, utviklere og forretningssiden Bidra til fagmiljøet gjennom deling av kunnskap og beste praksis Hvem er du? Vi ser etter deg som har: Erfaring fra arbeidslivet som AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Data Engineer eller utvikler Stor interesse for hva som er mulig å få til med hjelp av maskinlæring og generativ AI Gode norsk og engelsk kunnskaper Høyere utdanning innen Data Science, Computer Science eller andre relevante fagområder God programmeringskompetanse og erfaring med bruk av AI verktøy for utvikling (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code etc.) Vi håper at du har: Erfaring med maskinlæring, computer vision, med å bygge agenter og med å lage RAG løsninger Kjennskap til moderne ML‑rammeverk Forståelse for dataplattform og MLOps Hvem er vi? items.desc: We're looking for an experienced Applied AI Engineer to join our Growth team and help build operations automation systems for our global mobility platform. If you're excited about applying machine learning to customer support, document verification, and fraud detection challenges across Bolt's 200M+ customers, you'll find plenty of impactful work here. About Us With over 200 million customers across 50+ countries and 850+ cities, Bolt is one of the fastest-growing tech companies in Europe and Africa — powered by 4.5+ million partners on our platform, 4,000+ employees globally. And it's all thanks to our people. We believe in creating an inclusive environment where everyone is welcome, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or ability. Our ultimate goal is to make cities for people, not cars — and we need your help on this mission! About The Role Every new customer and order at Bolt can trigger an operational decision: a refund, a document check, an account review, a ruling in a dispute. Our teams already use AI on top of existing processes to make them faster and more accurate. Many of those processes need a redesign from the ground up, and a design that gets better with every decision it makes. You start with customer support for all users, then move to document verification & fraud detection. After that, any process with high decision volume and a recorded outcome is in scope. You are hands-on. You ship the product and own the result. Main Tasks And Responsibilities Redesign processes. Mine an area's systems of record, interview the people who run it, and decide which steps become software, agents or human checkpoints. Define what great looks like. Turn real cases and human decisions into test sets, and turn every new failure into a regression test. Build checks that are hard to game. Calibrate LLM judges against human labels, keep them apart from programmatic checks, and guard cost and payouts. Run the improvement loop across policies, prompts, tools and models. Add fine-tuning where a better policy is not enough. Own the rollout gates. Decide what ships, run the A/B test, and feed the live result back into the test sets. Codify what works so other teams can run it without you. You are measured on how many decisions you automate while raising their quality. About You You come from software engineering, ML or data science, and you have shipped and operated a system that calls LLMs. You have built an evaluation suite for an LLM or agent system and used it to decide what ships. You have spent dozens of hours in agent traces finding where decisions went wrong, and fixed them. You have designed an LLM judge, measured its agreement with human labels, and fixed it when the two disagreed. You know how verifiers get gamed, and have caught a case of reward hacking in your work. You can design an A/B test, read its result, and explain to an operations lead why the offline tests predicted something different. You know when a rule, a classic ML model or a human beats an LLM, and you can show the cost trade-off. You write clearly in English. Your reports pair a ceiling estimate with a realistic one. Nice To Have Hands-on post-training: RLVR, GRPO or DPO, reward modelling, LoRA etc. Program optimisation frameworks such as GEPA, DSPy or TextGrad. RL environment or gym design with programmatic grading. Operations automation at a marketplace, fintech or trust and safety team. Strong SQL, and comfort working in codebases you did not write. This role is not for you if you want to train frontier models, need a finished spec before you start, or prefer benchmark scores to live results. Why you'll love it here Accelerate your professional growth with unique career opportunities. Enjoy a rewarding salary and stock options, knowing that as Bolt succeeds, so do you. Take care of your physical and mental health with our wellness perks. Celebrate 5 years at Bolt with a 1-month paid sabbatical to recharge. Connect with colleagues at annual company events and smaller team gatherings. Work on-site at our Tallinn HQ, next to the operations and engineering teams whose decisions you automate. Some perks may differ depending on your location and role. At Bolt, using AI daily is a baseline expectation for everyone. If there's a faster, smarter way to do your work, we expect you to find it. You're still responsible for the output, so the standard stays high when using AI tools. Experience is great, but what we really look for is drive, intelligence, and integrity. So even if you don't tick every box, please consider applying! Everyone is welcome Bolt is an equal opportunity employer. items.desc: As we partner with a diverse array of Danish companies operating on a global scale, we navigate industries that must adhere to stringent laws and financial controls, all while delivering exceptional service levels. With over 1,500 dedicated colleagues across Denmark, The Czech Republic, and The Philippines, Aeven is not just a workplace — it's a community united by a common goal: to drive innovation and operational excellence. In Denmark, we boast four state-of-the-art data center facilities, allowing us to leverage advanced technologies and provide robust solutions tailored to our clients' needs. If you’re looking to make an impact in a dynamic environment that values expertise and collaboration, we invite you to explore joining our team at Aeven! About The Role Aeven is currently building a controlled AI platform: a gateway for models and tools, reference RAG and MCP patterns others can reuse, and an organization that builds on that foundation. In this role you will own that technical path from first production platform work to enablement at scale. You will also function as the technical lead for the Aeven AI Gateway and for the first reference RAG pipelines and MCP integrations. You will build and harden shared platform capabilities, then shift toward enabling other teams to adopt them. Production day-to-day operations for the gateway will be run with skilled-up colleagues in the wider organization; you design for that handoff. We offer ownership of a company-wide AI control plane; path from builder to technical enabler, and exposure to on-prem and cloud LLM stacks. Responsibilities: Own the technical direction and delivery of the AI Gateway, including routing, keys and budgets, guardrails, auditability, and OpenAI-compatible upstreams such as on-premises models. Design and ship the first reference RAG pipelines, covering ingestion, retrieval, access-control-aware patterns, and basic evaluation. Deliver the first MCP and tool integrations as reusable patterns rather than one off applications. Partner with Security and platform and network teams on identity, data classification, and production readiness. Write clear runbooks and interfaces so gateway operations can be owned by upskilled teams across the organization rather than requiring a 24/7 CoE pager role. After the first gold paths are established, prioritize enablement through templates, review gates, office hours, and pairing with line-of-business engineers. Challenge “build it for us” requests; default to platform capabilities and reusable patterns unless the Head of AI sponsors a time-boxed proof of concept, typically four to six weeks. Contribute estimates and technical options to the CoE backlog maintained with the AI Operating Lead. Requirements: You care about production systems and operator impact. You ship scalable building blocks and teach others to use them. Must-Have Qualifications: At least five years of software engineering experience with production ownership. Strong Python and/or TypeScript skills, including APIs and system integration. Hands-on LLM application experience, including tool calling, orchestration, and an evaluation mindset. Knowledge of RAG patterns, including chunking, embeddings, vector stores, grounding, and access-control awareness. Experience with API gateways, reverse proxies, or LLM gateways such as LiteLLM or an equivalent platform. Cloud literacy, preferably with Azure, and confidence working with Linux and containers. Clear written and spoken English for design documentation and stakeholder collaboration. Evidence of mentoring or enabling other engineers through reviews, templates, guilds, or pairing. Good-to-Have Qualifications Experience with MCP or a similar tool protocol. Knowledge of Entra ID and enterprise authentication. Experience with observability, including metrics, tracing, and token and cost visibility. Familiarity with Kubernetes or hybrid on-premises GPU inference. Experience in regulated industries such as finance, life sciences, or the public sector. Experience with vector databases or pgvector-style stores and document pipelines over enterprise knowledge bases. Employee Benefits Up to 6 weeks of paid time off per year 5 sick days per year Flexible working hours Possibility to work from home Flexible cafeteria account for leisure (18,000 CZK per year) allowing you to use points for MultiSport, public transport tickets, or contribute to your pension savings Meal vouchers in the amount of 200 CZK per workday (Aeven covers 55%) Referral bonus (20,000 – 60,000 CZK) Free snacks on Mondays and monthly get-togethers Free fruits and vegetables every day Height-adjustable tables Co-working offices in Ostrava and Brno Czech language lessons Annual flu vaccination for free

Responsabilità Mappare i processi aziendali (preventivi, capitolati, computi, schede impianto, SAL, assistenza) e individuare use case AI ad alto impatto Sviluppare e integrare soluzioni di machine learning e generative AI su dati tecnici e documentali (offerte, computi, schede prodotto, layout copertura, anagrafiche commessa) Costruire assistenti e workflow su LLM (RAG su documentale interno, draft di preventivi/relazioni, classificazione richieste, supporto all'ufficio tecnico) Collaborare con geometri, preventivisti, commerciali e responsabile di produzione per tradurre esigenze di cantiere e di commessa in strumenti usabili Integrare i modelli con gli applicativi già in uso (gestionale, Excel, cartelle di progetto, eventualmente CRM/ERP) tramite API e automazioni Portare le soluzioni dal prototipo all'uso quotidiano: qualità, tempi di risposta, costi, manutenzione e formazione degli utenti Definire regole minime di qualità dato, privacy e tracciabilità, coerenti con un'impresa edile (commesse, fornitori, clienti) Monitorare adozione ed effetti sul lavoro (tempi di offerta, errori di computo, recupero documentale) Requirements Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica o discipline STEM affini Esperienza di almeno 4-6 anni in sviluppo software, di cui almeno 3 su progetti AI/ML o GenAI usati in produzione Ottima padronanza di Python e stack AI di mercato (PyTorch e/o TensorFlow, Hugging Face, Scikit-learn, FastAPI) Esperienza concreta su LLM: RAG su documentale aziendale, prompting, integrazione via API, valutazione della qualità delle risposte Capacità di lavorare su dati "reali" di PMI (file disomogenei, Excel, PDF, disegni, anagrafiche), non solo su dataset di laboratorio Conoscenza di cloud (Azure, AWS o GCP), Docker e integrazioni verso gestionali/ERP Interesse o prima esposizione al mondo edile, impiantistico o energetico (fotovoltaico, computi, capitolati) è un plus decisivo Disponibilità a operare da Pavia, a contatto con ufficio tecnico e commessa; italiano fluente, inglese tecnico Plus: dimestichezza con computi/prezzari, lettura di elaborati CAD, dati di producibilità FV, Power BI o automazioni (n8n/Power Automate). Caratteristiche personali Profilo concreto, poco accademico: sa spiegare l'AI a un capo commessa o a un preventivista e misura il valore in giorni-uomo e qualità dell'offerta, non in paper. È autonomo in una realtà di medio-piccole dimensioni, dove non esiste un team data science strutturato . Curioso verso il mestiere (coperture, tetti, impianti FV), paziente con dati imperfetti, orientato al rilascio di strumenti usabili. Precisione, senso pratico e capacità di stare in squadra con profili tecnici non informatici sono essenziali. Benefits Retribuzione: RAL 50.000-55.000 €, commisurata a esperienza e autonomia.. Contratto a tempo indeterminato, CCNL Edile.

Dans Un Pôle De Compétences à Forte Valeurs Ajoutées Au Sein D’un Bureau D’études Pluridisciplinaires De Plus De 20 Développeurs Et Sous La Responsabilité Du Directeur Technique, Vous Êtes Garant(e) Des Outils Nécessaires Au Traitement Des Données Massives Et De La Bonne Intégration De L’Intelligence Artificielle Au Développement Des Solutions De Sûreté Synchronic. Vous Mettez Votre Expertise à Disposition De Nos Équipes Et Vos Missions Sont Les Suivantes Analyser et développer une solution permettant le traitement de volumes importants de nos données en garantissant leur sécurité Concevoir et développer des algorithmes d’IA et d’apprentissage automatique Préconiser l’architecture technique nécessaire aux traitements des algorithmes conçus Collaborer avec les équipes interdisciplinaires pour intégrer des IA dans nos solutions Evaluer et améliorer les performances des modèles d’IA Anticiper les évolutions dans les données et préparer l’architecture de nos solutions à y répondre techniquement Intégrer la sobriété numérique dans la gestion des données en adoptant des pratiques responsables comme l’optimisation de l’infrastructure de stockage et de la puissance de calcul pour réduire la consommation d’énergie, ou la sélection de technologies moins énergivores Participer au respect des normes applicables au sein de l’entreprise dans son périmètre (qualité, sécurité de l’information…), et notamment la norme ISO9001 Assurer une veille technologique pour rester à jour sur les dernières avancées La liste de ces missions est non exhaustive et est susceptible d’évoluer en fonction des besoins du service, de votre polyvalence et de vos compétences en lien avec l’activité. Votre sens du service, votre rigueur et votre aisance relationnelle associés à votre esprit de méthode, vos qualités rédactionnelles et votre sens de l’innovation vous permettront d’accomplir vos missions avec succès. Rémunération selon profil + participation + aménagement de la durée du travail avec JATT. Poste basé à Franqueville-Saint-Pierre (76). Postuler

We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here. We turn possibility into production — delivering automation that improves customer experience, boosts productivity, and unlocks new business value. Working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success, the team ensures every deployment delivers measurable impact. This is a dynamic, hands-on role at the intersection of technical consulting , project leadership , and AI adoption strategy . You don’t need to be a full-time software engineer, but you should be fluent in APIs, very confident managing technical projects, and eager to continuously learn, build, and scale new models that empower both customers and teammates. items.desc: Do you like being ahead of the curve? Do you want to work on developing software for new, market-leading technology? As a Software Developer at Robin Radar, you will do just that! The ideal candidate will have the opportunity to directly work on our software development and will be able to build, adapt, and modify the software of our radar products. To put it in simple terms, you will develop mind-blowing radar tech! Your work will be crucial, as equipping our radars with the best performing software also creates a better functioning product for our customers and increases safety, too. Not only that, but you would be part of an amazing, growing, and agile R&D Software Development Team, reporting to a team lead who is there to support and guide you every step of the way. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable C++ code with a special focus on complex algorithms. Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to these problems. Help maintain code quality, organization, and automatization. Working with other departments on technical issues including software system design and maintenance. Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system. Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements. Give direction to software programming and documentation development. Requirements MSc degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years' experience as a C++ software developer with current knowledge of (advanced) C++ 17/20 standards. Extensive experience developing and deploying software on Linux, with a strong grasp of multithreaded code and real-time environments. Proficiency in Qt and experience with complex algorithms (e.g., image processing or tracking) with real-time performance. Knowledge of PostgreSQL databases, JSON, and XML. Familiarity with low-level hardware interactions and unit testing using GoogleTest. Experience with Bitbucket (or similar), Jira, Qt Creator and CI/CD (Jenkins). Solid understanding of the SDLC and experience in Agile/Scrum environments. Excellent communication in English (Dutch proficiency is a plus). Nice to have Experience with radar systems or a similar industry. Experience with embedded systems design. N.B. All applicants, we realize that this is quite the list and people come with various levels of experience. Don't be afraid to apply even if you feel you don't meet every desired skill. Our mission is a journey and there's plenty to learn on the way! But of course, you should identify with our core values: We trust, We own it & We aim high. Please note: We will request a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and conduct a background check according to our screening policy. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in this matter. What's In For You Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company. Comprehensive pension plan. Commuting allowance: our teams work hybrid. 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days). Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications. High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role. An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks! Our hiring process First interview: An introductory conversation with our Head of Software and one of the Team Leads to discuss your background, experience and mutual cultural fit. Coding challenge: A practical take-home C++ assignment designed to let you showcase your technical skills on your own time. Final interview: A technical deep-dive with 2 other team members to review your solution. Robin is a technology leader in tracking and classification of small objects. Our mission is to increase the safety of people and wildlife by preventing bird strikes in aviation, reducing the environmental impact of wind farms, and protecting humans and critical infrastructure against drones. We achieve this by combining purpose-built radars with unique software algorithms. This powerful combination allows us to provide actionable information that empowers users to prevent serious incidents. We’re growing. Fast. In fact, we are one of the top 10 fastest‑growing companies in the Netherlands. But despite this growth, we stay true to our core values of trust, ownership and aiming high. At Robin, you don’t join just a team. You join a collective of bright minds driven by the belief that ‘doing things better’ is a continuous challenge. Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning? You’ll fit right in, we’re saving you a seat.

You’ll become part of a high-performing team delivering solutions for one of the UK’s largest public sector organisations - giving you the chance to work on meaningful projects that truly matter.
