At Capgemini, we are helping shape a new age of intelligence, partnering with clients across industries to harness AI, technology, and human potential to drive meaningful change. As part of this journey, you’ll join one of our specialist tracks aligned to your interests: Data Engineer: turn data into powerful insights, working with modern analytics tools and cloud platforms to drive smarter, data-led decisions. Software Engineer: bring ideas to life by building scalable, user-focused applications using modern frameworks and full-stack technologies. Platform Engineer: develop and maintain secure, scalable cloud platforms and infrastructure using modern DevOps practices and platform technologies. At Capgemini, we are helping shape a new age of intelligence, partnering with clients across industries to harness AI, technology, and human potential to drive meaningful change. If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: Identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service) This role is based in either Telford or Hove, and you’ll typically be in the office up to 3 days a week, so you’ll need to be within commuting distance of your chosen location. The nature of this role requires you to work on a secure site, if this isn't a suitable location for you, we encourage you to explore our other graduate opportunities with Capgemini, which are available at various locations across the UK. Please also note that the Software Engineer and Platform Engineer pathways are only available at our Telford office, and the Data Engineer pathway is only available at our Hove office. items.title: Data Scientist - Statistical Programmer (f/m/x)
items.card: In this role, you will be responsible for authoring comprehensive Statistical Analysis Plans and executing regulatory-grade programming necessary for Analytical and Clinical Validation. You will work remotely, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with FDA and EMA standards. If you have a passion for applying statistical methods to enhance healthcare technologies, we encourage you to apply.
items.desc: We are seeking a detail-oriented Statistical Programmer to join our team focused on the statistical validation of Digital Health Technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for authoring comprehensive Statistical Analysis Plans and executing regulatory-grade programming necessary for Analytical and Clinical Validation. You will work remotely, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with FDA and EMA standards. If you have a passion for applying statistical methods to enhance healthcare technologies, we encourage you to apply. Your tasks Designing Statistical Analysis Plans for Clinical Validation to assess the Digital Health Technologies' capability in measuring clinically meaningful concepts using appropriate statistical models Selecting and documenting suitable statistical methods and success criteria to meet FDA and EMA validation requirements Writing clean, modular, and well-documented code in Python (or R) to generate necessary datasets and statistical outputs for regulatory submission Implementing software development best practices, including version control and automated testing, to ensure high-quality statistical programming outputs Ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, including 21 CFR Part 11 and Good Clinical Practice (GCP), throughout the statistical validation process Mapping raw and processed DHT data into CDISC-compliant data structures to facilitate efficient FDA review Compiling and structuring statistical reports and validation documentation for regulatory submissions, ensuring audit readiness Requirements Master's or Ph.D. in Biostatistics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field Minimum 6 years of experience in statistical programming or data science within the pharmaceutical, medical device, or CRO sectors, with a focus on clinical trial statistics and SAP authoring Advanced proficiency in Python for statistical programming, with a strong understanding of best practices in software development, such as Git and unit testing Expertise in validation statistics and methods for assessing measurement agreement, including Bland-Altman analysis and mixed-effects models Experience preparing statistical evidence for regulatory bodies such as the FDA and EMA, particularly in the context of clinical assessments Advanced level of English Poland as a current place of living Job no. JOB-WP33K Sii ensures that all hiring decisions are made solely on the basis of qualifications and competence. We are committed to equal and fair treatment of all, regardless of legally protected characteristics. items.desc: THD - Technische Hochschule Deggendorf Wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiterin / Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) für das Projekt "QUANDA" innerhalb des Instituts Future Technologies Deggendorf Aufgabe Sie entwickeln und implementieren Verfahren zur Zerlegung komplexer Quanten Circuits sowie Daten-Encodings indem Sie geeignete Einsatzszenarien unter Berücksichtigung bestehender Limitationen und Anforderungen analysieren. items.title: R&D Engineer – Inkjet Technology
items.card: In this role, you will explore the physics behind the printing process and develop solutions that directly contribute to future products and applications. From ink behavior and droplet formation to media interaction and drying processes, you will investigate the fundamental mechanisms that determine print quality and system performance. This is a highly multidisciplinary role where scientific insight is translated
items.desc: About This Vacancy Are you fascinated by the science behind advanced technology? Do you enjoy combining experimentation, data analysis, and physical modelling to solve complex engineering challenges? If so, this could be the perfect opportunity for you. We are looking for a Print Process Developer to join an innovative R&D team developing the next generation of industrial inkjet printing technology. In this role, you will explore the physics behind the printing process and develop solutions that directly contribute to future products and applications. From ink behavior and droplet formation to media interaction and drying processes, you will investigate the fundamental mechanisms that determine print quality and system performance. This is a highly multidisciplinary role where scientific insight is translated into technology that works in real-world printing systems. As a Print Process Developer, you will work on complex technical challenges at the intersection of physics, chemistry, and engineering. Your Responsibilities Will Include Investigating printing phenomena through experiments, measurements, data analysis, and physical modelling. Developing and optimizing print processes involving inks, printheads, media, drying, fixation, and image processing. Translating print-quality challenges and application requirements into physical questions and technical solutions. Designing and executing experiments using laboratory setups and industrial printing systems. Building, validating, and refining physical models to explain and predict process behavior. Analyzing complex datasets and using insights to improve print performance. Collaborating with specialists from multiple disciplines to understand process interactions and trade-offs. Converting scientific knowledge into robust, scalable solutions for future products and applications. You will be part of a multidisciplinary R&D organization where innovation is driven by collaboration. Working alongside physicists, chemists, engineers, software developers, and technology specialists, you will tackle challenges ranging from: Fluid dynamics Droplet generation and jetting behavior Ink-media interactions Drying and fixation processes Print quality optimization Process modelling and validation The unique aspect of this role is that you will not only develop theories and models but also test them directly on experimental setups and real industrial printing systems. What We Expect From You We are looking for a curious and analytical professional who enjoys understanding how complex systems work and translating scientific knowledge into practical solutions. Qualifications BSc, MSc or PhD in Physics, Applied Physics or Chemistry with a strong interest in material science Strong understanding of physical principles and engineering fundamentals. Hands-on experience or affinity with experimental research and measurement techniques. Ability to describe physical behavior through calculations, models, and data analysis. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. A structured approach to investigating and testing hypotheses. Interest in bridging the gap between scientific research and product development. Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams. Fluent in spoken and written English. What You Can Expect From Us The opportunity to work on cutting-edge inkjet technology within a highly innovative R&D environment. Challenging technical projects that combine physics, experimentation, modelling, and engineering. Collaboration with experienced specialists across multiple disciplines. A culture that encourages curiosity, innovation, and continuous learning. The chance to see your ideas evolve from scientific concepts into technologies used in real-world products. Excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.

L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Laboratoire d'astrophysique de Bordeaux Type de Contrat IT en contrat CDD Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 33615 PESSAC Durée du contrat 12 mois Date d'Embauche 01/12/2026 Rémuneration Rémunération mensuelle brute de 3143.64 € à 3403.43€ Postuler Date limite de candidature : vendredi 6 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions L'ingénieur (H/F) recruté sera chargé d'apporter son expertise en matière de calcul accéléré appliqué à la radio-interférométrie, dans le cadre du lot de travail n° 4 du projet SEAMS et en collaboration avec les autres partenaires. Ce projet a pour objectif d’explorer des stratégies à haut risque et à fort potentiel visant à améliorer la durabilité du SKAO, le plus grand observatoire radio du monde, et en particulier l’empreinte énergétique des infrastructures de calcul intensif, grâce à l’utilisation de technologies européennes souveraines et frugales. Réunissant l’expertise de six partenaires internationaux, le consortium SEAMS s’appuie sur une nouvelle approche de co-conception matérielle et logicielle multi-échelle afin de cartographier et de planifier de manière optimale l’exécution des pipelines de traitement des données du SKA sur des accélérateurs grand public et des composants spécifiques, à haute efficacité énergétique. L’ambition de SEAMS est de combler le fossé en matière de programmabilité et de performances entre les processeurs à usage général et les processeurs à jeu d’instructions spécifique à un domaine, afin de permettre la migration des données et des tâches vers la ressource la plus durable au sein de la cyber-infrastructure complexe du SKA. L'Activité Travailler sur des modules portables de traitement des données mettant en œuvre des flux de tâches en radioastronomie, y compris le déploiement de ces flux Contribuer à la mise en œuvre de démonstrateurs destinés à la radioastronomie, qui seront optimisés et évalués sur des accélérateurs d’IA spécialisés Explorer les possibilités d’accélération au sein des flux de travail en radioastronomie. items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Laboratory Setting At Thermo Fisher Scientific you will join a scientific environment focused on turning complex biological questions into practical solutions for researchers. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of proteomics, helping shape technologies and workflows that can make advanced experiments more accessible, robust and impactful. We are seeking a Staff Scientist to provide scientific and technical leadership for the development of our next-generation proteomics sample preparation solutions. The successful candidate will bring a deep understanding of proteomics and its application to biological research, together with a strong appreciation of customer workflows, challenges and emerging needs. You will identify opportunities where new sample preparation tools can enable better proteomics experiments and help define the technologies, reagent kits and workflows needed to address them. Working across R&D and multidisciplinary teams, you will help shape our technology strategy and lead the development, automation and validation of new solutions that support innovation and new product development. This role is well suited to a scientist who enjoys connecting deep technical expertise with real customer needs and who wants to influence the future of proteomics sample preparation through practical, high-quality scientific solutions. Key Responsibilities Provide scientific leadership and expertise in proteomics, with a strong understanding of how proteomics is used to address biological questions. Understand customer workflows, applications and pain points and identify opportunities for new sample preparation tools and solutions. Lead the development, optimization, automation and validation of next-generation proteomics sample preparation workflows. Maintain a strong understanding of emerging trends, technologies and applications in proteomics and assess their implications for future product development. Collaborate across R&D, product management, commercial and other functions to connect customer needs with technology and product strategy. Requirements Qualifications and Experience: PhD, MSc or equivalent experience in proteomics, analytical chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology or a related discipline. Deep knowledge of mass spectrometry-based proteomics and its application to biological research. Strong understanding of proteomics sample preparation, experimental workflows and factors influencing data quality and biological insight. Strong scientific problem-solving, experimental design and data interpretation skills. Demonstrated scientific or technical leadership and ability to influence multidisciplinary teams. Excellent communication skills and ability to engage effectively with scientists, customers and internal stakeholders. Experience with automation, development of reagent-based workflows or translation of technologies into commercial products would be an advantage. We review applications continuously and may progress with suitable candidates as they apply, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

items.desc: Over deze vacature Bij TNO zetten we de nieuwste wetenschappelijke inzichten om in innovatieve technologische oplossingen en toepassingen. We ontwerpen en bouwen systemen die gebruikmaken van kwantumeigenschappen en slaan daarmee de brug tussen fundamenteel onderzoek en praktische toepassingen via testfaciliteiten, demonstratoren en productontwikkeling. Voor quantumsensing op basis van Rydberg-atomen bouwen we onze expertise verder op. Jij krijgt daarin een specialistische rol. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen de technologie, maar helpt ook de experimentele infrastructuur opzetten die nodig is om ideeën daadwerkelijk te kunnen bouwen en testen. Daarbij kijk je verder dan het experiment alleen. Je onderzoekt samen met collega's, klanten en partners waar deze technologie kan worden toegepast en helpt de mogelijkheden van Rydberg-quantumsensing zichtbaar en concreet te maken. Wat ga je doen? Je gaat aan de slag binnen de afdeling Quantum Technology van TNO. Hier werk je aan projecten voor klanten én in nauwe samenwerking met partners binnen het Nederlandse en Europese kwantumecosysteem. In deze functie werk je aan het opbouwen van onze kennis en experimentele mogelijkheden rond quantumsensoren op basis van Rydberg-atomen. Je vertaalt wetenschappelijke kennis en concepten naar experimentele ontwerpen en bouwt de opstellingen waarmee we deze in de praktijk kunnen onderzoeken en demonstreren. Dat betekent dat je zelf oplossingen moet ontwerpen en uitwerken. Je bouwt en test experimentele opstellingen en werkt daarbij met optische systemen, elektronica en software. Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van operationele concepten en proof-of-conceptdemonstraties en laat zien hoe de onderliggende meetprincipes in de praktijk kunnen werken. Tegelijk help je het expertisegebied verder te ontwikkelen. Je zoekt actief de verbinding met mogelijke toepassingen en externe partijen en denkt mee over waar deze technologie toegevoegde waarde kan hebben. Je kunt complexe wetenschap begrijpelijk maken voor anderen en krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen in de ontwikkeling van dit nieuwe werkgebied. Zo draag je eraan bij dat nieuwe quantumsensortechnologie niet in het lab blijft, maar wordt vertaald naar toepassingen die relevant zijn voor klanten en uiteindelijk bijdragen aan de veiligheid van Nederland. Wat wij van jou verwachten We zoeken een specialist die graag iets nieuws opbouwt. Je combineert wetenschappelijke diepgang met een praktische instelling. Je vindt het interessant om vanuit een idee of wetenschappelijk concept zelf de stap naar een werkende experimentele opstelling te maken. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar zoekt actief de samenwerking met collega's en externe partijen. Je neemt initiatief, brengt je eigen inhoudelijke perspectief in en kunt tegelijkertijd voortbouwen op de expertise van anderen. Ook vind je het interessant om verder te kijken dan de technologie zelf en mee te denken over nieuwe toepassingen en samenwerkingen. Wat je meebrengt Een master- of promotiediploma (PhD) in Experimentele Natuurkunde, Engineering of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied. Praktische ervaring met het ontwerpen, bouwen en testen van kwantuminstrumentatie, bij voorkeur op basis van Rydberg-atomen. Ervaring met optische systemen en elektronica. Sterke programmeervaardigheden, met name in Python. Het vermogen om wetenschappelijke kennis te vertalen naar experimentele ontwerpen en werkende opstellingen. Initiatief en ondernemerschap om een nieuw expertisegebied verder te helpen ontwikkelen. Het vermogen om verbinding te leggen tussen technologie, mogelijke toepassingen en externe partijen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels. Een zelfstandige en samenwerkingsgerichte manier van werken. Wat wij jou bieden Uitdagend én afwisselend werk met serieuze impact. En volop kansen, want bij TNO heb je grotendeels zelf de regie over je carrière. Naast een bruto (fulltime) maandsalaris tussen € 3500,- en € 5500,- (afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring), vakantiegeld (8%), een 13de maand (8,33%) en een flexbudget (5,58% + € 180), krijg je alle mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Misschien wil je doorgroeien in de richting commercie of consultancy. Of wil je projectmanager worden, jezelf meer verdiepen in duurzame innovaties of carrière maken als technisch expert. Daarnaast kun je bij TNO een ‘menu’ aan arbeidsvoorwaarden samenstellen dat bij jouw persoonlijke situatie past. Wat je ook mag verwachten Een uiterst professionele, innovatieve werkomgeving, met topexperts als collega’s. Mogelijkheid om cursussen, opleidingen en workshops te volgen en congressen te bezoeken, en coaching als je daar behoefte aan hebt. 33 vakantiedagen plus een flexibele feestdag, die in te zetten is op een culturele, religieuze of anderszins belangrijke dag naar keuze (bij een fulltime dienstverband). Een werkgever die divers talent waardeert en stimuleert, met initiatieven als Jong TNO, verschillende expertise gildes, onze Rainbow Community en Round Tables over …

items.desc: About This Position At TNO, we turn the latest scientific insights into innovative technological solutions and applications. We design and build systems that harness quantum properties, bridging the gap between fundamental research and practical applications through test facilities, demonstrators and product development. We are further developing our expertise in quantum sensing based on Rydberg atoms. You will have a specialist role in this field. You will not only develop the technology itself, but also help build the experimental infrastructure needed to turn ideas into systems that can actually be built and tested. Your perspective extends beyond the experiment itself. Together with colleagues, clients and partners, you explore where this technology can be applied and help make the potential of Rydberg quantum sensing tangible and concrete. What will be your role? You will join TNO's Quantum Technology department, working on projects for clients and in close collaboration with partners across the Dutch and European quantum ecosystem. In this role, you will help build our knowledge and experimental capabilities in quantum sensors based on Rydberg atoms. You translate scientific knowledge and concepts into experimental designs and build the setups needed to investigate and demonstrate them in practice. This means developing and working out solutions yourself. You build and test experimental setups using optical systems, electronics and software. You contribute to the development of operational concepts and proof-of-concept demonstrations, showing how the underlying measurement principles can work in practice. At the same time, you help further develop this field of expertise. You actively connect with potential applications and external partners and explore where this technology can add value. You can make complex science understandable to others and have the opportunity to take initiative in developing this new field. In this way, you help ensure that new quantum sensing technology moves beyond the lab and is translated into applications that are relevant to clients and ultimately contribute to the security of the Netherlands. What we expect from you We are looking for a specialist who enjoys building something new. You combine scientific depth with a hands-on mindset and enjoy taking an idea or scientific concept all the way to a working experimental setup. You work independently while actively seeking collaboration with colleagues and external partners. You take initiative, bring your own technical perspective and know how to build on the expertise of others. You are also interested in looking beyond the technology itself and contributing to new applications and collaborations. What you bring A Master's degree or PhD in Experimental Physics, Engineering or a comparable field. Hands-on experience in designing, building and testing quantum instrumentation, preferably based on Rydberg atoms. Experience with optical systems and electronics. Strong programming skills, particularly in Python. The ability to translate scientific knowledge into experimental designs and working setups. Initiative and an entrepreneurial mindset to help develop a new field of expertise. The ability to connect technology with potential applications and external partners. Strong communication skills in English. An independent and collaborative way of working. What you'll get in return Challenging and varied work with a real impact. And plenty of opportunities as, at TNO, you are in charge of shaping your career. We offer a gross monthly salary between €3500,- and € 5500,- (based on your knowledge and experience), 8% holiday pay, a 13th month bonus of 8.33% and a flex budget (5.58% + € 180). In addition, you will be given every opportunity to develop yourself. Perhaps you would like to grow your career in the direction of commerce or consultancy? Or would you like to become a project manager? Immerse yourself in sustainable innovations? Or carve out a career as a technical expert? TNO offers optional employee benefits, enabling you to tailor your benefits package to match your personal situation. You may also expect An extremely professional, innovative working environment where colleagues are leading experts in their field. The opportunity to attend courses, workshops and conferences, and to receive training and coaching based on your needs. 33 days annual leave plus a flexible holiday that can be used on a cultural, religious, or otherwise important day of your choosing (on a full-time basis). An employer working towards a respectful, inclusive, and equitable work environment where every employee can flourish, with various initiatives such as Jong TNO, numerous expertise based guilds, Rainbow Community and Round Tables on diverse inclusion topics. We offer a comprehensive and flexible mobility plan that also includes full compensation for public transportation for commuting and business travel. Great social events with your team …

items.title: Ingénieur Matériaux Céramiques & Modélisation F/H
items.card: vos missions et de trouver pleinement votre place au sein de nos équipes. Ce poste est peut-être fait pour vous. Alors osez vous lancer : cliquez, candidatez !
items.desc: Vous êtes rattaché au groupe Céramiques, Accidents et Modélisation (CAM) de l'ingénierie du combustible de la Business Unit Fuel, dont les activités principales sont de : Définir les exigences de conception et fabrication des céramiques nucléaires et traiter les écarts à celles-ci qui peuvent survenir lors de la fabrication. Participer au développement et à la qualification de nouveaux produits combustibles et justifier leur comportement en réacteur, par exemple les solutions EATF (Enhanced Accident Tolerant Fuel), le combustible TRISO (Tri-Structural Isotropic) ou pour RNR (réacteur à neutrons rapides). Réaliser des études spécifiques, via des outils de modélisation numérique, portant sur le comportement du combustible dans diverses situations. Etudier et justifier le comportement du crayon combustible dans les situations accidentelles. L’équipe CAM souhaite renforcer ses activités portant sur les céramiques nucléaires (UO2, MOX, B4C, SiC, etc.). Ainsi, en tant qu'ingénieur Matériaux Céramiques & Modélisation, vous réaliserez des activités de support à la fabrication des produits céramiques, des étude de R&D sur leurs comportement et propriétés et des travaux de modélisation thermomécanique. Plus précisément, les principales missions qui vous seront confiées sont : Des contributions à la documentation des exigences techniques encadrant la fabrication du combustible (spécification, plan, etc.), à la validation des évolutions des procédés de fabrication (qualification) et la gestion des écarts et anomalies survenant en usine. Des études de R&D, concernant la définition de solutions de combustible innovantes (EATF, combustible RNR ou TRISO, etc.) et visant l'amélioration des connaissances quant au comportement de ces produits. Selon vos prédispositions et motivations, des missions secondaires pourront être confiées: Des simulations numériques du comportement du combustible à l'aide d'outils de calculs scientifiques propres à Framatome ou externes (FEniCS, Cast3M, etc.). Le développement et la validation des outils de calculs et de leur environnement (outils de pré-, post-traitement, automatisation, etc.). Dans ces missions, vous serez en relation avec de nombreux interlocuteurs, en France et à l’international : Les usines de fabrication de combustible de la Direction des Opérations Fuel (DOF) de Framatome et celles des fournisseurs. Les autres services de l’ingénierie du combustible, notamment ceux responsables de la conception du crayon combustible ou de la neutronique. Les clients, les exploitants de réacteurs nucléaires. Profil Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur, d'un équivalent universitaire ou d'un doctorat dans le domaine des Matériaux et/ou de la Mécanique. Idéalement, vous possédez une première expérience dans le domaine des céramiques nucléaires. Pour mener à bien vos activités, vous démontrez : Une bonne connaissance du comportement thermomécanique des matériaux. Une connaissance des céramiques nucléaires sera un atout indéniable. Un bon esprit de synthèse et d’analyse, avec la capacité de faire des recommandations et de prendre des décisions. Une première expérience dans les domaines de la R&D ou du support à la fabrication, démontrant ces aptitudes sera appréciée. Thanks for your interest in working on our team! We are currently looking for a highly motivated and creative Engineer Advanced Technology (M/F/D) to shape with us the future of optical communication and fiber optic sensing technology by joining our Advanced Technology team in Meiningen, Germany. With its large research laboratory equipped with high-performance devices and its proximity to the R&D department, this environment provides ideal research conditions. Furthermore, this position offers the opportunity to work towards a PhD degree. ADTRAN is a leading manufacturer of optical connectivity solutions from access to long-haul with a strong presence in Europe. If you want to be a part of our growing company that is driven by innovation and is focused on building the future together with our employees, consider applying. Principle Duties And Essential Functions Performing research on optical transmission systems, subsystems and distributed fiber sensing with focus on the physical layer Setting up experimental assemblies in the laboratory and conducting experiments Contribution to the organization of the laboratory Cooperation with national and international project partners Internal subproject lead for research and advanced development projects Creative application of knowledge and experience in the several of the following fields: Technologies for increasing capacity of optical communication systems (multi-band transmission, space-division multiplexing) Amplifier setups for new applications Techniques for monitoring signal quality in optical networks Joint data communication and distributed fiber sensing Knowledge, Skills And Experience Required Diploma or Master degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics or related area Good programming skills (e.g. Python, C/C++) Good knowledge in optical transmission technologies and optical fiber effects Laboratory experience in optical sub-system and system characterization Ideally experience in one or more of the following topics: Coherent optical transmission and optical modulation Optical amplification and switching Monitoring of signal quality in an optical network Good presentation and communication skills Innovative, highly motivated personality Fluent in oral and written English, fluency in German is a plus Capability to think strategic, innovative, constructive and application oriented Benefits Possibility to work in an international, multicultural environment Strong team-oriented, friendly work culture and flexible working hours (work-life-balance) Internal training program Fitness, commuting and kindergarten allowance as well as drinks and fruits for free Employee discounts e. g. for events and branded products

items.desc: Location: London, candidates must have existing right to work in the UK Position type: Fixed Term Contract until March 2028, Full Time What The Hiring Manager Says “The ideal candidate is someone who pairs a strong ability to develop and lead impactful research with genuine technical fluency across the AI ecosystem, from infrastructure, compute and data through to models, applications and the distribution layer needed for impact-driven AI innovations to scale sustainably and responsibly. They’re as comfortable articulating global trends as they are looking under the hood of an innovation to spot where frugal, responsible AI can unlock socioeconomic, financial and climate resilience in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs).” ~Ibrahim Sajid, Senior Insights Manager, Emerging Tech About The Team GSMA Mobile for Development (M4D) is a dedicated global team within the GSMA, which brings together our mobile operator members, tech innovators, the development community and governments, to realise the impact of mobile in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). items.card: The role bridges R&D interfaces and operates at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, operations, EHS and quality. As such, the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams will be essential. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver, an effective communicator, and a team player who can influence outcomes through expertise, collaboration, and execution. This role is central to UDC’s vision
items.desc: At Universal Display Corporation (Nasdaq: OLED) (UDC), we’re changing the way people see the world. If you’re reading this on a smartphone, there’s a good chance UDC’s materials are producing the light and color shining from your screen right now. UDC’s OLED ingredients are key parts of stunning, energy-efficient displays used in everything from smartwatches to phones, tablets, laptops, monitors, TVs and automobiles. Virtually every OLED consumer electronics product around the world uses UDC’s phosphorescent OLED materials and technologies. UDC is a publicly traded company and pioneer in the OLED industry. When you join our global team, you are embarking on a journey at the forefront of display technology and organic electronics that impacts the daily lives of people around the world. From engineers to chemists, Ph.D. scientists, technicians, lawyers and more, our UDC team is continuously advancing our field. With a focus on energy efficiency, UDC’s team is contributing to making a better, more sustainable planet. Please visit us at www.oled.com. Job Summary The Process Development Scientist, Flow Chemistry role will lead the development of advanced continuous-flow and intensified chemical processes that enable the production of next-generation OLED materials. This is a hands-on, laboratory-based role. The successful candidate will combine expertise in organic synthesis, flow chemistry, process engineering, and engineering design to develop safe, efficient, and scalable processes for strategically important OLED materials. From early-stage laboratory development through pilot-scale implementation and technology transfer, this role will play a key part in transforming innovative chemistry into robust processes that can be reliably and safely implemented at scale. Success in this position requires strong technical leadership and a highly collaborative mindset. The role bridges R&D interfaces and operates at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, operations, EHS and quality. As such, the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams will be essential. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver, an effective communicator, and a team player who can influence outcomes through expertise, collaboration, and execution. This role is central to UDC’s vision of building a world-class advanced process and product development capability. It offers a unique opportunity to shape future chemical production technologies, establish new process platforms, and contribute directly to the development and commercialization of innovative OLED materials. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and scale-up of continuous-flow and intensified chemical processes, transforming laboratory concepts into safe, robust, and commercially viable processes. Drive process and reaction engineering excellence through the design, optimization, and implementation of scalable synthetic routes, flow reactor systems, and downstream processing strategies. Develop the technical foundation for successful commercialization, including process design packages, operating windows, scale-up strategies, risk assessments, and technology transfer documentation. Collaborate across R&D, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and EHS to advance strategic development programs, ensure process safety, and enable successful deployment of new technologies. Provide technical leadership for equipment qualification, commissioning, technology transfer and process implementation. Build organizational capability through problem solving, knowledge management, and mentorship, driving continuous improvement and fostering a culture of innovation, safety, and scientific rigor. Qualifications: PhD in Chemistry or Chemical Engineering. Industrial experience developing and implementing chemical processes, with a track record of translating laboratory innovation into scalable processes. Expertise in flow chemistry, continuous processes, process intensification, reaction engineering, or related technologies, with experience applying these approaches to solve complex chemical process challenges. Strong understanding of process development fundamentals, including process safety, scale-up, heat and mass transfer, reaction optimization, and unit operations. High level of proficiency in the application of modern analytical techniques (e.g., HPLC/UPLC, GC, MS, IR, NMR, etc.) to reaction/process monitoring, material characterization and structure elucidation. Experience leading cross-functional technical projects, including technology transfer, process documentation, and collaboration across R&D, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and EHS organizations. Effective communicator and problem solver, capable of influencing diverse stakeholders through scientific rigor, data-driven decision making, and clear technical communication.

items.desc: Brief Info About Vinted Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. Information About The Position As a Decision Scientist in the Search Relevance team within the Buyer domain, you will partner with Data Scientists, Engineers, and a Product Manager to improve how members search our catalog and maximize buyer conversion. The Buyer domain is organized across three layers of product teams: the Experience layer (Discovery & Rediscovery, Search & Refinement), the Content layer (Search Relevance, Recommender Relevance, Content Visibility Management), and the Platform layer (Search Platform, Content Visibility Platform). Together, these teams ensure members find relevant items effortlessly across millions of unique second-hand listings. Within Search Relevance, our scope spans the entire search journey: from semantic and keyword retrieval (including Dense Retrieval vector search) to multi-stage ML ranking (pre-ranking, deep reranking, and personalization). In this role, you will collaborate with your Product Manager, a senior Decision Scientist, and the engineering team to lead analytical discovery, identify search friction and opportunity areas, define success metrics, and design and evaluate A/B experiments measuring the business and member impact of our ranking and retrieval algorithms. You will also be part of the Buyer Decision Science community, collaborating quarterly on technical standards, domain-wide analyses, and experimentation capabilities. Additionally, you will participate in Vinted’s company-wide Data Science & Analytics (DSA) guild, which regularly hosts knowledge-sharing sessions, workshops, and off-sites. In this position, you’ll Collaborate closely with your Product Manager, Data Scientists, and Engineers to uncover search improvement opportunities, size their potential, and provide clear, evidence-based recommendations. Formulate testable hypotheses, establish tracking requirements, and analyze online experiments to measure the causal impact of new retrieval and ranking algorithms on buyer conversion and engagement. Define and monitor metrics and experiment guardrails for Search Relevance, proactively investigating anomalies and diagnosing root causes behind their movements. Build and maintain reliable, intuitive dashboards (e.g. in Looker) that enable your team and cross-functional stakeholders to track search health and feature performance independently. Ensure team initiatives have clear success criteria and decision rules before launch. About You Highly oriented toward business results and actionable recommendations. Good communicator who can present results in an informative and persuasive manner to a wide range of stakeholders. Experience as a Decision Scientist, Data Analyst or Data Scientist. Experience with A/B testing and product development. Knowledge of at least one statistical programming language (Python, R, Scala, etc.) Proficient in SQL and dashboarding tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau, etc.) You are passionate about applying data analytics and excited to use intelligent tools and techniques to uncover insights, improve decision-making and solve real-world business problems. University degree in statistics, econometrics, economics, business, or a related field. Excellent written and spoken English skills. Advantage: Experience with search, ranking or retrieval-based algorithms. Work perks The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme 30 days of paid annual leave Newest MacBook models Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP) Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal …

items.desc: The Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence (CFI), with the Institute for Technology and Humanity (ITH) at the University of Cambridge invites applications for two Research Assistant / Associates. The appointment will be full-time, for 24 months in the first instance (ideal start date 1st of December, or soon after that). The successful candidates will work on a project focused on establishing "red lines" for AI using cognitive capability and propensity profiles. The work will focus on AI Evaluation and will be drawing from multiple disciplines, but primarily from artificial intelligence, technical AI safety, Bayesian statistics and causal modelling, psychology and AI governance. Appointment at the Research Associate level is dependent on the award of a PhD. This is a postdoctoral-level appointment, those who have submitted but not yet received their PhD will be appointed at the Research Assistant -Grade 5, which will be amended to Research Associate-Grade 7 once the award of the PhD has been conferred. CFI is a highly interdisciplinary research centre addressing the challenges and opportunities posed by artificial intelligence (AI). Based at the University of Cambridge, the Centre has close links with industry, policymakers, and many academic disciplines. In order for your application to be considered, please upload the following: Curriculum Vitae (CV) A Covering Letter of no more than 1,000 words. This should detail relevant experience and interests with particular regard to this project The names and contact details of two referees who are familiar with your work. If you upload any additional documents which have not been requested, we will not be able to consider these as part of your application. Informal enquiries about the role are welcomed and should be directed to Professor Jose Hernandez-Orallo at jh2135@cam.ac.uk. items.title: ESPRC IDLA Studentship - Research into Low order modelling of Rotating Detonation Engines
items.card: Applications are invited for a fully funded 4-year PhD studentship at the University of Cambridge to conduct research into low order models of a rotating detonation engine, in collaboration with Rolls-Royce under the Industrial Doctoral Landscape Award (IDLA) scheme. Rotating Detonation Engines offer a potential improvement towards lower weight/higher power propulsion systems compared to to conventional gas turbine
items.desc: Applications are invited for a fully funded 4-year PhD studentship at the University of Cambridge to conduct research into low order models of a rotating detonation engine, in collaboration with Rolls-Royce under the Industrial Doctoral Landscape Award (IDLA) scheme. Rotating Detonation Engines offer a potential improvement towards lower weight/higher power propulsion systems compared to to conventional gas turbine engines. This project involves the development of a skeleton simplified model for a rotating detonation engine (RDE), using existing models, which will be coded it in a way that makes it simple to access potential performance using realistic thermodynamics. Validation will be conducted using higher fidelity models (RANS and/or LES) and potential experiments. The model will eventually extend to liquid fuels and integrate with a gas turbine simulation platform to simulate the overall system. The project is funded by Rolls-Royce and EPSRC, and belongs to a larger overall initiative on advanced propulsion concepts. The Student Is Expected To Undertake The Following Activities Training in thermodynamic modelling of compressible and supersonic systems Translate existing thermodynamic codes for chemical modelling and detonation toolbox into open source code Implement existing eigenvalue simulation for determination of RDE frequency and cycle properties as a function of operating condition Validate the implemented code against existing higher fidelity simulations and experimental results Extension of the code to include different fuels, geometries and interfaces with compressor and turbine Produce periodic progress reports and present and engage with company specialists Attend International Conferences and submit papers to Journals Attend Annual Doctoral Conference/Symposia organised by Rolls-Royce and other related organisations Qualifications Applicants should have (or expect to be awarded) a good UK Master's degree (or overseas equivalent) in a relevant science subject (Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics), preferably with a focus on fluid mechanics and numerical methods, with some programming experience (Python/C++). The applicant should be self-motivated, but able to work as part of a team, and effectively communicate their research findings. EPSRC IDLA studentships are four-year awards that cover full fees and maintenance, and are available for eligible home students and a limited number of international students. To apply for this studentship, please send your two page CV to Prof Simone Hochgreb (sh372@cam.ac.uk) to arrive no later than 28 February 2027. Applications may close early if the position is filled before this date. Please note that any offer of funding will be conditional on securing a place as a PhD student. Candidates will need to apply separately for admission through the University's Graduate Admissions application portal; this can be done before or after applying for this funding opportunity. The applicant portal can be accessed via: www.graduate.study.cam.ac.uk/courses/directory/egegpdpeg. The final deadline for PhD applications is 14 May 2027, although it is advisable to apply earlier than this. The University actively supports equality, diversity and inclusion and encourages applications from all sections of society.

items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth. As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details. What You’ll Do Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making; Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers; Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights. What We’re Looking For Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics; Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems; Fluency in English, both spoken and written. Nice-to-Have Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas; Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python; Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets. €45,000 - €75,000 a year Please note: this is the same position as the one referred as “Data Scientist” on our career site, posted with different job titles to reach STEM students and graduates who might not know a Data Scientist role suits them. Why you'll love it here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 💵 Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from €45k up to €75k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

items.desc: At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One. As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. Detta gör vi genom att utveckla, producera och sälja världens mest avancerade försvarsmateriel. BAE Systems Bofors verksamhet finns längs med hela Sveriges försvarspolitiska säkerhetsbälte och företaget har cirka 1000 medarbetare placerade i Karlstad, Karlskoga och Örebro. Företaget ingår i en av världens största försvarsindustrikoncern, BAE Systems, med över 100 000 anställda. Detta ger oss unika möjligheter att kombinera vår långa tradition av lokal expertis med världsledande internationell erfarenhet. Varje år gör flera studenter sina examensarbeten hos BAE Systems Bofors i Karlskoga. Vi som arbetsgivare ser examensarbete som en möjlighet för oss att lära känna potentiella framtida medarbetare, men också som en chans för dig som student att testa dina kunskaper, lära känna vår organisation och ta steget närmare en anställning. Vill du göra ditt examensarbete i en högteknologisk miljö där teori möter praktik? Hos BAE Systems Bofors erbjuder vi spännande examensarbeten där du får möjlighet att arbeta med avancerade simuleringar, experimentella tester och bidra till utvecklingen av framtidens försvarssystem. Som examensarbetare hos BAE Systems Bofors blir du en del av en kultur präglad av samarbete, innovation och kunskapsdelning. Din röst är viktig och nya idéer uppmuntras. Du får en konkret inblick i hur det är att arbeta som analysingenjör och möjlighet att bidra till utvecklingen av verkliga produkter och lösningar. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med erfarna ingenjörer och experter, och du får tillgång till modern analysutrustning i en dynamisk miljö där både praktiskt och teoretiskt arbete är centralt. För dig som är intresserad av en framtid som analysingenjör är detta en utmärkt möjlighet att få inblick i yrkesrollen och utveckla relevanta färdigheter. Vi har ett kontinuerligt rekryteringsbehov inom området och ser examensarbeten som en naturlig och viktig väg till framtida anställning – flera av våra tidigare exjobbare är idag en del av vårt team. Numerisk modellering av snabba tryckförlopp i gasgenererande kammare med OpenFOAM Bakgrund Snabba tryckförlopp i gasgenererande kammare förekommer i många tekniska system, där gas bildas i en begränsad volym och strömmar genom kanaler och komplex geometri. Tryckutvecklingen beror både på hur gasen genereras (t.ex. genom förbränning av ett drivmedel) och hur den strömmar och expanderar. I dag används olika typer av beräkningsmodeller, från enkla 0D/1D- och 2D-modeller till högupplösta 3D-CFD- och FE-modeller. En viktig fråga är när en enklare modell är tillräckligt bra och när högre modellfidelitet motiveras av krav på noggrannhet och detaljnivå. Ökad modellfidelitet ger möjlighet att beskriva fler fysikaliska fenomen och lokala effekter, men innebär samtidigt ökad komplexitet och beräkningskostnad. En central frågeställning är därför vilken modellnivå som krävs för att beskriva olika delar av förloppet med tillräcklig noggrannhet. OpenFOAM är en öppen och väl beprövad CFD-kod för kompressibla, transienta flöden som kan utökas med egna källtermer och partikelmodeller. Det gör verktyget väl lämpat för studier av gasdynamik i gasgenererande kammare. Syfte Att utveckla och använda en 3D-CFD-modell i OpenFOAM för att studera snabba tryckförlopp i en gasgenererande kammare, och genom jämförelse med enklare 0D/1D/2D-modeller analysera när olika modellfideliteter är lämpliga med avseende på noggrannhet, beräkningstid och användbarhet. En ytterligare frågeställning är hur olika representationer av gasgenereringen påverkar simuleringsresultaten och vilka fysikaliska fenomen som behöver modelleras explicit för att uppnå önskad prediktionsförmåga. Innehåll och arbetsuppgifter Litteraturstudie kring snabba tryckförlopp i gasgenererande kammare, modeller för gasproduktion (brinnlagar, källtermer) samt vanliga 0D/1D/2D- och 3D-metoder inom området. Framtagning eller förenkling av en representativ geometri för kammare och kanaler, samt generering av beräkningsnät (t.ex. med snappyHexMesh). Uppställning av en transient, kompressibel OpenFOAM-modell med relevanta rand- och initialvillkor. Implementering/konfiguration av modeller för gasutveckling från drivmedel och jämförelse mellan olika sätt att representera drivmedlet: som en lumpad gasproducerande volym, som en rumsupplöst volym i 3D, som möjlig fördjupning, som diskreta korn (Lagrange-partiklar) där rörelse och omfördelning kan studeras. Genomförande av simuleringar för representativa lastfall och jämförelse av tryck–tid-förlopp, flödesfält, i förekommande fall kornrörelse, samt beräkningstid mellan de olika modellfideliteterna. Jämförelse med resultat från enklare 0D/1D/2D-modeller och analys av avvikelser och överensstämmelse. Analys av sambandet mellan modellernas komplexitet, beräkningskostnad och förmåga att beskriva relevanta fysikaliska …

Job Description Summary 
Als Elektrotechniker übernehmen Sie eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle in der operativen Instandhaltung und stellen den sicheren Betrieb elektrischer Anlagen sicher. Sie führen selbstständig Wartungs‑, Reparatur‑ und Störungsbehebungsarbeiten durch, unterstützen Elektro‑Projekte und bringen sich aktiv in die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Prozessen (KVP) ein. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Kolleg:innen, externen Firmen sowie dem Produktionspersonal zusammen und gewährleisten die fachgerechte Umsetzung und Dokumentation aller Tätigkeiten gemäß GxP‑Richtlinien und geltenden Industriestandards. 
 Job Description 
 Deine Verantwortungen: 
 Durchführung von elektrotechnischen Wartungsarbeiten gemäß interner Vorgaben.
 Mitarbeit bei der Umsetzung von Elektro-Projekten.
 Selbstständige Umsetzung von Wartungstätigkeiten, Reparaturarbeiten, Fehlersuche und Fehlerbehebungen.
 Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung von Abläufen und Prozessen (KVP).
 Enge Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung bei der täglichen Arbeit innerhalb der Abteilung, sowie mit externen Firmen und Technikern.
 Umsetzung und Dokumentation aller Arbeiten unter Einhaltung von GxP-Richtlinien und Industriestandards.
 Einhaltung von Vorgaben aus Wartungs und Arbeitsplänen bei der Ausführung spezifischer Tätigkeiten.
 Unterstützung bei der Einschulung von neuen oder externen Mitarbeitern und dem Produktionspersonal.
 Was Sie für die Rolle mitbringen: 
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik.
 Für die Stelle sind gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie Grundkenntnisse in Englisch erforderlich.
 Teamfähigkeit (Teamplayer).
 Erste Berufserfahrung idealerweise im GxP-Bereich ist von Vorteil.
 You are applying to be part of the Novartis Talent Pool. We are not currently recruiting for this role but we are building a pipeline for future opportunities. If you would like to be considered for a similar position in future, then please submit your CV. 
 Warum Novartis? 
 Unser Vorsatz ist es, die Medizin neu zu gestalten, um Menschenleben zu verbessern und zu verlängern. Unsere Vision ist es, das wertvollste und vertrauenswürdigste Pharmaunternehmen der Welt zu werden. Wie wir das erreichen werden? Mit unseren Mitarbeitern. Es sind unsere Mitarbeiter, die uns tagtäglich dazu antreiben, unsere Ziele zu erreichen. Werden Sie Teil dieser Mission und dieses großartigen Teams! Erfahren Sie hier mehr: https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture 
 Stellen Sie sich vor, was Sie bei Novartis tun könnten!
 Was wir bieten: Neben einem marktgerechten Grundgehalt bieten wir ein attraktives Bonus/Incentive Programm, eine moderne Firmenpension, Kinderbetreuungseinrichtungen, Aus- und Weiterbildungsprogramme und weltweite Karrieremöglichkeiten innerhalb der Novartis Gruppe. Das Grundgehalt für diese Position besteht aus dem kollektivvertraglichen Mindestgehalt in Höhe von € 47.532,24/Jahr (auf Vollzeitbasis) sowie einer allfälligen Überzahlung, basierend auf Ihren bisherigen Erfahrungen, Qualifikationen und individuellen Kompetenzen. 
 Engagement für Vielfalt und Inklusion: Novartis setzt sich für Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und Inklusion ein. Wir sind bestrebt, vielfältige Teams zusammenzustellen, die für die Patienten und Gemeinschaften repräsentativ sind, denen wir dienen. Wir bemühen uns um die Schaffung eines inklusiven Arbeitsplatzes, der durch Zusammenarbeit mutige Innovationen fördert und unsere Mitarbeiter in die Lage versetzt, ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Unsere Einstellungsentscheidungen basieren auf Chancengleichheit und der besten Qualifikation, ungeachtet von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, Hautfarbe, Rasse, sexueller Orientierung, Nationalität oder Behinderung.
 Wenn Sie aufgrund einer Erkrankung, einer körperlichen Behinderung oder eines neurodiversen Zustandes eine Unterstützung bei unterschiedlichen Teilen des Rekrutierungsprozesses benötigen, wenden Sie sich bitte an disabilities.austria@novartis.com und teilen Sie uns die Art Ihrer Anfrage sowie Ihre Kontaktinformationen mit. Unsere Unterstützung umfasst die Beratung zu geeigneten Positionen sowie die Begleitung bei allen Phasen des Bewerbungsprozesses.  Job Description Summary 
#LI-Onsite 
Lokacija: Mengeš
Kot tehnik vzdrževanja boste odgovorni za podporo pri pripravi in izvedbi aktivnosti vzdrževanja in usmerjanja. Podpirali boste aktivnosti zagonov za projekte na nivoju lokacije skladno z zakonodajo, internimi predpisi, dobrimi praksami in poslovnimi cilji. 
 Job Description 
 Vaše ključne odgovornosti 
 - Izvajanje vzdrževalnih in kalibracijskih aktivnosti 
 - Priprava orodja, rezervnih delov itd. za vzdrževanje/kalibracijo, dostava na delovno območje, izdelava delov za hitra popravila in izboljšave 
 - Pridobivanje dovoljenj za vzdrževanje/kalibracijo/projekte 
 - Izvajanje delovnih nalogov za vzdrževanje/kalibracijo v skladu z opisom metod/procesom 
 - Posodobitve CMMS (npr. VIS/SAP PM, SAP MM ...) po zaključku vzdrževanja/kalibracije 
 - Dokumentiranje izvedbe vzdrževanja/kalibracije 
 - Sodelovanje pri izvajanju dejavnosti vzdrževanja/kalibracije s strani tretjih oseb 
 - Določanje rezervnih delov za vzdrževanje in vodenje seznamov za prevzem 
 - Podpiranje dejavnosti, povezanih s projekti vzdrževanja na ravni lokacije 
 - Predlaganje tehničnih izboljšav ter drugih uporabnih predlogov 
 Vaš doprinos k delovnem mestu: 
 Znanje slovenskega jezika. 
 Poznavanje orodja Microsoft Office. 
 Zaželene delovne izkušnje v farmacevtski / kemijski industriji. 
 Enoizmensko delo in dežurstva 
 Z izbranim kandidatom bomo sklenili delovno razmerje za nedoločen čas s poskusno dobo 6 mesecev . Prijavo oddajte z življenjepisom v slovenskem in angleškem jeziku. 
 Nagrajevanje: 
 V Novartisu smo zavezani k soustvarjanju prihodnosti medicine ter priznavanju in nagrajevanju ljudi, ki to omogočajo. 
 Pričakovani letni osnovni razpon plače za delovno mesto: 
 • Slovenija: 17.800,00 - 30.420,00 € 
 Osnovna plača se določa na podlagi vnaprej opredeljenih in transparentnih kriterijev, kot so relevantne veščine, kompetence in izkušnje, ne glede na spol, ter v skladu z Novartisovo politiko določanja plač. Po zaposlitvi v Novartisu se plača periodično pregleda v skladu z internimi akti in postopki. 
 Plačna enakost je temeljno načelo naše kadrovske politike in odraža našo zavezo k ustvarjanju raznolikega, pravičnega in vključujočega okolja, ki vse zaposlene obravnava dostojanstveno in spoštljivo, kot je opredeljeno v našem Kodeksu etike. 
 Poleg osnovne letne bruto plače so zaposleni upravičeni tudi do spodaj navedenih ugodnosti: 
 Letni bonus, ki pripada vsakemu zaposlenemu: 9% letne plače. 
 Regres za dopust : Leta 2025 je znašal 2.496 € (neto). Za leto 2026 znaša 2.678,28 € (neto). 
 Nagrada za poslovno uspešnost : Leta 2025 je znašala 2.538,64 € (bruto), skupaj z zimskim regresom. 
 Prostovoljno dodatno pokojninsko zavarovanje : Novartis v Sloveniji zagotavlja prostovoljno dodatno pokojninsko zavarovanje (5,844 % bruto izplačila, letno omejeno na 3.224,18 €). 
 Dodatek za izmensko delo (15 %); večizmensko delo (20 %), nočno delo (70 %), delo ob nedeljah in praznikih (50 %). 
 Zavarovanje: 
 undefined
 undefined
 Care Connect: Program, ki ponuja zaupno, osebno podporo za vaše duševno zdravje in dobro počutje s pomočjo terapij, svetovanj, orodij in še mnogo več. 
 Ostale ugodnosti v skladu z zakonom in kolektivno pogodbo: Prevoz, prehrana ter ostali dodatki. 
 Preberite brošuro in izvedite več o našem sistemu nagrajevanja: https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf 
 Opomba: Ugodnosti se lahko razlikujejo glede na državo ter so skladni z lokalno zakonodajo, vključno z določili kolektivnih pogodb. Celovit pregled vašega paketa prejemkov, vključno z morebitnimi relevantnimi določbami kolektivne pogodbe, ki veljajo za vašo delovno mesto glede na lokacijo zaposlitve in delodajalca Novartis, vam bo posredovan v okviru nadaljnjih korakov zaposlitvenega postopka. 
 Predani smo raznolikosti in vključenosti: Novartis si prizadeva ustvariti izjemno, vključujoče delovno okolje in oblikovanje raznolikih timov, saj ti predstavljajo naše bolnike in skupnosti, ki jih oskrbujemo. 
 Zakaj Novartis: Pomagati bolnikom in njihovim družinam zahteva več kot le inovativno znanost. Potrebna je skupnost zavzetih ljudi, kot ste vi. V Novartisu cenimo sodelovanje, podporo in navdihovanje drug drugega za razvoj prebojnih terapij, ki spreminjajo življenja pacientov. Ste pripravljeni ustvariti svetlejšo prihodnost skupaj z nami? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

items.desc:
Introduction to the job
 Would you like to work hands-on with some of the most advanced semiconductor manufacturing technology in the world? As a Mechanical Install Engineer - EXE at ASML in Veldhoven, you will help install our next-generation lithography systems at customer locations worldwide.
 Your goal is to deliver each system safely, on time, according to specification, and at the expected quality level. This is a highly international position where you will work abroad for more than 50% of your time.
 As a Mechanical Install Engineer - EXE, you will combine hands-on mechanical work with technical troubleshooting, problem solving, teamwork, and direct customer interaction.
 Role and responsibilities
 You will install and commission advanced EXE lithography systems at customer locations. Working closely with colleagues and customers, you will solve technical challenges and contribute to continuously improving our installation activities.
 You will:
 Perform mechanical installation, adjustment, and commissioning of complete EXE systems.
 Install equipment at customer locations, including systems with new features and technologies.
 Perform complex adjustments, upgrades, diagnostics, and troubleshooting with limited support.
 Answer technical customer questions and provide professional on-site support.
 Transfer technical knowledge to local installation and support teams.
 Complete required documentation, handovers, issue tracking, and progress reports.
 Identify and contribute to structural improvements in installation methods and processes.
 Education and experience
 To qualify for the Mechanical Install Engineer - EXE position, you have:
 A vocational degree with at least two years of relevant professional experience, or a bachelor’s degree.
 A technical background in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, aerospace engineering, automotive engineering, or a comparable field.
 Hands-on experience in a high-tech production, engineering, installation, or technical customer service environment.
 Demonstrated experience with mechanical assembly and technical troubleshooting.
 Experience working with both large-scale and precision mechanics is preferred.
 Skills
 Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.
 To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:
 Put safety first in every activity and working environment.
 Communicate clearly in spoken and written English with colleagues and customers.
 Approach hands-on engineering challenges with curiosity and a problem-solving mindset.
 Work accurately and aim to get things right the first time.
 Stay structured and focused while working in a dynamic and changing environment.
 Take initiative and work independently while recognizing when additional support is needed.
 Collaborate effectively with colleagues and customers from different cultures and backgrounds.
 Other information
 The Mechanical Install Engineer - EXE position is based in Veldhoven, the Netherlands. You will work abroad at customer locations for more than 50% of your time. You must also be willing to work flexible shift patterns, both in Veldhoven and at customer sites.
 Due to the investment in your technical development and training, you should be prepared to commit to the installation organization for at least three years.
 Please submit an updated resume and a cover letter explaining your motivation for this specific position at ASML.
 For this position, the indicative (fixed) annual salary range is between 58,500 euro and 66,000 euro. This range comprises vacation allowance and a 13th-month payment and is based on a full-time contract. Company profit sharing is not included in this range. As this is a shift-based position you will receive a shift allowance on top of the indicated salary range. The actual compensation offered will depend on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: job-related skills, relevant education and (work) experience, certifications, demonstrated abilities of the candidate, pay relative to other team members. This information is provided for transparency and guidance purposes only, and no rights can be derived from this salary indication.
 We have the intention to organize an interview day on the 24th of November to complete all the interviews for the role. Please make sure you will be available for this day. Of course we aim to give you clarity as soon as possible if you will be invited.

Job Description: 
 Au sein d’une équipe d’ ingénieurs Airworthiness confirmés, vous aurez l’occasion de travailler sur des programmes multiples et de découvrir les processus qui réglementent le suivi de navigabilité chez ATR . 
 Missions & Responsabilités 
 De profil ingénieur, vous serez responsable du suivi de navigabilité d'un ou plusieurs programmes A/C . Vous participerez en collaboration avec différents acteurs du suivi de navigabilité (service navigabilité, bureau d'études, support, programme) aux activités suivantes : 
 Revue des événements en service dans la flotte, 
 Analyse des causes profondes et suivi des incidents, 
 Gérer toute condition dangereuse survenant dans la flotte,
 Coordonner avec le personnel de navigabilité du site et les bureaux d'études pour la préparation des justifications nécessaires pour soutenir la fonction de maintien de la navigabilité. 
 Assurer un reporting approprié sur les progrès réalisés auprès de l'organisation du programme d'ingénierie du site,
 Gérer et coordonner avec le bureau de navigabilité les présentations de la flotte à faire aux autorités de navigabilité 
 Participation aux réunions avec les Autorités de Navigabilité (EASA, FAA, ...) 
 Analyse et suivi de la mise en œuvre des actions correctives proposées, 
 Analyse et suivi du Service Bulletin et des Consignes de Navigabilité. 
 Vous serez responsable du déroulement des activités et du respect des jalons de livraison. Vous devrez également communiquer l'avancement des activités au service de navigabilité. La connaissance de la Partie-21A.3 et de l'AMC/GM associé est requise pour mener à bien les activités de surveillance de la navigabilité. 
 Les compétences qui comptent pour nous: 
 Formation grandes écoles ou universités 
 Idéalement une spécialisation en aéronautique.
 Connaissances en : 
 ARP 5150 (Safety Assessment of Transport Airplanes in Commercial Service), 
 Part-21A.3, Part-M (Continuing airworthiness requirements) 
 CS 23/25/27/29 
 La connaissance des systèmes aéronautiques est un atout pour le poste. 
 Qualités : Ce que vous apporterez à votre future équipe 
 Rigueur et capacité de synthèse (écrite et verbale) 
 Esprit analytique, capacité de synthèse 
 Intérêt pour les aspects techniques 
 De solides compétences en communication. 
 As an international company, we work in a multicultural environment: an negociation level in English is mandatory.
 Votre processus de recrutement : 
 Nous valorisons le contact humain. Afin de mieux vous connaître, voici les étapes habituelles de notre processus de recrutement après analyse de votre candidature : 
 Dossier de candidature à remplir envoyé par votre chargé(e) de recrutement. 
 Entretien technique avec le manager. 
 Entretien avec le/la Chargé(e) de Recrutement. 
 Un feedback personnalisé après le processus 
 Vous recherchez un poste avec une activité variée et de réelles opportunités d'évolution… 
 Venez vivre l'aventure Airbus Protect… On vous attend !

Job Description: 
 About our team... 
 Airbus Helicopters is the world’s largest helicopter manufacturer and the company’s site at Oxford Airport is Britain’s civil helicopter hub. 
 AHUK offers considerable experience in helicopter sales, bespoke completions, maintenance and spares support. Its in-house engineering capabilities include design, customisation, installation, flight-testing and certification, as well as technical support, maintenance, training and the supply of spares for civil and military applications. 
 AHUK is the MoD’s chosen provider of helicopters and maintenance for its No.1 Helicopter Flying school (referred to as MFTS) located in RAF Shawbury (Shropshire) and RAF Valley (Anglesey). 
 Description/Overall purpose of the Job 
 Sheet Metal Fabricator/Fitter role is to contribute to the delivery of bespoke, high-quality helicopter solutions through complex prototype development, retrofit, and series production. The role involves developing and manufacturing detailed parts from sheet metal to aviation standards within a workshop or hangar, assembling components, and working closely with the design team on prototype work. 
 Carry out detailed inspections of subcontractor manufactured parts to ensure compliance with engineering drawings. Carrying out repairs to in service helicopters using sheet metal and composite techniques. With the overall output to maintain the safety and airworthiness of helicopters within the customisation and MRO departments 
 Main responsibilities 
 Accomplishment of work as directed by the Installation Supervisor or Certifying Engineer 
 Manufacture detailed parts from sheet metal 
 Inspect parts manufactured by subcontractors 
 Assembling parts manufactured by subcontractors 
 Applying protective coatings 
 Working closely with the design team 
 All parts manufactured must be in compliance with the design data to ensure safe operation of aircraft 
 Working as part of a team or individually depending on the specific work packages 
 Will also be required to assist in day to day running of the hangar, including aircraft handling. 
 Maintain high standards house keeping in line with the Airbus “Clean As You Go” initiative 
 Working within a highly regulated environment 
 Carry out repairs to helicopter structures and components 
 Flexible working attitude to deal with the changing priorities within the departments 
 Knowledge and Skills 
 Essential 
 Ability to work as part of a team, and on own initiative, as well as to high standards in order to ensure the continued safe operation of the aircraft. 
 Be able to read and understand detailed engineering drawings and associated data 
 Interest in DIY 
 Good manual hand skills 
 Able to work in confined spaces 
 Good communication skills 
 Reliable with ability to remain calm when under pressure 
 Well organised and methodical with a high attention to detail 
 Able to adhere to the requirements of H&S to wear the appropriate PPE for each task 
 Ability to use Google Office and MS products 
 Desirable 
 Knowledge of techniques used in manufacturing parts from sheet metal to close tolerance 
 Knowledge of types of fasteners used to assemble sheet metal and components using rivets, mechanical fasteners and adhesive bonding used in aviation 
 Ability to use SAP / Envision 
 Education, Qualifications or Training 
 Essential 
 Minimum Level 2 qualification in Fabrication 
 Must be able to present examples of work done via photographic record. 
 Previous experience in a similar role such as Sheet Metal Working, Metal Fabrication, Mechanical Fitter or Automotive repair 
 Clean Driving Licence 
 Desirable 
 Aviation experience 
 Sheet Metal Experience 
 Composites Experience 
 About you 
 Attention to detail 
 Punctuality 
 Ability to meet deadlines 
 Ability to work as part of a diverse, multi-skilled workforce 
 High level of integrity and understanding of responsibility 
 Additional requirements 
 Due to the nature of this position you will require DBS Security Clearance and be eligible for SC clearance. 
 Applicants must meet any/all requirements of Export Compliance Regulations. 
 All candidates must possess the current, legal right to work in the United Kingdom. Airbus will not be able to offer sponsorship for any employment Visa's. 
 Shift working may be required as part of a normal working pattern. (shift allowance payable) 
 Occasional need to travel to subcontractors or other Airbus facilities including overseas 
 The Reward 
 In joining the Airbus family, you will play a critical part in delivering the most efficient helicopters for its customers, who serve, protect, save lives and carry passengers in demanding environments. On top of your competitive base salary, you will have access to the following benefits below via our Airbus salary sacrifice schemes: 
 Private Medical Insurance (Bupa) – single cover for employees paid by the company 
 Pension: Employees are auto-enrolled into the Airbus Group UK Retirement Fund. …
