 Telefónica España 
 Quieres unirte a una empresa líder en la industria tecnológica? 
 Sabemos que estás en búsqueda de un cambio… 
 Y por eso, en Telefónica España te ofrecemos la oportunidad de unirte a nuestro equipo. 
 LUGAR DE TRABAJO: MADRID 
 ¿QUÉ BUSCAMOS? 
 Personas con muchas ganas de darlo todo y marcar la diferencia. Apasionadas de la innovación y las tecnologías punteras. 
 Con esta oportunidad podrás adentrarte en el apasionante universo tecnológico y ser parte del cambio: un mundo más conectado, más humano y lleno de historias que transforman vidas. 
 Recuerda adjuntar tu CV actualizado en formato PDF. 
 QUEREMOS GENTE COMO TÚ... 
 Definiendo, liderando y ejecutando la estrategia de innovación y evolución tecnológica en el ámbito de las Capacidades de Control de Telefónica España, gestionando el ciclo completo de innovación (ideación, priorización, experimentación y escalado) así como el diseño, desarrollo, certificación e implantación de nuevas funcionalidades y servicios sobre dichas capacidades, impulsando su automatización y la incorporación de casos de uso de IA, y asegurando el lanzamiento en plazo, con la inversión comprometida y con la calidad extremo a extremo requerida según los procedimientos del Grupo Telefónica. 
 QUÉ RETOS ENFRENTARÁS EN EL DÍA A DÍA: 
 Identificación, análisis y priorización de nuevas oportunidades de innovación sobre las Capacidades de Control, mediante el estudio de tendencias tecnológicas, benchmarking de mercado, reuniones periódicas con los principales actores de la industria y detección de necesidades latentes de clientes internos y externos, con objeto de proponer líneas de evolución de las plataformas de control y asesorar en la toma de decisión. 
 Liderar la definición funcional y técnica, el desarrollo y certificación de nuevas capacidades y funcionalidades sobre el conjunto de las plataformas de voz y control, asegurando su alineamiento con la estrategia tecnológica y los objetivos de negocio. 
 Impulsar la evolución de las plataformas y servicios de voz (OCMP, NGIN y capacidades asociadas bajo su responsabilidad), identificando oportunidades de innovación, automatización e inteligencia artificial que permitan mejorar la eficiencia, la calidad del servicio y la propuesta de valor para el cliente. 
 Impulso de la integración y orquestación de capacidades en red, propios o de terceros (SDF, NEF y ecosistemas como OpenGateway), y de la automatización extremo a extremo de los procesos asociados a las plataformas de control, incorporando casos de uso de IA orientados a la mejora de la eficiencia operativa, la calidad de servicio y la experiencia de cliente. 
 Liderazgo de la coordinación transversal con Negocio, Marketing y Producto, Tecnología, Ingeniería, Seguridad, DSS, Soporte y proveedores, asesorando a dichas áreas para viabilizar técnicamente sus propuestas sobre las Plataformas de Control, valorando en plazos y costes las soluciones propuestas y asegurando el lanzamiento en plazo de nuevas iniciativas y funcionalidades. 
 Asegurar la calidad extremo a extremo (E2E) de los servicios, definiendo criterios técnicos, planes de pruebas, estándares de arquitectura y gobernanza tecnológica, conforme a los procedimientos del Grupo Telefónica.

Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.
Provides clinical training and support to customers, as a subject matter expert, on-site and/or remotely to ensure customer is prepared to operate their equipment according to a minimum of safe and effective use guidelines and to fully utilize the complex functionality of the technology to meet their business needs.* Conduct product training for customers and employees, in particular training for complex situations involving multiple products. 
* Lead classroom lectures and laboratory sessions to ensure customers are trained to operate company equipment according to safety guidelines with the highest level of satisfaction. 
* Prepare lesson plans based on engineering documentation, field service requirements, and software documentation to address customers’ specific implementation questions. 
* Formulate complementary support training information in the form of quick tips, workbooks, video-media and implementation guides. 
* Collaborate with customers as well as the sales, product marketing, and technical support departments to ensure course material reflects current product features, and address customer inquiries including testing scenarios using company products. 
* Work with cross-functional teams as necessary to support and enable best services and optimize customer relations. 
 Who we are : We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.
 How we work : When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
 To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here .
 As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.
 Data Privacy : We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.
 Beware of Job Scams: Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees.  These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information.  If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site. 
 To all recruitment agencies : Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 2 200 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 800EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 400 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 1200 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch je možné získať jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy. Za prácu v obchodnom centre Ťa navyše odmeníme mesačným príspevkom vo výške 150 EUR. 
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Ak máte máte skúsenosti s prácou so živnostníkmi a malými podnikateľmi a máte v sebe ducha obchodníka, ste skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku pre VÚB! 
 Čakajú Vás u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie. 
Na pozícii Poradca/Poradkyňa pre podnikateľov bude Vašou úlohou:
 zabezpečovať servisné činnosti pre klientov - malých podnikateľov,
 identifikovať potreby právnických osôb a analyzovať ich potreby,
 poskytovať informácie a odborné poradenstvo klientom s cieľom nájdenia optimálneho riešenia,
 proaktívne zabezpečovať a rozvíjať dlhodobé obchodné vzťahy v segmente Small Business,
 aktívne vyhľadávať nové obchodné príležitosti,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).

Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 2 050 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 650 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 400 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 1800 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.

 identifikovať potreby klientov, analyzovať ich požiadavky a hľadať pre nich tie najideálnejšie riešenia,
 poskytovať odborné poradenstvo v oblasti produktov a služieb existujúcim a potenciálnym klientom z portfólia afluentných klientov,
 budovať si s klientmi dôverný vzťah,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.

 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!

 Bank- és befektetési számlanyitás kezelésében , az ügyfelek megbízásainak felvételében.

 Piaci változások nyomon követésében. 
 Proaktív ügyfélkapcsolattartásban a meglévő ügyfélkörrel. 
 Neked való mindez, ha: 
 Rendelkezel legalább 5 év személyi, privát bankár pozícióban szerzett tapasztalattal . 
 Tőzsdei szakvizsgával és felsőfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel . 
 Rutinod van a kiemelten nagy vagyonnal rendelkező ügyfelek kezelésében. 
 Otthon vagy befektetési portfoliók széles körében. 
 Erős részvénypiaci ismereteid vannak és a kötvény piac egészében rendelkezel megalapozott ismeretekkel. 
 Szakmai elhivatottság és megnyerő tárgyalástechnika jellemez. 
 Előnyt jelent, ha: 
 Gazdasági- vagy pénzügyi szakirányú felsőfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel. 
 Középfokon beszélsz angol nyelven. 
 Értékeljük a tehetséged: 
 Éves bruttó 500 000 Ft-os cafeteria keretet biztosítunk, melyet gyakorlatilag minden jól ismert elemre felhasználhatsz. 
 Próbaidő után kamatmentes lakáscélú hitelfelvétel lehetősége is adott lesz. 
 Éves teljesítményed alapján piaci, versenyképes bónusz kifizetésben részesülhetsz . 
 Támogatjuk testi és lelki jól-léted: 
 Egészségbiztosítási szolgáltatást nyújtunk. 
 Anyabankunknak köszönhetően, súlyos betegségek esetén térítésmentes második orvosi szakvélemény és kezelés nemzetközi orvos szakemberek által . 
 Pszichológiai tanácsadás a Szakértő Segítség Program keretén belül. 
 Nyári szünetekre táborok támogatása. 
 Banki, partneri kedvezmények vásárlásokra és egyéb szolgáltatásokra. 
 Csatlakozz hozzánk, mert: 
 Egy nemzetközi bankcsoport magyar leányánál biztos munkahelyed lesz .

 Számunkra fontos a szakmai fejlődésed, ezért széleskörű képzés palettát nyújtunk minden munkavállalónak. 
 Online és személyes programokkal színesítjük a hétköznapokat.

Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 1 500 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 300 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 200 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 700 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Čo od vás očakávame 
 Ak Ťa zaujíma svet bankovníctva, si komunikatívny/komunikatívna a máš prax v práci s hotovosťou, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku vo VÚB!
 Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
 Okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Vítame u nás skúsených bankárov, ale ak ešte bankovú prax nemáš, nevadí. U nás vo VÚB Ťa na to pripravíme celkom od začiatku.
 ČO TI DÁME NA ÚVOD?
Vďaka silnej podpore manažérov pobočky, nápomocným kolegom a priateľskému prístupu našich lektorov sa:
postupne začneš orientovať vo VUB bankových produktoch a službách,
naučíš pracovať s klientom a zlepšíš svoju komunikáciu a schopnosť argumentovať, čo sa Ti zíde aj v osobnom živote.
 PREČO SA TI PRÁCA VO VÚBKE BUDE PÁČIŤ?
 Budeš pracovať v jednej z najväčších a najvýznamnejších bánk na Slovensku.
 Na pobočke ste jeden tím – obchodné plány plníte spoločne a vzájomne sa podporujete.
 Rozširuješ si odbornosť a získavaš skúsenosti, ktoré využiješ v Tvojej kariére.
 Pri práci s klientom sa zlepšuješ v mnohých oblastiach, ktoré oceníš aj v osobnom živote.
 TVOJOU ÚLOHOU AKO PORADCU KLIENTA BUDE:
 podieľať sa na podpore predaja a spolupracovať s tímom,
 hľadať príležitosti pre predaj všetkých bankových produktov a služieb,
 poskytovať informácie a odborné poradenstvo klientom,
 vykonávať pokladničné a zmenárenské operácie,
 vykonávať servisné klientske operácie, zodpovedne pracovať s hotovosťou,
 podieľať sa na administratívnych činnostiach,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!

 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.

 Share

Bratislava, SK
 Join our Asset Management Operations team and contribute to the day-to-day investment activities of one of the world’s leading reinsurance companies. This entry level back-office position offers an exceptional learning opportunity with exposure to global financial markets.
 About the Role 
 Who said that static data doesn’t change?​
 This team is tasked with the crucial role of maintaining static data across various systems within the Asset Management organization. Through diligent data analysis and optimization, we uphold the integrity of enterprise data, which is fundamental to the organization's operations and decision-making processes. ​
 We maintain static data and resolve related issues in the primary following areas:​
 Counterparties that Swiss Re trades with​
 Asset Portfolios defining subsets of our investments.​
 Bank Accounts we own as well as those used by our counterparties​
 As an Investment Operations Associate within Asset Management Operations, you'll contribute to our investment infrastructure. This role is specifically designed for fresh graduates looking to build a solid foundation in Asset Management Operations with guidance from experienced professionals.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Set-up and maintenance of static data in internal golden source and external systems​
 End-to-end data integrity checks to ensure highest data quality​
 Ad-hoc analysis of data​
 Be a detective: help us identify areas for automation, improvements and simplification​
 About the Team 
 Our Asset Management Operations team creates an efficient operating environment that supports all financial market activities conducted by Swiss Re. As a back-office function, we ensure the seamless execution of investment processes. Our company invests in a multitude of innovative products and asset classes, including catastrophe bonds, infrastructure loans, private equity funds, derivatives and many more. Since an open, knowledge sharing culture is part of our DNA, you have an amazing opportunity to learn about every single one of our investments and about every step in the end-to-end investment process.
 About You 
 You're a detail-oriented individual with a passion for financial markets looking for a global exposure. As a recent graduate, or young professional you're eager to learn and grow in a international corporate environment. Your organizational skills, adaptability, and ability to communicate effectively make you an ideal candidate for this entry-level role that offers significant development potential.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements: 
 Basic investment knowledge
 Good command of written and spoken English
 Attention to detail and good analytical skills
 Ability to set priorities and meet deadlines
 Strong teamwork capabilities
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between 1400 EUR and 2400 EUR per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:
 the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​
 the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 #LI-Hybrid
 About Swiss Re 
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

items.desc:
Als Solution Architect vertaal je complexe beveiligingsvraagstukken naar een heldere technische visie. Je bepaalt niet alleen wat technisch mogelijk is, maar adviseert ook over wat voor een klant op de lange termijn de beste keuze is.
 Je houdt daarbij overzicht over de volledige levenscyclus: van eerste klantvraag en architectuur tot realisatie, beheer en verdere ontwikkeling.
 Wat ga je doen? 
 Architectuur ontwerpen: Je vertaalt business-, security- en technische eisen naar robuuste, schaalbare architecturen voor complexe IT/OT-omgevingen.
 Systemen integreren: Je brengt technologieën zoals PSIM, VMS, Access Control en securitymanagementplatformen samen met hosting, virtualisatie, netwerken en andere IT-componenten.
 Klanten strategisch adviseren: Je bent trusted advisor voor klanten en gesprekspartner voor zowel technische specialisten als management en directie. Je maakt complexe technische keuzes begrijpelijk en laat de consequenties ervan zien.
 Cybersecurity by design toepassen: Cybersecurity is vanaf het begin onderdeel van je architectuur. Je houdt rekening met de integriteit, beschikbaarheid en continuïteit van bedrijfskritische systemen.
 Technische richting geven : Je ondersteunt sales, engineering en realisatieteams vanuit jouw technische visie. Tijdens de uitvoering bewaak je de architectuurprincipes en kwaliteit van de gekozen oplossing.
 Processen verbeteren 
Je kijkt verder dan technologie alleen. Je analyseert hoe klanten hun beveiligingsprocessen organiseren en onderzoekt waar integratie, standaardisatie en automatisering waarde kunnen toevoegen.
 Innovatie naar de praktijk brengen 
Je volgt relevante technologische ontwikkelingen, beoordeelt nieuwe oplossingen en leveranciers en onderzoekt waar nieuwe technologie toegevoegde waarde kan bieden.
Jij brengt mee: 
 Een afgeronde technische hbo- of wo-opleiding .
 Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring als Solution Architect of in een vergelijkbare technische architectuurrol, bij voorkeur binnen fysieke beveiligingssystemen.
 PSIM, VMS, Access Control of securitymanagementplatformen .
 Ervaring met complexe IT/OT-integratie , building automation of vergelijkbare bedrijfskritische technologie.
 Ervaring met grootschalige integratievraagstukken , waarbij IT- en OT-componenten samenkomen.
 Goede kennis van cybersecurityprincipes binnen complexe technische omgevingen.
 Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal , zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
Waarom Bosch: 
 Bosch is een organisatie met een sterke langetermijnvisie waarin kwaliteit, ontwikkeling en duurzame relaties centraal staan. We investeren bewust in onze mensen en innovatie. Daardoor krijg je de ruimte om te leren, initiatief te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. 
 Bij Bosch Building Technologies combineren we al meer dan 100 jaar technologische kennis met innovatie. Ons doel is helder: mensen en hun omgeving duurzaam beschermen met slimme technologie. Dat doen we samen. Met aandacht voor jou, het team en de toekomst.
 Wat wij jou bieden: 
 Een goed salaris en 38 verlofdagen per jaar bij een fulltime dienst verband. 
 Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op vast dienstverband. 
 Laptop en iPhone. 
 Hybride werken mogelijk in overleg.
 Uitstekende begeleiding en volop ruimte voor opleidingen en doorgroeimogelijkheden. 
 Een stabiele, internationale werkgever met een mensgerichte en professionele cultuur. 
 Goede pensioenregeling via PMT 
 Klaar om verschil te maken? 
 Wil jij met jouw technische visie de security-ecosystemen van morgen vormgeven?
 Solliciteer vandaag nog en groei mee #LikeABosch.

Join the MEMS team! Together we shape the future of MEMS sensors and enable innovative automotive, consumer and industrial applications.
 Both conceptually and directly inside the cleanroom and laboratory, you develop advanced wafer processes for manufacturing high-end micromechanical products.
 You evaluate novel materials and manufacturing methods regarding technical feasibility and economic viability.
 In close alignment with demanding international customers, you drive technological development goals forward to meet tight schedules reliably.
 Cross-functional collaboration between development and production is guided by you to transition prototype designs smoothly into series production.
 Alongside thorough quality assessments and process releases, you coordinate joint projects with external research institutes for fundamental technology development.

 In accordance with our regulations, the gross annual salary for this position is at least 88.000 EUR for a 35h week (for a full year of employment and fulfillment of the eligibility requirements based on collective agreements) in the case of a comprehensive execution of job requirements. We offer flexible working models: from various part-time options to mobile working and job sharing. Feel free to contact us.

items.desc:
Join the Electric Solutions group at Bosch Home Comfort, where software engineering and DevOps come together to support the development of heat pump applications. You will work closely with engineers using model-based development approaches, building a strong understanding of how their software is designed, implemented, tested, integrated, and maintained. 
 You will use that understanding to shape reliable, practical tools and workflows that make continuous software development easier. From fast feedback during development to reproducible builds and releases, your work will help teams deliver high-quality software with confidence. 
 Your contribution to something big: 
 Enable continuous development : Design and improve CI/CD workflows that support the way software teams work, from early development and integration through testing and delivery.
 Enhance automation : Automate builds, tests, code analysis, packaging, and release activities, with useful feedback that helps engineers identify issues early.
 Put software quality first : Consider what matters throughout the development lifecycle, including testability, reproducible builds, version control, traceability, and maintainability.
 Partner with engineers : Collaborate with software teams and turn real needs into effective platform improvements.
 Improve developer experience : Reduce repetitive manual work and help teams integrate and validate changes frequently and reliably.
 Keep delivery systems dependable : Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot build and integration issues, and address bottlenecks across teams and sites.
 Scale delivery infrastructure : Contribute to reliable and scalable build infrastructure, including cloud-based services.
What distinguishes you: 
 Education: 
 Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields. 
 Professional Experience & Skills: 
 Methodologies: Solid experience in software development, CI/CD, DevOps and agile practices at scale.
 Programming: Practical programming skills in Bash, Git, Python, Go, and C. 
 Operating Systems: Practical knowledge with Linux and Windows systems.
 DevOps Tooling: Practical knowledge of Jenkins, SonarQube, jFrog Artifactory, Bitbucket, Jira, and GitHub.
 Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools (Ansible, Terraform) and server administration (Windows/Linux) is a plus.
 Additional Tech Stack: Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, NoSQL databases (such as MongoDB), Grafana, Conan, and Maven is beneficial.
 Interpersonal & Language Skills: 
 Languages: Fluent in English
 Working Style: Highly organized, collaborative, proactive, and structured with strong planning capabilities. 
 Personality: Responsible, self-driven, eager to innovate and continuously learn, with a strong willingness to collaborate within international teams (including willingness for occasional business travel).
Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden 
 Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
 At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
 Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
 Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch 
 Compensation and Benefits: 
 Competitive salary, Pension plans, health insurance, and other benefits according to the collective bargin.
 Flexible working hours and hybrid work options (depending on role).
 Employee discounts on Bosch products.

items.desc:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 CDD Direct Customer Onboarding team 
 Adyen is looking for a hands-on CDD Risk Analyst to join our Direct Customer Onboarding team and contribute to the growth and scaling of our customer base in EMEA. In this role, you will onboarding of merchants, including enhanced due diligence, KYC checks, and assessing the anti-money laundering risks, to protect Adyen and our customers. You will be working with a wide range of teams within Adyen, including commercial, compliance, and product to ensure that our customers and understanding of them remain up-to-date and compliant. You are expected to be very detail-oriented, take a risk-based approach, and have the ability to think critically with scalability always in mind, all while maintaining a high caliber work product.
 What you will do 
 End-to-End Onboarding: Manage end to end onboarding flows for enterprise accounts, conducting in-depth due diligence, analyzing complex ownership structures, and ensuring full compliance with regulatory obligations and internal policies.
 Quality & Accuracy: Maintain "first-time-right" quality accuracy across all risk assessments and regional compliance standards as well as regulatory expectations.
 Merchant Communication & Guidance: Act as the primary point of contact for merchants during onboarding, providing clear guidance and internal advice.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate cross-functionally with commercial, compliance, and product teams to balance risk mitigation with business scalability growth, as well as have a critical eye on our own internal processes.
 Risk Escalations: Handle complex risk escalations, providing expert analysis and decision-making on high-risk onboarding scenarios.
 Policy & Standards Alignment: Align local operational procedures with global policy requirements and second-line compliance standards.
 Who you are 
 3-6 years of experience in Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), or KYC.
 High sense of responsibility, integrity, and ability to prioritize tasks based on business needs.
 Curious, analytical, and critical mindset with a strong problem-solving orientation and risk-based approach.
 Clear communicator and team player, comfortable navigating ambiguity and tailoring messages for diverse audiences.
 Experience collaborating with commercial stakeholders to navigate discussions while maintaining robust risk standards.
 Experience with policies, procedures, and product teams to identify gaps and enhance processes.
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application! 
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 
 This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

items.desc:
Why us
 Aignostics is a spin-off from one of Europe’s largest and most prestigious university hospitals (Charité), with employees in Berlin and New York. We have received over €50M in funding from leading investors and are a growing team of over 80 interdisciplinary professionals. We work with leading global life sciences companies as well as academic partners. 
 We believe that AI has the potential to revolutionize how cancer and other complex diseases are diagnosed and treated. Without access to high quality data and a scientifically rigorous, transparent approach to model development, AI is just a buzzword. That’s where we come in. 
 The role
 You'll be the main contact for our employees and managers on everything across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding. Your work will keep our people operations running smoothly and support a culture where employees can do their best work.
 This is a chance to own day-to-day People operations at a mission-driven scale-up, contribute to ongoing projects and help shape how we grow as an organization. The right candidate brings sound judgment, discretion, a collaborative mindset and the ability to turn complex people topics into clear, practical solutions.
 What you will do
 Manage the employee lifecycle: Help make onboarding, contract changes, leave administration, and offboarding smooth and well organized for every employee.
 Oversee people operations: Prepare employment contracts, amendments, and reference letters; keep employee data up to date in our HRIS; and work with our external payroll provider to prepare monthly payroll inputs.
 Advise employees and managers: Be a friendly first point of contact for questions about policies, working time, leave, benefits, and employee relations, offering practical guidance grounded in German labor law.
 Support people programs: Help bring performance and feedback cycles, engagement initiatives, and team events to life, strengthening our culture along the way.
 Improve processes: Spot ways to simplify and scale our policies, tools, and workflows, and help put improvements into practice. Use Claude and other AI tools where appropriate.
 Contribute to team success: Share what you know, support your colleagues, and help create a positive, inclusive, and high-performing work environment. 
 What we are looking for
 Relevant experience: You have 3+ years of experience as an HR Generalist or in a similar role, ideally at a startup or scale-up.
 HR expertise: You have solid working knowledge of German labor law, employment contracts and payroll preparation. Experience with HRIS tools such as Personio is a plus.
 Ownership and judgment: You handle confidential matters with discretion, get up to speed quickly and work independently when things are ambiguous or changing.
 Communication and collaboration: You build trust quickly with people across teams, backgrounds and levels of seniority.
 Organized and results-oriented: You juggle competing priorities, meet deadlines and keep your standards high.
 Languages: You are fluent in English and German (C1 or higher).
 Nice to have experience in recruitment and people partnering.
 Our offer
 Competitive remuneration, 30 vacation days, flexible hours and remote work 
 €1,000 annual L&D budget (+ 2 L&D days), language classes, mentoring program 
 Family & pet friendly with flexible parental leave 
 Subsidized transport/sports/wellbeing membership and social events 
 Optional pension scheme 
 Join us to make a difference!
 We are committed to equal opportunity and welcome applicants of all identities, backgrounds, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, ethnicity, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that diverse and inclusive teams are stronger, more creative, and better equipped to serve our customers and communities.

items.desc:
W Voi naszą misją jest tworzenie bezpiecznych, zrównoważonych i niezawodnych rozwiązań w zakresie mikromobilności, z których korzystają wszyscy. Realizujemy tę misję od 2018 roku i dziś z dumą zajmujemy pozycję lidera wśród usługodawców oferujących hulajnogi elektryczne w Europie, działając w ponad 100 miastach w 12 krajach.
 Nasza podróż była niesamowita i jesteśmy zdeterminowani, aby utrzymać tempo rozwoju. W związku z dalszym rozwojem naszej działalności, z radością zapraszamy Cię do Poznania, gdzie dołączysz do naszego zespołu w Centralnym Magazynie.
 TWOJA MISJA W VOI 
 Jako specjalista ds. floty – renowacja, będziesz odpowiedzialny za utrzymanie floty pojazdów Voi w doskonałym stanie poprzez wykonywanie prac konserwacyjnych, naprawczych i montażowych w naszym magazynie. Twoja rola obejmuje renowację i montaż hulajnóg oraz części zamiennych, diagnozowanie i rozwiązywanie problemów technicznych oraz polecanie odpowiednich działań naprawczych. Będziesz również zajmować się recyklingiem i demontażem pojazdów nienadających się do naprawy, zgodnie z normami odnośnie rozwoju i bezpieczeństwa.
 Ponadto będziesz wspierać codzienne operacje magazynowe, przeprowadzać kontrole w celu zapewnienia jakości i bezpieczeństwa oraz dbać o czystość, porządek i bezpieczeństwo środowiska pracy. Dzięki swoim praktycznym umiejętnościom technicznym i dbałości o szczegóły odgrywasz kluczową rolę w przedłużaniu cyklu życia naszej floty i zapewnianiu niezawodnych usług dla naszych pasażerów.
 Jako specjalista ds. renowacji floty czekają na Ciebie ekscytujące zadania: 
 Konserwacja i naprawa floty pojazdów Voi
 Wykonywanie prac montażowych hulajnóg i części zamiennych
 Recykling i demontaż pojazdów, które nie nadają się do naprawy
 Diagnozowanie pojazdów, które nie działają prawidłowo i tworzenie planu działań naprawczych
 Kontrola komponentów i sprawdzenie zdolności do rozwiązywania problemów
 Wspieranie codziennych funkcji magazynu centralnego zgodnie z wytycznymi (np. kompletowanie zamówień, pakowanie, wysyłka)
 CO BĘDZIESZ POTRZEBOWAĆ, ABY WYRUSZYĆ W PODRÓZ: 
 1-2 lata doświadczenia w pracy jako mechanik, na stanowiskach produkcyjnych lub stanowiskach powiązanych z używaniem narzędzi i elektronarzędzi.
 Umiejętności manualne, obsługa skanerów ręcznych i urządzeń mobilnych.
 Doświadczenie w naprawach i diagnozowaniu usterek.
 Umiejętność pracy w zespole, co przyczynia się do osiągnięcia wyników wysokiej jakości.
 Dzielenie się wiedzą i umiejętnościami z zespołem.
 Skrupulatność, dokładność i otwartość na opinie.

 Praca w Voi to coś więcej niż tylko praca; to osobista podróż, podczas której rozwiniesz się jako profesjonalista i staniesz się częścią zróżnicowanego i zaangażowanego zespołu, który wywiera pozytywy wpływu na społeczeństwo. Ponadto będziesz miał ożliwość:

 branży mikromobilności.
 Współpracy z inspirującymi, pełnymi motywacji i różnorodnymi współpracownikami,

items.title: UX Designer
items.card: Als UX Designer bij Framna maak je complexe vraagstukken helder: in flows, in ontwerpen en aan tafel met partners. Je werkt vanuit onze studio in Amsterdam of Zwolle, samen met een groot designteam, aan digitale producten die dagelijks gebruikt worden. Word onderdeel van ons team Je komt in het designteam van Framna, met collega's in onze studio's in Amsterdam en Zwolle. Vanuit een van beide studio's werk je met
items.desc:
Als UX Designer bij Framna maak je complexe vraagstukken helder: in flows, in ontwerpen en aan tafel met partners. Je werkt vanuit onze studio in Amsterdam of Zwolle, samen met een groot designteam, aan digitale producten die dagelijks gebruikt worden.
 Word onderdeel van ons team 
 Je komt in het designteam van Framna, met collega's in onze studio's in Amsterdam en Zwolle. Vanuit een van beide studio's werk je met designers, developers en partners aan digitale producten zoals apps, websites, webapps en portals.
 Ons designteam staat bekend om een scherpe strategische blik, uitvoeringskracht, creativiteit en open samenwerking waarin ze complexe vraagstukken vertalen naar digitale ervaringen die écht het verschil maken. Ideeën worden hier snel werkelijkheid zonder in te leveren op kwaliteit en je kunt vanaf dag één impact maken.
 Wat je gaat doen 
 Je pakt complexe vraagstukken van partners zelfstandig op. Je maakt ze concreet in requirements, flows en ontwerpen, en toetst je oplossing bij gebruikers en stakeholders. Je presenteert je werk, doet pitches en adviseert partners over de keuzes die het product beter maken.
 Jouw belangrijkste taken zijn:
 Abstracte vraagstukken samen met partners doorgronden en omzetten in heldere requirements
 Informatiearchitectuur, user flows, wireframes, interaction design en UI-design uitwerken
 Prototypes maken en ontwerpen valideren bij gebruikers
 Bijdragen aan het design system en toegankelijke ontwerpen opleveren, in nauwe samenwerking met developers
 Ontwerpkeuzes presenteren, pitchen en partners adviseren
 Stakeholders actief betrekken, verwachtingen managen en verschillende belangen samenbrengen in het ontwerpproces
 Junioren begeleiden en je ervaring delen in het designteam
 AI in je werk 
 AI is bij Framna onderdeel van hoe we digitale producten ontwikkelen, waarbij de menselijke afweging altijd leidend blijft. Als designer zet je het in bij research, het schrijven van requirements, het genereren en opschonen van designs in Figma en prototyping. Wat AI oplevert, beoordeel je zelf kritisch.
 Omdat AI zich razendsnel ontwikkelt, blijft ook ons ontwerpproces continu in beweging. Je volgt deze ontwikkelingen actief, experimenteert met nieuwe mogelijkheden en vormt je eigen visie op de rol van AI binnen design. Je neemt initiatief, deelt inzichten en draagt bij aan het continu verbeteren van onze manier van werken.
 Het designteam omschrijft het zo: "AI speelt een cruciale rol in ons ontwerpproces. Het helpt ons met research, het structureren van input sneller te prototypen. Waar het werkzaamheden versnelt en de kwaliteit verhoogt, zetten we het in. De ontwerper speelt hierin een cruciale rol waarbij beoordelingsvermogen cruciaal is."
 Wie jij bent 
 Klaar om deze rol helemaal eigen te maken? Wij denken dat je goed bij ons past als je:
 Complexe vraagstukken zelfstandig oppakt, ook als het probleem nog niet helder is.
 Sterk bent in de kern van UX: flows, informatiearchitectuur, wireframes en interaction design.
 Overtuigende, gebruiksvriendelijke en esthetische UI ontwerpt.
 Zelf ervaring hebt met gebruikersonderzoek en het valideren van ontwerpen bij gebruikers.
 Zelfstandig presenteert en adviseert richting partners en je visie overtuigend uitdraagt.
 Over Framna 
 Framna betekent vooruitbrengen. En dat is precies wat we doen. We werken samen met marktleiders en met organisaties die dat willen worden om digitale producten te creëren die markten definiëren, industrieën vernieuwen en betekenisvolle groei realiseren.
 Vanuit een sterke productgedreven cultuur bouwen we met honderden collega’s aan de toekomst, verspreid over meerdere studio's in Europa en daarbuiten. Dagelijks vertrouwen miljoenen gebruikers wereldwijd op de producten die wij maken. Van soepele betaalervaringen tot dagelijkse mobiliteit, en van gezondheidsbeheer tot slimmer winkelen.
 Samen met ambitieuze partners bouwen we digitale producten die markten leiden en grenzen verleggen. Want wanneer producten winnen, winnen bedrijven ook. Wij noemen dat: win by product.
 Wat je krijgt 
 Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.000 - €5.500 afhankelijk van je ervaring.
 Pensioenbijdrage van 67% vanuit Framna.
 27 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen.
 Vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken.
 Een MacBook en telefoon in bruikleen.
 Dagelijkse lunch in de studio.
 Goed om te weten 
 In overleg werk je ook op locatie bij partners.
 Voor deze functie zoeken we een collega die vloeiend Nederlands spreekt.
 Framna biedt geen visa sponsorship.
 We ontvangen je sollicitatie graag inclusief portfolio. Laat daarin niet alleen het eindresultaat zien, maar ook het waarom erachter: van briefing tot oplevering.
 Het sollicitatieproces 
 Wil jij meebouwen aan digitale producten die de wereld vooruit helpen? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog. Binnen zeven werkdagen neemt Léon van ons recruitmentteam contact met je op.
 Klikt het? Dan starten we met een korte online kennismaking. Zijn we daarna …

items.desc:
At Voi, we’re on a mission to create safe, sustainable, and reliable ways to move around cities. As a Fleet Specialist Associate , you’ll play an important role in keeping our vehicles safe, available, and ready for everyone to ride. This is a hands-on and varied role where each day is different. You’ll work alongside supportive teammates, learn practical skills, and contribute to smoother, more sustainable urban mobility. 
 YOUR MISSION AT VOI 
 You’ll help ensure our fleet is safe, well-maintained, and accessible. Your work will be split between in-field operations and warehouse activities . 
 🚴 In the field
 Perform battery swaps to keep vehicles available for riders
 Reposition vehicles and maintain tidy, accessible parking areas
 Identify damaged or non-functioning vehicles, carry out minor fixes where possible, and escalate when needed
 Support safe and compliant vehicle deployment
 Locate and retrieve vehicles as instructed
 Represent Voi in a positive and respectful way when interacting with the public
 Support local engagement and awareness events when needed
 WHAT YOU NEED TO EMBARK 
 We’re looking for someone reliable, proactive, and eager to learn . You enjoy teamwork and feel comfortable in a hands-on, fast-paced environment. Requirements:
 Able to complete tasks efficiently and stay organised
 Committed to safe working practices and following processes
 Comfortable asking questions and raising issues when needed
 Team player with flexibility to adapt to changing priorities
 Positive attitude and willingness to learn
 Interest in vehicles or basic mechanics, nice to have (not essential)
 High school diploma or equivalent
 Provisional Driving Licence 
 Job conditions 
 Working shifts: 0800 - 1600 - 5 out of 7 (2-week shift pattern)
 Working hours: Full Time
 Contract type: 3 months Fixed Term Contract 
 WHY VOI? 
 Working at Voi is more than just a job; Our People Promise includes a personal Voiage where you will grow as a professional and be a part of a team and culture that builds something meaningful for society. In addition to this, you’ll have the opportunity to:
 Join Europe's #1 micromobility company
 Get “skin in the game” through our employee options program and play a crucial part in developing our warehouses
 Have a direct impact on our continued success and the development of the micromobility industry in London
 Work with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal
 At Voi, we are committed to responsible and ethical recruitment practices, ensuring that all recruitment processes are fair, transparent, and free from exploitation. We operate under the principle that we cover the associated recruitment costs, meaning that no recruitment fees or related costs are charged to workers at any stage of the hiring process. All such costs are borne by Voi, and we require the same standards to be upheld across the agencies we partner with. We work only with recruitment partners who share our commitment to ethical practices and regularly review our processes to ensure compliance, protect workers’ rights, and promote a safe and respectful hiring experience for all our candidates.

 V enoti Naložbe odpiramo novo karierno priložnost na delovnem mestu samostojni referent (m/ž). 
 Kaj boste počeli
 Glavne naloge in odgovornosti bodo: 
 izvajanje zalednih operativnih postopkov v podporo enoti Globalne skrbniške storitve, 
 spremljanje vplačil in oddaja nalogov v tujino za vzajemne sklade, 
 vnos, spremljava, poravnave in knjiženje poslov ter izvajanje dnevnih kontrol, 
 spremljanje stanja in zagotavljanje denarnih sredstev za poravnavo poslov na domačem in tujih trgih, 
 k njiženje izdanih in prejetih računov, spremljanje terjatev , 
 priprava in oddaja davčnih obrazcev za kapitalske dobičke, 
 sodelovanje z regulatorji ter priprava poročil in analiz s področja poravnave poslov, 
 posodabljanje in oblikovanje internih navodil s področja dela, 
 sodelovanje pri projektih za razvoj novih produktov, implementaciji zakonodajnih sprememb in informatizaciji poslovanja. 
 Kaj boste potrebovali za uspeh
 K prijavi vabimo kandidate, ki: 
 imate VI. stopnjo izobrazbe ekonomske ali druge ustrezne smeri, oziroma V. stopnjo izobrazbe ostalih ustreznih smeri, 
 imate najmanj 3 leta delovnih izkušenj z enakimi ali podobnimi deli, 
 imate dobro razvite analitične sposobnosti, ste natančni, sistematični, zanesljivi, odgovorni in vas veseli delo v timu, 
 ste samoiniciativni in željni novega znanja, pripravljeni proaktivno sodelovati pri projektih in optimizacijah procesov, 
 aktivno uporabljate slovenski in angleški jezik ter obvladate programska orodja MS Office v okolju Windows, 
 pozna te predpis e s področja dela in druge zaledne storitve v bančnem okolju (plačilni promet, osnove računovodstva – predstavlja prednost). 
 Kaj boste dobili v zameno
 Če ste se našli v naštetih opisih in si želite veliko izzivov pri svojem delu, vas vabimo, da se nam pridružite. V naši mednarodni skupini boste našli veliko priložnosti za strokovno in osebnostno rast . Z možnostjo dela od doma (hibridni način dela) sodelavcem omogočamo lažje usklajevanje zasebnega ter poklicnega življenja. 
 Prijave z življenjepisom in s spremnim pismom sprejemamo prek spletnega obrazca do vključno 30. oktobra 2026 . Z izbranim kandidatom ali s kandidatko bo delovno razmerje sklenjeno za nedoločen čas s 6 mesečno poskusno dobo .

 Co Vás u nás čeká:
 ✔️ Klienti každý den - budete v kontaktu se stávajícími i novými klienty a pomáhat jim najít řešení pro jejich finance. ✔️ Schůzky a péče o klienty - na pobočce budete zjišťovat, co klienti potřebují, a společně hledat řešení, která dávají smysl. ✔️ Telefonování - budete aktivně oslovovat klienty, domlouvat schůzky a pečovat o ně i po telefonu. ✔️ Finance od A do Z - účty, spoření, investice, pojištění nebo každodenní bankovní služby. Postupně budete mít finance opravdu v malíku. ✔️ Učení a růst - zkušenosti z banky nejsou podmínkou. Co budete potřebovat, vás naučíme.

Pokud máte certifikace ČNB, určitě je také oceníme.
 Co za to dostanete

 Benefity přesahující 75 000 Kč ročně a další výhody: 
 ✔️ 5 týdnů dovolené, narozeninové volno, sick days a 8 dnů na regeneraci. ✔️ 20 000 Benefit Plus bodů ročně na sport, kulturu, vzdělávání i další aktivity podle vašeho výběru. ✔️ Stravenky v hodnotě 180 Kč za každý odpracovaný den. ✔️ Možnost pořízení karty MultiSport. ✔️ Zvýhodněné bankovní produkty a služby včetně výhodnějších podmínek hypotéky. ✔️ Záleží nám na Vaší psychické pohodě - nabízíme neomezený přístup k online terapii Hedepy. ✔️ Bohatý program zaměstnaneckých akcí, od sportovních her až po vánoční večírek. ✔️ Možnost rekreace v podnikové chatě v Horní Malé Úpě. ✔️ 2 dny placeného volna na dobrovolnické aktivity. ✔️ Podporujeme rodiny: nabízíme placené volno navíc pro rodiče samoživitele i nastávající maminky. ✔️ Za věrnost odměňujeme: po 10 letech získáte dalších 5 dní dovolené, více Benefit Plus bodů a možnost sabbaticalu.

Missions Contribuer
items.desc: Contexte Un grand groupe media recherche un prestataire en développement IA / LLMOps pour renforcer son équipe IA transverse dédiée aux offres d'information. La mission porte sur des développements en intelligence artificielle générative, traitement du langage naturel (NLP) et reconnaissance vocale (Speech-to-text), dans un environnement technique exigeant alliant industrialisation et innovation. Missions Contribuer au développement et à la mise en production de modèles IA/ML/DL dans le cadre de projets liés aux offres d'information Concevoir et implémenter des architectures LLM, mettre en place des pipelines RAG, intégrer des modèles d'embeddings et des bases vectorielles Développer et exposer des routes API métiers : Speech-to-text, classification d'articles et de commentaires, titraille SEO, contextualisation Assurer la containerisation et le déploiement des solutions via Docker, Kubernetes et les pipelines CI/CD sous GitLab Mettre en ?uvre les pratiques MLOps : suivi d'expérimentations avec MLflow, évaluation via LLM-as-judge et golden datasets, gestion du drift de prompts Participer à la conception d'agents IA et au déploiement de modèles de langage de petite taille (SLM) Contribuer au monitoring et à l'observabilité des systèmes via Prometheus et Grafana Collaborer avec des profils non-techniques (journalistes, éditeurs) en vulgarisant les solutions développées Participer aux rituels agiles de l'équipe et contribuer à la culture d'amélioration continue Environnement de travail Démarrage prévu début à mi-novembre 2026 (date prévisionnelle de la lettre : 09/11/2026), pour une durée pouvant aller jusqu'à 4 ans (3 mois reconductibles). Présence sur site requise au moins 50 % du temps, soit 2 à 3 jours par semaine, en fonction des besoins de la prestation. Des astreintes ou interventions exceptionnelles le soir, le week-end et les jours fériés sont à prévoir. La mission se déroule dans le 15e arrondissement de Paris, à proximité du métro Balard ou du RER C. Pour candidater, merci d'envoyer un message à r e s s o u r c e s (at) a x a n d e . f r en y indiquant/joignant : CV ou profil à jour au format docx de préférence Date de disponibilité et sous quelles conditions (préavis à donner ? déjà disponible ?) Tarif journalier demandé pour la mission Préciser si vous pouvez intervenir sur site client comme demandé ci-dessus Votre experience en mise en production de solutions LLM et en MLOps (MLflow, evaluation, drift de prompts) dans un contexte media ou editorial sera un element determinant. Profil candidat: Minimum 3 ans d'expérience significative en développement IA/ML/DL avec des déploiements effectifs en production Maîtrise de Python et/ou Node.js appliqué à l'IA, ainsi que de la manipulation de données avec SQL Expérience avérée en conception d'architectures LLM, mise en place de RAG et utilisation de bases vectorielles Maîtrise de Docker, Kubernetes et des pipelines CI/CD avec GitLab Expérience en MLOps : MLflow, évaluation de LLM, gestion du drift Capacité à développer des routes API métiers (STT, NLP, classification) Appréciable : expérience sur GCP, Azure ou Cloud souverain (OVH/Scaleway), conception d'agents IA, tests de performance, Prometheus/Grafana Aisance relationnelle et capacité à vulgariser auprès de profils non-techniques

items.desc: Description Rejoins Flatchr et construis le futur du recrutement ! Flatchr , c’est une plateforme SaaS française spécialisée dans le recrutement. Notre mission : simplifier le quotidien des recruteurs et des managers grâce à un ATS performant, intuitif et connecté à leur écosystème. Aujourd’hui, nous accompagnons plus de 2 700 entreprises et traitons des centaines de milliers de candidatures chaque mois. Pour continuer à faire évoluer notre produit, nous recherchons un·e développeur·se Fullstack JS qui aime comprendre les enjeux métier, construire des fonctionnalités utiles et explorer de nouvelles façons de développer grâce à l’IA. Un produit qui passe à l’échelle 200 000+ candidatures traitées chaque mois 10 000 offres d’emploi générées chaque mois 190+ intégrations jobboards via XML, webhooks et API REST 25+ applications Marketplace : Lucca, AssessFirst, CoderPad… Derrière ces chiffres, des enjeux techniques concrets : fiabilité, performance, interopérabilité et expérience utilisateur. ️ Notre environnement technique Backend : Node.js, Hapi.js / Express Frontend : JavaScript, React Base de données : PostgreSQL Infrastructure : Docker, Google Cloud Platform, CI/CD IA : assistants de code au quotidien et intégration de LLM dans notre produit Organisation : Kanban, collaboration étroite entre Tech et Produit L’IA fait partie de notre quotidien Chez Flatchr, l’IA ne se limite pas à une expérimentation : elle transforme déjà notre manière de développer et les fonctionnalités que nous proposons à nos clients. Dans ton quotidien de développeur·se , tu pourras utiliser des assistants IA pour accélérer le développement, automatiser les tâches répétitives, faciliter le refactoring et consacrer davantage de temps à la conception et à la qualité du code. Dans notre produit , tu contribueras à explorer et intégrer de nouveaux usages : génération d’annonces, matching de CV, résumés de candidatures ou assistants dédiés aux recruteurs. Notre approche : utiliser l’IA comme un levier de productivité, sans faire de compromis sur la compréhension du code, la maîtrise technique et la qualité des solutions livrées. Avantages : RTT Mutuelle Remboursement des transports à 50% Ce que tu vas construire Au sein d’une équipe tech à taille humaine, composée d’un CTPO, d’un Engineering Manager, d’un Tech Lead, d’un Product Manager et de trois développeurs, tu participeras directement à l’évolution de notre plateforme. 1. Développer et faire évoluer notre produit Concevoir, développer et maintenir des fonctionnalités fullstack en Node.js et React, avec une attention particulière portée à la performance, à la fiabilité et à l’expérience utilisateur. 2. Relever des défis techniques concrets Faire évoluer nos systèmes d’ingestion et de multidiffusion d’offres d’emploi, gérer les échanges avec nos partenaires et contribuer à la robustesse de nos nombreuses intégrations. 3. Explorer de nouveaux usages de l’IA Expérimenter, prototyper et intégrer des fonctionnalités basées sur les LLM pour améliorer l’expérience de nos utilisateurs et simplifier leurs processus de recrutement. 4. Faire progresser la qualité du code Participer aux code reviews, améliorer l’existant, renforcer les tests et la documentation, et contribuer progressivement à nos pratiques de typage TypeScript. 5. Contribuer aux décisions produit et techniques Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, échanger avec l’équipe Produit et proposer des solutions pragmatiques qui répondent à de vrais enjeux métier. ‍ ️ Ce qu’on recherche Tu as de bonnes bases techniques et l’envie de progresser. Expérience : tu as environ 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en développement fullstack JavaScript et tu as déjà travaillé avec Node.js et React. Frontend & UX : tu apprécies particulièrement React et tu accordes de l’importance à la qualité des interfaces et à l’expérience utilisateur. Qualité du code : tu maîtrises JavaScript, tu connais TypeScript ou souhaites approfondir sa pratique, et tu sais écrire du code lisible, maintenable et testé. Curiosité pour l’IA : tu utilises déjà des assistants de code ou tu as envie de les intégrer à ta pratique quotidienne, avec suffisamment de recul pour comprendre et challenger leurs propositions. Esprit produit : tu cherches à comprendre le besoin avant de développer une solution et tu sais mettre en perspective les choix techniques avec les enjeux business. Collectif : tu apprécies les échanges techniques, les code reviews et la confrontation constructive des idées. Pas besoin de tout maîtriser dès ton arrivée : nous cherchons surtout une personne solide sur ses fondamentaux, curieuse et capable de prendre progressivement de l’autonomie. Ton environnement de travail Nous privilégions la collaboration et les échanges directs, tout en conservant de la flexibilité au quotidien. Organisation : 3 jours de présentiel par semaine et 2 jours de télétravail. Bureaux : 700 m² avec café, thé, fruits frais, sièges massants et salle de sport. Vie d’équipe : petit-déjeuner …

Face à l’urgence climatique, notre rôle est d’inventer un modèle énergétique qui respecte notre planète. items.desc: Qui sont-ils ? Accompagner les entrepreneurs pour qu’ils réussissent. Aujourd'hui je vais te raconter une histoire, celle de Dougs, Dougs, c’est avant tout une histoire humaine, c’est la rencontre de Véronique, Sarah et Patrick, experts-comptables et de Florent, ingénieur. C’est une société disruptive qui réinvente sans limite l’accompagnement des entrepreneurs. Dougs, c’est bien plus qu’un cabinet d’expertise comptable. Avec une équipe de plus de 90 ingénieurs et 270 professionnels des métiers (experts comptables et avocats), Dougs, c’est une société qui bouscule les codes. En 2023, notre vision a pris une nouvelle envergure avec une levée de fonds de 25 millions d'euros. Demain ? Nous allons bâtir une équipe de 500 passionnés partageant nos valeurs : Simple, Professionnel, Enthousiaste, Fantastique, Efficience totale, Voir grand. C'est par une approche innovante et révolutionnaire de la comptabilité et de l’entrepreneuriat que Dougs change la donne pour plus de 42 000 entrepreneurs. Alors, prêt à faire partie de l'aventure ? Descriptif du poste Ton futur poste Dougs a cassé les codes de l’expertise comptable traditionnelle pour simplifier la vie des entrepreneurs. Aujourd’hui, fidèle à notre ADN, nous déployons l’IA partout où elle peut apporter de la valeur pour accompagner les collaborateurs dans leur mission de conseil et fluidifier l’expérience de nos clients. Nous recherchons donc notre futur AI Agent Engineer. Tu vas rejoindre une équipe fonctionnelle et déjà impactante au cœur de notre stratégie d'innovation. Tu auras un rôle clé dans sa construction et son développement. Son ambition : faire gagner du temps à toutes les équipes métier (Comptabilité, Legal, Care, Sales, etc.) pour pouvoir servir au mieux nos clients en leur permettant de se concentrer sur leur mission de conseil et d’accompagnement. Tu seras en lien direct avec ces équipes : ton rôle sera de transformer leurs problématiques en agents autonomes, en exploitant pleinement le potentiel des modèles de langage. Trois atouts majeurs t’accompagneront : Des équipes métiers toujours partantes pour remettre en cause l’existant. Une collaboration main dans la main avec les équipes Produits, Opérations et Tech pour co-construire les solutions les plus efficaces. Une stack de pointe combinant notre plateforme d’agentique interne, Cursor et Claude pour accélérer ta vélocité de build. En résumé, tu seras à la croisée des chemins entre la tech et l’humain, avec une vraie possibilité d’avoir de l’impact ! Concrètement, quelles sont tes missions ? Comprendre les besoins métier et leurs enjeux : Échanger avec les différentes équipes (Marketing, Ventes, Support client, etc.) pour identifier leurs défis et opportunités sur lesquelles l’IA peut apporter de la valeur Traduire ces problématiques métier en besoins fonctionnels et techniques (architecture de l'agent, tools à développer ou à ajuster,etc.). Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des agents : Conception d’agents complexes : Concevoir et co-construire des agents précis, optimisés et sécurisés capables d’exécuter leurs missions en toute autonomie Build technique : Développer les "tools" et API manquants nécessaires aux agents pour interagir avec notre écosystème. Collaboration Tech : Travailler main dans la main avec les développeurs seniors pour garantir la qualité, la sécurité et etc. Amélioration et validation des agents : Tester, analyser les résultats (qualité des réponses, taux d'erreurs, etc…) et mettre en œuvre les améliorations nécessaires. items.desc: Job ID: 3571734 AIOps Engineer (m/f/d) AI Infrastructure & Orchestration Warsaw Professional Application deadline: 31.10.2026 Regular (Part Time Possible) T-Hub Polska Your Task Design, deploy, and maintain vLLM inference services on OpenShift/Kubernetes running on bare-metal GPU infrastructure. Manage NVIDIA GPU resources, including GPU partitioning and allocation, to maximize utilization across multiple models and tenants. Automate model lifecycle management, including model onboarding, versioning, deployment, hot-swapping, and rollback from private registries such as Hugging Face Enterprise and S3. Implement and manage Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA) based on workload demand, queue depth, and GPU resource utilization.Optimize vLLM configurations and serving parameters to maximize performance, throughput, and resource efficiency. Build and maintain observability and monitoring solutions for AI inference services, including metrics collection, logging, and tracing. Instrument vLLM endpoints to expose metrics related to token consumption, latency, throughput, and error rates. Develop usage tracking mechanisms to monitor token consumption by API key, user, team, or department, supporting quota management and chargeback/showback requirements. Create and maintain Grafana dashboards covering infrastructure health, GPU utilization, inference performance, service availability, and business consumption metrics. Configure proactive monitoring and alerting using Prometheus and Alertmanager to detect infrastructure failures, performance degradation, and unusual consumption patterns. Implement and maintain API Gateway solutions to provide authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and intelligent routing to inference services. Ensure secure operation of AI services through network segmentation, ingress and egress controls, and adherence to security best practices. Maintain audit logging capabilities to support compliance, security investigations, and operational governance. Collaborate with AI Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure AI services. Participate in troubleshooting, incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous platform improvement initiatives. Your Profile 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Operations. At least 2 years of hands-on experience supporting MLOps, AI Infrastructure, or Large Language Model (LLM) platforms. Strong experience with Kubernetes and OpenShift administration in production environments. Proven experience deploying and operating vLLM-based inference platforms in production. Strong understanding of LLM serving concepts, including Paged Attention, continuous batching, and inference optimization techniques. Deep knowledge of NVIDIA GPU technologies, CUDA drivers, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and GPU troubleshooting.Hands-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and ELK Stack. Experience building observability solutions, including custom metrics, exporters, dashboards, and alerting mechanisms. Strong Python programming skills with experience developing automation and operational tooling. Experience with Bash scripting and Linux systems administration. Familiarity with GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work in complex, distributed environments.Excellent communication and collaboration skills. As a leader in the telecommunications industry, we do not only provide a platform to hone your technical skills but also empower you to be a catalyst for innovation. You'll have the opportunity to work at the forefront of modern technologies, from 5G to IoT and AI, shaping the future of connectivity. items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. We are at the heart of Alan's mission , bringing to the team our technical leadership and expertise on healthcare and death & disability insurance. We work hand in hand with our data scientists, designers, engineers and product managers to build the most differentiating products and provide a delightful experience at a fair price. We build and manage offers for large companies and public institutions with our sales and account management teams. We make sure our portfolio is closely monitored and risks are effectively managed. We also manage our capital, steer our reinsurance strategy and maintain a trusting relationship with our insurance regulators. ️ The Insurance Pricing & Business role in Belgium ️ The role is to: Price and shape offers with our sales teams for large corporates and public institutions, Act as a trusted technical advisor in client meetings, Design insurance products that fit member needs and regulation, Support account managers in renewing our most strategic clients, including indexation and loss-ratio conversations. In Belgium, recent missions include: Build winning products and pricing strategies to unlock new segments Bring insurance expertise to help us sign the largest customers in Belgium, including public tenders Strengthen our competitiveness through coverage and price trade-offs Work with engineers to build tools to create tailored insurance offers at scale Be part of an insurance community at the global level, with an impact on our organisation, hiring and training across multiple countries. ️ Is it you we're looking for? ️ You may be a great fit for the role if: You have 3+ years of experience in an actuarial, pricing or underwriting role, ideally on health, hospitalisation or group insurance You are fluent in English and Dutch ; French is a strong plus You combine a scientific background (actuarial sciences, statistics, mathematics or data science) with an analytical, structured and fact-based way of working You are comfortable navigating technical, data, legal and business questions with clients and internal teams You are excited to bring technical expertise into a business-centric context , and are at ease with ambiguity You have a builder mindset : you continuously identify opportunities to improve and scale processes and tools You communicate in a clear, structured and to-the-point way in English (written and spoken) You are willing to deeply change the insurance industry and challenge the status quo For this role, we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range. items.desc: GE Vernova is looking for an Electrical Application Engineer to join our Power Quality team in Tampere, Finland. This is an opportunity to join an experienced engineering team working on harmonic filter and reactive power compensation solutions for transmission and renewable energy applications. In this role, you will support the technical execution of customer orders, helping to translate project requirements into clear engineering deliverables for customers including transmission system operators, renewable energy projects, and internal GE Vernova stakeholders. You will work within the Order to Remittance (OTR) phase, supporting the engineering activities required to deliver customer projects from order intake through to execution. This may include technical coordination, engineering documentation, design support and collaboration with internal teams and external suppliers to help ensure projects are delivered in line with customer requirements and business expectations. This role would suit an electrical engineer with an interest in high-voltage or medium-voltage applications who is comfortable working with technical specifications, engineering detail and cross-functional collaboration. Direct experience in harmonic filters is not essential, and the role offers the opportunity to contribute within a knowledgeable team while building or applying expertise in a specialist area. Job Description Key Responsibilities As an Electrical Application Engineer, you will play an active role in the engineering execution of customer projects within our Power Quality business. In this role, you will: Work with key equipment used in harmonic filter and reactive power compensation systems, including capacitors, reactors and resistors, as well as associated high-voltage equipment Use engineering tools and applications including DIgSILENT PowerFactory, AutoCAD, and other internal systems used in application engineering and project execution Your responsibilities will include: Supporting the technical execution of awarded projects, ensuring engineering deliverables are aligned with customer specifications and project requirements Preparing, reviewing and coordinating technical documentation, drawings and related engineering outputs required during project delivery Working with internal engineering teams, supply chain, project stakeholders and external vendors to ensure technical information is complete and accurately managed Contributing to technical reviews, engineering discussions and clarification activities throughout the project lifecycle Supporting the resolution of technical queries and helping to ensure engineering activities are delivered in line with required standards, quality expectations and project timelines The Ideal Candidate As this is a specialist field, we welcome candidates with relevant electrical engineering experience from adjacent areas, even if they have not worked directly with harmonic filter systems before. We are interested in candidates who bring strong electrical fundamentals, sound engineering judgement and the right mindset to learn and contribute.
