items.desc: We’re looking for an MLOps Engineer to join our tech team and help build the future of neuro-contextual advertising at global scale. Who We Are At Seedtag, our mission is to transform advertising by proving that effectiveness and user privacy can truly coexist. As the leading Neuro-Contextual Advertising Company, we combine Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and neuroscience to understand not only what content is about, but how it makes people feel and what they intend to do next. Our proprietary AI, Liz, enables brands to connect with audiences across the open web and Connected TV without cookies or user tracking. Founded in 2014 by two ex-Googlers, Seedtag has grown to 500+ Seedtaggers in 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and operates today as a global ad-tech leader. If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and building AI-driven systems at scale, you’ll feel right at home here. Your Challenge As our MLOps Engineer, you will help scale and maintain the infrastructure behind Liz, Seedtag's contextual AI, ensuring reliable, efficient, and low-latency ML model deployment across the open web and CTV. Your main responsibilities will include: ML Model Deployment: Deploy, maintain, and optimise ML models in production, ensuring performance, reliability, and latency standards. Data Pipelines: Build and improve pipelines for dataset generation, model training, validation, and performance analysis. Model Observability: Implement monitoring, dashboards, drift detection, and alerting to ensure model quality and stability. MLOps Infrastructure: Improve CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, reproducibility, and infrastructure automation. Performance & Cost Optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce serving costs and improve efficiency without compromising model quality. AI Automation: Develop internal automations and agentic integrations to streamline ML workflows. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data, Platform, and Backend teams to troubleshoot production issues and improve ML systems. Our Core Values Outcome over Output We measure success by impact and value, not by volume of features or lines of code. Failure Is Allowed, Learning Is a Must Experimentation is key to innovation. We test early, iterate often, and learn fast. We Are All Scouts We take ownership and leave things better than we found them. We Are Data-Driven Data informs our decisions and helps us continuously improve our systems and results. Tech Stack You'll work with the technologies powering LizCore, our contextual AI infrastructure, supporting real-time ML model serving across the open web and CTV. Our stack includes: Languages: Python, Go. Cloud & Infrastructure: GCP, Vertex AI, Kubernetes, Terraform. MLOps & Monitoring: MLflow, Weights & Biases, Evidently, Prometheus, Grafana. Data & Messaging: Kafka, Redis, Bigtable, MongoDB. AI & Machine Learning: NLP, embeddings, ranking models, MCP, agentic workflows. Engineering Practices: CI/CD, model versioning, automated testing, reproducibility. What You’ll Need to Succeed 2–4 years of experience building, deploying, and maintaining ML systems in production. Strong Python skills, including APIs, asynchronous programming, testing, and clean architecture. Hands-on experience with ML model development and production deployment. Solid understanding of MLOps practices, including CI/CD, model versioning, reproducibility, and monitoring. Experience with ML observability, including performance metrics, dashboards, and alerting. Knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure. Strong troubleshooting skills across models, data pipelines, APIs, and infrastructure. Proactive, curious, and autonomous, with the ability to own technical components end to end. Why Join Seedtag? A key moment of growth with real ownership and global impact. Flexible work model with 100% remote or hybrid options. (Remote contracts available in Spain, Italy, UK, Belgium, Netherlands, France, and Germany.) Continuous learning through a learning platform and optional language classes. A supportive, trust-based culture that values well-being. Team activities, offsites, and opportunities to connect beyond work. Additional Perks Home office setup budget up to €1,000 Paid trips to our HQ in Madrid MacBook Pro M3 Ready to Join the Seedtag Adventure? At Seedtag, we create an environment where everyone can thrive. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, let us know and we’ll ensure a positive experience. Send us your CV and let’s build the future of neuro-contextual advertising together.

items.desc: PRESENTATION GROUPE HENIX HENIX est une ESN française spécialisée en Qualité Logicielle et outillage de la transformation numérique . Créée en 1998, leader français parmi les ESN spécialisées en Qualité Logicielle et DevOps, elle compte aujourd’hui plus de 480 salariés. Nous élaborons et mettons en œuvre des démarches outillées pour améliorer la qualité et l'agilité des SI. Nous intervenons également en "tiers de confiance" auprès de nos clients, grands comptes, pour contrôler et pérenniser leurs actifs logiciels. Sur les 3 domaines Agilité , Test et DevOps , nous déclinons différentes activités : Services (outillage et réalisation) avec une expertise en mise en œuvre de méthodologie outillée ou en réalisation de prestations www.henix.fr Édition logicielle de la suite SquashTM (outil de test leader en France – 2000 téléchargements/mois ) www.squashtm.com Distribution et expertise sur les produits partenaires Gitlab, Jira, Sonatype, OpenProject. Formation (via notre École de la Qualité Logicielle) leader français de la reconversion aux métiers de la qualité logicielle (plus de 200 personnes formées par an). www.ecoleql.fr DESCRIPTION DU SERVICE ADMINISTRATION SYSTÈMES ET RÉSEAUX Le service AdminSys & Réseaux compte actuellement 3 personnes à temps plein plus un alternant, dont une chargée exclusivement du support aux utilisateurs. L’équipe se concentre principalement sur deux types d’activités : Activités de RUN (maintien en condition opérationnelle de trois SI) Supervision/monitoring, maintenance corrective et préventive au niveau matériel, logiciel, réseaux… Support aux utilisateurs : fourniture de PCs, de périphériques, attribution de droits, dépannages… Activités de BUILD Migration Windows 10 à Windows 11 Nouvelle architecture de sauvegardes Automatisation des infrastructures Chantiers techniques liés à notre démarche de certification ISO 27001 (notre objectif = obtenir la certification courant S2 2027) DESCRIPTION DU POSTE Afin d’accompagner notre croissance, nous recrutons un·e Administrateur·trice Réseaux & Systèmes polyvalent·e et autonome, capable d’assurer des missions de Run et de Build. Le poste s’inscrit dans un contexte majoritairement Linux (infrastructures Open Source et développement), complété par un environnement Windows pour les usages bureautiques. Basé·e principalement dans nos locaux de Montrouge, vous intégrerez une équipe à taille humaine et interviendrez sur un système d'information en constante évolution, nécessitant adaptabilité, curiosité technique et sens du service. Vous participerez aux activités suivantes : Support aux utilisateurs Maintien en conditions opérationnelles des SI du groupe Contribution à des chantiers de Build, notamment dans le cadre de notre démarche de certification ISO 27001 ACTIVITÉS D'ADMINISTRATION SYSTÈMES ET RÉSEAUX Activités de RUN Maintien en conditions opérationnelles du SI : installation, configuration, administration, sécurisation et maintenance des serveurs GNU/Linux. Administration des postes Windows 10/11, périphériques, imprimantes, salles de réunions et environnements collaboratifs Microsoft 365, Google Workspace ; Administration de l’infrastructure virtuelle : Proxmox / LXC, Docker, Vmware ; Administration des services d’infrastructure : Samba, Samba-AD, NFS, IAM, Active Directory, LDAP, gestion des droits utilisateurs ; Administration des infrastructures réseaux sous pfSense / OPNsense : WAN, LAN / VLAN, WLAN (Ubiquiti UniFi), DHCP, DNS, Radius 802.1x, routage, OSI, Switch HPE Aruba, Cisco, SSO ; Maintien en conditions opérationnelles des serveurs Dell PowerEdge et HPE ProLiant. Automatisation et industrialisation des tâches d’administration, de déploiement et de gestion des infrastructures à l’aide de Bash/Shell, Python, Ansible, Git et des outils CI/CD. Supervision & sauvegardes Des infrastructures et des services avec Zabbix (ou équivalent) ; Administration des solutions de journalisation (Syslog, Graylog, Wazuh, Splunk) ; Suivi de la disponibilité des plateformes ; Gestion et automatisation des sauvegardes des serveurs et des données. Bases de données Réalisation des montées de version, migrations techniques, transferts de données et administration des bases de données PostgreSQL et MariaDB. Support technique de niveaux 2 et 3 aux utilisateurs et accompagnement des équipes internes sur les problématiques systèmes, réseaux, sécurité et outils métiers. Documentation - rédaction et maintien De la documentation technique ; Des procédures d'exploitation ; Des schémas d'infrastructure ; Des référentiels d'administration. Réalisation d'une veille technologique et réglementaire Sur les infrastructures, les solutions d'administration, les technologies Cloud, les pratiques DevSecOps et les évolutions en cybersécurité. items.desc: Descriptif et missions La Ville des Ulis (25 000 habitants), au cœur du territoire d'innovation Paris-Saclay, conduit une transformation ambitieuse de son système d'information afin d'offrir des services numériques performants, résilients et sécurisés à ses agents comme à ses administrés. Notre Direction des Systèmes d'Information investit durablement dans ses infrastructures et prépare dès aujourd'hui les usages numériques de demain : cybersécurité, cloud, virtualisation, automatisation et intelligence artificielle. Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Systèmes, Réseaux et Cybersécurité capable d'accompagner cette dynamique et de contribuer activement aux choix techniques qui structureront notre système d'information pour les années à venir. Pourquoi rejoindre notre DSI : Contrairement à de nombreuses organisations, vous n'arrivez pas sur une infrastructure en fin de vie. Vous intégrerez une DSI disposant : d'une infrastructure moderne et performante ; d'une faible dette technique ; d'une politique d'investissement soutenue ; d'une forte autonomie dans les choix technologiques ; d'une équipe impliquée, agile et force de proposition. Ici, votre rôle ne se limitera pas au maintien en condition opérationnelle : vous contribuerez directement à la stratégie technique de la collectivité. Missions / conditions d'exercice Les grands projets qui vous attendent : Déployer un véritable Plan de Secours Informatique, participer à la conception et à la mise en œuvre d'un dispositif complet de continuité et de reprise d'activité afin de renforcer la résilience du système d'information, repenser l'identité numérique de la collectivité. Piloter la refonte de l'environnement Microsoft Active Directory / Entra ID afin de moderniser la gestion des identités, renforcer la sécurité et accompagner les nouveaux usages numériques. Introduire les technologies de conteneurisation, accompagner la mise en œuvre des technologies Docker afin de moderniser les méthodes de déploiement applicatif et préparer les futures architectures et développer une approche cybersécurité "by design". Participer au renforcement continu de la sécurité des infrastructures : sécurisation des infrastructures Microsoft ; évolution des architectures réseau ; amélioration de la supervision ; renforcement de la protection des données ; amélioration de la résilience des services numériques. Participer à l'introduction de l'Intelligence Artificielle La Ville des Ulis souhaite intégrer progressivement les technologies d'IA afin d'améliorer les services rendus aux agents et aux usagers. Vous participerez à la mise en œuvre des infrastructures nécessaires à ces nouveaux usages : recherche documentaire intelligente ; automatisation de tâches ; assistants numériques ; nouveaux services basés sur l'IA. Votre quotidien Vous serez l'un des acteurs majeurs de l'évolution des infrastructures de la collectivité. À ce titre, vous serez amené à : administrer les infrastructures Windows Server et Linux ; faire évoluer les environnements VMware ; administrer Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Active Directory et Entra ID ; administrer les solutions de sauvegarde Veeam ; maintenir les infrastructures réseau, Wi-Fi et téléphonie ; garantir la disponibilité, la performance et la sécurité des systèmes ; piloter ou contribuer aux projets techniques structurants ; assurer une veille technologique permanente ; participer aux choix d'architecture et aux orientations techniques de la DSI ; accompagner les techniciens dans les projets d'évolution. Ces missions s'inscrivent dans les responsabilités définies par la fiche de poste de la collectivité. Profil recherché Vous êtes avant tout un ingénieur passionné par les infrastructures et les nouvelles technologies. Vous aimez : concevoir des architectures robustes ; automatiser et industrialiser ; renforcer la cybersécurité ; résoudre des problématiques complexes ; proposer des solutions innovantes ; partager vos connaissances. Vous maîtrisez idéalement plusieurs des technologies suivantes : Windows Server ; Active Directory / Entra ID ; VMware ; Microsoft 365 ; Exchange Online ; Veeam Backup ; Fortinet ; réseaux LAN, WAN et Wi-Fi ; Docker ou les technologies de conteneurisation Powershell avancé Une sensibilité forte aux enjeux de cybersécurité constitue un véritable atout. Ce que nous vous proposons : Un poste à fort impact vous participerez directement aux décisions techniques et aux projets structurants de la collectivité. Vous interviendrez sur des projets d'infrastructure, de cybersécurité, de continuité d'activité, de cloud Microsoft et d'intelligence artificielle. Vous évoluerez dans une infrastructure moderne, où la qualité technique, la sécurité et l'amélioration continue sont des priorités. La collectivité accompagne la montée en compétences de ses collaborateurs grâce à la formation et à leur implication dans des projets innovants. Face à l’urgence climatique, notre rôle est d’inventer un modèle énergétique qui respecte notre planète. Nous voulons construire un monde où il sera possible de produire une électricité neutre en CO2, grâce au nucléaire et aux énergies renouvelables, conciliant préservation de la planète, bien-être et développement, grâce à l’électricité et à des solutions et services innovants. \n\n Au croisement d’enjeux essentiels et captivants, rejoignez un groupe à la dimension internationale, champion de la croissance bas carbone et activement engagé dans la lutte contre le réchauffement climatique Rejoignez particulièrement nos équipes qui développent et maintiennent les applications du Groupe EDF ! Une direction dynamique, à l’écoute de ses équipes et avec des méthodes de travail innovantes. Vous intègrerez le Centre d'Excellence Data IA & Développements, précurseur sur l'implémentation des nouvelles architectures et solutions numérique (IA, Blockchain, automatisation, DevSecOps, Cloud native, …) et a pour vocation d’industrialiser ces solutions au service des métiers d'EDF. En tant qu'Expert(e) DevSecOps Sécurité, vous êtes l'architecte de la confiance au sein de notre écosystème technique. Votre rôle est de transformer la sécurité d'une contrainte en un moteur d'accélération technologique. Vous devez maitriser tous les rudiments du DevSecOps (Gitlab, SonarQube, Selenium, Cloud Public AWS/GCP, Kubernetes, etc.). Sous la responsabilité du Chef de Groupe et du Product Manager, vos missions s'articulent autour de quatre piliers : 1. Ingénierie de la CI/CD Sécurisée (Shift Left) Intégration continue de la sécurité : Développer et maintenir des pipelines "Template-as-Code" incluant des scans automatiques (SAST, DAST, IAST) avec des seuils de blocage intelligents (Quality Gates). Software Supply Chain Security : Sécuriser la provenance de nos dépendances (SCA) et mettre en place la signature d'images ainsi que la gestion des SBOM (Software Bill of Materials). 2. Sécurité de l'Infrastructure & Cloud Native Policy-as-Code : Automatiser la gouvernance de l'infrastructure (IaC) pour prévenir les dérives de configuration avant le déploiement (via Terraform, Ansible ou Pulumi). Durcissement Kubernetes : Implémenter des stratégies de sécurité réseau (Network Policies), la gestion des secrets et le monitoring des runtimes de conteneurs. 3. Observabilité et Défense Active (Shift Right) Runtime Security : Mettre en place des outils de détection d'anomalies en production (ex: Falco, Tetragon) et corréler les logs de sécurité pour une visibilité 360°. Compétences - Compétences clés : GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, services Cloud), Python, SQL. Pratiques techniques : Développement d'APIs, Git, pipelines CI/CD, tests automatisés. items.desc: Contexte de la missionDans le cadre du développement d?une plateforme de gouvernance des données, nous recherchons un développeur Front-End expérimenté pour concevoir et faire évoluer des interfaces dédiées à la gestion, à la recherche et à la valorisation des données d?entreprise. La plateforme permet notamment de centraliser le vocabulaire métier, de structurer le catalogue de données, de visualiser les relations entre les données et de faciliter l?accès aux métadonnées grâce à des fonctionnalités de recherche avancées et à des interfaces intégrant l?intelligence artificielle. Missions principalesConcevoir et développer les interfaces Front-End de la plateforme à l?aide de Vue.js. Participer à la conception et à l?implémentation de nouvelles fonctionnalités dans un environnement orienté produit et sémantique. Développer des interfaces permettant de consulter et d?explorer le glossaire métier, le vocabulaire contrôlé et le catalogue de données. Concevoir des visualisations interactives représentant les relations entre les données et leur lignage. Faciliter l?exploration des métadonnées à travers des mécanismes de recherche à facettes et des interfaces intégrant des fonctionnalités d?intelligence artificielle. Contribuer à l?interopérabilité de la plateforme et à la cohérence de son architecture. Participer à la définition et à l?application des standards de développement et d?architecture. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques et métiers pour garantir la robustesse, la maintenabilité et la scalabilité de la solution. Environnement techniqueFront-End : Vue.js : expertise indispensable. TypeScript : niveau confirmé attendu. Données et intelligence artificielle : BigQuery : connaissances de base souhaitées. Intelligence artificielle : expérience confirmée, notamment dans l?intégration ou l?exploitation de fonctionnalités basées sur l?IA. Graphes de connaissances : expérience concrète dans la manipulation et la représentation visuelle de graphes. Environnement Back-End : Java et Spring Boot. Kafka et Kafka Streams. PostgreSQL. Profil candidat: Nous recherchons un développeur Front-End expert en Vue.js, disposant d?une expérience significative dans la conception d?interfaces web complexes et interactives. Le candidat devra notamment posséder une expérience concrète dans la représentation visuelle de graphes et manifester un intérêt marqué pour l?intelligence artificielle et ses applications. Autonome, rigoureux et curieux, il devra être force de proposition et capable de collaborer efficacement au sein d?une équipe pluridisciplinaire. LanguesAnglais professionnel indispensable. Objectifs et livrablesDévelopper des interfaces performantes et intuitives pour la plateforme de gouvernance des données. Garantir l?interopérabilité des composants et la cohérence de l?architecture. Contribuer à la mise en place d?une plateforme robuste, évolutive et scalable. Faciliter l?exploration des données, de leurs métadonnées et de leurs relations sémantiques.

items.desc: « BE PASSIONATE ! », c'est notre slogan ! Passionné(e) de technologie et d'innovation, vous avez un tempérament entrepreneurial ? Vous aimez sortir des chemins battus ? Vous êtes curieux(se) et passionné(e) par le challenge technologique ? Alors, plus qu'un job, ce projet peut être le projet de votre vie! PA.COTTE, créée en 2014 par des fondateurs expérimentés, 70 collaborateurs, faisant partie d'un groupe international, centralise son activité R&D près de Nantes. Plusieurs millions d'euros sont investis afin de réaliser notre ambition : devenir l'un des leaders mondiaux dans le luxe technologique. Nous développons une nouvelle catégorie de produits de luxe high-tech, totalement innovants et uniques au monde, soumis à la confidentialité la plus stricte, et agrégeant un panel important de technologies et de savoir-faire dans les domaines de la mécatronique, automatique, logiciels embarqués, connectivité, et process de fabrication de pointe et bien sûr l'intelligence artificielle. Dans ce cadre, nous recrutons un(e) Ingénieur Développement Linux Embarqué pour prendre en charge la plateforme Linux de nos produits, du BSP jusqu’à l’intégration des applicatifs. Vos principales missions seront de : Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer la distribution Linux embarquée basée sur Yocto (layers, recettes, BSP) Préparer la plateforme Linux à l’exécution des modèles IA : intégration des drivers et runtimes NPU Concevoir et optimiser les chaînes de traitement audio et vidéo Participer aux phases de spécifications, conception et développement d’applicatifs embarqués, Étendre l’intelligence embarquée par l’ajout de capteurs, actionneurs ou IA embarqué Être force de proposition, apporter de nouvelles solutions technologiques et inventer de nouveaux usages. Compétences : Langage de programmation C / C++ et Python Yocto / OpenEmbedded (création de layers, recettes, BSP) Noyau Linux : device tree, drivers, debug kernel Multimédia sous Linux : GStreamer, V4L2, ALSA Intégration de modèles IA sur accélérateur matériel (NPU/GPU) Protocoles de communications et réseaux embarqués (ex : CAN, I2C, BLE, TCP/IP, UWB...) Connaissance des OS temps réel et des microcontrôleurs Intégration continue (GitLab CI, Jenkins…) Intégré(e) à notre équipe Software, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes Hardware, IT et mécanique. Une formation d’ingénieur dans le développement en environnement embarqué est incontournable pour intégrer notre équipe. Curieux(se), créatif(ve) et rigoureux(se), vous appréciez le travail en équipe et êtes avant tout passionné(e) ! Vous serez basé(e) dans notre centre de R&D près de Nantes. Dans notre environnement en perpétuelle croissance, le mode d'organisation agile est indispensable pour réussir ! Chacun(e) partage et enrichit le fruit de son travail avec ses collègues et si nécessaire nous remettons en question nos pratiques, dans un esprit collaboratif. Notre mode de fonctionnement est transversal, participatif, un suivi individuel est assuré et au fil des besoins, nous continuons de développer vos compétences en vous formant à des outils et technologies spécifiques. Si vous êtes comme nous fasciné(e) par les produits technologiques innovants, nous vous garantissons une vie professionnelle passionnante au sein de notre équipe extrêmement engagée. On ne vit qu'une fois, venez nous rejoindre ! Type d'emploi : Temps plein, CDI Rémunération : 42 000,00€ à 46 000,00€ par an Avantages : Prise en charge du transport quotidien RTT Travail à domicile occasionnel Lieu du poste : En présentiel

En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Capgemini recherche actuellement des profils : Partenaire mondial de la transformation business et technologique, Capgemini intègre la puissance de l’IA pour créer de la valeur pour ses clients. Nous imaginons le futur des organisations et le rendons réel grâce à l’IA, à la technologie et à nos talents. Depuis près de 60 ans, nous sommes un groupe responsable et multiculturel, avec 420000 collaborateurs dans plus de 50 pays. Capgemini propose des services et des solutions de bout en bout, en mobilisant son expertise sectorielle, son écosystème de partenaires et ses compétences de pointe en stratégie, technologie, design, ingénierie et opérations. Le Groupe a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires mondial de 22,1 milliards d’euros en 2024. Choisir Capgemini, c’est avoir la possibilité de faire la différence, que ce soit pour les plus grandes entreprises du monde ou pour la société. Nous recherchons des talents pour entreprendre, inventer, oser, accompagner et construire un avenir inclusif et durable. Ensemble, donnons à la technologie cette touche humaine dont le monde a besoin. Make it real* | www.capgemini.com 

 Architecture, design et build : réaliser des audits, concevoir des architectures Cloud en s'appuyant sur des framework type TOGAF. Cadrage et suivi technique des projets : accompagner et piloter les équipes en charge de la mise en oeuvre de ces architectures. Technical leader : apporter des solutions d'industrialisation, d'intégration et de déploiement continue (choix et mise en oeuvre des solutions CICD et d'IaC). Innovation et partage : faire de la veille technologique et tester des solutions (PoC); diffuser les points de vues d'architecte sur les pratiques et technologies d'aujourd'hui et de demain auprès des collaborateurs de Capgemini et auprès de nos clients ; définir les orientations et les choix stratégiques et technologiques de nos centres de services Cloud et applicatifs. Faire vivre la communauté métier : en tant qu'architecte vous êtes un élément clef pour animer les communautés techniques de votre site 

Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en architecture logicielle et/ou Cloud au sein d'un cabinet de conseil ou d'une ESN. Bonne maîtrise des environnements Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP), des infrastructures, de l'IaC (Terraform), Linux, des API, microservices et de la conteneurisation. Connaissance des enjeux DevSecOps, FinOps, SRE ainsi que des usages de l'IA générative et de l'IA agentique (GitHub Copilot, assistants IA, etc.). Leadership, capacité à animer des ateliers et des communautés techniques, à fédérer les équipes et à porter les bonnes pratiques de développement. Quelques raisons de nous rejoindre Communauté d’experts : rejoignez un réseau actif d’ingénieurs, de consultants et d’architectes Cloud, avec des échanges réguliers, des sessions techniques et des retours d’expérience. Projets stratégiques : travaillez sur des environnements hybrides et multicloud, avec des missions à fort enjeu dans la modernisation des infrastructures, la migration cloud, l’automatisation et la sécurité. Apprentissage en continu : accédez à des certifications reconnues (AWS, Azure, …), et à des parcours de formation spécialisés.

Vous souhaitez vous réorienter dans l’informatique ? Vous n'avez pas de diplôme dans ce domaine ? Capgemini vous accompagne dans cette reconversion ! En partenariat avec Pôle Emploi et un organisme de formation, nous vous formons au métier d’Ingénieure / Ingénieur Cloud DevOps dans le cadre d'une Préparation Opérationnelle à l'Emploi Individuelle (POEI). Au sein d’une promotion de 15 apprenants, vous suivrez une formation de 64 jours, en partenariat avec l’organisme M2I Formation. Cette formation démarre le 3 mars 2025 pour une entrée en CDI le 10 juin 2025. Les + de la formation : * Format 100% distanciel * Programme mêlant apprentissages théoriques et mise en pratique. A l'issue de ce cursus, vous intégrerez une équipe projet à Nantes pour l’un de nos clients et vos missions consisteront à : * Construire des environnements Linux / Windows * Implémenter et déployer des solutions Cloud en utilisant des plateformes telles que AWS, Azure ou GCP * Assurer la gestion et le maintien des infrastructures, en assurant la disponibilité, la sécurité et les performantes * Maintenir les plateformes d’intégration continue et automatiser des pipelines avec Docker, Ansible, Terraform, Kubernetes, …

Critères d’éligibilité : * Être demandeur(se)s d'emploi inscrit(e)s à Pôle Emploi. * Être titulaire d'un BAC+5 (idéalement d’une formation scientifique) * Faire preuve d’un bon relationnel et apprécier le travail en équipe * Détenir une forte adaptabilité * Avoir une réelle appétence pour l'informatique * Un niveau d’anglais professionnel serait un atout Vous vous reconnaissez dans ces quelques lignes ? Transmettez-nous votre candidature pour discuter de votre avenir ensemble !

items.desc: About Alma At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started! About the team The Consumer Tribe builds the Alma app for consumers. To tackle more topics and accelerate the development of the consumer experience, the current Consumer squad is splitting into two dedicated squads: Alma Wallet and Consumer Engagement. Alma Wallet builds the payment experience of the app. With the Alma card, consumers can pay with Alma anywhere, not only at our partner merchants. In the app, they can manage their payments using Apple Pay, Google Pay or local payment methods. By taking Alma beyond our merchant network, the Alma card is one of the company's key strategic bets. Consumer Engagement drives consumer activation, engagement and long-term retention by helping people get more value from Alma. The team builds experiences that make it easier for consumers to discover partner merchants, benefit from loyalty and cashback rewards, and manage their account independently. In 2027, the focus is on turning Alma into a more engaging, everyday consumer experience by strengthening loyalty, increasing repeat usage and making Consumer Engagement a key driver of Alma's long-term growth. This is a new position created as the consumer app organization splits into two squads to tackle more topics. You will join one of these squads and work closely with its Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Designer and back-end engineers. You will report to Gautier Labarre , Engineering Manager . This position is a permanent contract (CDI), open to full remote from Metropolitan France. About the job Build and ship meaningful consumer experiences: Develop and release new features in the Alma app from design to production, working closely with Product, Design and back-end engineers. Make payments simple and secure: Integrate payment SDKs and native mobile capabilities such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, card management, biometrics and secure storage. Raise the quality bar of the app: Keep the application fast, reliable and maintainable through automated testing, monitoring, code reviews and continuous performance improvements. Help the team learn and move forward: Contribute to technical decisions, challenge product and back-end implementation when needed, and improve the team's architecture, tooling and release processes. You will work with Mobile: Expo / EAS, Expo Router, React Native, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, react-hook-form, Zod, Reanimated, Unistyles, MMKV, Nitro modules. Tests: Jest, Testing Library, Maestro. Payments: Adyen, Stripe, Checkout.com SDKs. Observability: Datadog, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, OpenFeature. Back-end: Python, FastAPI. Tools: GitHub, Linear, Notion, Figma, Crowdin, Claude. About you To succeed in this job You have 3+ years of experience building mobile applications with React Native and TypeScript , with experience releasing apps on both the App Store and Google Play. You have a strong understanding of the React Native ecosystem, including Expo, navigation, state management and data fetching. You care deeply about software quality and have experience with testing, code reviews, monitoring and mobile performance. You are fluent in English and comfortable working in a cross-functional, international environment. And it will be nice if you also Have worked on payment products, fintech products or other security-sensitive applications. Have experience contributing to a consumer application used at scale. Are comfortable challenging product or back-end implementation when it does not provide the best user or technical outcome. Have experience with web development in addition to mobile development. Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience. What's in it for you If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on: Work on products at the heart of Alma's strategy, including the Alma card, new payment methods in the app and our loyalty programme. Solve real mobile fintech challenges involving payment SDKs, Apple Pay, Google Pay, biometrics and secure storage. items.desc: Job Description: Idéalement si tué au centre ville de Toulouse dans le quartier des Minimes, le site AIRBUS opérations de Saint Eloi recrute! Vous cherchez un nouveau job, ou vous souhaitez découvrir de nouvelles opportunités dans le domaine de la qualité, logistique, manufacturing engineering et gestion de projet, rejoignez nous! Grâce à la diversité des métiers et des salariés qui contribuent à sa réussite, Saint Eloi est le seul site au monde à concevoir, usiner, produire, assembler et livrer les mâts réacteurs pour tous les modèles d’avions Airbus. Résolument tourné vers l’avenir, il investit dans les technologies de pointe et contribue notamment au développement de l'impression 3D métallique et du futur avion Airbus à 0 émissions de CO2. Saint Eloi, ce n’est pas seulement des technologies de pointe, c’est également un site où l’on promeut l’inclusion et la diversité sous toutes ses formes et où l’engagement et la qualité de vie au travail font partie de nos priorités Rejoignez nous et participez à une vaste aventure technologique et humaine. Un poste de Demand & Supply Planner (h/f) vient de s'ouvrir au sein d'Airbus Commercial Aircraft à Toulouse, au sein de l'usine de St Eloi. items.desc: TL;DR: We are looking for a gap-year or final-year student to work alongside the leadership team on Davis's go-to-market, strategy and growth . About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. The role The role is cross-functional. You work directly with the whole team: the CEO and the Real Estate Partner as much as the tech teams. Together with them, you take part in decisions on company strategy, client acquisition and relationships, and product improvement. Your analyses form the basis for these decisions. Client relationships and deliverables Contribute to studies for our developer and investor clients, from data analysis to final formatting. Incorporate client feedback and improve deliverable quality from one version to the next. Prepare prospecting materials and key meetings. Strategy and planning Maintain the business plan and prepare the analyses that inform leadership decisions, including with investors. Key skills : strong synthesis and presentation skills , a real appetite for AI tools and a genuine interest in the real estate sector. Ability to structure a client presentation and deliver it. Rigour and attention to detail in analysis. Strong writing skills, in French and English. Additional skills Strong intellectual curiosity, with an appetite for real estate and for AI tools. Autonomy and the ability to get up to speed quickly on new topics. Ease in dealing with leadership, clients and partners. Enjoys working with tech teams. Knowledge of real estate is a plus. Why join Davis? You will work closely with the leadership team, with a full view of strategy, business development, clients and product. You will have broad autonomy and a direct impact on company decisions. You will learn to use AI as an everyday productivity lever, on high-stakes topics. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20 , and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle. Today we're a team of 12 : technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We're small with an extremely high bar . If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated. Proptech …

items.desc: Your mission Join us in building solutions that keep space safe and sustainable . With a lean hierarchy and small working groups , you define your own way of work including flexible work hours . Work on groundbreaking space sustainability challenges with a team of top-tier engineers and scientists. Enjoy technical freedom . Influence system architecture, research methodologies, and data integration approaches. Grow continuously with access to training budgets, industry conferences, and networking opportunities. Be part of a strong engineering culture, with regular knowledge-sharing sessions, technical deep dives, and innovation sprints. Great team spirit , with company-wide events such as social activities like laser tag, dinners, and team-building outings. 30 days of Vacation and Workation Bahncard (25 if you live in Brunswick, 50 if you live outside of the city) Subsidized Hansefit / Wellpass Membership Free Drinks & Snacks in the office (the good ones) Bikeleasing Company Pension Scheme Coporate Benifits (Discount on Brands, Concerts, Holidays ) About us OKAPI:Orbits is at the forefront of space sustainability, addressing some of the most pressing challenges of the space industry: the growing problem of crowded orbital regimes, and the need for more efficient satellite operations. We are committed to safeguarding space missions and access to space for all humanity. Join us on our mission. items.desc: Location Munich, Germany Job type Full-Time Work mode Hybrid Job level Professional Job ID 12575 Company Munich Re Employment type Regular Area of expertise Information Technology Munich Re is a global market leader in re-insurance, global specialty insurance and digital solutions. New technologies are disrupting the insurance value chain. Our innovative minds in IT spearhead the transformation and make change happen. We support clients with a comprehensive range of insurance and risk management products. Our goal is to become even more digital through the expertise of our IT & Tech specialists, and by leveraging data and insights to support innovation and client service. We are therefore making targeted IT investments and helping our insurance clients and partners to tackle problems in the modern digital world with innovative and forward-looking solutions. This role will be part of the Investment & Asset Management Tower for Group Technology (IT1.19), responsible for ensuring the availability, reliability, and maintenance of all investment and asset management systems, applications, and platforms. The Tower manages the seamless transition of new systems or projects to steady-state operations and takes ownership of key business relationships, providing accurate metrics on uptime, issues, and resolutions. As an IT Solution Architect within our Big Data, Analytics, and AI unit, you will play a key role in shaping the architecture of advanced data-driven solutions. You will translate business requirements into robust system and technology architectures that align with our enterprise standards, support scalable data ecosystems, and enable innovation in analytics and artificial intelligence. Your Job Map business and functional requirements to detailed system and technical specifications, ensuring alignment with Munich Re enterprise architectural plans. Design and implement technology solutions with a strong emphasis on big data platforms, data analytics architectures, and AI/ML ecosystems. Create detailed component-level specifications and translate them into implementation-ready designs. Maximize the return on technology investments by evaluating emerging technologies (e.g. realtime data ingestion, data lakehouses, MLOps, real-time analytics, generative AI) and advising on adoption strategies. Balance functional requirements with service quality, data integrity, operational resilience, and systems management needs. Achieve the balance between functional, service quality and systems management requirements. Collaborate closely with data engineers, data scientists, and analysts to ensure solution designs support advanced analytics and AI-driven business use cases. Act as a trusted technology advisor for both business and IT counterparts. Your Profile Education & Background University degree in Computer Engineering, IT, or a comparable field (preferred). 4+ years of experience delivering IT solutions in the financial services industry. Hands-on experience as an application developer is an advantage. Core Technical Skills (Mandatory) Big Data & Analytics Stack: Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake Programming & Scripting: Python, Bash Cloud & Data Integration: Azure, Azure Data Factory DevOps & CI/CD, Git, Docker Databases: Oracle / SQL Architectural & Domain Knowledge Strong experience designing solutions in big data ecosystems (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, Snowflake) and building complex data pipelines. Deep understanding of analytics architectures, including BI platforms, data modeling, integration frameworks, and streaming architectures. Solid knowledge of AI and MLOps platforms (model deployment, training pipelines, feature stores, monitoring). Proven understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, cloud architecture standards). Soft Skills Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-oriented language. Application Instructions Please apply through our online portal and upload your CV, as well as your academic reference letters, including school certificates, graduation certificates and transcripts of record for any degrees. If applicable, please also submit reference letters from any previous employers or certificates from any other qualifications you may have. We recommend writing a cover letter to tell us more about why the position and Munich Re is of interest to you. About us As the world's leading reinsurance company with more than 16,000 employees at over 50 locations, Munich Re introduces a paradigm shift in the way you think about insurance. By turning uncertainty into a manageable risk we enable fundamental change. Join us working on topics today that will concern society tomorrow, whether that be climate change, major construction projects, medical risk assessment or even space travel. Together we embrace a culture where multiskilled teams dare to think big. We create the new and the different for our clients …

We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future. Location/Division Specific Information Our PPD® Laboratory Services team has a direct impact on improving patient health through the expertise of scientists, industry thought-leaders and therapeutic guides. As the world leader in serving science, our laboratory professionals bring their commitment to accuracy and quality to deliver groundbreaking innovations. Discover Impactful Work: The role of Data Reviewer is to support our Cell Laboratory teams in ensuring the integrity and quality of laboratory and chromatographic data and reports. Ensures analyses are following validated or experimental analytical procedures, and compare results to methodology, protocol and product specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) acceptance criteria, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Reviews data entered into databases and reports and monitors the quality of the laboratory data. This is the perfect job for someone who has strong review experience and is looking to move away from hands on lab duties. A day in the Life Ensures the quality of laboratory data and reports. Reviews chromatographic data, related notebooks and sample results for scientific soundness, completeness, accurate representation of the data, and final reported results. Evaluates data to ensure compliance with analytical methods, client criteria, Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Delivers review findings noting deficiencies within the analytical data or reports in a clear and concise manner Communicates with laboratory staff to proactively address the quality of laboratory documentation. Prepares QC statements noting deficiencies with the analytical data set or notebooks. Reports deficiencies to the project leader for correction. items.desc: We Make Life More Rewarding and Dignified Location : Ballina Department : Summary The Quality Assurance (QA) Technician performs laboratory testing and quality control activities to support protocols, process qualification/certification, supplier approval, and new product introduction. The role executes validated/approved test methods, ensures data integrity and traceability in line with Good Documentation Practices (GDP), and partners with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and R&D to enable timely, compliant product release and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Plan and perform laboratory testing of materials and products per approved methods to support protocols, process control/qualification studies, and new product approval. Record, analyze, and report results with accuracy and completeness; escalate nonconformances and support investigations as required. Support validation/qualification activities for new or modified equipment and processes in accordance with procedures. Conduct audits/inspections of products from external suppliers and compile clear, actionable reports. Calibrate or coordinate calibration of laboratory equipment; maintain calibration and maintenance records. Perform machine waste/defect analysis; collaborate with cross‑functional teams to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions to reduce scrap and rework. Compile release documentation for finished products and support product disposition activities in line with procedures. Apply Good Documentation Practices (GDP) in reviewing production and test records for accuracy and completeness. Contribute to standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and training materials; share knowledge with peers. Maintain a safe and compliant laboratory environment; follow EHS and quality system requirements. Other duties as assigned. Perform visual and dimensional inspections and laboratory tests using computerized test equipment and standard tools. Read and interpret procedures, specifications, and test methods; communicate clearly in writing and verbally. Operate office and laboratory equipment; perform keyboard‑intensive work; maintain accuracy and focus during repetitive tasks. Work independently and collaboratively to meet priorities and timelines; typical travel requirement: none. Essential Functions of the Role Inspect goods for damage or discrepancies and report issues promptly. Conduct audits and inspections (internal and supplier). Maintain scientific and regulatory compliance in all clinical communications. Education & Work Requirements Relevant Degree with 2-4 years of related experience Education & Work Preferences Post‑secondary qualification (certificate, diploma, or degree) in a scientific or engineering discipline. Typically 2-3 years of relevant experience in quality, manufacturing, or laboratory environments, including at least 2 years of hands‑on laboratory testing experience. Proficiency using computerized laboratory test equipment and basic computer applications; ability to follow SOPs and apply GDP. Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem‑solving skills; ability to manage multiple tasks Experience in medical device or other regulated manufacturing environments and exposure to validation activities. Familiarity with quality systems and tools (e.g., ISO 13485, GMP, SPC, CAPA, Minitab/other statistical tools). Experience supporting supplier/product audits and continuous improvement (e.g., Lean/5S). Thermal Management Systems Engineer Position Summary Analog Devices is seeking a Thermal Management Systems Engineer to join the Datacenter Infrastructure team. Datacenter infrastructure encompasses the hardware and supporting systems required for data center operation, including servers, networking equipment, power delivery and energy storage systems, and air and liquid-cooling systems. The engineer will contribute to the design, analysis, prototyping, validation, and optimization of thermal management systems for small and large-scale data center infrastructure. The role will focus on sensing, monitoring, and control of temperature, pressure, flow rate, pumps, fans, and valves, using Analog Devices technologies where applicable. The successful candidate will work with mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, systems, applications, and marketing teams to translate system requirements into practical technical solutions. The position is intended for an engineer who can execute defined technical work independently, contribute to customer-facing demonstrations and proof-of-concept platforms, and grow toward ownership of subsystem-level activities under the guidance of senior technical staff. Job Scope Industry focus: Thermal management systems for data center infrastructure. Territory focus: Worldwide, with collaboration across global engineering, business, and customer teams. Function: Support system engineering activities in thermal sensing, monitoring, control, simulation, prototyping, and validation. Level: P2/P3 individual contributor role. Scope and independence will be aligned with the successful candidate’s experience. Principal Responsibilities Contribute to the development and evaluation of thermal management architectures for data center servers, power systems, energy storage systems, coolant distribution units, and associated infrastructure. Perform thermal, fluid-flow, and system-level analysis to assess performance, identify design limitations, and support design optimization. Develop and execute laboratory test plans for thermal and liquid-cooling systems, including instrumentation, data acquisition, data processing, and results interpretation. Support the design and integration of temperature, pressure, flow-rate, pump, fan, and valve monitoring and control functions. Develop proof-of-concept hardware, reference platforms, and demonstrations that show how Analog Devices technologies can address data center thermal-management challenges. Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, applications, and systems engineers to define requirements and integrate sensing and control functions at system level. Create simulation models, engineering calculations, test procedures, technical reports, presentations, and other design documentation. Support design reviews, failure investigations, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action activities related to thermal performance and system operation. Evaluate technical literature, standards, market information, and emerging cooling technologies relevant to data center infrastructure. Support customer engagements by preparing technical analyses, demonstrations, and application-level recommendations in collaboration with senior engineers and commercial teams. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Thermal Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline. Relevant experience in thermal engineering, electronics cooling, fluid systems, HVAC, power electronics, data center infrastructure, or a closely related field. For P2 consideration, typically 2 or more years of relevant industry experience; for P3 consideration, typically 4 or more years of relevant industry experience. Equivalent advanced education and applicable project experience may be considered. Working knowledge of heat transfer, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, and engineering measurement principles. Experience planning or executing engineering analysis, simulation, laboratory testing, or prototype validation. Ability to analyze technical data, document conclusions, and communicate recommendations clearly. Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. items.desc: Bozen/Bolzano full-time, fixed-term Research Support Office Short description of the position Eurac Research ( https://eurac.edu ) is a private research organization based in Bolzano/Bozen, Italy. Our research institutes and centers are seeking answers to global challenges through interaction between a variety of disciplines: keeping societies healthy, fostering intact environments, promoting sustainable energy and developing well-functioning political and social systems. We develop concrete solutions for regional problems which can then be applied globally. The KTO (Knowledge Transfer Office) : The newly established Knowledge Transfer Office is a central service department, responsible for the protection and valorisation of Eurac Research’s intellectual property (IP) and enhancing the value of research results by turning them into solutions useful to society, institutions, and the market — representing the central hub for knowledge transfer at Eurac Research. The KTO carries out the following main activities: Training and awareness – promotes an IP culture among researchers and staff, organizes courses, distributes confidentiality agreement templates, and helps researchers plan the protection of their results before disclosure. Disclosure assistance and protection – analyses inventions and registers all new IP. Evaluation and commercialization – supports the technical-commercial evaluation of research results. Patenting support – assists researchers throughout the patenting process, from evaluating the innovative potential of scientific results to filing and protecting the patent. Provides technical and administrative assitance, coordinating relationships with specialized consultants. We are looking for a new team member to provide support in the development of Eurac Research’s patent portfolio. Mission of the Role The Patent Engineer is the point of reference for patent matters for Eurac Research's scientists. The Patent Engineer supports the entire patenting process, from the identification of an invention and preventing its premature disclosure through to managing patent examination, with a focus on prior art searches, strategic analysis (commercial value, freedom-to-operate, geographic coverage), and drafting the patent application. Tasks: Invention scouting – identifying, in close cooperation with our research staff, the research innovative results and defining the appropriate protection measures and commercialisation routes. Prevention: manage the confidentiality of the results, invention traceability, ownership, and define correct inventorship. Prior art search: conduct systematic searches across patent databases and scientific literature, documenting distinctiveness relative to prior art. Strategic analysis: estimate commercial value, coordinate freedom-to-operate analysis, define geographic coverage. Application drafting: oversee the technical description, claims, drawings, and unity of invention together with the patent attorney. Filing: choose between the direct route and the PCT route, manage deadlines Examination: review search reports, coordinate responses to objections, monitor competing applications. Cross-cutting duties: manage the patent portfolio and act as the interface between researchers, patent attorneys, and patent offices Manage the IP protection, strategic analysis, cost benefit evaluation of IPR maintenance. Provide internal advice, awareness training activites to researchers and institutes on IP and IPR matters. Manage relations with patent attorneys and external consultants. Ensure alignment of IP practices with national and European regulations IP internal regulation. Requirements: Master's degree in engineering, or a related technical field; a PhD is a plus; qualification as a registered patent attorney is preferred but not required. 2-3 years of experience in patent-related work, with demonstrated ability in prior art searching and drafting/reviewing patent applications. Knowledge of patent law, filing procedures (national/EPO/PCT), and freedom-to-operate principles. Strong communication skills, ability to manage multiple cases in parallel, fluency in Italian and English, knowledge of German is considered a plus. Previous work experience in an academic or research institution, preferably in the field of technology transfer, is a plus.. Ability to liaise effectively with researchers, companies, law firms, and IP consultants. Knowledge of software tools for patentability analysis and patent management. Excellent organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills. Enjoy working in a team and delivering a service to colleagues. Friendly and self-confident. We offer: Full-time fixed-term contract / initially 1 year. Opportunity to contribute to the development of Eurac Research’s newly established Knowledge Transfer Office. An interdisciplinary and international research environment. Continuous training and networking opportunities with national and international networks …

Chi siamo Humanitas Research Hospital è un ospedale universitario e di ricerca altamente specializzato, il primo in Italia a essere certificato come Academic Hospital dalla Joint Commission International . La ricerca è portata avanti quotidianamente da oltre 500 medici, biologi, fisici, data scientist e tecnologi, che operano nei reparti ospedalieri e nei 10.000 m² di laboratori ad alta tecnologia. La nostra missione è trasformare le scoperte scientifiche in cure concrete, con un focus strategico su cinque aree chiave: oncologia, immunologia, neuroscienze, medicina gastrointestinale e cardiologia molecolare . Titolo e breve descrizione del progetto Il progetto sostiene le attività di ricerca clinica dell'Unità di Oncologia Mammaria di Humanitas nella gestione del carcinoma mammario in fase iniziale, metastatica ed eredo-familiare. Le attività comprendono la conduzione di studi clinici e osservazionali, la raccolta e la gestione dei dati, il coordinamento delle attività cliniche e regolatorie e il supporto alla produzione scientifica dell'Unità. Attività: Inserimento, gestione e verifica dei dati clinici negli EDC/CRF degli studi del progetto. Controllo di qualità e completezza dei dati e gestione delle query. Predisposizione, aggiornamento e archiviazione della documentazione di studio (TMF/ISF). Interfaccia con sponsor/CRO, monitor e team clinico; supporto alle attività regolatorie e di coordinamento. Requisiti e competenze tecniche: Laurea (triennale o magistrale) in discipline scientifiche (Biologia, Biotecnologie, CTF/Farmacia, Statistica, Professioni sanitarie o titoli equipollenti); Conoscenza delle GCP e della normativa in materia di data protection; Utilizzo di sistemi EDC e di data management; Ottima padronanza di Excel e degli strumenti di gestione dati; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Pregressa esperienza di data management in ambito oncologico e/o in sperimentazioni cliniche; certificazione GCP; conoscenza della lingua inglese (B2); master o corsi in clinical data management Cosa offriamo Per questa posizione è prevista una retribuzione fissa compresa in un range tra €24.000 - €27.000 lordi annui. Lavorare in Humanitas significa contribuire a un futuro in cui cura, benessere e professionalità crescono insieme. Per questo motivo offriamo: un programma di wellbeing che include anche iniziative dedicate alla salute fisica e psicologica; strumenti concreti per la conciliazione vita-lavoro, tra cui misure a sostegno della genitorialità e sostenibilità finanziaria; percorsi di formazione per valorizzare talenti e competenze in un contesto dinamico e innovativo. L'offerta è rivolta a candidati nel rispetto del Dlgs 198/2006 e dei Dlgs 215/2003 e 216/2003.

items.desc: A Flash é um ecossistema inteligente de soluções para RH e financeiro que simplifica toda a gestão do dia a dia de trabalho em uma única plataforma, desde a admissão e o controle de ponto aos benefícios e despesas corporativas. Transformamos processos complexos em uma jornada encantadora, criando uma experiência de trabalho mais leve, humana e eficiente para todos. Aqui dentro, chamamos isso de Efeito Flamingo : cada ideia, cada linha de código, cada atendimento reverbera muito além da Flash, impactando a rotina de empresas e milhões de pessoas. Trabalhar aqui é viver o poder de fazer voar com criatividade, propósito e impacto real. Vem ser Flamingo! ✨ Por que trabalhar com a gente? Na Flash, acreditamos que grandes transformações nascem de voos individuais, ganham força no coletivo e encontram direção nos valores que nos guiam como bando: ✨Criamos valor com o Cliente ✨Resolvemos problemas com Pragmatismo ✨Jogamos Juntos ✨Entregamos Resultados Consistentes ✨Aprendemos e Transformamos Nosso jeitinho de trabalhar: Ser Flamingo na Flash é viver um ambiente de criatividade e tecnologia, com autonomia para criar, testar e transformar ideias em soluções reais que ajudam empresas e pessoas a voarem mais alto. Aprendizado acelerado: cada desafio é uma chance de crescer e inovar. Pertencimento de verdade: ninguém voa sozinho, sempre em formação. Sentido de propósito: o que começa na Flash transforma o jeito que o mundo trabalha. Deixe sua marca no mundo do trabalho e viva com a gente o poder de fazer voar. ✨ Nossos benefícios: Cartão Flash (o tão amado rosinha! ) com benefício flexível para alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, saúde, educação, cultura e bem-estar Assistência médica Assistência odontológica Seguro de vida Vale-transporte Auxílio home office Auxílio-creche Licenças-maternidade e paternidade estendidas TotalPass para cuidar do corpo e da mente OnHappy para deixar as viagens ainda mais especiais Convênio Pet com a Guapeco C4life, com assistência jurídica, emocional, social e financeira, além de apoio para pets +Família by Avus, com suporte e benefícios para diferentes momentos da vida Convênio com o SESC Participação nos Lucros e Resultados Day off no seu aniversário Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e acreditamos que times plurais constroem soluções mais fortes, humanas e inovadoras para Flash. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de qualquer gênero, raça, etnia, idade, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, religião e pessoa com deficiência (PCD). O que Buscamos: Procuramos uma Pessoa Engenheira de Software Sênior com forte mentalidade de produto. Na Flash, a pessoa engenheira vai além de apenas escrever código: ela entende as dores do negócio, colabora na concepção das soluções, pensa na experiência final do usuário e assume a responsabilidade de ponta a ponta pelo impacto do que constrói. Valorizamos fundamentos sólidos de engenharia de software acima de qualquer linguagem ou framework específico. Em um cenário em que a inteligência artificial transforma a forma como desenvolvemos software, domínio das ferramentas e foco no valor gerado ao cliente são os nossos grandes diferenciais. Suas responsabilidades e desafios: Atuação com Atitude de Produto: Participar ativamente das discussões de negócio e de produto, colaborando para transformar desafios do RH e do Financeiro em soluções técnicas elegantes e eficientes. Excelência e Fundamentos Técnicos: Projetar e evoluir sistemas escaláveis, performáticos e resilientes, aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura de software (como Clean Architecture , Event-Driven Architecture e DDD ). Uso Intensivo de IA no Ciclo de Desenvolvimento: Utilizar proficientemente AI coding agents (como Codex , Claude Code, entre outros) para prototipar, codificar, refatorar e acelerar entregas com alto padrão de qualidade. Cultura "You Build, You Run It": Ter responsabilidade pelo ciclo de vida completo do software — da concepção ao deploy, até o monitoramento e observabilidade em produção (com o suporte do time de SRE). Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Orientar pessoas desenvolvedoras de níveis plenos e juniores através de revisões de código, pair programming , feedbacks construtivos e disseminação de boas práticas. Inovação e Experimentação: Propor e testar novas abordagens, tecnologias e padrões para manter a engenharia da Flash na vanguarda tecnológica. Colaboração e Rituais: Trabalhar de forma altamente integrativa com peers de engenharia, produto e design , promovendo a cultura de aprendizagem contínua e celebração de conquistas. O que é fundamental você ter: Fundamentos Sólidos de Engenharia de Software: Domínio profundo de estruturas de dados, algoritmos, orientação a objetos/funcional, padrões de projeto, arquitetura de microsserviços e decisões de trade-offs técnicos. Proficiência com AI Coding Agents: Experiência prática e fluidez no uso diário de agentes de código com IA (como Codex e similares) para …

What's next? If you are passionate about offensive security, please get in touch! One piece of advice: Please don't send us the typical - boring - cover letter. We are not that kind of company. We are dynamic and fun. Send us just a paragraph describing why you are passionate and motivated about security testing, what type of projects you have been involved in, what excites you and what your aspirations are..

items.desc: Job Description: Closer to Space, closer to the Future: join Telespazio – Leonardo Space Division! Leonardo is a leading global industrial group in Aerospace, Defence and Security, delivering advance multi-domain technologies across Helicopters, Aircraft, Aerostructures, Electronics, Cybersecurity, and Space. As part of the Leonardo Space Division, Telespazio a joint venture between Leonardo (67%) and Thales (33%) , is a global reference in the field of satellite solutions and services. With a workforce of over 3.500 professionals across its offices in Europe and around the world, Telespazio operates an international network of Space Centres and Teleports, offering cutting-edge solutions in Geoinformation Services, Satellite Systems and Operations, and Satellite Communications. Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible in Space. We are looking for an Operations Engineer to join the Earth Observation unit within the Operations & Logistics Engineering department. The department is responsible for the study, development, and validation of operational and maintenance processes and procedures for complex satellites ground segment systems. Activities include the definition of possible tool supporting the operations execution and are carried out following the standards applied to the space programs (mainly ECSS) and, where necessary, of architectural frameworks (e.g. DoDAF, MoDAF, ...) and international best practices (e.g. ASD, S1000D, S3000L ...) You will apply systems engineering to the operational domain of space mission systems, focusing in particular on: Definition of the System/Mission Operations Concept (ConOps) and of nominal and contingency operational scenarios Derivation and definition of operational and operability requirements, to be applied to the system design Contribution to the definition of ground segment requirements from an operational perspective Analysis, characterization and modelling of operational processes and mission timelines Definition of the operations organization: roles, responsibilities and operational interfaces Development of operational products: plans (e.g. Mission/Flight Operations Plan), manuals and operational procedures (nominal, special, contingency) Definition and setup of operational tools Validation of operational products and verification of their end-to-end consistency Planning and support to operational validation campaigns: execution of scenarios, system validation tests Support to system operations development throughout the mission phases, supporting Operations Readiness Reviews and Operational Handover Requirements: Master's Degree in Aerospace Engineering / Electronic Engineering / Telecommunications Engineering / Management Engineering with a strong technical orientation to systems Junior profile or recent graduate Knowledge of the aerospace domain (preferred) Previous experience, even at an introductory level, in operational concept definition, operational analysis and operational validation of space systems is considered a plus Ability to work autonomously and take initiative, combined with intellectual curiosity and a constant drive to question the status quo and bring innovative solutions Good command of English (B2) Proficiency with MS Office Availability to travel abroad for limited periods Comfortable with software tools and a hands-on attitude in getting the most out of them What We Offer: Our applicable items.desc: Bozen/Bolzano full-time, part-time, internship Institute for Regional Development Short description of the position/project: We are seeking a trainee researcher (i.e. master’s degree either under development or achieved by less than 1 year) to join the Institute for Regional Development, with a working focus on transport planning and mobility research. The position aims to support our research on the analysis of (rural) transport accessibility and the understanding of rural mobility patterns. The successful candidate will support the Regional Development team in the implementation of one local project. The duration of the internship is at least 6 months and up to 10 months (to be agreed upon with the candidate). Tasks: Project “Passing-through traffic in Passeiertal”: Implement this consultation project with the institute team. The aim of the project is to estimate how much of the motorised traffic affecting the South Tyrolean valley of Passeiertal is generated by passing-through traffic flows (of locals and visitors). To this end, the project will analyse available secondary data, will collect additional primary data, and will derive estimates. Other projects: Support the institute's team in the implementation of other ongoing projects (if and when needed). Such projects typically regard (rural) passenger mobility and local or EU level. Relevant ongoing projects include RECCAM, CLOSING THE GAP, YOUTH4MOBILIT, iMONITRAF!. Requirements: Bachelor/master’s degree in transport-relevant disciplines (such as engineering or spatial planning), ideally with a focus on travel demand analysis, monitoring and estimation (relevant for the Passeiertal project). Hard skills: Good command of transport demand models, survey/statistical tools, and techniques to set up travel demand surveys and primary data collection campaigns (relevant for the Passeiertal project). Soft skills: Strong communication skills and ability to work in international, multidisciplinary teams with a positive and curious mindset. Interest in rural mobility challenges. Language (DE or IT): Professional knowledge of German or Italian for writing, speaking and listening. The Passeiertal project has a local scale, requiring the knowledge of at least one of the local languages. Language (EN): Professional knowledge of English (preferably C1, possibly B2 level) for writing, speaking and listening, to allow a smooth production of project-related scientific outputs. We offer: A full-time job position (40h/week), or 32h/week arrangement if preferred by the candidate. A supportive, international, and interdisciplinary research environment. Access to professional development and training opportunities. An attractive workplace in a highly cyclable city offering excellent access to outdoor and mountain activities. Workplace location: Viale Druso, 1 - 39100 Bolzano. How to apply: Interested candidates should submit their application (CV, cover letter, and any other relevant documents) exclusively through this website by 02.11.2026. Company : Eurac Research Location : Bozen/Bolzano Contact person : Nadja Colafati Phone number : +39 0471 055 682 E-mail address : nadja.colafati@eurac.edu

items.desc: Beschrijving van de vacature Soort vacature: Ondersteunend Wetenschappelijk Personeel (OWP) Instituut: DANS Locatie: Den Haag Sluitingsdatum: 09-11-2026 Minimaal aantal uur per week: 30,4 Salaris Max (€): 5.264 Duur overeenkomst: 1 jaar Quality Assurance Engineer (NL) Vacature: Quality Assurance Engineer Vind jij het belangrijk dat wetenschap transparant en toegankelijk is en dat onderzoeksdata beschikbaar zijn voor hergebruik? En wil je bijdragen aan open science op nationaal en Europees niveau? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Voor onze sectie Technologie zoeken wij een Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer 30,4 - 38 uur per week (0,8 – 1 fte) Wat ga je doen? Als QA Engineer speel je een belangrijke rol in het waarborgen van de kwaliteit van onze software. Je zorgt ervoor dat onze softwaresystemen voldoen aan functionele en technische standaarden voordat deze beschikbaar worden gesteld aan gebruikers binnen de wetenschappelijke gemeenschap. Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden: Schrijven, uitvoeren en onderhouden van testplannen voor onze op Dataverse gebaseerde systemen, waaronder de Data Stations, DataverseNL en het ODISSEI Portal. Vroegtijdig signaleren van fouten en in duidelijke, beknopte stappen beschrijven waarmee deze kunnen worden gereproduceerd, zodat ontwikkelaars problemen efficiënt kunnen oplossen. Testen van nieuwe en bestaande functionaliteiten in zowel de gebruikersinterface (UI) als API's, met passende testmethoden zoals functioneel testen, regressietesten en exploratory testing. Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van geautomatiseerde tests om het testproces efficiënter en betrouwbaarder te maken. Nauw samenwerken met developers, product owners en operations om de kwaliteit van het softwareontwikkelings- en opleverproces te verbeteren. Wat breng je mee? Je hebt een technische opleiding (informatica, software engineering of een vergelijkbare richting) of gelijkwaardige professionele ervaring. Je hebt ervaring en veel affiniteit met softwaretesten en bent bekend met gangbare testmethoden en -technieken. Je werkt georganiseerd en kunt zelfstandig je werkzaamheden plannen en uitvoeren. Tegelijkertijd communiceer je proactief met collega's en andere betrokkenen. Je bent nieuwsgierig en wilt je kennis en vaardigheden verder ontwikkelen. Je zoekt graag naar manieren om het testen slimmer en efficiënter te maken en bent gemotiveerd om bij te dragen aan de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van de dienstverlening van DANS. Daarnaast breng je de volgende kennis en vaardigheden mee: Je bent in staat om edge cases te identificeren en problemen te signaleren die anderen mogelijk over het hoofd zien. Je bent bereid scriptingvaardigheden te gebruiken en verder te ontwikkelen om taken te automatiseren. Ervaring met API-testing en/of geautomatiseerd testen is een pluspunt. Een certificering zoals ISTQB of TMap is een pluspunt. Ervaring met Dataverse of vergelijkbare repositorysoftware is een pluspunt. Je beheerst het Engels vloeiend; kennis van het Nederlands is wenselijk. Wat bieden wij? DANS biedt een plezierige werkomgeving, waar een gemotiveerde en goed samenwerkende club van research data experts en engineers zich inzet voor Open Science en FAIR data. Bij DANS vinden we initiatief nemen, deskundigheid, resultaatgerichtheid, betrouwbaarheid en samenwerken belangrijk. We stellen prijs op een levendige sfeer onder collega’s en hechten veel belang aan onderlinge kennisuitwisseling. Persoonlijke ontwikkeling wordt niet vergeten en de medewerkerstevredenheid is hoog. Het salaris bedraagt afhankelijk van leeftijd en ervaring minimaal € 3.873,- en maximaal € 5.264,- bruto per maand op fulltime basis (=38 uur, schaal 9 CAO-NU). Het betreft in eerste instantie een dienstverband voor bepaalde tijd van 1 jaar met uitzicht op een vast contract bij goed functioneren. Een volledig overzicht van de arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je op https://www.knaw.nl/werken-bij-de-knaw. Waar is je werkplek? DANS is gevestigd aan de Anna van Saksenlaan in Den Haag, op loopafstand van het station Laan van NOI. Het is mogelijk om gedeeltelijk (max. 50%) vanuit huis te werken. Bij wie kun je terecht voor meer informatie? Voor nadere inlichtingen over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Jan van Mansum (jan.van.mansum@dans.knaw.nl).Informatie over DANS staat op dans.knaw.nl. Hoe kun je solliciteren? Je motivatiebrief met cv stuur je t.a.v. Patris van Boxel, Head of Technology bij DANS, via het ATS-systeem. Diversiteit & Inclusie De KNAW acht een werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich welkom en gewaardeerd voelt van groot belang. Een werkomgeving waarin aandacht is voor individuele kwaliteit en waar ontwikkelmogelijkheden voorop staan. Samen streven we naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin we verschillen omarmen. We nodigen dan ook graag kandidaten uit die door hun achtergrond en ervaring hieraan een bijdrage willen leveren. Bij gelijke geschiktheid gaat de voorkeur uit naar de kandidaat die de diversiteit binnen de KNAW op deze wijze versterkt. Acquisitie naar …
