items.desc: Over Partnify Goed samenwerken vereist informatie: genoeg en vooral de juiste. Juist op dat moment gaat er in de praktijk veel verloren. Er wordt niet genoeg genoteerd, er wordt niet genoeg onthouden en niet genoeg vastgelegd. Werk je in elkaars systemen, dan is het de vraag of je überhaupt bij de informatie kunt. Partnify bouwt het B2B-platform waarmee organisaties van elke omvang, van zzp'er tot multinational, over organisatiegrenzen heen samenwerken: collabs, communicatie, documenten en afspraken op één plek. Het platform vangt zowel de bits, alles wat digitaal wordt gedeeld, als de atoms, alles wat buiten de systemen gebeurt: gesprekken, meetings, afspraken aan tafel. Onze AI-agent PAI zorgt ervoor dat de juiste informatie op het juiste moment bij de juiste mensen ligt. Hoe meer je samenwerkt, hoe meer waarde het platform levert. Onze engineering-afdeling groeide dit jaar van 5 naar 16 collega's, verdeeld over de teams: Core, Integrations, AI en FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering). We zijn een jong en snel groeiend productbedrijf met een enthousiast team in Zwolle. Dat betekent korte lijnen, veel eigenaarschap en direct zichtbare impact van wat je bouwt. Wat ga je doen? Als Software Engineer in het AI-team werk je mee aan PAI, onze AI-agent die gebruikers binnen Partnify helpt bij samenwerken, communiceren en het beheren van documenten en afspraken. Je pakt problemen en kansen zelfstandig op van ontwerp tot productie, en denkt mee over de technische richting van het team. Je werkt vooral aan: Harnessing van PAI. Je onderzoekt en verbetert hoe we de mogelijkheden van taalmodellen benutten binnen PAI, zodat die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt voor gebruikers. Research. Je volgt nieuwe ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI en taalmodellen, en vertaalt die naar bruikbare toepassingen binnen ons platform. Agents bouwen. Je ontwikkelt agents die het werk rondom B2B-samenwerkingen op ons platform bevorderen, van eerste opzet tot productie. Webapplicatie. Je bouwt aan de plekken in onze React-webapplicatie waar gebruikers met PAI in aanraking komen, van chat interface tot suggesties die meelopen in de workflow. Cloudinfrastructuur. Je werkt met Google Cloud Platform, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL en volledige CI/CD om AI-functionaliteit schaalbaar en betrouwbaar te laten draaien. Wie zoeken we? Opleiding en ervaring. Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in software engineering of een vergelijkbare richting, en minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring als software engineer. Technische basis. Je hebt stevige ervaring met minimaal één moderne programmeertaal, bij voorkeur Python, TypeScript of JavaScript, en pakt nieuwe systemen en technologieën snel op. Communicatie. Je communiceert makkelijk in het Nederlands en kunt technische documentatie in het Engels lezen en schrijven. Van businessprobleem naar oplossing. Je vertaalt een vraag van een gebruiker of collega naar een passende technische oplossing, en legt je keuzes begrijpelijk uit aan mensen zonder technische achtergrond. Teamspeler. Je werkt graag samen, vraagt en geeft feedback, en durft de lat hoger te leggen als je vindt dat het beter kan. Eigenaarschap. Je voelt je verantwoordelijk voor wat je oplevert, denkt mee over het waarom achter een AI-functie en trekt aan de bel als iets niet klopt. Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste: affiniteit met taalmodellen en ervaring met Django, React of AI/LLM-API's zoals die van OpenAI of Anthropic (Claude). Wat bieden we? Fulltime met passend salaris. Een baan van 40 uur per week met een salaris van € 4.250 tot € 7.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Kwaliteit als standaard. Een moderne stack en een team dat kwaliteit belangrijk vindt: code reviews, CI/CD en geautomatiseerde tests zijn bij ons vanzelfsprekend. AI-ondersteund ontwikkelen. Je werkt dagelijks met Claude als programmeerhulp, en bouwt daarnaast mee aan AI-functionaliteit voor onze eigen gebruikers. Hybride werken. Een goed bereikbaar kantoor aan de Dokter Spanjaardweg 19A in Zwolle, met ruimte om deels thuis te werken. Doorgroeimogelijkheden. Je groeipad ligt bij ons niet vast. Je kunt doorgroeien naar tech lead, of naar Forward Deployed Engineer, waar je samen met klanten oplossingen bouwt. Omdat we groeien, ontstaan er steeds nieuwe rollen. Wie initiatief toont, krijgt de ruimte om die mee vorm te geven. Solliciteren Stuur je cv met een korte motivatie, of een link naar je GitHub of portfolio (dat zegt ons vaak meer), naar thomasvermeulen@partnify.com. Vragen over de vacature? Bel of mail gerust. Salaris: €4.250,00 - €7.000,00 per maand Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Flexibele werkuren Pensioen Reiskostenvergoeding Werklocatie: Hybride werken in 8025 Zwolle

items.desc: Your job Are you looking for a challenging position where you can grow? Would you like to develop your expertise in grant schemes and everything that comes with them? Wageningen University & Research (WUR) is looking for a Project Controller for 36 hours per week. Will you become our new colleague? What are you going to do? As a Project Controller, you are responsible for the administration and financial management of research projects, including grant-funded projects. From budgeting through to final settlement, you translate between finance and research. Together with the Business Controller and project leaders, you ensure effective financial control and risk management of projects within several departments of the Agrotechnology & Food Sciences Group (AFSG). You have a comprehensive overview of the financial aspects of these projects. You identify potential risks at an early stage and take action where necessary. You also contribute to the implementation of internal control measures and provide critical input when assessing procedures. You coordinate and support (grant-funded) projects and manage their financial administration; you are the point of contact for the Business Controller and project leaders and maintain good relationships with external project partners and other stakeholders; you work closely with your colleagues in the back office and financial administration; you identify potential financial risks in a timely manner and take action where necessary; you close each financial period with a complete and reliable determination of the financial results and make an important contribution to the balance sheet file and annual accounts; you ensure the reliability of financial information and compliance with relevant legislation and regulations, internal policies and procedures. Some of our research projects are funded through grants. As the requirements of funders and grant providers are constantly changing and becoming more stringent, it is important that you keep your knowledge up to date and assess the project portfolio accordingly. Your team You will become part of a team of 15 enthusiastic and knowledgeable Project Controllers who are jointly responsible for a diverse portfolio of research projects. Where you will work How can we make our food healthier, safer and more sustainable? And how can we ensure that we can continue to produce enough food in the future? At the Agrotechnology & Food Sciences Group (AFSG) of Wageningen University & Research, scientists work every day on these major societal challenges. Our research ranges from food technology and biotechnology to food safety and sustainable production chains. Through innovative research, we translate scientific knowledge into practice and work on solutions for a future-proof food system . Here, your work contributes to impact that reaches far beyond our campus. Your qualities You have a completed bachelor's degree (HBO) in Business Economics, Accountancy or a comparable financial discipline; you are proficient in both Dutch and English; you are customer- and service-oriented; you work accurately and precisely and provide timely updates on the progress of your work; you enjoy working collaboratively with others; you are eager to learn and have strong analytical skills; Speaking and writing in Dutch is needed, a level of B2; A challenging and rewarding position within a great team! In our international working environment there is an increasing amount of communication in English. For this position it is about language level B2. Don’t have direct work experience but identify with these qualities? We still warmly encourage you to apply. WUR offers onboarding support for starters and career switchers. More finance vacancies can be found on our Finance at WUR job page. We offer Wageningen University & Research offers excellent terms of employment. A few highlights from our Collective Labour Agreement include: working hours that can be discussed and arranged so that they allow for the best possible work-life balance; sabbatical leave, study leave, and partially paid parental leave; there is a strong focus on vitality and you can make use of the sports facilities available on campus for a small fee; a fixed year-end bonus of 8,3%; excellent pension scheme. In addition to these first-rate employee benefits, you will of course receive a good salary. We offer, depending on your experience, a competitive gross salary of between €3.640,- and €5.132,- for a full-time working week of 36 hours, in accordance with the CLA Wageningen Research (scale 9). As for your contract, we initially offer a one-year contract that can be extended - if possible within (company) organizational circumstances - on good performance. Wageningen University & Research offers plenty of opportunities for growth and development, with a strong internal recruitment policy and excellent training programmes. items.desc: Tiny Telescope is looking for an ambitious Earth Observation Specialist to help shape the future of space-based Earth observation. Our payloads, mounted on satellites deliver high-resolution Earth observation data (~5 meters) with daily revisit capabilities. A key challenge is transforming raw sensor data into valuable information products while operating within the strict power, computing, and communication constraints of space systems. AI-driven processing will help identify valuable observations and reject unusable data, such as cloud-covered imagery, minimizing the amount of data that needs to be transmitted to Earth. You understand the complete Earth observation value chain: from satellite hardware and sensors to image processing, AI algorithms, and the applications that depend on the resulting data products. You enjoy working across disciplines and translating mission goals into practical technical solutions. Your Responsibilities : Develop Earth observation processing chains from Level 0 to Level 1 and Level 2 products. Design and implement image processing, AI, and machine learning algorithms for onboard and ground-based systems. Develop methods to identify and filter unwanted imagery, such as clouds and Optimize processing performance within the limited power and computing resources available on satellites. Work closely with hardware, software, and systems engineers to develop next-generation Earth observation capabilities. Support the development of innovative applications and products based on Earth observation data. Your Profile : Background in Earth observation, remote sensing, aerospace engineering, computer science, or a related field. Understanding of satellite imaging systems and remote sensing workflows. Experience with image processing, geospatial data analysis, and algorithm development. Familiarity with AI and machine learning techniques. Ability to bridge hardware, software, and application domains. Innovative, analytical, and comfortable working in a startup/scaleup environment. What We Offer : A unique opportunity to develop cutting-edge Earth observation technology. A multidisciplinary role involving space systems, AI, and remote sensing. Significant responsibility and impact within a fast-growing aerospace company. An enthusiastic startup/scaleup culture with motivated colleagues. Flexible employment from part-time to full-time . Location: The Netherlands . Interested? If you are passionate about Earth observation and space technology, we would love to hear from you. Contact Tiny Telescope to learn more about this opportunity.

items.desc: Over de functie Als Data Engineer word je onderdeel van een klein, hecht datateam met een architect, een Product Owner en een externe beheerpartij. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen ruwe data en bruikbare inzichten voor uiteenlopende domeinen, zoals HR, subsidies, inkoop en financiën. Je werkt nauw samen met directies, data scientists en het externe ontwikkelteam, en speelt een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van de dataomgeving. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn: Bouwen en onderhouden van datapijplijnen in Databricks met Python en SQL; Migreren van bestaande dataoplossingen uit ADF, SQL en een oudere Databricks-omgeving naar een nieuwe hub-spoke Databricks-omgeving; Ontwikkelen van generieke pijplijnen, API’s en een datacatalogus; Adviseren over en bouwen aan een incrementele aanpak in plaats van full-load batchprocessen; Reviewen en verbeteren van code van anderen om de kwaliteit te waarborgen; Zorgen dat data betrouwbaar, AVG-proof en conform overheidsstandaarden zoals NORA, DGB en BIO beschikbaar komt; Meedenken over de overgang naar een data mesh en nieuwe AI-toepassingen. Jouw kwaliteiten Voor deze rol van Data Engineer zoeken we voor dit ministerie iemand met het volgende profiel: Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau; Ruime ervaring met data engineering, Azure en Databricks; Ervaring met Python en SQL; Kennis van datapijplijnen en het werken met datasets; Ervaring met code reviews en het waarborgen van codekwaliteit; Een sociale, praktische instelling: je bouwt pijplijnen, maar helpt ook een collega of bouwt een rapport als dat nodig is; Bij voorkeur kennis van PySpark; Pré: ervaring binnen een overheidscontext en met de bijbehorende kaders. Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen, maar denk je wel een waardevolle bijdrage te kunnen leveren? Reageer dan gerust. Voor deze functie is een VOG vereist. De voordelen Dit bedrijf biedt betekenisvol werk met maatschappelijke impact en ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden, zowel binnen je functie als persoonlijk. Je krijgt de tijd om de specifieke dataomgeving goed te leren kennen. Als Data Engineer kun je rekenen op: Een salaris tussen €4.818 en €7.094 bruto per maand (op basis van 36 uur); Een contract voor twaalf maanden met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband; Een individueel keuzebudget om je arbeidsvoorwaarden deels zelf samen te stellen; Hybride werken, deels vanuit huis; Een OV-kaart voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen door heel Nederland; Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Leer de organisatie kennen Werken aan een gezonder Nederland, met data als stevig fundament: dat kan bij onze opdrachtgever. Dit is een ministerie in Den Haag dat zich inzet voor goede en betaalbare zorg, gezondheid en welzijn. Het werk is maatschappelijk betekenisvol, wat zorgt voor een prettige sfeer en veel vrijheid in je werk. De organisatie vindt het belangrijk dat iedereen gezien, gehoord en gewaardeerd wordt, en dat je jezelf kunt zijn en je mening durft te geven. Binnen de afdeling Informatievoorziening is een centrale, veilige en kostenefficiënte dataomgeving opgezet waar data-initiatieven uit het hele departement samenkomen. items.desc: Tiny Telescope is looking for an ambitious Star Tracker Specialist to help develop the next generation of high-accuracy attitude determination systems for space missions. Despite their compact size, Tiny Telescopes deliver exceptional optical performance and magnification, enabling highly accurate star trackers for spacecraft positioning and attitude control. In this role, you will work at the intersection of optics, electronics, software, and spacecraft systems to develop star trackers that meet the demanding requirements of modern Attitude Determination and Control Systems (ADCS). You understand the architecture and protocols of ADCS systems and can translate system-level requirements into reliable star tracker solutions. From optical design and sensor integration to star pattern recognition algorithms and system qualification, you will play a key role in delivering flight-ready products for space applications. Your Responsibilities : Develop high-accuracy star trackers for spacecraft attitude determination. Design and implement star pattern recognition and attitude estimation algorithms that generate precise quaternions. Define interfaces and protocols. Optimize reliability and processing performance within the limited power and computing resources available on satellites. Contribute to the development of next-generation ADCS technologies. Work across optical, electrical, software, and systems engineering disciplines. Develop and execute test, verification, and qualification programs. Your Profile : Background in aerospace engineering, physics, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field. Understanding of ADCS architectures, and spacecraft pointing requirements. Experience with performance optimization of star trackers, gyroscopes, optical sensors, computer vision, or image processing systems. Familiarity with attitude determination algorithms, star catalog matching, and quaternion-based representations. Knowledge of optical, electrical, and software aspects of embedded space systems. Hands-on, analytical, and comfortable working in a multidisciplinary team. Excited by the challenges of developing hardware and software for space missions. What We Offer : A unique opportunity to develop cutting-edge star tracker technology for space applications. A multidisciplinary role combining optics, electronics, software, and spacecraft systems engineering. Significant responsibility and technical ownership within a fast-growing company. An enthusiastic startup/scaleup culture with motivated colleagues. Flexible employment from part-time to full-time . Location: The Netherlands . Interested? If you are passionate about spacecraft navigation, attitude control, and high-performance space systems, we would love to hear from you. Contact Tiny Telescope to learn more about this opportunity.

items.desc: Position:Supervisory Board Member Location:The Netherlands (or someone who can travel to the Netherlands) Application Deadline:1st November 2026 Duration:4 years,4-8h per month About SPARK SPARK is an international NGO that creates high-impact jobs for young people, including women and refugees, in regions affected by fragility and conflict. We work with local and international partners to strengthen entrepreneurial ecosystems and education, ensuring our support is market-driven and contributes to post-conflict economic recovery and stability. Our growing team of 40 employees operates from offices in Amsterdam, Palestine, Iraq, Morocco, Tunisia, and other locations, mainly in the Middle East and Africa. SPARK Strategy SPARK’s journey ahead rests on three pillars: innovation, resilience, and localization. With a digitized organizational backbone, strengthened local governance, and a global marketplace for jobs and business linkages, SPARK is positioned to lead in fragile contexts. Our focus remains on creating dignified jobs, nurturing entrepreneurship, and bridging humanitarian and development divides. With donor and government partners, SPARK will scale its proven models to ensure that young people—especially women and refugees—have the opportunities and support they need to build stable, prosperous futures. The Role Supervisory Board is recruiting one new member with extensive financial experience, particularly in grants management from an operational leadership role. This includes experience in foundation or donor relations (EU, MENA, Africa, Netherlands) and an understanding of P&L responsibilities to support the Finance and Audit Committee. As a board member, you will monitor the Board of Directors performance, advise on and approve overall policy and strategy, and review annual plans, budgets, accounts, and reports. You will join the Finance and Audit Committee alongside existing board members and serve as a sparring partner to the Head of Finance and the Director. What We Seek We are looking for someone with a global perspective and cultural awareness who resides in the Netherlands or can travel to the Netherlands at their own expense at least four times per year. Experience working in or for SPARK operating regions (MENA and Africa) is highly valued. The commitment averages 4-8 hours per month plus occasional engagement with leadership and the committee. Board meetings occur four to six times annually, typically in Amsterdam or other office locations. The position is unremunerated but includes a limited volunteer allowance of €1,500 per year. Ideal Background The ideal candidate has experience in NGO grants, financial-operational leadership, or operational experience with foundation or donor relations. Strong links to SPARK operating regions are preferred. While conflict resolution, fundraising, advocacy, or tech/digital literacy are advantageous, the primary focus remains on financial governance and grant oversight. We encourage diverse backgrounds and individuals from underrepresented groups to apply. Application Process If you are enthusiastic about this opportunity, please submit your expression of interest explaining your alignment with the outlined requirements in a Cover letter, along with your CV finding this specificvacancy and using the ‘apply’ button on https://vacancy.spark-online.org/Tab1/LoadProfileFromVacancy/727 If you have any questions, please reach out to the current SB members Lizette van der Kamp, Fawad Shah, Nic van der Jagt and Fred de Vries through sb@spark-online.org Practical questions can be answered by the senior secretary Liesbeth Molenaar, through the general spark email address spark@spark-online.org Deadline of application: 1 November 2026. If we see a fit, we will get back to you within 2.5 weeks. Due to the high volume of applicants, we cannot provide feedback in all individual cases. We hope you understand. All communications will be treated confidentially. Apply Apply

For å skape verdi av disse dataene trenger vi mer enn bare en sterk dataplattform. Vi trenger gode datamodeller og datasett som gjør data tilgjengelige, konsistente og gjenbrukbare på tvers av organisasjonen. Nå ser vi etter en Analytics Engineer som vil være med på å videreutvikle dette grunnlaget i tett samarbeid med dataingeniører, dataanalytikere og andre fagmiljøer i Stingray. Arbeidsoppgaver – hva skal du gjøre? Som Analytics Engineer blir du en del av Data Platform-teamet og får en sentral rolle i arbeidet med å gjøre data tilgjengelige, konsistente og enkle å bruke på tvers av Stingray. Du vil jobbe tett med dataingeniører, dataanalytikere og fagspesialister for å forstå ulike behov og videreutvikle datagrunnlaget som brukes i analysearbeid på tvers av selskapet. Rollen kombinerer datamodellering, analyse og visualisering, og gir deg muligheten til å påvirke hvordan data struktureres, kvalitetssikres og gjøres tilgjengelige for våre ulike fagmiljøer. Du vil blant annet: Utvikle og vedlikeholde datamodeller, datasett og semantiske modeller i dbt og Power BI Utvikle og videreutvikle dashboards og analysegrunnlag tilpasset ulike fagområders behov Sikre høy datakvalitet gjennom testing, dokumentasjon og kontinuerlig forbedring Samarbeide med dataanalytikere og fagmiljøer for å forstå og konkretisere behov for data og analyse Bidra til standardisering, gjenbruk og videreutvikling av beste praksis for Power BI-løsninger Hvem ser vi etter? Vi ser etter deg som har bachelor- eller mastergrad innen et kvantitativt fagområde, som informatikk, matematikk, statistikk eller tilsvarende, og som har noen års erfaring med datamodellering, analyse eller dataplattformer. Kanskje jobber du i dag som Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, BI Developer eller Data Engineer, eller i en lignende rolle med fokus på analyse og datamodellering. Du liker å skape struktur i komplekse datasett og motiveres av å utvikle løsninger som gjør data enklere å bruke for ulike fagmiljøer i selskapet. Samtidig trives du med å samarbeide med ulike fagmiljøer for å forstå behov og omsette dem til gode dataløsninger. For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du har: Minimum 3 års erfaring med analyse, datamodellering eller dataplattformer Erfaring med SQL, Power BI, og gjerne dbt og Git Erfaring med å utvikle og vedlikeholde dataløsninger i produksjon God forståelse for datakvalitet, testing og versjonskontroll Evne til å omsette behov og problemstillinger til robuste og gjenbrukbare datasett Vi tror også at du er analytisk, nysgjerrig og opptatt av kvalitet. Du liker å lære nye ting, deler kunnskap med andre og trives med å jobbe på tvers av ulike fagområder. Har du erfaring med Snowflake, Python, GitLab eller CI/CD-pipelines er det en fordel, men det viktigste er at du er nysgjerrig, lærevillig og motivert for å utvikle deg sammen med teamet. Hva tilbyr vi? Hos Stingray får du muligheten til å jobbe med store datamengder og problemstillinger som har direkte betydning for utviklingen av en mer bærekraftig havbruksnæring. Du blir en del av et kompetent og tverrfaglig miljø der data, teknologi og biologisk innsikt møtes for å skape verdi både internt og for kundene våre. Rollen gir stor påvirkningskraft på hvordan data modelleres, tilgjengeliggjøres og brukes på tvers av organisasjonen, Arbeidsmiljøet preges av samarbeid, høy faglig kompetanse og korte beslutningsveier. Vi gir våre ansatte tillit, ansvar og mulighet til å påvirke både teknologi og arbeidsmetoder. Vi legger også stor vekt på det sosiale, med samlinger, arrangementer, turer, kantineordning og treningsmuligheter, inkludert eget treningsrom. Team Stingray har sitt utspring under overflaten, der menneskene, lidenskapen og ulikhetene knytter oss sammen. StingrayPodden er et resultat av de mange historiene som fortjener en arena hvor humor, energi og engasjement kommer opp fra dypet. Følg podkasten vår på Spotify! Er du vår nye Analytics Engineer? Da oppfordrer vi deg til å søke. Kom som du er til Team Stingray - vi ser frem til å høre fra deg! For spørsmål om stillingen kan du kontakte Mads Rismoen (Recruiter) på tlf. +47 902 33 917. Det er kort avstand til både buss, t-bane og tog. Stingray Avd. Nord-Norge ligger på Fauske, hvor vi i et moderne bygg har ressurser innen service og fiskebiologi. items.card: Responsibilities Plan, schedule and prioritize manufacturing engineering projects according to program and customer timing. Define manufacturing process and equipment concepts to meet quality, safety, capacity and cost requirements. Lead equipment specification, sourcing, purchase, installation and commissioning. Develop and implement new manufacturing technologies, automation and process improvements. Apply Lean
items.desc: Miejsce pracy: Balice, małopolskie (ref. ME 2) Responsibilities Plan, schedule and prioritize manufacturing engineering projects according to program and customer timing. Define manufacturing process and equipment concepts to meet quality, safety, capacity and cost requirements. Lead equipment specification, sourcing, purchase, installation and commissioning. Develop and implement new manufacturing technologies, automation and process improvements. Apply Lean Manufacturing principles to optimize process flow, cycle time, capacity and waste. Develop and maintain manufacturing documentation, including Process Flow, PFMEA, Control Plan and Standard Work. Create and maintain the Bill of Process (BOP) and manufacturing process standards. Support production ramp-up and ensure required quality, capacity and process performance. Analyze manufacturing data to identify losses, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities. Cooperate with cross-functional and global teams, equipment suppliers and plant Manufacturing Engineering. Qualifications: Required (R) Engineering Degree, preferably in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset. Experience with high-volume manual and automated assembly processes, preferably in automotive manufacturing. Understanding of manufacturing processes, machine design and industrial automation. Experience with equipment implementation, commissioning and production ramp-up. Knowledge of PFMEA, SPC, MSA, Control Plan and process capability. Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills. Good knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles. Strong analytical skills and ability to work with manufacturing data. Good MS Office skills, especially Excel and PowerPoint. Willingness and availability to travel internationally, including Mexico (up to 30%). Preferred (P) PLC programming and industrial automation experience. Robot programming or robotic systems integration. Experience using AI-based tools to support engineering analysis, problem solving and process improvement.

items.title: Assignment in Poznań Project Team
items.card: In this role, you will work closely with the Project Director and the entire Project Team to turn ambitious plans into reality and help deliver a building that will remain part of Poznań’s landscape for years to come. Working with us, you will have a chance to: support the delivery of Nowy Rynek C through its remaining development stages, working closely with the Project Director to help deliver the project on time
items.desc: Short description (Role) Join our Poznań team and help deliver the final building in the city's most recognized and highly successful office campuses. Nowy Rynek C is one of three active development projects currently underway within Skanska Commercial Development Europe and continues to attract strong interest from tenants. With construction now underway, it offers an excellent opportunity to become part of a project that is already shaping the local office market . In this role, you will work closely with the Project Director and the entire Project Team to turn ambitious plans into reality and help deliver a building that will remain part of Poznań’s landscape for years to come. Working with us, you will have a chance to: support the delivery of Nowy Rynek C through its remaining development stages, working closely with the Project Director to help deliver the project on time and within budget; contribute to project planning, cost control, schedule coordination and stakeholder relationship management; oversee construction works and help ensure compliance with quality, safety and environmental standards; coordinate tenant fit-out activities in close cooperation with the Leasing Team; collaborate with municipal authorities, subcontractors, consultants and inspection teams; maintain and manage project documentation, ensuring its accuracy, completeness and quality; participate in negotiations and the selection of key subcontractors together with Skanska SA; cooperate with our Environmental, Digitalization and Innovation teams to support certification processes and implement innovative solutions, including AI tools, BIM 360 and smart-building What We Expect from You and What We Offer You: What you'll bring: Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or a related field; At least 3 years of experience in construction or real estate development, including residential, office or retail projects; a good understanding of construction and investment processes, budgeting and relevant regulations; Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients and contractors; Strong communication, analytical and organizational skills; native-level proficiency in both spoken and written Polish; English proficiency at B2 level or higher. What you'll find with us: The opportunity to work on project which is part of Poznań’s landmark office investment – Nowy Rynek; the chance to join a project gaining strong momentum and gain experience across different stages of delivery, from core and shell works to preparing spaces for future tenants; exposure to modern building technologies and innovative solutions within one of our most sustainable current projects, including geothermal boreholes, ground-source heat pumps and a fossil-free heating and cooling system designed to enable the building to operate independently of the district heating network; close cooperation with experienced professionals across different disciplines; a collaborative culture where people share knowledge, support one another’s development and work together toward common goals; the opportunity to make a visible and lasting contribution to Poznań’s urban landscape. About this opportunity Starting in January 2027 (or earlier, depending on availability), this full-time opportunity is expected to last at least nine months. You'll join our Poznań team at an exciting stage of the project, with the chance to make a meaningful contribution and further develop your expertise. While the role is primarily connected to our Poznań location, we're open to discussing flexible working arrangements based on project needs and individual circumstances. We know that talented people bring different experiences, strengths and career aspirations, which is why we're open to shaping the final scope, title and ways of working around the right person. Informacje dodatkowe: Aleksandra Markiewicz, HR Manager/BP GDPR information clause Kandydacie, Twoje dane osobowe będą przetwarzane przez Skanska Property Poland Sp. z o.o. w Warszawie, z która możesz kontaktować się pod adresem do korespondencji: Al. „Solidarności” 173, 00-877 Warszawa lub bezpośrednio z Inspektorem Ochrony Danych pod adresem mailowym: odo_spp@skanska.pl Twoje dane osobowe, o których podanie prosimy Cię w treści ogłoszenia, będą przetwarzane na podstawie przepisów prawa pracy. Jeżeli zdecydujesz się przekazać nam dodatkowe informacje o sobie, dane te będą przetwarzane na podstawie odrębnej, wyrażonej przez Ciebie zgody, która powinna brzmieć następująco: "Wyrażam zgodę na przetwarzanie moich danych osobowych zawartych w niniejszym zgłoszeniu rekrutacyjnym w celach rekrutacyjnych Skanska Property Poland Sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie." Jeżeli zapomnisz jej wyrazić w swoim CV lub liście motywacyjnym, poprosimy Cię o jej uzupełnienie na rozmowie kwalifikacyjnej lub o dostarczenie nowych dokumentów aplikacyjnych niezawierających dodatkowych informacji. items.title: Solution Architect
items.card: Job Description We are looking for a Solution Architect to join Sopra Steria Apps Services team on an international Program for a leader in the aerospace sector. You will support the implementation of a new approach for Safety Assessment within the new program and focus on defining and governing the architecture of the selected engineering solutions, supporting tool evaluations, and preparing High-Level Design
items.desc: Company Description Sopra Steria is one of the largest players in the tech industry in Europe, known for its consulting, digital services and software development. We operate in nearly 30 countries in the world, hiring more than 55,000 employees. The Polish branch, as the Global Delivery Center, operates in Katowice since 2007 and has been growing ever since. Currently, our team consists of around 1,000 specialists. Within the Digital Platform Services department, our teams specialize in areas such as cloud, operating systems, virtualization, databases, backup or storage, as well as networking and security. We also have 1st line support consultants who speak French and English, but also Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and German. The Application Services department is responsible for areas such as software development, data engineering, testing services, CRM, ITSM and ERP platform integrations, as well as application management for customers in Scandinavia, Benelux, France, Germany, Switzerland and the UK. Job Description We are looking for a Solution Architect to join Sopra Steria Apps Services team on an international Program for a leader in the aerospace sector. You will support the implementation of a new approach for Safety Assessment within the new program and focus on defining and governing the architecture of the selected engineering solutions, supporting tool evaluations, and preparing High-Level Design Documentation. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and solution providers to establish architecture principles, constraints, and standards that ensure a robust, scalable, maintainable, and compliant solution. Note that we can only offer cooperation to people who are located in Poland and have EU citizenship. Responsibilities: Develop, maintain, and govern High-Level Design Documents (HLDD). Define and validate the end-to-end technical and solution architecture for engineering and safety assessment platforms. Define and document architectural constraints, design principles, standards, and governance applicable to the selected toolchain. Establish architecture guidelines and best practices to ensure consistency, scalability, interoperability, maintainability, and long-term sustainability. Perform architecture modelling and maintain relevant views using Enterprise Architect (Sparx EA). Evaluate candidate tools from architecture, integration, compliance, and operability perspectives. Facilitate architecture reviews and support evidence-based technical decision-making. Collaborate with business, engineering, IT, and solution-provider stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions. Identify technical risks, dependencies, constraints, and mitigation actions. Support the architecture roadmap and the controlled evolution of the selected digital engineering solution. Qualifications Must have requirements: Solution and technical architecture design High-Level Design Documentation (HLDD) Architecture governance, reviews, standards, and design principles Enterprise Architect (Sparx EA) Requirements engineering, interface definition, and data-flow modelling Scalability, maintainability, interoperability, security, and compliance-by-design Technical risk and dependency assessment Business and technical requirement analysis Tool evaluation and solution selection Stakeholder management and workshop facilitation Architecture roadmap development Technical decision support and documentation Experience working in complex or regulated engineering environments Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills Clear written, verbal, and presentation skills Ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders Collaborative, pragmatic, and outcome-oriented working style Attention to detail and commitment to documentation quality Fluent English B2/C1. Being open to occasional business trips abroad and visits in our office in Katowice or Gdańsk. Nice to have requirements: Safety engineering and safety assessment processes Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and digital engineering ecosystems Model-based engineering concepts Additional Information What we offer: BENEFITS (UoP): Luxmed, Medicover Sport, Worksmile, educational platforms, languages learning platform, referral bonus, life insurance, certifications (paid by the company), conferences, Tech Lunches, possibility to join our Communities (Project Management, Architecture, Security, Process Management, Leadership, AI and Cloud), local kindergarten. DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES (B2B): Tech Lunches, Worksmile, possibility to join our Communities (Project Management, Architecture, Security, Process Management, Leadership, AI and Cloud). ADDITION: free parking, fresh fruits, workation. In case of questions, please contact the HR team. The recruitment process for this position consists of two stages: a short phone call with a recruiter (30 min max) one-hour long interview on Teams (with both general and technical questions) …

items.desc: Jesteśmy liderem w zakresie generalnego wykonawstwa obiektów logistycznych, przemysłowych i technologicznych w Polsce. Oferujemy kompleksowe rozwiązania w zakresie doradztwa, projektowania, produkcji i realizacji. Działamy od ponad 26 lat i w tym czasie zrealizowaliśmy ponad 850 inwestycji o łącznej powierzchni ok. 6 mln m². Realizujemy projekty na rynku polskim i europejskim. Stawiamy na nowoczesne i zrównoważone budownictwo – jesteśmy jednostką certyfikującą BREEAM, działamy zgodnie z metodyką BIM, posiadamy certyfikaty ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001. Zatrudniamy najwyższej klasy kadrę inżynierską z ekspertyzą w zakresie nowoczesnego budownictwa. Nasza siedziba główna znajduje się we Wrocławiu. Posiadamy oddziały w Warszawie, Krakowie, Poznaniu, Szczecinie i Gdyni. Miejsce pracy: Szczecin Region: zachodniopomorskie Numer referencyjny: 10.2026|Łódź, Kraków, Poznań, Szczecin Opis stanowiska Wdrażanie i prowadzenie BIM na przypisanych kontraktach zgodnie z wymaganiami Inwestora (EIR/AIR) i Planem Realizacji BIM (BEP), w tym udział w przygotowaniu i aktualizacji BEP wykonawczego. Bieżące wsparcie kierownictwa budowy i inżynierów w pracy z modelami: wyciąganie informacji, przekroje, zestawienia ilościowe, weryfikacja rozwiązań przed realizacją robót. Weryfikacja modeli i dokumentacji wykonawczej (jakość, zgodność z BEP, wykrywanie kolizji) oraz obieg uwag z projektantami i podwykonawcami w formacie BCF. Administrowanie środowiskiem CDE na kontrakcie: struktura, uprawnienia, obieg dokumentów, statusy, wdrażanie nowych użytkowników. Prowadzenie zastosowań BIM w realizacji: 4D (powiązanie z harmonogramem), wsparcie przedmiarów i rozliczeń (5D), monitorowanie postępu robót, zarządzanie usterkami i odbiorami w narzędziach mobilnych. Koordynacja dostaw modeli od podwykonawców. Przygotowanie i weryfikacja modeli powykonawczych (As-Built) oraz danych do przekazania Inwestorowi i obszarowi Gwarancji i FM. Szkolenia personelu budowy i podwykonawców z narzędzi BIM/CDE. Udział w spotkaniach koordynacyjnych z Inwestorem w zakresie BIM i raportowanie postępu realizacji wymagań BIM. Przekazywanie doświadczeń z kontraktów do Centrum Kompetencji AECO (lessons learned, propozycje usprawnień standardów). Wymagania Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne: budownictwo, architektura, inżynieria środowiska lub pokrewne. Min. 3 lata doświadczenia w budownictwie, w tym min. 1–2 lata pracy z BIM na etapie realizacji (budowa lub biuro). Doświadczenie na budowie na stanowisku inżynierskim (inżynier budowy, kierownik robót, koordynator) - mocno preferowane. Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi do przeglądu i koordynacji modeli (np. Navisworks, Solibri, BIMcollab) oraz podstaw modelowania (Revit lub analogiczne). Doświadczenie z platformą CDE (np. Autodesk Construction Cloud, Dalux, Trimble Connect). Znajomość otwartych standardów (IFC, BCF) oraz ISO 19650. Umiejętność czytania dokumentacji wielobranżowej i rozumienie procesu budowlanego. Gotowość do pracy głównie na budowach. Prawo jazdy kat. B. Język angielski na poziomie umożliwiającym pracę z dokumentacją. Umiejętność „tłumaczenia” BIM na język budowy, z praktycznymi korzyściami zamiast teorii. Asertywność wobec podwykonawców i projektantów przy egzekwowaniu wymagań Mile widziane Doświadczenie z 4D (Synchro, Navisworks) i przedmiarami z modelu. Praca z chmurami punktów, skanowaniem laserowym lub dronami przy kontroli postępu. Doświadczenie w tworzeniu modeli powykonawczych. Studia podyplomowe lub certyfikaty BIM. Podstawy automatyzacji (Dynamo, Power BI, skrypty). Udział w realizacji dużych i prestiżowych projektów – zrealizowaliśmy ponad 850 inwestycji o łącznej powierzchni ponad 6 mln m². items.desc: Would you like to join a global, growing company that innovates for a more sustainable tomorrow? UPM could be the team for you. We are frontrunners in developing renewable alternatives to fossil-based materials. Besides enabling both businesses and consumers make more sustainable choices, we strive to create a positive UPM experience for all our employees around the world. We live by our values – trust and be trusted, achieve together, renew with courage. Together we can renew the everyday, for a future beyond fossils! Learn more about us as a workplace upm.com/careers We are looking for a Junior Supply Planner to join our team in UPM Nowa Wieś Wrocławska or Biskupice Podgórne , near Wrocław, Poland. Greetings from your future manager “Hi! I’m looking for someone curious and open-minded to join our Supply Planning team. You’ll work with me and colleagues across the business to help keep our plans on track and respond when things change. You don’t need to know everything on day one. We’ll help you build your planning skills, and you’ll have room to ask questions, share ideas and grow into the role. What matters most to me is the energy you bring, your willingness to learn and how well we work together. If that sounds like you, let’s meet!” – Andrzej Gałka, Supply Planning Manager, EMEIA. What you will do Plan production runs and schedule orders based on customer demand, stock levels, available materials and machine capacity Manage laminate stock levels, balancing reliable delivery with the need to avoid excess stock and waste Work with Operations, Procurement and other teams to make sure information flows clearly and production runs smoothly Spot supply risks early, help find solutions and keep the right people informed when plans change Keep planning data and production capacity information up to date in our systems Track delivery and inventory performance and take action when results are off target Plan trials and samples and support the introduction or phase-out of products Look for practical ways to use digital tools and AI to improve planning, decision-making and data quality Share your knowledge and support other Supply Planners, including providing cover when needed Who you are You have a bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Logistics, Data Analytics, Engineering, Economics or a related field, or equivalent experience You communicate clearly in Polish and English, both spoken and written You enjoy working with people and building good working relationships You can adapt when plans change and keep track of your priorities You stay organized when priorities change You are comfortable working with numbers and checking your work for accuracy You are curious, look for practical solutions and take the initiative when something needs attention You are willing to make decisions, ask questions when needed and take responsibility for your work You are confident using Excel, especially formulas and pivot tables Experience with an ERP system is a plus, but not required This is what we offer to you A meaningful job : We have an inspiring purpose “We renew the everyday for a future beyond fossils”. Our work is impactful and transformative. A caring community : Our community is built on great team spirit and shared commitment. We care about each other and the well-being of our colleagues. We support the work-life balance of all our employees. Development opportunities : We offer you great opportunities to learn and grow throughout your career. We are committed to ambitious, science-based sustainability targets in all areas, from climate change mitigation to enhancing biodiversity. We foster diversity and inclusivity, offering a work environment in which everyone can be themselves. items.desc: Fancy helping to shape the future of FinTech? We have always been innovators. In 1996 we were the first company to share exchange rate information, free of charge on the internet. Today, we are a world leading online trading group. Join us to: Help build the future of online trading Be part of a culture driven by integrity and global impact Become part of an award-winning company - check out our full list of awards here We are only as good as our people. Luckily, our people are the best. Join us! So if you like Sherlock Holmes, you enjoy reading criminal books or watching criminal movies: and you pay attention to the details - you should join our Account Onboarding Team! like Sherlock Holmes, like reading crime books or watching crime movies... solve the mysteries together with Sherlock Holmes... and you have to pay attention to details... You should join our Account Onboarding Team! How do we work? Our Account Onboarding Analysts play a crucial role in onboarding and managing all new Client applications and ensuring all required documentation is properly submitted and compliance with regulatory requirements. This includes being the owner of the end-to-end Client application process from the moment a new request is received till Client is fully onboarded and ready to trade. We work in a hybrid model - we'd love to meet you in the office 2 times a week. In this role, you will: Maintain an appropriate audit trail and documentation in all instances, to evidence/support the review and assessment of each reviewed application. Review and investigate suspicious alerts, referring/escalating to the Team Lead for guidance when necessary. Correspond with Clients in a professional and courteous manner with regards to documents, status of accounts. Protect the confidentiality of client information in accordance with GDPR regulations. Maintain a well-developed knowledge of regulatory and legal requirements across all OANDA Divisions. Build and maintain a good working relationship with Sales, Funds, Compliance and Client Experience Teams and respond to requests and queries effectively and promptly. What skillset you need, to be successful in this role? University Degree, with a focus in Finance, Law or Economics preferred. Previous experience of KYC, AML, Compliance, Legal or Audit areas will be a plus. Fluency in English. Ability to work independently and as a part of a team as well. Excellent communication skills and attention to the details. ___ At OANDA, to help us efficiently process applications, we use AI-driven tools to help source and rank candidates based on professional experience and skills. While these tools provide recommendations, our recruitment process remains human-centric: all final shortlisting and hiring decisions are made by OANDA team. You have the right to request a human review of your application. OANDA Global Corporation is a diverse and global team with offices around the world. We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to OANDA. We are committed to creating and sustaining a collegial work environment in which all individuals are treated with dignity and respect and one which reflects the diversity of the community in which we operate. We provide an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Candidates selected for an interview will be contacted directly. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know. We will work with you to provide as seamless a recruitment experience as possible. Twoją rolą będzie bliska współpraca z biznesem – od identyfikacji codziennych wyzwań i edukacji, przez projektowanie i wycenę rozwiązań, aż po tworzenie zaawansowanych narzędzi opartych na generatywnej AI i automatyzacji. ZAKRES OBOWIĄZKÓW Bezpośrednia współpraca z obszarami biznesowymi, m.in. sprzedażą, operacjami, finansami, HR i administracją, w celu identyfikowania potrzeb oraz problemów, które można rozwiązać z wykorzystaniem AI. Analiza procesów biznesowych i wymagań oraz przekładanie oczekiwań na konkretne koncepcje rozwiązań technicznych. Samodzielne projektowanie, prototypowanie i tworzenie narzędzi AI dopasowanych do rzeczywistych potrzeb biznesowych, z wykorzystaniem Microsoft Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, Power Platform i generatywnej AI. Dobór technologii i podejścia do rozwiązania problemu, z uwzględnieniem możliwości integracji z istniejącymi systemami i narzędziami. Mentoring techniczny zespołów biznesowych uczestniczących w wewnętrznym programie rozwijania kompetencji AI. Około 20% czasu pracy będzie przeznaczone na wspieranie uczestników w samodzielnym projektowaniu i tworzeniu własnych rozwiązań AI oraz rozwiązywaniu problemów technicznych. Doświadczenie w bezpośredniej współpracy z biznesem, rozumienie jego potrzeb i procesów oraz umiejętność przekładania oczekiwań biznesowych na konkretne, wykonalne rozwiązania techniczne z wykorzystaniem AI. Praktyczne doświadczenie w budowaniu aplikacji, automatyzacji procesów lub integracji systemów. Praktyczna znajomość administracji Microsoft 365 i/lub Power Platform, np. Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint lub Dataverse, ewentualnie innych platform low-code. Praktyczne doświadczenie w wykorzystywaniu Microsoft Copilot i/lub GitHub Copilot w codziennej pracy. Znajomość generatywnej AI i umiejętność wykorzystania jej do rozwiązywania problemów biznesowych oraz usprawniania procesów. Umiejętność samodzielnego projektowania i prototypowania rozwiązań oraz oceny ich wykonalności. Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie B2. MILE WIDZIANE Znajomość Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Dataverse, Power BI lub Azure. Doświadczenie w budowaniu agentów AI i automatyzacji z wykorzystaniem dużych modeli językowych (LLM). Znajomość podstaw integracji REST API, pracy z danymi oraz łączenia różnych narzędzi i systemów. Doświadczenie w tworzeniu aplikacji, skryptów, prototypów lub narzędzi wewnętrznych. Znajomość Git i podstawowych praktyk związanych z wersjonowaniem kodu oraz cyklem życia aplikacji. Doświadczenie w pracy konsultingowej, transformacji cyfrowej, enablemencie technologicznym lub we współpracy z zespołami biznesowymi. Umiejętność projektowania praktycznych warsztatów i materiałów edukacyjnych dostosowanych do różnych poziomów zaawansowania. CO OFERUJEMY Pracę przy projektach klienckich i produktach własnych. Realny wpływ na rozwiązania biznesowe i technologiczne w ramach realizowanych projektów. Szkolenia oraz wsparcie w określeniu ścieżki rozwoju. Eventy firmowe, dostęp do usług medycznych oraz pakietów sportowych. Zatrudnienie na umowę B2B / UZ Student. Pracę w trybie hybrydowym (Trójmiasto). Krótki proces rekrutacji.

We are building a new team in Krakow. Our employees work fully from the office with the possibility to work remotely occasionally. Alarm.com is seeking a Junior Software Engineer (SRE) to join our Video team. Our platform powers live streaming, recorded video, and real-time object detection and identification notifications for millions of IoT cameras worldwide. In this role, you will help keep the platform reliable at scale, advance observability, reduce incident response time, and build for long-term growth. Long-term employment based on a permanent employment contract (CoE). Attractive benefits package: including medical care, life insurance, sports package, annual budget for professional development ($2,000). items.card: The Role We are looking for a skilled DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team in Warsaw (hybrid/remote) and help manage, design, and scale the AWS-based infrastructure supporting Batmaid and PFA. You will build automations and tooling that make our engineering teams more effective, drive improvements across our CI/CD pipelines, and ensure high availability, security, and performance across all environments.
items.desc: About Us We are on a mission to make looking after your home effortless, and to clean up an industry that has too often left its workforce in the shadows. Batgroup is the company behind Batmaid , our English-speaking brand, and PFA / Putzfrau.ch , our German-speaking brand: a portfolio spanning direct cleaning, recruitment, and fiduciary services that has made us Switzerland's number one home cleaning company, with more than 4,000 cleaning professionals and a growing footprint across Europe. Our purpose goes beyond business. It is about people. Every cleaner who works with us deserves declared, insured, and properly protected employment, on permanent contracts governed by the sector's Collective Bargaining Agreement, with real access to pensions, sickness cover, and paid leave. By taking on the multi-billion-franc cleaning black market, we level the playing field, bring fairness to a sector that badly needs it, and give customers professionals they can genuinely trust in their homes. That is our fight, and it is why we rally behind #fightblackmarket. Technology is how we win it. We build the platforms, apps, and services that let thousands of customers book a trusted cleaning in a few clicks, and that let thousands of cleaners work with dignity and security. That is where you come in. The Role We are looking for a skilled DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team in Warsaw (hybrid/remote) and help manage, design, and scale the AWS-based infrastructure supporting Batmaid and PFA. You will build automations and tooling that make our engineering teams more effective, drive improvements across our CI/CD pipelines, and ensure high availability, security, and performance across all environments. AI-assisted development is simply part of how we work. The team uses modern AI tooling, including a company-provided Claude Code subscription, to move faster through routine tasks, freeing up time and attention for what actually matters: solid architecture, sound problem-solving, and reliable infrastructure. We are pragmatic about it: we reach for these tools where they genuinely add value, and we keep human judgement firmly in charge. What you will do Maintain and manage our AWS-based infrastructure. Design, maintain, and extend robust CI/CD pipelines. Build automations and tooling that make engineering teams more productive. Monitor and optimize the performance, availability, and security of our environments. Drive continuous improvements across our cloud security posture, deployment processes, and system scalability. Requirements What we are looking for 4+ years of hands-on DevOps experience. Commercial experience with Kubernetes, ideally EKS. Solid experience with AWS (or another major cloud provider with a strong willingness to master AWS). Proven track record with CI/CD automation, specifically GitHub Actions or similar tools. Observability expertise, working with the ELK Stack or similar tracing and logging solutions. Cloud security and compliance mindset, with a strong focus on secure architecture. Code & script literacy: ability to read, understand, and debug existing application code and configurations. Problem-solving drive: ability to break down complex technical issues and deliver simple, clean, and maintainable solutions. Nice to have Previous commercial experience as a Software Developer. Familiarity with TeamCity, Helm, and/or Terragrunt. Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Grafana, or Prometheus. Experience with message queues (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS). Experience with Fastlane for mobile app (iOS/Android) automation. Basic working knowledge of PHP, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python. How you work You communicate clearly: able to advise both technical and non-technical team members with ease. You lead by influence and example, helping to level up the engineers around you. You are adaptable and curious: quick to pick up new tools, paradigms, and emerging technologies. You take ownership: dedicated to solving root causes and upholding high standards of quality and reliability. Fluent English (B2 or higher), as it is our primary working language. Benefits Room to grow, professionally and personally. Our platform is full of real engineering challenges, the company continues to grow, and there is space to grow with it. Remote-friendly working with flexible hours (core hours during the day, CET). Claude Code subscription and access to modern AI tooling. A mature SDLC working alongside an experienced team of developers and QA engineers (continuous integration, code/solution reviews, automated testing). A bright, modern office in the heart of Warsaw, a short walk from the metro (office access also available on request in Lisbon and Lausanne). A VIP private healthcare package. Multisport membership. Regular team events in Warsaw to enjoy your colleague community. The best tools for the job, including hardware and software setups tailored to your needs. Sounds like you? items.desc: TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions. We are looking for a Learning Experience Designer who will design and build skill-based learning programs from the ground up, translating complex subject matter expertise into clear, actionable, and engaging educational experiences. Requirements: What we’re looking for: Strong experience as a Learning Experience Designer (LXD) or Instructional Designer, with a proven track record of building complex, skill-based learning programs from scratch. Proficient level of English (from B2 level) with exceptional writing skills, capable of crafting clear, engaging, and pedagogically sound learning materials. Demonstrated mastery of curriculum mapping, competency-based education, instructional scaffolding, and assessment design. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills to effectively interview SMEs, extract implicit knowledge, and align with product and content teams. Data-informed approach to learning design, using qualitative feedback (CustDev) and quantitative performance data to iterate on educational content. Nice-to-have: Experience working in fast-paced EdTech or modern product environments. Hands-on experience with modern LXD tools, LMS platforms, and user research methodology. Background in developing technical or highly specialized curricula. Brand: TripleTen What you will do: Design and build skill-based learning programs from the ground up in close collaboration with subject matter experts (SMEs): turn their expertise into clear competencies, learning outcomes, and meaningful practice. Write learning content at every level of detail: program competencies, curriculum outlines, modules, lessons, and the lesson content itself (explanations, examples, practice tasks, projects, and assessments). Design learning experiences using scaffolding principles to gradually build learner independence. Take part in curriculum and product decisions based on customer development interviews, qualitative and quantitative learning data, and research. Form hypotheses, validate design decisions, and address learner pain points. Collaborate with Product Managers, SMEs, Curriculum Developers, Instructors, and Designers. Contribute to the evolution of learning design standards and best practices across curricula.

Experience with requirements management and ALM tools, preferably DOORS NextGen and EWM. Ability to understand system requirements and translate them into structured and traceable test cases. Experience working in Agile development environments. ISTQB certification is considered an advantage. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with a structured approach to identifying and investigating system-level issues. items.desc: Data Engineer We are looking for a talented Data Engineer to help shape the next generation of AI-driven financial crime detection solutions. If you have strong data engineering expertise, hands-on experience building and optimizing large-scale data pipelines, and a passion for solving complex real-world challenges, this could be the perfect opportunity for you. In this role, you will design and develop the data foundations that power advanced money laundering detection solutions for leading financial institutions worldwide. Responsibilities: Develop, implement, and maintain production-grade data pipelines based on data science requirements. Design and build scalable data flows for specific business use cases that can be integrated into the product. Build and maintain machine learning data pipelines. Create tools and frameworks that support data scientists and analytics teams in developing and optimizing innovative solutions. Collaborate closely with Product, R D, Data, and Analytics teams to enhance system functionality and performance. Train customer data scientists and engineers on maintaining and enhancing data pipelines within the platform. Travel domestically and internationally to support customers when required. Build and manage strong technical relationships with customers and partners. Requirements: 2+ years of hands-on experience with Apache Spark (required). Strong experience with SQL. Experience using version control systems, particularly Git. Hands-on experience with the Apache Hadoop ecosystem, including Hive, Impala, Hue, HDFS, and Sqoop. Experience with Python (Pandas). Experience with PySpark, Scala, Java, or R. Proven experience in data transformation, validation, cleansing, and machine learning feature engineering. Bachelor s degree or higher in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Information Systems, Engineering, or another quantitative field. Experience working with and optimizing large-scale data pipelines, architectures, and datasets. Strong analytical skills and experience working with structured and semi-structured data. Experience building processes that support data transformation, metadata management, dependency management, and workload optimization. Ability to perform root cause analysis on data and processes to answer business questions and identify improvement opportunities. Strong customer-facing and cross-functional collaboration skills. Fluent in English preferred but not mandatory Spanish Advantages: Experience working with Linux. Experience building machine learning pipelines. Knowledge of Elasticsearch. Experience with Zeppelin and/or Jupyter. Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Jenkins or Apache Airflow. Experience with microservices and containerization technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes. items.desc: Client Services Advisor Join Our Team as a Client Services Advisor at Carousel Logistics part of the DANX Carousel Group! The DANX Carousel Group, a leading pan-European provider of critical service logistics operating across 10 countries with revenues in excess of €250 million, is seeking a talented individual to fill the position of Client Services Advisor . Are you a dynamic professional with a strong background in Client Services or logistics? We are looking for a motivated, Client services Advisor to join our Client Services team based at home but with the option of working flexibly in our office in Barcelona with the possibility for remote working . Our Company Values: ✓ Ownership : Clear, measurable objectives empower employees to take ownership of results. ✓ Learning : We deliver personal and professional growth opportunities that are accessible and inclusive. ✓ Care: We show deep respect for our colleagues, families, subcontractors, and the wider community. Your Role in a Nutshell: The Client Services Advisor’s role is to provide an exceptional client experience via all communication channels as the first point of contact to our clients and suppliers where ‘going the extra mile’ is part of the daily activity. To take ownership of all client enquiries both new and follow up, with a focus on providing first contact resolution or help whilst positively managing expectations: Deliver Service Excellence to our clients; ensuring operational escalations are resolved quickly and effectively and communicated proactively to the client. Ensure that specific client SLA’s are consistently met and that any issues that prevent SLA achievement are addressed appropriately. Ownership of client query resolution; aiming for 1st time resolution and if escalated ensure that query is resolved, and client informed of outcome in a timely fashion. Investigation and resolution of internal invoice queries to ensure clients are billed correctly. Focus on continuous improvement by reviewing existing systems and processes, making recommendations for change to improve service, costs and efficiency. Candidate Profile: Plans, organises, schedules and delivers in an efficient, organised manner. Ability to focus on and execute key priorities. Prioritises the delivery of a high level of client satisfaction. Monitors client satisfaction (internal and external). Establishes partner relationship with clients. Visible and accessible to clients. Clear, concise, timely communication both verbal and written; keeps people informed proactively. Passionately finds ways over, around, or through barriers to success. Goes beyond the call of duty. Shows bias for action. A results-oriented “doer.” Exhibits dynamism, excitement, and a positive can- do attitude. Possesses a willingness to work hard to get the job done. Works efficiently and with tenacity. Essential Attributes: Customer service expertise gained in a fast-paced logistics environment. Demonstrable experience of proactive client relationship management. Highly developed organisational skills. Excellent communication skills both verbal and written Language skills: Spanish, English and German Why work for Carousel? Basic salary of 35.000 € per annum 40 hours per week 23 holidays plus Bank holidays The day off for your birthday Remote working Company discount portal Company events Development and training options In the DANX Carousel Group, we value expertise, innovation, and dedication. Apply now and be a key player in our success!

items.desc: Location: Madrid Other locations: Primary Location Only Salary: Competitive Date: Oct 14, 2026 Job description Requisition ID: 1752766 En EY, damos forma al futuro con confianza. En EY encontrarás mucho más que un empleo : una oportunidad real para crecer, aprender y dejar huella en una firma global líder. En España somos cerca de 7.000 profesionales , presentes en 15 oficinas , y formamos parte de una red global de más de 400.000 personas que trabajan cada día con un propósito común: Building a Better Working World . En EY impulsamos carreras con impacto, desarrollo estructurado y aprendizaje continuo. Damos forma al futuro con confianza, a través de las personas y la tecnología. #ShapeTheFutureWithConfidence #EYCareers #BuildingABetterWorkingWorld La oportunidad : En el departamento de FAIT (EY Financial Audit IT) podrás conocer, desde el primer momento, el entorno tecnológico de las principales empresas nacionales cuyos estados financieros son auditados por EY y evaluar los controles implementados para la gestión de sus diferentes riesgos tecnológicos, entrevistando para ello a los Directores de tecnología de estas compañías y a sus principales colaboradores. El principal objetivo del grupo de los más de 1.000 auditores de EY en España es el de aportar valor basándose en la visión de la auditoría como herramienta de gestión para la Dirección, identificando las necesidades y objetivos de los clientes, así como los consiguientes riesgos financieros, además de los factores críticos de éxito para la empresa. Como profesional de EY utilizarás la tecnología más avanzada para desarrollar un plan a medida para la empresa, centrándote en las áreas de negocio trascendentes para los estados financieros que son críticos a la hora de analizar los perfiles de riesgo para la organización. Realizarás, entre otras, las siguientes funciones : Entender el entorno de TI de las compañías que auditamos : Identificar la plataforma tecnológica (entornos, aplicaciones, bases de datos…) relacionada con los estados financieros de las empresas mediante entrevistas con los diferentes responsables del departamento de tecnología y análisis de la documentación proporcionada. Validar los controles existentes : Evaluar el diseño, implementación y efectividad de los controles establecidos para cubrir los riesgos existentes en el ámbito de la seguridad lógica, las comunicaciones, el desarrollo de aplicaciones, la explotación de los sistemas (ITGCs), los procesos de negocio y sus aplicaciones (ITACs), etc. Realizar pruebas automatizadas : Verificar el funcionamiento, cálculos, integridad y consistencia de un determinado proceso de negocio mediante su simulación utilizando para ello CAAT (Computer Assisted Auditing Techniques) y herramientas informáticas como ACL, IDEA, Alteryx, etc. Emitir recomendaciones de mejora : A partir de los resultados obtenidos, indicar a nuestros clientes como pueden subsanar sus debilidades y mejorar los controles de su plataforma tecnológica. ¿Qué perfil buscamos? Requisitos: Formación: Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería Telecomunicaciones, Ingeniería Industrial o MBA o formación financiera/administración de empresas con inquietud por la Tecnología. Contar con al menos 1-2 años de experiencia en auditoría IT / consultoría IT. Perfil competencial: Se precisa persona acostumbrada a trabajar en equipo, extrovertida, con capacidad de comunicación, análisis y organización. Con iniciativa, espíritu crítico y ganas de aprender. Con capacidad para gestionar equipos. Buscamos perfiles con una clara orientación al cliente, acostumbrado a la gestión de proyectos, con inquietudes tecnológicas y con ganas de aportar valor a nuestro equipo. Valorable: Idiomas: Nivel alto de inglés (mínimo B2). Buen manejo de herramientas informáticas. Conocimientos de ERPs como SAP Hana o Navision. Valorables certificaciones CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CISM (Certified Information Security Management) y otras certificaciones similares. Conocimientos de estándares y normas como COBIT, COSO, NIST, ISO 27001, ISO 22301 ¿Qué valor añadido te podemos aportar? Un gran ambiente de trabajo, tanto dentro como fuera de la oficina. Oportunidades internacionales y red de contactos global. Formación continua: acceso a trainings y certificaciones. Salario competitivo y plan de remuneración flexible. Posibilidad de teletrabajo, desde, dónde y cómo quieras. Posibilidad de implicarte en proyectos de voluntariado profesional. items.desc: ABOUT THE JOB The “Infrastructure” Domain is part of the Corporate & Institutional Banking Information Technology & Operations (CIB ITO) of BNP Paribas, it is in charge to manage a key part of the infrastructure such the core of the servers, databases, storage, backup, middleware, citrix farms, and hypervisor for virtual infrastructure. To work following ITIL methodology is part of the daily basis in this and the rest of IT areas. PROFILE & SKILLS Requirements: Hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (preferable). items.desc: Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition. Lund University welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard equality, equal opportunities and diversity as a strength and an asset. MAX IV is looking for a RF Technician to join the RF Group. Your team The RF Group at MAX IV is responsible for the operation, maintenance and development of several high-power radio-frequency systems that are essential for the MAX IV accelerators. The systems include pulsed S-band RF systems as well as continuous-wave VHF/UHF systems, together with associated high-voltage modulators, diagnostics, instrumentation and control systems. Would you like to work hands-on with advanced accelerator technology at one of the brightest light sources in the world? About the role You will work with the operation, maintenance, repair and installation of RF, electronic and high-voltage equipment used throughout the MAX IV accelerator facility. The position has a strong practical focus and involves troubleshooting, repairing, modifying and maintaining specialised technical equipment. The work includes electronics, electrical systems, cabling and, where needed, basic mechanical fabrication and modification of parts. You will work closely with RF engineers and other technical staff to ensure high reliability and availability of the accelerator RF systems. MAX IV is preparing for MAX 4U, a major upgrade of the 3 GeV storage ring. As part of the RF Group, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the technical work associated with this upgrade, including installation, modification and commissioning of RF-related equipment. Your main work tasks will be Maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of RF, electronic and high-voltage equipment. Maintenance and repair of high-voltage modulators. Electrical and electronic assembly work. Precision soldering and repair of electronic equipment and circuit boards. Manufacturing, installation and repair of cables and cable assemblies. Installation and modification of RF equipment, electronics and associated infrastructure. Preventive maintenance and inspection of technical systems. Documentation of maintenance, repairs and technical modifications. Participation in fault finding and corrective maintenance during accelerator operation. Collaboration with RF engineers in system upgrades, improvements and new installations. Participate in technical installations, modifications and commissioning activities related to future accelerator upgrades, including MAX 4U. To be successful in this role you need to have the following qualifications Relevant technical education in electronics, electrical engineering, RF technology or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. Good practical skills in electronics and electrical work. Experience with soldering and assembly of electronic equipment. Ability to read and understand electrical schematics and technical documentation. Experience in troubleshooting and repairing electrical or electronic equipment. A structured and safety-conscious way of working. Good command of spoken and written English. Good communication and teamwork skills. Experience with high-voltage equipment. Experience with high-power electronics. Experience with cable manufacturing, connectors and RF cabling. Experience in the fields below is considered a merit RF systems or RF equipment. Pulsed power systems or modulators. Industrial electronics. Electrical cabinets and installations. Measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters and signal generators. Mechanical workshop skills, such as using a milling machine, drill press and other common workshop tools. Basic mechanical fabrication, modification and fitting of components. Maintenance of complex scientific, industrial or accelerator equipment. Experience from accelerator facilities or synchrotron light sources is an advantage, but not a requirement. About you We are looking for someone who enjoys practical technical work and takes pride in solving problems and keeping complex equipment operational. You are systematic, thorough and safety-conscious, and you are comfortable working both independently and together with engineers and technicians. You are curious and willing to learn new systems and technologies, and you enjoy turning technical problems into practical solutions. What we offer When you join our MAX IV team, you step into a world of cutting-edge science. We make the invisible visible by supporting scientists from all over the world and enabling scientific results for the benefit of society.
