The role will include: Supporting residents using a strengths-based, trauma-informed, recovery-oriented approach. Delivering and supporting structured workshops, psychoeducational sessions, and recovery-focused interventions in line with Brynawel’s therapeutic programme. Using approaches including motivational interviewing, relational practice, relapse prevention, emotional regulation support, and recovery capital development. Supporting residents to identify their strengths, personal goals, values, interests, and aspirations, and assisting them to create realistic recovery and resettlement plans. Working collaboratively with residents to develop personalised progression plans that support long-term recovery, independence, and quality of life following discharge. Supporting residents to build recovery capital across personal, social, community, and practical domains. Assisting residents to access appropriate services including housing, benefits, debt management, education, training, employment, volunteering, healthcare, wellbeing services, and peer support networks. Creating effective links with community organisations and external providers that can offer meaningful recovery-oriented opportunities and activities. Supporting residents to attend initial appointments, where appropriate, to reduce barriers to engagement and increase confidence in accessing support. Supporting residents during transition periods including discharge planning, graded community exposure, community leave preparation, and aftercare engagement. Working in a neurodiverse-friendly and psychologically informed manner, adapting communication and support approaches to meet individual learning, cognitive, emotional, and sensory needs. Promoting inclusion, dignity, empowerment, and resident participation in all aspects of care and recovery planning. Contributing to the development of a safe, therapeutic, and recovery-focused community environment within Brynawel. Maintaining clear, accurate, and timely records in accordance with organisational policies, professional standards, and confidentiality requirements. Completing all data collection and outcome monitoring requirements within the service, including contributing to recovery outcome reporting and evaluation processes. Using clinical records, resident feedback, and outcome measures to support reflective practice and continuous service improvement. Participating in multidisciplinary meetings, reviews, supervision, reflective practice, and ongoing professional development. items.desc: Indra is a leading global technology and consulting company, and a trusted technological partner for the core business operations of its clients worldwide. It stands at the forefront of key sectors including Transport, Defence, Air Traffic Management and Space, alongside advanced Information Technology services delivered through Minsait, and cutting-edge capabilities in Sovereign AI, Cybersecurity, and Cyberdefence via IndraMind. The company’s business model is built around a comprehensive portfolio of proprietary products, combining strong innovation with a high-value focus for customers. With more than 2,500 projects implemented across 50 countries and over 100 cities, Indra is a global benchmark in innovative transportation and mobility solutions. It is recognised as one of the world’s top three companies in public transportation management systems. Indra’s technology supports the daily journeys of over 78 million people, helping to reduce more than 10 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions annually, and helping save nearly 3,000 lives through improved traffic management and road safety. Indra Group is paving the way to a more secure and better-connected future through innovative solutions, trusted relationships and the very best talent. Sustainability sits at the heart of its strategy and culture, driving efforts to address current and future social and environmental challenges. In the 2024 financial year, Indra achieved revenues of €5.5 billion, over 60,000 professionals, maintained a local presence in 46 countries, and operated across more than 140 countries worldwide. As the technological partner for its customers’ key operations, Indra is at the core of their business, and Indra’s four values guide everything we do: Innovation - Our capacity for innovation, cutting-edge solutions, and specialised team of professionals enables us to drive a safer, more connected future through technology. Trust - We work with strength, commitment, and reliability, delivering quality solutions to build trust with customers, employees, partners, investors, and society. Connection - We harness the power of collaboration, connect ideas and solutions, and adapt to our customers’ needs, supporting them on the path to a better future. Foresight - We anticipate future needs to make the world safer and more connected, transforming our experience and knowledge into solutions for a better tomorrow. About the Project Transport for London (TfL) has awarded Indra a long-term contract to operate, develop, enhance and expand ticketing and access control systems across London’s transport network through to 2034, with extension options to 2039. This programme covers the maintenance, operation and evolution of a large-scale, complex ecosystem, including turnstiles, validators, ticket machines, sales terminals, back-office systems, payment gateways, IT infrastructure and cybersecurity that supports over 8.6 million daily journeys. Therefore, Indra will become TfL’s strategic technology partner to guarantee the operation and evolution of the world’s largest and most sophisticated ticketing system. Following a transition period of approximately two years, Indra will serve as the sole provider across the network that includes more than 8,500 buses, nearly 400 Underground stations, around 300 rail stations (Overground, DLR, Elizabeth Line and suburban services), 4,000 Oyster Card outlets, seven customer service centres, and 24 river boat boarding points. Drawing on over 30 years of experience in urban public transport solutions, Indra will manage and evolve all aspects of the system. The project also envisages, in partnership with TfL, the implementation of new technologies to develop the system, make it more efficient and automate key processes; in short, to jointly create the next generation of the ticketing system for London. Role overview The Asset Performance Administrator is responsible for monitoring, analysing and reporting on system, asset and service performance to ensure contractual requirements, performance indicators and service objectives are achieved. The role supports the Performance Assurance Manager by providing data-driven analysis, identifying performance risks, managing asset lifecycle information and supporting decisions relating to obsolescence, residual life and service improvement. Evaluate asset performance, reliability, availability and maintainability trends. Identify emerging performance issues and recommend corrective or preventative actions. Support the continuous review of system performance against established forecasts and targets. Monitor the residual life of assets and components to identify risks of obsolescence. items.desc: Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported. Your role at a glance The Capacity Assignment Specialist (m/f/d), supports execution of the global capacity strategy by partnering with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Operations to assign and manage inventory (space and power) against revenue opportunities. This role acts as a key operational link between sales pipeline demand and data center inventory availability. The Specialist ensures capacity is allocated in alignment with governance standards, supports utilization optimization, and maintains clear reporting to enable informed sales planning and decision-making. What we are looking for Key Responsibilities: Capacity Assignment & Sales Support Partner with Sales and Solutions teams to evaluate opportunities and assign space and power in accordance with global capacity policies. Validate availability against the capacity ledger and support management of holds, reservations, and commits. Provide timely confirmations and escalate conflicts or allocation risks. Identify and escalate potential oversubscription or stranded capacity issues. Inventory Monitoring & Optimization Monitor space and power utilization across sites and highlight inefficiencies or fragmentation. Support analysis of consolidation or reallocation opportunities to improve usable inventory. Partner with Operations to validate constraints and support incremental capacity improvements. Reporting & Planning Support Maintain accurate reporting on inventory availability, utilization, and reservation status. Prepare data inputs for weekly capacity reviews and monthly planning forums. Support sales forecasting by ensuring pipeline demand aligns with available inventory. Governance & Data Integrity Ensure compliance with capacity governance processes and change control standards. Maintain data accuracy across planning systems (DCIM, CRM/CPQ, ERP, etc.). Document allocation decisions and inventory changes in accordance with policy. Support process improvement efforts related to reporting and workflow efficiency. Knowledge & Attributes: Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, analytics, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience. Multiple years of experience in inventory management, capacity planning, reporting, or analytics roles. Working knowledge of data center space, power, and cooling fundamentals. Experience within data center, cloud, telecommunications, or infrastructure-focused organizations preferred. Familiarity with enterprise systems such as DCIM, CMDB, CRM/CPQ, ERP, and analytics platforms. Experience supporting sales-facing or operational planning functions preferred. Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret inventory data and capacity models. Experience collaborating with Sales, Operations, and Planning teams. Strong reporting and data validation capabilities. High attention to detail and disciplined process orientation. Ability to manage multiple opportunities in a fast-paced environment. Clear written and verbal communication skills. Who we are As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime. NTT Global Data Centers is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

The Role Support the revenue and billing function for a multi-entity group, from closed-won deal through to issued invoice. This is a hands-on administrative role covering order preparation, customer and billing setup, invoicing, purchase order chasing, first-line queries, and month-end and audit support. We are automating our revenue and billing process, and the role exists to carry the manual workload while that automation is designed and implemented. items.desc: About Reaseheath Reaseheath College and University Centre is a leading land-based and technical education provider, with a proud history stretching back over 100 years. Our mission is simple: to deliver industry focused, career ready education that transforms lives and supports the future of all our learners – from further education, higher education, apprenticeships and adult courses. Set in a stunning rural campus near Nantwich in Cheshire, we offer an inspiring place to work, with industry-leading facilities, strong employer partnerships and a clear focus on innovation, sustainability and real-world skills. Working at Reaseheath Working at Reaseheath means being part of a supportive, ambitious and values-driven community. Our staff play a vital role in shaping futures, helping our learners develop the skills, confidence and experience they need to succeed in their careers. We are committed to creating a positive working environment where colleagues feel valued, supported and able to grow. With opportunities for professional development, strong industry links and a collaborative culture, you can build a rewarding career while making a genuine impact. Job Title: Dairy Herdsperson Status: Permanent, 48 hours per week Closing Date: Midnight, Sunday 8th November Assessment Centre Date: To be confirmed Overview Reaseheath College is seeking a dedicated and experienced Dairy Herdsperson to join our farm team. This is a key practical role with a particular focus on calf rearing and youngstock, alongside supporting the day-to-day management, health and welfare of the wider dairy herd. Our award-winning farm is a centre of excellence for agricultural education and innovation, supporting a 300-head pedigree Holstein and Ayrshire dairy herd, sheep, and arable enterprises. With cutting-edge facilities including a GEA rapid exit parlour, Lely A5 robotic milkers, and a Lely Vector feeding system, we are proud to be at the forefront of UK land-based education and farming innovation. About the role We are looking for an enthusiastic Dairy Herdsperson to help implement our dairy strategy, taking lead responsibility for calf rearing and maintaining the highest standards of animal husbandry from birth. You will support daily livestock and milk production activities while taking primary ownership of youngstock health, welfare and growth. You will manage calf feeding and rearing in line with agreed protocols, monitor and record calf health and growth, and carry out routine youngstock treatments including disbudding, vaccinations and the administration of veterinary medicines. You will also support wider herd duties including milk production across robotic and manual systems, group allocations, foot bathing and trimming, veterinary treatments, and maintaining dairy infrastructure and equipment. Alongside your practical farm responsibilities, you will work with academic teams and students, demonstrating industry best practice and helping learners develop their practical knowledge and skills. Accurate record keeping is an important part of the role, including monitoring youngstock performance, lameness, fertility and milk quality, and contributing to weekly management discussions. Key responsibilities: Lead calf rearing and youngstock care, taking ownership of calf health, welfare and growth. Manage calf feeding, weighing and health monitoring in line with agreed protocols and youngstock performance measures. Carry out routine youngstock and herd treatments safely, including disbudding, vaccinations, veterinary medicines, foot bathing/trimming and AI activities. Support daily herd management and milk production across robotic and manual milking systems, maintaining excellent hygiene and animal welfare standards. Maintain accurate herd and youngstock records and ensure compliance with legislative requirements, Red Tractor standards, Arla regulations and the Arla Every Calf policy. Support students during practical activities, demonstrating industry best practice and sharing knowledge in a supportive manner. The successful candidate will have: Practical experience in dairy cattle care, including milking and general husbandry. Knowledge of herd health practices such as AI, foot trimming, and administering treatments. An ability to maintain accurate records and follow strict protocols. Strong commitment to animal welfare and compliance with industry standards. Familiarity with modern dairy technology (e.g., robotic milking) and willingness to support student learning. A willingness to engage actively and enthusiastically within the dairy team and to work flexibly as business needs change. A keen interest in working with educational staff and students and sharing skills and knowledge. items.desc: Vehicle Mechanic / Technician — AutoTyne York £2,700 per month take-home pay An ambitious company. A growing network. A chance to help build something bigger. AutoTyne is bringing together used car sales, skilled mechanics and modern technology to build a dealership group with ambitions to become one of the largest in the North East. With existing sites in Yorkshire, including Ripon, and plans encompassing York, Newcastle and Middlesbrough, we’re building a business that can grow across the region. We’re looking for an experienced mechanic to join our York operation and play a central part in that growth. Our plans for York We’re working towards bringing our York sales forecourt and independent garage operations together into a purpose-refurbished used car dealership. We’re currently operating from a temporary workshop as we progress those plans. Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge dealership where investment in people, equipment and technology runs through the whole business. That means modern diagnostic tools in the workshop and AI-powered systems supporting vehicle sourcing, stock management, sales and customer service. We’re adaptable, open to better ideas and willing to invest in tools that help our team do their jobs well. We want to put capabilities usually associated with much larger dealer groups into an independent business that can move quickly and think differently. Where you fit in A dealership’s reputation depends on the quality of the cars it sells. Your work will be central to ours. You’ll inspect and prepare vehicles for sale, diagnose faults, carry out repairs and complete servicing and maintenance across a variety of makes and models. We need someone who takes ownership of their work, spots problems early and cares about getting vehicles ready properly. Joining at this stage means having a voice in how the workshop develops, from equipment and working practices to how we manage an expanding workload. What’s on offer £2,700 a month take-home pay , with the salary package agreed around your tax code and deductions. Varied work across sales preparation, servicing, diagnostics and repairs. A business committed to investing in modern tools, equipment and technology. The opportunity to help shape our future workshop. Scope to develop and take on greater responsibility as the group grows. What we’re looking for You’ll have relevant qualifications or substantial practical workshop experience, strong diagnostic and repair skills, and the confidence to work independently. We value reliability, sound judgement and pride in your workmanship. You don’t need to understand AI—you do need to be open to learning, adaptable and interested in helping us improve. A full UK driving licence is required. MOT tester status would be an advantage. Help us build AutoTyne York—and grow with us. To apply, send your CV or a brief summary of your experience, including your availability. Location: York Working hours: [Insert days and hours] All applications and initial enquiries will be handled confidentially. Pay: £40,100.00 per year Work Location: In person

items.desc: Hungry for a challenge? That’s good, because at Just Eat Takeaway.com (JET) we have abundant opportunity or, as we say, everything is on the table. We are a leading global online food delivery marketplace. Our tech ecosystem connects millions of active customers with hundreds of thousands of connected partners in countries across the globe. Our mission? To empower every food moment around the world, whether it’s through customer service, coding or couriers. About this role: As a Product Designer within the Customer pillar, you'll be part of a UX team looking after the apps and websites our customers use to order their food globally. You’ll work with an empowered cross-functional team that prioritises using research and data to help understand the problem space, before moving through the design process to deliver engaging and user-friendly solutions. We are specifically looking for an AI-forward designer who leverages modern AI tools as a force multiplier—moving rapidly from concept to functional artifacts to accelerate visual exploration, prototyping, and delivery. We want to discover what our users will love as soon as we can. We like to explore user problems in-depth, speak with users regularly, and embrace modern, AI-assisted workflows to help us understand and meet user needs faster. You'll be part of a passionate UX team of 80+ UX designers, UI designers, product designers, service designers, researchers and writers across 7 countries. These are some of the key ingredients to the role: Focus on key user problems and come up with innovative solutions to those problems. Quickly yet thoroughly create process flows, user journeys, wireframes, visual design mock-ups, and AI-accelerated prototypes as needed to effectively conceptualise and communicate detailed interaction behaviours. Work across the entire product lifecycle from concept to delivery; creating documentation, wireframes, hi- & lo-fi prototypes, and pixel-perfect UI. Confidently integrate AI tools into your day-to-day workflow for rapid visual exploration, generative prototyping, and streamlining production tasks across web and mobile platforms. Collaborate with engineering & product management to build experiences and present your work to stakeholders. Collaborate on research alongside UX researchers, conducting usability studies and utilizing AI tools where appropriate to assist with synthesis and insights. What will you bring to the table? Experience in a product design role delivering UX&D work as part of a multi-disciplinary, cross-functional team. Hands-on experience designing and delivering user experiences across mobile app platforms (iOS/Android) or responsive web. Solid design fundamentals (layout, typography, color), high-fidelity prototyping skills (Figma, Axure, etc.), and familiarity working with established design systems. AI curiosity & practice: Hands-on experience or genuine enthusiasm for integrating AI tools (Figma AI tools, AI-prototyping, AI-assisted research synthesis, etc.) into your design workflow as a force multiplier to iterate faster and work smarter. Familiarity with collaborative design processes, including workshop facilitation, design sprints, and working alongside User Research. Good business awareness with the ability to articulate design decisions clearly to product managers, engineering teams, and stakeholders. A proactive approach to taking ownership, creatively solving problems, and contributing directly to business objectives. At JET, this is on the menu: Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth and about celebrating every aspect of our JETers. Thanks to them we stay one step ahead of the competition. Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day. What else is cooking? Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels. Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now!

items.desc: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Introduction to the Team Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and employees. A singular technology platform powered by data, machine learning, and AI provides secure, differentiated, and personalised experiences that build loyalty and traveler satisfaction. The Content AI team develops machine learning capabilities that improve the quality, relevance, and usefulness of content-focused products and services across Expedia Group. Working within the Product & Technology Machine Learning Science and Engineering organisation, you will translate research and experimentation into reliable, scalable production outcomes. The team works across content understanding, review intelligence, search relevance, ranking, recommendations, content moderation, image-based AI applications, and Generative AI experiences used by millions of travelers worldwide. In This Role, You Will Develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning models and algorithms for Content AI applications. Design and implement end-to-end machine learning solutions, including data preparation, feature engineering, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous optimisation. Apply statistical analysis, experimentation, and data-driven decision-making to assess model performance and guide technical direction. Collaborate with engineers, product managers, applied scientists, and domain experts to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable ML solutions. Contribute to system design, low-level design, API development, and data modelling for production machine learning systems. Build and operate production solutions using technologies such as Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Redis, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native infrastructure. Design and deploy scalable batch and real-time ML pipelines supporting customer-facing applications. Develop and operationalise LLM applications, RAG systems, and Generative AI capabilities for content understanding, summarisation, classification, and recommendation use cases. Build evaluation frameworks and observability solutions to monitor model quality, reliability, latency, drift, and business impact. Evaluate trade-offs between model quality, scalability, latency, and infrastructure cost when developing AI-powered products. Partner with engineering teams to deploy and scale machine learning systems in production. Produce clear technical documentation and share expertise through mentorship, design reviews, and technical leadership. Experience And Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience. 5+ years of industry experience developing machine learning solutions in production environments. Proficient programming and software engineering skills in Python, including experience building production-grade services and APIs. Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and/or PyTorch. Experience owning machine learning solutions across the full lifecycle, including experimentation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and operational improvement. Experience building and operating production ML systems at scale. Understanding of distributed systems, data structures, algorithms, system design, low-level design, API design, and data modelling. Experience with batch and real-time data processing systems, databases such as Redis, and low-latency serving technologies such as KServe, FastAPI. Ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver measurable machine learning outcomes. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Data Science, or a related STEM field. Experience applying Generative AI and LLMs to customer-facing products and designing, building, or scaling RAG systems. Experience in search, ranking, recommendations, personalisation, content intelligence, moderation, NLP, computer vision, or related AI domains. items.desc: Statsvetenskap vid Försvarshögskolan är unik i sitt särskilda fokus på säkerhet och krishantering. Ämnet är samtidigt teoretiskt brett och bygger på ett brett spektrum av relaterade områden, såsom internationella relationer, politisk kommunikation, offentlig förvaltning och politisk teori, samt hämtar inspiration från annan forskning inom och utanför statsvetenskapen. Institutionen för statsvetenskap söker nu en forskare inom AI-assisterad och computational social science till forskningsgrupp som bedriver uppdragsforskning om informationspåverkan och desinformation. Arbetsort är Stockholm. Arbetsuppgifter Anställningen är inriktad mot AI-assisterad samhällsvetenskaplig forskning, computational social science och kvantitativ metod. Forskningen kan exempelvis beröra informationspåverkan, politisk och strategisk kommunikation, medier och narrativ. En central del är att utveckla och pröva vetenskapligt hållbara sätt att använda stora språkmodeller (LLM) och andra AI-baserade metoder i samhällsvetenskaplig forskning Forskaren förväntas planera och genomföra egen och gemensam forskning samt bidra till vetenskapliga publikationer och konferenspresentationer. Forskaren arbetar i en forskningsgrupp som bedriver uppdragsforskning om informationspåverkan och desinformation. En central del av anställningen är också att stärka forskargruppens kompetens inom AI-assisterad forskning, computational social science och kvantitativ metod. Forskaren förväntas därför aktivt utbilda och handleda övriga forskare i gruppen och bidra till att bygga upp långsiktig metodkompetens. I Arbetsuppgifterna Ingår Bland Annat Att planera och genomföra egen och gemensam forskning med AI-baserade, computational och kvantitativa metoder; utveckla och utvärdera metoder för bland annat LLM, kvantitativ textanalys, machine learning och NLP; undersöka användning av lokala och open-source-baserade språkmodeller på egna forskningsdata, med fokus på validering och reproducerbarhet; stärka forskargruppens metodkompetens genom workshops, individuell handledning och stöd i programmering och analys; bidra till vetenskapliga publikationer, konferenspresentationer och forskningsansökningar. Kvalifikationer Vi söker en forskare som har avlagt doktorsexamen eller har en utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara doktorsexamen. För Anställningen Krävs Även erfarenhet av kvantitativa och/eller computational samhällsvetenskapliga metoder, inklusive analys av text och/eller bilder och behandling av data från sociala medier/plattformar, samt förmåga att använda Python och/eller R för analys och forskning. erfarenhet av maskininlärning, NLP eller kvantitativ textanalys, med särskilt fokus på LLM-baserade metoder, god förståelse för forskningsdesign, validering och reproducerbar forskning, Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på engelska. Stor vikt läggs vid förmågan att kommunicera avancerade metodfrågor på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt samt att samarbeta väl med forskare med varierande metodförkunskaper. Mycket stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet. Vi söker dig som är självständig, initiativtagande och kommunikativ och som har god förmåga att samarbeta med forskare med olika metodologiska bakgrunder. Meriterande Erfarenhet av lokala eller open-source-baserade språkmodeller, RAG, fine-tuning, multilingual NLP eller avancerad kvantitativ metod är meriterande. Erfarenhet av forskning inom statsvetenskap, mediestudier, computational social science eller annat relevant samhällsvetenskapligt område är meriterande. Erfarenhet av handledning, utbildning eller metodstöd är meriterande. Goda kunskaper i svenska eller annat skandinaviskt språk är meriterande. Ansökan Ansökan utformas i tillämpliga delar i enlighet med Försvarshögskolans mall för akademisk tjänst. Ansökan Ska Innehålla Presentationsbrev där du motiverar varför du är kvalificerad för tjänsten, CV inklusive vetenskapliga publikationer eller projektportfolio, Examensbevis och betyg från tidigare studier Ansökan skickas in via Försvarshögskolans rekryteringssystem genom att klicka på länken ”Logga in och sök jobbet” på annonssidan. Märk din ansökan med dnr HR 180/2026. Din ansökan ska vara inskickad senast den 2026-10-18. Komplett ansökan ska vara Försvarshögskolan tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdagen vid midnatt, CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time). I de fall det inte råder en jämn könsbalans kan Försvarshögskolan vid lika eller i stort sätt lika kvalifikationer hos de sökande anställa den av underrepresenterat kön. Om anställningen Detta är en tidsbegränsad anställning på heltid i 12 månader. items.desc: Applying innovative optics solutions to AI hardware technology products Essex / Cambs; to £75,000 DoE This expanding tech company is utilising AI within their core hardware products. This extends to the use of computer vision for monitoring and tracking. As their next Computer Vision Physicist, you’ll deliver projects from concept through design, prototype to product release. Key responsibilities would involve the design of optical systems (lenses, mirrors, sensors) and optimising them for VIS, NIR and FIR application. This would include simulations (using OpticStudio or similar), component selection, prototype device testing and relevant process documentation. Requirements Degree in Physics or Electronics followed by PhD in applied optics (equivalent industry experience will also be considered). Demonstrable experience with optical system ideally for machine vision. Additional experience with lasers would be desirable. Strong understanding of ray tracing, lens design, optical simulations, image processing, electro-optical systems and opto-mechanics. Experience with optical test methodology and validation. The role is based fully onsite. Due to technologies having applications for military uses, this role is subject to the incumbent being security cleared (British national residing in the UK for the past 5 years). This is a timely opportunity to join this growing company early in their journey, and take ownership of significant technology development projects they are working on. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2 600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au coeur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l’énergie, l’industrie, le transport, l’aéronautique et la cybersécurité. Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d’innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d’affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites. En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante. Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance. Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain. Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l’innovation. Engagés à vos côtés, au service de vos enjeux critiques. Business Unit Défense & Sécurité Protéger les territoires, anticiper les menaces. Notre Business Unit Défense & Sécurité est au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Nos équipes interviennent sur des projets à haute valeur ajoutée : liaisons de données tactiques, lutte antidrones, surveillance maritime, simulation et entraînement, sûreté aérienne. items.desc: Rothschild & Co Rothschild & Co est un groupe international de services financiers de premier plan, contrôlé par la famille depuis sept générations et au centre des marchés financiers depuis plus de 200 ans. Notre expertise, notre savoir-faire et notre réseau mondial nous permettent de proposer une vision unique qui bénéficie à l’activité et la richesse de nos clients et de nos parties prenantes, en respectant notre planète. Nos équipes de 4 200 spécialistes du conseil financier présents sur le terrain dans plus de 40 pays, apportent une vision internationale unique à travers quatre activités de premier plan – Global Advisory, Wealth Management, Asset Management et Five Arrows. En notre qualité de groupe familial fondé sur les relations humaines, nous attachons une importance particulière au recrutement et au développement de carrière de nos collaborateurs afin qu'ils puissent s'épanouir dans leur parcours professionnel. Contexte Au sein du périmètre Wealth & Asset Management, le Centre d’Expertise Intelligence Artificielle accompagne le développement de solutions innovantes au service des métiers de la banque privée et de la gestion d’actifs. L’équipe intervient sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des cas d’usage IA, depuis l’identification des opportunités jusqu’à l’expérimentation, la validation et le déploiement de solutions concrètes. Dans un environnement international et exigeant, le CoE IA joue un rôle clé pour accélérer l’adoption de l’intelligence artificielle générative, tout en garantissant un cadre d’usage maîtrisé, sécurisé et conforme aux standards d’un groupe financier de premier plan. Vous rejoindrez une équipe pluridisciplinaire travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les métiers, les équipes Data, les équipes plateformes, la sécurité et la conformité afin de transformer les besoins opérationnels en solutions IA utiles, robustes et industrialisables. Rôle En tant que Data Scientist spécialisé en intelligence artificielle générative, vous contribuerez à la conception, à l’évaluation et à l’industrialisation de solutions IA à forte valeur ajoutée pour les métiers du Wealth & Asset Management. Vous interviendrez depuis la compréhension du besoin métier jusqu’à la validation des modèles et prototypes, en lien avec des profils techniques et fonctionnels variés. Missions principales Concevoir, développer et tester des solutions d’intelligence artificielle générative répondant à des besoins métiers concrets : assistants conversationnels, systèmes de recherche augmentée par génération, outils d’extraction documentaire, workflows d’analyse ou dispositifs d’aide à la décision. Préparer, structurer et analyser les données nécessaires aux cas d’usage IA, en veillant à leur qualité, leur pertinence, leur traçabilité et leur conformité. Définir et mettre en œuvre les dispositifs d’évaluation des modèles et des réponses générées : tests fonctionnels, mesure de performance, analyse des risques d’hallucination, robustesse et pertinence métier. Contribuer, en collaboration avec les équipes Data Engineering et plateformes, à l’industrialisation des solutions IA : intégration, automatisation des déploiements, monitoring, observabilité, gestion des environnements et préparation au passage en production. Documenter les modèles, les jeux de données, les choix d’architecture, les limites connues et les résultats d’évaluation afin de garantir la traçabilité et la bonne gouvernance des solutions. Accompagner les utilisateurs métiers dans la qualification des besoins, la formalisation des cas d’usage, l’interprétation des résultats et l’adoption des solutions IA. Participer à la veille technologique, aux expérimentations, aux preuves de concept et à l’identification de nouvelles opportunités d’usage de l’intelligence artificielle générative. Compétences attendues Expérience confirmée en data science, idéalement acquise dans un environnement bancaire, financier, de conseil ou dans un contexte fortement régulé. Solide maîtrise de Python et des principales librairies de data science, machine learning et traitement du langage naturel. Bonne compréhension des modèles de machine learning classiques et des principes statistiques associés : classification, régression, clustering, séries temporelles, NLP. Expérience ou bonne compréhension des architectures d’intelligence artificielle générative : grands modèles de langage, recherche augmentée par génération, prompt engineering, évaluation de prompts, extraction d’informations, orchestration de chaînes ou workflows IA. Connaissance des mécanismes d’optimisation des modèles de langage, tels que finetuning, quantization, distillation ou techniques équivalentes, appréciée pour des usages industriels. Bonne compréhension des fondamentaux du Deep Learning et des systèmes d’IA agentiques. Expérience avec Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry ou des environnements équivalents de développement et d’évaluation de solutions IA. Connaissance d’Azure Document Intelligence, Microsoft …

Classée depuis 10 ans au Palmarès Great Place to Work®, ISAGRI fait partie des meilleures entreprises en France où il fait bon travailler. Mission Le pôle Data & IA accompagne les équipes produit d'Isagri dans l'industrialisation de leurs usages de la donnée et de l'intelligence artificielle. Il porte notamment la structuration de la plateforme data (« raffinerie de données ») et la mise à disposition d'un cadre d'industrialisation (guidelines, templates projet réutilisables) pour faire passer les projets du prototype à la production. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un ou une Data Scientist pour aider les équipes à valoriser les données de leurs solutions grâce au machine learning et à l'analyse avancée. La Mission Identifier les cas d’usage : comprendre les besoins métiers, évaluer les données disponibles et proposer les approches les plus pertinentes. Concevoir des modèles de machine learning : analyser les données, développer et évaluer des modèles de prévision, classification, recommandation ou détection d’anomalies. Préparer et suivre la mise en production : garantir la qualité du code, contribuer au déploiement des modèles et suivre leurs performances dans le temps. Accompagner les équipes produit : partager les bonnes pratiques, vulgariser les résultats et contribuer à la montée en compétences. Explorer de nouvelles approches : évaluer les apports de l’IA générative et assurer une veille technologique. Profil Le Profil Recherche Vous justifiez de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en data science, avec au moins un modèle mis en production et suivi dans la durée. Vous maîtrisez Python et ses principales bibliothèques data science (pandas, scikit-learn, ainsi qu’un outil de boosting ou de deep learning). Vous possédez de solides connaissances en statistiques, machine learning et SQL, et savez travailler sur des volumes de données importants. Vous connaissez les pratiques MLOps : suivi d’expériences, versioning et CI/CD. Vous appliquez les bonnes pratiques de développement : tests, Git, conteneurisation et environnement cloud. Curieux et rigoureux, vous savez comprendre les enjeux métiers, prendre du recul sur les résultats et les expliquer à des interlocuteurs non techniques. La connaissance de l’IA générative et des LLM constitue un plus. EVOLUTIONS La politique RH vous garantit un accompagnement régulier pour vous faire progresser et évoluer vers de nouvelles missions en fonction de votre projet. Rejoindre notre Groupe, c'est la garantie d'une formation initiale et continue, d'un plan de carrière personnalisé et d'un management de proximité. CONDITIONS PROPOSEES Poste basé à Beauvais, à pourvoir dès que possible. Rémunération : Fixe + Variable. Dans le cadre de sa politique RH, nous étudions, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap. Référence de l'offre : vn48g6i8gf

items.desc: L’IA, chez nous, ne s’arrête pas au POC. Chez Hubvisory, tu ne livres pas une démo qui tourne sur un portable : tu conçois, tu industrialises et tu déploies des solutions IA qui vivent en production chez des grands comptes. En tant qu’AI Engineer, tu es responsable de la conception technique, de la mise en production et de la fiabilité de ce qu’on construit. Ce que tu fais concrètement : Tu construis des architectures IA sur mesure. LLM, RAG, fine-tuning, agents : tu choisis les briques, tu assumes les arbitrages techniques et tu les expliques. Pas d’empilement d’outils à la mode, des choix justifiés par un cas d’usage qualifié. Tu emmènes tes modèles jusqu’en production. Déploiement, monitoring, latence, coûts, robustesse dans le temps. C’est là que le métier se joue vraiment, et c’est ce qu’on attend de toi du premier jour au dernier. Tu passes du prototype à l’échelle. POC, MVP, pipelines industriels : tu sais quand il faut aller vite et quand il faut consolider, en gardant l’enjeu business en ligne de mire. Tu travailles au contact direct du métier. Product Managers, équipes Data, MLOps, et surtout le client. Tu expliques ce que fait le modèle, ce qu’il ne fait pas, et pourquoi. Tu fais monter les autres. Acculturation IA des équipes internes et des équipes clientes, partage de ce que tu as appris en atelier, contribution à la practice Agents IA. Tu participes à la vie d’Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant.e et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de référent.e technique, Lead IA ou Architecte Gen-AI. 👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ? Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l’IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. Plus de 10% de notre chiffre d’affaires vient déjà de missions 100% IA : tu travailles sur des sujets réels, pas sur des sujets de plaquette. Une practice dédiée aux Agents IA, avec des pairs qui font le même métier que toi. Tu ne seras pas l’unique profil technique au milieu de consultants qui n’ont pas le vocabulaire. Un cadre qui récompense la progression, pas l’ancienneté : Campus de deux semaines à l’arrivée, buddy dédié, mentorat de proximité, revalorisations bi-annuelles. Des valeurs fortes : depuis 2016, Hubvisory grandit autour de l’ambition, l’expertise, la curiosité, la méritocratie et l’exigence bienveillante. Le package : 42.000-48.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu’à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire. 👉 Le profil que nous recherchons Tu as une vraie expérience de l’IA générative en conditions réelles : LLM, RAG, création d’agents. Tu as déjà mis un modèle en production et tu sais décrire ce qui s’est passé entre « ça marche en local » et « ça tourne chez le client ». Côté technique : Python, APIs, déploiement cloud et conteneurisation. Le ML classique est un atout, la GenAI est le socle. Anglais courant obligatoire. Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : la capacité à vulgariser face à un interlocuteur non technique, une curiosité entretenue (on te demandera ton dernier effet « waouh » en entretien) et de la débrouillardise sur des sujets sans mode d’emploi. Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ? Étape 1 : Échange avec un RH pour valider l’adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle Étape 2 : Entretien technique GenAI avec un AI Engineer de la practice Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP Étape 4 : Échange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d’embauche Quelle que soit l’issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum ! Leverage geospatial algorithms to optimize pipelines, as well as creating automated tuning and outlier detection algorithms. Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends. What We Believe Are Important Traits For This Role 8-10+ years of backend and ML experience: Extensive hands-on experience showcasing expertise and a strong track record in the engineering field. Experience with Reinforcement Learning. Technical knowledge: Extensive experience with Python, distributed processing pipelines (Hadoop, Spark, Airflow, Dask), and very large datasets – statistical analysis, data quality control, optimizing storage. Cloud proficiency: Extensive experience with cloud and infrastructure services, including, as well as deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud environments. Operational excellence: You drive a culture of quality and continuous improvement in your organization. Strong passion for clean code and robust architecture, with a drive to elevate engineering practices and design standards across the team. Ownership & execution: Own the technical vision, lead the strategy and guide the team to execute towards building the future of our routing cost engine. Customer focus: You care deeply about your customers and their problems, and you work tirelessly to innovate on their behalf. Growth mindset: Have the humility to accept mistakes, learn and grow from them. Mentorship: Experience mentoring and leading engineering teams developing skill sets and career growth. Strong written and vocal communication skills: You can talk and write about complex ideas concisely to a wide audience. You are able to lead and resolve org-wide technical discussions and are able to collaborate and include input from cross-functional teams (security, devops, data, compliance and product). Data informed mindset: You believe in the value of data informed decision making and strive to measure things that are not straight forward but essential. You also have the right instincts to make speedy decisions in the absence of perfect & comprehensive data. Design, develop, and evaluate advanced statistical models and machine learning algorithms to solve complex business challenges and enable smarter decision-making. Apply rigorous statistical methodologies to quantify uncertainty, estimate business impact, and generate reliable recommendations for decision-making. Design experiments and define evaluation frameworks to measure the effectiveness of new products, pricing strategies, and business initiatives. Strong foundation in probability theory, statistical inference, regression analysis, Bayesian statistics, experimentation, causal inference, and predictive modelling. Proven experience developing, validating, and improving machine learning models in business environments. Strong programming and modelling skills in Python and experience with modern data science libraries. Excellent SQL skills and experience working with large analytical datasets. Experience designing experiments and evaluating business initiatives, balancing statistical rigor with pragmatic decision-making to deliver simple, high-value solutions over unnecessary complexity. Strong commercial mindset with a passion for exploring new analytical methods/AI tech and translating complex findings into measurable business recommendations. Fluency in English with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills alongside the ability to explain complex concepts to audiences with varying technical backgrounds. This achievement reflects the team’s commitment to innovation, impact, and excellence in applying data science to real-world insurance challenges. Working on the end-to-end data solution including understanding complex business challenges, designing solutions, working with large and small data sets (including 3rd party and internal data of a wide variety), using cutting-edge machine learning or Generative AI techniques Work collaboratively with data scientists and other technical disciplines including product and business teams Work closely with other members of the data and analytics community at Hiscox, contributing to delivering value though the use of a range of analytics techniques. Experience working both independently and collaboratively within small, cross-functional teams to deliver analytics and data science projects. items.desc: Qui sont-ils ? 🚀 Accompagner les entrepreneurs pour qu’ils réussissent. Aujourd'hui je vais te raconter une histoire, celle de Dougs, Dougs, c’est avant tout une histoire humaine, c’est la rencontre de Véronique, Sarah et Patrick, experts-comptables et de Florent, ingénieur. C’est une société disruptive qui réinvente sans limite l’accompagnement des entrepreneurs. Dougs, c’est bien plus qu’un cabinet d’expertise comptable. Avec une équipe de plus de 90 ingénieurs et 270 professionnels des métiers (experts comptables et avocats), Dougs, c’est une société qui bouscule les codes. En 2023, notre vision a pris une nouvelle envergure avec une levée de fonds de 25 millions d'euros. Demain ? Nous allons bâtir une équipe de 500 passionnés partageant nos valeurs : Simple, Professionnel, Enthousiaste, Fantastique, Efficience totale, Voir grand. C'est par une approche innovante et révolutionnaire de la comptabilité et de l’entrepreneuriat que Dougs change la donne pour plus de 42 000 entrepreneurs. Alors, prêt à faire partie de l'aventure ? Descriptif du poste 🚀 Ton futur poste Dougs a cassé les codes de l’expertise comptable traditionnelle pour simplifier la vie des entrepreneurs. Aujourd’hui, fidèle à notre ADN, nous déployons l’IA partout où elle peut apporter de la valeur pour accompagner les collaborateurs dans leur mission de conseil et fluidifier l’expérience de nos clients. Nous recherchons donc notre futur AI Agent Engineer. Tu vas rejoindre une équipe fonctionnelle et déjà impactante au cœur de notre stratégie d'innovation. Tu auras un rôle clé dans sa construction et son développement. Son ambition : faire gagner du temps à toutes les équipes métier (Comptabilité, Legal, Care, Sales, etc.) pour pouvoir servir au mieux nos clients en leur permettant de se concentrer sur leur mission de conseil et d’accompagnement. Tu seras en lien direct avec ces équipes : ton rôle sera de transformer leurs problématiques en agents autonomes, en exploitant pleinement le potentiel des modèles de langage. Trois Atouts Majeurs T’accompagneront Des équipes métiers toujours partantes pour remettre en cause l’existant. Une collaboration main dans la main avec les équipes Produits, Opérations et Tech pour co-construire les solutions les plus efficaces. Une stack de pointe combinant notre plateforme d’agentique interne, Cursor et Claude pour accélérer ta vélocité de build. En résumé, tu seras à la croisée des chemins entre la tech et l’humain, avec une vraie possibilité d’avoir de l’impact ! Concrètement, quelles sont tes missions ? Comprendre les besoins métier et leurs enjeux : Échanger avec les différentes équipes (Marketing, Ventes, Support client, etc.) pour identifier leurs défis et opportunités sur lesquelles l’IA peut apporter de la valeur Traduire ces problématiques métier en besoins fonctionnels et techniques (architecture de l'agent, tools à développer ou à ajuster,etc.). Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des agents : Conception d’agents complexes : Concevoir et co-construire des agents précis, optimisés et sécurisés capables d’exécuter leurs missions en toute autonomie Build technique : Développer les "tools" et API manquants nécessaires aux agents pour interagir avec notre écosystème. Collaboration Tech : Travailler main dans la main avec les développeurs seniors pour garantir la qualité, la sécurité et etc. Amélioration et validation des agents : Tester, analyser les résultats (qualité des réponses, taux d'erreurs, etc…) et mettre en œuvre les améliorations nécessaires. Déploiement : Mettre en production en suivant un plan de déploiement rapide mais sécurisé. Monitorer et analyser la performance : Mettre en place des outils de monitoring pour suivre la performance des agents et la fiabilité des tools développés. Assurer la maintenance, garantir la qualité et l’optimisation des agents mis en place Participer à l'évolution IA : Assurer une veille technologique constante sur les modèles de langage et les techniques les plus avancées pour identifier les meilleures recommandations Faire évoluer l’existant pour améliorer la performance de la plateforme et de ses agents Accompagner les équipes : Sensibiliser les équipes à l’IA, les former et les aider à intégrer de façon pertinente ces nouvelles technologies Diffuser les bonnes pratiques autour de l’IA : quand l’utiliser ? items.desc: Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases. We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients. We are currently looking for a Scientist to join our dynamic R&D team in our facility in Gent/Zwijnaarde. The candidate should have a high drive to generate qualitative results through hands-on lab work and take scientific ownership of defined discovery projects, coordinating research activities in close collaboration with other members of the project team. This all happens in a dynamic, informal and stimulating environment where you and your colleagues work to reach the set goals and co-develop novel therapeutics to bring to patients. Work Description The candidate will be accountable for the scientific progress of one or more defined discovery projects, spanning the discovery, characterization, and optimization of novel therapeutic antibodies, next to conceptual evaluation and experimental derisking of complex and emerging biology. The Scientist will own the experimental workplan, integrate data generated internally and externally, and coordinate activities toward decision-enabling milestones in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Include Scientific Leadership & Strategy: Take end-to-end scientific ownership of defined discovery projects by mastering target immunobiology, positioning it within the broader immunology landscape, building and adapting the experimental workplan, and driving project decisions through robust in vitro and in vivo studies in collaboration with internal and external partners. Data Quality & Communication: Ensure the highest standards of data integrity by planning, executing, interpreting, and reporting experiments, while critically reviewing data generated by colleagues, CROs, and collaborators. Integrate the complete data package into clear conclusions, recommendations, and next steps, and communicate key insights, risks, and trade-offs to multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders. Collaborative Problem-Solving & Project Delivery: Proactively engage with colleagues, external experts, and CROs to address scientific challenges, coordinate internal and external activities, maintain project timelines, and advance decision-enabling data packages toward defined milestones and go/no-go decisions. Team Development & Mentorship: Foster a collaborative team environment by organizing work, setting priorities, guiding the scientific quality and reporting of project contributors, and supporting the development of more junior colleagues, with or without formal reporting responsibility. Ambassador for argenx’s Immunology Innovation Program: Contribute to immunology innovation within a defined thematic area by scouting novel disease biology, promising targets, and biological insights that could lay the foundation for the next argenx molecule. Help build validation plans and make science-based recommendations when reviewing new targets and collaborative opportunities with internal and external experts. Profile PhD with a background in immunology, autoimmune/-inflammatory diseases or biological drug discovery is required. Experience in an industrial setting or with regular industry interaction is a plus. Experience with FcRn and FcγR biology as well as Fab, Fc and antibody format engineering is a plus. items.desc: Institutionen för fysik vid Göteborgs universitet är lokaliserad i centrala Göteborg har cirka 100 medarbetare. Kommunikationsmöjligheterna är goda, både nationellt och internationellt. Forskningen är fokuserad inom ämnena atom- och molekylfysik, den kondenserade materiens fysik, spinntronik, komplexa system samt biofysik och genomförs i en internationell miljö med omfattande nationella och internationella samarbeten. Utbildningen på institutionen inkluderar undervisning på kandidat- och mastersprogram i fysik, fysik på lärarutbildningar och kurser i fysik som riktar sig till allmänheten. Fysikcentrum i Göteborg, ett nära samarbete med tre andra institutioner inom den naturvetenskapliga fakulteten och Chalmers tekniska högskola, skapar en innovativ miljö för alla institutionens forskare och studenter. Mer information om verksamheten på institutionen för fysik finns på www.physics.gu.se. Ytterligare information om Göteborg Fysikcentrum finns på www.chalmers.se/sv/centrum/fysikcentrum/Sidor/default.aspx. Ämnesbeskrivning Ett av de mest framgångsrika forskningsområdena vid institutionen är spinntronik i Professor Johan Åkermans grupp med särskilt fokus på magnetodynamiska fenomen i tunna filmer och spinntroniska komponenter. Dessa studeras med magnetiska, elektriska och optiska metoder, och modelleras med hjälp av GPU-accelererade mikromagnetiska simuleringar. Gruppen har erhållit finansiering från Knut och Alice Wallenbergs Stiftelse (KAW) för att utveckla nya spinntroniska komponenter. Institutionen söker därför en Forskare som kan driva en del av detta projekt framåt. Arbetsuppgifter Det huvudsakliga ansvaret för denna tjänst är att bredda användningsområdet för spinn Hall-nanooscillatorer (SHNO) inom ett stort antal olika materialsystem. Rollen kräver gedigen expertis inom utveckling av spinntroniska material samt inom mikrovågsmätning och karaktäriseringstekniker för SHNO. De huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifterna omfattar framställning och optimering av material för SHNO:er, design och tillverkning av nanostrukturerade komponenter med hjälp av nanolitografiska tekniker samt mikrovågsmätningar och karakterisering för att utvärdera SHNO-komponenternas dynamiska egenskaper och prestanda. I arbetet ingår även att implementera mättekniker i sub-THz-området med hjälp av Brillouin-ljusspridningsmikroskopi (µ-BLS). Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med doktorander och postdoktorer och bidra till såväl experimentell design som analys för att driva forskningen framåt. Ytterligare ansvarsområden omfattar att publicera forskningsresultat i vetenskapliga artiklar, bidra till forskargruppens gemensamma publikationer samt presentera resultat vid vetenskapliga konferenser. Behörighet Behörig att anställas som forskare är den som har svensk doktorsexamen eller har en utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara doktorsexamen. Bedömningsgrunder Vi söker kandidater som har uppvisat stark vetenskaplig kompetens inom följande områden: utveckling och framställning av spinntroniska material, framställning och karaktärisering av ferrimagnetiska nitrider, mer än fem års erfarenhet av nanofabrikationstekniker samt mikrovågsmätning och karaktärisering av spinntroniska komponenter. Erfarenhet av spinn Hall-nanooscillatorer (SHNO), liksom elektriska mätningar och µ-BLS-mikroskopimätningar, ses som meriterande. Vetenskapliga meriter kommer i första hand att bedömas utifrån sakkunniggranskade publikationer i vetenskapliga tidskrifter samt presentationer vid internationella konferenser. Anställning Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning 1 år. Omfattning: 100 % Placering: Institutionen för Fysik, Göteborg Tillträde: 1 januari 2027 Tillsättningsförfarande Registrera din ansökan elektroniskt. Ansökan ska innehålla: Ett personligt brev med motivering till varför du söker tjänsten. CV som inkluderar vetenskapliga publikationer. Kopia på examensbevis. Två personliga referenser (namn, telefonnr, relation). Kontaktuppgifter för anställningen Har du frågor om anställningen är du välkommen att kontakta Johan Åkerman, Professor, johan.akerman@physics.gu.se. items.desc: Job Summary Are you passionate about analytical science, natural ingredients, and transforming complex data into meaningful discoveries? IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products. As (Senior) Scientist - Analytical Sciences , you will play a critical role in supporting the development and characterization of innovative natural ingredients within our R&D Naturals organization. Combining deep analytical expertise with scientific leadership, you will help translate complex research questions into analytical strategies that drive innovation and business impact. Working closely with R&D Program and Project Leaders, the Analytical Laboratory Technical Manager, and Analytical Project Managers, you will leverage advanced analytical techniques and data-driven approaches to generate actionable insights and strengthen our analytical capabilities. The role is based in Grasse, France . Together we can discover the next generation of natural ingredients and shape the future of innovation. Where You'll Make a Difference Lead analytical workstreams supporting the development and characterization of natural ingredients, from defining scientific questions through to analytical recommendations. Interpret and challenge complex analytical datasets generated through GC, GC-MS, LC and LC-MS techniques. Apply targeted and untargeted analytical approaches, including chemical profiling, metabolomics, chemometrics, and multivariate data analysis. Develop, optimize and implement innovative analytical methods and advanced data-processing strategies. Translate analytical findings into meaningful scientific insights that support project and program decisions. Partner closely with R&D Program Leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex scientific challenges. Collaborate with laboratory and analytical science colleagues to ensure efficient experimental execution and knowledge sharing. Mentor scientists and contribute to the development of analytical expertise across the organization. Explore emerging analytical technologies, automation solutions, advanced data analytics and AI-assisted approaches. Depending on experience, progressively assume broader project coordination and leadership responsibilities. What Makes You The Right Fit Strong expertise in GC/GC-MS, with additional experience in LC/LC-MS. PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Natural Products Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. Proven ability to interpret complex analytical datasets and solve challenging scientific problems. Experience working with natural extracts, essential oils, botanical ingredients, flavors, fragrances, or other complex natural matrices. Knowledge of untargeted profiling, metabolomics, chemometrics and multivariate data analysis is highly valued. Demonstrated experience leading scientific projects or analytical workstreams within an R&D environment. Strong communication, collaboration and mentoring capabilities. Passion for staying close to experimental science while contributing to strategic project leadership. How Would You Stand Out? Naturally curious and driven by scientific discovery. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect data to business and innovation outcomes. Passion for exploring what lies beyond conventional analytical approaches. Interest in emerging technologies, digitalization, advanced analytics and AI applications. Comfortable working in a dynamic, collaborative and multidisciplinary environment. Ability to influence stakeholders through scientific rigor and clear communication. Why Choose Us? Opportunity to work at the forefront of natural ingredient innovation. Exposure to cutting-edge analytical technologies and data-driven scientific approaches. Collaborative international environment with world-class scientific experts. Ongoing learning and development opportunities. Chance to contribute directly to innovations that impact customers and consumers worldwide. We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. items.desc: PRÉSENTATION DE L'ENTREPRISE Siemens EDA est un leader technologique mondial en conception électronique assistée par ordinateur (EDA). Nos outils logiciels permettent aux entreprises du monde entier de développer des produits électroniques hautement innovants plus rapidement et de manière plus rentable. Nos clients utilisent nos outils pour repousser les limites de la technologie et de la physique et livrer de meilleurs produits dans le monde complexe de la conception de puces, de cartes et de systèmes. Description Du Poste Nous recherchons un Ingénieur R&D / Ingénieur Logiciel C++ pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique à Grenoble. Dans ce rôle, vous participerez à l'architecture et au développement de logiciels qui aident à commercialiser la prochaine génération de puces électroniques. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe talentueuse d'ingénieurs dans un environnement innovant et en croissance rapide où vos contributions impactent directement le succès de nos clients. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les ingénieurs produit et application pour harmoniser et optimiser notre environnement de développement et nos méthodologies de conception. RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES Participer à la collecte interne des exigences des clients. Soutenir et développer des solutions logicielles existantes et nouvelles. Travailler avec les ingénieurs produit et application pour harmoniser et optimiser l'environnement de développement et les méthodologies de conception. Qualifications Master ou doctorat en informatique ou génie logiciel avec une expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel et microélectronique. Expertise solide en langages de programmation C++ et Python avec une bonne connaissance des architectures logicielles orientées objet. Connaissance avancée des systèmes d'exploitation Linux, des langages de script associés (Tcl/Python) et des langages de description matérielle (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog, UPF). Excellentes compétences en communication (française et anglaise parlées et écrites) avec de fortes capacités analytiques, autonomie et approche orientée vers le travail d’équipe ; l'expérience en EDA ou microélectronique et les compétences DevOps sont un plus. POURQUOI NOUS Nous sommes Siemens : Chez Siemens Software, la flexibilité est notre façon de travailler—hybride par défaut, fondée sur la confiance et l'autonomie. Ensemble, 30 000 personnes dans plus de 200 pays construisent une technologie qui façonne le monde réel. Vous grandirez grâce à des projets concrets, des pairs techniques solides et la mobilité mondiale, soutenus par l'échelle et les avantages d'un leader du logiciel industriel. Nous nous engageons envers l'égalité et l'inclusion, et nous embauchons en fonction du mérite, des compétences et de l'impact. Apportez votre curiosité et votre créativité et aidez-nous à façonner demain ! NOS AVANTAGES & RÉMUNÉRATION La fourchette salariale pour ce poste est 64 000 à 82 500 EUR, et ce rôle est admissible à une rémunération incitative. La rémunération réelle offerte est basée sur les compétences liées au poste, l'expérience et la formation/éducation pertinente du candidat retenu. Siemens offre des avantages en matière de santé et de bien-être aux employés ; vous pouvez accéder aux avantages disponibles dans votre pays via le lien : https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/ DIVERSITÉ, ÉQUITÉ & INCLUSION Siemens est un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances. Nous célébrons la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Tous les candidats qualifiés recevront une considération égale pour l'emploi, sans distinction de race, couleur, religion, sexe, identité de genre, orientation sexuelle, origine nationale, âge, handicap ou statut de vétéran. Nous valorisons les perspectives diverses et cherchons activement à créer un environnement accueillant pour tous les employés, notamment les personnes noires, autochtones, les personnes de couleur (BIPOC), les femmes, les personnes LGBTQ+, les personnes en situation de handicap, les anciens combattants et d'autres membres de groupes sous-représentés. Nous fournissons des aménagements raisonnables aux candidats tout au long du processus de recrutement. Si vous avez besoin d'aménagements pour participer au processus d'entretien, veuillez nous contacter. Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

items.desc: About Lendable Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start: One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK Profitable since 2017 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot) So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting About The Team Lendable is the UK market leader in real rate risk-based pricing, offering consumers transparency and product assurance at the point of application. Data Science and Analytics sits at the heart of this, developing the credit risk models and strategies to underwrite loan and credit card products. Our team is primarily focused on the pricing domain but we also work on other areas including product and credit. We implement a range of machine learning techniques and analytical tools to continually improve our product offering. About The Role You will be working in the UK Loans team at Lendable and will work on projects related to pricing, funnel and credit optimisation in collaboration with the credit and product teams. items.desc: Embark your journey as a Quantitative Developer here at Barclays. Are you passionate about developing complex systems, and ready to make an impact in the world of securitisation and credit? Our QA Securitised Products/Credit Dev team is at the forefront of developing and implementing advanced models and analytics that power trading, risk management, and quantitative strategies across a diverse range of products. We support Credit and Securitisation businesses globally with cutting-edge tools for valuation, risk assessment, and portfolio optimization. Our global team collaborates closely with traders, risk managers, and technologists in London and New York to deliver top-tier quantitative solutions. To be successful as a Quantitative Developer, you should have: Excellent programming skills in C++ and scripting languages (Python). Experience working in a shared codebase within a multi-developer environment. Willingness to learn financial mathematics, with a preference for candidates who already have relevant knowledge. Willingness to gain expertise in the securitized products business. Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Experience of AI tooling (development of skills, workflows, MCP servers) Experience with building cross platform (Linux RHEL/Windows) applications and distributed systems (Symphony/Kafka/Redis) Experience with JIRA You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for this role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. This role is based in Prague. Entry Salary: Kč 1,000,000.00 Upper Salary: Kč 1,700,000.00 The entry and upper salary information above includes only annual full-time equivalent base salary and represents the typical range of pay for the role. The actual pay rate will reflect the responsibility level of the role and experience level of the individual. The entry and upper salary information does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available. Barclays employees are also eligible for a suite of competitive country-specific benefits. This position is eligible for an incentive award. Purpose of the role To provide quantitative and analytical expertise to support trading strategies, risk management, and decision-making within the investment banking domain, applying quantitative analysis, mathematical modelling, and technology to optimise trading and investment opportunities. Accountabilities Development and implementation of quantitative models and strategies to derive insight into market trends and optimize trading decisions, pricing, and risk management across various financial products and markets. Working closely with sales teams to identify clients' needs and develop customised solutions. In-depth research, data analysis, and statistical modelling to derive insights into market trends, pricing, and risk dynamics. Provide front office infrastructure support though ownership and maintenance of analytical libraries. Provision of expertise on quantitative methodologies, technological advancements, and industry best practices to drive innovation within the trading environment. Assistant Vice President Expectations To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness.
