items.desc:
Fedezd fel a benned rejlő lehetőségeket a KUKA-val 
 A KUKA számos lehetőséget kínál, melyek által előremozdíthatod karriered, átélheted álmaidat és kibontakozhat a benned rejlő potenciál. A világ egyik vezető automatizálási szakértői vagyunk, globális lehetőségeket kínálunk a robotika, automatizálás, logisztika, szoftvermegoldások és az elektronika területén. Ha motivált vagy, merész ambíciókkal és elképzelésekkel, aki hisz az együttműködésben és a kölcsönös tiszteletben, akkor a KUKA-nál biztos lehetsz a sikerben!
 Feladatok 
 A műszakban előírt gyártási, termelési feladatok ellátásának és a technológiai előírások betartásának ellenőrzése és irányítása. A gyártás előfeltételeinek megteremtése, a festőüzem és a gyártáshoz szükséges eszközök üzemképes állapotának ellenőrzése.
 A dolgozók irányítása, tevékenységeiknek összehangolása, a munka minőségének folyamatos ellenőrzése. A műszakban dolgozók tevékenységének felügyelete, munkabeosztásuk elkészítése, szabadságuk tervezése. Kapacitástervezés a munkaerő alkalmazásával összefüggésben.
 People management feladatok ellátása: munkavállalók teljesítményértékelése; elkötelezettség-fenntartó/növelő intézkedések, akciótervek megfogalmazása, megvalósításukban való aktív részvétel; csapattagok szakmai fejlődésének támogatása; toborzási és kiválasztási folyamatokban való aktív részvétel; motiváló, együttműködésre épülő csapatkultúra kialakítása és fenntartása; P&O (HR és munkaügyi) folyamatok támogatása a vállalati irányelveknek megfelelően.
 A termelési területéhez tartozó MES rendszer (valós időkönyvelési rendszer) adatainak, kimutatásainak elemzése, a feltárt fejlesztési lehetőségek és rendellenességek feldolgozása, visszajelzés a beosztott munkatársaknak, javító intézkedések végrehajtásnak felügyelete.
 A műszakban keletkezett problémák (selejtgyártás, géphiba és egyéb rendellenességek) okainak feltárása, visszajelzés a beosztott munkatársaknak, hibaelhárítás és megelőző intézkedések végrehajtása.
 A vállalati folyamatok alapos ismerete mellett felel e folyamatok betartásáért és betartatásáért.
 Társosztályokkal való aktív kapcsolattartás és együttműködés. Fejlesztési projektekben szakmai támogatóként való részvétel.
 A munkavédelmi, környezetvédelmi és tűzvédelmi előírások betartása és betartatása.
 Elvárások 
 legalább középfokú végzettség,
 minimum 3-5 év gyártóterületen, több fős csapat vezetésében szerzett tapasztalat,
 MS Office alapismeretek,
 vállalatirányítási rendszer (előny az SAP) felhasználói szintű ismerete,
 coaching szemléletű vezetői hozzáállás,
 erős problémamegoldó és döntéshozatali képesség,
 pontos, precíz, igényes munkavégzés,
 minőség iránti elkötelezettség,
 2 műszakos munkarend vállalása.
 Előny: porfestési technológiában szerzett jártasság, tapasztalat.
 Amit mi ígérünk 
 Kultúránk gyökere a robotika és a könnyű, felhasználóbarét automatizálási megoldások iránti szenvedélyünkben rejlik. Az eredmény? Világszerte egyszerűbbé és biztonságosabbá tesszük az emberek életét. Vállalatunk lelke a sokszínűség – nagyra értékelünk minden egyes ragyogó és merész ötletet. Mindenkit arra bíztatunk, hogy munkája során legyen teljesen önmaga, ezáltal egy olyan környezet tud létrejönni, ahol az inspiráció, a szakértelem és a személyes fejlődés kibontakozhat. Közös célunk? A nagyszerűség és az innovatív, pozitív változások beindítása és elérése – nem csak az automatizálási iparágon belül, hanem annak határain túl is.
 Juttatások és támogatások 
 Elkötelezettek vagyunk munkatársaink jóléte iránt, ezért juttatások széles skáláját biztosítjuk, a versenyképes juttatási csomagoktól a rugalmas munkarenden át a szakmai fejlődési lehetőségekig. Mindezzel célunk, hogy munkavállalóink elégedettek legyenek. Hiszünk abban, hogy munkatársaink elkötelezettségét és kemény munkáját elismerés illeti, és juttatásaink tükrözik ezt a hozzáállásunkat. Célunk, hogy olyan munkahelyet hozzunk létre, ahol az alkalmazottak értékesnek érzik magukat, inspiráltak és motiváltak, hogy a legjobbat hozzák ki magukból. Csatlakozz hozzánk, és élvezd az előnyeit egy olyan vállalatnak, amely a csapatának a jóllétét és fejlődését helyezi előtérbe!
 Sokszínűség, méltányosság és elfogadás 
 Alapvető meggyőződésünk, hogy kedvesen, nyitottan és kölcsönös tisztelettel egymás iránt egy olyan környezetet teremthetünk, ahol mindenki önmaga lehet a munkája során. 
 A KUKA az esélyegyenlőség iránt elkötelezett vállalat. Minden jelentkezést aprólékos gondossággal és odafigyeléssel kezelünk – olyan döntéshozatali folyamattal, amelyet nem befolyásol a származás, az iskolai végzettség, az életkor, a nem, a szexuális irányultság, továbbá a vallási vagy a politikai meggyőződés sem. Ha csatlakozol a KUKA-hoz, rengeteg lehetőséged lesz arra, hogy megoszd, mi motivál téged, és mi határozza meg egyéniségedet, ha szeretnéd.
 Csatlakozz az utazáshoz! 
 Ha úgy gondolod, hogy a KUKA által kínált karrier az, amit keresel, szívesen hallanánk felőled.
 Várjuk jelentkezésedet!

items.desc:
Where do people love what they do, and being great at what they do? 
 At Swisslog, that’s where! Our teams are the heart of a world-leading Robotics company that’s harnessing the power of technology to shape the future of intralogistics. The result? We’re transforming performance and efficiency for customers across the globe, giving them the vital edge in their markets.
 Make an impact 
 Resident Site Engineer, Castle Donnington. Working rotating 12-hour days and nights. Company benefits to include private healthcare and company contributory pension scheme. 
 Electrical and mechanical breakdown and planned preventative maintenance on a variety of automated machinery, to include wrappers; pallet conveyors; packaging machinery; pallet stacker cranes and robots. 
 Carry out automated materials handling equipment servicing, in accordance with quality standards. 
 Working with Siemens S7 and safety PLC's. 
 Always Comply with Health & Safety legislation. 
 Working at heights. 
 Prioritise system faults. 
 To always ensure quality of output. 
 To accurately record all work undertaken. 
 Involvement in continuous improvement projects. 
 What you need to succeed 
 Apprentice trained or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering. 
 Happy to work at heights. 
 This is a customer facing role, so you must be able to communicate effectively at all levels 
 An understanding of PLC systems is desirable. 
 Our promise to you 
 Swisslog is a world of opportunity for people who can deliver a game changing mission: driving the future of intralogistics, by shaping an era of robotic and data-driven automated solutions that create exceptional customer value.
 Join us on this journey and you’ll be part of a global enterprise that’s proud of its Swiss roots - and hugely excited by the worldwide opportunities open to everyone in the Swisslog family. So come and realize your potential, in a team that’s united by passion and driven by the OneSwisslog team spirit.
 About Swisslog 
 Swisslog is shaping the future of intralogistics. As part of the KUKA Group, we work on the latest technologies that are reimagining the world of logistics. We’re a team of 3,000+ experts from 50 countries, serving some of the world's largest and most exciting brands. Together, we’re implementing smart and innovative approaches - including flexible robot-based and data-driven automation solutions that are transforming the supply chain. So join our team and share your unique perspective.
 Join the journey! 
 If you think a career with Swisslog could be what you are looking for, we´d love to hear from you.
 We´re looking forward to receiving your application!

items.desc:
Widen Your Horizons. Join the Next Chapter of Your Career 
 At EssilorLuxottica, we are committed to empowering our people to grow and succeed. This is your opportunity to take your career to the next level, embrace new challenges, and continue making a difference. 
 We work for a brighter future, thinking today about the world of tomorrow. ​ 
 Don’t miss the chance to shape your #FutureInSight with us! 
 Your role 
 Study mass production plating and painting equipment; 
 Learn key factors of painting processes; 
 Support production output and industrialization process. 
 Plan and support maintenance execution on key machines (DURR); 
 Run test for quality improvement; 
 Analyze production processes, schedules, methods, and other data and then provide business leaders with reports containing the data and statistics to enable them to better understand future requirements needed for the manufacturing process. 
 Process measurement (OEE, capabilities, cycle time, balancing, desaturation) 
 Benchmarking with other surface treatment technologies inside Essilorluxottica; 
 Learn and support painting department’s automation processes. 
 Main requirements: 
 You have a Degree in Chemical or Materials Engineering
 You have strong Project Management skills.
 You have good knowledge of Ms Office (in particular Excel and Power Point)
 You are a flexible person, able to adapt in a contest of constant change
 You have strong facilitation and communication skills
 You love challenges and you take your responsibility seriously
 You are looking for a shopfloor experience and you give your best when you work in team
 You are searching for learning by doing experience
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitment​ 
 We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and provide equal opportunities to all, regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

 Overview 
 Entrerai nel Servizio Sistemi di Pagamento, all'interno di una struttura dedicata alla gestione e al presidio di applicazioni mission-critical operative 24/7. Ti occuperai del monitoraggio, della gestione e della manutenzione applicativa dei sistemi a supporto dei processi di pagamento, garantendone continuità operativa, stabilità e adeguate performance. Collaborerai con team tecnici e funzionali in contesti complessi, contribuendo alla risoluzione delle anomalie, all'analisi dei problemi e all'evoluzione dei servizi applicativi. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Monitorare le applicazioni e gestire incidenti e anomalie, garantendo la continuità operativa dei servizi 
 Analizzare e risolvere problematiche applicative su architetture legacy e cloud 
 Eseguire attività di manutenzione applicativa correttiva ed evolutiva 
 Supportare i processi di change management e le attività di rilascio in produzione 
 Collaborare con team interni e coordinarsi con fornitori esterni e partner internazionali 
 Supportare la gestione di applicazioni ad alto volume transazionale, nel rispetto delle finestre operative critiche 
 Contribuire al miglioramento delle performance, della stabilità e dell'affidabilità dei sistemi attraverso attività di analisi e ottimizzazione 
 Garantire il rispetto degli standard aziendali e delle policy in materia di Cybersecurity, Privacy e Data Management 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 Esperienza di 3-5 anni nella manutenzione applicativa/system analysis di sistemi IT complessi 
 Laurea in Informatica, discipline quantitative o titolo equivalente 
 Conoscenza di Java 
 Conoscenza di architetture applicative Oracle WebLogic based 
 Conoscenza di db 
 Conoscenza di OpenShift e Kubernetes 
 Conoscenza dei processi di incident management, problem management, monitoring e change management 
 Conoscenza delle tecniche di analisi e troubleshooting applicate a sistemi IT complessi 
 Gestione di applicazioni operative 24/7 
 Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese scritta e parlata
 Costituiscono un plus: 
 Esperienza nella gestione di applicazioni ad alto volume transazionale operanti in contesti con finestre operative critiche 
 Conoscenza delle metodologie Agile e ITIL, delle pratiche DevOps e degli strumenti CI/CD 
 Esperienza nell'utilizzo di sistemi di AI per l'analisi degli incidenti applicativi 
 Significative esperienze professionali o di studio in contesti internazionali 
 Cosa ti offriamo 
 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 40.000 € 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo 
 Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello 
 Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone 
 Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli 
 Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile e alla settimana corta 4x9 
 Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link ) 
 Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione 
 Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 L’Area Chief Data, A.I. & Technology Officer è la realtà IT del Gruppo che coniuga l’agilità di una fintech con la solidità di un grande gruppo; avrai l'opportunità di lavorare in un contesto innovativo con tecnologie all’avanguardia e con forte spinta alla trasformazione digitale. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03.

 Pružanje profesionalne usluge klijentima o bankarskim proizvodima i uslugama.
 Identificiranje i razumijevanje financijskih potreba klijenata te pružanje stručnih savjeta i rješenja.
 Obavljanje transakcija i mjenjačkih poslova - rad s gotovinom.
 Aktivno sudjelovanje u postizanju prodajnih ciljeva.
 Svakodnevna suradnja s kolegama iz različitih dijelova Banke i timski rad.

 Razvijene komunikacijske vještine.
 Preciznost i posvećenost detaljima.
 Visoka razina stručnosti i predanosti pružanju vrhunske usluge klijentima i prodajne vještine.

 Menadžer za odnose s klijentima/Stručni suradnik (m/ž) u SB centru Slavonija 
 (mjesto rada Osijek) 
 Radno mjesto obuhvaća cjelokupan proces prodaje, preciznije: 
 direktnu prodaju rizičnih i nerizičnih proizvoda mikro poduzećima i obrtnicima 
 poslove platnog prometa te podršku prodaji 
 kontaktiranje i akviziciju novih klijenata 
 praćenje odnosa s klijentom – brigu o postojećem portfelju klijenata 
 prikupljanje dokumentacije i obradu zahtjeva za rizične proizvode 
 pisanje kreditnih prijedloga 
 administraciju odgovarajuće (ugovorne i ostale) dokumentacije 
 izradu planova i provedbu naplate dospjelih nenaplaćenih potraživanja 
 Formalni uvjeti koje kandidati trebaju zadovoljavati su sljedeći: 
 VSS/VŠS ekonomskog usmjerenja 
 2 godine radnog iskustva u bankarskom/financijskom sektoru 
 iskustvo rada sa klijentima 
 aktivno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu 
 Uz izraženu želju za radom u dinamičnom okruženju, idealni kandidati posjeduju: 
 razvijene prodajne i komunikacijske vještine 
 analitičke vještine 
 sklonost timskom radu 
 sigurnost i proaktivnost u nastupu 
 organiziranost i sistematičnost 
 mobilnost 
 Što nudimo? 
 Mogućnost napretka u karijeri i profesionalno usavršavanje 
 dinamično i motivirajuće okruženje 
 izazovni projekti 
 stručni tečajevi, seminari, interni razvojni moduli 
 Ravnotežu poslovnog i privatnog života te brigu za zaposlenike 
 r ad izvan poslovnog prostora 
 sistematski pregled svake dvije godine 
 korporativni vrtić uz subvenciju 
 slobodan dan za rođendan 
 sportska udruga PBZ standard i MultiSport kartica 
 PBZ book club 
 Prigodne nagrade, dar djetetu, novčane nagrade 
 o karijeri u PBZ grupi više možete pročitati i na našim korporativnim stranicama 
 Zainteresirane kandidate pozivamo da se prijave za otvorenu poziciju najkasnije do nedjelje, 25. listopada 2026.

We genuinely care about your work-life balance by providing significant flexibility in terms of working hours.

 We're looking for a detail-oriented professional with strong organizational abilities and able to communicate effectively with stakeholders. We value individuals who bring a positive attitude, customer focus, and analytical thinking to their work.

 Proficiency in English (reading, written and verbal)

 Ability to work both independently and collaboratively while prioritizing and multitasking in a fast-paced environment 
 Strong analytical and organizational skills 
 Excellent customer focus and can-do mindset 
 Digital literacy and experience with MS Office Package 
 These are additional nice to haves: 
 Knowledge and understanding of (re)insurance products and business 
 Proficiency in any other European language

 About the job
 As a Local Privacy Officer (LPO) , you will be a strategic business partner responsible for protecting data subjects rights and freedoms, enabling data-driven innovation within Sanofi and maximizing business opportunities. You will lead the implementation of the Privacy operating model, balancing robust data protection with business growth opportunities in an increasingly complex privacy landscape. This role requires you to address critical privacy risk areas, implement privacy maturity at all levels of the company, generate trust and transparency while enabling the business to deliver according to its objectives.
 Acting as a force of proposal you'll have to proactively contribute to a robust data governance while having a thoughtful risk-based approach. You will manage local privacy initiatives while contributing to global and regional projects, ensuring compliance with evolving privacy regulations and championing privacy-by-design principles in an increasingly AI-driven environment.
 Key Accountability
 Prevent Privacy Risks
 Develop and maintain a comprehensive local privacy risk assessment framework that addresses business maturity and ownership, and promotes the effective implementation of the privacy operating model among leadership team members and key stakeholders
 Understand, map and become familiar with business strategy and activities to proactively support their deployment while mitigating privacy risks
 Appoint and lead the Local Privacy champions' network to implement in a proactive way privacy strategy and priorities
 Monitor and analyze local privacy regulations, AI regulatory developments, and enforcement trends and document & implement local variations of global procedures when required by local laws
 Contribute to global position papers, develop and maintain external network with public authorities and other privacy networks, represent Sanofi in industry advocacy efforts to enhance transparency and build trust with internal and external stakeholders
 Actively contribute to transformation initiatives impacting both the business the privacy operating model
 Implement privacy-by-design principles in both local and global projects, with a focus on emerging technologies, innovation, data security and data democratization
 In accordance with the Global Privacy maturity framework, provide periodic reports to map existing and emerging privacy risks
 Provide periodic reports to the Italy Leadership Team to map existing and emerging privacy risks, in accordance with the Global Privacy maturity framework
 Adapt global privacy templates and procedures to local requirements while maintaining consistency, including vendor management due diligence, oversight and monitoring
 Monitor and assess data sovereignty regulatory developments across jurisdictions relevant to Italy, including cross-border transfer requirements, and escalate identified risks to the relevant governance bodies
 Implement and promote Data Sovereignty by Design principles in local and regional projects, ensuring that data sovereignty risk screening is integrated into business transition and transformation design processes, in alignment with the Data Compass framework and the data transfer compliance routes
 Monitor and analyze AI regulatory developments, including the EU AI Act, and their intersection with data protection law (GDPR), to proactively identify and mitigate privacy risks arising from AI systems, automated decision-making (ADM), and profiling activities deployed locally or globally impacting data subjects in Italy
 Integrate AI and ADM risk considerations into the local privacy risk assessment framework, ensuring that high-risk AI systems and profiling activities are subject to appropriate Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and, where required, prior consultation with the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali
 Protect Fundamental Rights and Sanofi's Interests
 Oversee the mapping and maintenance of local personal data processing activities, and ensuring transparency and effectiveness in data handling practices
 Perform, review and validate accuracy of local privacy, assets and vendors assessments to protect individual rights and freedoms and to protect Sanofi's liability, reputation and license to operate
 Manage data subject rights requests and personal data breaches promptly and effectively to maintain trust and prevent business issues and disruptions

 Description and Requirements
 Quer fazer parte da Endesa? 
 O que é feito na área? 
 O Responsável Territorial de Segurança tem como missão garantir a proteção das pessoas, dos ativos, das infraestruturas e a continuidade das atividades da Endesa na área geográfica sob a sua responsabilidade, assegurando o cumprimento dos padrões corporativos, dos requisitos legais e das obrigações regulamentares aplicáveis. 
 A unidade é responsável pela gestão integral da segurança física das instalações, incluindo a supervisão dos serviços de vigilância, dos sistemas eletrónicos de segurança e de controlo de acessos, a gestão de incidentes, a coordenação das atuações em situações de emergência ou de crise e a implementação de medidas de proteção adequadas ao nível de risco de cada instalação. 
 Além disso, mantém uma estreita colaboração com as diferentes áreas de negócio da empresa, as autoridades competentes e as Forças e Serviços de Segurança, especialmente nas infraestruturas consideradas críticas ou essenciais para a prestação de serviços à população. 
 Entre as suas funções encontram-se a supervisão de contratos e fornecedores de segurança, o controlo orçamental dos serviços sob a sua responsabilidade, a elaboração e atualização de procedimentos operacionais, a avaliação de riscos, a realização de auditorias e o acompanhamento de planos de melhoria destinados a garantir um nível de proteção adequado e uniforme em todo o território. 
 A unidade atua como referência territorial em matéria de segurança corporativa, prestando apoio técnico e operacional às diferentes áreas de negócio e contribuindo para a resiliência e continuidade das operações da empresa. 
 Responsabilidades da Função: 
 Gerir a segurança física das instalações, ativos e pessoas no âmbito territorial atribuído; 
 Coordenar a implementação, manutenção e melhoria das medidas de proteção aplicáveis às infraestruturas e instalações da empresa; 
 Supervisionar os serviços de vigilância, supervisão territorial, centrais recetoras de alarmes e restantes fornecedores de segurança; 
 Gerir incidentes de segurança, coordenando a resposta operacional e as medidas de mitigação necessárias para garantir a continuidade das operações; 
 Manter a relação operacional com as autoridades competentes e com as Forças e Serviços de Segurança, colaborando em investigações, ocorrências e ações preventivas; 
 Participar na gestão de emergências e crises, integrando os mecanismos corporativos de resposta sempre que necessário; 
 Elaborar, atualizar e implementar procedimentos, planos de proteção, avaliações de risco e medidas de segurança adaptadas às necessidades do território; 
 Supervisionar o correto funcionamento e manutenção dos sistemas eletrónicos de segurança, videovigilância, deteção de intrusão e controlo de acessos; 
 Controlar a qualidade dos serviços contratados, verificando o cumprimento dos acordos de nível de serviço, das especificações técnicas e dos requisitos regulamentares aplicáveis; 
 Gerir e controlar o orçamento de segurança atribuído ao território, incluindo a certificação dos serviços prestados e o acompanhamento dos custos; 
 Realizar auditorias, inspeções e atividades de controlo para assegurar o cumprimento das políticas corporativas e da legislação aplicável; 
 Prestar aconselhamento técnico em matéria de segurança às diferentes áreas de negócio e colaborar em projetos relacionados com a proteção dos ativos e a continuidade operacional; 
 Uma parte do trabalho será dedicada ao cumprimento da regulamentação de cibersegurança NIS, atuando como ponto de contacto com a autoridade competente, bem como coordenando a investigação e gestão de incidentes relacionados com esta regulamentação e a coordenação das respetivas ações, em colaboração com as áreas envolvidas.

items.desc: AI macht uns schneller. Das Denken nimmt sie uns nicht ab. Was AI produziert, überprüfen wir. Für alles, was rausgeht, stehen wir gerade. Beim Ausprobieren sind wir schnell, beim Ausliefern gründlich. Du liest ein Paper und willst wissen, ob die Idee hält. Also klonst du das Repo. Läuft es nicht, folgst du dem Stacktrace in den Quellcode. Und widersprechen die Daten deiner Hypothese, stutzt du kurz und freust dich: Jetzt wird es interessant. Ein schönes Ergebnis macht dich dagegen erst mal misstrauisch. Zufall? Bug? Oder hält es? Bei smartclip arbeitest du mit Messdaten von Dutzenden Millionen Geräten, eigener GPU-Infrastruktur und Sidekicks, unserer AI-Initiative für Wissensfragen und echte Workflows. Du verantwortest deine Fragestellung vom ersten Experiment bis zum belastbaren Prototyp. Den baut Engineering mit dir zum Produkt aus. Unser Stack basiert auf Linux, Open Source und freier Software. Du kannst nachvollziehen, was unter der Haube passiert. Deine Mission Eine Stelle, zwei Schwerpunkte. Ob du einen vertiefst oder beide, entscheiden dein Können und deine Vorlieben. AI gehört immer dazu. 1. Knowledge Agents & Agentic Retrieval Wie beantwortet ein Agent eine Frage, deren Antwort über Tausende Dokumente verteilt ist? Wie erkennt er Widersprüche zwischen Entwürfen und finalen Fassungen? Und wie belegt er seine Antworten zuverlässig? Entwickle Agenten, die Informationen über große Dokumentbestände hinweg erschließen. Untersuche, wie sich Vollständigkeit, Widersprüche und die Qualität von Quellen bewerten lassen. Sorge dafür, dass Antworten nachvollziehbar bleiben und Unsicherheiten sichtbar werden. 2. Machine Learning at Scale Wir messen das Werbegeschehen bei mehr als 150 TV-Sendern in Europa. Unser Ziel: lineares Fernsehen so planbar und messbar machen wie digitale Werbung. Entwickle Prognosemodelle für die Leistung von Werbeblöcken. Bewerte Unsicherheiten, Messfehler und die Aussagekraft deiner Modelle. Verarbeite große Datenmengen mit Spark auf unserem Cluster und untersuche, wo Datenqualität oder Verarbeitung die Ergebnisse beeinflussen. In beiden Bereichen machst du aus einer guten Frage etwas, das läuft: Experimentiere und evaluiere: Formuliere Hypothesen, entwirf aussagekräftige Tests und lerne aus Ergebnissen, auch wenn diese nicht deine Erwartungen erfüllen. Übernimm Verantwortung: Entwickle deinen Ansatz eigenständig bis zum belastbaren Prototyp. Hol dir einen zweiten Blick oder denk mit deinem Team am Whiteboard weiter. Arbeite mit Engineering: Begleite die Überführung deines Prototyps in ein Produkt und bringe dein Wissen über Problem und Lösung ein. Unterstütze andere Teams: Bewerte Datenfragen, zeige sinnvolle Einsatzmöglichkeiten von AI auf und liefere je nach Bedarf eine fundierte Empfehlung oder einen Prototyp. Deine Skills Fundierte technische Grundlagen: Bring Kenntnisse in Informatik, Softwareentwicklung oder Data Science mit – erworben durch Studium, Promotion oder praktische Erfahrung. Du kannst deine Methodenwahl begründen und Ergebnisse kritisch bewerten. Verständnis für AI: Du musst keine Modelle in PyTorch trainieren. Du kannst aber den Unterschied zwischen Prefill und Decode erklären und wie dieser für Latenz und Kosten relevant ist. Eigenständiges AI-native Development: Nutze Coding-Agenten, um schneller zu entwickeln. Validiere den generierten Code, teste die Ergebnisse und verstehe, wie deine Anwendung und ihre Komponenten funktionieren. Strukturiertes Experimentieren: Formuliere klare Specs, definiere eine Definition of Done und prüfe mit passenden Tests und Evaluationen, ob deine Umsetzung das richtige Problem löst. Offene Zusammenarbeit: Teile Wissen, diskutiere technische Entscheidungen und gib respektvolles, direktes Feedback. Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erfahrung mit NLP/Computerlinguistik, Agentic Retrieval oder der Entwicklung von LLM-Agenten. Unser Stack Knowledge Agents: Python (Pydantic AI), TypeScript, vLLM/SGLang Daten und Pipelines: Spark, Trino, StarRocks, Postgres und Prefect Infrastruktur und Observability: OpenTelemetry, Docker/Kubernetes Kennst du eher Ray, LangChain, Airflow, passt das genauso: Die Konzepte zählen, nicht die Logos. Was dich bei uns erwartet Remote Work mit gezielten Treffen: Wir arbeiten überwiegend remote und kommen gelegentlich für Workshops, Team-Sessions und den gemeinsamen Austausch in unserem Tech-Office in Berlin zusammen. Außerdem veranstalten wir über das Jahr verteilt Team-Events, darunter unser jährliches Company Offsite, das jedes Jahr an einer anderen Location in Deutschland stattfindet. Die Bereitschaft, für diese Treffen anzureisen und daran teilzunehmen, gehört zur Rolle. Eigenverantwortung statt Mikromanagement: Übernimm Verantwortung für deine Themen und bringe sie selbstständig voran. Build > Talk: Früh ausprobieren, früh danebenliegen, früh dazulernen. Hohe Ansprüche, wenig Ego: Wir geben direktes Feedback und arbeiten offen und respektvoll zusammen. Weiterentwicklung: Nutze Hackathons, Konferenzen und …

items.desc: Bouw mee aan data- en AI-oplossingen met maatschappelijke impact. 32 - 40 uur per week HBO / WO werk- en denkniveau Wat jij gaat doen Bij Axendo ontwikkelen we digitale oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt door scholen, overheden, zorgorganisaties en maatschappelijke instellingen. Met onze platformen, portalen en maatwerkapplicaties helpen we organisaties efficiënter werken en meer impact maken. Data en AI spelen daarin een steeds grotere rol. Daarom zoeken we voor ons AI-team een data scientist / engineer. Je werkt op het snijvlak van Data Engineering, Data Science en Artificial Intelligence. Je zorgt dat data uit verschillende systemen betrouwbaar en bruikbaar beschikbaar komt, onderzoekt wat die data ons kan vertellen en vertaalt dit naar slimme toepassingen. Dat kan gaan om voorspellende modellen en slimme analyses, maar ook om AI-assistenten, intelligente zoekoplossingen, RAG-toepassingen en agents die informatie combineren, gebruikmaken van verschillende tools en zelfstandig onderdelen van bedrijfsprocessen kunnen uitvoeren. Jouw rol Als Data & AI Engineer werk je aan het volledige traject van ruwe data naar een werkende data- of AI-oplossing. Je ontsluit en structureert data uit bijvoorbeeld databases, API's, documenten, SharePoint-omgevingen en andere bedrijfssystemen. Je onderzoekt datasets, zoekt naar patronen en verbanden en bepaalt welke technieken geschikt zijn om een vraagstuk op te lossen. Afhankelijk van het probleem werk je met statistische analyses, Machine Learning, voorspellende modellen of Generative AI. Je ontwikkelt bijvoorbeeld een classificatie- of voorspellingsmodel, onderzoekt afwijkend gedrag in datasets of bouwt een oplossing met Large Language Models, vector search en RAG. Een onderdeel is het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI-agents. Je bouwt agents die niet alleen informatie genereren, maar ook gebruikmaken van tools, API's en bestaande systemen om acties uit te voeren. Denk aan agents die informatie ophalen uit meerdere databronnen, documenten verwerken, processen starten of ondersteunen en samenwerken met andere agents of applicaties. Daarbij gaat het niet alleen om het bouwen van een prototype. Je denkt ook na over orchestration, rechten, logging, evaluatie, guardrails, human-in-the-loop en hoe een agent veilig en betrouwbaar onderdeel wordt van een bestaande applicatie of bedrijfsproces. Je werkt nauw samen met onze developers, cloud-specialisten en collega's binnen het AI-team. Samen onderzoeken we hoe we data en nieuwe AI-technologie praktisch kunnen inzetten binnen onze eigen producten en de digitale oplossingen van onze klanten. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Je ontsluit, structureert en verwerkt data uit verschillende databronnen en systemen. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt data pipelines en integraties. Je analyseert datasets en ontdekt patronen, trends, correlaties en afwijkingen. Je bouwt rapportages en dashboards in Microsoft Power BI om inzichten helder en bruikbaar te presenteren. Je ontwikkelt en evalueert Machine Learning-modellen voor bijvoorbeeld voorspelling, classificatie, segmentatie en anomaliedetectie. Je bouwt AI-oplossingen met LLM's, RAG, embeddings en vector search. Je ontwikkelt en implementeert AI-agents die gebruikmaken van tools, API's en bestaande systemen. Je koppelt agents aan bedrijfsprocessen en zorgt voor orchestration, logging, evaluatie, guardrails en human-in-the-loop. Je integreert data- en AI-functionaliteit in websites, platformen en applicaties. Je ontwikkelt API's en services waarmee data, modellen en AI-functionaliteit beschikbaar worden gemaakt. Je test en evalueert oplossingen op kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid, performance en kosten. Je denkt mee over datakwaliteit, security, privacy, governance en verantwoord gebruik van AI. Je zorgt samen met developers voor productieklare oplossingen via versiebeheer, CI/CD, monitoring en automatisering. Je deelt je kennis en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Data & AI binnen Axendo. Wie zoeken we? We zoeken iemand die analytisch én technisch sterk is en het leuk vindt om nieuwe dingen te bouwen. Je hebt ervaring met Python, SQL en data-analyse en begrijpt de basis van statistiek en Machine Learning. Je bent gewend om met API's, databases en Microsoft Azure-omgevingen te werken en hebt interesse in of ervaring met Generative AI, LLM's en agents. Je vindt het interessant om nieuwe technologie te onderzoeken, maar kijkt verder dan een demo: je wilt oplossingen bouwen die betrouwbaar, veilig en onderhoudbaar in productie kunnen worden gebruikt. Je hoeft niet alles al te beheersen. Data Engineering en Data Science zijn brede vakgebieden. Technisch inzicht, analytisch vermogen en nieuwsgierigheid vinden we minstens zo belangrijk als ervaring met iedere techniek uit onze stack. Je hebt HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau, spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels en bent 32 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar. Wat bieden wij jou? Een functie waarin Data, Data Science en AI daadwerkelijk …

items.desc: Job Title AI UX Designer Design the future of airport experiences — where human insight meets artificial intelligence. At Amadeus, we’re reimagining how travelers interact with airport technologies — from check-in kiosks to boarding gates. As a Senior AI UX Designer, you’ll play a key role in shaping intuitive and efficient user experiences for millions of passengers worldwide. You’ll use artificial intelligence as a creative companion — accelerating prototyping, ideation, and testing — to bring smarter, faster, and more connected travel solutions to life. Join a global team where design, technology, and innovation come together to transform the travel of tomorrow. In this role, you'll Design user experiences for airport and passenger-facing products such as kiosks, boarding systems, and self-service touchpoints. Use AI tools, agents, and automation workflows to enhance productivity, prototyping, and concept exploration in the UX process. Conduct user research, interviews, and journey mapping to ensure designs meet traveler, business, and technical needs. Create low- and high-fidelity prototypes using tools like Figma and other AI-assisted design platforms. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX and 3D Designers, R&D Engineers, and AI specialists throughout the design lifecycle. Document workflows, principles, and best practices for AI-assisted UX design and share knowledge with global design teams. Present concepts, insights, and recommendations through clear storytelling and visual communication. Stay up to date with new AI design tools, trends, and workflows that enhance efficiency and creative exploration. Participate in cross-functional workshops and ideation sessions focused on the passenger experience. About the ideal candidate Experienced UX professional (typically 6 years) with a strong foundation in user-centered design and experience creating complex digital interfaces. Skilled in research, prototyping, usability testing, and design documentation using Figma or similar tools. Experienced in using AI tools or agents to accelerate creative work, automate tasks, or explore design alternatives. Proactive and curious about integrating AI ethically and meaningfully into design processes. Strong storytelling and collaboration skills, able to communicate ideas effectively across diverse technical and design teams. Comfortable working in evolving, multidisciplinary, and global environments. Fluent in English; other languages are an advantage in a global environment. Willingness to travel occasionally for user research, testing, and collaboration activities at airports or innovation centers. What we can offer you A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture. Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues. A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment. A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them. A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization. A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees. A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose. #LI-EMEA Diversity & Inclusion Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law. Be aware of recruitment scams Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

items.card: The Role: We are looking for strong engineers with experience and interest in designing, building, and maintaining the novel, high-performance systems that make up our serverless platform. Specifically, you'll be working on the distributed object storage system that underpins every container image, volume, and checkpoint on Modal: hundreds of petabytes of data, replicated across multiple cloud object stores and a
items.desc: Location Stockholm Employment Type Full time Department Engineering Compensation $250K – $300K About Us: AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal. Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now. Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale. We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation. Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn,Luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience. The Role: We are looking for strong engineers with experience and interest in designing, building, and maintaining the novel, high-performance systems that make up our serverless platform. Specifically, you'll be working on the distributed object storage system that underpins every container image, volume, and checkpoint on Modal: hundreds of petabytes of data, replicated across multiple cloud object stores and a CDN, cached on local NVMe across a large fleet of workers in many datacenters, and shared peer-to-peer within each datacenter. You'll make cold starts feel local when the data is hundreds of milliseconds away, designing the caching, preloading, and peer-to-peer layers that hide object-store latency and keep public ingress off saturated uplinks. You'll own durability and cost at petabyte scale, from streaming and batch replication between origins, to garbage collection over billions of objects. You'll work across the stack, from local disk and page cache to distributed blob storage and garbage collection and you'll help shape what storage becomes next as we push storage closer to workloads. Requirements: 5+ years of experience writing high-quality production code Experience building high-performance distributed storage or caching systems at a large scale (the more challenges you've worked through, the better) Strong cloud skills, including deep familiarity with object storage (S3 or similar), CDNs, and their consistency, throughput, and cost characteristics Strong knowledge of low-level operating system foundations (Linux kernel, file systems, page cache, containers, etc.) Willingness to step into the thick of it with our on-call rotation and respond to production incidents Nice-to-Haves: Experience with replication, content addressing, and consistency models in multi-region or multi-cloud systems Experience operating storage systems at scale (petabyte-scale datasets, high-throughput read/write paths, large-scale garbage collection or data migration) Experience with data engineering at petabyte-scale. Prior experience with Rust Key Things the Team Is Working On: P2P sharing of data across workers within a single datacenter to dramatically reduce ingress Replicating data across multiple blob storage providers Automating garbage collection across hundreds of petabytes of data Deploying colocated storage clusters to datacenters to accelerate high-throughput customer workloads Compensation Range: $250K - $300K

items.desc: Business Unit: Otto Bock Patient Care, LLC Location: Remote, PA, US Contract Type: regular Scope of employment: full-time Contact Person: Contact Information: Job ID: 8702 Summary Statement Ability Prosthetics & Orthotics has served patients in Pennsylvania and Maryland for decades. Known for our personal touch, clinical expertise, and community involvement, we've built a reputation for care that goes beyond the device. Today, as part of Ottobock.care, we continue that legacy—combining the strength of a global innovator with the relationships and responsiveness of a local clinic. This next step deepens our commitment to delivering exceptional orthotic and prosthetic care to the communities we serve. We are currently looking for a Verification of Benefits & Prior Authorization Coordinator to support our clinics in Pennsylvania and Maryland. The VOB Auth Coordinator is responsible for the accurate and timely completion of all prior authorization requirements for patients across the company. This person will also support verification of benefits as needed. Duties & Responsibilities Perform insurance verifications and authorizations for orthotic and/or prosthetic devices to ensure coverage for each code used for each device ordered for a patient. Collaborate with other team members and communicate requirements pertaining to their patient’s insurance coverage. Communicate accurate benefits to the patient or applicable customer. Explain co-insurance and deductible amounts to patient or applicable customer and collect if possible. Process all authorization requests that are required by the patient’s insurance carrier through live communication via phone with carrier’s or using insurance carrier online portals to obtain the most up to date benefit information. Create patient account profile in the Medical Record system, manage the collection of medical documentation required to secure authorization for patient cases across all offices, and update patient file with appropriate notes accordingly. Communicate any changes in requirements for verification or authorization by insurance carriers to manager for training and compliance updates. Answer calls in a timely and professional manner and provide excellent customer service. Participate in training programs for continuing learning and development. Comply with Corporate Compliance and HIPAA responsibilities. Observe and communicate to management any opportunities to streamline processes and improve efficiency in day-to-day operations. Perform other duties and special projects as assigned. Qualifications Ability to work independently. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks to completion. Développer les collaborations institutionnelles et académiques, et identifier de nouvelles opportunités de recherche. 2. items.desc: Your role The Beyond Air Task Force is responsible for developing and maintaining new compression technologies for gas applications. Our activities range from initiating completely new developments to upgrading existing products, as well as exploring innovations together with internal stakeholders, R&D cells, and external partners. The team manages the entire process from product strategy, design, and testing through to operations and customer delivery. To further strengthen our innovation capabilities, we are now looking for a Technology Developer. In this expert role, you act as a key technical authority in the development of advanced gas compressor technologies, with a strong emphasis on thermodynamics, modelling, and first-principles engineering. You perform in-depth thermodynamic analyses and system-level calculations to assess performance, efficiency, and operational limits, forming the backbone of technology development and design decisions. You develop advanced analytical and numerical models to simulate compressor behavior across a wide range of gases and operating conditions. You validate and continuously improve these models using experimental data, ensuring strong alignment between simulation and real performance. Based on your expertise, you define critical operating scenarios and boundary conditions, applying engineering judgement to evaluate performance limits and risks. In addition, you define and drive the technology roadmap, translating deep technical insights into clear development directions. You lead and contribute to BDC activities, providing technical direction, consolidating knowledge, and supporting key strategic decisions. Join us in developing the highly technological oil-injected screw (OIS) compressor, the heart of our best-in-class compressor units converting mechanical energy to compressed air. You (and the project team) will define the development of products from the first prototype to serial production. You will be responsible for technology development and advancing specific knowledge domains. Product development, modelling (digital twin), simulations, testing, data processing and manufacturing are mainly done on site in Wilrijk. This means you will have hands-on experience with the products and will also work outside of a traditional desk environment. The oil-injected screw product development team consists of project leaders, designers, technology engineers dedicated to the development on state-of-the-art compressor elements. Atlas Copco has a strong focus on sustainability where you will have many learning possibilities and get the chance to work on making more efficient and sustainable products in a high impact industry sector. Your responsibilities will be: Extensive research, simulations, calculations and modelling on components or subsystems of compressors. Identify key decisions and devise/execute a test plan to answer knowledge gaps. Ensure the implementation of new concepts as part of new product development projects. Acquire the relevant knowledge from internal and external stakeholders Follow up the technology evolution for specific compressor types and subsystems. You have a strong technical background, preferably in engineering, supported by excellent analytical skills to solve complex technical problems. Broad knowledge of mechanical engineering, thermodynamics and fluid dynamics. You can work on multi-disciplinary problems, dive deep into the details of a problem, while keeping an overview of the bigger picture. Experience in oil-injected screw compressors or compressors in general is a plus but not required. Experience as project member or leader in product development projects is a plus. You can work in an international environment. Good communication skills and English proficiency are required, communication skills in Dutch are a plus. In return, we offer you At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning. You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. items.desc: Your role Our experienced team develops centrifugal compressors that are used worldwide. We pride ourselves on delivering some of the most energy-efficient compressor solutions on the market. With rated powers of up to 6300 kW per compressor, even small improvements can have a significant impact on energy consumption and sustainability. Besides product development, we continuously invest in research and technology development to remain at the forefront of our industry. Our projects range from clean-sheet product development to upgrades of existing products and disruptive innovations in collaboration with universities, research institutes and industrial partners. We are passionate about technology and continuously push boundaries through advanced engineering methods, multidisciplinary optimization and close collaboration across departments and regions. Working in our team means contributing directly to a more sustainable future while continuously learning and growing as an engineer. As a Mechanical Engineer – Centrifugal Compressors, you will play a key role in the development of next-generation centrifugal compressor technologies and products. You will work closely with specialists from various engineering disciplines throughout the complete product development cycle: from concept generation and technology development to prototype validation, product release and field support. You combine strong analytical skills with sound engineering judgment. You are able to translate complex technical challenges into robust and practical design solutions. You can independently evaluate design concepts, identify risks, challenge assumptions and contribute to well-founded engineering decisions. Mechanical design and analysis are at the core of your expertise. You are comfortable sizing and validating critical rotating equipment components such as shafts, gears, rolling-element bearings and hydrodynamic bearings. You are experienced in performing engineering calculations, finite element analyses and rotor dynamic assessments to ensure reliable and performant product designs. You also enjoy working on complex engineering challenges and are not afraid to get hands-on when needed. Whether supporting prototype assembly, investigating field failures or validating a new design concept, you are driven by understanding how things work and how they can be improved. You have a structured and detail-oriented approach to engineering. You understand the importance of product architecture, configuration control and design documentation. You help maintain accurate product structures, manage engineering BOMs and ensure designs are properly documented for future generations of products. Risk management is an integral part of your engineering approach. You are familiar with design reviews, DFMEA methodologies and engineering best practices, and you use them to improve product robustness and reliability. You communicate clearly and effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds. You can explain complex concepts, document your findings and provide constructive feedback on designs and technical proposals. In the world of centrifugal compressors, breakthroughs rarely come from easy opportunities. Success comes from deep technical understanding, meticulous engineering and relentlessly pursuing improvements that create value for customers. If that challenge motivates you, we would love to hear from you. You will report to the Team Leader Centrifugal Compressors and work in a hybrid setup from our site in Wilrijk. Experience in the design and development of mechanical systems or rotating equipment. Strong understanding of gears, shafts, rolling-element bearings and hydrodynamic bearings. Experience with engineering calculations, finite element analysis (FEA) and rotor dynamics. Familiarity with DFMEA, design reviews and engineering risk assessment methodologies. Understanding of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) and engineering standards. Experience supporting prototype development, testing and failure investigations. Structured way of working with strong attention to detail and documentation quality. Ability to manage and maintain engineering BOMs and product structures. Strong team player with good communication skills. Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is considered an advantage. items.desc: Your role Are you a driven manufacturing engineer with a passion for process optimization, automation systems, and advanced production technologies? Do you want to play a key role in introducing cutting-edge production equipment and coating processes that power sustainable industrial innovations? What does a manufacturing project engineer do at the Atlas Copco Group in Wilrijk? As a manufacturing project engineer within our engineering competence center, you will independently plan, execute, and deliver capital investment projects and manufacturing process improvements in accordance with Atlas Copco standards (such as NPPI and Safety First). You will take full responsibility for specifying, budgeting, and qualifying new production equipment and coating technologies (including FDA-focused Z-coat applications), before seamlessly handing them over to the shop floor flow teams. Your daily flow involves conducting technical and commercial evaluations for capital goods (STPO creation, supplier negotiation, internal/external buy-offs, uptime registration), while optimizing for ergonomics, safety, maintenance, and unit cost reduction. As project leader, you assemble cross-functional teams, manage project budgets and timelines, present feasibility studies to management, drive patent applications, and report progress at PCM milestones. Additionally, you provide early-stage manufacturability input to product development teams, troubleshoot production launch phases, and audit equipment availability during warranty periods. If interested, you also have the opportunity to work overarching on digital manufacturing and software systems integration (such as SOFE, Ignition, CAQ, GEMS, Delmia). items.desc: ABOUT TETON Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our proprietary computer vision system enables staff to automate documentation, proactively manage resident acuity, and streamline workflows across entire facilities. From assisted living communities to hospital wards, our system delivers unprecedented access to real-time data insights, empowering providers with actionable intelligence to enhance decision-making and elevate care delivery. Backed by a $20M Series A, we are scaling fast. Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI, and desktop and mobile applications, Teton helps create a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, striving to always raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you. THE ROLE This is not your typical job description. As Strategy & Operations Associate, you will become an integral part of our Operations Team and operate across the full scope of the business, wherever analysis, structure, or execution is needed. We are looking for someone who has learned to think and work at a high bar, typically in investment banking or management consulting, and who now wants to apply that rigor inside a fast-scaling company, with real ownership of the outcome. You will build the models and the business cases, and then you will help make them happen. Your role will evolve with the pace of our growth, giving you exposure across finance, commercial operations, contracting, people operations, legal, corporate governance, supply chain and customer delivery. Some days you will be giving leadership the analysis that sets strategic direction; other days you will be doing whatever it takes to get things done. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES In practice, that means you'll be: Working closely with the Director of Operations and leadership on Teton's most important strategic and operational priorities. Building the analyses, financial models and business cases that inform leadership decisions, and presenting clear, well-founded recommendations. Identifying operational challenges, structuring the problem, and proposing practical, data-driven solutions, including systemic changes to how we work. Driving internal projects end to end to improve processes, reporting, and operational efficiency across teams. Jumping into whatever the week demands: a contract review before Friday, a customer escalation, a pricing model for a tender response, a forecast revision, a redline on a public-sector DPA, or a quarter-end ARR reconciliation. Using AI and modern tooling to automate the routine and spend your time on the judgment calls. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Analytical Rigor: Experience from investment banking, management consulting, or a similarly demanding analytical environment. You are fluent in Excel modelling, financial analysis and turning messy data into a clear answer. Structured Problem Solving: You break down ambiguous problems quickly, form a hypothesis, and get to a recommendation leadership can act on, and you can communicate it crisply in writing and in person. High Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You solve problems independently, move fast, and hold yourself to the same standard on small tasks as on big ones. Comfort with Ambiguity: You thrive without a playbook and are energised, not alarmed, by a broad mandate in a fast-growing startup. Education: A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related analytical field. Curiosity about AI: You are interested in learning and using AI to drive business operations. WHAT WE OFFER Participation in our warrant program (stock options). Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field. A role where you can make a significant impact on healthcare delivery. Work with the smartest people, and the opportunity to learn from your peers. Exposure to every major part of how a company scales, with a steep learning curve. WHAT IT'S LIKE WORKING AT TETON We're a growing team of extremely hard-working and talented people. The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is not just encouraged, it's expected. It's a hands-on environment where you'll be challenged, supported, and constantly learning. We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than just another 9-5 job. With us you will have an opportunity to truly make an impact on the world with the outcomes of your work. So, if you are looking for a ride and not just a job, jump on board

items.desc: GE Vernova is looking for an Electrical Application Engineer to join our Power Quality team in Tampere, Finland. This is an opportunity to join an experienced engineering team working on harmonic filter and reactive power compensation solutions for transmission and renewable energy applications. In this role, you will support the development of technically sound tender solutions, helping to translate customer requirements into clear engineering deliverables for customers including transmission system operators, renewable energy projects, and internal GE Vernova stakeholders. You will work within the Inquiry to Order (ITO) phase, where customer RFQs, specifications and system data are converted into technical solutions, electrical dimensioning and tender-phase documentation. Direct experience in harmonic filters is not essential, and the role offers the opportunity to contribute within a knowledgeable team while building or applying expertise in a specialist area. We are interested in candidates who bring strong electrical fundamentals, sound engineering judgement and the right mindset to learn and contribute. The ideal candidate is likely to have some combination of the following: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering. A background or interest in power systems, substations, grid connections, high-voltage or medium-voltage applications Exposure to substation design, primary equipment, transmission systems or industrial power applications Familiarity with equipment used in high-voltage or medium-voltage environments The ability to interpret technical requirements and turn them into practical engineering solutions Confidence communicating with cross-functional stakeholders including sales teams, engineers, vendors and project teams Experience with PowerFactory / DIgSILENT, AutoCAD, or similar engineering software would be beneficial, but is not essential. items.desc: Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time. Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario. With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software. At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. The Data & Automations Team The Data & Automations team builds and operates Pigment's internal data platform, and designs, implements, and maintains the intelligent automation solutions that rely on it. Together, they streamline business processes and enhance data-driven decision making: we empower product, business and corporate functions through technology integration, robust data architecture, and process optimization, enabling teams to focus on high-value activities while ensuring accuracy and scalability. The data platform is the foundation of everything we deliver. It is a centralized, governed ecosystem that collects, stores, transforms, and serves data to internal consumers across Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), and General & Administrative (G&A) functions, providing a single source of truth for analytics, automations, and AI. Making it reliable, secure, cost-efficient, and scalable is at the core of our mission. The team also consolidates and orchestrates AI efforts across Pigment, from governance and enablement to building AI-powered solutions. Our team tackles diverse challenges, from integrating finance and HR systems and streamlining employee lifecycle processes, to building pipelines that turn product usage and customer interactions into actionable insights for Finance or GTM teams. AI is now at the center of most of what we do with data: many of our pipelines feed LLM-powered solutions, and the quality, structure, and governance of our data architecture directly determine what these solutions can deliver. The team is led by Pigment's Deputy CISO and works closely with the Security team: security and data governance are part of how we build, not an afterthought. Role As a Junior Data and Automations Engineer, you will contribute to the continued development of Pigment's data platform: ingestion pipelines, dbt models, orchestration, data quality, and the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will also build and maintain the data pipelines, automations, and AI projects that support our G&A (Finance, People, IT) and GTM (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships) teams. You will work closely with senior engineers, starting with well-scoped tasks and progressively taking ownership of small projects end to end, from requirements gathering to production monitoring. This role involves collaborating with a wide range of internal stakeholders and requires excellent communication skills in English (primarily) and French, verbal and written. Tech environment Our core stack relies on Google Cloud Platform, maintained with Terraform, with components including BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer (Airflow), as well as dbt, Fivetran, Hightouch, Elementary for data observability, and Python for integrations and automations. Our pipelines connect business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, our HRIS, Gong, or Slack, and feed Pigment applications used by our own business teams. We also build LLM-powered pipelines and use AI tools in our daily engineering work. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills across these technologies while making a meaningful impact on Pigment's operational efficiency. Les objectifs de ce stage consistent à l'élaboration et à l'enrichissement des méthodologies pour l'intégration des variables climatiques et environnementales dans les différents modèles utilisés par l'équipe (ICAAP, stress tests, IFRS9, bâlois). Pour cela, vous contribuerez à ces travaux avec les équipes projet en place. Le stage s'articulera autour des axes suivants : Identification et modélisation des drivers de risque climatique et environnementaux Développement et amélioration de la méthodologie du groupe autour de la mesure des risques physiques et des risques de transition Développement et amélioration des méthodologies pour l'intégration de ces risques dans les outils de modélisation (modèles de stress tests, modèles IRB, modèles forward looking) Compréhension des modèles utilisés par les équipes et des étapes de production Familiarisation avec les exigences réglementaires et les normes internes sur les critères climatiques et environnementaux Développement méthodologique et rédaction de la documentation relative Identification et traitement des données pertinentes Participation à des travaux ad hoc Ce que vous apportera le stage : Découvrir les méthodes de modélisations utilisées par l'équipe MOD Proposer des innovations méthodologiques pour prendre en compte les enjeux climatiques et environnementaux Développer ses compétences en programmation et en modélisation Mettre en application les concepts théoriques dans un environnement bancaire Avoir un contact avec le métier bancaire Durée du stage : 6 mois. Et si c'était vous ? Formation requise : Ecole d'ingénieur ou Master en Statistiques / Mathématiques appliquées / Informatique Connaissances requises : Maîtrise de la programmation sous R, Python Manipulation des bases de données Connaissances des modèles statistiques (économétrie, machine learning) Compétences additionnelles : Logiciels bureautiques : Pack Office Une familiarité avec les concepts de risques climatiques et environnementaux serait un plus (risques physiques, risques de transition, cadre réglementaire) Bon niveau d'anglais écrit Aptitudes comportementales : autonomie, curiosité, proactivité, rigueur, esprit d'équipe Plus qu'un poste, un tremplin Rejoignez-nous pour faire grandir vos ambitions ! Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos experts qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence. A la fin de vos études, diverses opportunités pourront s'offrir à vous, en France et à l'international. Pourquoi nous choisir ? Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail , vous bénéficiez d'avantages : Télétravail possible selon le rythme de votre service Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Billetterie à prix réduits de notre Comité d'Entreprise (concerts, cinéma, sport) Offre variée de restaurants d'entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l'action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s'engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l'éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. items.desc: Support N3 / Projet et maîtrise de Terraform Expertise Niveau 3 & Maintien en Conditions Opérationnelles (MCO) Le poste implique d'intervenir en escalade ultime sur les incidents de production complexes, notamment l'analyse de crash dumps, la résolution de problèmes de performance CPU/I-O/Mémoire et les pannes réseau système. Gestion du cycle de vie (Patching & Upgrades) : définir et piloter les campagnes de mise à jour des OS (RedHat/Rocky Linux, Debian/Ubuntu) et durcir la sécurité du noyau (Kernel tuning, SELinux/AppArmor). Capacity Planning & Tuning : superviser la performance globale des serveurs, analyser les goulots d'étranglement et optimiser les configurations système pour les applications critiques (bases de données, serveurs web). Industrialisation & Automatisation (IaC & Templates) Création et gestion de templates : concevoir, builder et maintenir les images de référence ("Golden Images") Linux pour différents environnements (VMware, AWS, Azure, Bare-metal) en utilisant des outils de templating comme HashiCorp Packer. Intégration Terraform : rendre ces templates consommables par Terraform. Créer et documenter les modules Terraform pour automatiser le cycle de vie du provisionnement des serveurs. Gestion des configurations : développer et maintenir les rôles Ansible (ou Puppet/SaltStack) pour la post-configuration automatisée des serveurs fraîchement déployés par Terraform. Expertises spécifiques : Expertise OS, outils d'Infrastructure as Code, gestion de configuration, scripting, environnements virtualisés / cloud, sécurité. Agilité au changement (S'adapte & Saisit les opportunités) : l'administration système traditionnelle évolue vers le "Software-Defined". Vous passez avec aisance du diagnostic d'un serveur en ligne de commande à la résolution d'un bug dans un pipeline CI/CD. Vous voyez l'évolution des pratiques d'ingénierie et l'hybridation des infrastructures comme une opportunité d'enrichir votre quotidien. Culture de l'innovation (Propose, expérimente & Veille active) : vous êtes force de proposition pour moderniser nos méthodes d'exploitation. Vous menez une veille active sur les outils d'automatisation, les nouvelles distributions Linux et les méthodes de conteneurisation. Vous n'hésitez pas à concevoir des maquettes (PoC) pour tester des approches d'auto-remédiation des pannes. Appropriation de l'IA (Comprend l'impact & Exploite) : vous intégrez l'IA générative dans vos méthodes de travail pour gagner en efficacité. Vous l'utilisez pour accélérer l'écriture de vos playbooks Ansible, valider et optimiser vos codes Terraform, ou pour générer des scripts Bash/Python complexes. Vous explorez également l'usage de l'IA pour l'analyse prédictive des logs système. Collaboration & Transmission (Partage & Monte en compétences) : en tant qu'expert N3, vous êtes le mentor des équipes de support N1/N2. Vous rédigez des procédures d'exploitation claires, documentez l'architecture de vos templates et animez des sessions de partage de connaissances pour rendre les équipes autonomes sur l'utilisation des modules Terraform que vous concevez. Profil candidat: Expertise OS : maîtrise des distributions d'entreprise (RedHat Enterprise Linux / Rocky / Alma, Debian, Ubuntu). Bonne compréhension des internals du noyau Linux, de la gestion du stockage (LVM, multipathing) et des protocoles réseau. Outils d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) : maîtrise de Terraform et de Packer (indispensable pour la création de templates d'images). Gestion de configuration : expertise sur Ansible (écriture de rôles complexes, Ansible Tower / AWX). Scripting : excellente maîtrise de Bash et de Python ou Go pour l'outillage système. Environnements virtualisés / Cloud : connaissance de VMware vSphere et/ou d'un fournisseur Cloud public (AWS, Azure, GCP). Sécurité : connaissances en durcissement système (CIS Benchmarks, SSH hardening, configuration Firewall local). Comportements attendus : s'adapter et saisir les opportunités ; proposer, expérimenter et assurer une veille active ; intégrer l'IA générative dans ses méthodes de travail ; partager et monter en compétences, en tant que mentor des équipes de support N1/N2.

Acteur majeur en maintenance multi-expertises (plomberie, chauffage, électricité, menuiserie, serrurerie...) dans l'environnement de l'habitat social et dans l'habitat individuel, notre groupe familial est fier de maintenir son indépendance. Nos priorités sont de satisfaire nos clients par la qualité de nos prestations mais aussi d’assurer la promotion et l’évolution de notre personnel. Fil@com, filiale du Groupe ISERBA Invest, est spécialisée dans la gestion de la relation client à distance. Ses équipes assurent notamment l’accueil téléphonique, le traitement des demandes, la planification et le suivi des interventions techniques. En lien avec les différentes entités du Groupe, Fil@com contribue chaque jour à la qualité de service, à la satisfaction des clients et des locataires, grâce à l’écoute, à la réactivité et à l’engagement de ses collaborateurs. Description des missions ou activités Rattache à la Directrice de Fil@com, votre rôle sera de piloter les projets d’innovation et de transformation des Centres de Relation Client (CRC), notamment autour de l’IA et des outils digitaux, tout en garantissant la performance opérationnelle des activités internes et externalisées. Le poste intervient de manière transverse auprès des équipes opérationnelles, du commerce, des fonctions support et des prestataires afin d’identifier les leviers d’amélioration, de les déployer et d’en mesurer les résultats. Principales responsabilités 1. Innovation & Intelligence Artificielle Identifier les opportunités d’utilisation de l’IA dans les CRC : automatisation, assistance aux conseillers, analyse des interactions, qualité, connaissance client, pilotage de la performance. Piloter les expérimentations et projets IA, de l’expression du besoin jusqu’au déploiement. Réaliser des benchmarks des solutions du marché et proposer les évolutions adaptées aux enjeux du Groupe. Mesurer les gains générés : productivité, qualité, satisfaction client, coûts, expérience collaborateur. Accompagner les équipes dans l’appropriation des nouveaux outils et usages. 2.
