Learning & Development : Freedom to choose your learning path, with internal and external coaching available. Flexible Working : Flexible hours and hybrid working options. Rockfeather Community : Frequent social (sport) activities. Company Certificates : Option to buy certificates in the company. About Rockfeather Rockfeather is a young and ambitious consultancy company specialized in Data Visualization, Data Engineering, and Low-Code . Our work is guided by five core values: Together : We collaborate, share knowledge, and build lasting partnerships. We Own It : We take responsibility and deliver on our promises. We Fix It : We go the extra mile to find smart, reliable solutions. We Love It : We bring passion, energy, and optimism to everything we do. No Bullshit : We are open, honest, and focused on what really matters. We don’t claim to be the perfect place for everyone. If you’re looking for rigid structures and lots of hierarchy, we’re not your match. But if you want to shape impactful solutions, grow fast, and have fun while doing it, you’ll feel at home here. Application Procedure Ready to make an impact as our next Medior Data & Analytics Consultant? Our process typically has three steps, including two interviews - one with our internal recruiter and another with your potential team lead - along with a technical assessment. As a Developer Advocate, you will join our highly skilled and collaborative Marketing and Developer Experience organization, where you will be responsible for communicating with developers and engineers to help them
items.desc: About the job It is an exciting time to join Nordic Semiconductor, as more developers and engineers are building Bluetooth Low Energy, Matter, Wi-Fi, and cellular IoT products using Nordic ICs. As a Developer Advocate, you will join our highly skilled and collaborative Marketing and Developer Experience organization, where you will be responsible for communicating with developers and engineers to help them understand and succeed with Nordic’s solutions. At the same time, security has become a key requirement for connected products, with new regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) raising the bar for compliance across the industry. While security will be your primary area of focus, you will also contribute across other technical topics, so we are looking for someone with a broad embedded background combined with a strong interest in security. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that requires experience working with embedded systems, ideally across wireless technologies, firmware, hardware, security, and cloud. You will deep-dive into technical topics and have a strong understanding of how developers build wireless products with Nordic. Your work will involve creating compelling content that helps developers understand and build with Nordic’s solutions and bring end-products to market more easily. Key responsibilities Develop technical content for developers, including courses, videos, webinars, blog posts, and web content, with a focus on IoT security and regulatory compliance. Plan and execute the introduction of new security-related features, SDK updates, and tools. Simplify and communicate complex technical, security, and compliance topics. Develop demonstrators and embedded projects that highlight features and capabilities of our products. Represent and advocate for Nordic at tradeshows and seminars through technical presentations and direct engagement with developer communities. Work closely with product management, R&D, and security teams, and bring developer feedback back into Nordic. Stay up to date on industry trends and advancements in embedded development, including the evolving security and regulatory landscape. Key Qualifications BSc/MSc in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Cybernetics, Computer Science, Communication Technology, or related discipline. Several years of experience working with embedded systems, preferably with exposure to wireless technologies, firmware, hardware, security, and cloud. Strong understanding of embedded development processes and best practices. Experience and interest in developing technical content for developers, including videos, webinars, blog posts, and web content Familiarity with IoT security regulations and standards, such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act, is a strong advantage. Fluent in written and spoken English. Personal Skills We are looking for a curious, proactive, and engaging communicator who can transform complex technical concepts into compelling content and customer experiences. You take ownership, drive initiatives from concept to delivery, and thrive in a collaborative environment where you work closely with engineers, product teams, and developer communities. With strong presentation and communication skills, you are comfortable representing Nordic on stage and on camera, building relationships with developers, and inspiring others through clear and impactful storytelling. Above all, you have a genuine passion for technology, continuous learning, and helping others succeed. Working for Nordic Working at Nordic, you will be inspired and supported to develop yourself. Our teams enjoy a professional and informal working environment. We value and encourage the continuous development of skills and expertise to the highest levels. We are proud of our Norwegian heritage, our highly skilled international workforce, and our world-leading innovation. We offer a variety of tasks and projects, and the possibility to work alongside some of the world’s most renowned experts within their field. We encourage our employees to question the established and innovate while expecting professionalism, commitment, and the will to learn. Benefits Competitive salary with short- and long-term incentive plan Flexible working hours Medical insurance Family-friendly policies, insurances, and benefits Practical details Location: Oslo, Norway | Trondheim, Norway | Kraków, Poland | Espoo, Finland Please note that this position might be subject to a background check.

Your focus will be on developing and operating data pipelines, data models and platform capabilities that make data easy to find, trust and use. Build and maintain data pipelines using Databricks and PySpark. Develop data products using modern Databricks capabilities such as Unity Catalog, Apache Spark™ Declarative Pipelines and Delta Lake. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Databricks environment and engineering ways of working. Experience: At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines and data solutions. Technical skills: Strong Python skills. Experience with Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake and Azure. Familiarity with Unity Catalog, data modelling and automated data processing workflows is a plus. Platform operations: Experience monitoring data pipelines, investigating failures and improving reliability and performance. Nice to have: Experience with Apache Spark™ Declarative Pipelines, CI/CD, DataOps practices (including Declarative Automation Bundles). items.desc: Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Scania Industrial Batteries is part of Scania’s ambition to accelerate the transition to sustainable transport and industrial solutions. The business focuses on developing and commercializing battery systems for industrial applications, leveraging Scania’s expertise in electrification, energy efficiency, and lifecycle sustainability. As part of Ventures and New Business we works closely with customers and partners to deliver innovative battery solutions that support the decarbonization of industries beyond traditional transport, helping create new growth opportunities while contributing to a more sustainable future. Role Summary As a Manufacturing Digital Systems Engineer you will be responsible for the development, integration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of digital manufacturing systems that support production, quality, and traceability. Working closely with Process, Test, and Automation Engineers, you will translate manufacturing needs into reliable software solutions, covering areas such as manufacturing traceability, equipment connectivity, data management, test applications, and production analytics. From solution design and validation through deployment and ongoing support, you will play a key role in driving digitalization, improving manufacturing performance, and exploring AI-assisted tools to enhance operational efficiency and quality. Job Responsibilities Key responsibilities in this role: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve manufacturing applications and digital systems supporting production, quality, and traceability. Integrate new production and test stations by developing software interfaces, equipment connectivity, and data acquisition solutions. Collaborate with Process, Test, and Automation Engineering teams to translate manufacturing requirements into reliable software solutions. Develop applications using C#/.NET, SQL Server, and related technologies to support manufacturing operations. Manage manufacturing data, ensuring accurate product traceability, production records, and test-result tracking. Create reports, dashboards, and data visualization tools to support production performance monitoring and quality improvement initiatives. Develop and maintain integrations between manufacturing systems and enterprise platforms such as MES, ERP, and test data management systems. Ensure software quality through testing, debugging, documentation, version control, and controlled deployment processes. Evaluate and implement AI-assisted tools and capabilities to enhance manufacturing applications and operational efficiency. Drive continuous improvement by standardizing software components, integration methods, and development best practices. Who You Are Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience developing and maintaining software applications in a manufacturing or industrial environment. Strong hands-on experience with C#/.NET and SQL Server . Experience integrating software with production equipment, industrial controllers, automated test systems, or measurement devices. Knowledge of SQL databases, APIs, and industrial communication protocols. Experience with software testing, debugging, deployment, version control, and application lifecycle management. Experience with manufacturing traceability, MES, or production data systems is an advantage. Experience from automotive, battery, electronics, or other quality-critical manufacturing environments is preferred. Professional working proficiency in English. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us. This Is Us Electrification is essential to decarbonizing the world, and it needs to happen faster and at scale. At Scania Industrial Batteries, we’re not just responding to change; we’re leading it. Since joining Scania in April 2025 as a newly acquired company, we combine engineering excellence with visionary innovation. We develop high-performance, modular battery systems for demanding off-highway applications, helping industries such as mining, construction, and marine operate more sustainably. Our success is built on collaboration, resilience, and reliability. We challenge conventional thinking, embrace change, and deliver solutions our customers can trust. If you’re passionate about driving electrification and shaping the future with scalable battery systems built for the toughest environments on land and sea, this is the place for you. Join us and help lead the change toward a cleaner, more sustainable world! Scania Industrial …

O EY Polska Jesteśmy globalną firmą doradczo-technologiczną. Robimy różnicę - transformujemy i zmieniamy usługi, produkty, organizacje, a nawet reguły gry. Biznesowo i technologicznie, wykorzystując sztuczną inteligencję i prawdziwe talenty. Pomagamy organizacjom rozwiązywać złożone problemy, podejmować lepsze decyzje i wdrażać zmiany na lepsze. Dajemy pewność - danych, opinii, standardów, technologii i bezpieczeństwa. Codziennie podejmujemy wyzwania, analizujemy możliwości, promptujemy, badamy, współpracujemy, zadajemy dobre pytania, planujemy, modelujemy, kodujemy, próbujemy nowych rzeczy, wyciągamy wnioski – tworzymy rozwiązania, które są kluczowe dla klientów. Tutaj tworzą się przyjaźnie, relacje i wspomnienia na całe życie. Tutaj robisz trudne i ważne rzeczy, z wspierającymi i najlepszymi ludźmi. Zatrudniamy ponad 400 000 wyjątkowych osób w ponad 150 krajach na świecie. W Polsce jest nas ponad 7000 – pracujemy w Warszawie, Gdańsku, Katowicach, Krakowie, Łodzi, Poznaniu, Rzeszowie i Wrocławiu oraz w centrum usług Global Delivery Services w Warszawie i Wrocławiu. Dbamy o środowisko – nie tylko biznesowe. W ramach realizacji założonego planu zmniejszyliśmy globalną emisję gazów cieplarnianych o 40% w stosunku do roku bazowego 2019. EY jest pracodawcą równych szans – doceniamy i promujemy różnorodność wiedzy, doświadczeń i perspektyw naszej społeczności. Tworzymy środowisko oparte na szacunku, otwartości i współpracy, w którym każdy może się rozwijać i mieć realny wpływ. Prowadzimy program „Poziom Wyżej bez Barier”, który wspiera pracowników z niepełnosprawnościami w realizacji ich ambicji i marze ń zwi ązanych z rozwojem zawodowym. EY zapewnia wszystkim kandydatom jednakowe szanse w procesie rekrutacji, niezależnie od płci, wieku, rasy, wyznania, orientacji seksualnej, pochodzenia, niepełnosprawności lub jakiejkolwiek innej prawnie chronionej podstawy, zgodnie z obowiązującym prawem.

items.desc: Twice a year, we welcome a new group of interns. Some start with a bootcamp to get up to speed on our stack; others jump straight into a project. Either way, you'll work on real client or internal products, with a mentor beside you and a team you can ask anything. Notify me We will let you know when the recruitment process starts. Real products, a mentor beside you, and a team you can ask anything. We run internships hoping people will stay. Many do – some of them are still here a few years later, now mentoring interns of their own. The internship is where a lot of our engineers started, and we run every edition with that in mind. A few highlights from previous editions The internship has a history here. What you'll actually work on Web and mobile work that ships. We focus on web and mobile projects, divided into two categories: client projects – mostly US startups, but also corporate ones – and internal, often open-source products. Our main technologies are TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and React Native; on the backend, Node.js, Python with Django, and Elixir. Client projects Client work gives you the chance to build products for teams around the world, from early-stage startups to larger organizations. Internal and open-source products Internal work lets you contribute to the open-source tools and products that Software Mansion is known for. How the internship works Real work, from day one. Interns are part of the team from day one and work on real projects – client or internal – alongside our specialists. We recruit to the company, not to specific projects – we'll try to match your preferences, but the assignment depends on our needs when you join. Who we're looking for Smart, curious people with a strong engineering mindset. The internship is open to everyone. You don't need work experience, and it doesn't matter which year of study you're in or whether you're a student at all. What matters is how you present your skills during the recruitment process. We look for smart, curious people with a strong engineering mindset rather than specific skills. However, there are a few requirements that you'll need to meet. Core programming basics: algorithms and data structures, databases, networking, operating systems, web basics, and Git. Polish and English at B2 level or higher. Availability to work mainly from our Kraków office – occasional remote days are fine. Knowing our technologies helps, but if you don't – you'll pick them up during the internship. If you'd like to find out how our recruitment process works, feel free to visit our blog. In their words What former interns remember. A few people who started their Software Mansion story with an internship. “I was treated like a real teammate from day one, with trust, real ownership, and work that actually mattered. What stuck with me most is the confidence to jump in, take responsibility, and trust that I can figure things out along the way.” Szymon Szołdra Winter 2022 “Starting out as an intern here was the best way to get real React Native experience from day one. Being able to work alongside and learn from devs who contribute to core RN libraries was an absolute highlight. That hands-on guidance made all the difference for where I am today.” Bartek Szar Summer 2023 “What stood out most to me was the trust I received from day one, giving me the opportunity to work on real projects that people actually use every day. At the same time, I never felt left on my own, as my mentor and colleagues were always eager to help me navigate any challenges. Ultimately, the vibrant culture and engaging activities created a welcoming environment where I always felt truly comfortable in the office.” Piotr Rzadkowski Summer 2023 “The range of work surprised me (in a good way) – one week I'd be doing a landing page, the next a much bigger system, plus things like big conference sites along the way. But the real thing I took from the internship is the people. It's hard to stay in place when everyone around you is clearly trying to get better at what they do.” Szymon Halski Winter 2026 “The internship at SWM was an incredible experience for me. Even without any prior experience in RN, I was able to start earning money while developing my skills by reading documentation and building mobile apps. It was great to watch the product evolve with each passing day of the internship and to feel that I had an impact on it.” Dawid Jagieła Summer 2016 “I think the internship at SWM was one of the most valuable experiences for my career. I got to own a real project from start to finish, worked closely with the client and had real autonomy from day one. The team was very welcoming and the vibe in the office was chill and supportive. Five years later, I'm still here, which I think says everything about the foundation that experience created. ” Kasia Płoskonka Summer 2021 “From day one, I was working with top experts and had an amazing mentor by my side. items.title: Junior Software Engineer (C++), Authentication Team - Splunk
items.card: Your Impact As a Junior Software Engineer on the Platform Identity, you will contribute to designing, building, and improving identity services that support authentication, authorization, and user lifecycle management across Splunk and Cisco products. You will work closely with senior engineers to implement secure and scalable features, maintain existing components, and learn best practices in distributed systems.
items.desc: Meet the Team The Platform Identity builds the secure foundation that enables millions of users to access the Splunk and Cisco ecosystem seamlessly and safely. Our mission is to deliver a centralized Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform that is scalable, resilient, and intelligent. We collaborate closely with product, security, and infrastructure teams to unify identity across the entire portfolio. If you’re passionate about learning modern identity technologies, solving meaningful engineering challenges, and growing your skills in a supportive environment, this team is the perfect place to start your journey. Your Impact As a Junior Software Engineer on the Platform Identity, you will contribute to designing, building, and improving identity services that support authentication, authorization, and user lifecycle management across Splunk and Cisco products. You will work closely with senior engineers to implement secure and scalable features, maintain existing components, and learn best practices in distributed systems. You will have opportunities to explore identity protocols, contribute to API development, and get hands-on experience with modern security and IAM technologies. Success in this role means demonstrating curiosity, growth, solid technical fundamentals, and the ability to collaborate effectively with your team. Minimum Qualifications Academic or early professional experience in software development (internships, projects, open-source contributions, or equivalent). Basic understanding of authentication or authorization concepts (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0 are a plus, but not mandatory). Fundamental programming skills inC++ and/or Go (university coursework or project experience acceptable). Understanding of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, networking basics). Eagerness to learn secure, distributed systems and identity technologies. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to AI/ML concepts or coursework. Familiarity with cloud services or IAM concepts (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) at a basic level. Knowledge of directory services (LDAP or Active Directory) or willingness to learn. Participation in open-source projects, coding competitions, or personal technical projects. Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

W roku 2025 zatrudniając ponad 155 000 pracowników w ponad 100 krajach osiągnęła przychody w wysokości 40,6 mld USD. Portfolio usług CBRE obejmuje m.in.: zarządzanie nieruchomościami, obsługę transakcji, doradztwo inwestycyjne, wycenę, leasing nieruchomości oraz doradztwo strategiczne. CZYM SIĘ BĘDZIESZ ZAJMOWAĆ? Monitorowaniem jakości danych w kluczowych systemach, identyfikowaniem niezgodności, duplikatów oraz braków w danych i wspieraniem działań naprawczych. Współpracą z zespołami biznesowymi przy definiowaniu i wdrażaniu standardów jakości danych oraz zasad Data Governance. Dokumentowaniem przepływów danych i procesów zarządzania danymi oraz tworzeniem i utrzymywaniem słowników danych (Data Dictionary). Przygotowywaniem raportów, analiz i dashboardów w Power BI wspierających podejmowanie decyzji biznesowych. Wykorzystywaniem narzędzi AI, takich jak Microsoft Copilot czy Claude, do usprawniania pracy z danymi. Automatyzacją powtarzalnych procesów przy użyciu Power Automate i podobnych rozwiązań. CZEGO OD CIEBIE OCZEKUJEMY? Wykształcenia wyższego oraz rozwiniętych umiejętności analitycznych i dbałości o szczegóły. Umiejętności identyfikowania anomalii, niespójności i problemów jakościowych w danych oraz wyciągania trafnych wniosków. Znajomości podstaw zarządzania danymi, w tym takich obszarów jak Data Governance, Data Lineage, Data Dictionary oraz cykl życia danych. Umiejętności mapowania przepływu danych pomiędzy systemami i dokumentowania procesów związanych z danymi. (to już bardzo zaawansowane, usunęłabym to) Praktycznej znajomości narzędzi AI oraz umiejętności tworzenia skutecznych promptów i wykorzystywania AI do analizy danych i raportowania. Komunikatywności i umiejętności współpracy z interesariuszami biznesowymi. Dobrej znajomości języka angielskiego w mowie i piśmie. Dobrej znajomości programu Excel. Mile widziane: Doświadczenie w tworzeniu raportów i dashboardów w Power BI. Znajomość Power Automate lub innych narzędzi do automatyzacji procesów. Podstawowa znajomość modelowania danych, relacji między tabelami oraz języka DAX. OFERUJEMY: Pakiet świadczeń: Prywatna opieka zdrowotna - w tym 70% zniżki na usługi stomatologiczne Ubezpieczenie na życie Platforma MyBenefit People Power - program wellbeingowy (w tym konsultacje psychologiczne) Program skróconego tygodnia pracy - 38h tygodniowo Elastyczne godziny pracy Dodatkowy dzień wolny na urodziny, Dwa dni na wolontariat Płatny program poleceń dla pracowników Rozwój i szkolenia: m.in. globalny program doskonalenia kompetencji przywódczych People Manager Excellence, regionalny program mobilności Swap & Share oraz dofinansowanie zewnętrznych certyfikacji i studiów Udział w imprezach sponsorowanych przez CBRE w tym CSRowych W CBRE Sp. z o.o. stawiamy na rozwój i różnorodność. Oferujemy elastyczne środowisko pracy, wspierające kulturę opartą na wartościach RISE: szacunek, uczciwość, zaangażowanie i doskonałość. Cenimy dobre samopoczucie pracowników, promując zdrowie i aktywność. Zapraszamy do aplikowania osoby reprezentujące różne środowiska, poglądy i pochodzenie. CBRE Sp. z o.o. została wielokrotnie wyróżniona za wysoką jakość realizowanych usług i etykę biznesu, jak również jako pracodawca m.in. licznymi nagrodami Eurobuild. Jesteśmy sygnatariuszem Karty Różnorodności i zostaliśmy wyróżnieni przez Forum Odpowiedzialnego Biznesu wpisem na listę pracodawców najbardziej zaawansowanych w zakresie zarządzania różnorodnością i inkluzji w Polsce Diversity in Check 2024. items.card: Your Impact As a member of the team, you will contribute to building, testing, and maintaining core security components to support secure and reliable product functionality. You will deliver well-defined features and improvements, write clean and secure code, and assist in solving product and production issues. You will also participate in on-call rotations and support operational tasks to help maintain service
items.desc: Meet the Team As the Security Foundations Engineering team within the Platform Engineering organization, we own and operate foundational platform security components that enable secure management of secrets, auditing, cryptography, and compliance capabilities across our product portfolio. Our work aligns with internal and external security standards, industry best practices, and rigorous compliance requirements. We are a team of 10+ engineers working in a fast-paced, high-velocity environment, leveraging innovative technologies. Our customers include internal engineering teams as well as end users, and we support critical use cases that ensure the security, compliance, and functionality of our SaaS and On-Prem offerings. We build and maintain a fleet of cloud-based, highly available platform security services deployed across multiple geographic regions on multiple cloud service providers. Your Impact As a member of the team, you will contribute to building, testing, and maintaining core security components to support secure and reliable product functionality. You will deliver well-defined features and improvements, write clean and secure code, and assist in solving product and production issues. You will also participate in on-call rotations and support operational tasks to help maintain service availability for our cloud-based platform security services. Collaborating with senior engineers and other teams, you will grow your skills and take on increasing responsibility over time. Minimum Qualifications Master's degree or bachelor's degree plus 1-2 years of related experience Experience delivering and maintaining production software in Go and/or C++ Understanding of software design, debugging, testing, and secure coding principles Familiarity with Unix/Linux (including shell scripting), networking concepts, and cybersecurity fundamentals Ability to solve technical issues methodically and learn unfamiliar parts of a system Willingness to adopt and apply GenAI tools across software engineering workflows Growth mindset with a strong desire to learn, try new technologies, and take on new challenges Strong verbal and written English communication skills Preferred Qualifications Exposure to cloud infrastructure across multiple cloud service providers and familiarity with DevOps practices Basic knowledge of containerization technologies and container orchestration with Kubernetes Experience with automation tools like Terraform for infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipeline management Understanding of cybersecurity concepts, including secrets management, auditing, cryptography, and compliance Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Splunk Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

You will architect scalable and secure APIs, unify identity systems, and serve as a subject matter expert on modern identity protocols. Your work will directly strengthen platform security,
items.desc: Meet the Team The Platform Identity builds the secure foundation that enables millions of users to access the Splunk and Cisco ecosystem seamlessly and safely. Our mission is to deliver a centralized Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform that is scalable, resilient, and intelligent. We are a highly collaborative engineering group working across product, security, and infrastructure teams to unify identity across the entire portfolio. If you’re inspired by large-scale engineering challenges and shaping the future of secure user experiences, you’ll feel right at home with us. Your Impact As a Software Engineer on the Platform Identity, you will design, build, and operate the core identity services that power authentication, authorization, and user lifecycle management across Splunk and Cisco products. You will architect scalable and secure APIs, unify identity systems, and serve as a subject matter expert on modern identity protocols. Your work will directly strengthen platform security, improve customer trust, and influence our long-term identity strategy. You will also explore opportunities to use AI/ML to increase automation and enhance identity protection. Success in this role means delivering reliable services, driving technical excellence, and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams to ship impactful solutions. Minimum Qualifications Significant professional experience in software engineering delivering scalable, production-grade services. Hands-on expertise with identity protocols such as SAML, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and OAuth 2.0. Experience designing and implementing authorization models (RBAC, ABAC). Strong programming skills in C++ OR/AND Go. Experience building secure, distributed, and fault-tolerant systems. Preferred Qualifications Experience applying AI/ML techniques in the identity, security, or platform engineering space. Familiarity with cloud provider IAM services (AWS IAM, Azure AD, Google Cloud Identity). Knowledge of directory services such as LDAP or Active Directory. Contributions to open-source IAM projects or communities. Strong cross-functional communication skills and ability to partner with product, security, and engineering teams. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

items.desc: Job Title: Associate, Risk & Controls Oversight Contract Type: 1 year fixed-term contract, full-time Location: Warsaw Department: Risk & Controls Reporting to: Head of Risk and Controls What the Hiring Manager says…. ‘This is an exciting time to join the ICG Risk & Controls team. The role provides multiple opportunities to make a tangible impact on the Group’s delegate oversight function as we expand the governance offering and support ICG’s ambitious growth.’ You will gain extensive exposure to ICG’s diverse and rapidly growing private strategies. This position not only provides visibility across multiple key stakeholders and a very diverse spectrum of alternative asset fund strategies but also empowers the individual to shape how the organisation’s governance system and process is improved, making a significant impact on the future of our control function operations. The scope covers a wide array of tasks, including portfolio management delegate oversight, product lifecycle oversight, and production of relevant internal and external reporting while remaining abreast with fast evolving EU regulatory framework. Summary of our opportunity Intermediate Capital Group (ICG) is an FTSE-100 listed alternative asset manager with over 30 years' history, managing over $100bn of assets and investing across the capital structure. We operate across four asset classes: Structured and Private Equity, Private Debt, Real Assets, and Credit. The business employs over 500 people in 20 countries around the world and is well positioned for growth and benefits from the long-term trend of increased demand for alternative investments. The Risk & Controls Function team consists of professionals based in London, Luxembourg and Poland. The Control Functions (Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit) team operates across London, the US, Luxembourg and Poland. In addition to the permanent team, various external providers are used to supplement delivery, including risk, legal and regulatory advice. Reporting to the Luxembourg-based team, this role will primarily support product lifecycle oversight and delegated portfolio manager oversight. The scope includes new product approvals, post-NPA activities and sign-off, material fund changes and liquidations, together with the initial due diligence and ongoing monitoring of delegated portfolio managers. The role will also support the integration of ESG and sustainability considerations across these processes and the preparation of reporting to the Executive Committee and Board of Managers. The role requires intellectual breadth and agility, strong organisational and analytical capabilities, and the ability to coordinate with internal departments and external service providers. The successful candidate will have a problem-solving mindset, good communication and partnering skills, and the ability to work effectively with colleagues based in London, Luxembourg and Warsaw. The role will require regular interaction with Product Development, Fund Legal, Operations, Portfolio Management, Sustainability, Compliance and other relevant functions. Primary responsibilities for this role include (but are not limited to): Supporting the coordination and preparation of New Product Approval submissions to governing bodies for new funds, mandates and material product initiatives. Coordinating post-NPA activities, including tracking the completion of contracts, actions and formal sign-off requirements. Maintaining ongoing oversight of AIFM products throughout their lifecycle and supporting appropriate reporting and escalation to the governing bodies. Supporting the governance and oversight of material fund changes, restructurings and liquidation events in collaboration with Operations, Fund Legal and other relevant stakeholders. Supporting the integration of ESG and sustainability considerations across the NPA, product lifecycle and portfolio manager oversight processes. Supporting the performance of ongoing monitoring - due diligence of delegated portfolio managers in accordance with the applicable oversight framework. Maintaining portfolio manager oversight schedules, due diligence records and monitoring templates, and supporting the escalation and reporting of material observations. Contributing to the simplification, standardisation and continuous improvement of processes, templates, governance records and reporting. Identifying opportunities to use technology, including approved AI-enabled tools, to improve process efficiency while maintaining appropriate governance and controls. Key Requirements/ Qualifications You will have demonstrable experience of: Undergraduate degree in a relevant subject, including Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Law or Risk Management. Postgraduate degree in the above subjects will be considered a plus. items.desc: As a Master Data Specialist , you will be responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date master data across company systems to support smooth business operations. You will process data updates ensuring data quality and consistency. The role requires a detail-oriented and organized professional who enjoys working with data, identifying discrepancies, and collaborating with internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Master Data Maintenance: Create, update, and maintain master data records in company systems, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards. Data Processing: Analyze requests received via tickets, emails, and Excel files, determine required changes, and execute data updates in a timely manner. Data Quality & Validation: Review and validate data entries, identify inconsistencies or errors, and take appropriate corrective actions. Issue Resolution: Respond to data-related inquiries and collaborate with internal stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve discrepancies. Documentation & Recordkeeping: Maintain accurate documentation of data changes and support audit and compliance requirements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with teams across procurement, finance, supply chain, and other business functions to ensure data accuracy and alignment. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve data management processes and contribute to operational efficiency. PPG Way: Embrace and promote PPG Way values, aligning actions with company culture and objectives. Competencies: Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Ability to organize and prioritize multiple tasks effectively. Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues. High level of responsibility, reliability, and ownership. Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with stakeholders. Qualifications: Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build effective working relationships across teams. Excellent communication skills in both English and Polish , written and verbal. Analytical thinking skills with the ability to interpret information, identify issues, and make data-driven decisions. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel . Bachelor's degree. Previous experience working with data entry, master data, invoice processing, administrative operations, or similar data-focused activities. Familiarity with SAP or other ERP systems is considered an advantage. How we work: At PPG, we bring teams together to accelerate collaboration and career development, with in-person work Monday through Thursday and the opportunity to work remotely on Flexible Fridays. Schedules may vary by location. items.desc: Strategia, Zgodność i Zarządzanie (Governance & Compliance) Współpraca z Dyrekcją przy budowaniu kultury i strategii bezpieczeństwa oraz adaptacji standardów korporacyjnych, w tym frameworku NIST. Zapewnienie zgodności organizacji z kluczowymi regulacjami rynkowymi i europejskimi (m.in. NIS2, CRA, RODO). Opracowywanie polityk bezpieczeństwa, definiowanie i raportowanie wskaźników KPI do Zarządu oraz facylitacja komitetów sterujących ds. bezpieczeństwa. Zarządzanie Ryzykiem i Architektura (Security by Design) Opracowywanie i bieżąca aktualizacja mapy ryzyk cybernetycznych oraz realizacja adekwatnych mechanizmów kontrolnych (Kontrola N2). Eksperckie wsparcie działu projektowego gwarantujące integrację wymagań bezpieczeństwa od wczesnych faz koncepcyjnych (Security by Design), w tym weryfikacja architektury i nadzór nad zlecanymi testami penetracyjnymi. Operacje i Zabezpieczenia Techniczne (SecOps & Protection) Projektowanie, wdrażanie oraz utrzymywanie platform zabezpieczających infrastrukturę, w szczególności rozwiązań klasy EDR/XDR, mechanizmów uwierzytelniania wieloskładnikowego (MFA) oraz firewalli. Ciągła weryfikacja efektywności zabezpieczeń w ramach całej floty urządzeń (serwery, stacje robocze, urządzenia mobilne, aplikacje). Kompleksowa realizacja procesu Vulnerability Management – od detekcji podatności, przez rekomendacje mitygacyjne, po nadzór nad wdrożeniem poprawek we współpracy z działem IT. Monitorowanie i Reagowanie na Incydenty (Detection & Incident Response) Analiza alertów z systemów bezpieczeństwa oraz koordynacja działań zewnętrznego centrum operacyjnego (SOC) w celu zapewnienia ciągłości monitoringu w trybie HNO (obsługa i reagowanie poza standardowymi godzinami pracy). Kompleksowe zarządzanie incydentami bezpieczeństwa: identyfikacja, mitygacja zagrożeń oraz opracowywanie działań naprawczych w ramach procedury RETEX (analiza poakcyjna typu lessons learned). Optymalizacja procedur reagowania na incydenty oraz projektowanie i koordynacja cyklicznych ćwiczeń kryzysowych. Budowanie Świadomości (Awareness) Kształtowanie świadomości zagrożeń poprzez realizację rocznych planów szkoleniowych dla całej organizacji, w tym koordynację symulacji phishingowych oraz modułów e-learningowych. Transfer wiedzy i prowadzenie specjalistycznych warsztatów podnoszących kompetencje z zakresu bezpieczeństwa dla zespołów IT 170 zł - 200 zł an hour Ekspert ds. Cyberbezpieczeństwa (GRC & SecOps) Zaangażowanie: Pełny wymiar Cel roli: Kompleksowe zarządzanie obszarem cyberbezpieczeństwa w organizacji. Współpraca obejmuje pełne spektrum działań – od kreowania strategii i zapewnienia zgodności prawnej, po wdrażanie zabezpieczeń technicznych, monitorowanie zagrożeń oraz reagowanie na incydenty. Realizacja powyższych obszarów ma na celu zbudowanie proaktywnego modelu ochrony organizacji, minimalizację ryzyka cybernetycznego oraz zagwarantowanie najwyższych standardów bezpieczeństwa, adekwatnych do surowych wymogów regulacyjnych i operacyjnych. Rola stanowi centralny punkt kompetencyjny, łączący architekturę bezpieczeństwa z bieżącym reagowaniem na ewoluujące zagrożenia. Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner. items.desc: Job Reference 459_26_CS_CTHPC_RE1 Position LLVM Software Engineer (RE1) Closing Date Saturday, 24 October, 2026 Reference: 459_26_CS_CTHPC_RE1 Job title: LLVM Software Engineer (RE1) About BSC The Barcelona Supercomputing Center - Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain. It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe. The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress. BSC combines HPC service provision and R&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over 1000 staff from 60 countries. Look at the BSC experience: BSC-CNS YouTube Channel Let's stay connected with BSC Folks! We are particularly interested for this role in the strengths and lived experiences of women and underrepresented groups to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights in science and IT research. In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under-represented sex will be favoured. We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences. If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer. We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team. Context And Mission The Computer Sciences (CS) department of the Barcelona Supercomputing Center is participating in different projects around the RISC-V ecosystem and HPC. We are looking for a software engineer that wants to push forward this ecosystem by implementing support for vector support code generation and other features that can speed-up typical HPC applications when running on RISC-V. Key Duties Improve the code generation for the RISC-V Vector Extension to make the most of the available instruction set when it comes to segmented memory accesses. Collaborate with upstream LLVM/Clang to the extent possible and contribute if there is interest in the LLVM community for the implemented features. Requirements Education Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science. Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience Good skills in C++. Experience in compiler development. Knowledge of LLVM and Clang codebases Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience Good knowledge of Linux low level interfaces would be a plus. Knowledge of HPC architectures and systems would be a plus. Competences Have good communication and interpersonal skills to be able to work within a team to complete tasks on schedule. Show a problem-solving, can-do, pro-active and result-oriented attitude. Be keen to deliver good quality code and follow good practices in the industry. Be curious and willing to learn about LLVM, RISC-V and HPC. Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included. Applications without this document will not be considered. We work in an open and collaborative environment where people share ideas, take ownership, and learn from each other.You'll be part of an international team with different backgrounds and expertise, working together on challenging engineering projects. Implement embedded software based on formal designs, with particular attention to security countermeasures and non-functional requirements. Participate in code reviews from both architectural and security perspectives. Verify and validate product behavior against functional and non-functional requirements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure product quality and successful delivery. Drive continuous improvement of software development processes and engineering practices. Qualifications & Skills Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field. Experience with programming and scripting languages such as Java, C, C++, and Python. Knowledge of computer networking fundamentals and cybersecurity concepts. Fluency in written and spoken English. items.desc: The Institute The Centre for Genomic Regulation (CRG) is an international biomedical research institute of excellence, based in Barcelona, Spain, with more than 400 scientists from 44 countries. The CRG is composed by an interdisciplinary, motivated and creative scientific team which is supported both by a flexible and efficient administration and by high-end and innovative technologies. In September 2026, the Centre for Genomic Regulation (CRG) has received the renewal of the 'HR Excellence in Research' Award from the European Commission. This is a recognition of the Institute's commitment to developing an HR Strategy for Researchers, designed to bring the practices and procedures in line with the principles of the European Charter for Researchers and the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers (Charter and Code). Please, check out our Recruitment Policy The role The CRG Bioinformatics Unit is seeking a Bioinformatician to support bioinformatics workflows for high-throughput sequencing technologies, ensuring reliable data processing, quality control, integration of new technologies, and reproducible analysis. The successful candidate will act as a liaison between the CRG Genomics and Bioinformatics Units and contribute to the implementation, evaluation, and benchmarking of new sequencing technologies and associated bioinformatics analyses. Opportunities for conference attendance and career development are available. About the Bioinformatics unit The Bioinformatics Unit supports CRG and external researchers with experimental design, high-throughput sequencing data analysis, software/pipelines and database development, and other scalable bioinformatics solutions that enable reproducible and FAIR research, supported by training and dissemination of best practices. Whom would we like to hire? Professional experience Must have Understanding of experimental design and statistical concepts relevant to high-throughput sequencing data Experience analysing omics data, such as RNA-seq, WGS/WES, or single-cell sequencing data Ability to interpret analysis results in a biological context and identify potential technical or analytical biases Proficiency in R and/or Python, with working knowledge of Bash Experience developing, implementing, or maintaining bioinformatics pipelines Experience with workflow management systems such as Nextflow, Snakemake, or similar Experience with Git for version control and collaborative development Comfortable working in Linux/Unix and high-performance computing (HPC) environments Understanding of reproducibility and good practices in scientific computing Basic experience with container technologies such as Docker or Singularity/Apptainer Experience collaborating with researchers to define analytical approaches and interpret results. Experience providing training and user support Nice to have Experience with software maintenance, testing, and troubleshooting Experience preparing technical documentation and standard operating procedures (SOPs) Familiarity with CI/CD practices Experience supporting technical personnel and operational workflows in a genomics or sequencing technology environment Experience evaluating, benchmarking, or implementing new sequencing technologies or bioinformatics method Education and training PhD or MSc in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, or related field Languages Proficiency in spoken and written English Competences Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities and work independently. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to make independent technical decisions. Clear written and verbal communication skills. Collaborative and service-oriented working style. Ability to communicate effectively with people from different scientific and technical backgrounds, including experimental biologists, laboratory technicians, researchers, software developers, and bioinformaticians. Ability to translate scientific and technical requirements into practical bioinformatics solutions. The Offer – Working Conditions Contract duration: Open-ended technical and scientific activities contract linked to Bioinformatics Unit Estimated annual gross salary: Salary is commensurate with qualifications and consistent with our pay scales Target start date: November 2, 2026 We provide a highly stimulating environment with state-of-the-art infrastructures, and unique professional career development opportunities. To check out our training and development portfolio, please visit our website in the training section. We offer and promote a diverse and inclusive environment and welcomes applicants regardless of age, disability, gender, nationality, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or gender identity. The CRG is committed to reconcile a work and family life of its employees and are offering extended vacation period and the possibility to benefit from flexible working hours.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys organising learning activities, working with different stakeholders and ensuring that training activities run smoothly from planning through delivery, evaluation and reporting. The successful candidate will work closely with the Training and Academic Office team to deliver high-quality, innovative and effective training opportunities for CRG researchers and science support staff , aligned with the institute's strategic priorities and the professional development needs of its different communities. Contribute to the development and implementation of training activities responding to the needs of CRG researchers and science support staff. Manage course information, documentation, registrations and e-learning content through the CRG Learning Management System (LMS) and FUNDAE. Prepare communication and dissemination materials and promote training opportunities across CRG communities. About the department The Training and Academic Office (TAO) was established in 2022 as one of the CRG strategic Office. Education and training Master's degree or equivalent professional experience in life sciences, education/training, research management or another relevant field. Languages Proficiency in English (written and oral) Technical skills Strong command of Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365 . Seguridad: Conocimientos de IAM, controles de seguridad cloud y buenas prácticas de hardening. Habilidades y Mentalidad Clave (Soft Skills): Capacidad para trabajar en equipos multidisciplinares. Orientación a la automatización y mejora continua. Mentalidad analítica y resolución de problemas. Buenas capacidades de comunicación con equipos técnicos. Capacidad para aprender nuevas tecnologías cloud de forma continua. Proactividad y orientación al cliente. Cualificaciones Deseables: Certificaciones Associate o Profesionales de AWS, Azure o Google Cloud. Experiencia en Terraform. Conocimientos de Enterprise Landing Zones. Experiencia en proyectos de migración cloud. Grado en Informática, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones o experiencia equivalente. items.desc: We power people’s progress. At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact. We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale. Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day. Meet the team! Preply’s Copy team works across Brand, CRM, and Product. As Preply grows, we need better ways to understand demand, manage priorities and help our writers deliver consistently at scale. As our Copy Operations Specialist, you will build and improve the operating system for copy at Preply: the workflows, tools, data, and AI-enabled processes that make work visible and keep it moving. We’re looking for a practical problem-solver. Working closely with the Copy team and cross-functional partners, you’ll turn ideas into useful shared systems and help shape what effective AI-enabled work looks like at Preply. What you’ll be doing Help improve how copy work flows Build and maintain a clear, shared view of copy demand, priorities and capacity across the team by bringing together relevant information from tools such as Jira, Slack and squad boards. Improve copy intake so requests arriving in different formats become clear, actionable briefs. Coordinate the team’s weekly prioritization process, highlighting conflicting priorities, dependencies and capacity risks. Identify repetitive coordination tasks that could be simplified or automated, including follow-ups around deadlines, reviews, and handovers. Gather feedback and improve these processes as the volume and complexity of work increase. Apply AI and automation to operations and performance Identify opportunities to reduce operational friction and improve planning, quality, speed, consistency, and learning. Design, test and introduce AI-enabled workflows for areas such as briefing, workflow management, reporting and insight. Turn useful individual experiments into simple, reliable workflows that the wider team can adopt. Create simple automations, dashboards and integrations between tools. Track introduced measures such as adoption, time saved, delivery improvements and quality. Make voice and performance insights easier to use Make Preply’s voice principles easier to apply at scale through practical guidance, systems and checks. Help the team use available performance data to improve copy quality, effectiveness and decision-making. Establish clear processes for multilingual copy projects, partnering with Localization so requests, reviews and decisions move smoothly. Develop repeatable processes for supporting copy in new subjects, markets and languages. Support adoption and collaboration Turn ambiguous operational problems into simple, testable solutions. Support colleagues as new workflows and tools are introduced, gathering feedback and making improvements. Share progress, learnings and results clearly with stakeholders. Build the team’s confidence and capability in using AI responsibly and effectively. What you need to succeed Hands-on experience using AI tools to solve real problems, with evidence of experimenting, learning and evaluating the results. Practical experience improving a process or workflow in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment. A practical, experimental approach: you enjoy trying ideas, gathering feedback and improving what you have built. An ability to think systematically about how people, processes, tools, and information fit together. Confidence in working with data and using it to understand whether something is working. Good organizational skills and the ability to manage several pieces of work at once. Clear communication and the ability to work effectively with people from different teams and areas of expertise. Good judgment about quality, data privacy and human oversight when using AI. Nice to have Experience supporting a copy, content, creative, or brand team would be helpful but is not essential. Experience using performance data or experiment results to improve copy or creative outcomes would also be valuable. You do not need to have experience with every tool we use. You should be comfortable learning new tools, building or configuring simple solutions, and asking for technical support when needed. We care more about your curiosity, judgment, ideas and evidence of what you can do than the number of years you have worked. Why …

items.desc: About Camlin Camlin is a global technology leader that operates with the vision of bringing revolutionary products to life for a wide range of industries, including power and rail, and also has interests in a number of R&D projects in a variety of scientific sectors. At Camlin we believe in high quality engineering and design, allowing us to develop market leading products and services. In short, we love creating value for our customers by solving difficult problems. As of now, Camlin operates in over 20 countries worldwide. WHAT TO EXPECT DAY TO DAY We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Full Stack Software Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will bring a strong background in software engineering, modern technologies, and cloud-based infrastructure. As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you'll play a key role in shaping how we build software. You'll contribute to the selection, adoption, and standardisation of technologies, frameworks, and development processes across multiple projects. Working across both the discovery and delivery phases, you'll help ensure the right technical decisions are made early and take a hands-on role in delivering high-quality solutions on time. You'll have the opportunity to work with the latest technologies and tools, building solutions on infrastructure running within a Kubernetes environment. We actively encourage continuous learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing, giving you the space to explore new ideas and stay ahead of industry trends. items.desc: Join an exciting journey to build and scale a global Media Data Foundation for a leading global organization based in Europe. This platform brings together paid media, digital analytics and marketing performance data from dozens of advertising and measurement platforms. It unlocks reliable media reporting, marketing ROI measurement and data-driven investment decisions across markets. As a Middle Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and implementing the platform's architecture. The focus is on hands-on technical execution and collaboration with cross-functional teams. Your work will turn raw media and marketing data into trusted, harmonised data products used by marketing, media and analytics teams around the world. You will use modern tools to solve complex challenges, working alongside skilled architects, engineers and business stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Hands-On Development: Build, maintain and optimize data pipelines for ingestion, transformation and delivery of media data (Meta, Google Ads, DV360, TikTok, The Trade Desk, GA4, CM360 and others). Create and implement scalable solutions to handle many data sources, frequent API and schema changes, and high volumes of data. Data Modeling & Warehousing: Design and maintain efficient, harmonised data models for cross-platform media reporting in Snowflake. Lead the move of transformation logic to dbt, including orchestration, testing, documentation and CI/CD. Collaboration: Partner with Solution Architects to translate high-level designs into detailed implementation plans. Work closely with Technical Product Owners, media agencies and market teams to align data solutions with business needs. Platform Development: Enable data readiness for media dashboards (Power BI), marketing mix modelling / ROI analytics and campaign taxonomy governance. Implement robust frameworks to monitor data freshness, completeness, quality and pipeline performance, with automated alerting. Security & Compliance: Implement robust access controls and data protection across the pipeline and for data shared with internal and external consumers. Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g. GDPR, CCPA) and internal data governance policies (data product tiers, tagging, naming standards). Monitor and address potential vulnerabilities, including service account and secret management, ensuring the platform follows security best practices. Requirements: 2+ years of experience showing technical expertise and critical thinking in data engineering. Hands-on experience with dbt and strong Python programming skills. Proficiency in Snowflake and strong expertise in data modeling are essential. Demonstrated experience with marketing, media or advertising data (ad platform APIs, campaign hierarchies, web analytics) is required. In-depth understanding of security and governance in Snowflake: RBAC, secure views, data sharing, masking and row access policies, object tagging. Ability to design, implement and promote solution patterns and standards for complex, multi-source data platforms. Familiarity with multiple cloud platforms (Azure or GCP preferred, with a focus on Azure, including ADF). Experience with ETL/ELT and data integration tools (Adverity, Fivetran or similar) and batch orchestration. Competence in SQL, relational database design and efficient methods for data retrieval and preparation at scale. Proven ability to collect and process raw data at scale, including scripting, REST API integration and SQL querying. Experience with BI tools (Power BI preferred) and supporting reporting consumers. Experience working in global environments and collaborating with virtual teams and external agencies. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Economics or a related discipline. items.desc: Job Description: An opportunity for an Aircraft Static Loads Engineer within Flight Physics has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). This position is offered to people with the Official Master Degree in Aeronautical Engineering on top of the Official Undergraduate Degree in Aerospace Engineering. It is kindly requested to attach the academic reports of both Bachelor and Master Degrees. We are looking for people having excellent academic reports, especially in the subjects related to Flight Physics, focused in the following areas (but not only in them): 1) Flight Mechanics, Aircraft Design, Aeroelasticity. 2) Aerodynamics, Structures. 3) Maths, Programming. 4) Control Systems, Propulsion. RESPONSIBILITIES Our domain is involved in a wide variety of programs, like military tactical transports (CN-235, C-295, A400M, FMTC), Airbus derivatives and tankers (A330 MRTT, A321-AEW), fighters (EF-2000, FCAS), UAVs (Eurodrone, Sirtap) and technological programs. The main activities that are done in these programs are: Loads models building for flight and ground loads. Management of 6DOF simulation codes for manoeuvre and gust conditions. Load analysis for design, fatigue, 1g, failure cases and operational loads, including trade-offs for sensitivity studies. Nodal loads generation for FEM (NASTRAN). Clearances of flight and ground loads to achieve "Permits to Fly" of prototypes. Specification, tracking and analysis of Flight Tests, regarding loads measurements, with post-flight adjustment of load models if needed. Continuous software development and maintenance of methods and tools for loads calculation. Writing certification documents and presentation to Airworthiness Authorities. Continuous airworthiness support and fleet analysis. Continuous support to aircraft preliminary design. SKILLS To perform the above passionate tasks, the members of our team have: A great entushiasm and predilection for technical work. A multidisciplinary profile and great learning capacity. Good analytical and synthesis capabilities. Ability to make decisions and present alternatives. Great teamwork skills. Advanced level of English. WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? items.desc: Göteborgs universitet möter samhällets utmaningar med mångsidig kunskap. 37 000 studenter och 6 000 medarbetare gör universitetet till en stor och inspirerande arbetsplats, flödande av kunskap och idéer. Stark forskning och attraktiva utbildningar lockar forskare och studenter från hela världen. Göteborgs universitet är miljöcertifierat och arbetar aktivt för hållbar utveckling. Med ny kunskap och nya perspektiv bidrar universitetet till en bättre framtid. Universitetet arbetar aktivt för en arbetsmiljö med jämställda förhållanden och sätter värde på de kvalitéer mångfald tillför verksamheten. Handelshögskolan har, med sina drygt 3 700 helårsstudenter, 470 anställda, 160 internationella partneruniversitet, sina huvudämnen - ekonomi och juridik - och fyra institutioner en unik bredd. Unik är också skolans nära samverkan med näringsliv och offentlig sektor. Handelshögskolan är ackrediterad av EQUIS, AACSB och AMBA och är därmed den enda handelshögskola i Sverige som är Triple Crown-ackrediterad. Företagsekonomiska institutionen är den största institutionen vid Handelshögskolan och bedriver omfattande forskning och utbildning på grund- och avancerad nivå och forskarutbildning inom ämnena företagsekonomi och ekonomisk geografi. Institutionen har cirka 150 anställda och är uppdelad i fyra sektioner: Industriell och finansiell ekonomi & Logistik, Management & Organisation, Marknadsföring samt Redovisning. Arbetsuppgifter Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar att stödja forskare och lärare i användningen av AI-baserade analysmiljöer, lokala språkmodeller och GU IT beräkningsresurser. I uppdraget ingår att utveckla, uppdatera och undervisa i en kurs där studenter lär sig använda Python för datahantering och analys, inklusive praktiska moment där studenter arbetar med GU IT beräkningsytor och lokala språkmodeller. Arbetet innefattar även stöd till forskare genom att identifiera relevanta tekniska lösningar, förstå metod- och analysbehov ur ett ekonomiskt och forskningsmässigt perspektiv och bidra till att översätta dessa behov till fungerande arbetsflöden i dialog med Bitlab och GU IT. En viktig del av arbetet är att löpande följa den tekniska utvecklingen inom AI, programmering, dataanalys och beräkningsmiljöer samt bedöma hur nya verktyg och metoder kan användas i Handelshögskolans forskning och undervisning. Kvalifikationer För uppdraget söker vi i första hand en person med utbildning på avancerad nivå inom ett ekonomiskt ämnesområde, särskilt redovisning, finans eller nationalekonomi, kombinerat med en stark profil inom dataanalys och programmering. Även närliggande ekonomiska utbildningar kan vara relevanta om de innefattar en tydlig kvantitativ och teknisk inriktning. Särskilt meriterande är dokumenterad erfarenhet av Pythonbaserad datahantering och analys, exempelvis genom avancerade kurser, självständiga projekt eller examensarbete. Den sökande bör ha god förståelse för kvantitativa metoder och regressionsanalys samt erfarenhet av eller intresse för textanalys, maskininlärning, AI-baserade analysmiljöer och lokala språkmodeller. Erfarenhet av att praktiskt tillämpa programmering och dataanalys på ekonomiska frågeställningar, exempelvis inom ramen för en masteruppsats, forskningsprojekt eller liknande arbete, är särskilt meriterande. Vi värdesätter förmågan att förstå ekonomiska forskningsfrågor och att koppla samman ämneskunskap och metodbehov med lämpliga tekniska lösningar. Stor vikt läggs vid analytisk förmåga, tekniskt intresse, pedagogisk förmåga och vilja att snabbt sätta sig in i nya verktyg och arbetsflöden. Den sökande bör trivas i gränslandet mellan ekonomi, forskning och teknik och kunna kommunicera med forskare, lärare, studenter och teknisk personal. Förmågan att omsätta ekonomiska och forskningsmässiga behov till praktiska lösningar för forskning och undervisning är central för rollen. Anställning Anställningen är 100 % av heltid med placering under företagsekonomiska institutionen. Start för anställning är 1 januari 2027 eller enligt överenskommelse. Anställningen är tidsbegränsad till och med 2027-12-31. Sista dag kan komma att förskjutas beroende på startdatum. Analysenheten söker nu en digital utredare som vill kombinera utredningsarbete med programmering, AI och digital utveckling. Du arbetar tillsammans med kollegor med olika specialistkompetenser och får goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling samt att delta i verksamhetens utveckling. Vårt kontor, där alla medarbetare har egna rum, ligger i centrala Katrineholm. Det finns bra förbindelser till bland annat Stockholm, Eskilstuna, Västerås och Norrköping. Vi erbjuder goda möjligheter till distansarbete och möjlighet att arbeta under restiden för dig som pendlar. På myndigheten arbetar medarbetare med bakgrund inom bland annat statsvetenskap, nationalekonomi, juridik och statistik. Läs mer om oss på https://www.iaf.se/jobba-hos-oss/. Arbetsuppgifter Som digital utredare kombinerar du utredningsarbete med teknisk kompetens. Du arbetar med tillsyn och granskning och bidrar till att utveckla IAF: s förmåga att granska digitala och automatiserade processer och system. Du kommer bland annat att: utveckla interna digitala verktyg och metoder för tillsyn och granskning genomföra analyser av stora datamaterial, exempelvis med hjälp av textanalys, programmering, generativ AI och maskininlärning delta i och leda projektgrupper vid granskningar analysera och värdera resultat samt dra slutsatser utifrån genomförda granskningar strukturera och skriva rapporter samt presentera resultat muntligt. Våra granskningar genomförs ofta i tvärprofessionella grupper med kompetenser från olika delar av IAF. Resultaten redovisas vanligtvis i rapporter och presenteras även muntligt för de verksamheter vi granskar och för regeringen. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har relevant högskoleutbildning inom exempelvis systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, statistik, informatik eller annat område som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant. Du kan också ha förvärvat motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Vi söker dig som har: goda kunskaper i programmering och erfarenhet av att använda programmering för analys eller utveckling kunskap om generativ AI och maskininlärning samt förståelse för hur teknikerna kan användas i praktiken god förståelse för hur digitala och automatiserade system är uppbyggda och fungerar förmåga att analysera stora och komplexa informationsmängder mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska, både i tal och skrift. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av: att utveckla digitala verktyg eller applikationer textanalys, NLP (naturlig språkbehandling) eller andra metoder för att analysera stora mängder text att arbeta med eller granska automatiserade besluts- eller handläggningssystem AI- eller maskininlärningsprojekt i praktisk verksamhet utrednings-, analys- eller granskningsarbete arbete inom offentlig sektor. Personliga kompetenser För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha följande personliga kompetenser: Samarbetsförmåga: Du är lyhörd, kommunicerar tydligt och respektfullt samt hanterar olika perspektiv på ett konstruktivt sätt. Du bidrar till ett gott samarbete med andra. Utvecklingsorientering: Du är öppen för nya idéer, metoder och arbetssätt. Du ser möjligheter till förbättringar och tar initiativ till att omsätta idéer i praktiken. Pedagogisk insikt: Du har förmåga att förklara tekniskt komplexa frågor på ett tydligt och begripligt sätt. Du anpassar hur du förmedlar information och kunskap utifrån mottagarens förutsättningar och förkunskaper. Problemlösande analysförmåga: Du har förmåga att analysera komplexa frågor, identifiera samband och bryta ner problem i hanterbara delar för att hitta lösningar. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga kompetenser. Arbetstid/varaktighet Heltid. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning. IAF tillämpar provanställning under längst sex månader. Vi ger dig en timmes friskvård i veckan och friskvårdsersättning. Vi erbjuder också trevliga friskvårdsaktiviteter tillsammans med dina arbetskamrater. Anställningsinformation Tillträde snarast, efter överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning.
