items.desc: Join Our Adult Audiology Team An opportunity has arisen to join our friendly and supportive team. Who We’re Looking For: Whether you are newly qualified or have more experience, we invite you to be part of these exciting developments. Benefits of Joining Our Team: Option of compressed hours Training and development opportunities Preceptorship programme for early professionals A supportive and collaborative ENT team An excellent location near London, Heathrow, and the Surrey countryside If you are passionate about audiology and eager to contribute to a dynamic and evolving team, we would love to hear from you. You will: Be delivering high-quality audiology care. Perform hearing assessments, hearing aid fittings and follow up care for adults. Provide diagnostic support to ENT clinics, including some paediatric testing. Work both independently and as part of a team. Demonstrate excellent communication and interpersonal skills with patients, carers, and other professionals. Participate in service development. We provide care at Ashford Hospital, St Peter's Hospital and Woking Community Hospital in Surrey. Ashford and St. Peters Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust is the largest provider of acute hospital services to Surrey residents, serving a population of 410,00 people and employing approximately 4,800 staff. Our vision is to provide an outstanding experience and best outcomes for patients and the team. We are committed to providing continuous professional development and flexibility to deliver our workforce plan. We work in partnership with Royal Surrey Hospital NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities. St Peter’s Hospital delivers complex medical and surgical care, maternity and emergency services. Day and Orthopaedic surgery, ophthalmology and outpatient services are delivered at Ashford Hospital. Additional services are delivered at Woking Community Hospital. Our Values provide us with the behaviours we respect and can commit to. By living our values through our everyday interactions, we can build a stronger, more resilient, and forward- thinking organisation, guiding us to achieve success and make a positive impact on how we deliver our services. We can offer you the full range of NHS benefits and discounts. Please note that adverts may close early, so early application is encouraged. For more information about careers at ASPH please visit: www.asph-careers.org For the main duties and responsibilities for this role please read the attached job description and person specification. When completing your application please ensure your supporting statement reflects the criteria set out in these documents by showing how your experience and skills apply to this post.

items.title: Employment Specialist
items.card: the role. Conditions apply. What you’ll be doing: Southdown’s Work & Wellbeing Service helps people accessing treatment for mental health support, back into employment. As an Employment Specialist, you’ll be working in partnership with Sussex Partnership Foundation Trust and co-located within the Neighbourhood Mental Health Team, with some remote and community-based working. Working as part of the Secondary Mental
items.desc: Description Location : Hailsham base, co-located in Uckfield Hours : 37 per week Base Salary : £28,640 per year Technical Premium* : 5% additional to salary of £1,432 per year (based on base salary) effective from 1 April 2026 - reviewed annually. The technical premium is paid in addition to the base salary in recognition of the external benchmarking for the role. Conditions apply. What you’ll be doing: Southdown’s Work & Wellbeing Service helps people accessing treatment for mental health support, back into employment. As an Employment Specialist, you’ll be working in partnership with Sussex Partnership Foundation Trust and co-located within the Neighbourhood Mental Health Team, with some remote and community-based working. Working as part of the Secondary Mental Health Care team, you’ll support clients in treatment for varied mental health issues, assisting them in securing sustainable paid employment in line with their preferences. You will deliver the Individual Placement and Support (IPS) model; providing person centred guidance to clients, whilst building positive relationships with local employers to enable clients to move into suitable employment. Do you understand the importance of work and the vital role it can play in the lives of those with mental health conditions? Here’s a short video about a day in the life of our mental health Employment Specialist: A day in the life of an IPS Employment Specialist We welcome applications from candidates with previous experience such as Employability Practitioner, Employment Specialist, Recruiter, Employment Advisor, Employment Support Officer, Career Specialist or Job Coach. Or you may be looking for a new challenge and believe you have the transferable skills to support individuals to fulfill their employment goals. Perks and benefits: Health cost cash-back scheme: access to our health insurance scheme which covers dental, optical, physical therapies and other medical treatments with the option to add greater levels of cover. Interest-free loans: assistance with larger costs that arise such as tenancy deposits, season travel tickets or buying a car. Access to the Easit Network: discounts and incentives on train, bus and car journeys such as 15% off eligible daily and season rail tickets. Blue Light card: access to discount services for the social care sector with savings across thousands of online shops, restaurants, and high-street vendors. Free advice and counselling service: confidential emotional support and practical guidance from our independent telephone service. 25 days paid holiday plus bank holidays. Knowledge, skills and experience What you’ll need for the role: You will need exceptional communication skills, be reactive to the differing needs of the client and be able to adapt your approach as appropriate. An understanding of the employment needs and challenges for people experiencing mental health issues Knowledge of the principles of co-production and a personalised care approach An Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check, which will be paid for by Southdown A full driving licence is essential along with access to your own vehicle or a vehicle insured for you What would be nice: Experience supporting clients experiencing mental health challenges, including those in crisis and/or facing complex challenges. Training: Our award winning in house training team will help you to gain valuable qualifications, continually develop your skills and build a great career with the largest provider of housing, care and support in Sussex. How to apply: Please click on the ‘Apply Now’ button and fill out our simple one-page application form. The application closing date is 1 November 2026 and interviews will be held on 9 November 2026. Please note, if we receive a large number of applications then this position may close before the advertised application closing date. We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. About Southdown Contact information: Our online careers page has a list of helpful FAQs that you can view here . If you have any further questions, please get in touch with recruitment via email at jobs@southdown.org We are a Disability Confident Employer and are fully committed to supporting Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion (EDI) and welcome applications from all candidates that meet our job specifications. If you feel there is a barrier that potentially prevents you from applying, do get in contact with us, as we are always happy to discuss (or arrange a discussion with the recruiting manager) to explore if any reasonable adjustments can be made to support your application.

items.desc: Job Overview We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Graphic & Multimedia Designer / Animator to bring visual concepts to life across various digital platforms. This role offers an exciting opportunity to craft compelling graphics, animations, and multimedia content that captivate audiences and elevate brand storytelling. The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in graphic design, animation, and video editing, combined with technical expertise in industry-standard tools and programming languages. Join us to shape engaging visual experiences that inspire and inform! Duties Develop high-quality 2D and 3D animations, motion graphics, and multimedia content for diverse projects including marketing campaigns, product demos, and digital media. Design visually striking graphics using Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) to support branding, advertising, and user interface needs. Create detailed 3D models and environments utilizing Cinema 4D, Maya, 3ds Max, ZBrush, Mudbox, or similar tools for use in animations or interactive applications. Implement animations and interactive elements within game engines such as Unity and Unreal Engine using C#, C++, Python, or other scripting languages. Edit videos with Adobe Premiere and After Effects to produce polished promotional materials, tutorials, or social media content. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and deliver creative solutions on time. Maintain version control and project organization using tools like Perforce to ensure seamless collaboration across teams. Skills Proficiency in graphic design software including Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Adobe Creative Suite. Strong experience with animation software such as Adobe After Effects, Cinema 4D, Maya, 3ds Max, ZBrush, Mudbox. Knowledge of game development tools like Unity and Unreal Engine; experience with C#, C++, Python scripting is a plus. Skilled in video editing techniques using Adobe Premiere; capable of producing engaging visual narratives. Familiarity with version control systems like Perforce for managing project assets efficiently. Understanding of anatomy principles to create realistic character models and animations. Ability to work with 3D modeling software such as Maya or 3ds Max; experience with texturing tools like ZBrush or Mudbox is advantageous. items.title: Technical Solutions Engineer
items.card: The Role AI is changing what "technical support" means at a fast-growing SaaS company. The old model was reactive: wait for a ticket, dig through logs, escalate up a chain until someone senior enough could unblock it. Increasingly, the first pass on an integration failure or a broken workflow can be directed rather than done line by line by hand: AI can trace through logs, draft hypotheses, and suggest fixes fast.
items.desc: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails , and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . The Role AI is changing what "technical support" means at a fast-growing SaaS company. The old model was reactive: wait for a ticket, dig through logs, escalate up a chain until someone senior enough could unblock it. Increasingly, the first pass on an integration failure or a broken workflow can be directed rather than done line by line by hand: AI can trace through logs, draft hypotheses, and suggest fixes fast. The job shifts with it. Instead of grinding through every stack trace yourself, you direct AI to accelerate the investigation and apply what AI can't: judgment on whether a fix is safe to ship into a live enterprise environment, whether the root cause is actually fixed or just patched, and whether this is a one-off or a pattern worth escalating to Product. As Omnea's Technical Solutions Engineer, you're the senior technical presence sitting between Customer, Product, and Engineering. You own Omnea's most complex customer-facing technical problems end to end - gnarly integrations, cross-system issues, escalations nobody else can crack. You're the person the team calls in when something's on fire, and you're just as comfortable stepping into a customer's implementation when it gets technical. This is a foundational hire. You'll set the technical bar for how Omnea supports enterprise customers, and help define how the function grows from here. What You'll Do Own the hardest technical problems: Lead investigation and resolution of Omnea's most complex customer issues - integrations, configuration edge cases, cross-system bugs. Direct AI to accelerate the first pass, then apply the judgment AI can't: is this safe to ship, is the root cause actually fixed. Be the SWAT team between Customer, Product, and Engineering: Act as the senior escalation point when an issue is beyond what the Customer team can resolve alone, and the technical voice in the room when Product and Engineering need to understand what's really happening on the ground. Get technical inside implementations: Step into live implementations when they hit technical complexity - tricky integrations, custom logic, unusual data flows - and work directly with the implementation team to get them unstuck. Feed the product roadmap: Spot patterns across the issues you resolve and turn them into clear, well-scoped input for Product and Engineering, so the same problem doesn't need solving twice. Build the standards as you go: Document what you learn, build the tooling and playbooks for triaging and resolving complex technical issues, and raise the bar for technical quality as the team grows around you. What's Different About This Role You'll spend more time directing AI through the first pass of an investigation than manually tracing every log line yourself. AI narrows down the likely cause fast; your job is confirming it's right and safe to act on. Writing a sharp, specific brief for what you want AI to investigate or fix is now a core skill, not a nice-to-have. Judgment on production risk matters more, not less: AI can suggest a fix in minutes, but you decide whether it's safe for a live enterprise environment. You'll keep experimenting with AI tooling as it evolves, and bring what works back to the rest of the team. About You We don't expect you to have done this exact job before. TL;DR: you're a technical, customer-facing problem-solver who's as comfortable elbow-deep in an API integration as you are explaining what went wrong to a CFO's technical lead. 3-8+ years in a customer-facing technical role - technical support engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, or similar - at a fast-growing SaaS company A technical background: a Computer Science or …

items.desc: Role Title: Heavy Mineral Technician Grade and Salary: Grade 7 - £38,448 - £48,337 per annum FTE and working pattern: Full-time (35hrs per week) Fixed term for 12 months Reward and Benefits: 33 days annual leave, plus 9 buildings closed days for all full-time staff. Detailed Description We are seeking a Heavy Mineral Technician to support geological research through the preparation and processing of rock and sediment samples in our mineral separation laboratory at Heriot-Watt University. The successful candidate will carry out sample preparation, separate heavy minerals for subsequent analysis, and support the day-to-day operation of the laboratory. The role requires a careful, methodical approach, strong organisational skills and a commitment to safe laboratory working. Applicants should hold a BSc in geoscience or a related scientific discipline that includes practical laboratory work. Training will be provided in specialist mineral separation techniques and the completion and use of Control of Substances Hazardous to Health (COSHH) assessment forms. Key Duties and Responsibilities The successful candidate will: Receive, label, catalogue and store geological samples, maintaining accurate records throughout processing. Prepare rock and sediment samples using appropriate methods, including drying, disaggregation, crushing and sieving. Separate and recover heavy mineral fractions using heavy-liquid and magnetic separation techniques, following training and approved procedures. Use a microscope to examine mineral separates and pick grains where required. Prepare, label and store mineral fractions for subsequent mineralogical and geochronological analysis. Maintain detailed records of processing methods, sample weights, mineral yields and any deviations from standard procedures. Prevent cross-contamination through careful sample handling and thorough cleaning of equipment. Handle, store and dispose of chemicals and laboratory waste in accordance with approved procedures. Assist with preparing and updating COSHH forms, risk assessments and laboratory procedures, with appropriate training and supervision. Undertake routine equipment checks, maintain laboratory cleanliness and report faults or safety concerns. Monitor consumables and chemical stocks, identifying replenishment needs. Coordinate sample-processing priorities with researchers and technical staff to meet project deadlines. Person Specification Essential A BSc in geology, geoscience, mineralogy, chemistry or a related scientific discipline, including practical laboratory training. Practical experience of laboratory work gained through a degree, research project or employment. An understanding of safe laboratory practice, including the importance of chemical safety, appropriate protective equipment and following risk assessments. Ability to follow detailed procedures accurately and maintain consistent standards during repetitive sample-processing tasks. Strong attention to detail, particularly in sample labelling, record keeping and contamination prevention. Good organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple samples at different processing stages. Confidence using spreadsheets and digital systems to maintain laboratory records. Ability to work independently following training, recognise problems and seek guidance when required. Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with researchers, students and technical colleagues. Willingness to undertake training in mineral separation methods, COSHH assessments and equipment operation. Desirable Experience working in a geological or mineral separation laboratory. Experience preparing rock or sediment samples, including crushing, disaggregation or sieving. Familiarity with heavy-liquid or magnetic separation techniques. Knowledge of mineralogy and the physical properties used to separate minerals. Experience using a binocular microscope for mineral identification or grain picking. Experience preparing mineral separates for automated mineralogy or geochronology. Familiarity with COSHH documentation, chemical inventories and laboratory waste management. Experience carrying out routine equipment checks and maintaining laboratory supplies. Training and Development Training will be tailored to the successful candidate's experience and will cover specialist sample preparation and mineral separation methods, safe chemical handling, equipment operation, quality control and COSHH documentation. Previous experience of heavy mineral separation is desirable but is not essential. We may close this vacancy early if we receive a high volume of applications. We therefore encourage you to submit your application promptly. We recognise that many …

items.desc:
Role highlights: 
 RF Test Engineer
 Location: Valencia
 Reports to: Laboratory Lead & Test Architect
 Employment type: Permanent
 Workplace model: Hybrid
 Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)
 Why this role matters: 
 As an RF Test Engineer, you’ll capture real signals from real hardware and build the system that plays them back through a channel simulator. ICEYE is building a space-based RF constellation covering 100 MHz to 30 GHz alongside its SAR fleet, and the Experimentation Lab in Valencia is where we develop, simulate and validate that capability.
 Our processing, on the ground today and on board from Gen 2, is only as good as the signals we test it against. Today we have some synthetic I/Q, a few captures and a lot of assumptions. You’ll help us build a library of real emitter signals with known truth, plus a way to replay them as a satellite would hear them, with LEO Doppler, delay, path loss and interference, coherently across several satellites at once.
 You’ll be one of the first engineers in the lab, with direct influence on how ICEYE builds and proves this capability.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
 ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
 Your day-to-day responsibilities 
 Capture real emissions: bring emitters into the lab (marine radars, AIS and ADS-B transponders, satcom terminals, partner-supplied equipment), operate them in a controlled, screened setup, and record them at the right bandwidth, dynamic range and timing accuracy. Extend this to field and airborne collection.
 Characterise captures: turn raw recordings into library entries with I/Q in a documented format (SigMF or equivalent), measured parameters (PRI, pulse width, scan, chirp, hopping, modulation), metadata and truth, so someone who wasn’t there can reuse them.
 Build the generate and playback chain: specify, integrate and calibrate the RF record and playback system (SDRs, vector signal generators, arbitrary waveform generators and multi-channel playback), from a single emitter up to a dense scene.
 Build the channel simulator path: apply per-satellite delay, Doppler, Doppler rate, path loss, multipath and interference to recorded and synthetic signals, phase-coherently across channels and driven by geometry from the simulation software.
 Develop test hardware and software: fixtures, RF interconnect, switching, attenuation and calibration paths, plus the Python code that controls and automates your instruments, so every measurement runs as a script.
 Feed the end-to-end loop: inject signals into the flatsat, receivers and processing chain, work with the simulation team so RF stimulus and simulated truth line up in time and frequency, and support algorithm validation campaigns.
 Keep operations lawful and safe: work with the regulator, site safety and partners on screened operation, test identities (MMSI, ICAO address) and RF exposure limits for everything that transmits.
 What we’re looking for 
 Must haves: 
 Hands-on RF measurement and signal capture experience with spectrum and real-time signal analysers, vector signal generators, SDRs and oscilloscopes, and the judgement to spot a clipped, aliased or contaminated capture
 Experience building or integrating an RF record and playback, signal generation or hardware-in-the-loop test system
 Solid DSP fundamentals: sampling, I/Q, filtering, channelisation, Doppler and timing effects, and how each shows up in a recording
 Python (or equivalent) for instrument control, automation and analysis, with comfort in SCPI/VISA and SDR APIs
 Calibration discipline: reference planes, path loss and phase characterisation, and an uncertainty you can defend
 Clear written and spoken English
 Nice to haves: 
 Radar, ELINT, ESM or EW background, especially with pulsed and frequency-agile emitters
 Experience with channel emulators or fading simulators (for example PROPSIM or Vertex) or a home-built equivalent, and satellite or LEO link simulation
 Multi-channel phase-coherent systems, precision timing (GPSDO, PPS, White Rabbit) or TDOA/FDOA test
 GNU Radio, MATLAB, UHD, VITA 49, SigMF
 Microwave work above 18 GHz, anechoic and screened-room operation, …

Role highlights: 
 Test Engineer
 Location: Valencia
 Reports to: Laboratory Lead and Test Architect
 Employment type: Permanent
 Workplace model: Onsite
 Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)
 Why this role matters: 
 As our Lab Test Engineer, you’ll plan, run, automate and document the lab’s tests across simulation, signal capture, playback and hardware in the loop, so results are repeatable and trusted. ICEYE is building a space-based RF constellation covering 100 MHz to 30 GHz alongside its SAR fleet, and the Experimentation Lab in Valencia is where we develop, simulate and validate that capability. We simulate the constellation and its emitters end to end, capture real signals from real hardware, and generate and play back signals through a channel simulator for end-to-end runs and algorithm validation.
 A lab that only its builders can operate becomes shelfware. Specialists will build the simulation, the capture system and the playback chain, and you’ll turn those into tests that run reliably, on schedule, with traceable results. The role covers the full breadth of the lab: setting up hardware, running campaigns, automating procedures, keeping equipment calibrated and inventoried, and producing evidence that engineers and customers can rely on.
 You’ll have an early seat in a new lab, with direct influence on how ICEYE builds and proves this capability.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
 ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
 Your day-to-day responsibilities 
 Plan and run tests across all three lab missions: end-to-end simulation runs, emitter capture sessions, playback and channel simulator campaigns, flatsat and receiver tests, and algorithm validation.
 Write procedures and automate them: turn manual setups into scripted, repeatable test sequences, and add them to regression so each software or firmware build is checked.
 Set up and maintain the lab: instruments, SDRs, cabling, fixtures, the screened enclosure and emitter bays, network and compute. Track calibration, configuration and inventory so every result records what produced it.
 Manage test data: keep recordings, run outputs and metadata organised, searchable and backed up, with the provenance to reproduce a result.
 Analyse and report: compare results to expectations and to previous runs, flag regressions and anomalies, write concise test reports, and log issues with the evidence needed to fix them.
 Support campaigns in the field and in the air, customer and partner demonstrations, and the reproduction of on-orbit anomalies on the ground.
 Run the lab safely: RF safety, ESD, equipment handling, access control and the handling rules for controlled material.
 What we’re looking for 
 Must haves: 
 Hands-on test experience in an electronics, RF, space or comparable hardware lab: test setups, procedures, execution and reporting
 Comfort with lab instruments (oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, signal generators, power supplies) and basic RF practice (connectors, attenuators, cable loss)
 Scripting for test automation and data analysis, typically Python
 An organised and rigorous way of working: you write things down, version them, and can reproduce last month’s result
 Clear written English
 Nice to haves: 
 Satellite AIT, flatsat or hardware-in-the-loop testing
 SDR experience, RF capture or signal analysis
 Test automation frameworks, CI pipelines, instrument control (SCPI/VISA)
 Test data management, databases, dashboards
 Verification under a formal process (ECSS or similar)
 Experience setting up a lab from scratch: equipment selection, layout, safety, calibration programme
 Spanish, for working with local suppliers and facilities
 Eligibility for national security clearance (an advantage)
 What success looks like 
 6 months: lab equipment is inventoried, calibrated and configuration-tracked, and capture and playback sessions run from written procedures, with data stored and findable.
 12 months: core tests are automated and running in regression, test reports are produced routinely, and you’ve supported the first field campaign.
 24 months: the lab runs as a service. Other teams book and run tests with …

 As a Software Engineer, Simulation and Modeling, you’ll build the software world the satellites live in (orbits, emitters, signals, truth and scoring) so the whole team can ask “what if” and get a number back. ICEYE is building a space-based RF constellation covering 100 MHz to 30 GHz alongside its SAR fleet, and the Experimentation Lab in Valencia is where we develop, simulate and validate that capability.

It doesn’t exist yet. You’ll build it, and it will become a tool used by engineers, analysts and customer-facing staff.

 Model the constellation: orbit propagation, cluster geometry, attitude and pointing, antenna beams, access and contact windows, with spacing and timing as swept variables.

items.desc:
Your mission at Voi 
 For the Fleet Specialist position, you’ll have the opportunity to work across two main operational areas, with tasks allocated by the line manager based on business needs.
 In our mechanical team , you’ll focus on the maintenance and repair of our vehicles, keeping our scooters in excellent condition and providing crucial support to colleagues in the field.
 In our in‑field team , you’ll use our vans to carry out different tasks around the London area, ensuring our operations run safely, smoothly and reliably for our riders.
 Depending on daily priorities and workload, your line manager will assign you to one area or the other, giving you variety in your day‑to‑day while making sure we cover the most important operational needs. Here are some of the tasks awaiting you as a Fleet Specialist: 
 Ensuring the logistics of collecting and deploying Voi scooters ⚙️
 Searching for and collecting damaged scooters 🛴
 Replacing batteries so vehicles are always ready to ride 🔋
 Performing quick on‑site repairs of scooters 🔧
 Diagnosing and repairing broken vehicles 🔧
 Recycling and dismantling vehicles that cannot be repaired ♻️
 Assisting with the acceptance, packaging and preparation of new vehicles and batteries arriving at the warehouse 🔍
 Supporting our on‑site team as needed – for example, identifying damaged vehicles, clearing parking spaces or setting up fallen vehicles 🤝 You’ll work closely with a supportive team that shares knowledge and helps each other out.
 What you’ll need to embark 
 Mandatory requirement – You must hold a full UK driving licence for at least 12 months, with no more than 6 points and no major offences, to meet our e‑van insurance requirements. Licence checks will be conducted during the recruitment process. As part of the role, you will drive one of our company e‑vans. 
 Good knowledge of your city and feeling comfortable driving there.
 A responsible team player who can manage tasks independently and also enjoys working together with others.
 Willingness to share knowledge, support colleagues and contribute to a positive, respectful team culture.
 A practical, solution‑oriented mindset – you like getting things done and helping the team reach its goals.
 Comfortable navigating the city in a van in different weather and traffic conditions.
 Ability to stay calm and courteous in stressful situations (e.g. poor parking, traffic).
 A physical condition that allows you to safely handle and move scooters and batteries, using the equipment and support provided. PLEASE NOTE: You may be required to go through a DBS Check for this role. 
 Job conditions 
 Working shifts : Friday - Tuesday 08:00-16:00 
 Working hours: 37.5 hours per week
 Contract type: 6‑month fixed‑term contract
 Why Voi? 
 Working at Voi is more than just a job; it’s a personal Voiage where you can grow professionally and be part of a diverse team and culture committed to making a positive impact on society.
 At Voi, you’ll:
 Join Europe’s leading micromobility company and one of the fastest‑growing scale‑ups
 Make a direct impact on our success and contribute to the development of the micromobility industry in London.
 Collaborate with inspiring, motivated and diverse colleagues who share a common goal
 Be part of the micromobility revolution and help create sustainable cities that are cleaner, quieter and less polluted.
 We’re committed to fair, transparent and ethical recruitment practices. All recruitment costs are covered by Voi – no recruitment fees or related costs are ever charged to workers at any stage of the hiring process. We work only with recruitment partners who share our commitment to ethical practices and regularly review our processes to protect workers’ rights and promote a safe and respectful experience for all candidates. We’re also committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We particularly welcome applications from women and other under‑represented groups in logistics, operations and technical roles.
 Are you ready to embark on the Voiage with us?

Нашата цел е да бъдем банката за бъдещето на Европа и търсим хора, които имат желание да поемат с нас в тази посока. Ключово за отношенията и процесите, които градим, е те да са най-добър пример в прилагането на принципите за многообразие и равнопоставеност и в утвърждаването на приобщаваща среда за всички.
 Бизнесът ни създава инвестиции, ресурси и нови възможности, които стимулират развитието на нашите служители, като им предоставят уникално и динамично професионално преживяване. Ще се радваме да допълните екипа ни с вашите таланти и силни страни и да изградите кариера, в която ще бъдете възнаградени подобаващо за постиженията ви.
 Ние ще ти дадем възможност да
 ● Предлагаш пълната гама от банкови продукти и услуги за физически лица;
 ● Активно участие в кампании за продажба на продукти и услуги, запознаване и използване на най-успешните търговски техники;
 ● Извършване на касови и безкасови операции при стриктно спазване на действащите вътрешно-банкови нормативни актове;
 ● Стремеж към повишаване качеството на обслужване на клиентите, проявяване на активно отношение при възникващи проблеми и разрешаването им.
 В теб търсим
 ● Търговски умения, ориентираност към клиента;
 ● Добри комуникативни и презентационни умения;
 ● Познания по английски език (ще се считат като предимство);
 ● Компютърна грамотност;
 ● Икономическо образование (ще се счита за предимство);
 ● Сходен опит в банковата сфера или опит на търговска позиция (ще се счита за предимство).
 При нас ще откриеш
 ● Коледен бонус;
 ● Ваучери за храна в размер на 102.26 евро;
 ● Кредити при преференциални условия;
 ● 25 дни отпуск;
 ● Платен почивен ден и подарък за рожден ден;
 ● Платен почивен ден за доброволчество;
 ● Разнообразни възможности за обучение и развитие;
 ● Допълнително здравно осигуряване;
 ● MultiSport карти и обновени фитнес зали в централата ни;
 ● Програма „Препоръчай приятел“.

 In der Privatkundenbank begleiten wir unsere Kund:innen ganzheitlich in allen Finanzfragen – über alle Lebensphasen hinweg. Dabei orientieren wir uns an den sich wandelnden Bedürfnissen unserer Kund:innen: Persönliche Beratung bildet den Kern unseres Angebots und geht Hand in Hand mit leistungsstarken, kontinuierlich weiterentwickelten digitalen Services. Unser Anspruch ist es, mit modernen Filialkonzepten, flexiblen Zugangswegen und innovativen Technologien ein nahtloses Kundenerlebnis zu schaffen. 
 Das erwartet Dich bei uns
 Du bist der erste Eindruck:  Mit Deinem Lächeln und Deiner Kompetenz empfängst Du Kund:innen am Schalter und in der SB-Zone. 
 Du übernimmst Verantwortung:  Kassengeschäfte? Erledigst Du zuverlässig. Kundenanliegen? Klärst Du direkt oder leitest sie gezielt weiter. 
 Du bringst Digitales näher:  Du zeigst, wie einfach Mobile- und Online-Banking funktionieren – und machst unsere digitalen Services erlebbar. 
 Du gewinnst neue Kund:innen:  Mit Deiner offenen Art und Deinem Gespür für Menschen baust Du Beziehungen auf. 
 Du hältst den Laden am Laufen:  Ob Materialbestellung oder Wartebereich – Du denkst mit und gestaltest mit. 
 Du sorgst für Zufriedenheit:  Du hörst zu, findest Lösungen und machst aus Feedback echte Chancen. 
 Das bringst Du mit
 Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder vergleichbarer beruflicher Hintergrund 
 Interesse und Leidenschaft für modernes Banking (Multikanal-Lösungen, Mobile Banking-Apps, SB-Geräte) 
 Freude am Kundenkontakt und daran, Menschen mit exzellentem Service zu überzeugen 
 Souveränes Auftreten und eine selbstbewusste Persönlichkeit, die Vertrauen schafft 
 Teamgeist, Engagement und Flexibilität, um gemeinsam im dynamischen Arbeitsalltag erfolgreich zu sein 
 Das bieten wir Dir
 #JoinOurTeam – Unsere Mitarbeiter:innen sind die treibende Kraft hinter unserem Erfolg und damit unser höchstes Gut. Weil wir uns unserer Verantwortung als Arbeitgeber bewusst sind, wurden wir erneut als Top Employer ausgezeichnet. Werde auch Du Teil unseres Teams.
 #UnleashYourPotential – Bei uns gestaltest Du Deine Weiterbildung eigenständig und individuell. Mit umfangreichen Qualifizierungsmaßnahmen, strategischen und zukunftsorientierten Entwicklungsprogrammen oder individuellem Mentoring geben wir Deiner Karriere eine Perspektive. 
 #ThinkEuropean – Wir zählen nicht nur zu den größten Finanzinstituten Deutschlands, sondern sind als Teil der UniCredit auch international tätig und erfolgreich. Bei uns erwartet Dich ein paneuropäisches Unternehmen mit regionaler Verbundenheit sowie spannende Karrierechancen in den aufregendsten Städten der Welt.
 #DesignYourWorkingLife – Digitalisierung und Flexibilität prägen unsere moderne Arbeitswelt. Gestalte Deinen Arbeitsalltag so, wie er am besten zu Dir passt: Ob im Office, remote in ganz Deutschland oder aus dem EU-Ausland. Du möchtest länger verreisen? Dann nimm ein Sabbatical und entdecke mit uns die Möglichkeiten von New Work.
 #EnjoyTheBest – Nutze als Mitarbeiter:in das beste Premiumkonto Deutschlands kostenfrei. 
 #CareNowForLater – Wir sorgen auch in Zukunft für Dich. Denn neben monatlichen Gehaltszahlungen ist die Altersvorsorge ein Thema, mit dem Du Dich nicht erst zu Beginn der Rente beschäftigen solltest. Deshalb unterstützen wir vom ersten Tag an Deine finanzielle Vorsorge für den Ruhestand.
 #DontStopMoving – Nutze die Flexibilität von Wellhub: Deutschlandweit steht Dir ein umfassendes Netzwerk an Sport-, Freizeit- und Wellnesseinrichtungen zur Verfügung. Darüber hinaus profitierst Du von einem internationalen Partnernetz, das Dir Zugang zu Angeboten rund um den Globus ermöglicht. Weil Bewegung für uns nicht nur Gesundheit, sondern auch Nachhaltigkeit bedeutet, bieten wir Dir zudem die Möglichkeit, ein JobRad zu attraktiven Konditionen zu leasen und das Deutschlandticket zu vergünstigten Bedingungen zu nutzen. So unterstützen wir Dich bei einem aktiven Lifestyle und fördern gleichzeitig eine umweltfreundliche, kosteneffiziente Mobilität.
 #RelaxInNature – Berge oder See? Du hast die Qual der Wahl, denn die Gästehäuser unseres Partners Food & More bieten beides! Während Dich auf der Markbachjochhütte in Österreich auf 1.500 …

 Schimbă lumea de mâine alături de noi. 
 Unitatea noastră de business Automation (DI AUT) este unul dintre liderii mondiali în furnizarea de produse, sisteme, soluții și servicii în domeniul Motion Control. Aceasta include aproximativ 20.000 de angajați și patru segmente de activitate. Prin locațiile sale globale de producție, cercetare și dezvoltare (R&D) și servicii, MC este aproape de clienții săi și este activă într-o gamă largă de industrii. În cadrul grupului nostru de fabrici, Siemens AG dezvoltă și produce motoare electrice pentru piața globală. Clienții noștri țintă activează în domeniul tehnologiilor de automatizare, în industria auto și în zona de intralogistică. 
 In prezent cautam un Packaging Specialist care sa se alature echipei de logistica. 
 Responsabilitatea principala va fi asigurraea managementului operational end-to-end al ambalajelor returnabile si nereutilizabile, cu focus pe disponibilitate, circulatie, stocuri, calitate, cost si trasabilitate. Administreaza procesele si datele in BinMan, coordoneaza activitatea furnizorului de spalare si actioneaza ca punct central de contact pentru clienti, furnizori, transportatori si functiile interne. Contribuie la standardizarea, digitalizarea si imbunatatirea continua a circuitului de ambalaje, pentru sustinerea productiei si a livrarilor. 
 Descrierea postului: 
 • Administreaza operativ BinMan si asigura utilizarea corecta a sistemului, inclusiv actualizarea datelor, monitorizarea miscarilor, reconcilierea soldurilor si tratarea abaterilor. 
 • Monitorizeaza disponibilitatea, circulatia, stocurile, timpii de ciclu, pierderile si deteriorarile ambalajelor; initiaza masuri corective si escaladeaza riscurile care pot afecta productia sau livrarile. 
 • Coordoneaza activitatea furnizorului de spalare: planificare, prioritati, capacitate, volume, timpi de procesare, calitate, trasabilitate si respectarea nivelului de serviciu agreat. 
 • Verifica rezultatele spalarii si conditionarii ambalajelor, gestioneaza deviatiile de calitate si urmareste implementarea actiunilor corective impreuna cu furnizorul si functiile interne relevante. 
 • Coordoneaza operational relatia cu clientii si furnizorii pentru cerinte, disponibilitate, livrari/retururi, diferente de sold, reclamatii, pierderi, deteriorari si reguli de utilizare a ambalajelor. 
 • Asigura necesarul de ambalaje pentru productie si livrari, respectiv disponibilitatea ambalajelor la furnizori, in corelare cu volumele si prioritatile operationale. 
 • Coordoneaza fluxurile de transport asociate ambalajelor si confirma executia acestora pe baza planificarii si a documentelor disponibile. 
 • Mentine si verifica instructiunile, retetele si datele de ambalare; initiaza crearea sau modificarea acestora impreuna cu functiile responsabile si sustine standardizarea conceptelor de ambalare. 
 • Defineste si urmareste indicatori operationali relevanti: disponibilitate, acuratete stoc, timp de ciclu, restante, pierderi/deteriorari, calitate spalare, cost si nivel de serviciu. 
 • Pregateste rapoarte periodice si analize, conduce revizuiri operationale cu partenerii si documenteaza deciziile, responsabilitatile si termenele. 
 • Participa la proiecte de optimizare, relabeling, transfer, introducere de ambalaje noi, reducere de cost, digitalizare si sustenabilitate. 
 • Asigura respectarea standardelor interne, a instructiunilor de lucru, a cerintelor de calitate, EHS, curatenie, reutilizare si reducere a deseurilor. 
 • Instruieste utilizatorii si partenerii privind procesele de packaging si BinMan si actioneaza ca punct de escaladare operationala in aria sa de responsabilitate. 
 • Indeplineste si alte sarcini dispuse de superiorul direct, in limita competentelor si a ariei postului. 
 Cerinte 
 • Experienta: minimum 2 ani in Supply Chain, Logistica, Material Management, Packaging sau Operatiuni constituie avantaj. 
 • Cunostinte particulare: procese de ambalaje returnabile, gestiune containere, fluxuri logistice si coordonare furnizori de servicii. 
 • Sisteme: SAP si BinMan sau sisteme logistice comparabile; Microsoft Office, in special Excel si PowerPoint. 
 • Capabilitati: analiza de date si raportare, management KPI, standardizare de proces, rezolvare structurata a problemelor si imbunatatire continua. 
 • Limbi straine: limba engleza minimum nivel B1-B2 pentru colaborare operationala si corespondenta. 
 • Responsabilitate: acuratetea datelor, disciplina procesului, monitorizarea performantelor, coordonarea partenerilor si escaladarea la timp a riscurilor.

 A projektről: Az elmúlt 25+ évben fejlesztett Sitras Sidytrac szoftver mögött egy német-magyar fejlesztői csapat áll. Dinamikusan fejlődő csapatunkba olyan C# fejlesztőt keresünk, aki nyitott az új kihívásokra, szeret csapatban dolgozni, optimalizálni, és érdeklődik a vasúti hálózatok elemeinek, menetrendjének szimulálása és matematikai modellezése iránt, miközben aktívan hozzájárul a termék CRA-kompatibilitásának megteremtéséhez.

 Biztonságos kommunikáció fejlesztése: HTTPS implementáció a Sitras® Sidytrac Simulation Commander (SSC) számára, a meglévő interfészek kiterjesztése a biztonságos fájlátvitel érdekében.

 Rendszerstabilitás és biztonság: Aktív részvétel a szoftver stabilitásának biztosításában, hibák javításában és biztonsági rések felderítésében, elhárításában .

 Felsőfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel mérnöki/informatikai/természettudományi (matematika vagy fizika) területen.
 Van legalább 3 év C# alapú szoftverfejlesztésben szerzett tapasztalatod.
 Magabiztos angol és német (minimum B1) nyelvtudással rendelkezel szóban és írásban.

 Van tapasztalatod cybersecurity területén (pl. titkosítás, tanusítványok, biztonsági rések azonosítása).

 Családbarát munkahelyet, kötetlen munkaidővel, rugalmas hozzáállással.

 Fejlődési lehetőségeket, egyéni tréning kerettel, kidolgozott karrierúttal.
 Fontos számunkra az egészséged, többek közt élet- és egészségbiztosítással óvunk.
 Ergonomikus munkakörnyezetet biztosítunk számodra, ezzel is kényelmessé téve az irodai munkavégzést.

 Supporting maintenance of our existing capability (bug fixing, code refactoring, etc.)

 Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience:
 Candidates applying for this position are required to have the following skills and experience: 
 A Master’s or PhD degree in engineering or physical science discipline, ideally focusing on the heat transfer applications in the context of fluid and thermal transport problems 
 1-5 years of total experience 
 Experience in commercial CFD software development, or in non-commercial CFD software development 
 Expertise in implementing different heat transfer models 
 Expertise in object-oriented C++ software development 
 Expertise in development of complex software applications using modern design patterns and principles 
 Preferred Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

 Expertise in areas of physical science: fluid flow, multiphase, or combustion

 Hello World, We are hiring! 
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future.
 Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant team.
 Siemens Software, a business unit of the Siemens Digital Industries, is a leading global provider of software solutions to drive the digital transformation of industry, creating new opportunities for manufacturers to realize innovation.
 About the role: 
 The Build and Dependency Management Engineer is a technical role within a global, multi-site DevOps organization. The BDM engineer owns the build lifecycle and dependency management for one or more software products, acting as a bridge between DevOps infrastructure and product development teams. This role exists because build and dependency management requires dedicated, specialized ownership that cannot be absorbed by general DevOps or product development roles alone.
 What you’ll be doing: 
 · Build System Ownership 
 Develop, maintain, and modernize product build systems (e.g., CMake, MSBuild, Bazel, or bespoke solutions)
 Drive migration from legacy build tooling toward modern, maintainable solutions
 Support and improve CI infrastructure (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent)
 Maintain and configure CI-related software on build nodes (Windows and Linux)
 · Dependency Management 
 Own the dependency lifecycle: acquisition, versioning, caching, and distribution of third-party and internal libraries
 Collaborate on dependency orchestration tooling and services (e.g., Conan, Artifactory, or equivalent)
 Support legal clearing and compliance workflows for third-party dependencies
 · Compliance & Quality Tooling 
 Support and improve automation for compliance-related tooling: SAST, binary analysis, threat response analysis, and similar
 Maintain product installers and packaging infrastructure
 · Cross-Team Alignment 
 Collaborate with product development teams to understand build and dependency needs
 Align with DevOps, platform, and product teams on ownership boundaries and best practices
 Participate in stakeholder discussions to evaluate and improve build lifecycle processes
 Working at Siemens Software 
 A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.

items.desc: Description Varjo is the world-leading provider of enterprise virtual and mixed reality solutions, delivering the highest levels of immersion, performance, and security for the most demanding industrial customers globally. Used by over 25% of the Fortune 100 to transform how they operate, Varjo is known for virtual and mixed reality that look and feel as real as the real world, allowing training fighter jet pilots and astronauts, designing cars, and conducting pioneering medical research across virtual environments. With our technology, professionals can recreate the exact feeling and conditions of real life in 3D, allowing them to work and train faster, better and more cost effectively. Founded in 2016, Varjo now operates in over 40 countries worldwide with 200 employees in offices in Helsinki and Washington D.C. We believe in the power of diversity – where different experiences, backgrounds, and ideas drive innovation and results. Job Description We are looking for a Computer Vision Engineer to join our Eye Tracking Team and contribute broadly across the eye tracking stack to deliver algorithms and machine learning models that power gaze-driven features in Varjo mixed reality products. items.desc: Our Mission Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve. About Brain Co. Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model. Why Now Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services. Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact. You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now. Machine Learning Engineer, Applied AI About The Role So much of the work society depends on is still slower and harder than it should be. Permits take months. Claims sit unresolved. And AI hasn't changed that — because the bottleneck isn't the models. It's the institutional context AI needs to do the work: rules, history, relationships, and judgment scattered across people, documents, and legacy systems. BrainCo exists to fix that. We build agent-native operating systems for the institutions society depends on, and our products are the first of their kind in the world — we were the first, anywhere, to fully automate construction permitting, and we're now doing the same across insurance and other industries. There is no playbook here, because no one has built this before. As a Machine Learning Engineer on Applied AI, your work begins where the demo ends: getting a model to look impressive is the easy part; making it a production decision system an institution stakes its process on is the job. The problems come in every shape — custom vision model pipelines that check blueprints against building codes at 95%+ accuracy, agents that untangle policy stacks to reveal coverage gaps, systems that predict from clinical records whether a patient is on their care path — and you'll own them end-to-end, from ambiguous customer problem to the eval that catches a whole class of errors. This is frontier ML applied where it's hardest and matters most. The problems are underspecified, the documents are brutal, the accuracy bar is institutional-grade — and the feedback loops are real, because our systems move real workflows forward every day. Who We're Looking For You understand how machine learning actually works — not just the tooling, but the philosophy underneath: what a loss function really optimizes, how generalization breaks under distribution shift, why evaluation is where systems quietly go wrong. And you live at the bleeding edge of modern AI, with hard-won instincts for squeezing the most out of LLMs and agentic systems — prompting, fine-tuning, tool use, and reasoning. That combination is the job: you know when a fine-tuned segmentation model beats a VLM, when a rule engine beats both, and how to compose all three into a system more accurate than any single model. You treat frontier models as components to be measured, pushed, and engineered — never as magic. Most of all, you're energized by building things that have never existed, and comfortable when the problem, the data, and the definition of success all have to be invented at once. The Problems You'll Work On Composite AI systems and credit assignment. Our most demanding systems chain vision transformers, segmentation models, VLM reasoning, and rule engines. When the pipeline is wrong, which component failed? One of the most interesting open problems in applied ML. Document understanding beyond the frontier. Blueprints, site plans, policy stacks, contracts, clinical records — dense, multimodal documents that break off-the-shelf models. You'll build models that actually read them. Agents that learn from real work. Our deployments generate verified, ground-truth outcomes on every decision — reward signals most labs can only simulate. You'll help design the data, evals, and training loops to build and fine-tune agents on them. Evaluation as a product discipline. When a regulator has to trust your system, evals are the product. You'll build eval suites and failure-mode taxonomies rigorous enough to earn institutional sign-off. Institutional Intelligence that compounds. Every verified correction improves the system twice: the corrected fact percolates to every application, and the system that builds the intelligence learns to build it better. You'll work on both loops. In This Role, You Will Turn ambiguity into shipped systems — from no problem statement, no labeled data, and no agreed definition of success, to well-posed ML problems and production deployments. items.title: Data Scientist IA & Machine Learning
items.card: mission : Longue Démarrage : Dès que possible Conclusion Cette opportunité s'adresse à un Data Scientist souhaitant évoluer sur des sujets à forte valeur ajoutée autour du Machine Learning, du NLP et de l'IA générative, au sein d'un environnement technique moderne et stimulant offrant une grande diversité de cas d'usage Data et IA.
items.desc: act digital est un groupe international de conseil et d'ingénierie qui accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de transformation numérique. Présent dans 12 pays et fort de plus de 7 000 collaborateurs, nous mettons nos expertises au service de leurs enjeux en développement logiciel, cybersécurité, data, cloud et IA. Notre ambition : devenir le partenaire technologique de confiance des entreprises les plus innovantes, en concevant et sécurisant des systèmes qui renforcent leur performance et leur résilience. Rejoindre act digital France, c'est intégrer une organisation agile et engagée, qui fait avancer les projets avec ses clients pour transformer les idées en résultats concrets, avec pragmatisme et exigence. POSTE / MISSIONS Dans le cadre de programmes de valorisation de la donnée et d'intelligence artificielle, vous rejoindrez une équipe Data chargée de concevoir, développer et industrialiser des modèles avancés d'analyse et de prédiction. Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des projets Data Science, depuis l'exploration des données jusqu'à l'évaluation et l'amélioration continue des modèles en production. Les principales missions seront les suivantes : Extraire, transformer et fiabiliser les données à partir d'environnements cloud, notamment via des requêtes SQL sur des plateformes Data modernes. Concevoir, développer et optimiser des modèles de Machine Learning répondant à des problématiques de détection, prédiction et classification. Évaluer les performances des modèles à travers des approches de backtesting, de validation statistique et de suivi des indicateurs de performance. Développer des approches d'ensemble (ensemble learning) et des stratégies combinant plusieurs modèles afin d'améliorer la précision et la robustesse des résultats. Réaliser des études exploratoires et analytiques à partir de jeux de données complexes. Mettre en place des tableaux de bord et indicateurs de suivi sous Power BI afin de faciliter la prise de décision. Concevoir et industrialiser des produits Data intégrant des traitements automatisés et des algorithmes d'intelligence artificielle. Développer des modèles de traitement du langage naturel (NLP) pour l'analyse de données textuelles. Contribuer à la conception, à l'évaluation et à l'optimisation de solutions basées sur l'IA générative, les grands modèles de langage (LLM) et les architectures RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation). Assurer l'interprétabilité et l'explicabilité des modèles à l'aide des méthodologies adaptées. Collaborer avec les équipes techniques et métiers afin d'identifier les opportunités de création de valeur par la donnée. Présenter les résultats des analyses et formuler des recommandations auprès des parties prenantes. Participer à la documentation, à la maintenance et à l'amélioration continue des solutions développées. Veiller au respect des normes de qualité des données, de sécurité et de conformité réglementaire, notamment en matière de protection des données personnelles. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Le candidat dispose d'une expérience en Data Science, Machine Learning et Intelligence Artificielle. Il maîtrise l'ensemble de la chaîne de traitement de la donnée, depuis l'acquisition et la préparation des données jusqu'au déploiement et au suivi des modèles en production. Le profil recherché évolue dans les environnements suivants : Développement en Python pour la Data Science et le Machine Learning. Utilisation avancée de SQL pour l'exploration et la transformation de données. Expérience des environnements Google Cloud Platform (GCP), notamment BigQuery. Maîtrise des bibliothèques de Machine Learning et de Data Science (Scikit-Learn, Pandas, NumPy ou équivalent). Expérience en Deep Learning et traitement automatique du langage naturel (NLP). Connaissance des architectures Transformer et des modèles de type BERT, Flan-T5 ou modèles équivalents. Expérience sur les solutions d'IA générative, grands modèles de langage (LLM) et pipelines RAG. Maîtrise de Power BI pour la visualisation et le monitoring des données. Bonne connaissance des techniques d'évaluation, de monitoring et d'interprétabilité des modèles. Compréhension des principes de gouvernance des données, de qualité des données et des exigences RGPD. Expérience dans l'industrialisation de produits Data et l'intégration de modèles en environnement de production. Au-delà des compétences techniques, le candidat possède d'excellentes capacités d'analyse, de communication et de vulgarisation, lui permettant d'interagir efficacement avec des interlocuteurs variés. Modalités Localisation : Paris Télétravail : 3 jours / Semaine Durée de mission : Longue Démarrage : Dès que possible Conclusion Cette opportunité s'adresse à un Data Scientist souhaitant évoluer sur des sujets à forte valeur ajoutée autour du Machine Learning, du NLP et de l'IA générative, au sein d'un environnement technique moderne et stimulant offrant une grande diversité de cas d'usage Data et IA.

items.desc: Möbius is een adviesbureau dat organisaties binnen verschillende sectoren helpt om de beste oplossingen te ontwerpen en te implementeren. Onze +140 collega's zijn actief in België en Nederland en begeleiden al meer dan 28 jaar een diversiteit aan organisaties. Met een sterke focus op de nieuwste technologische ontwikkelingen ondersteunen we bedrijven in hun transformatie naar data-gedreven en AI-gebaseerde organisaties — van generatieve AI-oplossingen die repetitieve taken automatiseren, tot klassieke machine learning-modellen die complexe patronen blootleggen. Om deze transformatieve oplossingen te realiseren en onze impact verder uit te breiden, zijn we op zoek naar een gemotiveerde AI Engineer . Deze rol is in de eerste plaats technisch, maar je verliest de business nooit uit het oog. Jouw rol Je vertrekt vanuit een businessprobleem: denk hierbij aan een stapel documenten die manueel wordt verwerkt, een klantendienst die verdrinkt in mails, een proces dat te veel tijd kost, … en vertaalt dat naar de meest passende architectuur. Vervolgens ontwikkel je de AI-oplossing: soms is dat een oplossing op maat , soms een schaalbaar platform dat over meerdere klanten of use cases heen werkt. Jij maakt die keuze bewust en onderbouwd. In de praktijk betekent dit: Samenwerken met klanten en interne teams om hun behoeften en processen goed te begrijpen en te (helpen) vertalen naar concrete AI- en ML-oplossingen. AI-applicaties ontwerpen en ontwikkelen , met een sterke focus op Large Language Models (LLM’s) en Generative AI . Je past technieken zoals prompt engineering en RAG toe om betrouwbare, pragmatische en performante oplossingen te bouwen die aansluiten bij de specifieke klantbehoeften en use-cases. Oplossingen ontwikkelen met Python en relevante AI/ML-frameworks (bv. Scikit-learn, TensorFlow en PyTorch), en AI-functionaliteit integreren in bredere applicaties en processen, onder andere via API’s. Technische architecturen voor AI/ML-oplossingen ontwerpen , waarbij je bewuste keuzes maakt rond modulaire componenten, integraties, schaalbaarheid, betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, beheersbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie. Je denkt daarbij niet alleen na over wat technisch werkt , maar ook over wat passend en duurzaam is voor de specifieke use-case. Vanuit die architectuur robuuste en schaalbare AI/ML-pipelines bouwen en vervolgens in productie brengen : van proof-of-concept tot een betrouwbare deployment in cloudomgevingen zoals Azure - kortom: MLOps van A tot Z. GenAI met klassieke Machine Learning-technieken combineren wanneer dat relevant is (vb. classificatie, regressie, clustering of tijdreeksanalyse). Je kiest daarbij de techniek die het best past bij het probleem , in plaats van AI of LLM’s als doel op zich te zien. Wij bieden jou 💸 Een aantrekkelijk salarispakket inclusief extra voordelen (zoals een elektrische bedrijfswagen, laptop, verzekeringen, sport- en welzijnsinitiatieven, enz.) 💪🏼 De kans om zelfstandig aan toonaangevende projecten te werken, waarbij je je talenten kunt tonen en ontwikkelen 🎓 Uitgebreide opleidingsmogelijkheden om een expert in jouw vakgebied te worden en om steeds up-to-date te blijven met de nieuwste AI-trends 👥 Een ondernemende en innovatieve bedrijfscultuur waar klantgerichtheid, kennisdeling en collegialiteit centraal staan 👩🏼 💻 Werken binnen een modern holacracy framework dat zelforganisatie en wendbaarheid stimuleert 💬 Een cultuur van continue feedback , gericht op persoonlijke en professionele groei 🕦 Flexibele werktijden , inspirerende kantoren en de mogelijkheid om vanuit je eigen thuiskantoor te werken 💡 Inspirerende en uitdagende events gedurende het hele jaar Ontdek op hier hoe deze job er in praktijk kan uitzien en solliciteer via LinkedIn, onze website of via jobs@mobius.eu Tot binnenkort!

items.desc: At a glance Are you a pioneering data scientist who likes to think outside-the-box? Would you like to drive new data science solutions to tackle financial fraud? Do you want to work with cutting-edge technologies to catch criminals? Your job As a data scientist, in the Grid Channel Security, you will work together with fraud experts, data scientists, machine learning engineers and data analysts to safeguard our customers from criminals. This includes threats such as phishing, account takeover, lost or stolen debit cards, e-commerce fraud, and more. Your role will encompass analysing diverse data sources to get actionable insights. This analysis will include, but not limited to, understanding fraud trends across various payment channels, evaluating the potential of different data fields to enhance our fraud detection, experimenting with different modelling approaches and enhancements, recognizing seasonal patterns, and creating reliable forecasts. Your contributions will extend beyond immediate solutions, serving as a catalyst for ongoing improvements in our fraud detection capabilities through model experimentation and the integration of new data elements. In addition to your focused problem-solving efforts, you will be collaborating with others to brainstorm how data science solutions can help us stay one step ahead of criminals in the ongoing cat-and-mouse game. ABN AMRO is a future driven bank that is working continuously on unlocking the power of data: you will be part of this transformation! Working environment Grid Channel Security within Corporate Information Security Office (CISO) is responsible for the prevention and detection of payment fraud, and deciding the policy and strategy in the area of fraud. The Fraud Monitoring team that you are going to be part of, is a motivated multidisciplinary group of approximately 25 colleagues working with a focus on protecting customers. We work in a hybrid way and our day to day work is organized by the agile and scrum principles. CISO is recognised as having an informal work atmosphere where everyone has a heart for their job and is prepared to help others. Your profile We are looking for a data scientist with strong technical and problem-solving skills, as well as a collaborative mindset. We strongly emphasize that there are no "lone wolves" on our team. You should care deeply about helping your colleagues, mentoring, and coaching where possible, while maintaining a learning mindset. Required Qualifications and technical skills: A master’s degree or PhD in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, etc.). 5 years of independent machine learning development experience, including exploratory data analysis, model experimentation, and collaborating with engineers for model deployment in real-world applications. Demonstrated professional experience developing ML models in a big data environment (e.g., Spark, distributed computing frameworks). Strong working knowledge of Python, SQL, and Spark. Familiarity with MLOps concepts such as lineage, reproducibility, and model monitoring, and experience with tools like MLFlow. An understanding of the full data science lifecycle and an ability to make trade-off decisions around key concepts such as sampling, cross-validation, model evaluation metrics, and feature engineering. Experience working in a professional software development environment, such as appropriate use of Git, code reviews, code packaging, and orchestration of jobs. Strong technical communication skills; capable of presenting data science work to either business or highly technical stakeholders. You should see the value in technical documentation. Project management skills: you understand how to scope modelling projects. You have experience working in an Agile environment. Preferred team values: A demonstrated ability to innovate and think creatively to solve complex technical puzzles. You display persistence and intellectual curiosity to ensure that not only is work complete, but the problem at hand is truly solved. You are proactive in solving problems; reaching outing to stakeholders as and when necessary, ask for reviews or brainstorming sessions with your team, suggesting new ideas to solve existing problems. In addition to meeting the above requirements, please write a one-page cover letter describing how your experience meetings the required qualifications and describe a few scenarios where you have demonstrated our teams' values. We are offering We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer: An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowanceand a flexible benefit budget. An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future. Flexibility …

items.desc: About The Job La Maison Depuis 1854, les femmes et les hommes de Louis Vuitton partagent le même esprit d'excellence et réinventent chaque jour leur métier. Chaque parcours est un véritable voyage, nourri d'émotion et de conquête, d'envie et d'audace. Aujourd'hui, dans un contexte de forte croissance, Louis Vuitton vous invite à imaginer votre propre voyage en rejoignant nos équipes. Louis Vuitton respecte et promeut l’égalité des chances. Nous célébrons et accueillons toutes les singularités et nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail inclusif. L’équipe Au sein de la Direction Digital et Client Development, vous serez rattaché(e) au pôle Data Science & IA. Vous transformez les métiers en étant au cœur de l’activité et en collaborant au quotidien avec les équipes. Job responsibilities Vos Missions Regardons de plus près ce qui vous attend : Cadrage et pilotage : Après avoir recueilli les besoins des équipes business, vous définissez et pilotez les projets Data & IA pour résoudre leurs problématiques. Vous évaluez les priorités, suivez les avancements et communiquez en permanence avec l’ensemble des acteurs. Vous construisez des argumentaires solides pour faire valoir vos choix et faites le pont entre les équipes techniques et les équipes métiers, trouvez les leviers de compromis pour faire aboutir les sujets. Mise en œuvre et exploitation : Vous mettez en œuvre les projets et analyses data science, en réponse aux problématiques en lien avec le produit Louis Vuitton et les opérations. Vous mesurez la performance et l’apport des modèles de machine learning, en comparant aux approches métiers utilisées. Vous mesurez les bénéfices/ROI après leur mise en œuvre. Vous mettez en production les différentes méthodes implémentés en collaboration avec les data engineers. Adoption et engagement : Vous restituez les résultats tout en alertant si nécessaire. Vous accompagnez les équipes business dans l’exploitation des outils mis en place et formez les équipes aux principes et techniques data et IA. Vous améliorez les modèles et les outils en continu, en fonction des retours des équipes. Profile Votre Profil Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'un Bac+5 en Ecole d'Ingénieur ou Université et justifiez d'au-moins 5 ans d'expérience en data science, idéalement sur des problématiques orientées supply chain, manufacturing ; Vous maîtrisez les principales techniques statistiques, les modèles descriptifs et prédictifs, et algorithmes de machine learning ; Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre expertise dans l'analyse des bases de données volumineuses, complexes, dans des environnements distribués ; Vous disposez d'une expérience significative de développement data science sur Google Cloud Platform (GCP) et sur des outils de data visualisation (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik...) ; Vous maîtrisez le logiciel de Data Science Dataiku et avez une très bonne connaissance du langage Python ; Vous avez un niveau d'anglais courant, à l'écrit comme à l'oral ; Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre excellent relationnel et votre esprit d’équipe ; Vous êtes sensible à l’univers du luxe, et répondez aux compétences que ce milieu implique : excellence, rigueur, sens du détail, créativité. Pourquoi participer à l’aventure ? Pour travailler dans une entreprise où sens de l’excellence et innovation sont des valeurs fortes et devenir vous aussi un(e) acteur/actrice de sa réussite. Pour travailler en plein cœur de Paris, dans le 1er arrondissement ; Pour grandir et bénéficier d’un suivi RH personnalisé tout au long de votre carrière. Vous êtes partant(e) ? Nous vous attendons ! items.desc: Welcome to Data Intellect , we thrive on solving complex data challenges in high-stakes environments. We’re a team of engineers, problem-solvers and collaborators who believe in pushing boundaries, not egos. Job Description We build AI systems that go into production. Our clients are Tier 1 banks and hedge funds with real data volumes and real regulatory pressure and they hire us because we can put working software in front of them quickly. This role is for an engineer who has already built agentic AI systems and wants to do more. You will design and build agents that call tools, query client data, reason over it and hand back something a user can act on. Some of that runs against cloud model APIs, some of it runs on local models inside a client's network because the data cannot leave the building. You need to be comfortable with both. You will work directly with client engineers and stakeholders, as an AI specialist. What you will be doing Building and shipping LLM-backed agents: tool use, MCP servers, retrieval, orchestration between specialist agents, evaluation and guardrails Working across cloud model APIs and locally hosted models, and making sensible calls about which fits a given client's constraints Using AI-assisted development tools as a core part of how you work, and having a view on where they help and where they get in the way Turning a vague client problem into a scoped proof of concept, then into something maintainable Explaining your design decisions to people who are technical and non-technical people. Building reusable accelerators so the next engagement starts further along than the last one Qualifications Essential 5+ years' commercial experience in a Software Engineering role, with a proven track record of designing, building, testing and deploying production-quality software Demonstrable experience building AI agents that use LLMs, cloud hosted or local. We will want to talk in detail about something you have built, why you built it that way and what broke Fluent use of AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in day to day development Strong software engineering fundamentals: version control, testing, code review, CI/CD and an understanding of what makes code someone else can maintain Strong written and spoken communication. You can write a clear client-facing document and hold your own in a technical conversation with a client Able to work with minimal supervision. You take a problem, ask the right questions early and come back with progress rather than waiting to be unblocked Genuine interest in where agentic AI is going, evidenced by what you read, build or contribute to outside of what your last employer asked of you Desirable Claude Certified Architect (Foundations or Professional), or an equivalent credential from another vendor. If you have not done one, we will support you through it Background in financial services, market data or another regulated, data-heavy domain Experience with MCP server development Experience with time series or analytical databases (kdb+/KDB-X, ClickHouse, Oracle) Python, Java and TypeScript Experience deploying models on-premise or in a locked-down cloud environment Who does well here People who are honest about what they do not know. People who put in the work. Consultancy has peaks and clients notice who shows up during them People who can hold a relationship as well as a codebase.
