items.desc: 🖇️Sobre Diverger. Somos una compañía tecnológica de más de 100 profesionales y 14 años de trayectoria. Integramos IA y sistemas de agentes en el ciclo completo de desarrollo de software de sectores como banca, retail, energía, industria y telecomunicaciones. Lo hacemos con un método propio, Exponential Programming, y somos partner de Anthropic y Google . Tenemos oficinas en Madrid y A Coruña y una cultura de trabajo remoto. En Diverger la IA no se aprende en un curso, se aprende entregando software con ella. Buscamos personas entusiastas en aplicar las herramientas de IA en el desarrollo de software, con base en deep learning, entre 1 y 3 años programando, que quieran aprender a construir con agentes en equipos que ya lo hacen para grandes compañías. No te pedimos que llegues sabiéndolo. Te pedimos fundamentos y criterio para aprovecharlo. 🔛Qué harás: Desarrollar y mantener servicios en Python y, según el proyecto, podrás tocar otros lenguajes: Java, .Net, JavaScript/TypeScript... Integrar modelos de lenguaje en aplicaciones reales. Llamadas a APIs de modelos, recuperación de información sobre la documentación del cliente y evaluación de resultados. Trabajar a diario con asistentes y agentes de código siguiendo Exponential Programming , nuestro método de desarrollo con IA. Escribir tests, revisar el código de otras personas y dejar documentado lo que construyes. Proponer cómo medir si lo que se construye con IA funciona de verdad. Llevar a la comunidad interna de IA lo que aprendas en tu proyecto. ✨Lo imprescindible: Entre 2 y 3 años desarrollando software. Las prácticas largas, proyectos personales y los proyectos de investigación cuentan. Formación universitaria con un máster o una especialización, un TFG o un TFM en IA. Si vienes de otra disciplina y te especializaste después, cuéntanoslo. En nuestro equipo de IA hay quien llegó por ese camino. Python con soltura. Has escrito código que otras personas usan o mantienen. Base real en Java, React, Next o en JavaScript/TypeScript. Con uno de ellos basta. Fundamentos de LLM que sepas explicar con tus palabras. Cómo se entrena y se evalúa un modelo, qué mide una métrica y cuándo engaña. Inglés suficiente para leer documentación técnica y trabajar con equipos internacionales. 😊Cuéntanos al menos una de estas cosas: Un proyecto, TFG o TFM en el que fuiste más allá de lo que te pedían, y qué decidiste por tu cuenta. Algo que construiste sin que nadie te lo encargara. Un repositorio, una demo, un artículo. Una competición, un hackathon o una publicación, y qué te llevaste aunque no ganaras. Una disciplina que llegaste a dominar viniendo de otra. Un resultado académico que refleje constancia más que un buen día. 🪄Cómo trabajamos en equipo: Aquí el conocimiento no se guarda. Revisamos el código (HITL, HOTL, …),, contamos en la c omunidad de IA y en otros foros especializados , lo que funciona y lo que no. Quién sabe más, dedica tiempo a quien empieza. Invertimos en el desarrollo de cada persona y esperamos que quien entra quiera hacer lo mismo por el equipo. Valoramos, sin que sea requisito: Haber usado APIs de modelos como Claude, Gemini o GPT, o modelos open source, en proyectos reales, un proyecto académico o personal. Nociones de RAG, embeddings o bases de datos vectoriales. Conocimientos de sistemas multiagente y harness. Git, Docker, CI/CD y algo de cloud en AWS, Azure o GCP. SQL y modelado de datos. Cómo vas a crecer: Itinerario formativo interno de IA y Exponential Programming aplicado en proyecto desde el primer día. Acceso a las certificaciones oficiales de Anthropic. Un Technical Leader de referencia en tu proyecto. Una comunidad interna de IA donde se comparten casos reales, tendencias, estado del arte, etc. 💡 Lo que te espera en Diverger 🎯 Meritocracia real: tu salario refleja lo que aportas 📚 Formación (Codely, Udemy, certis Google & MS, workshops internos) 🧠 Comunidad técnica + mentoría + equipo de IA que te acompaña 🌍 100% remoto (oficinas en Madrid y Coruña si te apetece) 🕒 Flexibilidad horaria total ☀️ Jornada intensiva en julio y agosto 🏖️ 23 días de vacaciones + 24 y 31 diciembre 💳 Retribución flexible (transporte, comida, guardería, seguro…) 💬 Comunicación transparente y cultura horizontal 📈 Plan de carrera y revisiones anuales 🧘 Red de apoyo interna: no caminas solx 💜 ¿Por qué Diverger? Porque creemos que un buen proyecto no se define únicamente por su stack tecnológico, sino también por las personas con las que trabajas y por todo lo que puedes aprender y aportar. Aquí encontrarás: 🚀 Proyectos estables y con retos reales. 🧠 IA generativa aplicada al desarrollo. 🤝 Cultura horizontal y colaborativa. 💡 Espacio para aportar criterio técnico. En Diverger respiramos un entorno diverso y en el que todas las personas tengan igualdad de condiciones. Crecemos por nuestro compromiso, nuestra exigencia y nuestra pasión por lo que hacemos sin importar la mochila con la que viajemos. Porque no entendemos estas prácticas solo como principios, sino como la …

items.desc: Purpose As an AI Engineer in the IP Development team, you will be responsible for driving the effective use of AI across our software development lifecycle. Your focus will be on identifying where AI can improve delivery, quality, and user experience, and turning those opportunities into practical, scalable solutions. You will work closely with Engineering Managers, the Principal Developer, Software Architect, and Product teams to embed AI into both how we build products and how our platforms operate. This includes enhancing existing capabilities (e.g. retrieval-augmented generation), improving prompt design and reliability, and exploring new use cases that deliver real value. You will also play a key role in enabling the wider team, helping developers, designers, and product teams adopt AI tools and approaches in a way that is effective, responsible, and aligned to our engineering standards. Role Responsibilities Identify and deliver practical AI use cases across the development lifecycle (e.g. planning, design, development, testing, and support) Design, build, and improve AI-enabled features within our platforms, including RAG-based solutions and LLM integrations Develop and refine prompts, workflows, and evaluation approaches to improve reliability, accuracy, and usefulness of AI outputs Work closely with Engineering and Architecture to ensure AI solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with platform design Collaborate with Product teams to identify opportunities where AI can enhance user experience or unlock new capabilities Support the integration of AI services and tooling (e.g. model APIs, orchestration layers, vector stores) into existing systems Help define and evolve best practices for using AI within the team, including quality, security, and governance considerations Enable and upskill the wider team by sharing knowledge, running sessions, and supporting hands-on adoption of AI tools Evaluate emerging tools and technologies, balancing experimentation with practical implementation Contribute to improving team efficiency through the use of AI-assisted development tools and workflows Monitor and assess the effectiveness of AI implementations, iterating based on feedback and outcomes Where appropriate, support the safe and responsible use of AI, including data handling, prompt safety, and output validation Person Specification & Skills Experience working with AI/ML technologies, particularly LLMs and modern AI tooling Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled applications (e.g. RAG, chat interfaces, AI-assisted workflows) Strong understanding of prompt design, evaluation, and techniques to improve output quality and consistency Experience working with APIs and integrating external services into applications Familiarity with concepts such as vector databases, embeddings, and information retrieval Understanding of software development practices and how AI fits into the development lifecycle Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and design teams Strong problem-solving experience (e.g. TypeScript, Python, or similar) is beneficial but not essential

L'ambition est claire : “make intelligent software for Europe”. Notre culture repose sur des valeurs fortes : être, faire et transformer ensemble . Elle n’est pas figée; elle se vit chaque jour dans nos actions et nos décisions, à travers un équilibre entre performance, responsabilité et plaisir. Cette ambition s’incarne dans ce que nous faisons au quotidien : concevoir des logiciels qui accompagnent les moments de vie essentiels, au service de millions de citoyens. Être présent derrière ces instants clés est une responsabilité forte. C’est la nôtre. Et peut-être bientôt la votre. Rejoindre Septeo, c’est intégrer une aventure collective à dimension internationale , porter la transformation du groupe dans un environnement en mouvement rapide, et faire de l’IA un levier concret de création de valeur, aujourd’hui comme demain. Prêt(e) à faire partie de l’aventure ? Description Du Poste Nous recherchons un(e) Backend Engineer / Data Scientist, en CDI, à proximité de Montpellier (Lattes) pour notre filiale Septeo ADB. Ce que nous pouvons accomplir ensemble : Dans le cadre du développement et de l’évolution d’ Immosearch , la plateforme de données cadastrales et immobilières de la division, l’équipe renforce son expertise autour de cet écosystème. La plateforme repose sur plusieurs briques : PIGE, DPE, DVF, Gateway, Danim, Stats et AI , ainsi que sur les interactions entre ces différents composants. Le poste s’inscrit dans un environnement Data , avec un enjeu fort autour du fonctionnement, de l’évolution et de l’intégration des différentes briques de la plateforme . Vous interviendrez au cœur de l’écosystème Immosearch et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec : Le Tech Lead Data et un data engineer Les équipes produit Les équipes métier (migration / fonctionnel) Les équipes infra / DevOps Vos missions principales Vous maintenez et faites évoluer le backend Immosearch, et vous devenez à terme le l'expertise sur l'ensemble du périmètre. items.desc: Beschrijving Voor onze klant, een gevestigde speler binnen de financële sector , ben ik op zoek naar een Data & AI Engineer. Deze organisatie investeert sterk in technologie en innovatie om haar dienstverlening continu te verbeteren. Binnen een stabiele en hoogtechnologische omgeving krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan betrouwbare dataoplossingen en innovatieve toepassingen die een concrete meerwaarde bieden voor de organisatie. Je zal deel uitmaken van een team waar je meewerkt aan de verdere uitbouw van het data-ecosysteem . Je ontwerpt, bouwt en onderhoudt robuuste datapipelines en dataproducten die data uit verschillende bronnen ontsluiten, verwerken en beschikbaar maken voor analyse en rapportering . Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's uit data, IT en de business om databehoeften te vertalen naar kwalitatieve en schaalbare oplossingen. Naast klassieke data engineering krijg je ook de kans om mee te werken aan innovatieve AI-toepassingen . Denk hierbij aan het voorbereiden en ontsluiten van data voor toepassingen op basis van generatieve AI , waaronder Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) en vector search. Je waakt over de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en herbruikbaarheid van de data en denkt actief mee over hoe nieuwe technologieën de organisatie vooruit kunnen helpen. Meer info? e.dhooge@madison.be Profiel Je behaalde een relevant bachelor- of masterdiploma Je hebt relevante ervaring als Data Engineer Je hebt een goede kennis van Python en SQL en ervaring met het bouwen en onderhouden van datapipelines Je hebt inzicht in datamodellering , ETL/ELT-processen en datakwaliteit Ervaring met technologieën zoals SQL Server, PostgreSQL of Delta Lake is een plus Je heb ervaring in moderne AI-toepassingen en hebt kennis van concepten zoals RAG, embeddings, vector search en documentverwerking Je werkt graag samen met collega's uit verschillende teams en vertaalt technische uitdagingen naar betrouwbare dataoplossingen Je volgt nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen data engineering en AI met interesse op Aanbod Een competitief loon, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen ( bedrijfswagen of mobiliteitsbudget , nettovergoeding, hospitalisatieverzekering voor jou en je gezin, groepsverzekering, ecocheques...) Een aantrekkelijk aandelenoptieplan Een aangename en professionele werkomgeving Een stabiele organisatie met weinig personeelsverloop De kans om mee te bouwen aan moderne data- en AI-oplossingen binnen een hoogtechnologische omgeving

items.desc: Buscamos un/a Data & AI Engineer que lidere la evolución del ecosistema de datos de la compañía y participe activamente en la definición de nuevas soluciones basadas en IA, automatización y analítica avanzada. Modelar y poner a disposición la información necesaria para iniciativas de IA Generativa, incluyendo entornos RAG, agentes, embeddings y tecnologías de búsqueda semántica sobre bases de datos vectoriales. Reimaginar la forma en que los usuarios consumen información, impulsando la transición desde el reporting tradicional en Power BI hacia experiencias apoyadas en IA, asistentes conversacionales y aplicaciones de autoservicio. Establecer estándares y buenas prácticas que garanticen la integridad, gobernanza, seguridad y disponibilidad de los datos en toda la organización. Desarrollar y gestionar procesos de integración, automatización y orquestación de datos mediante herramientas como n8n, optimizando flujos operativos y reduciendo tareas manuales. Actuar como enlace entre las áreas técnicas y de negocio para transformar necesidades operativas en métricas, indicadores y soluciones analíticas de valor. Detectar nuevas oportunidades donde el uso de datos, inteligencia artificial y automatización pueda generar eficiencias, mejorar la toma de decisiones o aportar nuevas capacidades a la compañía. Formación en Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Matemáticas, Ciencia de Datos o disciplinas afines. Experiencia sólida con SQL Server: modelado dimensional, procedimientos almacenados, ETL, optimización y explotación de datos. Conocimiento práctico de LLMs, RAG, embeddings, bases de datos vectoriales y agentes de IA. Experiencia con herramientas de visualización de datos, idealmente Power BI. Dominio de Python para procesamiento de datos e integración con modelos de IA. Capacidad para comprender procesos de negocio y traducir necesidades funcionales en soluciones técnicas. Oferta de empleo Liderar la evolución de la estrategia de datos e IA de una compañía en expansión. Participar en proyectos vinculados a omnicanalidad, e-commerce, logística y transformación digital. Trabajar con una infraestructura de IA ya operativa, incluyendo modelos comerciales y open source. Modelo híbrido de trabajo y alta autonomía dentro del rol. Ubicación: Barcelona. items.desc: Location: London (Chancery Lane) Working pattern: Full time, hybrid (circa 2/3 days in office) About The Role Accordience Group is the parent company of four specialist communications agencies - Grayling, CDR, Red Consultancy, and Cirkle - operating across 30+ offices worldwide. We are building custom AI tools across the group. We have strong demand and clear ideas; we need someone to turn them into working products that our agencies and clients can use. This is a hands-on builder's role. You'll spend most of your time shipping - agents, internal tools, automations, reporting workflows, and the occasional client-facing MVP. You'll scope work with stakeholders, then own delivery end-to-end. The role may also involve working directly with clients to help embed AI within their communications functions. What You'll Do Build and ship custom internal AI tools, agents, and automations that the agencies use day to day Automate reporting, monitoring, and workflow tasks across the group Prototype and build MVPs of client-facing AI products, working alongside the AI team Work with internal teams and, where appropriate, clients to embed AI within communications workflows and functions Scope use cases with stakeholders across the agencies and translate them into working solutions Work directly with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and managed AI services on AWS and Azure Deploy serverless functions, wire up APIs, data sources, auth, and light front-ends around what you build Use workflow automation platforms (n8n, Make) for the jobs that don't need code Maintain and improve the tools you ship - and the ones already in flight Work with Group IT to stay inside approved platforms and security standards What We're Looking For You've shaped real things, you can show us what they do, and you can explain why you made the choices you made. We’re also open to recent graduates with a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering or a related field, ideally with some relevant work experience or internship experience. You'll have: Hands-on experience building agents, workflows, or automations - ideally inside a company rather than just side projects Comfort with Python and scripting, and the ability to wire things together via REST APIs, webhooks, auth, and permissions Direct experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) - prompts, tool use, agent design Hands-on with at least one cloud (AWS or Azure): deploying serverless functions (Lambda / Azure Functions), using managed AI services (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI), basic storage and auth Working knowledge of workflow automation platforms (n8n, Make, or equivalent) Enough front-end (HTML, React, CSS/Tailwind, or similar) to build a usable interface around what you've built Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, T-SQL / SQL Server, or similar), including enough to query, structure, and connect data sources Experience with authentication and access management patterns (e.g. OAuth/OIDC; Auth0, Microsoft Entra ID, or equivalent) Git/GitHub and good repo hygiene A pragmatic, ship-it mindset - you'd rather get a v1 in front of users than perfect a v0 in private Strong communication skills, especially with non-technical teams Useful but not essential: Multi-cloud exposure (AWS and Azure) Retrieval / RAG patterns - vector stores (Pinecone, pgvector), Azure AI Search, or similar Airtable or similar as a structured data layer Background in marketing services, PR, or communications Experience working with a Group IT or governance function Experience working directly with clients or embedded teams in a forward-deployed / solutions engineering capacity How To Apply To apply, send us: Your CV A few lines on similar work you've done and what you took from it A link or demo of something you have built OR a short take on how you would build this: weekly client coverage, pulled and summarised for sentiment and themes, into a shared doc every Monday morning

items.desc: Who We Are A lot of enterprise work still happens by hand. People copy-paste between spreadsheets, live in endless email threads and click through clunky legacy UIs. We started Duvo to end that for good. Customers already trust us with business-critical processes, and our agents are automating them today. We're growing fast, and to win from here we need exceptional people. That's where you come in. We're a team of 60, with 22 engineers, and we just raised a $32 million Series A led by Balderton Capital. What We Are Building Duvo is the AI operations platform for large enterprises. Right now we're focused on retail and consumer packaged goods. Customers build AI agents in Duvo that do the work wherever it lives: SAP, spreadsheets, supplier portals, email, APIs, you name it. We're heavy on browser and computer use. Business users say what outcome they want. The agents plan, act, ask for approval on exceptions and get better with every run. To help customers figure out what to automate, we also map their processes from interviews and internal docs, which gets our foot in the door. We start with the parts of a company we know best (category management, supply chain, finance ops), where we can show value fast, and expand from there to other functions and sectors. Velocity is our moat. We ship fast and iterate even faster. The Role You'll own user-facing features and the systems behind them end to end, live in production and measured by customer impact. You connect technical choices to what customers actually get. Product engineers at Duvo are intense about delivering impact fast. You also get to work directly with our enterprise customers. You'll deliver specific pieces for them and talk to them when it helps. That said, we don't expect you to be a polished presenter on day one. You don't need retail or CPG expertise, but you should be curious about how our customers' businesses actually work. What We're Looking For These are the non-negotiables, and it's what we'll evaluate you on: Shipping and ownership. You've taken ambiguous requirements to production across the whole feature (UI, API, data, deployment), more than once. You don't wait for someone to tell you what to build next. You set your own scope based on customer problems and ship it within a week. Product judgment. You can scope an MVP, pick the metric that matters and kill work that isn't delivering. You think about what the user needs before what's technically interesting. You can explain the tradeoff between shipping fast and going deep, and you can tell us what your work was worth to the customer or the business, beyond how it works. AI-native. You use AI every day to build. Think coding agents, often several running in parallel in Claude Code or Codex. You still own the quality, also when the reviews and tests are AI-written. Product quality. You care how a feature looks and feels. When something is off, you notice and you fix it. Collaboration. You work across functions. You align early with product and design, pull in people from other teams whenever you're missing context, and unblock yourself and others. You Might Also Have designed and run distributed systems that scale, with a good sense for security and reliability in production. Have built LLM products: features on top of LLM outputs or AI agents (parsing agent responses, human-in-the-loop flows), ideally in production with eval design, prompt engineering, safety controls and cost optimization. You won't be training models either way. Have designed interfaces for AI-assisted workflows, like confidence signals. This Is Not For You If You need a lot of hand-holding, or figuring things out yourself doesn't give you energy. You mostly want to work on infrastructure. Check out our SRE and AI Platform Engineer roles instead. You only want to do frontend without owning the full feature path. Location We're looking for people based in Europe, in European time zones, so we overlap for most of the working day. Our Tech Stack TypeScript first: Next.js, React, Tailwind, Fastify, Kysely (PostgreSQL), Zod GCP, Datadog Latest AI primitives (Anthropic) You don't need to know all of it. You should be excited to pick it up fast. How We Work These are real tradeoffs we made: Initiative-driven. We organize around customer problems instead of org charts. Problems come from product feedback, competitive analysis and talking to customers directly. Then we prioritize, build and ship every week. Customer-obsessed. We work on real problems for real customers, not hypothetical ones. Iterative by default. We ship small, learn fast and don't get attached to yesterday's code. Things break sometimes, and we fix forward. AI first. We use AI to go faster and spend human time where it really matters. If a tool can do it, a person shouldn't. Direct feedback. We tell each other right away what to improve. It can feel uncomfortable, and we think it's worth it. Autonomy with accountability. We trust people to make the call, …

items.desc: Powering the world’s payments ecosystem ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments. As a Data Scientist in Limerick, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem! This purpose of this Data Scientist is: Designs, develops and programs methods, processes, and systems to consolidate and analyse unstructured, diverse “big data” sources to generate actionable insights and solutions for client services and product enhancement. Interacts with product and service teams to identify questions and issues for data analysis and experiments. Develops and codes software programs, algorithms and automated processes to cleanse, integrate and evaluate large datasets from multiple disparate sources. Identifies meaningful insights from large data and metadata sources; interprets and communicates insights and findings from analysis and experiments to product, service, and business managers. A typical day at ACI for a Data Scientist is: - Develops predictive models for customers utilizing a variety of statistical and machine learning algorithms. - Holds responsibility for projects of a moderate degree of complexity. - Executes all stages of model development and delivery including data definition, sampling, preprocessing, feature selection, model generation, and validation and support or production model release. - Validates and prepares data for model development, performs exploratory data analysis and data cleaning on large datasets and queries and visualizes data with a variety of tools. - Works with a team of scientists and engineers responsible for the development and deployment of the state-of-the-art predictive models for a variety of financial applications. This includes the design, development and deployment of statistical predictive models. - Understands and complies with Risk Management program requirements including Identification of risks, key controls, and control testing as applicable to their responsibilities. - Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics. Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed to succeed in this role: - Bachelor’s degree required, PhD preferred in Statistical Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Computational Chemistry or related field. - 2+ years industry or related field experience. - Proficient in managing RAG pipelines and development of Agentic Process in a save and secure manner. - Prior experience in working with agentic based development is favorable Core Capabilities: We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities — these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together: - Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments. - Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. - Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions. - Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful. - Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. - Courage: stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the Ireland on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future. I n return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment. Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com Job ID (Requisition #19859) ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally. The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment.

items.desc: Creatio is an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together — with no limits on users, agents, or scale. We help midsize and large organizations run customer workflows in the AI era. With a global team and a large ecosystem of partners, Creatio serves thousands of customers in over 100 countries and automates tens of millions of workflows daily. Genuine care for our clients and partners is at the heart of our DNA. We’re proud to be recognized by top industry analysts as a Leader and Strong Performer in multiple Gartner and Forrester reports. In 2025, Creatio was named to Inc.’s Best Workplaces list , recognizing our commitment to employee wellbeing and a strong workplace culture. Who We’re Looking For We are looking for an AI Software Engineer to design, build, evaluate, and operate AI-powered capabilities within the Creatio platform. This is an AI-first engineering role: you will spend most of your time designing agents, engineering prompts and context, building retrieval and evaluation pipelines, and directing AI coding agents - with solid .NET engineering as the foundation rather than the whole job. You will join the AI teams building the agent platform that enables AI agents to safely perform real work in the product: call tools and APIs, read and write data, maintain context and memory, follow permissions, and escalate to humans when needed. The team also owns the core infrastructure for evaluation, monitoring, logging, observability, and cost/performance control, ensuring AI agents are reliable, scalable, secure, and production-ready. This role combines strong software engineering expertise with hands-on AI engineering experience. You will work on enterprise-grade AI solutions, including assistants, copilots, knowledge systems, semantic search, RAG-based capabilities, and agentic workflows - and you will use AI coding agents as your primary daily development workflow. Responsibilities Design and implement AI-powered product features within the Creatio platform: assistants, copilots, agentic workflows, knowledge systems, RAG, and semantic search. Design agent architectures - tools, memory and context strategy, orchestration, permissions, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop escalation - and choose the right pattern for each problem (single LLM call vs. tool-using agent vs. multi-agent). Engineer prompts, system instructions, and agent context as first-class artifacts: versioned, reviewed, and covered by evaluations. Integrate LLM providers, MCP servers and tools, enterprise data sources, embedding pipelines, and vector/hybrid search into the platform. Build evaluation datasets, offline and online evals, quality gates, and observability (tracing, logging, drift detection) for AI capabilities. Monitor and improve the quality, latency, cost, reliability, and security of AI capabilities in production, including prompt and model updates. Identify and mitigate AI-specific risks: prompt injection, data exfiltration through tools, hallucinations, over-permissioned agents, and sensitive-data leakage. Develop and maintain backend services using C# and .NET. Use AI coding assistants and engineering agents as the default development workflow; critically review and verify agent output; contribute reusable rules, skills, and prompts to the team. Follow the AI landscape closely and bring new models, tools, and patterns to the team. Requirements Must have: Hands-on experience shipping LLM-based features to production: prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, context-window and cost management. Practical understanding of agent architectures (tool loops, planner/executor, multi-agent, human-in-the-loop), MCP, and at least one agent framework or SDK. Working knowledge of RAG: chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, grounding and citations, and common failure modes. Experience with AI evaluation (datasets, offline evals, LLM-as-judge), LLM observability and tracing, and AI security (prompt injection, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, Responsible AI practices). Daily proficiency with AI coding agents: the ability to direct, review, and verify agent output rather than only write code by hand. Solid experience with C# and .NET, API design, distributed systems, and software architecture. Experience with SQL databases, automated testing, CI/CD, and cloud-native development; Docker and basic Kubernetes. Strong knowledge of engineering best practices and production-grade software development. Nice To Have Python for prototyping, data work, and evaluation scripting. Hands-on experience with a major AI platform (Anthropic API, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI). Experience building agent-facing tools or MCP servers. LLMOps practices: prompt and model versioning, evaluation gates in CI/CD, canary rollouts of prompt changes. Fine-tuning, distillation, or adapter-based model customization. Experience with Creatio or other low-code CRM platforms. What To Expect …

items.card: About The Role As a Full Stack Data Scientist, you are interested in what happens under the hood of modern data solutions and data architectures. You care about data quality, usability and the value it can provide for various business processes. You're experienced with data science and engineering practices, including data observability, implementing MLOps (maybe even LLMOps) workflows and real-time data processing.
items.desc: Are you a Full Stack Data Scientist driven by turning data into tangible business results? Do you want to help organizations become more productive and competitive? Vuono Group is now looking for Full Stack Data Scientists to join our growing team of experts in Helsinki. Vuono Group is a consultancy that drives business value with processes and AI. We empower Nordic organisations in both the private and public sectors to bridge the gap between business needs and AI capabilities, enabling smarter decision-making, increased operational efficiency, and accelerated growth. About The Role As a Full Stack Data Scientist, you are interested in what happens under the hood of modern data solutions and data architectures. You care about data quality, usability and the value it can provide for various business processes. You're experienced with data science and engineering practices, including data observability, implementing MLOps (maybe even LLMOps) workflows and real-time data processing. You understand the intersection of ML/AI systems and data engineering and can build scalable pipelines that support both analytical and operational use cases. Experience with cloud-native data architectures (e.g. Azure, AWS, GCP) is essential. At Vuono Group, you will get to work in a cross-competence team making our clients' businesses more intelligent with data. In practice, this means building data pipelines, integrating systems together, and utilising ML and AI for insights and operational use cases. What We’re Looking For Experience in planning and building production level data solutions that solve real business problems An analytical mindset and problem-solving skills Machine learning modeling and/or natural language processing experience Experience in designing and implementing end-to-end data pipelines that transform raw operational data into business-ready information products Experience in running and monitoring production workloads Programming experience in Python and SQL Willingness and readiness to learn and operate with new technology platforms, tools, whether low code like Celonis or Fabric or pro code like new cloud infrastructure MSc degree in Machine Learning, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or similar Professional-level Finnish and English language proficiency The Following Is Considered a Plus Interest in continuously learning and applying new technologies and platforms; generative AI, RAG, AI Agents, among others Experience with various tech stacks, e.g. AWS Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, DBT, Apache Kafka, Terraform, or similar Experience in utilising data from business technology platforms, such as ERP, CRM or similar (SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.) Experience in transforming data for process and content intelligence purposes Previous consulting experience You don’t need to tick every box! What matters most is your drive to make a real impact! What We Offer We are building the best work environment for data, AI and business process professionals. To get there, we invest in the well-being and work-life balance as well as the professional development of our people. We operate on trust and transparency rather than titles, fostering a high-autonomy, growth-oriented environment where collaboration, impact, and everyone’s unique thoughts and ideas are valued. In addition to the usual perks, such as work tools of your choice and extensive healthcare benefits, we also offer our employees the opportunity to invest in our rapidly growing company via an employee share program. Work with Leading Nordic Companies At Vuono Group, you’ll collaborate with Nordic clients on a range of challenging digital projects. Along the way, you’ll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, architecture, and how solutions are built. Explore some of our client cases here. Next steps We’re always on the lookout for new talent, which is why we recruit on a rolling basis. If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, take the next step and submit your application! Once we receive your application, we’ll be in touch. Our recruitment process typically includes at least two interviews, giving you the chance to meet some of our team members and giving us the opportunity to get to know you better: as a professional, a colleague, and a person. Reference checks are also a standard part of our process. We look forward to hearing from you! Vuono Group is a process AI company. We create superior business processes through data and AI. Our growing team of kind and ambitious people is on a mission to turn AI into real, measurable business impact. Take the next step, explore our open positions and connect with us to find your next opportunity!

Build conversational AI solutions, intelligent assistants, and AI automation workflows. Develop prompt engineering strategies to improve AI response quality and business outcomes. Integrate AI services into web applications using REST APIs and Python-based backend services. Design NLP
items.desc: We are looking for an innovative AI Developer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and modern AI frameworks. The successful candidate will work closely with product managers, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build intelligent software solutions that solve real-world business problems. This role combines AI application development, prompt engineering, backend integration, and production deployment while contributing to scalable AI product development. Responsibilities Design and develop AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar). Build conversational AI solutions, intelligent assistants, and AI automation workflows. Develop prompt engineering strategies to improve AI response quality and business outcomes. Integrate AI services into web applications using REST APIs and Python-based backend services. Design NLP pipelines for text analysis, information extraction, semantic search, and document understanding. Collaborate with product teams to translate business requirements into AI-driven solutions. Participate in product architecture discussions and AI solution design. Optimize AI performance through prompt refinement, retrieval techniques, and evaluation methodologies. Develop scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI (or similar frameworks). Work with Git, version control, Agile development methodologies, and CI/CD pipelines. Deploy AI applications using cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Monitor AI system performance and continuously improve model outputs and user experience. Document AI solutions and maintain technical documentation. Qualifications, Experience & Personal Attributes Required Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Linguistics, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Proven working experience in software development (2-4 years). Knowledge of computational linguistics or Natural Language Processing. Experience designing AI workflows for customer engagement and business automation. Understanding of semantic analysis, language modelling, and prompt optimization. Familiarity with vector search, embeddings, and knowledge retrieval. Exposure to MLOps practices and AI model deployment. Key Skills Large Language Models (LLMs) Prompt Engineering Conversational AI AI Workflow Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) AI Automation Natural Language Processing (NLP) We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age

Then join us in shaping the next generation of AI-driven architectures for leading organizations worldwide. Design agentic platforms, autonomous delivery pipelines, and intelligent systems that translate enterprise knowledge into scalable business impact. Bring your unique strengths to our distinctive team – one that consistently supports each other. As part of the Boston Consulting Group, we drive innovation from the boardroom to the code. Shape the world of tomorrow You will contribute to the design of AI-driven target architectures – from LLM orchestration and agentic AI to harness engineering in autonomous software factories such as evaluation frameworks and CI/CD integrations that govern the behavior of coding agents across the entire SDLC You will build modern software delivery approaches: from DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines to Apply now with your CV, an informative project list and all relevant references via our online portal or contact Leonie Kutschera-Gross (+49 221 58958-555) if you have any questions. items.desc: Overall Purpose: Design, develop, and maintain software solutions that enable AI-powered workflows, enterprise application integration, and secure automation. Build scalable APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Python-based services, and cloud-native components that connect business systems, data platforms, and AI agents. Partner with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and maintainable solutions using modern DevOps practices, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and strong software engineering standards. Key Roles and Responsibilities: Typical tasks may include, but are not limited to, the following: AI-Enabled Software Development: Design, build, and maintain software capabilities that support AI-enabled workflows, including MCP servers, agent-facing tools, and application integrations that allow enterprise systems and data sources to be accessed securely and consistently. API and Service Development: Develop robust APIs, backend services, and integration layers using Python and modern service patterns, with emphasis on reliability, maintainability, authentication, observability, and clear interface design. MCP Server and Tooling Implementation: Implement MCP tools and server-side capabilities that expose business functions, data access patterns, and automation workflows to AI agents while enforcing security, access controls, and responsible usage guardrails. DevOps and CI/CD Automation: Build, enhance, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or similar platforms, supporting automated builds, testing, code quality checks, artifact management, deployments, and repeatable release processes. Cloud-Native Engineering: Develop and deploy cloud-ready services using Azure-based patterns, containerized workloads, secure configuration management, logging, monitoring, and scalable runtime architectures. Collaboration and Documentation: Partner with product owners, software engineers, data engineers, security teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable technical solutions. Document APIs, MCP tools, deployment patterns, runbooks, and engineering standards for long-term support and reuse. Job Contribution: Independently design, develop, and support AI-enabled software solutions, APIs, MCP servers, and cloud-native services using strong DevOps practices. Lead moderate-sized technical efforts, contribute to architecture decisions, improve engineering standards, and deliver secure, scalable solutions that accelerate automation, AI adoption, and business productivity. What You’ll Need (Required Skills): Hands-on experience with: Python development for applications, services, automation, or integration work Proficiency with general software engineering languages and practices, with the ability to work across modern programming stacks as needed API development using modern backend frameworks and secure service design patterns MCP server or AI tool development, including exposing structured tools, data access, or workflow automation to AI agents Azure DevOps, Git-based development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release automation Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including code quality, modular design, version control, security, logging, monitoring, and documentation best practices. Experience collaborating across engineering, data, AI, security, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver reliable enterprise software solutions. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with FastAPI, FastMCP, SQLAlchemy, containerized deployments, or cloud-hosted Python services Familiarity with Azure services, managed identity, Key Vault, container platforms (Docker), private networking, or enterprise authentication patterns Experience with AI-assisted development tools, prompt-aware engineering workflows, agentic architectures, or LLM application integration Hands-on experience with LangGraph and LangChain for developing LLM-powered applications, agents, and workflow orchestration Contractual name of the role : Senior Specialist Software Engineering Location : Bratislava, Slovakia Working hours : EMEA Salary : The gross monthly base salary for this position ranges from EUR 3,200 to EUR 4,900. items.desc: Country: Portugal COMEÇA AQUI O Santander (www.santander.com) está a evoluir de uma marca global de grande impacto para uma organização orientada pela tecnologia, e as nossas pessoas estão no centro desta jornada. Juntos , estamos a liderar uma transformação centrada no cliente , que valoriza o pensamento crítico, a inovação e a coragem de desafiar o que é possível . Esta é mais do que uma mudança estratégica. É uma oportunidade para pessoas motivadas crescerem, aprenderem e fazerem uma diferença real. A nossa missão é contribuir para que mais pessoas e empresas prosperem . Adotámos uma cultura de risco sólida, e todas as nossas pessoas, em todos os níveis, têm um papel ativo e responsável na gestão de riscos. O TEU IMPACTO O Santander está à procura de um(a) estagiário/a de GenAI para Lisboa. Procuramos talento com interesse em desenvolvimento de software e inteligência artificial para integrar a nossa equipa de GenAI. O foco será o desenvolvimento de aplicações e microserviços que utilizam modelos de AI generativa pré-treinados (como os da OpenAI) para resolver desafios reais de negócio. Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para aplicar conhecimentos técnicos em projetos inovadores com impacto direto. Estamos a redefinir a forma como trabalhamos através da inovação, da tecnologia de ponta, da colaboração e da liberdade para explorar novas ideias. Para ter sucesso nesta função, serás responsável por: Desenvolver aplicações e microserviços que integrem modelos de GenAI via APIs. Criar e manter pipelines de dados e serviços backend escaláveis. Trabalhar com equipas multidisciplinares para identificar casos de uso e implementar soluções baseadas em IA. Garantir boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo testes, versionamento e integração contínua. Explorar novas ferramentas e abordagens para melhorar a eficiência e a qualidade das soluções desenvolvidas. O TEU CONTRIBUTO As nossas pessoas são a nossa maior força. Cada indivíduo contribui com perspetivas únicas que nos tornam mais fortes como equipa e como organização. Capacitamos as equipas para irem mais além , valorizando quem são e potenciando o que trazem consigo. Os seguintes requisitos representam os conhecimentos, competências e capacidades essenciais para o sucesso nesta função. Serão consideradas adaptações razoáveis para permitir que pessoas com deficiência possam desempenhar as funções essenciais. FORMAÇÃO ACADÉMICA Formação em áreas de STEM. (obrigatório) IDIOMAS Português (obrigatório) Inglês (preferencial) Espanhol (preferencial) Hard Skills Conhecimentos em linguagens de programação como Python, SQL e Java. (obrigatório) Experiência com bibliotecas e frameworks de IA. (preferencial) Containers (Docker, Kubernetes). (preferencial) Prompt Engineering. (preferencial) OpenAI (preferencial) RAG (preferencial) Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git). (preferencial) Conhecimento em computação cloud (Azure, Aws). (preferencial) Conhecimento com ferramentas de CI/CD como GitHub Actions, GOCD ou similares. (preferencial) Soft Skills Atitude proativa e dinâmica. Capacidade de trabalho em equipa e de relacionamento interpessoal. VALORIZAMOS O TEU IMPACTO A tua contribuição é importante e será reconhecida. Podes esperar um pacote de remuneração justo e competitivo, que reflete o impacto que crias e o valor que entregas. Mas sabemos que as recompensas vão muito além dos números. Oferecemos mais do que um salário. Os nossos benefícios foram concebidos para apoiar a tua vida, os teus objetivos e o teu bem-estar, agora e no futuro. A tua saúde é a nossa prioridade. Através do BeHealthy, o nosso programa global de bem-estar, promovemos o bem-estar holístico. Sabemos que a família é tudo. Por isso, oferecemos licença parental, apoio à infância e programas adaptados a cada fase da vida. Potenciamos as nossas equipas através de oportunidades globais e percursos de carreira diversificados. Acreditamos no poder da ajuda. Pode dedicar parte do teu tempo de trabalho a atividades de voluntariado. Estamos aqui para te manter motivado(a) , ajudar-te a alcançar os teus objetivos e celebrar o teu progresso em cada etapa do caminho. CONFORMIDADE LOCAL O Santander orgulha-se de ser uma organização que promove a igualdade de oportunidades, independentemente da idade, género, deficiência, estado civil, raça, religião ou orientação sexual. Comprometemo-nos a oferecer um processo de candidatura inclusivo e acessível a todas as pessoas. O QUE FAZER A SEGUIR Se consideras que esta função é do teu interesse, candidata-te. Pronto(a) para dar o próximo passo na tua jornada?

items.desc: About Customs Support Group Customs Support Group (CSG) is the European market leader in customs services, operating across 15 countries. CSG is owned by private equity and a fast-growing, dynamic, data-driven company, dedicated to expanding its presence through strong organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Its key priorities include digital transformation, operational excellence and customer experience, all aimed at driving growth and enhancing efficiency. The Role You will take our AI stack and lead its development and customisation for the market. This is a builder and do-er role. You will design, test and implement practical and compliant agentic AI solutions on top of foundation models document understanding, classification support, retrieval over our own procedures and tariff material, and agents that carry multi-step operational work end to end. You are not being asked to train models from scratch. You are being asked to make models that already exist behave reliably enough that operations staff trust them with customs declarations, where being wrong has consequences. Working closely with Operations, Transformation, IT and Group teams, you will turn business needs into scalable solutions. Key Responsibilities Develop and customise AI solutions for the market, from prototype through to production ownership. Be curious and prepared to self-learn to use generative-AI to build agents that make a difference to our business Identify automation and decision-support opportunities across customs and business processes, and size them honestly before building. Design solutions using generative AI and large language models — retrieval, tool calling, structured extraction from customs documentation, and agentic workflows where they genuinely fit. Own the evaluation. Define how we know a solution is working before it ships, and how we know a change has not made it worse. This is treated as core to the role, not an afterthought. Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it. Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact. Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners. Contribute to privacy, security and AI governance compliance, working with Group Legal and IT Security. You should understand how the EU AI Act applies to what you build, and be able to produce the documentation that goes with it. Requirements Essential 1-2 years AI engineering, software engineering or intelligent automation, including LLM or AI features that real users depended on. Strong Python and SQL, with production code ownership. Not familiarity. Demonstrable experience integrating large language models into production systems — prompt and context design, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output, and handling failure gracefully. Practical experience with at least one major cloud AI platform (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex). Solid full stack backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, testing, CI/CD. Most of this job is Strong communication skills — you will spend real time with operations staff who are experts in customs and not in AI. Professional fluency in English. Desirable Evaluation engineering: building eval harnesses and regression suites for non-deterministic systems, LLM-as-judge approaches, and human-in-the-loop review design. This is the single strongest signal we look for and we will weight it heavily. Context engineering: designing and version-controlling what a model sees — retrieval strategy, memory, tool descriptions, and policy layers that constrain what an agent is allowed to do. Agent orchestration frameworks and standards (LangGraph, MCP, Temporal or equivalent), and experience with long-running or multi-step agent workflows. Observability and cost control for inference at volume. What success looks like in your first year By month three: You understand our customs processes well enough to challenge what we ask for, and you have shipped one small, useful thing. By month six: At least one AI solution is live, measured against a baseline, and demonstrably better than what it replaced. By month twelve: There is a working evaluation process others can use, a ranked pipeline of next opportunities, and at least two colleagues outside IT operating what you have built without you in the room. What We Offer A key role in shaping AI capabilities. The opportunity to build solutions with direct business impact, on real operational volume rather than pilots that never leave the lab. An international and fast-evolving environment, with peers in other Customs Support Group markets working on the same problems. Professional growth opportunities, including a budget for conferences, certification and model/compute costs for your own experiments. Permanent role. Hybrid working. How to apply Send us your CV and a short note a few paragraphs is plenty describing one system you have put in front of …

The role turns operational needs into structured requirements, analyses processes, data and workflows, and identifies opportunities to improve service delivery, reporting, AI enablement and transformation execution across internal functions. Build or support dashboards, reports and management views for transformation progress, operating model performance and service improvement. Conduct data quality checks and document assumptions, definitions and limitations to support reliable decision-making. Prepare concise communication, training and decision materials for stakeholders and senior leadership. Contribute to reusable standards, methodologies and artefacts that improve how Synpulse delivers transformation initiatives. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. we operate in 3 markets as one Central European business, so there are many opportunities for growth and development Solid Business Background with more than 100 proud years of company history We are a Great Team , and we are not fond of any formalities here Modern Office with great location (e.g.: free parking) Flexible working policy You will be responsible for - items.desc: The SAL MicroFab is looking for a motivated R&D Process Engineer focusing on stepper-based lithography processes to join the team. As an R&D Process Engineer, you will take on challenging and responsible tasks with corresponding decision-making scope. You will work independently across all required activities, continuously expand your skill set, and contribute to the growing success of the team. Your Future Tasks Include Develop, optimize, and maintain stepper-based lithography processes for a diverse multi-project R&D environment. Establish repeatable process baselines and maintain control through SPC and routine performance monitoring. Define and document process parameters, recipes, and SOPs to support repeatable user operation. Own stepper tool and periphery equipment, ensuring high uptime and consistent performance for multiple technologies and flows. Work closely with process engineers and users to ensure lithography compatibility across varied fabrication flows. Work closely with equipment maintenance engineers to ensure tool health. Lead hands-on troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement in a fast-changing R&D setting. Support tool upgrades, new installations, and capability expansion projects. Your Profile Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Materials Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related field. 5 years of experience as a stepper process engineer in an industrial or applied research semiconductor FAB; more experience is of advantage. Hands-on experience with lithography process & metrology tools. Hands on experience with lithography Tracks - advantage Understanding in mask design – advantage Proven experience with methodologies - process control, SPC, Problem Solving, CIP, Lean, equipment maintenance principles, etc. Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a research-driven environment supporting multiple stakeholders. Excellent teamwork, communication, reporting, and organizational skills. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic R&D setting. items.desc: kausable is moving from a pure research lab toward products used by real customers. As our software engineer for product and enablement, you own two scopes, and serve two types of customers: external ones (product) and internal ones (enablement/tooling). Product : externally shipped functionality. This is the software layer around our AI: the applications through which users interact with our AI and the delivery infrastructure that unlocks them. This entails quality assurance before and after delivery, for the technical/software axis as well as the machine-learning/capability axis. Enablement : internal platforms and tools, developer workflows; in a sense products where the customers are your research-science colleagues. The boundary with our Harness Engineer is deliberate. That role owns building and improving the ML capabilities. You own the adaptable software systems through which users experience those capabilities. Tasks Build customer-facing applications and integrations from scoping through delivery. Assure the quality of our products: before and after delivery, technical (software) and capability (machine-learning performance). Design APIs, workflows and frontend interfaces that keep complex model capabilities usable. Act as a technical bridge between researchers, product stakeholders and the people using what we build. Contain technical debt through thoughtful abstractions, testing and documentation. Design the delivery pipelines, versioning and observability needed across training, evaluation and live inference. Own model releases, monitoring and rollback patterns as the production footprint grows. Build internal platforms and tools that reduce setup time and cognitive load for researchers. Improve researcher experience through reproducible environments, CI/CD, automation and clear repository standards. Requirements Broad software engineering experience across backend and infrastructure. Deep understanding of software design and complexity management: you build systems that remain easy to change. Strong Python skills plus TypeScript, JavaScript or another modern frontend language. Experience with containers, cloud infrastructure and production delivery. Experience with quality measurements and assurance of ML capabilities. A track record of customer-facing or cross-functional project work. Clear communication, strong problem solving and a pragmatic, self-directed operating style. We are primarily hiring at senior level. We are also open to exceptional candidates with fewer years of experience who can demonstrate comparable depth, judgment and ownership. Nice to have: Security, privacy or on-premise deployment requirements. C++ or Rust for performance-sensitive services and tooling. Enough exposure to ML systems to collaborate productively with researchers without being expected to build models. Internal developer platforms, research tooling or ML infrastructure. Experiment tracking, data tooling or reproducible compute environments. Benefits 🚀 Where This Can Go You will shape how kausable builds and ships software as we scale: the architecture, tooling, standards and developer experience. The role can grow into ownership of our platform and internal engineering, or into leadership of customer-facing product delivery. The hard part is balancing both horizons: helping the team move today while keeping the system adaptable tomorrow. 🫂 Our Culture We are "Putting Science at the Core of AI" — with all its curiosity, daringness, and humanity. That means we: are scientists at heart, with a builder's mindset, are open to challenge, grounded in curiosity and respect, welcome diverse perspectives and value thoughtful, open debate, focus on outcomes and real-world impact, foster an environment of support, inspiration, and freedom for everyone to do their best work. 🏆 Perks & Benefits VSOP equity: a real stake in what we build. 30 days of paid holiday per year. Statutory social insurance. Conference travel and role-relevant learning. Flexible hybrid work, with roughly one in-person team meet-up per month. A high-end laptop of your choice. ⚒️ Tools and Infrastructure Python and a modern frontend stack. Docker, AWS, GCP, Hetzner, RunPod or comparable infrastructure. CI/CD, testing and developer-tooling systems. AI agents such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini in daily work. 🫶 Sounds like it's for you? Send us your favorite way to drink coffee along with your CV or LinkedIn, and we'll get back to you soon. If it's a match, we'll get to know each other over a number of online interviews, followed by an onsite day where we go in depth. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

items.desc: The University of Vienna is a community of almost 11,000 individuals, including approximately 7,700 academic staff members, who passionately pursue answers to the profound questions that shape our future. They represent individuals driven by curiosity and a relentless pursuit of excellence. With us, they find the space to try things out and unfold their potential. Are you inspired by their passion and determination? We are currently seeking a/an University assistant predoctoral - Vienna Network for Atmospheric Research (VINAR) 51 Faculty of Physics Startdate: 01.11.2026 | Working hours: 30 | Collective bargaining agreement: 48 VwGr. B1 Grundstufe (praedoc) Limited until: 31.10.2030 Reference no.: 6233 Are you interested in experimental aerosol physics, in-situ measurements, and both laboratory and field work? If so, join the Aerosol Physics and Environmental Physics (AEP) Group to investigate understudied aerosol components across urban and remote environments. As a pre-doc, you will be part of the AEP Group around Professor Bernadett Weinzierl. The AEP Group combines highly sophisticated laboratory, ground-based and aircraft measurements with innovative modelling to study the fundamental physical and chemical properties of aerosol particles and clouds. Current research covers various areas of aerosol science and spans the whole size spectrum from the nano- to the microscale. We are looking for a motivated pre-doctoral scientist to extend our team. The employment duration is 4 years. Your Personal Sphere Of Influence As a pre-doc university assistant in this 4-year position, you will be part of the Aerosol Physics and Environmental Physics Group around Professor Bernadett Weinzierl. The overall aim of this position is the characterization of the atmospheric aerosol collected at the Aerosols Observatory of the University of Vienna, which is in the process of becoming a National Facility within the pan-European Aerosol, Clouds and Trace Gases Research Infrastructure ACTRIS, and comparison to the aerosol data measured at the Sonnblick Observatory, Austria. Specifically, you will focus on the determination of optical and microphysical properties of atmospheric aerosols measured at these two stations, one representing urban background environment, and the other one, remote atmosphere at 3100 m in altitude. The position is offered within the Vienna Network for Atmospheric Research (VINAR) and involves collaboration with colleagues at GeoSphere Austria and the Department of Meteorology and Geophysics at the Faculty of Earth Sciences, Geography and Astronomy, University of Vienna. The employment duration is 4 years. Initially limited to 1.5 years, the employment relationship is automatically extended to 4 years if the employer does not terminate it within the first 12 months by submitting a nonextension declaration. Your Future Tasks Active participation in research, teaching & administration, which means: You will be involved in unique research projects in which we collaborate with top scientific institutions Your work will focus on rarely-studied aerosol components (including microplastics and others) at urban and remote sites in the framework of ACTRIS and beyond You will set up, characterize, maintain and operate ACTRIS instrumentation such as Aethalometer (AE), Nephelometer, Aerodynamic Particle Sizer (APS) in order to measure the aerosol microphysical and optical properties sampling from a PM10 inlet at the Aerosol Observatory You will characterize instruments in the laboratory, perform aerosol measurements at the Aerosol Observatory, process, analyze and interpret the aerosol data with respect to aerosol microphysical and optical properties You will compare data obtained at the Aerosol Observatory (urban background) in Vienna and the Sonnblick Observatory (remote atmosphere) You will collaborate within VINAR, GeoSphere Austria (Sonnblick Observatory) and the Department of Meteorology and Geophysics at the Faculty of Earth Sciences, Geography and Astronomy, University of Vienna (FLEXPART modelling) You will work on your dissertation and towards its completion in time. You will present your research plan to the faculty and complete a dissertation agreement within 12–18 months. This will be reviewed and adapted on an annual basis You will actively and continuously perform literature search to independently locate relevant journal articles You will contribute to teaching (lab courses, exercise classes) within the provisions of the collective bargaining agreement You will fill some administrative tasks, contributing to the success and self-organization of the group for research, teaching and administration You will contribute to outreach by publications, conference presentations and public activities Compulsory This is part of your personality: Master's degree (or equivalent) in physics and/or aerosol-related topics such as atmospheric sciences, aerosol chemistry, meteorology, or similar Affinity for practical …

items.desc: A Different Kind Of Job Description At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make. Why this is a terrible job This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable. You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall. Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four. And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless. Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise. The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening. The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that. We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win. What You'll Build As a Fullstack Developer, you'll build the product surface and the platform underneath it: The workflows tax professionals live in every day, from document intake through review to delivery Deep integrations with the tax software firms already use, so Filed works where they work The pipelines that move documents, data, and returns reliably at scale, through the most intense weeks of tax season You'll ship across the stack, own features end to end, and see your work in front of some of the most demanding professional users in the world within days, not quarters. What You'll Be Responsible For Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told Learning about LLMs and making them work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale Your Hard Skillset Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python: you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it Your Soft Skillset Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it A championship team We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together. We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is …

items.desc: The University of Vienna is a community of almost 11,000 individuals, including approximately 7,700 academic staff members, who passionately pursue answers to the profound questions that shape our future. They represent individuals driven by curiosity and a relentless pursuit of excellence. With us, they find the space to try things out and unfold their potential. Are you inspired by their passion and determination? We are currently seeking a/an University assistant predoctoral 51 Faculty of Physics Startdate: 01.12.2026 | Working hours: 30 | Collective bargaining agreement: 48 VwGr. B1 Grundstufe (praedoc) Limited until: 30.11.2030 Reference no.: 6265 Explore and teach at the University of Vienna, where more than 7,500 academics thrive on curiosity in continuous exploration and help us better understand our world. Does this sound like you? Then join our accomplished team! The Group Electronic Properties of Materials at the Faculty of Physics at the University of Vienna searches excellent candidates for the subgroup Low Dimensional Quantum Solids. The Group of Electronic Properties of Materials at the Faculty of Physics is a committed team of scientists with the main research focus on low dimensional quantum solids. We dedicate a great part of our research to the growth and spectroscopic analysis of pristine and doped carbon-based molecular structures to unravel their underlying electron transport and optical properties. We aim at understanding which parameters control their unique properties to subsequently engineer them to access their full application potential. Your Personal Sphere Of Influence Your job will be focused on tailoring the electronic and optical properties of 1D and 2D nanostructures via advanced filling reactions and intercalation. Especially, the control of basic correlation effects, doping of interfaces and the concomitant understanding of their influence on charge transfer and hybridization are crucial. The group offers a vibrant and intellectually stimulating research environment where curiosity and scientific excellence thrive. You'll be part of a dynamic, collaborative community of researchers who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of materials science. Our atmosphere balances ambitious research goals with mutual support and collegiality, fostering both independent thinking and teamwork. We offer an active research culture with regular seminars, group discussions and knowledge exchange that keep you connected to the latest developments. We all value open communication, creative problem-solving, and a healthy work-life balance, creating an environment where you can grow both professionally and personally. International collaboration is at the heart of what we do, providing you with opportunities to build a global network while working alongside diverse, talented colleagues who share your enthusiasm for cutting-edge science. You will be associated to the MORE-TEM project and OVID laboratory as well as to the MATE platform. See more information on more-tem.univie.ac.at and ovid.univie.ac.at. Within these projects our group focuses strongly on the development of new techniques combining high spatial, energy & momentum (q)-resolution for nanospectroscopic analysis at all energy scales. This enables us to investigate dispersion and lifetime of primary excitations in nanomaterials such as 2D heterostructures and 1D nanotubes. This facilitates the control of quantum phases, like charge-density waves and superconductivity, to engineer new materials for energy (e.g. batteries, (opto-)electronic devices). Your Future Tasks You actively participate in research, teaching & administration, which means: You will present your research plan to the faculty and complete a dissertation agreement within 12-18 months. This will be reviewed and adapted on an annual basis. You will work on and advance your dissertation and towards its completion in time toward successful completion with dedicated mentorship. We expect a large degree of independence paired with a high level of social awareness as the goal will only be achieved in a team. You will contribute to teaching activities (lab courses, exercise classes) both in teams and independently within the provisions of the collective bargaining agreement. You will fill some administrative tasks, contributing to the success and self-organization of the group for research, teaching and administration. You will continuously stay informed about the state of the art in your field. You will contribute to outreach by publications, conference presentations and public activities. You will engage with the broader scientific community through conferences and collaborative events. This Is Part Of Your Personality You must have a master's degree or diploma in physics, physical chemistry, materials science or a related field. You must have experience either in inelastic electron scattering (EELS), TEM or optical and Raman spectroscopy. You must have basic …
