items.desc: Why Keyrus, Why Now! Keyrus is an international group of 3000 experts across 30 countries , built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work - designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence. Intelligent systems are only as dependable as the data beneath them. Reliable pipelines, trusted data products, governed access, and meaningful enterprise context allow analytics, applications, models, and agents to operate consistently in production. Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates . Industrial discipline connects the two. What You'll Architect As a Data Engineer - AI & Data Platforms, you will design, build, and operate reliable data products and pipelines that support analytics, applications, and intelligent systems. This is fundamentally a Data Engineering role, with an additional focus on preparing enterprise data for modern AI use cases. You will work across structured and unstructured information, transforming source data into trusted, reusable data products that can support analytics and operational applications as well as RAG, retrieval, evaluation, and agent-enabled systems. Your responsibilities Design, build, test, and operate production data pipelines and data products, moving data reliably from enterprise source systems into reusable consumption layers. Develop and maintain data models and transformation logic that preserve clear definitions, business context, and reliable use across analytical, operational, and AI workloads. Implement data quality, lineage, metadata, and observability controls, ensuring critical data is trustworthy, understandable, and monitored in production. Prepare structured and unstructured enterprise data for intelligent systems, including retrieval, grounding, RAG, semantic context, and evaluation datasets where required. Engineer reliable ingestion and processing patterns across APIs, databases, files, documents, events, and other relevant enterprise sources. Operate and improve data workloads in a major cloud/data ecosystem, balancing reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost. Collaborate with AI Engineers and Software Engineers on stable data interfaces, without taking ownership of model behavior, agents, or the surrounding application. Document and reuse data-engineering patterns, including data contracts, transformations, controls, dependencies, and operational knowledge that can strengthen future Keyrus engagements. Who You Are You are a hands-on Data Engineer who understands that moving data is not enough. Data must remain trusted, understandable, available, and usable once a system is operating in production. You think from source to consumption and can determine what is required to turn fragmented enterprise data into reliable data products. You combine strong engineering fundamentals with practical judgment. You understand that analytics, applications, RAG systems, evaluations, and agents may consume data differently, and you design the foundation accordingly without trying to own the intelligence or application layers yourself. What You Bring Must Have Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and data products. Strong SQL and data-modeling fundamentals, with the ability to design clear, maintainable transformation and consumption layers. Practical engineering capability in Python or another language commonly used for production data engineering. Deep practical expertise in at least one major cloud data ecosystem, with the ability to apply the same engineering principles across comparable technologies. Experience implementing data quality, testing, monitoring, lineage, or observability within production data workflows. Understanding of production engineering concerns including reliability, scalability, security, access, maintainability, and performance. Should Have Experience preparing structured and unstructured data for AI or GenAI use cases. Practical understanding of how RAG, retrieval, embeddings, semantic context, and evaluation datasets depend on enterprise data. Experience working with distributed processing, orchestration, and modern data-transformation approaches. Experience with batch ingestion and one or more additional patterns such as APIs, change data capture, event-driven processing, or streaming. Working knowledge of CI/CD, automated testing, version control, and repeatable deployment practices for data solutions. Experience with vector or hybrid search infrastructure used for retrieval-based AI systems/ Feeding and maintaining RAG indexes Rapid prototyping, from mockup to working proof of concept in days (Streamlit) Experience collaborating with AI, software, analytics, architecture, or …

Our energies are focused on creating solutions that help them get more out of their crops, now and in the future. A commitment in every seed. We do this by protecting seed, bulbs, or small plant quality from the start to enable growers to achieve the highest yield potentials in their operations; continually investing in R&D to bring cutting-edge innovations to the market; and striving to make a real-world difference through more sustainable practices on farms, in shipping, and at the grocery store. Job Description At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, Syngenta’s Analytics & Data Sciences Team is seeking an R&D Analytics - AI Developer. This role will build software solutions that enable R&D teams to analyze experimental, phenotypic, genotypic, environmental, operational, and pipeline data at scale. The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering, applied AI, and scientific data understanding to deliver tools that improve decision-making across Vegetable R&D. The role requires fluency in modern AI-assisted development tools, including internal AI platforms, while also being able to design solutions that go beyond generic AI by embedding R&D-specific models, datasets, workflows, and domain logic. We are looking for someone who does not simply use AI tools, but knows how to build beyond them. The ideal candidate will use AI platforms and modern AI development assistants to accelerate delivery, while also creating differentiated R&D solutions that depend on Syngenta’s scientific data, models, experimental context, and domain expertise. Accountabilities: Design and build data pipelines to support the development and deployment of machine learning models and advanced analytics. Build analytical software and AI solutions that integrate R&D-specific data, models, and decision frameworks into intuitive user workflows. Build application containerization and orchestration within a cloud environment. Managing software deployment and configuration in non-production and production environments. Partner with R&D scientists, data scientists, and analytics teams to translate scientific and operational needs into scalable software solutions. Use AI-assisted software development tools to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, testing, while maintaining strong engineering judgment and accountability for final outputs. Evaluate emerging AI, agentic AI, and automation capabilities and identify where they can responsibly improve R&D analytics, experimentation, and decision support. Ensure solutions are scientifically valid, explainable where needed, reliable in production, and aligned with data governance, model governance, security, and compliance expectations. WL4A Qualifications Master or PhD in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Quantitative Genetics, or a related field A minimum of 5 years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years building and maintaining production systems in Python. Familiarity with AI and machine learning frameworks. Strong knowledge and experience of Agentic AI and large language models. Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining end-to-end software solutions. Strong Python programming and software engineering skills. Experience with big data platforms and technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks). Experience packaging, deploying, and monitoring ML models in production. Proficiency in developing cloud-native applications and deploying to cloud environments, especially AWS. Experience with API technologies (e.g. RESTful APIs or GraphQL) Experience developing software products or analytical applications for scientific, R&D, agricultural, biological, or similarly complex data domains. Demonstrated ability to use AI coding assistants, enterprise AI platforms, or agentic AI tools to accelerate software delivery while applying independent technical review, testing, and validation. Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including model evaluation, bias/error assessment, traceability, prompt/version management, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Additional Information Location: You may work from any site in Netherlands following the local guidances of the hybrid model. #LI-DNI

With more than 3,5 million customer accounts and more than 75 million securities transactions processed in 2025, flatexDEGIRO is the largest retail online broker in Europe. In times of bank consolidation, growing digitalization and the immanent need of millions of Europeans to take their financial future into their own hands, flatexDEGIRO is ideally positioned for further profitable growth. Want to know what it’s like to work for flatexDEGIRO? Check out our Instagram @lifeatflatexdegiro and meet the great people that makes us who we are! Do you already see yourself as part of this team? Apply! At flatexDEGIRO, we're taking AI beyond isolated experiments and individual applications. Our ambition is to create a scalable, secure, and self-service AI environment where business and technology teams across the company can independently build, integrate, and use AI capabilities to solve real problems. As an AI Engineer , you will join our growing AI Hub to help make this vision a reality. You'll build production-ready AI applications, develop reusable platform components, and create the technical foundations that make AI accessible, reliable, and scalable across the organization. We're not looking for someone who simply knows how to experiment with AI. We're looking for a strong software engineer who knows how to build things that last. Our AI Hub is still evolving, you won't simply be stepping into an established engineering environment. You'll have the opportunity to help shape the shared AI Platform, influence engineering standards, and build capabilities that enable teams across the company to innovate independently. This is what you'll do Design, build, and maintain production-grade AI applications using Python, modern software engineering practices, and reusable architectural patterns. Develop intelligent applications using LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool calling, and agentic AI , including orchestration, context management, and integration with external systems. Build APIs, connectors, and integration layers that connect AI capabilities with enterprise applications, business processes, and internal data sources. Design and implement retrieval solutions involving data ingestion, transformation, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval strategies. Develop secure and scalable data integration pipelines that make structured and unstructured enterprise data accessible to AI applications. Package, deploy, and operate AI services using Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines , ensuring consistent and reliable delivery across environments. Build automated testing, LLM evaluation, and regression testing frameworks to continuously assess and improve AI output quality, accuracy, and reliability. Implement monitoring and observability to track AI response quality, latency, performance, system behaviour, and operational stability. Take end-to-end technical ownership of AI solutions, from initial experimentation and development to production deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. Develop reusable libraries, services, integration patterns, and engineering templates that contribute to the evolution of our shared AI Platform. Work closely with other AI engineers, product teams, architecture, infrastructure, and security colleagues to solve technical challenges and deliver practical solutions. Ensure AI applications meet enterprise standards for security, data protection, governance, and regulatory compliance, without introducing unnecessary complexity. You'll bring us these skills We're looking for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with genuine curiosity about AI and a passion for building things that work in the real world. Technical expertise is essential, but ownership, creativity, and the ability to turn ideas into working solutions matter just as much. Strong hands-on Python software engineering experience , with a proven ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable, production-grade applications. Practical experience building applications with Generative AI, LLMs, and modern AI development frameworks , rather than only experimenting with AI tools. Experience with RAG architectures, retrieval strategies, embeddings, vector search , and integrating structured and unstructured data into AI applications. Nous informons nos clients et les accompagnons dans tous leurs déplacements, quel que soit le moyen de transport, afin que leur mobilité soit une expérience efficace mais surtout agréable. Nous développons des solutions d’assistance, de services et de mobilité multimodales tournées vers l’avenir, avec une attention particulière pour l’aspect humain et un caractère innovant. Touring est « a cool place to be » . Nous vous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique dans un bâtiment flambant neuf, équipé des dernières technologies. https://www.touring.be/nl/jobs About the job... En tant qu’ Analyste Intégration Senior , vous jouez un rôle clé dans la réussite des projets d’intégration en faisant le lien entre les besoins métier, l’architecture et les équipes de développement. Vous transformez les besoins d’échange de données en spécifications techniques exploitables, validez les interfaces et garantissez, grâce à des tests rigoureux, la qualité et la fiabilité des flux mis en production. Vous disposez d’une véritable autonomie sur les technologies d’intégration et les API. Vous êtes capable de rédiger et analyser des contrats OpenAPI ou WSDL, d’exécuter des campagnes de tests, de diagnostiquer des erreurs HTTP ou d’authentification et d’assurer la qualité des intégrations de bout en bout. Vos responsabilités : Analyse et spécification des intégrations Recueillir les besoins d’échange de données auprès des équipes métier, Product Owners et partenaires. Rédiger les Interface Design Documents (IDD) incluant les contrats d’API, mappings de données, règles de transformation, gestion des erreurs, volumétrie et SLA. Positionner les flux dans l’architecture cible (xAPI, pAPI, sAPI) et identifier les écarts aux principes d’architecture API-led. Conception fonctionnelle et technique des API Définir et revoir les contrats OpenAPI (REST) et WSDL/XSD (SOAP) en collaboration avec les architectes et développeurs. Concevoir les modèles d’intégration adaptés : synchrone, asynchrone, événementiel, batch ou publish/subscribe. Définir les exigences de sécurité : OAuth2, certificats, client credentials, subscription keys APIM, JWT et mTLS. items.desc: We are looking for one or two highly motivated research assistants for 4-month period to investigate how a long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) variant of ASCC3 regulates transcriptional recovery following DNA damage, in the Svejstrup lab, DNRF Center of Excellence, Center for Gene Expression (CGEN), Department of Cellular and Molecular Medicine (ICMM), Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. Staring date: January 1, 2027 Previous work from the Svejstrup group identified two gene products of ASCC3 implicated in this response: a protein, encoded by the long mRNA transcript, that suppresses transcription during the late stages of the UV-induced global shutdown; and a short mRNA transcript that acts as a regulatory lncRNA, suppressing the ASCC3 protein's function and enabling transcriptional recovery. The project will be focused on understanding how the ASCC3 lncRNA regulates RNAPII-mediated transcription and its recovery after DNA damage, using CRISPR/Cas9 technologies to generate and manipulate ASCC3 transcript variants, combined with state-of-the-art transcription profiling approaches such as TTchem-seq and RNA-seq. Information on the Department can be found at: https://icmm.ku.dk/english/ Our Center and Research CGEN is an interdisciplinary research center consisting of 6 research groups located in modern laboratories in the Mærsk Tower at the Panum Institute. Our mission is to use a cutting-edge ensemble of genetic, cell biological, biochemical, organismal, and modern ‘omic’-approaches to achieve a comprehensive understanding of the process of gene expression. CGEN performs ground-breaking research in a collaborative and ambitious environment, where young researchers are offered the best conditions to engage in bold and imaginative research. CGEN is also a center of learning, where PhDs and postdocs receive comprehensive insights in the cellular processes underlying gene expression, as well as a clear view of their medical importance and potential for a future research carreer. Information on the Svejstrup Group can be found at: https://icmm.ku.dk/english/research-groups/svejstrup-group/ Your job The role of the candidate will primarily be to perform experiments in the laboratory, analyse and interpret data, scientific publication, and undertake training, as well as attend scientific seminars. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and with access to state-of-the-art facilities for cell engineering, next-generation sequencing, flow cytometry, and mass spectrometry Scientific environment The Department of Cellular and Molecular Medicine (ICMM) offers an ambitious scientific environment, with many different nationalities represented. ICMM aims to produce research with high international impact focusing on the functional cell, its genetic components and molecular cellular mechanisms in a medical context. ICMM currently comprises five research programmes, three high profile Research Centers as well as a number of international research groups. The scientists at ICMM are involved in high quality research based undergraduate and graduate teaching programs at the University of Copenhagen. items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. The design and research community at Alan Alan’s Design & Research (D&R) community is the group of designers and researchers behind everything our members see and use. Our goal is simple: build the most member-centric health experience there is, with high standards of craft and a real understanding of the people we design for. We are growing fast, and AI is changing what is possible in the way we work. We are looking for someone who loves tooling, ops and AI to help us move faster without lowering the bar on quality. This is a builder role where design, operations and AI meet. You will scope where AI and automation can help us build faster, scale better and catch quality issues earlier, then turn the best ideas into tools the community actually uses. Along the way, you will help us improve our rituals and best practices, and share what we learn inside and outside Alan. You are not a designer or a researcher yourself: you are the enabler that allows the community to go faster and perform better as our member base grows. Your missions You will help D&R work smarter and keep quality high as we grow, in close collaboration with the community, its lead, and the engineering, Product Ops and platform teams we work with. You will help shape our community strategy on AI and tooling, then build and run what comes out of it. Explore: Test new AI tools and automations, find the ones that really save time or improve quality, and share the best with the community. Work wth our internal AI tooling teams to bring what’s cutting edge to design and research. Build : Create skills, agents and automated checks that make design and research work more efficient, reliable and of higher quality. Run the tooling : Maintain and upgrade the tools the community relies on, and be our point of contact with Alan’s platform and agentic teams. Improve how we work : Bring in better practices and rituals, push our existing rituals to the next level and help us show what we learn and achieve, inside and outside Alan. Own your roadmap : Identify opportunities, prioritize solutions, set clear goals, track adoption and quality, and adjust as you go. You are a good fit if... You are an ops-minded builder with around 4 years of experience in ops or enablement roles: design ops, tooling, automation, analytics, program management or something close. Design and research interests you, but what drives you is helping teams work better with tools, automation and better rituals. What you bring Hands-on experience automating work. You have replaced repetitive tasks with automations, internal tools or AI workflows (no-code, low-code or AI tools), at work or on your own projects, and you can tell us what you built and who used it. Familiarity with AI tools. You have built or tested skills, agents or automations, and you care that they are reliable, not just impressive in a demo. Comfort working with engineers. You can build things yourself, you know when to ask for production-grade work, and you speak their language. Experience supporting a team or community, for example through onboarding, rituals, events or internal communications. Strong English communication, to collaborate with our international team. French is a plus. Nice to have Experience in or alongside a design or research team. Familiarity with Figma and design systems. Qualities we look for Builder and strategic mindset: you make progress with incomplete information, choose the simplest approach that works, and ship. Rigour: you set a baseline and a target, and improve with each iteration. Systems thinking: you see how people, processes, tools and data fit together. Judgment: you frame ambiguous problems, prioritise, and know what to drop. Clear communication: you keep people updated and explain your choices. items.desc: Founding Engineer Role can be based remotely in the EEA or hybrid in our London or Munich offices. Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us. About Tarebase We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it. Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people. Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us. About you The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on. You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build. You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes. You use coding agents effectively, but stay close to the code. You know their limitations in a large codebase, review and challenge their work, and take testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation seriously. You can design useful tests and evaluations, manage complexity, and tell when something is genuinely ready to ship. You also enjoy digging into challenging problems. You keep up with what current models, agent harnesses and research make possible, and you can judge what actually works for a given use case. You know how to build agents and AI workflows into a product and use evaluations, validation and deterministic logic to make what they produce consistent and verifiable. You're comfortable extracting structure from messy documents and care a lot about data quality. You experiment, measure the results, question your assumptions, and keep going until you've found a solution that really holds up. You can turn that work into shipped software, taking a product idea or technical direction through design and implementation without waiting for someone to assign you a ticket. We work remotely, so clear communication and follow-through matter a lot to us. We value people who manage their own work, can be counted on, and raise important issues early. items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION Join us at our Dublin Technology Hub for an exclusive in-person event focused on cybersecurity in the age of AI. At JPMorganChase, we foster a culture of learning, inclusion and community for those seeking a rewarding career in Technology. As AI becomes more capable—and more embedded in how people and businesses operate—the most interesting security problems are no longer just about firewalls, endpoints, or phishing. They're about new questions such as: How do we authenticate an AI agent? What data should it be allowed to access? How do we prevent manipulation, misuse, or unintended actions at scale? On 4th November, we will host an in-person event at our Dublin office, where you'll engage with our technologists as they showcase the cutting-edge work that supports our business. You'll hear how teams are tackling emerging AI security challenges hands-on—ranging from enabling engineers to identify risks earlier in the development lifecycle (including work such as an AI Threat Modeling Co-Pilot) to designing safeguards as intelligent systems interact with sensitive data and critical financial services. Join us for valuable conversations, new connections, and a glimpse into exciting tech career opportunities at JPMorganChase - at the intersection of security engineering, AI, threat modeling, data, and human-centered design. Interested in joining us? Simply click apply, submit your CV, and our recruitment team will reach out to you directly. Date: Wednesday 4th November Time: TBC upon selection to attend Location: Dublin Technology Centre ABOUT US J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. items.desc: Who are we? At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people. We are seeking a highly skilled Data Product's Engineer in Cluj-Napoca, Romania , with deep expertise in Snowflake and strong hands-on experience with Matillion on AWS. The ideal candidate will design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that feed our Data Marketplace and enable the creation, publication, and consumption of certified Data Products across the enterprise. This role is central to our Data Marketplace strategy — ensuring data flows reliably from source systems through our silver, and gold layers, and is curated, governed, and made discoverable as reusable Data Products. The ideal candidate thrives in complex, enterprise-level environments, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and is passionate about delivering high-quality, governed, and AI-enabled data assets. Key Responsibilities Data Products Engineering & ETL Development Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Matillion on AWS to ingest, transform, and curate data across incoming (raw/staging), silver (cleansed & conformed), and gold (business-ready/aggregated) layers in Snowflake. Develop and publish certified Data Products — governed, documented, and reusable datasets made available through the Data Marketplace for self-service consumption by analysts, data scientists, and business users. Develop and optimize Snowflake objects including warehouses, schemas, tables, views, streams, tasks, and stored procedures to support Data Product pipelines. Optimize Snowflake performance through clustering, caching, micro-partitioning, and resource monitoring to ensure Data Products are delivered with reliability and speed. Data Marketplace & Data Governance Support the design and population of the Data Marketplace, ensuring Data Products are cataloged, discoverable, and compliant with enterprise data governance standards. Define and enforce data contracts, SLAs, and quality standards for each Data Product published to the Marketplace. Define and automate data validation, profiling, and quality checks embedded within ETL pipelines to guarantee Data Product integrity. Collaborate with data governance teams to implement naming standards, lineage tracking, metadata management, and access policies for Data Products. Ensure data lineage is traceable end-to-end from source systems through bronze/silver/gold layers to the final Data Product. Collaboration & Delivery Work closely with data analysts, data scientists, AI/ML teams, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into well-defined Data Products. Partner with the Data Marketplace product owner to define the Data Product lifecycle (creation, certification, publication, deprecation). Lead code reviews, provide mentorship, and support best practices across the engineering team. Contribute to architectural decisions and participate in strategic data roadmap planning. Automation & DevOps Build CI/CD pipelines for Matillion job deployments and Snowflake object management. Develop reusable ETL frameworks, templates, and patterns to accelerate the creation of new Data Products. Implement monitoring, alerting, and operational excellence practices for data pipelines and Data Product health. Automate Data Product certification workflows, including quality gates and approval processes. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar role. Strong expertise with Snowflake (SQL, performance tuning, data modeling, warehouse configuration, streams, tasks). Hands-on experience with Matillion on AWS (or comparable ETL/ELT tools such as Talend, Informatica, dbt, Azure Data Factory). Solid understanding of Data Product and Data Marketplace concepts (data contracts, data-as-a-product, self-service data consumption). Advanced SQL skills; ability to write complex queries and optimize them. Strong understanding of data modeling, dimensional models, star schemas, and data warehouse/data lake concepts (bronze/silver/gold architecture). Experience with cloud platforms, specifically AWS. Experience with Oracle Business Applications (ERP/EBS) as source systems is a plus. Proficiency in Python, Airflow, or other orchestration tools. Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and general DevOps practices. Knowledge of data governance principles, metadata management, and data cataloging tools. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or contributing to an enterprise Data Marketplace or Data Catalog. Familiarity with data mesh or data product …

items.desc: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. About the Role As an Associate in Strategic Finance, you'll focus on turning financial and commercial data into clear insight - enabling leadership to deeply understand our business and the drivers of performance. You’ll partner with Data Engineering, Finance and cross-functional stakeholders, and build analytical workflows to support fast and data-driven decision-making. What You’ll Be Doing Analyse commercial and business performance - evaluating the full P&L and measuring ROI in order to help the business assess where it is creating value. Translate ambiguous requests from leadership, Finance and cross-functional stakeholders into clear, decision-ready insights. Craft executive-style deliverables, which may include decks, models, written documents or AI-powered apps. Leverage AI tooling as a force multiplier to build and automate reusable analytical workflows that enable your stakeholders to quickly understand performance. Drive continuous reporting improvements, standardisation, and simplification whilst documenting definitions and limitations - leaving no room for approximation. Collaborate directly with Data Engineering and Data Science to support the development and enhancement of our core financial data models, and the context layer that enables AI agents to leverage that data. You will be empowered to work directly with Finance and Data partners to scope requirements and deliver initiatives end-to-end. What We Look For Essential Criteria You’ll have 3+ years of relevant experience in data-driven and analytical roles, and hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitative or business discipline. Strong analytical thinking: you’re comfortable working with numbers, identifying the underlying patterns and drawing sound conclusions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills: you have the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels. Commercial curiosity: you want to dive into the details to understand how merchant, product, and commercial dynamics affect financial performance. Confidence with data tools: You have strong spreadsheet skills and experience with BI tooling and data platforms, or demonstrate a clear aptitude and willingness to learn. Python and SQL experience is a plus. Exceptional attention to detail: you rigorously validate data, pressure-test assumptions, and transparently communicate analytical limitations. You’ve used AI hands-on in a business environment to create new tooling or workflows. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

items.desc: Are you ready to unlock your potential within a challenging, creative and fast paced work environment? Do you want to escape your current job role and work with people to build positive and productive lives, whatever their past? Now is the time to break into offender healthcare and develop your career. Oxleas NHS trust were awarded the South West prison contract in 2022 and currently have a portfolio of 19 prisons across the South of England. We are currently looking to expand our pool of bank workers by recruiting Pharmacy Technicians to work within the Prison service on a flexible basis. Our healthcare team have a real impact on promoting health and well-being to those in prison and we pride ourselves on using skills and strategies that instil hope for patients future resettlement back into the community. We directly deliver Mental Health, Physical Health, Pharmacy and Clinical Substance Misuse in an integrated healthcare delivery model to provide effective and responsive care to improve wellbeing and support better outcomes in the future. As a Pharmacy Technician, you will be providing a medicines management service to patients within the prison with the professional support of a prison service pharmacist. You will administer medicines to patients against a valid prescription, ensuring this is taken correctly, provide advice to patients about the appropriate use of medicines and promote healthy lifestyles to aid their rehabilitation. You will dispense prescriptions and stock items, whilst supervising assistants when in the dispensary. There will also be elements of stock control involved in your role, such as undertaking stock top-up services and reviewing expiry dates and storage facilities for all medicines, reporting any deficiencies to the prison service pharmacist. items.desc: sennder is redefining road logistics. As Europe’s leading digital freight forwarder, we are building a smarter, faster, and more sustainable future for freight, powered by a single, unified platform that already runs our entire business. We are moving from a decade of growth through acquisition to a company that is outcome-driven, outward-focused, and AI-native by design. Logistics is one of the best possible use cases for AI, and unlike most of our peers, we own the full loop: the platform, the operations, and the data connecting them. That closed feedback loop is a compounding advantage most competitors can’t replicate. This role exists to turn that advantage into sennder’s sharpest edge in margin, cost, and service, because AI will give us that edge if we lead, or become a risk if we lag. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will join our highly talented ML team. This is an applied machine learning role focused on highly innovative, research-oriented topics. You will work on a diverse portfolio of high-impact projects, ranging from optimizing our established Recommendation engine & Pricing engine to building greenfield solutions. This role can be based out of our Berlin, Barcelona or Amsterdam office. To succeed, this role demands a strong focus on deep Data Science and statistical exploration (roughly 70% of your scope), paired with the foundational Machine Learning Engineering skills (~30%) required to transition prototypes into production-ready models. You will not just be implementing technical specifications; you will sit directly with end-users, operators, and Product Managers to deeply understand their workflows, granting you real decision-making power over the product's direction. You are expected to have a holistic approach to project deployment, acting as an end-to-end ML Engineer and taking full ownership from "Light MVP" R&D to production deployment. What You Will Do… Pricing Engine Optimization: Develop and iterate on bid estimation algorithms and margin-optimization models to power our dynamic pricing engine, directly driving company profitability. Carrier Forecasting: Build robust predictive models to forecast carrier behavior and market capacity, enabling our operational teams to secure the right trucks at the right price before the market shifts. Recommender Systems: Maintain and improve our existing recommender systems to seamlessly support our operational teams' day-to-day efficiency. Industry Innovation & Applied ML: Explore and validate new areas where machine learning can solve fundamental logistics challenges (such as freight routing and network optimization), turning open-ended industry problems into scalable, data-driven solutions. Product Discovery & Ideation: Partner closely with Product Managers to drive continuous product discovery, translating ambiguous operational pain points into clear, outcome-driven ML hypotheses and rapid prototypes. AI & LLM Integration: Leverage foundational models and AI agents both as daily accelerators for your own engineering workflows and as core components to build new internal products. We expect you to pragmatically evaluate trade-offs and always choose the right solution for the right problem—whether that is an LLM, a traditional ML model, or a simple heuristic. Platform Collaboration: Partner with our Data & AI Platform (MLOps) team to utilize and deploy models via our internal ML infrastructure. You will act as a key customer of this platform, providing continuous feedback and contributions to shape our global engineering standards. End-to-End Execution: Adopt a holistic approach to project deployment, maintaining an end-to-end attitude that covers the entire lifecycle from initial R&D and prototyping all the way through to production release and monitoring. What We Are Looking For… Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Science or Machine Learning Engineering. Data Science Fundamentals: Strong foundation in statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and deep data exploration to validate assumptions and commercial viability before building complex models. You must possess a working knowledge of ML approaches to address basic regression and classification problems. ML Engineering: Experience deploying models to production environments, writing modular code, and understanding software engineering best practices. Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and Git. Experience working with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake), utilizing Jupyter Notebooks for data exploration, and building interactive data apps/dashboards (e.g., Streamlit, PowerBI) to visualize outcomes for stakeholders. AI Proficiency: A solid understanding of how to set up, evaluate, and leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and related AI tools in a production setting. Business Acumen: Ability to translate complex & multifaceted logistical problems into data-driven solutions, prioritizing 'Outcome over Output'. Collaboration: Strong communication …

items.desc: Why Qogita Wholesale is a $50 trillion market still working the way it did in 1950. 90% of transactions happen offline, over calls, catalogues and trade shows, and a product passes through four or five layers of distributors and wholesalers before it reaches a store, with every party deciding on a fraction of the picture. By the time it hits the shelf, it costs roughly 40% more than the maker charged. That inefficiency tax runs into the trillions, and everyone pays it every time they buy anything. Qogita is building the operating system that replaces that chain: a single order book connecting the global market, the rails to move goods across borders, and a self-learning system that does every job once, against real-time data about the whole market. That puts data science at the core of the product. Forecasting reads what is actually selling in every market as it sells, a buyer's basket is assembled from every available seller and split across the optimal combination, and every trade writes a record that sharpens the next price, allocation and route. It is a hard problem, spanning physical goods, thirty national regimes in Europe alone and buyers who are increasingly agents, and it is already working: 95% of transactions involve no human touch, and the business is doubling every year. The role You're a data scientist with strong quantitative and ML chops who can move between classical modelling, experimentation, and modern applied ML (including LLMs where they're the right tool). You'll own end-to-end data science work across Qogita's wholesale marketplace: framing ambiguous commercial problems, building models that ship, and keeping them healthy in production. The Data Science team partners with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Commercial to build the intelligence layer behind pricing, matching, demand, and product discovery. What You'll Do Build and deliver data science solutions across the stack: predictive models, ranking, demand forecasting, segmentation, pricing, experimentation, and LLM-powered features, depending on where the business need is greatest Take ownership of business-critical ML systems end-to-end: problem framing, model design, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance in production Translate ambiguous business problems into tractable ML or statistical problems with clear success criteria, working closely with Product and Commercial Apply quantitative methods (regression, causal inference, classical ML, and deep learning where useful) to pricing, demand, liquidity, supplier matching, catalogue enrichment, and related marketplace problems Design and analyse experiments and A/B tests, owning statistical validity and turning results into recommendations teams can act on Collaborate with Engineers to ship models via reproducible MLOps workflows: experiment tracking, model serving, alerting, and production monitoring Communicate model choices, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders What You'll Bring 3+ years as a data scientist, applied ML engineer, or quantitative analyst, with meaningful exposure across ML methods and statistical modelling A track record of owning models in production, not just building them: maintaining, monitoring, and iterating as live infrastructure Solid grounding in ML and stats fundamentals: probability, supervised and unsupervised learning, and measurement/validation discipline Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with large transactional datasets and common DS/ML libraries (e.g. pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch or similar) Experience collaborating on MLOps-style workflows (experiment tracking, serving, monitoring) and shipping with engineers Able to communicate uncertainty and model limitations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences Bachelor's or Master's in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Mathematics, CS, or related), or equivalent experience Nice to have (depth in one or more) Pricing and market economics: price theory, buyer behaviour, demand estimation, causal inference, experimentation with real commercial stakes Production LLM systems: RAG, evaluation frameworks, prompt/fine-tuning trade-offs, transformers and major model families, LangChain or similar Marketplace or B2B dynamics; AWS/GCP/Azure ML infra; Airflow, Docker, dbt, Snowflake, Lightdash or similar Perks & Benefits Base salary: €60,000 to €90,000 (Amsterdam) / £60,000 to £90,000 (London) depending on experience 26 days of annual leave, plus 4 additional personal days Company performance-based bonus Attractive equity package Pension contributions Annual learning & development budget Office-led culture with hybrid flexibility Dog-friendly offices Home-office setup package Office socials and annual company-wide offsite Who we are Qogita [ Ko-gi-ta ] is a fast-growing European startup building the operating system for modern wholesale. Founded in early 2021, we now operate globally. Offices in …

items.desc: YOUR MISSION AT VOI As an AI Engineer at Voi, you will build and own the AI platform that our business depends on. Close to 400 colleagues use Voi’s AI platform every day, and teams across the company have already built over 300 apps on our in-house app-building platform. This is a hands-on builder role in a small, senior team where your work will have company-wide impact. You will keep our existing AI platform fast, secure, and reliable, while building the next generation of capabilities that help Voi move faster, work smarter, and continue leading in applied AI. You Will Own and improve Voi’s AI platform, including our in-house app-building platform, Claude stack and future AI capabilities. Build robust backend services and full-stack, user-facing features that make the platform reliable, scalable, and easy to use. Develop the next layer of AI infrastructure, such as agentic platforms, enterprise search, knowledge bases, knowledge graphs and open-weight model access. Strengthen security, identity and access control across the platform, including permissions, security reviews, audits and integrations with company systems. Work closely with the AI team, platform team and colleagues across Voi to understand needs, test ideas and ship useful tools quickly. Help decide what we build, buy or integrate, with a focus on control, long-term value and avoiding vendor lock-in. A solid backend engineering background, with experience building applications and services at scale. Hands-on experience with LLMs in production, such as agents, tool use, MCP, RAG, search or evaluation. Full-stack ability and a good sense of UX, especially when building tools for non-engineers. Good understanding of identity, authentication and access control, or a strong interest in going deeper in this area. A practical builder mindset, with the ability to turn ideas into working software and iterate quickly. Autonomy, ownership and good judgement in open-ended technical areas. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to different audiences. Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box. WHY VOI? Working At Voi Is More Than Just a Job; Our People Promise Includes a Personal Voyage Where You Will Grow As a Professional And Be a Part Of a Team And Culture That Builds Something Meaningful For Society. In Addition To This, You’ll Have The Opportunity To Own a platform that is already critical to how Voi works and shape what comes next. Work in a small, senior team with high trust, fast decisions and a clear mandate. Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme. Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog-friendly office. Work together with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal. Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution. Since 2018, Voi has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 200,000+ vehicles in 130+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8+ million riders with over 500+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way - through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain. items.desc: The Role: We are looking for a Software Development AI Technical Expert to serve as the department’s designated AI specialist and lead the responsible evaluation, adoption and practical application of AI across Software Development and Software Quality Assurance. The role will research emerging AI technologies, support experimentation and pilot projects, and translate successful solutions into practical tools, standards and development practices. You will provide technical guidance on AI-enabled development, code quality, security, AI advocacy, capability building and impact measurement. You will work closely with Software Development and Software Quality Assurance teams to develop practical, responsible and measurable AI-native ways of working that improve productivity, quality, security and innovation. The key responsibilities of the position include: Act as the subject-matter specialist for AI-enabled Software Development and Software Quality Assurance, maintaining current knowledge of large language models, AI development tools, AI agents and emerging technologies. Research and benchmark AI applications, tools, vendors and industry practices, assessing their relevance, maturity, limitations, security and potential value to the organisation. Provide expert advice on the practical and technical application of AI across the Software Development Lifecycle, from requirements and design through coding, testing, deployment and monitoring. Explore, prototype and evaluate AI capabilities and use cases, defining clear objectives, success criteria, evaluation methods and recommendations. Contribute to AI pilots from concept through implementation and evaluation, identifying lessons learned, adoption requirements and opportunities for scaling successful solutions. Support the transition of approved AI tools and practices into Software Development and Software Quality Assurance, including AI code assistants, automated code review, AI-supported testing and intelligent CI/CD practices. Develop guidance, standards and best practices for the responsible use of AI and AI-generated code, covering quality assurance, security, data protection, intellectual property, maintainability and human oversight. Establish and monitor measures of AI effectiveness and impact, including output quality, reliability, usability, developer experience, cycle time, defect rates, deployment frequency, test coverage and rework. Assess the AI maturity of Software Development and Software Quality Assurance teams and recommend practical actions to improve organisational capability. Support cultural change, knowledge-sharing and upskilling through playbooks, prompt libraries, FAQs, onboarding materials, reusable templates, case studies and communities of practice. Collaborate with stakeholders across IT, the Group and other departments to identify and assess AI opportunities aligned with business priorities, roadmaps and projects. Collaborate with AI representatives across the Group to share knowledge and support a coordinated approach to AI adoption. Maintain relationships with vendors, research communities and industry peers, bringing relevant developments and insights back to the organisation. Represent the Group, when requested, at conferences, external events and industry forums, contributing to presentations, demonstrations, articles and other technology-related activities. Main requirements: BSc/MSc in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. At least 7 years of experience in IT engineering roles, including experience in a managerial or leadership role within a Software Development team. Solid working knowledge of the modern AI landscape, including Large Language Models, AI agents, automation platforms, prompt engineering techniques and practical business applications. Demonstrated experience modernising or transforming software development lifecycles through AI tooling and automation. Deep understanding of modern SDLC practices, including CI/CD, DevOps and platform engineering, combined with hands-on experience with AI-powered development tools. Strong Machine Learning and AI background, with hands-on experience building, prototyping or deploying AI solutions. Experience contributing to governance frameworks covering quality assurance, security review or intellectual property considerations for AI-generated outputs. Solid understanding of IT engineering metrics and data-driven measurement of development performance. Exposure to AI or IT engineering maturity models and experience assessing team capabilities against defined frameworks. Experience evaluating technology vendors and AI tooling through trials, benchmarking and recommendations. Experience presenting to and working directly with senior or C-level stakeholders. Public speaking or conference presentation experience in AI or technology, with the ability to inspire technical and non-technical audiences. Innovative and curious …

Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée Un package de rémunération attractif Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu Votre quotidien En nous rejoignant à Meudon, vous rejoignez le siège social du Groupe Thales situé en bord de Seine et organisé en un véritable campus, regroupant notamment nos activités d’identité et de sécurité numériques. Mission Au sein de l'équipe IT Data & AI de CDI, vous contribuez au développement et à l'industrialisation de solutions basées sur l'IA générative et les technologies AI Agentic afin d'accélérer la transformation digitale des métiers. Vous travaillez au carrefour des enjeux technologiques et métier pour transformer des idées et cas d'usage en solutions concrètes, robustes et déployées à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Dans Ce Cadre, Vous Concevez et développez des solutions d'IA générative et agentique répondant à des besoins métiers à forte valeur ajoutée; Réalisez des prototypes ou MVP et accompagnez leur passage vers des solutions industrielles exploitables en production; Intégrez les solutions d'IA avec les applications, données et systèmes d'information existants à travers APIs, connecteurs et services cloud; Contribuez à la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques de développement (DevOps/CI/CD), de qualité logicielle, de sécurité et d'exploitation; Accompagnez les utilisateurs dans l'identification et la formalisation de cas d’usage et les former aux outils quand nécessaire.; Assurez une veille active sur les technologies IA et contribuez à l'amélioration continue des solutions déployées. Profil Titulaire d’une formation supérieure en ingénierie informatique ou équivalent, vous justifiez d’une expérience significative dans les systèmes d’information, la transformation digitale ou les technologies d’intelligence artificielle. Le profil recherché combine expertise technique, compréhension des enjeux business et forte appétence pour l'innovation. Bonne connaissance et expérience avec les outils d’IA Generative et agentic (Copilot, cowork, code assist, plateforme agentique etc); Maîtrisez les principes clés des architectures d’IA générative et agentique : RAG, MCP, orchestration d’agents, mémoire, points de contrôle humain; Pratique d’un outil d’orchestration tel que n8n, Mindflow, LangSmith ou équivalent, et capacité à choisir entre low-code, configuration et développement spécifique selon le besoin; Connaissance d’un langage de programmation; Familiarité avec les environnements Cloud (Azure souhaite), les méthodes Agile et les pratiques DevOps / CI-CD; Capacité à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés, à vulgariser des sujets techniques et à accompagner le changement auprès des utilisateurs; Curiosité, esprit d'initiative, sens du service et forte appétence pour les nouvelles technologies et l'innovation; Bon niveau d'anglais permettant d'évoluer dans un environnement international. Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc: Your role at Dynatrace Dynatrace Documentation is a critical asset in driving user adoption of our unified observability, security, and AI platform. It guides users through Dynatrace's multi-faceted functionality and helps them extract real value from the platform. At Dynatrace, writers architect knowledge, curate output, and serve as the final accuracy and experience quality gate. They build AI-first documentation: structured, governed information architecture managed by domain and content experts, explicitly optimized for both human readers and AI consumers. In This Role, You Will Architect knowledge across complex, cross-domain product areas by defining content models, taxonomy, and lifecycle so the same source can serve human readers and AI consumers (copilots, search, support agents, LLMs). Curate AI-generated content and review work from other Information Developers for nuance, structural integrity, and accuracy — the things only human judgment can reliably catch — before content is trusted and served. Design prompts, build reusable templates and skills, and instruct agents that draft, validate, and surface gaps in the knowledge base. Apply Dynatrace's structured content principles, metadata schema, and chunking strategy so every content unit is modular, independently addressable, composable, and machine-readable. Retrievability is a first-class requirement. Partner directly with subject-matter experts, Development, Product Management, and AI teams to scope knowledge work, define what users need to know, and design the content and structure. Identify improvements to content models, taxonomy, and AI-pipeline quality, and contribute to evolving authoring standards across the team. Use your technical depth and writing craft to navigate complex use cases and produce concise, clear, accurate copy that non-technical users — and AI consumers — can grasp. Mentor less-experienced writers and Information Developers, and shape team-wide standards and authoring practices. Work in a docs-as-code process using a Markdown-based static site, VSCode, Git, and an evolving stack of agentic tooling (Claude plugins, docs MCP, AI content validators). Collaborate within a truly global R&D team with a presence across multiple continents. What Will Help You Succeed 5+ years of experience in technical writing, information development, or a closely related content-engineering discipline, with a track record of documenting B2B software products. Hands-on experience operating an AI-first authoring workflow: designing prompts, building reusable templates and skills, instructing agents, and curating AI-generated drafts for accuracy and consistency. Comfort being an architect, quality gate, and final approver rather than the sole author of every piece of content. Experience treating documentation as structured data: modular, semantically structured units optimized for both human readability and AI retrievability. Familiarity with frontmatter, metadata, chunking, and retrieval signals. Experience contributing to information architecture within a product domain: content models, taxonomy, and lifecycle considerations. Demonstrated ability to independently scope a knowledge project across complex, cross-domain product areas: interviewing SMEs, defining the content's scope, and designing its structure without being handed a brief. Strong editorial judgment when reviewing AI-generated drafts and peer work — catching nuance, structural integrity, and accuracy before content is served. Excellent written English, with the ability to produce clear, precise, and conversational writing that works for both human readers and AI consumption. Genuine curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning, especially as AI-first authoring evolves in real time. The ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders across an organization — from engineers to executives — including Development, Product Management, and AI teams. Experience working in an Agile software development environment. Proficiency with Markdown, Git, Jira, and the command line. Why you will love being a Dynatracer Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security. We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance. Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances. Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace. Compensation And Rewards We offer attractive compensation packages and stock purchase options with numerous benefits and advantages. Due to legal reasons, we are obliged to list a salary range for this position, which is € 61,000 up to € 76,000 gross per year based on full-time employment (38.5 h/week). Own the full system lifecycle: design, build, deploy, operate, and continuously improve production systems. You move quickly from idea to working system without needing heavy direction. You are able to balance speed, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. You enjoy mentoring juniors and helping to grow their systems design & infrastructure knowledge and take them along in your decisions and trade-offs. You can clearly communicate technical decisions to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. You are interested in GenAI and know how it fits into real production systems. items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Evaluation Engineer based in Belgium. As a founding AI Evaluation Engineer, you will design and build the evaluation, testing, and observability infrastructure that ensures production-grade AI agents perform reliably, safely, and efficiently. You will develop automated testing systems for complex reasoning, multi-turn conversations, and agent interactions involving APIs, databases, and code execution. Working across AI engineering, software testing, and infrastructure, you will create scalable evaluation pipelines that go beyond traditional QA and manual prompt testing. You will establish robust regression testing, statistical evaluation methods, and adversarial scenarios to identify weaknesses before deployment. This is an opportunity to take ownership of an evaluation architecture from the ground up while working with modern AI technologies in a fully remote, globally distributed environment. Your work will directly contribute to the reliability, security, and continuous improvement of advanced AI systems. Accountabilities Design, build, and maintain automated CI/CD testing pipelines to validate AI agent behavior before deployment and throughout the development lifecycle. Develop and maintain golden datasets containing regression prompts, edge cases, and synthetic scenarios to measure agent accuracy, safety, performance, and latency. Implement fast, cost-effective, deterministic evaluation checks before introducing LLM-as-a-judge approaches, including JSON schema validation, regular expressions, API status checks, and embedding similarity. Create comprehensive test suites for multi-turn agent conversations, evaluating context retention, state consistency, reasoning behavior, and safeguards against infinite tool-calling loops. Design and implement adversarial testing scenarios to assess resilience against prompt injection, malformed inputs, unexpected tool responses, and other potential security vulnerabilities. Build statistical evaluation frameworks to measure non-deterministic AI behavior using pass rates across multiple runs, confidence intervals, and other quantitative reliability metrics. Integrate evaluation workflows into GitHub Actions or comparable CI systems using SDK-level execution and automated testing practices. Implement observability and tracing solutions using tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or equivalent platforms to monitor agent execution and diagnose failures. Optimize evaluation efficiency and cost through caching, mocking, and other techniques that reduce unnecessary LLM API calls. Validate structured outputs, including JSON schemas, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads, to ensure agents interact reliably with external systems. Evaluate and improve agent performance under load, accounting for variable response times and non-deterministic endpoint behavior. Independently design and own the evaluation architecture, establishing best practices, testing standards, and scalable processes for ongoing quality assurance. Requirements Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript, particularly for API testing, headless execution, asynchronous programming, and automated testing systems. Hands-on experience building LLM evaluation pipelines, AI testing frameworks, or statistical testing systems capable of measuring performance across repeated runs. Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD environments, particularly GitHub Actions or similar platforms, with SDK-level execution. Strong expertise in validating structured data and outputs, including JSON schema, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads. Familiarity with observability and tracing tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or custom logging solutions. Ability to independently design, implement, and maintain an evaluation architecture from scratch, with a strong sense of ownership and technical judgment. Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate technical findings clearly in a distributed team. Availability to overlap with US Central Time business hours for at least three hours each day. Experience with code execution sandboxes or AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI. Strong understanding of embedding models, vector databases, and their applications in AI evaluation and similarity-based testing. Experience with load testing non-deterministic endpoints and assessing system behavior under varying workloads.
