items.desc: Why Keyrus, Why Now! Keyrus is an international group of 3000 experts across 30 countries , built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work - designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence. Intelligent systems are only as dependable as the data beneath them. Reliable pipelines, trusted data products, governed access, and meaningful enterprise context allow analytics, applications, models, and agents to operate consistently in production. Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates . Industrial discipline connects the two. What You'll Architect As a Data Engineer - AI & Data Platforms, you will design, build, and operate reliable data products and pipelines that support analytics, applications, and intelligent systems. This is fundamentally a Data Engineering role, with an additional focus on preparing enterprise data for modern AI use cases. You will work across structured and unstructured information, transforming source data into trusted, reusable data products that can support analytics and operational applications as well as RAG, retrieval, evaluation, and agent-enabled systems. Your Responsibilities Design, build, test, and operate production data pipelines and data products, moving data reliably from enterprise source systems into reusable consumption layers. Develop and maintain data models and transformation logic that preserve clear definitions, business context, and reliable use across analytical, operational, and AI workloads. Implement data quality, lineage, metadata, and observability controls, ensuring critical data is trustworthy, understandable, and monitored in production. Prepare structured and unstructured enterprise data for intelligent systems, including retrieval, grounding, RAG, semantic context, and evaluation datasets where required. Engineer reliable ingestion and processing patterns across APIs, databases, files, documents, events, and other relevant enterprise sources. Operate and improve data workloads in a major cloud/data ecosystem, balancing reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost. Collaborate with AI Engineers and Software Engineers on stable data interfaces, without taking ownership of model behavior, agents, or the surrounding application. Document and reuse data-engineering patterns, including data contracts, transformations, controls, dependencies, and operational knowledge that can strengthen future Keyrus engagements. Who You Are You are a hands-on Data Engineer who understands that moving data is not enough. Data must remain trusted, understandable, available, and usable once a system is operating in production. You think from source to consumption and can determine what is required to turn fragmented enterprise data into reliable data products. You combine strong engineering fundamentals with practical judgment. You understand that analytics, applications, RAG systems, evaluations, and agents may consume data differently, and you design the foundation accordingly without trying to own the intelligence or application layers yourself. What You Bring Must Have Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and data products. Strong SQL and data-modeling fundamentals, with the ability to design clear, maintainable transformation and consumption layers. Practical engineering capability in Python or another language commonly used for production data engineering. Deep practical expertise in at least one major cloud data ecosystem, with the ability to apply the same engineering principles across comparable technologies. Experience implementing data quality, testing, monitoring, lineage, or observability within production data workflows. Understanding of production engineering concerns including reliability, scalability, security, access, maintainability, and performance. Should Have Experience preparing structured and unstructured data for AI or GenAI use cases. Practical understanding of how RAG, retrieval, embeddings, semantic context, and evaluation datasets depend on enterprise data. Experience working with distributed processing, orchestration, and modern data-transformation approaches. Experience with batch ingestion and one or more additional patterns such as APIs, change data capture, event-driven processing, or streaming. Working knowledge of CI/CD, automated testing, version control, and repeatable deployment practices for data solutions. Experience with vector or hybrid search infrastructure used for retrieval-based AI systems/ Feeding and maintaining RAG indexes Rapid prototyping, from mockup to working proof of concept in days (Streamlit) Experience collaborating with AI, software, analytics, architecture, or …

items.desc: 🤖 Who we are We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone. We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise . We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖. We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe. 🚀 Why we need you Mo’s scope is expanding fast: inside Alan (a new Clinic, new capabilities), across the countries we operate in, and at the interfaces with many other Alan experiences. To get this expansion right, and to keep ownership distributed within the team, we’re looking for a Product Builder to take on a real share of that complexity and ambiguity. You’ll own end-to-end one slice of Mo’s product scope. Depending on your profile, it could be: 🩺 Mo for reactive care. Build all the integrations between Mo, our Clinic and the healthcare system, and shape how our medical team interacts with members in and through Mo. 🛡️ Mo for insurance. Make Mo the main interface between members and Alan, building on our Support AI agents, across channels and countries. 🌍 Mo global. Adapt Mo to new countries and find the right operating model for each (medical reviews, safety, local features). ➕ Mo as a platform. Make Mo the companion other teams build upon, so our domain experts can ship their own experiences through it. 🎯 Is it you we’re looking for? We’re looking for Product Builders with around 5+ years of experience who want to build state-of-the-art AI products and apply them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare. You’ll own a product area end-to-end: problem framing, vision, prioritisation, shipping, and measuring whether we actually help members get and stay better. You’ll work daily with engineers, ML engineers, data, and doctors, at the frontier of LLMs and agentic systems, and see your work in production with real people. You’ll navigate ambiguity and many stakeholders across Alan, and turn it into clear decisions and a focused roadmap. You’ll be hands-on: prototyping, digging into data, reading conversations and evals, getting into the technical details with the team. You’ll contribute to our product culture and help build the team (hiring, interview loops, etc.). You would be a good fit in Mo if most of this sounds like you: Experience building and shipping a live AI/LLM product Very hands-on, comfortable with technical and data topics (SQL, prototyping, understanding how an LLM system behaves and fails) Interest or experience in one or several medical or prevention themes Product-minded and outcome-driven: you care about impact, not output Self-directed, pragmatic, driven, hard working Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!) Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching Fluent in English Ex-engineers and ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus 🤘 How we do it ? We benefit from Alan’s platform , infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise — but operate with the speed and focus of a startup. If you’re curious about Alan’s broader vision, our Shareholder Letters are worth a read. About People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as: How we work: our Leadership Principles Mission is the Boss — We think long-term and are methodical optimists who take risks, seeking our mission's success above all else. Distributed Ownership — Accountable enlightened despots: everyone owns their decisions and results. Radical Transparency — All information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously. Always Growing — Direct, positive, and caring feedback, combined with self-growth ownership. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary. Flexible Office . Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest. All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible …

We look for those who see technology not just as tools or platforms, but as the invisible infrastructure behind strategy, performance, and growth. We transform bold ideas into scalable, secure, and human-centered solutions. Our AI Strategy practice is PwC Greece’s dedicated centre of excellence for AI advisory, with a dual mandate: serving as the cross-functional AI hub that helps every PwC department deliver AI-powered solutions to clients, and operating as an independent service line providing end-to-end AI strategy, governance, and compliance services. SHAPING TOMORROW Make a real impact, today, and tomorrow, through work that matters. Here, you will tackle today’s toughest challenges with a future-focused mindset; so our clients turn to us first when it matters most. Make a real impact In this dynamic environment, we are looking for a Senior Associate to join our AI Strategy practice as an AI Strategy Analyst. This is a high-exposure role for a driven professional who wants to be at the centre of AI advisory- contributing to everything from cross-functional propositions to end-to-end strategy engagements. You will be a core member of the practice’s execution engine, producing high-quality deliverables, conducting research and analysis, and supporting managers and senior leaders across all service lines. This role offers unusual breadth: in any given week you might be researching AI applications for shipping, building a proposal deck for a banking client, or supporting a governance framework for an energy company. Produce high-quality client deliverables- presentations, reports, frameworks, and strategic analyses that meet PwC’s quality standards. Support cross-functional AI proposals: research solutions, prepare decks, build one-pagers, and compile supporting materials under the direction of the AI Solution Architect. Conduct AI-related research and analysis: market trends, vendor comparisons, technology benchmarks, industry best practices, and competitive landscapes. Execute AI maturity assessments: design questionnaires, conduct stakeholder interviews, analyze results, and produce scoring reports. Support gap analyses and AI roadmap development: data collection, current-state mapping, gap identification, recommendation development, timeline creation, and dependency mapping. Prepare AI governance documentation drafts under manager guidance: policy templates, process descriptions, and compliance checklists. Build and maintain knowledge assets- AI use case databases, vendor evaluation matrices, assessment templates, and reusable frameworks. Support business development through prospect research and meeting preparation, contribute to thought leadership, and help develop Associates on deliverable quality and research methodology. What You Bring Matters Master’s degree in Business, Data Science, Digital Innovation, AI, or a related field. 2–4 years of professional experience in consulting (Big 4 or boutique), technology advisory, analytics, or a relevant corporate role. Excellent structured thinking — able to organize complex, ambiguous information into clear, logical narratives. Outstanding deliverable craft (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) with strong attention to detail. Strong research capability — synthesizing information from multiple sources into actionable insight. AI literacy: solid grasp of AI/ML concepts (you can explain what an LLM does, how a recommendation engine works, what MLOps means — without needing to build one). items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. 
 Neuroscience & Rare Diseases (NRD), we are committed to realizing the vision of the Roche One Pharma Strategy in Neurology to preserve and restore what makes people who they are. Our research and early development activities center around large and rare indications within four major therapeutic network areas: Dementias, Multiple Sclerosis, Movement Disorders, and Neuromuscular & Neurodevelopmental Disorders. With strengths across diverse disciplines, Roche is uniquely positioned to lead in transforming science to medicines for patients with disorders of the nervous system. 
 We are looking for an experienced and passionate clinical scientist to join our team. You will bring 8+ years of experience in drug development and 5+ years the clinical scientist role in different neurological indications, including Alzheimer’s disease, neurodevelopmental disorders and multiple sclerosis. MD degree and medical monitoring experience in phase 1-2 clinical trials will be considered a major plus. 
 The Opportunity 
 Shape the future of global Phase 0–2 studies in Neuroscience and Rare Diseases, making a direct impact on patient care and innovative scientific research. 
 Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations and Medical Directors to plan, execute, and oversee clinical studies in a supportive, high-performance team environment. 
 Develop and write critical study documentation, including protocols and study reports, while guiding operational and regulatory strategies. 
 Drive clinical data review plans and oversee study conduct, ensuring data quality from collection through to analysis, interpretation, and decision-making. 
 Perform medical and safety data review in clinical studies and interact with study sites 
 Represent clinical science in study management, fostering a culture of excellence by training and supporting operations teams and study sites. 
 Partner with Data Management to design clinical forms and instructions, while continuously reviewing clinical and safety data to ensure patient wellbeing. 
 Advance scientific knowledge by collaborating with leading academics, contributing to publications, and representing our innovative research at global conferences. 
 Who You Are 
 You hold a PhD in Neuroscience and bring over 8 years of experience in drug development and 5 years of experience in supporting early clinical programs in neuroscience spanning across different indications 
 You hold an MD degree and have experience as medical monitor in phase 1-2 clinical trials 
 You possess strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a proven track record in clinical data review, analysis, and reporting data. 
 You have a solid understanding of clinical development processes, study design principles, and international clinical research and safety guidelines. 
 You are a collaborative, solution-oriented scientist who communicates effectively across teams, values diverse perspectives, and makes sound, independent decisions. 
 You have excellent written, oral communication, and presentation skills. 
 You are adaptable, able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment, and willing to travel occasionally to support study needs. 
 At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you. 
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

items.desc:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance 
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.
 Innovate with Tether 
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.
 Why Join Us? 
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future? 
 About the job 
 We are looking for Developer Productivity Engineer to help QVAC application teams develop, review, test, and deliver reliable software with less friction. Your focus will be our desktop and mobile applications and their shared runtime, AI harness, and skills packages. You will build and maintain developer tools, integrate AI agents into engineering workflows, and improve code quality and delivery automation. 
 This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape the tooling roadmap. You will work with engineers to identify useful improvements and own them from implementation through adoption and ongoing support. Success means shorter feedback loops, dependable automation, and tools that developers trust and use. 
 Responsibilities 
 Evaluate, integrate, and maintain developer tools and AI agents, including the repository guidance and integrations they need to work effectively. 
 Build and operate agents in CI and scheduled workflows that investigate failures, propose fixes, and give engineers evidence they can act on. 
 Improve automated pull request reviews, evaluating finding accuracy and reducing noise for reviewers. 
 Develop code quality scripts and checks for complexity, function and file size, dependency cycles, and performance regressions. Work with package owners on practical thresholds and targeted refactoring. 
 Improve development environments, testing, and build and release workflows so engineers and agents can verify changes reliably. 
 Prioritize improvements with engineering teams, support adoption through documentation and onboarding, and measure effectiveness, reliability, and operating costs. 
 Example projects include agents that investigate CI failures, diagnose compatibility and performance regressions, and flag changes that affect package interfaces or architecture. You will choose and refine these workflows with the engineers who use them. 
 Experience building and maintaining developer tools or engineering automation used by others, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js skills. 
 Hands-on experience using and integrating AI coding tools or agents, with sound judgment about their limitations, output validation, and human review. 
 Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and systematic debugging of build, test, or integration failures. 
 A strong approach to code quality: maintainable code, useful automated checks, and refactoring that preserves behavior. 
 Ability to work independently, collaborate with engineers, and communicate clearly in English within a remote, globally distributed team. 
 Important information for candidates

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
 Job Description 
 Menedżerka/Menedżer ds. strategii AI 
Miejsce pracy: Bank BPH, Gdańsk/Warszawa 
 Forma zatrudnienia: umowa o pracę 
 Wymiar czasu pracy: pełny etat 
 W Banku BPH rozpoczynamy program rozwoju i wdrażania rozwiązań opartych na sztucznej inteligencji (AI). Naszym celem jest wykorzystanie nowoczesnych technologii do zwiększania efektywności operacyjnej, automatyzacji procesów oraz tworzenia nowych możliwości wspierających realizację celów biznesowych banku.
 Poszukujemy osoby, która odegra kluczową rolę w budowaniu kompetencji AI w organizacji – od współtworzenia strategii i architektury rozwiązań, przez organizację bezpiecznego środowiska eksperymentowania, aż po wdrażanie rozwiązań przynoszących mierzalne korzyści biznesowe.
 Stanowisko łączy kompetencje architekta rozwiązań AI oraz koordynatora inicjatyw realizowanych we współpracy z jednostkami biznesowymi, IT, funkcjami kontrolnymi i strukturami korporacyjnymi.
 Osoba zatrudniona na tym stanowisku będzie raportować bezpośrednio do Dyrektora IT i będzie miała realny wpływ na kształtowanie sposobu wykorzystania AI w banku.
 Kogo szukamy? 
 Szukamy osoby, która nie tylko zna technologie AI, ale przede wszystkim potrafi wykorzystać je do rozwiązywania rzeczywistych problemów biznesowych.
Rozumiejącej, że skuteczne wdrożenie AI wymaga połączenia technologii, bezpieczeństwa, zgodności regulacyjnej i współpracy z biznesem.
 Twój zakres odpowiedzialności 
 Strategia i rozwój AI 
 Udział w opracowaniu i realizacji strategii AI banku, we współpracy z partnerami doradczymi, biznesem i IT.
 Przekładanie strategii AI na konkretne inicjatywy, rozwiązania technologiczne i plan wdrożeń.
 Identyfikowanie możliwości wykorzystania AI do automatyzacji i optymalizacji procesów bankowych.
 Monitorowanie rozwoju technologii AI oraz rekomendowanie rozwiązań odpowiadających potrzebom banku.
 Architektura i technologia 
 Projektowanie i rozwijanie architektury rozwiązań AI
 Koordynowanie budowy i rozwoju wewnętrznej platformy AI Sandbox, umożliwiającej bezpieczne eksperymentowanie z modelami językowymi.
 Ocena, dobór i integracja modeli LLM oraz narzędzi do budowy chatbotów, asystentów AI, rozwiązań RAG i automatyzacji procesów.
 Projektowanie integracji AI z istniejącymi systemami i źródłami danych banku.
 Ocena wydajności, bezpieczeństwa, skalowalności i kosztów proponowanych rozwiązań.
 Współpraca z biznesem i realizacja inicjatyw 
 Wspieranie jednostek biznesowych w identyfikowaniu i definiowaniu zastosowań AI.
 Ocena wykonalności technicznej, potencjalnej wartości oraz ryzyk inicjatyw AI.
 Koordynowanie realizacji Proof of Concept (PoC), pilotaży i wdrożeń produkcyjnych.
 Współpraca z właścicielami biznesowymi przy definiowaniu kryteriów sukcesu i mierzeniu efektów wdrożeń.
 Budowanie standardów i dobrych praktyk umożliwiających efektywne wykorzystanie AI przez pracowników banku.
 Bezpieczeństwo, governance i zgodność regulacyjna 
 Współpraca z Compliance, Risk, IT Security i DPO przy tworzeniu oraz wdrażaniu zasad AI Governance.
 Zapewnianie uwzględnienia wymagań AI Act, DORA, RODO, regulacji bankowych i polityk wewnętrznych w projektowanych rozwiązaniach.
 Wspieranie klasyfikacji ryzyka zastosowań AI oraz definiowania wymagań bezpieczeństwa i kontroli.
 Udział w opracowaniu standardów dotyczących zarządzania modelami AI, ich testowania, monitorowania i cyklu życia.
 Wspieranie bezpiecznego przechodzenia od eksperymentów i PoC do rozwiązań produkcyjnych.
 Współpraca z korporacją i partnerami technologicznymi 
 Współpraca z korporacyjnymi zespołami odpowiedzialnymi za AI, architekturę i bezpieczeństwo.
 Identyfikowanie możliwości wykorzystania dostępnych w korporacji platform, modeli, narzędzi, kompetencji i dobrych praktyk.
 Ocena możliwości zastosowania rozwiązań korporacyjnych w banku, z uwzględnieniem lokalnych wymagań regulacyjnych.
 Współpraca z dostawcami technologii i partnerami zewnętrznymi.
 Nasze oczekiwania 
 Doświadczenie i kompetencje 
 Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w IT, w tym praktyczne doświadczenie w projektowaniu lub wdrażaniu rozwiązań AI, ML lub Generative AI.
 Bardzo dobra znajomość architektury rozwiązań opartych na LLM, w tym RAG, embeddings, vector databases, AI agents oraz integracji API.
 Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi i platform AI
 Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i wdrażaniu rozwiązań w środowiskach on-premise, kontenerowych lub hybrydowych.
 Znajomość zagadnień bezpieczeństwa danych, kontroli dostępu, integracji systemowych oraz architektury aplikacyjnej.
 Umiejętność przełożenia potrzeb biznesowych na rozwiązania technologiczne i koordynowania ich realizacji.
 Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu PoC i projektów technologicznych od koncepcji do wdrożenia.
 Umiejętność komunikacji i współpracy z biznesem, zespołami IT oraz kadrą zarządzającą.
 Bardzo dobra znajomość języka polskiego i angielskiego (w mowie i piśmie).
 Mile widziane

We are looking for an Desktop Publishing Specialist to join our Localization Services Team on a temporary basis (6 months). 
 In this role, you will be responsible for the desktop publishing and production of multilingual localized content, ensuring that translated materials are correctly formatted, visually consistent and ready for delivery. You will work closely with Localization Services, Graphic Design, Project Managers and external partners.
 A strong eye for detail, solid graphic design skills and experience working with right-to-left (RTL) languages are essential.
 More about the role : 
 Format, lay out and typeset multilingual documents, including user guides and marketing materials.
 Adapt existing designs to accommodate translated content, text expansion/contraction, font substitution and language-specific requirements.
 Work with both left-to-right and right-to-left languages such as Arabic and Hebrew, ensuring correct text direction, mirroring and typography.
 Prepare files for internal review, manage versions and accurately incorporate feedback.
 Perform detailed DTP quality checks, including text overflow, missing characters, fonts, formatting, page breaks, tables, images, hyperlinks, numbering and headers/footers.
 Manage several projects and deadlines simultaneously, coordinating review cycles with stakeholders.
 Prepare final files according to specifications and ensure they are production-ready.
 Support the evaluation of an internal DTP model by tracking effort, turnaround time, rework and quality.
 More about you : 
 A degree in Graphic Design or a related field.
 3–5 years of experience as a DTP Specialist, desktop publisher or multilingual layout specialist.
 Strong experience with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly InDesign, with working knowledge of Illustrator and Photoshop.
 Proven experience adapting layouts for translated content while maintaining the original design intent.
 Hands-on experience with RTL languages such as Arabic, Hebrew or Farsi, including troubleshooting RTL/bidirectional layout issues.
 Strong attention to detail and a good visual/graphic design sense.
 Good project management and organizational skills.
 Ability to work independently and manage deadlines in a remote, contract-based environment.
 Excellent written and spoken English.
 More about what we offer : 
 As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

items.desc:
​
 This is a fixed-term appointment with an initial duration of 4 years. Depending upon performance and organisational needs, the appointment may be extended up to a possible maximum duration of 8 years. 
 Location 
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands 
 Description 
 Earth Observation (EO) Future Missions Optical Payload and Performance Engineer in the Optical Instruments Section, Future Missions and Instruments Division, Future Missions and Architecture Department, Directorate of Earth Observation Programmes.
 Reporting to the Head of the Optical Instruments Section, you will be responsible for the end-to-end definition, engineering, technology breadboarding and pre-development of optical payload systems for future EO missions, both for research missions (e.g. Earth Explorers, Missions of Opportunity and Scout missions) and operational missions (e.g. Copernicus and meteorology missions).
 The above payloads include EO multispectral imagers, imaging spectrometers and Fourier-Transform spectrometers, as well as active laser payloads for Earth surface and atmosphere sensing, covering the full wavelength range from ultraviolet to far infrared. 
 You will be involved in the study and pre-development of one or several of them. You will be appointed optical instrument lead for the preparation of future EO missions in Phase 0 or Phase A.
 Duties 
 Your duties will include:
 identifying and investigating new Earth observation principles, techniques and technologies in coordination with staff in this Department, in the Science, Applications and Climate Department and the Directorate of Technology, Engineering and Quality, including interfacing with research and technical groups, in particular with relevant Science Mission Advisory Groups;
 maintaining knowledge of relevant technology status and instrument development programmes inside and outside ESA, including developments undertaken by other space agencies in Europe and worldwide, as well as commercial initiatives such as those driven under NewSpace, in close collaboration with the Division’s Technology Coordination and Frequency Management Section;
 defining and assessing the performance and technological readiness of new EO optical payload systems in close collaboration with the staff of the Division’s Mission and System Studies Section, taking into account mission, system and programmatic objectives and requirements;
 defining, negotiating, initiating and managing industrial contracts for the study and risk-retirement of new optical payload systems, according to the agreed activity plan;
 defining, negotiating, initiating and managing risk-retirement activities through technology breadboarding and pre-development of optical payload systems for future EO missions (including Earth Explorer, Copernicus, meteorology) up to their completion, coordinating instrument pre-development activities with project teams when required;
 defining, negotiating, initiating and managing the development of ground-based or airborne instrument models, according to the maturity of the concepts and performance-demonstration needs;
 providing expert support to the Division for the optical payload aspects of missions undergoing evaluation or preparation, including for the evaluation of mission proposals, optical payload system support for Phase 0/A and mission architecture studies, and contributing to the preparation of technical and scientific dossiers on new EO research and operational missions;
 being the optical instrument lead for future EO missions in Phase 0 or Phase A;
 supporting InCubed proposal evaluation and ensuring the technical management of activities when related to EO optical payloads and technologies;
 defining, developing, maintaining and upgrading optical payload systems dimensioning and mission performance models and tools to assess new instrument concepts.
 Technical competencies 
 Knowledge of technical domains and related R&D space industry trends
 Knowledge of innovation-related processes
 Experience in spaceborne optical instrument development
 Experience in optical Earth observation mission and instrument performance modelling
 Knowledge of optical remote sensing techniques and understanding of Earth observation user needs
 Behavioural competencies 
 Result Orientation
Operational Efficiency
Fostering Cooperation
Relationship Management
Continuous Improvement
Forward Thinking
For more information, please refer to ESA Core Behavioural Competencies guidebook 
 Education and professional experience 
 A master's degree in engineering or physics is required for this post together with five years of relevant professional experience.
 Additional requirements 
 At least five years of relevant experience in EO optical instrument preparation and/or development is required.
 Experience in the development of mission and instrument performance analysis models/tools for EO optical instruments is required.
 Experience in working in a team or project environment is required.

 Are you passionate about shaping the future of work through cutting-edge Digital Workplace experiences powered by AI technologies? Do you thrive at the intersection of innovation, collaboration, data, and people? 
If so, this is your opportunity to make a real impact at one of the world's leading reinsurance companies. Join us and help redefine how over 14,000 employees connect, collaborate, and create value — every single day. 
 About the role 
 Step into a pivotal role within Swiss Re's Digital Workplace team, where you will be at the forefront of continued workplace transformation. As a Workplace Engineer, you will co-lead implementation, adoption, and continuous delivery of intelligent Digital Workplace capabilities — with a spotlight on Microsoft 365 services, Workplace AI assistants, agents and automation. Your work will directly shape the modern, best-in-class digital experience for our global workforce, driving measurable business value while ensuring services are delivered in line with security, compliance, regulatory, and governance requirements.

 Leverage data platforms such as MS Power Platform and Palantir Foundry to drive data-informed workplace decisions and visualisations

 Continuously upskill , improve controls and procedures, and actively share knowledge across teams to foster a culture of learning and innovation

 We in Digital Workplace (DWP) set out to make it easy for more than 14,000 employees to seamlessly connect with people, ideas, and expertise — within and beyond Swiss Re. 
 Our team is built around Microsoft 365, Workplace AI solutions, and related services — spanning design, architecture, development, integration, and orchestration across teams and internal partners. We believe the key to success lies in deeply understanding the business needs of our internal clients, identifying where technology can add real value, and focusing on how people will adopt and embrace change. 
 To support this, we are continuously redefining the way we work. DWP is an early adopter of agile methodologies and agile leadership within Swiss Re — and we're proud of it. We are a diverse, passionate team of experts who genuinely welcome professionals who bring curiosity, drive, and experience to help us deliver world-class solutions. Come join us on our journey! 
 About You 
 We are looking for a self-starter with a can-do, hands-on, and end-to-end mentality — someone who is adaptable, curious, values close stakeholder interactions and is ready to challenge colleagues and the status quo in the best possible way. You thrive in an environment where no two days are alike, engaging regularly with new requirements and topics alongside a diverse team of experts. You bring a track record of successful delivery in complex, fast-paced environments and are energised by the opportunity to create real impact. 
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements: 
 Proven knowledge and hands on experience of managing and developing M365 digital workplace platform and services, such as Exchange, Sharepoint, Teams and PowerPlatform. 
 Experience around security, governance and compliance controls related to the M365 Workplace 
 Strong automation and scripting capabilities using PowerShell, Power Automate, AI Agents and other modern tools supporting continuous delivery and operational efficiency. 
 Ideally including experience with modern DevOps technologies and CI/CD methodologies. 
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week. 
 We accept only English CVs.

items.desc:
Treat Health | Full-stack Engineer (Elixir, Phoenix LiveView, React) | Helsinki, Finland | ONSITE | Full-time | Compensation in the link below
Treat Health is building healthcare where the right care takes minutes, not days. You describe your concern in your own words, our smart intake asks the follow-up questions a doctor would ask, and a licensed doctor reviews the whole picture and decides on the care. Prescriptions and records go straight to Kanta, Finland's national health archive.
Right now, agentic frontend engineering and agentic mobile app development matter most to us. We expect you to work across the whole stack, with our assistance and tooling.
Stack: Elixir, Phoenix LiveView, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, GCP, Cloudflare and Rust, with Swift and Kotlin for our native mobile apps. Claude is part of everyday work, from planning and coding to review. We care about how well you direct coding agents, not how fast you type.
Small team, high trust: you own problems end to end, with real influence on what we build. Health data stays in the EU, every sign-in uses strong identification, and patient data never ends up in logs.
For now, working on site in Helsinki is a must, and we can't offer relocation or visa support, so you need to already be able to work in Finland. We may hire remotely in the future, so check back later.
Compensation, details and how to apply: https://treat.health/en/careers/full-stack-engineer/

Does this sound like you? Then join our accomplished team! The Group Electronic Properties of Materials at the Faculty of Physics at the University of Vienna searches excellent candidates for the subgroup Low Dimensional Quantum Solids. The Group of Electronic Properties of Materials at the Faculty of Physics is a committed team of scientists with the main research focus on low dimensional quantum solids. We dedicate a great part of our research to the growth and spectroscopic analysis of pristine and doped carbon-based molecular structures to unravel their underlying electron transport and optical properties. We aim at understanding which parameters control their unique properties to subsequently engineer them to access their full application potential. Your personal sphere of influence: Your job will be focused on tailoring the electronic and optical properties of 1D and 2D nanostructures via advanced filling reactions and intercalation. Especially, the control of basic correlation effects, doping of interfaces and the concomitant understanding of their influence on charge transfer and hybridization are crucial. The group offers a vibrant and intellectually stimulating research environment where curiosity and scientific excellence thrive. You'll be part of a dynamic, collaborative community of researchers who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of materials science. Our atmosphere balances ambitious research goals with mutual support and collegiality, fostering both independent thinking and teamwork. We offer an active research culture with regular seminars, group discussions and knowledge exchange that keep you connected to the latest developments. We all value open communication, creative problem-solving, and a healthy work-life balance, creating an environment where you can grow both professionally and personally. International collaboration is at the heart of what we do, providing you with opportunities to build a global network while working alongside diverse, talented colleagues who share your enthusiasm for cutting-edge science. You will be associated to the MORE-TEM project and OVID laboratory as well as to the MATE platform. See more information on more-tem.univie.ac.at and ovid.univie.ac.at. Within these projects our group focuses strongly on the development of new techniques combining high spatial, energy & momentum (q)-resolution for nanospectroscopic analysis at all energy scales. This enables us to investigate dispersion and lifetime of primary excitations in nanomaterials such as 2D heterostructures and 1D nanotubes. This facilitates the control of quantum phases, like charge-density waves and superconductivity, to engineer new materials for energy (e.g. batteries, (opto-)electronic devices). Your future tasks: You actively participate in research, teaching & administration, which means: You will present your research plan to the faculty and complete a dissertation agreement within 12-18 months. We expect a large degree of independence paired with a high level of social awareness as the goal will only be achieved in a team. You will contribute to teaching activities (lab courses, exercise classes) both in teams and independently within the provisions of the collective bargaining agreement . You will fill some administrative tasks, contributing to the success and self-organization of the group for research, teaching and administration . You will continuously stay informed about the state of the art in your field . You will contribute to outreach by publications, conference presentations and public activities . You will engage with the broader scientific community through conferences and collaborative events . items.desc: We are looking for one or two highly motivated researcher interested in transcription regulation at the DNRF Center of Excellence, Center for Gene Expression (CGEN), within the Department of Cellular and Molecular Medicine (ICMM), at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. Starting date: 1st of January 2027 or after agreement. Information on the department can be found at: https://icmm.ku.dk/english/ Our research CGEN is an interdisciplinary research center consisting of 6 research groups located in modern laboratories in the Mærsk Tower at the Panum Institute. Our mission is to use a cutting-edge ensemble of genetic, cell biological, biochemical, organismal, and modern ‘omic’-approaches to achieve a comprehensive understanding of the process of gene expression. CGEN performs ground-breaking research in a collaborative and ambitious environment, where young researchers are offered the best conditions to engage in bold and imaginative research. CGEN is also a center of learning, where PhDs and postdocs receive comprehensive insights in the cellular processes underlying gene expression, as well as a clear view of their medical importance and potential for a future research career. Information on CGEN and its individual groups can be found at: https://cgen.ku.dk/ and on ICMM at: https://icmm.ku.dk/english/ Your job The researcher’s responsibilities will primarily consist of: research, including publication/academic dissemination duties research-based teaching and mentorship, primarily in a laboratory setting. The project will be decided in consultation with the selected candidate(s) in accordance with ongoing research programmes within the individual groups. Broadly projects are focused on understanding the various aspects of the process of gene expression, ranging from the mechanisms of 3D chromatin organisation to transcription, mRNA processing, translation, and protein turnover. CGEN addresses fundamental questions in this broad field at the leading edge of science and aims to dramatically expand our knowledge of the processes, signals and factors allowing a gene to be transcribed while integrating with protein synthesis and protein turnover, so that the overall integrity of gene expression is maintained. Profile Six overall criteria apply for researcher appointments at the University of Copenhagen. The six criteria (research, teaching, societal impact, organisational contribution, external funding, and leadership) are considered a framework for the overall assessment of candidates. Find information about each criterion here: https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/criteria-for-recognising-merit. Furthermore, we are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following skills and experience: Essential experience and skills: You have a PhD in life science Research qualifications at the level that can be achieved by satisfactorily completing a period of employment as a postdoc but may also be obtained in other ways. Research-based teaching or mentorship. You are highly experienced in either biochemistry, molecular cell biology, genome-wide analysis, or quantitative imaging in mammalian cells You have previous experience within the field of transcription and/or co-transcriptional processing, ideally with a focus on RNAPII regulation You possess a high degree of independence, motivation, attention to detail and proactiveness. You have excellent time-management, self-organisation and teamwork skills We value a problem-solving mindset, strong communication skills, and a collaborative spirit. Desirable experience and skills: Experience with CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing and/or screening approaches Experience with techniques to profile nascent transcription, RNAPII occupancy, ribosome footprinting, etc. Experience with proteomics to characterise RNAPII elongation complexes The working language of the department is English and, consequently, the successful applicant must possess excellent skills in written and spoken English. An ability to communicate in Danish is preferable. Place of employment The place of employment is at the Department of Cellular and Molecular Medicine, Panum, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. items.desc: Job Title: Software Engineer - B2B Lending & Payments Type: Full-time Location: Paris What about us? Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas. At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents. By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide. Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation The Role We are hiring a Software Engineer (B2B Lending & Payments) to take ownership of the financial infrastructure that powers how our clients finance their assets through INFINIT. We believe the most resilient lending and payment systems are built by engineers who operate at the intersection of deep technical mastery, genuine product judgment, and direct proximity to the client’s financing workflow. This is not a ticket-execution role. You will work with business stakeholders and clients to understand why a problem matters before deciding what to build then use agentic coding to ship the how fast and well. Partnering with other engineers owning this domain, you will own two deeply connected responsibilities. First, crafting the best possible experience for a client going through a loan application, from the moment they submit a request to the moment financing is confirmed, every step should feel clear, fast, and trustworthy. Second, ensuring that every payment executed throughout the loan lifecycle (interest accruals, supplier disbursements, reimbursement) is processed correctly, securely, and without exception. Third, supporting the physical audit and due diligence workflows that allow us to maintain control over the collateral throughout the life of the loan. You will be the person the rest of the team pings when something in this domain breaks. What do you need to be successful in this role? Expert C# & .NET Engineering, mastery of the .NET ecosystem with a focus on building high-performance, distributed backend systems. You have a proven track record of shipping scalable, production-grade architectures where technical clarity and long-term maintainability are the default. Core banking & ledger logic , a strong professional background in regulated financial environments. You understand the mechanics of ledgers, loan origination, and payment execution and the cost of getting any of it wrong. Mission-critical ownership: Demonstrated ability to own features end-to-end. You don't just "write code"; you analyze customer financing workflows, define rigorous technical requirements, and take full accountability for the reliability of every transaction you process. Highly effective stakeholder communication , capable of seamlessly translating deep technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders (customers, product managers) and clearly translating business objectives into prioritized engineering tasks. Practical experience leveraging modern developer tools (such as agentic coding or advanced automation techniques) to achieve significantly accelerated development velocity while rigorously upholding code quality standards. What will you find working at INFINIT? Competitive Salary and Equity : We offer highly competitive salaries and a stake in our success with share options because we're building this together. Diverse and Inclusive Team : Join a dynamic and international team in excess of 8 nationalities. You'll have the chance to work with experienced professionals from around the world, fostering a rich learning environment. Inspiring Mission : We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities. Flexible Benefits: Access Flexible Retribution benefits through a convenient mobile app Health and Well-being: Your health matters to us. You will have access to top-quality Medical & Mental Health Insurance Coporoate gym discount Quality Time Together : We foster a sense of community with annual gatherings and bi-weekly office team gatherings. You're more than welcome to join us for quality time. Birthday Off : Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off. Flexibility and Ownership : We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid working 3 days a week in our Paris office and 2 days at home. items.desc: About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh) Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today's hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get: Predictable performance, even at scale Secure, compliant environments by default Real-time observability and profiling built in Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum. What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work. Our values: We make a positive impact. ✨ We aim for the stars. We care for each other. Impact of a Software Engineer As a Software Engineer at Upsun, you will build and maintain the backend services behind our customers' billing. Billing is your main focus: invoices, taxes, usage reporting, and the integrations that connect our platform to the commercial systems behind it. These systems handle tens of millions in revenue each year across multiple products, entities, and currencies. Accuracy matters, and your work reaches customers directly. You will own components in this space and act as a key link between engineering, Finance, and Product. Every new offering Upsun launches needs a billing component, and you will help build it. Over time, you will become a long-term owner of the systems you build. You may also contribute to adjacent services such as project provisioning and account management. What to expect Build billing integrations: Develop and maintain backend services and API integrations in Go that connect our platform to external billing systems. Ship usage-based billing features: Build features such as usage tracking, estimates, usage alerts, and invoicing. Work with other engineering teams to understand how new features are measured and charged. Complete billing migrations: Help finish moving billing to external systems while keeping data accurate and customers unaffected. Troubleshoot and fix issues: Investigate and resolve billing issues raised by Support and Finance, from incorrect usage data to failed integrations. Protect customers and data: Contribute to anti-abuse measures and keep security in mind when working with sensitive customer and payment data. Work across teams: Partner with Finance, Product, and Support, and communicate clearly and asynchronously with a team spread across Europe, North America, and India. Build with good practice: Write tested, well-documented code, take part in pair programming and code review, and use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully in your workflow. What you bring Go development experience: 3+ years of professional backend development in Go. Relational databases: Hands-on experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB. Third-party API integration: Experience integrating with external REST APIs, including handling errors, retries, and rate limits. Care for accuracy: Attention to detail in systems where a mistake can reach a customer's invoice, and an interest in concepts like idempotency and consistency in distributed systems. Testing and reliability: A habit of writing unit and integration tests, including for failure paths, and thinking about how your code behaves in production. Security awareness: An understanding of common security vulnerabilities and how to avoid them in backend services. Interest in billing: You enjoy working on billing and financial systems and want to make them your focus. Clear async communication: You write clearly and collaborate well across teams and time zones. Where we hire At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom . Although we're unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. How …

You will design and implement the product services in the existing cloud infrastructure along with these teams, and work to improve existing infra solutions based on feedback and design sessions with them. Solid understanding of core networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, subnets, routing, and firewalls — essential for building secure and reliable cloud-native systems. Familiarity with PostgreSQL or similar relational database. Experienced with observability and logging solutions (e.g. Coralogix, DataDog, etc.). items.desc: Who we are: Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products. Our culture: We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule. We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless. Location: Remote - Germany About the role: As a Full Stack Engineer at Sardine, you will bridge the gap between complex technical backend systems and user-friendly interfaces to help us stop fraud in its tracks. This is a dynamic, high-impact role. On average, you will be working 60% on backend development and 40% on frontend development but are willing to help out wherever is needed. You will build out data-intensive applications, including advanced graph systems used to uncover complex fraud rings. You will own features end-to-end at a massive scale, ultimately empowering fraud analysts to uncover and investigate suspicious transactions faster than ever before. What you’ll be doing: Own features end-to-end: Drive the product lifecycle from determining the initial problem space and user needs, to technical modeling, UX execution, and iterative improvements based on vague requirements. Translate complexity to usability: Build out complex technical systems into intuitive, user-friendly interfaces. Build fraud-fighting tools: Develop and optimize advanced graph systems to visualize fraud rings, and build performant search tools that help analysts rapidly identify suspicious transactions. Collaborate cross-functionally: Work tightly with Design, Data, Product, and Account Management teams to align engineering output with business and user needs. Ensure system health: Proactively diagnose, triage, and resolve bugs while writing highly efficient and performant code. What you’ll need: Core technical stack: Extensive experience writing efficient, production-ready code in TypeScript, Node.js, React, Go and other server programming languages. Scale and data expertise: Proven experience working with data-intensive applications, complex workflows, and big data at scale. Pipeline proficiency: Deep background in technical data modeling and building robust production data pipelines. High-growth adaptability: The ability to thrive, execute, and deliver consistently in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment. Independent execution: A proven track record of taking extreme ownership of ambiguous problems and independently turning them into polished, scalable features. Benefits we offer: Generous compensation in cash and equity Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture Flexible paid time off and Year-end break Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific MacBook Pro delivered to your door One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc. Monthly meal stipend Monthly social meet-up stipend Annual health and wellness stipend Annual Learning stipend Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you. To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice . Compensation Range: €125K - €139K

Als Familienunternehmen legen wir größten Wert auf nachhaltiges Wirtschaften und langfristige Beziehungen. Wir stehen für Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit. Im Team Data Foundation entwickeln und betreiben wir eine Plattform, die als Basis für Datenaustausch, Berichte, Analyse und KI dient. Schlagwörter wie performant, skalierbar, zentraler Datenspeicher, unternehmensweit einsetzbar, Daten für interne und externe Apps bereitstellen, Self-Service, usw. treiben uns Tag für Tag an. Agilität, iteratives Vorgehen, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und offenes Feedback stehen bei uns auf der Tagesordnung. Dein Beitrag zum Erfolg Datenmodellierung & ETL/ELT-Pipelines : Du verantwortest das Design effizienter Datenmodelle und orchestrierst Pipelines (Extract, Transform, Load). Du kombinierst dabei die Flexibilität von Code mit der Effizienz von Tools wie dbt und Matillion ETL. Datenintegration, Qualität & BI: Du integrierst heterogene Datenquellen in unser Data Warehouse und etablierst Standards für Datenqualität. Du stellst sicher, dass die Daten optimal für BI-Tools wie Looker oder Tableau aufbereitet sind, damit Data Scientists und Business-Analysten stets auf verlässliche Insights zugreifen können. Software Engineering & AI Integration : Du nutzt Deine fundierten Python-Kenntnisse, um komplexe Data-Services zu entwickeln. Confluent Kafka) für die Echtzeit-Datenverarbeitung mit. Fundierte Python-Kenntnisse sowie solide Praxiserfahrung in der ETL/ELT-Modellierung mit modernem Werkzeugeinsatz (dbt und/oder Matillion ETL). Praktische Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an der Einbindung von AI-Agenten, LLMs und Agentic Workflows in moderne Datenprodukte. Vertrautheit mit CI/CD-Pipelines, Clean-Code-Prinzipien und agiler Teamarbeit (Scrum/Kanban) an der Schnittstelle zu Data Science und Business-Analysten. Analytische Fähigkeiten und der Antrieb, technologische Herausforderungen eigenständig und zielgerichtet zu lösen. Du bist ein Teamplayer, der sein Wissen gerne teilt und eng mit Data Scientists, Analysten und Fachbereichen zusammenarbeitet. Du verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Deine Benefits Wir sind ein Great Place to Work Conrad bietet dir durch eine offene und empathische Arbeitsumgebung die optimale Möglichkeit, aktiv an der Zukunft des Unternehmens mitzuwirken und dich dabei selbst weiterzuentwickeln. Für diese einzigartige Unternehmenskultur wurden wir vom Institut Great Place to Work ausgezeichnet. Zeit fürs Leben Durch flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, hybrides Arbeiten und Sonderurlaub hast du die Möglichkeit, deinen Arbeitsalltag individuell nach deinen Bedürfnissen zu gestalten. Auch dein Nachwuchs liegt uns am Herzen: An unserem Zentralstandort in Hirschau werden unsere "Conrad Kids" liebevoll in unserer betrieblichen Kindertagesstätte betreut. Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe Wir sind ein Familienunternehmen, deshalb ist uns ein familiärer Umgang besonders wichtig. Die Du-Kultur wird bei uns nicht nur kommuniziert, sondern ebenso wie die flachen Hierarchien tatsächlich gelebt. Vielfalt als Teil des Erfolgs Wir sind international aufgestellt - englische Meetings gehören genauso zu unserem Arbeitsalltag wie die Aufgeschlossenheit gegenüber anderen Kulturen. Durch den Austausch unterschiedlicher Erfahrungen und Sichtweisen fördern wir Kreativität und Innovation in unserem Unternehmen. Tragende Säule für die strategische Zukunft von Conrad Wir befinden uns in einer aufregenden Transformation zur führenden Beschaffungsplattform für den technischen Bedarf. items.desc: The Opportunity From the moment you wake up until you go to bed, chances are that most of the media, ads, apps, websites and online shopping you interact with were touched by an Adobe product. Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) is the backbone that powers these experiences: it helps enterprises such as Verizon, Nike, AT&T and Disney centralize and standardize their customer data, build 360-degree customer profiles, and drive real-time personalized experiences. AEP processes terabytes to petabytes of data and serves billions of requests every day. We are expanding our Compute / Data Distiller team in Bucharest. The team owns two core AEP capabilities: Data Distiller – a SQL engine on top of the AEP data lake that lets customers run interactive, batch and scheduled queries, accelerated queries, templates and alerts, and connect BI tools through the PostgreSQL protocol, to derive datasets, audiences and insights. We are also building AI agents that generate and personalize SQL from natural language. Compute Gateway – the multi-cloud, multi-engine compute layer that orchestrates data processing workloads with policy-based routing and support for long-running applications and jobs. This position is for a key contributor who will help design modern data architectures and highly distributed cloud solutions, and take them all the way to production. What You'll Do Design, build and operate complex features in a large-scale, multi-cloud, microservices-based SaaS product. Own the outcome: lead application, framework and service design efforts, optimizing for quality, testability, scalability and performance. Work on query execution, Spark SQL and query optimization, and the orchestration of compute workloads across multiple engines and clouds. Prototype new approaches and deliver production solutions at scale; research new technologies and keep up with industry trends. Partner with Product Management, Design, Data Science and engineering teams across domains, including our US counterparts on a shared roadmap. Provide guidance in architecture, design and code reviews; mentor teammates and promote good engineering practices and continuous learning. Take part in on-call activities on a follow-the-sun rotation with the rest of the team. Contribute to open-source projects where relevant. What You Need to Succeed B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent engineering degree, and/or 3+ years of relevant experience building software systems. items.desc: About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh) Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today's hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get: Predictable performance, even at scale Secure, compliant environments by default Real-time observability and profiling built in Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum. What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work. Our values: We make a positive impact. ✨ We aim for the stars. We care for each other. Impact of a Software Engineer As a Software Engineer at Upsun, you will build and maintain the backend services behind our customers' billing. Billing is your main focus: invoices, taxes, usage reporting, and the integrations that connect our platform to the commercial systems behind it. These systems handle tens of millions in revenue each year across multiple products, entities, and currencies. Accuracy matters, and your work reaches customers directly. You will own components in this space and act as a key link between engineering, Finance, and Product. Every new offering Upsun launches needs a billing component, and you will help build it. Over time, you will become a long-term owner of the systems you build. You may also contribute to adjacent services such as project provisioning and account management. What to expect Build billing integrations: Develop and maintain backend services and API integrations in Go that connect our platform to external billing systems. Ship usage-based billing features: Build features such as usage tracking, estimates, usage alerts, and invoicing. Work with other engineering teams to understand how new features are measured and charged. Complete billing migrations: Help finish moving billing to external systems while keeping data accurate and customers unaffected. Troubleshoot and fix issues: Investigate and resolve billing issues raised by Support and Finance, from incorrect usage data to failed integrations. Protect customers and data: Contribute to anti-abuse measures and keep security in mind when working with sensitive customer and payment data. Work across teams: Partner with Finance, Product, and Support, and communicate clearly and asynchronously with a team spread across Europe, North America, and India. Build with good practice: Write tested, well-documented code, take part in pair programming and code review, and use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully in your workflow. What you bring Go development experience: 3+ years of professional backend development in Go. Relational databases: Hands-on experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB. Third-party API integration: Experience integrating with external REST APIs, including handling errors, retries, and rate limits. Care for accuracy: Attention to detail in systems where a mistake can reach a customer's invoice, and an interest in concepts like idempotency and consistency in distributed systems. Testing and reliability: A habit of writing unit and integration tests, including for failure paths, and thinking about how your code behaves in production. Security awareness: An understanding of common security vulnerabilities and how to avoid them in backend services. Interest in billing: You enjoy working on billing and financial systems and want to make them your focus. Clear async communication: You write clearly and collaborate well across teams and time zones. Where we hire At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom . Although we're unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. How …

items.desc: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role This is not a lab technician position. This is a senior scientist who owns assay quality, data QC and controls, and production troubleshooting across the entire experimental pipeline. The production team runs 150+ experiments per month across expression, BLI, SPR, thermostability, and enzyme activity. When something goes wrong (failed expression, anomalous binding data, instrument artifacts), this person diagnoses the root cause and fixes it. As the assay and instrumentation portfolio expands, this person translates new R&D methods into production-ready protocols, builds robust methods that junior technicians can execute reliably, and designs comprehensive controls that enable automated QC and data processing. This is a player-coach position. You will still run experiments personally, especially as you integrate into the lab, but you will also elevate the whole team's capabilities. What You'll Do Troubleshoot production failures across the full pipeline. A batch of proteins isn't expressing: is it the construct design, the expression system, or the media? BLI sensorgrams look noisy: is it the sensor tips, the sample prep, or an instrument issue? You figure it out, fix it, and make the cause easier to identify next time. Develop and document SOPs for new assays as the portfolio expands. Take methods from the R&D team and make them production-ready: robust, reproducible, and executable by junior technicians without hand-holding. Mentor a growing production team. Set quality standards, review data, train new hires, and build a culture where people flag problems early instead of hiding them. Work at the intersection of biology, automation, and QC. Collaborate with researchers, laboratory technicians, and automation engineers on protocol optimization for work cells, and with software on LabOS protocol integration. Own the relationship between assay science and throughput. The easy version of every assay doesn't scale, and the scalable version often sacrifices quality. You find the right tradeoff. What We're Looking For Deep hands-on expertise in protein production: expression (E. coli, mammalian, cell-free), purification (IMAC, SEC), and biophysical characterization (BLI and SPR at minimum). This isn't negotiable. You need to have done this work yourself, at volume. PhD in protein biochemistry, biophysics, or structural biology, plus 3-5 years in a production or development role at a CRO, foundry, or high-throughput lab. Academic postdocs count if the work was high-throughput and production-oriented. Experience with high-throughput workflows. You're comfortable with 96-well plates and liquid handlers, not just single-column purifications. You've optimized protocols for scale, not just for one perfect result. Mentorship mindset. You've managed or trained junior scientists before. You enjoy teaching and get satisfaction from watching your team grow. Troubleshooting instinct. When data looks wrong, your first impulse is to understand why, not to rerun the experiment and hope it works. Quality-obsessed but pragmatic. You care deeply about data quality, but you also understand that production has deadlines and sometimes "good enough" is the right call. Bridge between R&D and production. You can speak both languages: the exploratory mindset of research and the reproducibility demands of production.
