items.desc: We are seeking to appoint a Research Assistant (AI Scientist & Computational Cancer Biology) to join the Nuffield Department of Medicine, University of Oxford, working on an state of the art project funded by Advanced Research & Innovation Agency. Reporting to Dr Lennard Lee, Programme Director, the post holder will serve as a Cancer Vaccine Epitope Discovery & Future mRNA Manufacturing Research Assistant for the UK Cancer Vaccine AI Scientist & Supercomputing Project. The UK Cancer Vaccine AI Scientist & Supercomputing Project is a government-supported national flagship research initiative hosted by the University of Oxford. The project brings together advanced immunology, automated laboratories, sovereign AI supercomputing, and AI Scientists to develop and manufacture safer, more precise and more effective personalised cancer vaccines. Experimental findings are rapidly fed back to the AI scientist, enabling increasingly accurate predictions and accelerating translation of scientific discoveries towards NHS patient benefit. You will provide experimental research support across cancer vaccine epitope discovery and the development of future approaches to personalised mRNA vaccine manufacturing. They will contribute to the experimental validation of AI-predicted cancer vaccine targets using immunological assays and support the development, manufacture and characterisation of experimental mRNA vaccine candidates. They will work closely with immunologists, computational scientists, AI researchers and autonomous laboratory scientists, helping connect AI-led target discovery with experimental validation and vaccine manufacturing. The project has been recognised as one of the UK’s leading strategic research initiatives, having been referenced within both the Government’s AI for Science Strategy and the 10-Year National Cancer Plan. It is supported by major UK research funders and government organisations, including ARIA, the Medical Research Council, UK Research and Innovation, Cancer Research UK and the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology, alongside a consortium of more than 2,500 scientists, clinicians, engineers, patient representatives and technology experts. The successful candidate will join a highly collaborative multidisciplinary team working at the interface of artificial intelligence, computational biology, cancer immunology, robotics, software engineering and clinical research, contributing to research that aims to establish new approaches for the discovery and development of personalised cancer vaccines. You will provide computational research support within the programme, working with large-scale cancer, genomic and immunological datasets and applying established and emerging artificial intelligence approaches to cancer vaccine research. They will use frontier and open-source AI models and agentic coding tools, contribute to the development and evaluation of AI models and scientific agents, and support computational analyses alongside cancer biologists, immunologists and AI researchers. The post holder will manage their own research and administrative activities within agreed guidelines and contribute to project planning, data analysis, research outputs and collaborative research. It is essential that you hold a degree in immunology, biomedical sciences, molecular biology, biochemistry, cancer biology or a related discipline and possess sufficient specialist knowledge of immunology, cancer biology, molecular biology or a related discipline to work within established research programmes. With experience analysing biological, genomic, biomedical or other large-scale research datasets using computational methods, you will have the ability to manage own research, laboratory and administrative activities within agreed guidelines. Practical experience of laboratory research, with experience in one or more relevant techniques such as mammalian cell culture, immunological assays, flow cytometry, fluorescence microscopy, sequencing or molecular biology is also essential. Applications for this vacancy should be made online and you will need to upload a supporting statement and CV. Your supporting statement must explain how you meet each of the selection criteria for the post using examples of your skills and experience. Please restrict your documentation to your CV and supporting statement only. Any other documents will be requested at a later date. This position is offered full time on a fixed term contract until 30 September 2030 and is funded by ARIA. Only applications received before 12 midday on Monday, 26 October 2026 will be considered. items.desc: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 10 The Team: The Chemical Research & Analytics team is growing as it builds market intelligence and insight across the commodity chemicals sector. This team is in constant dialogue with the industry to understand market dynamics and create market outlooks for key petrochemicals. The team also connects with groups across S&P Global to understand linkages across the industry, from upstream energy cost impacts to policy and sustainability influences as well as macroeconomic drivers impacting demand. We interact with all major stakeholders including industry associations, producers, consumers, traders, transportation providers and financial institutions engaging with individuals up to and including board level executives. The Chemical Economics Handbook (CEH) team delivers comprehensive market intelligence on commodity and specialty chemicals. The team produces structured reports that integrate asset-level data, supply and demand balances, trade flows, and price analysis to provide a consistent and forward-looking view of industry fundamentals. CEH outputs are used by clients across the value chain—producers, consumers, and investors—to support strategic planning, investment decisions, benchmarking, and market monitoring. The Impact: This role will support the regional and global Methanol & Derivatives team in generating chemical market intelligence. There is a short and long-term cadence of market coverage and activities which will include: Analysis of chemical value chain market trends Collating industry statistics and internal data to provide market insights Regular update of supply/demand balances, trade flows, operating schedules and price forecasts Research into emerging markets, plants and technologies Modelling and supporting the transformation of data This role will also support the CEH commodity team, managing the timely, end‑to‑end delivery of comprehensive industry reports. The role involves developing in-depth chemical market reports for the Chemical Economics Handbook (CEH) and related services, combining rigorous research with structured analytical frameworks. The analyst is responsible for building independent market assessments based on both primary and secondary research, while actively liaising with internal experts to ensure robust and well-informed conclusions. Key responsibilities include analyzing supply–demand balances, evaluating market dynamics and industry trends, and assessing macroeconomic and sector-specific drivers to produce forward-looking, insight-driven assessments. What’s in it for you : This person will join a global, dynamic and internationally-orientated research team of established individuals with varied industrial experience. The analyst role will support the continued building of chemical expertise which will provide exposure to a wide range of petrochemical products, markets, technologies and industries. The role provides the opportunity to work alongside other skilled analysts, helping to form a consistent and comprehensive view of the global chemical markets. Additionally, they will have the opportunity to improve their analytical skills and knowledge by interacting with other commodities teams, and groups within the wider S&P Global organization. The successful candidate joins at a time of unprecedented change within the industry, with geopolitics, climate policies and volatile energy markets gaining ever-increasing importance in reporting and decision-making. The role provides opportunity to be at the forefront of this fast-changing landscape and help influence the way the industry navigates through these macro trends. This role comes at a time when the team is looking to leverage S&P Global’s wider expertise and experience in emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. The right candidate will be able to gain exposure to this, and influence the role that these technologies play in revolutionising the ways that we gather and deliver market intelligence. items.desc: About Winton Winton is a research-based investment management company with a specialist focus on statistical and mathematical inference in financial markets. The firm researches and trades quantitative investment strategies, which are implemented systematically via thousands of securities, spanning the world's major liquid asset classes. Founded in 1997 by David Harding, Winton today manages assets for some of the world’s largest institutional investors. We employ ambitious professionals who want to work collaboratively at the leading edge of investment management. We seek a highly skilled developer with strong computer science fundamentals to join our Quantitative Platform team. This team is responsible for developing the core platforms that underpin and provide data to the research and trading of our quantitative investment strategies, alongside tools, APIs, libraries, and user interfaces to support this. In this role you will work closely with our research and other technology teams to deliver high impact projects that improve our ability to predict and trade movements in global financial markets. Our Technology Operating in a cloud-first environment, we predominantly write our backend systems in C# but otherwise make pragmatic choices for each scenario. This often means Python with C++ employed in performance-sensitive cases. Our applications are written with containerisation in mind from the outset and deployed as a Docker image into Kubernetes on AWS where we can scale on-demand to satisfy burstable workloads. We make extensive use of Kafka for low-latency communication across applications and use a mixture of different technologies for storage, from S3 to relational databases. We utilise GitHub for source control and Jenkins for CI, though with an increasing interest in GitHub Actions. We constantly evaluate our stack to ensure we’re using the most appropriate technologies for the needs of our business and the efficient delivery of those requirements. Your responsibilities will include: Build and maintain a world-class platform that enables storage, transformation, and testing of data at scale by leveraging the latest open-source software, cloud, and distributed computing technologies. Gain a deep understanding of the requirements of our research teams to deliver business-critical functionality in a timely-manner. Collaborate with the team through active contribution in code reviews, knowledge-sharing, and design discussions. Write and maintain good quality, well-tested code across services, data storage and UI layers. What we're Looking For: A Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or equivalent technical field. 2+ years of professional software development experience, including C#, Python or C++ Comfortable using agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code and are genuinely keen to use them as a natural part of daily work Collaborative nature and ability to work in a team e.g., partnering with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, and other technologists. Strong interest in keeping abreast of latest technologies and a measured approach for adopting them. Comfortable with problem solving across multiple technologies and business domains. What would Be Useful: Experience engineering systems for the cloud-based storage and processing of large datasets or using frameworks such as Spark and open standards like Parquet and Arrow. Experience working with other cloud and related technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes. Experience working as a software developer in the quantitative hedge fund space. Experience building web applications using front-end frameworks such as Angular. Equal Opportunity Workplace We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin. 
 Part of something bigger 
 Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants. Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe. items.desc: About the job CIBOS Innovation is looking for a hands-on AI / LLM Engineer to design, build, and ship production agentic AI systems — from architecture through deployment to operational tuning. You'll work across CIBOS's commercial products and EU-funded R&D projects, building LLM agents and retrieval systems that solve real business problems for real users, not just demos. This role suits someone who wants to own AI features end-to-end: design the agent, wire it into live APIs and data stores, ship it to production, and keep tuning it once it's live. Responsibilities • Design, build, and deploy LLM-based agents (e.g. LangGraph, ReAct-style tool-calling) that interact with live APIs, databases, and business systems • Build and maintain RAG and retrieval pipelines — vector embeddings, semantic search, similarity-based deduplication — for tasks like knowledge retrieval, document processing, and inbound-request triage • Design evaluation frameworks and deterministic scoring for agentic AI behavior, to benchmark and continuously improve system quality • Own AI features end-to-end: architecture, backend integration (APIs, SQL, async pipelines), deployment, and post-launch tuning • Integrate AI components into existing product and client systems (REST/SOAP APIs, SQL backing stores, message queues) • Collaborate with the product and engineering team to scope, prioritize, and ship AI-driven features across CIBOS's product lines and client projects • Produce clear technical documentation (specs, architecture notes) to communicate AI system design to technical and non-technical stakeholders • Stay current on emerging LLM/agentic-AI techniques and tooling, and bring relevant ones into CIBOS's stack Required Skills • BSc or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field • Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM agents or agentic workflows (tool-calling, ReAct-style patterns, frameworks such as LangGraph or equivalent) • Practical experience with RAG, vector embeddings, and similarity/retrieval systems • Experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI or similar) and/or open-source LLMs • Solid backend engineering skills: Python, API development (e.g. FastAPI), SQL • Comfortable owning a feature from design through production deployment and iteration • Experience with Git and standard version control workflows • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to work independently and in a small, fast-moving team • Fluent in Greek and English, with strong technical communication skills Nice-to-have Skills • Experience designing evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for agentic AI systems • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for connecting agents to external tools and data sources • Familiarity with classical ML/forecasting (e.g. LightGBM, scikit-learn, TensorFlow) for hybrid AI + ML product features • Experience with OCR / document AI and human-in-the-loop review workflows • Knowledge of distributed/streaming technologies (Kafka, async processing) • Container experience (Docker; Kubernetes a plus) • Prior exposure to EU-funded research projects (Horizon Europe / H2020) or working in a research-adjacent environment • Modern software development practices (Agile/Scrum) About us CIBOS Innovation IKE is a deep-tech spin-off of ICCS/NTUA, founded in 2020 and based in Athens, Greece. We work across AI/ML, AR/VR, digital platforms, and edge computing, combining EU-funded research (Horizon Europe, H2020) with real commercial deployments — from AR/voice-guided warehouse picking to LLM-based digital assistants and IoT/digital-twin platforms. We're a small, senior team that takes products from research prototype to production, and we work closely with major research institutions and industry partners across Europe. What we offer • Competitive compensation [range 30-40K gross depending on skills and past experience in related fields] • Hybrid work arrangement, Athens-based • Laptop and standard equipment provided • Opportunity to own AI features end-to-end, from architecture to production • Exposure to both cutting-edge EU-funded research and real commercial deployments • Small, senior team — direct ownership and fast decision-making • A clear path of progression tailored to your skills and interests

items.desc: Word de beste versie van jezelf als AI Engineer Als AI Engineer bij Sogeti bouw je mee aan AI-toepassingen die organisaties dagelijks gebruiken. Je hebt je eerste ervaring met AI opgedaan en wilt verder groeien in Generative AI en agentic AI. Samen met ervaren collega's ontwikkel je bijvoorbeeld een kennisassistent, een toepassing voor documentverwerking of een AI-agent die afgebakende taken uitvoert. Binnen onze Data & AI-community werk je op het snijvlak van data, AI en software engineering. Je blijft betrokken van de eerste klantvraag en het prototype tot integratie, productie en verbetering. Je leert door te bouwen, feedback te vragen en jouw ervaringen met vakgenoten te delen. Waarom jij het verschil maakt Jij bent nieuwsgierig naar wat AI kan, maar kijkt ook kritisch naar wat het daadwerkelijk oplevert. Samen met je team ontwikkel je betrouwbare en bruikbare AI-oplossingen die aansluiten op de vraagstukken van klanten. Je vertaalt klantbehoeften naar concrete AI-usecases en ontwikkelt toepassingen met behulp van Python, large language models (LLMs) en eigen databronnen. Daarbij werk je aan moderne oplossingen op het gebied van Generative AI, zoals RAG-toepassingen, én aan Agentic AI-oplossingen waarbij agents zelfstandig taken uitvoeren binnen vooraf bepaalde kaders. Gedurende het hele proces houd je oog voor kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Je test antwoorden en agentgedrag, onderzoekt fouten en hallucinaties en houdt rekening met aspecten als privacy, beveiliging, prestaties en kosten. Samen met je collega's werk je aan de integratie van AI in applicaties en bedrijfsprocessen en draag je bij aan het succesvol in productie brengen van oplossingen. Ook na livegang blijf je betrokken en gebruik je gebruikersfeedback, resultaten en inzichten om oplossingen continu verder te verbeteren. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Vertalen van klantvragen naar concrete AI-usecases en ontwikkeltaken; Het ontwikkelen van GenAI-oplossingen met LLM's, prompts en eigen databronnen; Bouwen van RAG- en Agentic AI-toepassingen; Testen en verbeteren van antwoorden, agentgedrag en betrouwbaarheid; Het integreren van AI-oplossingen via API's in applicaties en processen; Monitoren, optimaliseren en doorontwikkelen van oplossingen na livegang. Hiermee word je de beste versie van jezelf Maakt impact binnen de Data & AI-organisatie van Sogeti, waar vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en samenwerking centraal staan; Je werkt samen met ervaren AI Engineers die met je meedenken over code, ontwerp en verantwoorde AI; Jij komt terecht in een hechte community waarin kennisdeling centraal staat via communitydagen, workshops, open podia en intervisiesessies; Je verdiept je in GenAI, Agentic AI, MLOps en andere moderne AI-technologieën en leert hoe je deze betrouwbaar ontwikkelt, test en beheert; Je krijgt toegang tot inhouse trainingen op het gebied van AI, techniek, communicatie en leiderschap, afgestemd op jouw ambities; Ontwikkelt jouw consultancyvaardigheden en deelt actief kennis met collega's en klanten; Je werkt aan uitdagende opdrachten bij toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland, waar jouw werk zichtbaar bijdraagt aan innovatie en betere besluitvorming; Groeit stap voor stap door als AI Engineer, specialist, lead engineer of richting thought leadership; Je werkt in een omgeving waar plezier en professionaliteit hand in hand gaan. Je kunt daarnaast rekenen op Een vast contract van 32, 36 of 40 uur met een beloningsbudget tot €4.600, bruto per maand incl. vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsvergoeding; Je kunt bij ons kiezen voor de manier van reizen die het beste bij je past zoals een leaseauto (elektrisch), kilometervergoeding en je krijgt een NS-Business Card, of een combinatie daarvan; We motiveren een actieve levenstijl daarom bieden wij daarbovenop een fietsleaseplan via Lease A Bike; 26 vakantiedagen met optie tot bijkopen, een onkostenvergoeding en een jaarlijkse bonus vanaf C-Grade; Met onze Benefits at Work krijg je kortingen bij webshops zoals bol.com, HEMA en Wehkamp, én voordeel op activiteiten, elektronica en meer; Een sterk inhouse L&D-programma, een onbeperkt opleidingsbudget en actieve vakinhoudelijke communities waar kennisdeling en groei centraal staan; Ruimte om bij te dragen aan een duurzamere toekomst via een duurzaamheidsbudget en flexregelingen; Aandacht voor (mentale) gezondheid, met initiatieven zoals OpenUp, ouderschapstrainingen, vitaliteitswebinars en een korting op je sportabonnement; Toegang tot inspirerende events zoals Women@Sogeti en SoPlay, waar tech en verbinding samenkomen. items.desc: Stellen-ID: 155025 Bei HORNBACH bauen wir nicht nur Baumärkte, sondern erschaffen das digitale Fundament für das Heimwerken von morgen. In unserem AI Platform Team entwickeln wir eine zentrale KI-Plattform, die modernste Sprachmodelle (LLMs) mit unseren internen Daten und Prozessen verbindet. Wir suchen keine Theoretiker, sondern Macher, die Lust haben, in einem explorativen Umfeld innovative Lösungen zu bauen, die für unsere Kunden und Mitarbeiter einen echten Mehrwert schaffen. Das sind Deine Aufgaben: KI-Plattform skalieren: Du entwickelst unsere interne KI-Infrastruktur weiter und sorgst dafür, dass modernste Technologien nahtlos in die HORNBACH-Systemlandschaft integriert werden. Cloud Native Development: Du designst und implementierst robuste Microservices in Python, die nativ in der Google Cloud Platform (GCP) laufen. Intelligente Integration: Du schaffst die Verbindung zwischen LLMs und unseren Kernsystemen. Explorative Entwicklung: Du experimentierst mit neuen Ansätzen und Agentic Workflows, um komplexe Aufgabenstellungen automatisiert zu lösen. Agiles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest in schnellen Lernzyklen, baust Prototypen, testest Hypothesen und verbesserst stetig unsere produktiven Lösungen. Dabei bist Du im direkten Austausch mit unseren Stakeholdern. Das bringst Du mit: Tech-Stack: Du bist sattelfest in der Softwareentwicklung mit Python und bringst Erfahrung mit Cloud Native Architekturen (idealerweise GCP) mit. Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure ist ein Plus. KI-Expertise: Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis dafür, wie man LLMs über APIs effizient nutzt und durch kluges Engineering (z.B. RAG, Caching, Skills) in produktive Anwendungen überführt. Mindset: Du bist neugierig, technologieoffen und hast eine Leidenschaft für exploratives Arbeiten. Du liebst es, Dinge zu entwickeln, die vor Dir noch niemand entwickelt hat. Teamgeist: Du schätzt eine offene Feedbackkultur und arbeitest gerne auf Augenhöhe mit Kollegen zusammen, die technologische Exzellenz und menschliche Lockerheit verbinden. Arbeitsweise: Ein eng definiertes Skillset gibt es bei uns nicht – wir setzen auf Dein Potenzial, Deine Wissbegierde und Deinen Drive. Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1, C2 oder Muttersprache); Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

items.desc: New Producers for Sustainable Energy (NP4SE) is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to prepare the data for, and test the accuracy of, two AI tools funded by Energy Corps. The role is part-time: about 65 days over 12 months, at a day rate of USD 300–400, depending on experience. You can be based outside the UK - in fact we welcome candidates based in the Global South. Background NP4SE is a charity that supports governments in 25 emerging oil and gas producing countries. With Energy Corps funding, we are building two tools to help small government teams oversee their resources with better information. The AI Advisory Desk draws on 14 years of NP4SE peer exchanges and expert analysis. It is retrieval-based: it answers from a closed, expert-weighted set of documents and does not train a model on them. Answers on high-risk topics go to a human expert before they reach the user. The emissions dashboard helps a national regulator check methane and greenhouse gas data reported by operators. It is cloud-hosted and, once tested, run by the government agency. The Machine Learning Engineer is responsible for the quality of the data going into both tools and for measuring whether their outputs are accurate. Scope of workAI Advisory Desk (about 20 days) • Clean and structure the foundation archive of about 500 documents, including text extraction from scanned files, and tag each with consistent metadata (maturity stage, resource type, discovery phase). • Run the transcription pipeline for practitioner exchanges recorded as audio or video, and check the transcripts before they enter the document set. • Apply the expert-weighting scheme so that senior practitioner material takes precedence in retrieval. • Design and run the accuracy tests: build a set of test questions from historical regulatory scenarios, record results, and review hallucination logs, reporting findings to the Lead Subject Matter Expert. • Agree written accuracy criteria with the Lead Subject Matter Expert for the escalation protocol. • Support the pilot with five partner countries, including logging errors and feedback. Emissions dashboard (about 45 days) • Build and maintain the uniform data coding maps so that operator submissions follow one reporting structure. • Process unstructured field logs and paper records into that structure, with the Technical Data Intern. • Review operator submissions for anomalies and flag them to the regulator's team. • Compare reported emissions against satellite and other open data sources, and agree the data interfaces with the AI Architect without taking part in the build. • Document the data pipeline so that the agency's staff can run it after handover. Across both tools • Keep data handling consistent with NP4SE's confidentiality commitments: no data from one country is visible to another, and no document leaves the closed environment. • Test the tools independently of the people who build them, and report results plainly, including failures, to the Lead Subject Matter Expert. The MLE does not do the strategic impact tracking. That belongs to the MEL Officer, so that performance reporting stays independent of the people building the tools. Profile We are looking for someone who has built and tested retrieval-based AI systems in a practical setting, ideally for a development organisation, a multilateral body or a government. Essential: • Several years of hands-on machine learning or data engineering experience, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems and ways of testing their accuracy. • Experience cleaning messy, mixed-format data: scanned documents, spreadsheets, transcripts. • Python, and comfort with open-source tools such as Dify and Whisper. • Careful about data protection. Has worked with confidential or government data and understands why it must stay in a closed environment. • Able to explain results, including errors, in plain language to non-technical colleagues. • Fluent in English. Able to work remotely with a small team across time zones. Useful: • Familiarity with oil, gas, energy or climate data, including emissions reporting. • Experience working with ministries or regulators in emerging economies. • French or Portuguese, since the dashboard is meant to be replicated in French- and Portuguese-speaking countries. Terms • Time and fee: about 65 days between appointment and September 2027 (about 20 for the Advisory Desk and 45 for the dashboard), at a day rate of USD 300-400 depending on experience. Days are called off by email against deliverables. • Location: remote, with occasional travel only if agreed in advance. • Supervision: the Lead Subject Matter Expert directs and reviews the work. The Executive Director manages the contract. • Engagement: consultancy agreement with NP4SE, including confidentiality terms. • Ownership of work: NP4SE will publish its methodology so that others can replicate it. The agreement will say what that means for code and data. How to apply Send a CV, …

items.desc:
Kitchener (ON), Canada 
 Product Cybersecurity Expert
 Research & Development | Hybrid 
 Help secure the future of connected hearing care. As our Product Cybersecurity Expert in R&D, you will help protect the products and digital experiences that improve hearing health and human connection worldwide. 
 In this role, you will combine product cybersecurity expertise with technical leadership responsibilities, supporting secure design, threat modeling, vulnerability management, DevSecOps integration, and regulatory evidence for connected medical devices while collaborating across global R&D, quality, regulatory, and product teams. 
 WHAT YOU’LL DO 
 Embed cybersecurity across the secure product lifecycle for connected medical devices, embedded platforms, firmware, mobile apps, and cloud-based services 
 Lead threat modeling, product cybersecurity risk assessments, and mitigation planning with global R&D teams 
 Integrate security checks and tooling into development workflows and CI/CD pipelines to find and address issues early 
 Drive product vulnerability management for Sonova products, including intake, triage, remediation tracking, and post-market monitoring. 
 Prepare audit-ready cybersecurity evidence for regulatory submissions and quality processes, including FDA, MDR, and IEC 81001-5-1 expectations 
 Plan and coordinate security testing with internal teams and external partners; analyze findings and drive remediation 
 Advise product, engineering, quality, and regulatory stakeholders on practical, risk-based security decisions 
 Strengthen cybersecurity capability through coaching, security champions, and cross-functional collaboration 
 WHAT YOU BRING 
 5+ years of experience in software engineering, system/software architecture, product development, project management, or DevSecOps, including 3+ years in cybersecurity 
 Strong practical knowledge of secure SDLC, threat modeling, security assessments, security testing, and vulnerability management 
 Experience translating security risks and technical findings into clear decisions for engineering, product, quality, and leadership audiences 
 Understanding of modern development workflows, CI/CD, and how to integrate security without slowing innovation 
 Knowledge of cryptography, authentication protocols, cloud and software supply chain security 
 Basic understanding of AI technology and associated threats; hands-on experience using AI technology 
 Higher-level engineering degree or equivalent experience, with further education or specialization in cybersecurity 
 Excellent English communication skills and the ability to influence across distributed, cross-functional teams 
 NICE TO HAVE 
 Experience in medical devices, healthcare, or another regulated product environment 
 Security certifications such as ISC2/CISSP, GIAC, or equivalent accredited programs 
 Working knowledge of Privacy by Design principles 
 A minimum of 200Mb/sec download and 10Mb/sec upload speed internet connectivity is required to support any remote/hybrid employee functionality at Sonova 
 Don't meet all the criteria? If you’re willing to go all in and learn we'd love to hear from you! 
 We are looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform. For this position only direct applications will be considered. Sonova does not recruit via app, telegram, carrier pigeon or any other format that does not include speaking with an actual human. If you are offered a job without speaking with someone please contact mailto:wholesale.HR@sonova.com 
 This role's pay range is between: $112,000 - $140,000. This role is also bonus eligible. 
 How we work: 
 At Sonova, we prioritize the well-being of our employees and foster an inclusive environment that promotes engagement and collaboration. Our team-customized hybrid work model empowers teams to balance individual needs with business goals, offering flexibility and individualized time management. We recognize the importance of life outside of work and strive to create a supportive and motivating workplace where innovation thrives.

Make an Impact with Healthcare Technology Jobs That Matter 
 Are you ready to build a career in healthcare technology that truly makes a difference? At Swisslog Healthcare, we’re looking for passionate individuals to join us in shaping the future of care. Whether you’re exploring healthcare engineering jobs, pharmacy automation roles, healthcare IT careers, or healthcare logistics opportunities, you’ll be part of a team that’s driving innovation in medication management and hospital workflows around the world.  Contribute to the definition of system architecture and software design

 Good knowledge of electromechanical components and systems

 Good knowledge of English language

 Overview 
 Entrerai nella Rete Imprese della Divisione Banca dei Territori, dove supporterai le aziende del territorio nella crescita del loro business. Offrirai consulenza ad alto valore aggiunto grazie a soluzioni innovative e a un percorso di formazione continua, pensato per sviluppare competenze distintive e costruire relazioni solide con la clientela imprese. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Gestione del portafoglio e sviluppo del patrimonio aziendale e personale 
 Incontri periodici di sviluppo della clientela 
 Analisi del merito creditizio e lettura bilancio 
 Cross selling di prodotti e servizi 
 Pianificazione assicurativa e protezione 
 Gestione del ciclo incassi e pagamenti 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 esperienza di almeno 5 anni nel settore del credito con una buona conoscenza del tessuto imprenditoriale e commerciale del territorio di riferimento 
 laurea Triennale o Magistrale in ambito economico aziendale o economico finanziario 
 conoscenza dell'analisi di bilancio e della contabilità generale e analitica 
 buona conoscenza della lingua inglese 
 apprezzata esperienza in ambito agribusiness o terzo settore (no profit) 
 Cosa ti offriamo 
 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 45.000€ 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo 
 Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale del Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello 
 Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone 
 Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli 
 Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile 
 Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link ) 
 Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione 
 Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 La Divisione Banca dei Territori è focalizzata sul mercato e sulla centralità del territorio per il rafforzamento delle relazioni con le persone, le piccole e medie imprese e gli enti non profit. Dedicata ai segmenti di clientela retail, exclusive e imprese offre un’ampia gamma di prodotti e servizi, distribuiti sia attraverso la rete fisica sia attraverso i canali digitali. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03. 
 Per la valutazione delle candidature, i dati saranno utilizzati da Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. come Data Controller. Ti invitiamo a prendere visione dell’ Informativa Privacy dedicata.

Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Wavestone recherche actuellement des profils : Dans un monde où savoir se transformer est la clé du succès, l'ambition de Wavestone est d'apporter à ses clients des réponses uniques sur le marché, en les éclairant et les guidant dans leurs décisions les plus stratégiques. Wavestone est un nouveau cabinet de conseil, issu du rapprochement début 2016 de Solucom et des activités européennes de Kurt Salmon (à l'exclusion de consumer goods & retail en dehors de France). Notre cabinet rassemble 2800 collaborateurs présents sur 4 continents, figure parmi les leaders indépendants du conseil en Europe, et constitue le 1er cabinet de conseil indépendant en France. Pour satisfaire nos clients, nous développons 18 terrains d’excellence, à la fois sectoriels, fonctionnels, et technologiques. Sur chacun d’eux, nous nous engageons à apporter à nos clients une profondeur d’expertise de premier plan. Mais surtout, et c’est là le cœur de notre proposition de valeur, nous combinons ces 18 terrains d’excellence sans couture et sans silos. Enfin, pour enrichir notre offre, nous investissons dans 5 assets à forte valeur ajoutée : le Research Knowledge Center, parce que pour prendre de bonnes décisions il faut de bonnes informations, le Creadesk, qui permet de stimuler la créativité et l’innovation, la Faktory, pour prototyper des idées en mode « test and learn », le Machine Learning et Data Lab, pour exploiter les gisements de valeur qui se cachent dans les données de nos clients et Shake Up', pour accompagner des start-ups dans leur croissance et leur développement. Nous recrutons des talents aux parcours diversifiés, de tous niveaux d'expérience. Des personnalités engagées, reconnues pour leur goût d'entreprendre et leur esprit d'équipe. items.desc: ️About Volter AI and renewables are the 21st Centuries two largest megatrends and they're colliding in the world's largest industry: energy. AI has made intelligence abundant, so human brains are no longer the bottle neck, cheap and secure power is. The people, businesses and countries that have access to cheap, clean and secure power will lead this century. Renewables can deliver it, but they’ve turned a previously static predictable commodity into a huge complex changing forecasting and optimisation problem that the industry’s decades-old systems were never built to solve. Volter exists to solve it. We’re building the first AI native operating system for business energy, so that every business can run on power that’s cheaper, cleaner and more secure. Octopus and Kraken did this for homes; we’re doing it for business. And it’s working. We launched our platform in early 2026 and have already 20x revenue with customers from all across the UK now using the Volter platform. We’re still a small team, so you’ll shape the product, the tech and the culture from the ground up. Where you plug in Our platform runs on data: half-hourly meter reads, market prices, forecasts, trades and tariffs all feed the products that price, match, and bill our customers' energy. We’re hiring a Senior Engineer with a data-oriented bent to own and scale our data foundations, while building the product on top of them. In your first year, success looks like data pipelines the business trusts, faster and more reliable pricing and billing, and a product that you've shipped end-to-end that customers and our ops team use every day. ️ What you'll power Build and own the pipelines that bring data into Volter: half-hourly meter feeds, market and price data, network tariffs, weather data, and other third-party sources. Own our data foundations: schema design, data modelling (lots of time-series), query performance and data quality, so our customers and partners can rely on it. Ship product features end to end, from data/backend services and APIs through to the customer-facing flows on top of them. Shape what we build with commercial, ops and data science: understand the real problem, scope a v1, then measure it and decide what comes next. Challenge how we do things: bring your experience to architecture decisions, name the trade-offs and push back when there's a better way. Partner with our data scientists to improve forecasting and pricing models. Run what you build in production, with logging, monitoring, and alerting that keep it reliable. Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, testing, and helping other engineers grow. What you'll bring Several years as a broad-based software engineer, with a track record of owning complex features and systems end-to-end in production. Hands-on data engineering: you've built and run ETL pipelines and worked deeply with databases in data-intensive systems, ideally including time-series data. Strong data fundamentals: knowledge about database technology choices (OLTP, OLAP), schema design, data modelling, query optimisation and data quality. Product instincts as well as pipelines: you enjoy shipping user-facing features and solving user problems as much as building data pipelines. Proficiency across the stack: backend in Go and/or Python, frontend in TypeScript and React, plus cloud deployment (we use AWS), and infrastructure-as-code (we use Terraform). Fluency in AI-driven engineering: you see its value and use it day-to-day, with established processes for high and consistent standards Confidence to challenge the status quo, make sound calls in ambiguity and advise the team as a peer. Nice-to-haves Experience in energy, utilities or another data-heavy, regulated market such as fintech. Building at an early-stage startup, balancing speed with technical debt. Previous experience working with data scientists on forecasting or modelling. Event-driven architectures and security-aware development (least privilege, auditability, PII handling). Your kind of energy How we bring the Volter values to life in this role: Integrity, trust and transparency: When the data looks wrong, or a project is slipping, you say so early, with options and a recommendation. When you disagree, you push back with evidence, then commit. Growth, ambition and excellence: You hold a high bar for quality, learn new domains fast by building, and leave our systems better than you found them. Getting sht done: You ship in days, not weeks. You pick the pragmatic option that gets useful things to customers, then measure whether it worked. Electric enthusiasm: You're always learning, whether that's a new corner of the energy market or a better way to build, and you bring the team with you. Build NLP pipelines to extract complex signals (e.g. transaction patterns, legal clauses) from unstructured text and convert them into usable features. Write clean, modular Python code in Azure DevOps ensuring models are testable, reproducible, and ready for deployment. Align with model suites across different risk domains to understand and create added value in AI-powered lifecycle management. How To Succeed We hire smart people like you for your potential. items.desc: Wir sind ein spezialisiertes AI-Engineering- und FullStack-Team und bauen produktive LLM-/Agenten-Systeme für unsere Kunden — kein PoC-Theater, keine Powerpoint-Decks, keine „Slide-Architekten". Wir beraten partnerschaftlich auf Augenhöhe und liefern Software, die in Produktion läuft. Du kannst hier Probleme lösen, ohne dass dich dabei Titel oder feste Rollendefinitionen einschränken — die gibt es bei uns nicht. Unsere Jobs sind nicht starr, sie dienen dir nur zur Orientierung. Du wirst nicht auf (d)einen Job begrenzt, sondern entwickelst dich quer durch AI Engineering, Backend, Platform und Consulting weiter. Du stehst mit deinen individuellen Zielen, Vorstellungen und Stärken im Vordergrund. Du gestaltest deine Karriere bei Arcode proaktiv mit. Wichtig: Da wir eng mit unseren Kunden im DACH-Raum (Finanz, Versicherung, Public Sector, Industrie) zusammenarbeiten, sind exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (idealerweise muttersprachlich, mindestens C1) zwingend erforderlich — verhandlungssicheres Englisch setzen wir voraus. Aufgaben Aufgaben Was dich erwartet Als AI Engineer (w/d/m) schreibst du nicht nur Notebooks und Prompts, du baust produktive GenAI-Systeme: Agenten, RAG-Pipelines, LLM-getriebene Workflows — end-to-end vom Use-Case-Workshop bis zum Production-Deployment. Du arbeitest in crossfunktionalen, agilen Teams an Kundenprojekten und kommst dabei mit dem gesamten modernen GenAI-Stack in Berührung: pydantic-ai, LangChain/LangGraph, MCP (Model Context Protocol), OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock. Zusammen mit deinem Team berätst du unsere Kunden bei Use-Case-Identifikation, Architektur-Entscheidungen (RAG vs. Fine-Tuning, Agent-Design, Tool-Use, Memory), Aufwandsschätzungen und der Auswahl geeigneter Vorgehensmodelle — du bist am gesamten AI-Lebenszyklus beteiligt. Du analysierst Kundenanforderungen, entwirfst und implementierst agentenbasierte Lösungen, RAG-Pipelines über Unternehmensdaten, strukturierte LLM-Outputs (pydantic-Schemas, Tool-Use) und sorgst auch für gute Dokumentation. Du behältst stets die Qualität auf dem Schirm — und das heißt bei AI: systematische Evals, Regression-Tests gegen Goldsets, Hallucination-Monitoring, Cost-per-Inference-Tracking, Prompt-Versionierung, Observability für Agent-Traces (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Phoenix). Du nutzt moderne, automatisierte Ansätze und AI-native Entwickler-Workflows (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) zur Optimierung von Code, Fehlererkennung und für innovative Lösungen — wir leben "AI-native", nicht nur AI-für-Kunden. Du integrierst deine LLM-/Agent-Komponenten sauber in bestehende Backend- und Frontend-Architekturen (Python/FastAPI, Node.js/TypeScript, Java, React/Angular) und sorgst für saubere Übergaben an die Plattform-Seite (Kubernetes, ArgoCD, MongoDB/pgvector, AWS/Azure). Qualifikation Qualifikation Das solltest du mitbringen Dank deiner entsprechenden Berufserfahrung verfolgst du den AI-Engineering-Ansatz hands-on — du redest nicht nur über LLMs, du baust mit ihnen. Gute bis muttersprachliche Deutschkenntnisse sind ZWINGEND erforderlich, da wir eng mit Kunden im DACH-Raum zusammenarbeiten. Du arbeitest gerne agil, verstehst aber auch, dass nicht alle Kunden Agilität (und schon gar nicht GenAI-Engineering) bereits kennen und schätzen wie wir. Du hast einen M.Sc. (oder vergleichbaren Abschluss) in Artificial Intelligence, Informatik, Data Science, Statistik, Mathematik, Physik oder einer verwandten Natur- oder Ingenieurwissenschaft. Ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit fundierten Grundlagen in Statistik, Machine Learning und Software Engineering ist für diese Stelle zwingend erforderlich. Wichtig — bitte vor der Bewerbung lesen: Das ist keine „Vibe-Coding"-Stelle. Wer seit ein paar Monaten mit AI-Assistenten Code generiert, aber die Grundlagen dahinter (Statistik, ML-Theorie, Datenstrukturen, Software-Architektur) nicht beherrscht, ist hier falsch. Wir nutzen AI-native Tooling täglich — aber als Verstärker für fundiertes Können, nicht als Ersatz dafür. Bewerbungen ohne einschlägigen Abschluss und ohne nachweisbare, mehrjährige Data-Science-/ML-Praxis können wir nicht berücksichtigen. Du bist Team-Player, schätzt offene Kommunikation, lernst gerne von anderen und teilst dein Wissen — gerade im LLM-Bereich, wo sich die Tooling-Landschaft alle drei Monate neu ordnet. Du willst an spannenden Kundenprojekten arbeiten und hast gute Kenntnisse in einigen dieser Technologien: AI / GenAI: Python, pydantic, pydantic-ai, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI APIs, Anthropic Claude, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, Embeddings & Vector DBs (pgvector, MongoDB Atlas, Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant), RAG-Patterns, Prompt Engineering, Agent-Evals (Langfuse, Phoenix, ragas) Backend / FullStack: Python (FastAPI), Java/Spring oder Quarkus, Node.js/TypeScript (Express, NestJS), React, Angular, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, REST/GraphQL Platform / DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, GitLab CI / GitHub Actions, AWS, …

Al menos 3 años desarrollando aplicaciones web full stack que hayan llegado a producción. Back end en Python (FastAPI, Django o similar) y/o Node.js con TypeScript, y front end en React u otro framework moderno con TypeScript. PostgreSQL o similar, SQL y diseño de APIs REST con autenticación OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect. Git, Docker, CI/CD y experiencia desplegando en Azure, AWS o GCP. Experiencia práctica integrando APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic o similares) en una aplicación. Flexibilidad horaria y trabajo híbrido. Plan de retribución flexible con Cobee. Formar parte de un equipo dinámico, multidisciplinar y con un clima basado en la confianza, la autonomía responsable y la colaboración. Participar en proyectos estratégicos para clientes referentes a nivel nacional e internacional. En RocaSalvatella apostamos firmemente por la diversidad, la inclusión y la igualdad de oportunidades, creando un entorno donde todas las personas puedan desarrollarse y aportar su mejor versión.

You will be responsible for building high-performance, Clean Core compliant extensions using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and crafting intuitive front-end experiences with UI5, Angular. Continuous Learning: Stay ahead of the curve by testing and adopting new AI dev-tools that improve the team’s workflow. You understand the Fiori Design Guidelines and can build responsive, enterprise-ready frontends that users actually enjoy. Git & CI/CD: You know the difference between a rebase and a merge, and you’re comfortable managing code versioning within SAP Continuous Integration and Delivery or Azure DevOps. BTP & Containers: You can navigate the SAP BTP Cockpit, deploy MTAs (Multi-Target Applications), and understand why "Cloud Foundry" and "Kyma" (Kubernetes) are the backbone of modern SAP extensibility. Familiarity with Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). A "testing" mindset—experience with JUnit, or Jasmine/Karma or equivalent Who You Are Pragmatic: You know when to write code from scratch and when to let an AI assistant do the heavy lifting. Curious: You don't wait for a training manual; you're already experimenting with the latest LLM models and plugins. Quality-Focused: You understand that as AI generates more code, the human's role as a "Code Reviewer" becomes even more vital. items.desc: I am recruiting for a SerDes Architecture and Modelling Engineer to join my client’s team in Lausanne, Switzerland. As a SerDes Architecture And Modelling Engineer, You Will Research and develop new concepts for high-speed serial communication systems Build system level models to investigate, compare and optimise new architectures Develop signal processing algorithms and evaluate their impact on link performance Use MATLAB, Python or C++ to model communication systems and test new ideas Work with architects and IC designers to translate research concepts into practical transceiver architectures Analyse system limitations including signal integrity, noise, power and clock recovery Define link budgets and block-level specifications based on system requirements Support analog, digital and verification teams throughout the development process My client is looking for an engineer with a strong research background in signal processing, communications, control theory or mathematical modelling. Relevant Experience Could Include Research and development of new communication or signal processing techniques Strong understanding of digital algorithms and control theory Experience developing and implementing signal processing algorithms System-level modelling of digital communication systems Strong programming skills in MATLAB, Python or C++ Understanding of SerDes, clock recovery or other high-speed communication systems Knowledge of signal integrity and analog circuit behaviour Experience with SPICE or Spectre would be useful The role is aimed at someone with 5+ years of experience in semiconductor, telecommunications, communications research or scientific software development. A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Communications, Computer Science or a related field is expected. The SerDes Architecture and Modelling Engineer position would suit someone who enjoys working in an R&D environment, challenging existing approaches and turning research ideas into new system architectures. The role requires a minimum of 3 days on site in Lausanne. Get in touch with Parm Shergill for more information.

items.desc: At IQM, we build world-leading quantum computers for the well-being of humankind. We design systems to tackle computational challenges beyond the practical limits of classical machines. Our work sits at the edge of science and engineering. It's complex, demanding, and deeply collaborative. We turn deep research into reliable, full-stack systems that drive discoveries in fields like medicine, energy, and technology, reshaping how the world computes. Join the team that gives quantum a heartbeat. The work We are looking for a Quantum Engineer (Junior to Senior level) with an experimental background to join our Calibration and Benchmarking team, focusing on improving the performance of superconducting Quantum Processing Units (QPUs). In this role, you will work hands-on with quantum hardware to develop, optimize, and execute calibration and benchmarking protocols. items.desc: QUELLE SERA VOTRE CONTRIBUTION ? Intégrer et piloter des capteurs complexes via des interfaces comme SPI, I2C, BLE, NFC et des techniques de bitbang. Mettre en œuvre des pratiques de développement rigoureuses, incluant l'utilisation de GIT pour le contrôle de versions, le débogage embarqué et le JTAG. Assurer une veille technologique active sur les dernières avancées en systèmes embarqués, microélectronique et gestion de l'énergie. QUELLES SONT LES CLÉS DE VOTRE RÉUSSITE ? Ingénieur.e en électronique, systèmes embarqués, microtechnique ou équivalent. items.desc: Il Gruppo Almaviva leader italiano nell’Information & Communication Technology, accompagna i processi di crescita del Paese raccogliendo la sfida che le realtà enterprise devono affrontare per rimanere competitive nell’era del digitale.Da solide competenze Made in Italy, unite alla capacità di integrare culture, intelligenze ed esperienze diverse, è nato un network globale. Entrerai a far parte di Almaviva Bluebit , la società del Gruppo Almaviva creata per accompagnare la trasformazione digitale nel settore della gestione delle risorse idriche. Posizione: Ti unirai al nostro team come Ingegnere R&D (Firmware) e avrai l’opportunità di lavorare su progetti strategici e di produrre un impatto reale sui risultati che raggiungeremo insieme, in particolare ti occuperai delle seguenti attività: Progettare, sviluppare e manutenere software embedded per dispositivi elettronici destinati al monitoraggio e alla gestione di risorse idriche, ambientali e agricole; Realizzare sistemi intelligenti (sensori, datalogger, centraline IoT) garantendo affidabilità, efficienza energetica e robustezza anche in condizioni operative difficili (outdoor, ambienti ostili); Sviluppare firmware per sistemi embedded basati su microcontrollori della famiglia STM32 con sistema operativo ThreadX; Implementare driver per sensori; Gestire protocolli di comunicazione (es. I2C, SPI, UART, RS485); Integrare connettività IoT (es. LTE-M, LoRaWAN, wM-BUS); Ottimizzare consumi energetici per dispositivi alimentati a batteria o energia solare; Collaborare con team hardware per debugging e bring-up delle schede elettroniche; Sviluppare sistemi di acquisizione dati e logiche di controllo; Eseguire test, validazione e debugging firmware; Documentare codice e architetture software; Supportare le fasi di industrializzazione e manutenzione prodotto. Requisiti: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica, Informatica, Automazione o affini Esperienza di 3–7 anni nello sviluppo firmware embedded Ottima conoscenza di C/C++ per sistemi embedded Esperienza con microcontrollori e ambienti di sviluppo (es. STM32CubeIDE, IAR) Conoscenza di componenti software per l’integrazione di funzionalità avanzate (es. FileX, LevelX, Mbed-TLS, lwIp, …) Familiarità con strumenti di debug (es. J-Link, ST-Link) Conoscenza dei principali protocolli di comunicazione Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese Problem solving tecnico e debugging Attenzione all’affidabilità e alla robustezza del codice Capacità di lavorare in team multidisciplinari (hardware/software/cloud) Approccio pratico e orientato al prodotto Autonomia e capacità organizzativa Altre informazioni: Sede di lavoro: Rubano (PD), con possibilità di lavoro in modalità ibrida Orario di lavoro: full time, dal lunedì al venerdì Contratto: tempo indeterminato, CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria Profilo: Ingegnere R&D (firmware) equiparato a Progettista di sistemi complessi Inquadramento: livello B3 Retribuzione: RAL compresa tra €36.906,87 e €45.000, commisurata all'esperienza e alle competenze maturate Benefit aziendali: cellulare e pc portatile, buono pasto per ogni giornata lavorata Perché scegliere il Gruppo Almaviva? In AlmavivA troverai un modello organizzativo in cui la persona e le sue competenze sono al centro. Ci contraddistingue un ambiente di lavoro fondato su fiducia, collaborazione, autonomia e responsabilità, orientato all'efficienza e al raggiungimento dei risultati. Il nostro impegno verso le persone si traduce nella promozione di un contesto inclusivo e attento alle pari opportunità, supportato dalla conformità agli standard ISO 30415 per la Diversity & Inclusion, UNI/PdR 125 per la parità di genere e SA8000 per la responsabilità sociale. La tua opportunità è ora! Se l’innovazione è la tua passione, se esplorare il mondo dell’Information e Communication Technologies è un tuo desiderio, se la tua aspirazione è lavorare in un team con forte volontà di condivisione e focalizzato su obiettivi sempre più sfidanti, incontriamoci ora! Ai sensi della normativa vigente, la presente offerta di lavoro è rivolta a tutte le persone candidate, senza distinzione di genere, in conformità alla normativa applicabile. Le persone interessate possono inviare il proprio CV aggiornato e dettagliato, corredato dell'autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali ai sensi del D.Lgs. 196/2003 e dell'art. 13 del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679 (GDPR).

items.desc: Chanel est une entreprise indépendante qui croit en la liberté de la création, cultive le potentiel humain et s’engage activement pour avoir un impact positif dans le monde. L'activité Parfums Beauté affirme sa singularité à travers une promesse : celle de révéler la beauté de chaque femme dans ce qu'elle a de plus singulier à travers son Parfum, son Maquillage et ses produits de Soin. La Recherche, l’Innovation et la recherche de Chanel Parfums Beauté est au service de la Création et du développement. Au sein de 5 centres de recherche regroupant plus de 300 scientifiques, chaque métier dédie son temps à la connaissance des femmes et de leur peau et à la recherche de performance pour créer les produits Chanel de demain. VOTRE IMPACT CHEZ CHANEL Rattaché au responsable du Laboratoire Développement Lèvres au sein de notre centre de Recherche et Développement, vous concevez, développez et participer à l’industrialisation des formules et concepts innovants de Rouges à Lèvres en réponse aux briefs Marketing et Studio. Vous êtes garant·e de la performance produit, de la robustesse formule et du respect des exigences de qualité, coûts, délais et écoresponsabilité. A ce titre, vos missions consisteront à : Développer et optimiser des formules rouges à lèvres (textures, performances, robustesse, teintes) et réaliser les contrôles, analyses et demandes de tests associés ; Suivre l'industrialisation des formules en identifiant les risques process. Réaliser les essais complémentaires et valider le mode opératoire en collaboration avec les équipes pilote ; Réaliser des études sur des problématiques identifiées en développement, plans d'essais, reporting et présentation des résultats ; Assurer la veille technologique et matières premières spécifiques lèvres Être référent·e formulation dans les projets transverses Lèvres et accompagner les équipes techniquement Participer à la vie du laboratoire (qualité/sécurité/hygiène/logistique/matériel). Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec les experts des différents départements pour assurer ces missions. CE QUE VOUS APPORTEREZ Formation minimum : Bac +3 (chimie, formulation, cosmétique ou équivalent) Expérience impérative : 6 à 10 ans en formulation rouges à lèvres Expertise approfondie des textures lèvres (sticks, liquides, mates, brillants, longue tenue…) Forte maîtrise des pigments, cires, huiles, charges et contraintes industrielles Leadership technique, autonomie, esprit d’analyse et de décision Capacité à intervenir comme référent·e et expert·e métier CE QUI VOUS ENTHOUSIASME ET CE QUE CHANEL PEUT VOUS OFFRIR Tout au long de votre expérience, vous serez immergé(e) dans un environnement dynamique, innovant et apprenant ; où la création et l’humain sont au cœur des préoccupations. Vous rejoignez une activité singulière, aux méthodes et procédés uniques – qu’ils soient créatifs, de développement ou d’industrialisation – et évoluez aux côtés d’une diversité d’experts aux savoir-faire reconnus. Chez CHANEL, nous nous attachons à promouvoir une culture inclusive qui favorise l’épanouissement personnel et contribue au progrès collectif. Nous sommes convaincus que le caractère unique de chaque individu contribue à la diversité, la complémentarité et l’efficacité de nos équipes. Nous encourageons vivement votre candidature, car nous apprécions la perspective, l’expérience et le potentiel que vous pourriez apporter à CHANEL. LIEU : Pantin Date : Septembre 2026 DUREE : CDI

items.desc: Shape the future of software with Witted At Witted, we match top-tier software and tech talent with the most ambitious projects in the market. Whether you thrive as an employee in a close-knit tech community or prefer the freedom of running your own business as a freelancer, we’ve got you covered. We are now looking for experienced experts in AI Platform Engineering to join us. You can apply for an employment position at Witted Mavericks, or join our freelance network through Witted Partners — either way, you’ll get access to high-impact client projects, competitive terms, and a community of top-level peers. Looking for AI Platform Engineers Are token costs spiraling out of control, or does AI infrastructure lack clear ownership? These are the questions that our clients are needing help with. For this reason, we are seeking AI Platform Engineers to build and operate platforms that enable developer teams to leverage AI efficiently, securely, and cost-effectively. In this role, you will: Build and operate AI infrastructure and model gateway solutions. Optimize model selection, run environments, and token expenses (FinOps for AI, cost forecasting). Ensure AI platform performance, security, and scalability (SRE, Observability). What we expect from you: Around +7 years of relevant work experience, and solid consulting background in working with large Nordic organizations. Experience of AI operations in large scale, preferrably commercial settings. Familiarity with the following tools and concepts: Cloud & Infrastructure (Kubernetes, Containers, Terraform / Pulumi, HashiCorp Vault), AI/LLM Platforms & Gateways (LiteLLM, Portkey, Azure AI Studio, AWS Bedrock, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Ray / vLLM, MLflow), and Observability & SRE (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog). Ideally opportunity to visit client's premises in Helsinki or Oslo area on a weekly basis. Ideally fluent Finnish or Norwegian skills, on top of English. Why Witted? (Employment vs. Freelance): As an employee through Witted Mavericks: competitive compensation, comprehensive employee benefits, a supportive community, and the flexibility to switch projects internally. As a freelancer through Witted Partners: access to top AI projects in both Finland and Norway, full independence, and the backing of Witted’s extensive sales network without administrative hassle. The application process: Drop us an application - we will review it, and if everything looks good, we’ll invite you for a chat. First chat: let’s get to know each other. Second chat: a deeper dive into your technical domain. Project matching: we will invite you to our talent pool, and start looking for a suitable project for you. As soon as a client project aligns, we will introduce you to the client, and then support you through the client interview process. Welcome aboard: once we land a project for you, we will either sign an employment contract (Witted Mavericks) or a freelance agreement (Witted Partners) together. This is where our journey begins - join us!

items.desc: Lieu : Valence, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée Un package de rémunération attractif Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu Votre quotidien En nous rejoignant à Valence, vous intégrez le centre de gravité mondial de nos activités avioniques hélicoptères. Il abrite également nos activités de services numériques. Nous recherchons un Architecte Capteurs MEMS (F/H) en CDI, à Valence. Ce poste vient renforcer l’équipe de développement de capteurs MEMS inertiel et pression en forte croissance dans le domaine de l’aéronautique civil et militaire. A ce titre, vous intègrerez l’équipe projet MEMS développant une nouvelle gamme de capteurs inertielles (accéléromètre et gyromètre) de classe navigation grade et donc les plus performants sur le marché. A cela s’ajoute une roadmap R&T de capteur de pression visant à établir une nouvelle gamme de capteur de taille réduite et plus compétitif. Vous serez responsable de l’architecture de capteur MEMS (spécification, l’étude du concept prenant en compte les principes physiques de mise en œuvre, les asservissements, le modèle capteur et identification des erreurs, le développement de la solution incluant les contraintes d’industrialisation et enfin sa vérification). Vous serez appuyé par une équipe d’ingénieurs spécialisés en électronique analogique et numérique, mécanique et micromécanique (MEMS) ainsi que simulation thermique et mécanique. Vous devrez ainsi les coordonner fonctionnellement. Vous interviendrez dans toutes les phases du cycle de vie du capteur ; R&T, développement et industrialisation et support en production ou fin de vie. items.desc: Since 1965, Stoneridge has designed and manufactured advanced, award-winning technologies including driveline and transmission actuation systems, vision systems, emissions control systems, safety systems, and security and monitoring systems for vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle, automotive, off-highway and agricultural vehicle markets. items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As an Embedded Software Engineer (Multimedia) at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to expand our Linux Board Support Package (BSP) capabilities. You will be the technical lead for CMOS and IR sensor integration, managing the entire video pipeline bring-up. This is a high-impact role that blends sophisticated "desk work" in Linux environments with hands-on "lab work" to validate next-generation hardware prototypes. Responsibilities Board Support Package (BSP): Expand and maintain Linux BSP capabilities with a specific focus on video pipeline architecture. Sensor Integration: Integrate and configure CMOS and IR camera sensors via MIPI/CSI interfaces. Driver Development: Configure and debug existing drivers within the Linux kernel and chip manufacturer ecosystems (NXP, NVIDIA, Qualcomm). Hardware Validation: Participate in hardware design reviews and validate new designs through schematic review and physical debugging. Reverse Engineering: Perform deep-system reverse engineering when documentation is incomplete to ensure robust system integration. Framework Management: Utilize V4L2 and GStreamer frameworks to achieve glitch-free, continuous video streams for downstream processing. Cross-Functional Support: Collaborate with Optical engineers for ISP tuning, Hardware teams for design reviews, and Computer Vision engineers to ensure acquisition meets algorithmic needs. Candidate Requirements Experience: 5–10 years of senior-level experience in embedded systems, specifically focused on camera video acquisition for Linux. Hardware Proficiency: Proven ability to work with chipsets from manufacturers such as NVIDIA, NXP, or Qualcomm. Debugging Expertise: Advanced skills using laboratory tools, including oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, to investigate memory corruption or performance latency. Framework Knowledge: Practical experience with Video4Linux2 (V4L2) and GStreamer for video pipeline management. Technical Rigor: A methodical investigator who is comfortable performing deep-system debugging and reverse engineering. System Design: Experience connecting and synchronizing multiple camera modules on a single chip. Mindset: Highly collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to translate complex hardware constraints into software requirements for multidisciplinary teams. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission and readiness to solve the most difficult integration challenges in the drone industry. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Au sein du Airbus Helicopters Drone Center, né de la fusion entre Survey Copter et Airbus Helicopters, nous concevons, fabriquons et assurons le maintien en conditions opérationnelles de systèmes de drones tactiques légers, destinés à des missions militaires et civiles. Filiale à 100% du groupe Airbus depuis 2011, elle est le centre d’expertise drones d’Airbus Helicopters, implantée à Pierrelatte (sa maison mère) et à Aix les Milles. Nous rejoindre, c’est intégrer des sites à taille humaine et des équipes passionnées, tout en profitant d’un cadre de vie privilégié dans la Drome ou les Bouches du Rhône, territoires dynamiques et ensoleillés. Pour en savoir plus sur nos produits UAS (Uncrewed Aerial Systems) : https://www.airbus.com/en/products-services/defence/uas Ce que nous pouvons accomplir ensemble : Sur notre site d’Aix en Provence, au sein du département du Bureau d’études, vous aurez pour missions principales de : Développer des briques logicielles software critique (code manuel ou model-based) Analyser des exigences fonctionnelles et de mission Concevoir de nouveaux systèmes et outils (conception de nouveaux concepts et mise à jour et suivi des conceptions existantes) Faire des simulations (simulations prédictives pour le prototypage, simulation hors ligne, simulation pilotée, simulateurs de vol complets) Vérifier par simulation et sur équipement réel Faire des mises au point des lois de commande de vol sur simulateurs et en vol Valider et vérifier et certifier Participer aux projets d'innovation relatifs aux projets de drones Vous serez également être amené à : Être en interface avec la gestion de projet, les achats, le service commercial et les autres acteurs du projet au sein de l'organisation Être l’interface pour le management des fournisseurs et des clients Supporter les essais sur banc d'intégration, au sol et en vol du système Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d’être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. About the Team

The Intelligence & Investigations Engineering team builds systems that detect, analyze, and disrupt abuse across OpenAI’s products. We partner closely with the Child Safety team and cross-functional groups to protect users while advancing OpenAI’s goal of developing AI that benefits everyone.


About the Role

As a Fullstack Engineer focused on child safety, you’ll build data-intensive, AI-powered applications and infrastructure that enable operators and investigators to work effectively and responsibly. You’ll adapt quickly in ambiguous, fast-moving environments to deliver well-crafted, reliable tooling for high-severity safety work.



*Candidates should understand this role involves exposure to sensitive and egregious content.


In this role, you will:

 - 7+ years of experience as a software engineer

 - Prototype, build, and maintain intelligence systems that detect, triage, and enable efficient human review of possible high severity harm

 - Work hand in hand with operators and investigators, designing and delivering systems that enable them to do their work faster, more accurately, and more safely.

 - Develop across the stack: UIs, services, pipelines, and anything else required to solve the problems we face.

 - Interact with partners across Product Policy, Platform Integrity, Safety Systems, and Research

 - Contribute to the team’s technical strategy, especially for child safety related tools and systems

 - Report on impact in a data-driven fashion
   

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a strong software engineering foundation and enjoy owning systems end-to-end—from infrastructure and data ingestion to frontend tooling

 - Are energized by working at the frontier of AI capabilities, integrating new models and APIs into practical systems

 - Have experience building and operating large-scale data pipelines or search/retrieval systems

 - Are proficient in Python and/or TypeScript, and familiar with tools like Spark, Kafka, Flink, data warehouses, and SQL

 - Take a product-minded approach, design with user workflows in mind, and iterate quickly based on feedback

 - Favor pragmatic solutions and can ship in hacky, low-support environments when needed

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and open-ended problem spaces with evolving goals

 - Have prior experience working on engineering for high-severity harms

 - Bring intuition for the pain points and workflows of operations and investigative teams, and curiosity about solving complex investigations

 - Bonus: prior knowledge of child-safety-specific challenges such as secure handling of quarantined content and reporting to NCMEC

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
