ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

This is a builder role for someone extremely analytical, comfortable running live enablement at scale, and already advanced with AI tools to automate the systems behind it.

Since this is a new role, we expect the scope to evolve over time - being adaptable and excited to build is a core part of being successful here. Focus areas include, but aren't limited to:

items.desc: À propos du poste Vous connaissez Salesforce et vous utilisez déjà l'IA dans votre travail ? Ce poste est fait pour vous.  AI Factory Compute & IT Infrastructure Architect 
 Position Overview 
 The AI Factory Compute & IT Infrastructure Architect will serve as a global technical authority for compute, networking, storage, memory, and IT infrastructure architecture within Siemens' AI Factory organization. The role will track how AI, hyperscale, cloud, HPC, and enterprise platforms are evolving and convert those changes into actionable AI Factory reference architectures and go-to-market guidance. The successful candidate will bring practical experience building or architecting large-scale compute, network, and storage environments and enough data-center fluency to translate upstream IT decisions into clear implications for power, cooling, controls, physical topology, resiliency, and deployment strategy. A critical responsibility is to partner with electrical, thermal/liquid cooling, controls & automation, digital thread, and regional Solutions Architects, rack density, cluster topology, network fabrics, storage architecture, and workload behavior are accurately reflected in the complete AI Factory architecture. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Serve as the technical authority for AI, HPC, cloud, and enterprise infrastructure architectures. 
 Evaluate emerging processor , accelerator , networking, memory, and storage technologies and assess their impact on AI Factory designs. 
 Develop scalable reference architectures spanning compute , storage, networking, racks, clusters, and data hall environments. 
 Translate IT infrastructure requirements into actionable inputs for electrical, cooling, controls, and facility design teams. 
 Partner with customers, hyperscalers , enterprises, and technology partners on infrastructure strategy and architecture planning. 
 Develop technical guidance, architecture frameworks, and thought leadership content supporting sales and go-to-market initiatives. 
 Basic Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; Master’s preferred. 
 1 0 + years of experience in compute infrastructure, networking, storage, cloud, HPC, enterprise systems, or hyperscale environments. 
 5+ years in architecture, principal engineering, technical leadership, or equivalent roles. 
 Proven experience designing or architecting large-scale infrastructure environments. 
 Experience with AI infrastructure, accelerated computing, HPC, hyperscale, or high-density data centers. 
 Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 Ability to travel up to 30-50%. 
 Technical Expertise 
 Large-scale compute , AI, HPC, cloud, or hyperscale infrastructure environments. 
 Server, CPU, GPU, and accelerator architectures. 
 AI training and inference platforms. 
 Data center networking including Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE, and AI fabrics. 
 Enterprise and high-performance storage architectures. 
 Linux, virtualization, containers, and distributed systems. 
 Rack-level infrastructure, power, cooling, and high-density deployments. 
 Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into scalable architecture strategies. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Deep expertise in compute , HPC, networking, AI infrastructure, hyperscale systems, or a related domain . 
 Broad knowledge across compute , networking, storage, and data center infrastructure.

items.desc: Notre mission L'IA transforme déjà le fonctionnement des entreprises. Chez Modjo, nous voulons révolutionner la manière dont les équipes commerciales vendent. Fondée à Paris en 2019, Modjo est en train de devenir le leader européen de l'IA appliquée à la vente. Les équipes commerciales ont accès à plus de données que jamais, mais celles-ci sont dispersées entre les CRM, les e-mails, les outils de vente et les échanges avec les clients. Lorsque le contexte est fragmenté, des signaux essentiels se perdent, les pipelines ralentissent et les opportunités s'envolent. Chez Modjo, nous développons un système d’agents IA qui comprend le contexte de chaque compte, de chaque opportunité et de chaque équipe. Nos agents aident les commerciaux à préparer leurs réunions, à gérer les objections, à exploiter pleinement les opportunités, à hiérarchiser les actions pertinentes et à faire avancer les dossiers. Le défi n’est pas de créer un énième outil. Il s’agit de développer une IA suffisamment fiable et utile pour devenir un véritable coéquipier des équipes commerciales. Avec une solution développée en France et des données hébergées en Europe, Modjo construit une alternative européenne souveraine en matière d’IA appliquée à la vente. Rejoindre Modjo, c’est contribuer à redéfinir la manière dont des millions de commerciaux travailleront demain. Pourquoi on recrute ? On recrute un(e) Machine Learning pour renforcer l'équipe. Tu seras au cœur de la construction, de la maintenance et du passage à l'échelle des features LLM et agentiques qui font tourner le produit Modjo. Ton terrain de jeu principal : notre système agentique avec un focus sur l'orchestration de modèles, l'exécution d'outils, l'évaluation, la fiabilité et la performance en production. Tes missions Concevoir, builder et optimiser le stack agentique qui fait tourner nos agents conversationnels et autonomes — avec un vrai souci de fiabilité, de scalabilité et de faible latence en prod. Architecturer et maintenir nos features LLM de bout en bout : orchestration de modèles, routing, monitoring, logging et évaluation. Développer et améliorer l'infrastructure ML : observabilité, load balancing, patterns de scaling, workflows de déploiement. Construire des datasets et pipelines d'évaluation robustes pour des systèmes déterministes (ASR) et non-déterministes (LLMs et agents), pour améliorer en continu la qualité. Collaborer avec les Software Engineers pour mettre en place une infrastructure scalable, observable et automatisée autour de nos services ML. Travailler main dans la main avec les Product Managers pour évaluer la faisabilité, affiner les specs et livrer nos features ML de manière fiable. Contribuer à la stratégie technique : choix des modèles et outils, décisions d'architecture, roadmap long terme de notre plateforme agentique. Faire de la veille sur les dernières recherches, frameworks et évolutions open-source en LLM, systèmes agentiques et méthodologies d'évaluation. Ton profil 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en ML Engineering ou Data Science Solide maîtrise de Python (bonus si tu as aussi touché à des langages bas niveau comme Java ou C ; un profil purement scripting ne suffira pas) Bonnes bases en ML : types de modèles, bonnes pratiques data science, méthodes d'évaluation Bonne maîtrise des LLMs : prompt design, évaluation, arbitrages coût/performance Expérience avec les systèmes agentiques : exécution d'outils, workflows, architectures mémoire, LangChain / LangGraph ou équivalent Exposition à MCP (Model Context Protocol), DeepEval, FastAPI, Uvicorn Compréhension des concepts NLP : transcription, embeddings, compréhension du langage Une vraie curiosité intellectuelle : tu te renseignes, tu creuses les sujets, tu as ton propre point de vue De l'ownership et une bonne communication : tu ne restes pas bloqué(e), tu poses les bonnes questions et tu avances Process de recrutement Etape 1 screening call avec Julien, VP Engineering Etape 2: Case study onsite avec Luca, Engineering Manager et Julien Etape 3: Team fit avec des membres de l'équipe Etape 4 : Final interview avec Paul (CEO) Etape 5: prise de références Notre culture Chez Modjo, nous recherchons des personnes qui souhaitent construire, et pas seulement exécuter. Des personnes qui prennent leurs responsabilités, transforment l’ambiguïté en action et restent concentrées sur la création d’un véritable impact. Des personnes curieuses, résilientes et prêtes à remettre en question le statu quo, tout en sachant que les meilleures idées naissent de la collaboration. Nous avançons rapidement, testons, apprenons et nous améliorons. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’excellence, mais nous n’attendons pas la perfection pour passer à l’action. items.desc: Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning. Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge. Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success. Your Responsibilities Will Include Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning. Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system. Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization. Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking. Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda. Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture. We Expect You To Have A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead. At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI. A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine-tuning approaches. Hands-on experience with: Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation. Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent. Vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns. Deploying and scaling LLM-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open-source models. Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Proficiency in English, both written and verbal. Our Ideal Candidate Would Have Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph-based reasoning. Experience in early-stage startups – you enjoy the zero-to-one phase. The ability to think strategically about product-led AI, beyond just training models in isolation. A background in code analysis, developer tools, or software engineering research. Experience with multi-agent systems or complex agentic workflows. Actively contributed to relevant open-source projects or publications. What we offer A competitive salary and JetBrains benefits. A generous runway and corporate resources with startup autonomy. We are an equal opportunity employer We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation. items.desc: Notre mission L'IA transforme déjà le fonctionnement des entreprises. Chez Modjo, nous voulons révolutionner la manière dont les équipes commerciales vendent. Fondée à Paris en 2019, Modjo est en train de devenir le leader européen de l'IA appliquée à la vente. Les équipes commerciales ont accès à plus de données que jamais, mais celles-ci sont dispersées entre les CRM, les e-mails, les outils de vente et les échanges avec les clients. Lorsque le contexte est fragmenté, des signaux essentiels se perdent, les pipelines ralentissent et les opportunités s'envolent. Chez Modjo, nous développons un système d’agents IA qui comprend le contexte de chaque compte, de chaque opportunité et de chaque équipe. Nos agents aident les commerciaux à préparer leurs réunions, à gérer les objections, à exploiter pleinement les opportunités, à hiérarchiser les actions pertinentes et à faire avancer les dossiers. Le défi n’est pas de créer un énième outil. Il s’agit de développer une IA suffisamment fiable et utile pour devenir un véritable coéquipier des équipes commerciales. Avec une solution développée en France et des données hébergées en Europe, Modjo construit une alternative européenne souveraine en matière d’IA appliquée à la vente. Rejoindre Modjo, c’est contribuer à redéfinir la manière dont des millions de commerciaux travailleront demain. Pourquoi on recrute ? On recrute un(e) Machine Learning pour renforcer l'équipe. Tu seras au cœur de la construction, de la maintenance et du passage à l'échelle des features LLM et agentiques qui font tourner le produit Modjo. Ton terrain de jeu principal : notre système agentique avec un focus sur l'orchestration de modèles, l'exécution d'outils, l'évaluation, la fiabilité et la performance en production. Tes missions Concevoir, builder et optimiser le stack agentique qui fait tourner nos agents conversationnels et autonomes — avec un vrai souci de fiabilité, de scalabilité et de faible latence en prod. Architecturer et maintenir nos features LLM de bout en bout : orchestration de modèles, routing, monitoring, logging et évaluation. Développer et améliorer l'infrastructure ML : observabilité, load balancing, patterns de scaling, workflows de déploiement. Construire des datasets et pipelines d'évaluation robustes pour des systèmes déterministes (ASR) et non-déterministes (LLMs et agents), pour améliorer en continu la qualité. Collaborer avec les Software Engineers pour mettre en place une infrastructure scalable, observable et automatisée autour de nos services ML. Travailler main dans la main avec les Product Managers pour évaluer la faisabilité, affiner les specs et livrer nos features ML de manière fiable. Contribuer à la stratégie technique : choix des modèles et outils, décisions d'architecture, roadmap long terme de notre plateforme agentique. Faire de la veille sur les dernières recherches, frameworks et évolutions open-source en LLM, systèmes agentiques et méthodologies d'évaluation. Ton profil 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en ML Engineering ou Data Science Solide maîtrise de Python (bonus si tu as aussi touché à des langages bas niveau comme Java ou C ; un profil purement scripting ne suffira pas) Bonnes bases en ML : types de modèles, bonnes pratiques data science, méthodes d'évaluation Bonne maîtrise des LLMs : prompt design, évaluation, arbitrages coût/performance Expérience avec les systèmes agentiques : exécution d'outils, workflows, architectures mémoire, LangChain / LangGraph ou équivalent Exposition à MCP (Model Context Protocol), DeepEval, FastAPI, Uvicorn Compréhension des concepts NLP : transcription, embeddings, compréhension du langage Une vraie curiosité intellectuelle : tu te renseignes, tu creuses les sujets, tu as ton propre point de vue De l'ownership et une bonne communication : tu ne restes pas bloqué(e), tu poses les bonnes questions et tu avances Process de recrutement Etape 1 screening call avec Julien, VP Engineering Etape 2: Case study onsite avec Luca, Engineering Manager et Julien Etape 3: Team fit avec des membres de l'équipe Etape 4 : Final interview avec Paul (CEO) Etape 5: prise de références Notre culture Chez Modjo, nous recherchons des personnes qui souhaitent construire, et pas seulement exécuter. items.desc: Datafundamenten & Analytics (DF&A) is op zoek naar een GenAI Engineer bij de afdeling Business Ontwikkeling Analytics (BOA). We zijn op zoek naar een genAI engineer voor een nieuw te vormen team dat generatieve AI producten naar productie brengt. Dit team ontwikkelt generatieve AI oplossingen voor de hele Belastingdienst: slimme zoekfuncties, documentverwerking, hulp bij het opstellen van teksten. Geen experimenten of proof-of-concepts, maar producten die collega’s daadwerkelijk gebruiken in hun werk. Dit doe je bij de Belastingdienst Als GenAI engineer ontwerp, bouw, evalueer en verbeter je generatieve AI oplossingen (prompting, RAG, agentic workflows) die aantoonbare waarde leveren voor de klant. Deze oplossingen toets je zodat ze voldoen aan de eisen die aan de Belastingdienst worden gesteld op het gebied van betrouwbaarheid, transparantie en verantwoord gebruik. Je werkt op de componenten die het AI platformteam levert. Je bouwt daarop de eindproducten en beheert de configuraties ervan. De kwaliteit van wat je bouwt is een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk. Je hebt affiniteit met generatieve AI en je bent een ambassadeur van de mogelijkheden van AI en analytics. DF&A is volop in ontwikkeling en actief op zoek naar vernieuwing – innovatie - binnen de Belastingdienst. Dat betekent vernieuwen in bijvoorbeeld technologie, toepassing, opleiding, wijze van organiseren, wijze van samenwerken en het werven van nieuwe medewerkers. Met jouw werkzaamheden speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol en help je onze afdeling en de Belastingdienst vooruit. Uiteraard krijg je ook zelf de kans om je te ontwikkelen. Een bijzondere baan, omdat... je de ruimte krijgt om out-of-the-box te denken. je vakgenoten enthousiasmeert om nieuwe ontwikkelingen uit te proberen. je trends en ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied vertaalt naar de Belastingdienst. “Als GenAI engineer bij de Belastingdienst ontwikkel ik GenAI-producten die toegevoegde waarde leveren voor de Belastingdienst” – Matthijs, genAI engineer Wanneer past deze baan bij je? Je hebt een wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in econometrie, statistiek, wiskunde, natuurkunde, data science of software engineering Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bouwen van GenAI-/LLM-toepassingen, zoals het schrijven van prompts of RAG oplossingen Je hebt ervaring met programmeren, bij voorkeur in Python en SQL Je hebt basisvaardigheid in deployment, zoals het bouwen van CI/CD-principes, logging en monitoring Je houdt van pionieren en gedijt goed in een organisatie waar nog niet alles is vastgelegd. Jouw competenties plannen en organiseren overtuigingskracht analyseren resultaatgerichtheid samenwerken De afdeling - Corporate Dienst Datafundamenten en Analytics De Corporate Dienst Datafundamenten en Analytics (DF&A) werkt voor directies van de Belastingdienst die belast zijn met de fiscale behandeling van burgers en bedrijven én voor bedrijfsvoering. DF&A levert signaalmodellen en informatiedashboards die zijn gebaseerd op de analyse van ‘big data’ en die de organisatie inzicht geven in de mogelijkheden om werkzaamheden slimmer en beter uit te voeren. Zo kunnen op informatie-gestuurde wijze keuzes worden gemaakt in bijvoorbeeld handhavingsstrategieën, behandeladviezen en procesinrichtingen. De signaalmodellen en dashboards worden gebouwd door gebruik te maken van innovatieve IT-ontwikkelingen en het koppelen van zeer divers aangeleverde data. DF&A maakt hiervoor gebruik van een zelfontwikkelde methodiek om data op te bouwen tot datafundamenten, die de basis zijn voor de producten. De organisatie Belastingdienst Bij de Belastingdienst werken ongeveer 28.000 mensen verspreid over het hele land aan een financieel gezond Nederland. Dit doen we door eerlijk en zorgvuldig belastingen en premies volksverzekeringen te heffen, te innen en te controleren en fraude op te sporen. De Belastingdienst maakt het burgers en bedrijven zo gemakkelijk mogelijk om verplichtingen na te kunnen komen en gebruik te kunnen maken van rechten. Dat gebeurt met passende dienstverlening, door massale processen juist en tijdig uit te voeren én door adequaat toezicht uit te oefenen. De Belastingdienst is sterk in ontwikkeling en heeft de ambitie om de beste Belastingdienst voor Nederland te zijn met focus op fiscale taken en vakmanschap. Lees meer over de Belastingdienst op: https://over-ons.belastingdienst.nl Bijzonderheden We ontvangen je brief en cv graag in een Word- of PDF-bestand. Neem in de bestandsnaam jouw voor- en achternaam op. Als je een beroep doet op een voorrangspositie, stuur dan ook een kopie van die kennisgeving mee. Selectieprocedure Allereerst wordt beoordeeld of een voorrangskandidaat binnen de Rijksoverheid in aanmerking komt voor de functie. Daarna wordt beoordeeld of jouw cv en motivatiebrief voldoen aan de gestelde functie-eisen. Mid november vinden de selectiegesprekken plaats. De voorkeur gaat uit naar kandidaten die het meest aansluiten bij het opgestelde profiel. Dit heeft betrekking op zowel …

Construir y configurar agentes de IA, incluyendo herramientas, llamadas a funciones (function calling), memoria, planificación, flujos de razonamiento y conversaciones. Diseñar e implementar estrategias avanzadas de prompting, incluyendo plantillas de prompts, salidas estructuradas, gestión de contexto, few-shot prompting y optimización de prompts. Implementar flujos de trabajo basados en agentes y procesos de IA de múltiples pasos, garantizando fiabilidad, controlabilidad y una gestión adecuada de errores y casos excepcionales. Integrar soluciones de IA con sistemas empresariales mediante APIs, bases de datos, microservicios, aplicaciones y otras plataformas corporativas. Desarrollar conectores y herramientas que permitan a los agentes de IA interactuar de forma segura con datos empresariales y aplicaciones de negocio. Supervisar y analizar el rendimiento de las aplicaciones de IA e identificar oportunidades de mejora continua y optimización. Implementar mecanismos adecuados de gestión de errores, salvaguardas (guardrails), validaciones y planes de contingencia (fallbacks) para aplicaciones de IA. Colaborar con arquitectos y equipos de ingeniería para garantizar que las soluciones sigan los estándares establecidos de arquitectura, seguridad, integración y desarrollo. Contribuir al desarrollo de componentes reutilizables, bibliotecas, patrones y mejores prácticas para el desarrollo de soluciones de IA. Mantenerse actualizado sobre los avances en LLMs, IA generativa, IA basada en agentes (agentic AI), RAG y frameworks y tecnologías de desarrollo de IA. Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role Experiencia demostrada como desarrollador de IA, ingeniero de IA generativa, ingeniero de LLM, ingeniero de aprendizaje automático, ingeniero de software o puesto equivalente. Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de agentes de IA y flujos de trabajo basados en agentes. Experiencia con herramientas y llamadas a funciones, memoria de agentes, planificación, orquestación y flujos de trabajo conversacionales. Sólidos conocimientos sobre ingeniería de prompts y patrones de interacción de los LLM. Experiencia práctica en la implementación de soluciones RAG, incluyendo incrustaciones, búsqueda vectorial, estrategias de recuperación y gestión del contexto. Experiencia en la integración de aplicaciones de IA con API REST, bases de datos, microservicios y aplicaciones empresariales. Experiencia trabajando con datos estructurados y no estructurados. Conocimiento de las mejores prácticas de ingeniería de software, incluyendo control de versiones, pruebas, CI/CD, depuración y calidad del código. Experiencia en el diseño y la ejecución de procesos de evaluación y validación de la IA. Capacidad para definir métricas significativas y evaluar la calidad y la fiabilidad de los resultados generados por la IA. items.desc: About The Company Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. Together, they add a human layer to an AI-driven internet. World is already running at a global scale. More than 17 million people across 160 countries have verified with World ID, and more new Orb verifications take place each week. World App is already among the most used wallets globally. Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate. Founded in 2019, TFH has more than 400 people across hardware, software, AI, cryptography, mobile engineering, and global operations. Our teams come from OpenAI, Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, Google, Stripe, Meta, Coinbase, Palantir and MIT Media Lab. We’re backed by leading investors, including a16z, Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Blockchain Capital, Variant, Tiger Global, and Coinbase Ventures, as well as prominent operators and founders across fintech and AI. TFH and World have been featured on the cover of TIME Magazine, highlighted in Fast Company’s Next 5 in Fintech, and explored in a Bloomberg deep dive. The New York Times, Bankless and TechCrunch have all recognized our collective progress in identity, cryptography, AI, and global-scale hardware deployment. Our leadership is also named to the Time AI 100. Learn more about the newest product launches from our Liftoff event. About The Team We are building a planet‑scale biometric recognition system that will serve more than a billion users and enable them to become part of the World protocol. We use cutting-edge Machine Learning models deployed on custom hardware to enable high-quality image acquisition, identification, and fraud prevention, all while requiring minimal user interaction. We are building a biometric recognition and fraud detection engine that works on the 1bn people scale. Therefore, its performance needs to outperform all the current recognition technologies. We leverage our powerful custom-made iris recognition and presentation attack detection device, the Orb, combined with the latest research from the field of AI and Deep Learning. To reach our next milestone—continuous, trustworthy ML innovation across millions of edge devices—we’re hiring a Senior ML Platform & Ops Engineer to own the ML lifecycle from data to device. You’ll design and operate production-grade pipelines that transform state-of-the-art ML research into deployed models with clear telemetry, rollback, and reproducibility. If you thrive on building self‑service platforms that turn research ideas into reliable, observable production systems, we’d love to meet you. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and operate reliable, observable infrastructure for training, evaluation, telemetry ingestion, and deployment. Maintain CI/CD workflows and automated pipelines. Edge‑aware rollout services with staged deployment, A/B experimentation and instant rollback across Orbs, Orb Mini and Mobile Apps. Develop secure APIs and backend services that expose governed datasets and model artefacts at scale. Implement automated checks, drift detection, and alerting for real-time model monitoring. Champion best practices in data lineage, reproducibility, privacy‑by‑design, security and secure edge delivery. Collaborate across ML research, product, and firmware teams to streamline delivery and feedback loops. About You 5+ years building ML infrastructure, data platforms, or production ML systems at scale. Track record of delivering platforms and CI/CD pipelines used daily by ML or data teams. Hands-on experience running large-scale training on multi-tenant GPU clusters to maximize throughput and reliability. You’ve built versioned dataset & lineage systems with slice-level provenance and governed access, making every model reproducible to the exact data, features, code, and config used. Deep understanding of containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS) plus Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Terraform/CDK/Cloudformation). Strong backend engineering skills in Python and/or Go; you value clean, maintainable code. Deep understanding of modern CI/CD, model packaging, and observability practices. Comfortable operating production systems, defining SLAs, and handling rollout or incident workflows. Comfortable using modern Agentic AI development

items.desc: Position description Business unit Investment Management - Equity Management Job title Quantitative Equity Researcher F/M Contract type Permanent Candriam Group Presentation Candriam is a global multi-specialist asset manager and a recognized pioneer and leader in sustainable investment. For more than 25 years, Candriam has offered innovative and diversified investment solutions across many asset classes including fixed income, equities, alternatives, absolute return, asset allocation and illiquid assets. As a Responsible Employer, Equal Employment Opportunity is crucial to Candriam. We are committed to building the best global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We provide an inclusive work environment and support wellbeing and work-life balance. Mission The Quantitative Equity Management team manages assets across active global, US, European and Japanese long-only equity funds and institutional mandates, as well as a long/short market-neutral strategy. We are looking for a Quantitative Equity Researcher to strengthen the team’s research capabilities and contribute to the continued development of its investment strategies. The successful candidate will conduct applied quantitative research aimed at enhancing the existing investment framework and identifying new, differentiated sources of alpha. This includes improving current stock-selection models and developing complementary strategies that broaden and diversify the team’s investment approach. Responsabilities Responsabilities Conduct quantitative research into new equity signals, datasets and investment strategies. Enhance and extend the team’s existing stock-selection models and research framework. Identify complementary sources of alpha across investment styles, regions and market environments. Assess the robustness, economic rationale and scalability of new signals and strategies. Design and perform rigorous backtests, including transaction costs, liquidity constraints and implementation considerations. Analyse signal interactions, factor exposures, portfolio risks and performance across different market regimes. Explore alternative and unstructured datasets, as well as advanced statistical, machine-learning and AI techniques where relevant. Translate successful research into robust, production-ready investment solutions. Collaborate closely with Quantitative Fund Managers on portfolio construction, strategy implementation and ongoing model monitoring. Clearly present research findings and investment recommendations to colleagues and internal decision-making committees. Contribute to the team’s research agenda and challenge existing approaches constructively. Profile A master's degree or PhD in finance, econometrics, statistics, mathematics, engineering, data science or another quantitative discipline. At least five years of relevant professional experience in quantitative equity research, systematic investing or a closely related field. At least five years of relevant professional experience in quantitative equity research, systematic investing or a closely related field. A master's degree or PhD in finance, econometrics, statistics, mathematics, engineering, data science or another quantitative discipline. Strong knowledge of equity markets, quantitative stock selection, factor investing and portfolio construction. Demonstrated experience in developing and testing systematic equity signals or investment strategies. Advanced programming skills, preferably in Python, combined with strong data-handling capabilities. Sound understanding of statistical methods, research design, model validation and the risks of overfitting. Ability to connect rigorous quantitative analysis with a clear economic and investment rationale. This is a KTP Associate to contribute to the Knowledge Transfer Partnership (KTP) project that aims to develop next-generation thermal comfort and energy optimisation models for scalable deployment. Funded by InnovateUK, the KTP project is co-led by the Institute for Infrastructure and Environment and Institute for Energy Systems at the University of Edinburgh (UoE), and Cosysense . Cosysense reduces electricity costs and carbon emissions in commercial buildings by delivering optimised comfort through AI-native climate control powered by sensors, digital twins, and autonomous control systems. The KTP Associate will lead the development and deployment of advanced thermal comfort and grid demand response physics models into Cosysense’s AI control system. You will act as the bridge between academic research and real-world application, translating cutting-edge building physics and human comfort modelling into production-ready algorithms controlling HVAC systems in live buildings. In line with the KTP model, the Associate is embedded at Cosysense day to day, engaging regularly with the University of Edinburgh for knowledge transfer and academic supervision. This role will be primarily based at Cosysense. The Role Combines Research (building physics and energy systems) Applied AI / modelling Real-world deployment and validation in commercial buildings A unique employer in a vibrant city. In Edinburgh, you are in one of the world’s most attractive cities with active arts and social sectors, while working in a University that has made significant contributions to society, medicine, physics and teaching for over four centuries. Our people have helped create the modern world and are working on more ground-breaking technologies and practices. Make a meaningful impact. Here, you can continue to make a difference in everything around you. Take on new challenges, grow your career, be recognised for your contributions, and benefit from our commitment to your wellbeing. Be part of something bigger — where your work has real impact and your development matters. There are so many reasons to take your next step with us. items.desc: Contexte : Dans le cadre d’un projet de transformation de la chaîne outillée RxD (PLM, ALM, MBSSE), nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur ou Architecte Logiciel Embarqué pour évaluer, sélectionner et déployer une solution de génération de code à partir de modèles (Matlab/Simulink, UML, SysML). Votre mission : Concevoir, modéliser et industrialiser la génération de code embarqué Vous interviendrez sur un projet stratégique visant à moderniser les outils de conception et de développement logiciel pour l’ensemble des entités du groupe. Vos tâches : Évaluer les différentes solutions de génération de code disponibles sur le marché (outils, générateurs, chaînes de production). Sélectionner la solution la plus adaptée aux besoins en termes de qualité, performance et intégration dans la chaîne outillée existante. Accompagner le fournisseur pour optimiser la solution retenue (paramétrage, adaptation, montée en version, corrections). Déployer la solution au sein de la chaîne outillée, en garantissant la production d’un code de niveau production (qualité, efficacité, maintenabilité). Produire les livrables associés : spécifications, modèles (UML, SysML), rapports d’évaluation, résultats de tests, documentation technique. Collaborer avec les équipes R&D, PLM, ALM et MBSSE pour assurer l’intégration cohérente du générateur de code dans l’écosystème existant. Profil candidat: Formation : Bac+5 ingénieur (ou équivalent) en informatique, systèmes embarqués, automatique ou domaine connexe Expérience : 5 à 10 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel embarqué automobile, avec une forte dimension architecture et modélisation Environnement technique : Langages : maîtrise experte du C, bonne maîtrise du C++ Systèmes embarqués : expérience sur Embarqué OS, FreeRTOS, Linux embarqué (notions), AUTOSAR (design & outils type Vector DaVinci) Modélisation : expertise confirmée en UML et SysML (idéalement SysML v2), avec une pratique avancée d’outils tels que IBM Rhapsody, Catia Magic Cyber System (MagicDraw, Cameo), Enterprise Architect Génération de code : expérience sur Matlab/Simulink, Embedded Coder, TargetLink ou équivalents Méthodes & outils modernes : maîtrise de Git, bonnes pratiques de développement, et appétence pour l’usage d’outils d’IA dans le développement logiciel Anglais courant pour les échanges avec les fournisseurs

items.desc: Your Role As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection. You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification. What You’ll Do Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams What You Bring A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC) Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability Ability to interpret defect data and identify relevant items.desc: About the positionVISION Plextek is a leading choice for employees and customers for exceptional engineering and strategic innovation to create better, safer, and more sustainable technologies and products. OUR VALUES AND BELIEFS Being a responsible business, we work with integrity and honesty. We share success with our people and our communities. We embrace diversity in outlook and work as a team with colleagues, customers, and suppliers to provide the best technical solution and professional service experience. We empower each other, we’re adaptable, show initiative, and deliver on our commitments together. THE ROLE If you’re a recognised radar expert who still enjoys hands-on engineering, and want to help shape the future direction of a rapidly expanding capability, we’d like to talk to you. As a Lead Radar Systems Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across our radar activities, supporting customer delivery, capability development and business growth. You will lead the technical definition of advanced radar systems and RF architectures from concept through to demonstration and deployment, working closely with multidisciplinary teams spanning RF, electronics, signal processing, software and systems engineering. You will also play a key role in developing our radar capability, helping to identify new opportunities, mentor engineers and maintain Plextek’s reputation for solving technically challenging problems. This role requires UK SC / UKEO clearance. Key Responsibilities:Technical Leadership Lead the development of advanced radar and RF systems. Define and assess Radio Frequency architectures against (sometimes unclear) customer requirements. Make critical system-level trade-offs involving performance, cost, risk and implementation complexity. Guide multidisciplinary engineering teams through the delivery of complex projects to help drive effective execution. Support technical strategy and the growth of RF and radar-related capabilities. Radar Systems Engineering Develop radar system requirements and performance models. Conduct system-level analysis and architecture selection. Evaluate radar performance trade-offs including detection range, resolution, sensitivity and clutter performance. Act as a trusted technical authority for customers. Support project scoping, proposal generation and technical planning. Present complex technical concepts clearly to customers and stakeholders. Identify new opportunities arising from customer challenges and emerging technologies. Capability Development Mentor and coach engineers across radar, RF and systems disciplines. Contribute to technology roadmaps and research activities. Support recruitment and technical development within the radar team. Help maintain and expand Plextek’s position as a leader in advanced RF and radar solutions. Essential Experience: We are looking for a highly capable engineer with significant (minimum 10 years+) industrial experience in customised radar systems development. You should have deep expertise across a substantial proportion of the following: Radar Systems Pulsed radar systems FMCW radar systems SAR and radar imaging systems Radar performance modelling and analysis Radar architecture development Antenna concepts and system integration RF Systems Design Radio propagation RF link and level planning Synthesiser systems design RF transceiver architecture selection RF Hardware Understanding RF and microwave circuit design Distributed microwave techniques Millimetre-wave systems High-performance frequency synthesisers Analogue electronics relevant to RF electronics Systems Engineering Requirements capture and analysis Verification and validation planning Technical leadership of multidisciplinary teams Project definition and technical scoping Technology and capability development The ideal candidate will be: Technically exceptional and recognised by peers as an authority in radar systems. Curious, proactive and motivated by difficult engineering challenges. Comfortable operating with significant autonomy. Commercially aware and able to engage directly with customers. A natural mentor who enjoys developing less experienced engineers. Excited by building capability and shaping the future direction of a growing business. THE REWARDS We offer an excellent package, a stimulating environment, and a real interest in your development to encourage you to achieve your full potential. We are a versatile business, able to support career progression as appropriate. We are based just south of Cambridge with easy road and rail routes to the city centre. We provide a friendly and supportive working environment, including regular on-site and off-site social events.

items.desc:
Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. 
Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.
This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.
This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Experience organizing and prioritizing work across multiple teams in a large-scale, distributed environment and experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes in a large-scale, distributed environment.

Perform and drive RCA and CA, in collaboration with hardware and software engineering teams Issue timely alerts and fixes to operations teams, and assure a robust feedback pipeline to engineering teams Build strong relationships and collaboration with engineering and cross functional teams across the company. Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Ingénieur Conception Outillages Spatial (f/h) pour rejoindre notre Département Bureau d’Études Mécaniques basé à Toulouse , France.
 Vos missions : 
Au sein du département Bureau d’Études, vous serez en charge du développement des outillages destinés à être utilisés par les équipes lors des phase d'Assemblage, d'Intégration et de Test (AIT) de nos satellites et systèmes spatiaux. 
 Vos responsabilités : 
 Conception technique et modélisation 3D : Concevoir sur logiciel de Conception Assistée par Ordinateur (CAO) les outillages mécaniques et optiques, réaliser les études d'aménagement en salle blanche (intégration, simulation de déploiement, analyse d'interférences) et définir la séquence d'assemblage des satellites. 
 Gestion de projet et suivi budgétaire : Effectuer le chiffrage des activités (conception, analyse, tests), piloter le planning et garantir le respect des jalons de livraison, du niveau de qualité et du budget imparti ("On Quality, On Time, On Costs"). 
 Pilotage des fournisseurs et sous-traitants : Élaborer les dossiers techniques de fabrication (modèles 3D, plans d'assemblage, nomenclatures), consulter et sélectionner les fabricants, puis piloter les sous-traitants jusqu'à la réception finale des matériels.

 OBLIGATOIRE : 
 Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 
 Le candidat doit posséder la nationalité française conformément à l’IGI 1300 du 9 Août 2021 (§1.2.2.1).

 une première expérience en gestion de projets de conception mécanique

 Niveau d'anglais courant (avancé) et maîtrise du français permettant la négociation professionnelle.

Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space is looking for a DevOps Architect (f/m) to join its Public Safety and Security subsidiary based in Elancourt . You will be part of the "Terminal Software Engineering" team, which works on secure communication solutions particularly used by public safety forces . You will work on a Broadband "Mission Critical" solution . 
 As a DevOps Architect, you will be responsible for defining the architecture of the CI/CD pipelines for the software solutions developed by the team, as well as their implementation. The developed solutions must comply with the "Mission Critical" solution and the functional and operational requirements of our customers. You will be responsible for the delivery and deployment of the solution across various platforms. You will ensure the high availability of the pipelines as well as the quality and security of the solution's components. You will work with various teams based in France and Finland. Knowledge of a Broadband "Mission Critical" solution coupled with strong DevOps skills will be a significant asset for this position . 
 Your challenges: 
 Gather and analyze the functional and technical requirements of the customer project, and define the pipeline architecture required for the solutions to be developed . 
 Develop the solution's CI/CD pipelines in an environment as close as possible to the customer's using your IT/DevOps skills . 
 Implement the security level in line with project requirements and contribute to the continuous improvement of tools, methods, and upgrade procedures . 
 Participate in investigations and problem-solving . 
 Lead technical discussions with the project and product managers to define the solution's development stages regarding DevSecOps aspects . 
 Your boarding pass: 
 Significant professional experience in the field of at least 5 years (which may include work-study periods) . 
 Containerization & Orchestration: Kubernetes (rancher, k3s...) + Helm, Docker Swarm, Docker, Podman, LXC .

items.desc:
Location: Reading, United Kingdom 
 Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.
 Embedded Systems & Integration Engineer - UAS 
 Reading, Bristol, Crawley ideally, but flexible on location 
 Thales Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) UK is a principal supplier of Electronic Warfare (EW), Radar and Uncrewed Aerial Systems (UAS) equipment to the UK armed forces, as well as an exporter of these capabilities worldwide.
 We’re recruiting for an experienced Embedded Systems / Software Integration Engineer to develop and integrate software for an edge-computing system based around NVIDIA Jetson.
 The role will involve integrating a range of hardware and software components into an existing system, including digital cameras, IMUs, GNSS, SSD storage and other peripheral devices. Responsible for ensuring that these devices operate reliably with the Jetson platform and that their data is correctly delivered into existing C++ processing and algorithm software.
 A significant element of the role will be the integration of new and alternative hardware into an existing system. This may include, for example, moving an existing Jetson application onto a new carrier board, integrating different cameras or sensors, adapting interfaces and drivers, and reconfiguring the software and operating system to accommodate changes in the underlying hardware, developing software interface specifications
 The role therefore requires someone who is comfortable working across the boundary between hardware and software, rather than someone focused solely on application-level software development.
 There will be travel involved so the successful individual should be prepared to travel to Ukraine (all training and briefings will be provided)
 Key Responsibilities 
 Jetson / Embedded Linux
 Develop, configure and maintain software running on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano platforms.
 Work extensively with Ubuntu Linux in an embedded environment.
 Manage system resources including:
 Diagnose and resolve hardware/software integration problems.
 Configure boot, system services, device configuration and application start-up.
 Hardware and Peripheral Integration
 Integrate and configure hardware peripherals including, but not limited to:
 Carrier Board Integration
 A key responsibility will be adapting the software platform to accommodate changes to the underlying hardware. For example: Integrating a new Jetson carrier board
 Identifying differences in peripheral interfaces and hardware configuration.
 Key skills and experience required 
 The successful candidate should be comfortable working from hardware documentation, schematics, interface specifications and manufacturer documentation rather than relying solely on pre-existing software abstractions.
 C++ Algorithm Integration
 Integrate sensor and peripheral outputs into existing C++ algorithms and processing pipelines.
 Develop interfaces between hardware acquisition software and existing application/algorithm code.
 NVIDIA CUDA / GPU
 Develop, integrate and optimise software using NVIDIA CUDA where appropriate.
 Understand the Jetson GPU architecture and its implications for application performance.
 Cyber Security
 Apply appropriate cyber-security principles to embedded Linux systems.
 Configure systems securely and minimise unnecessary services and interfaces.
 System Integration and Verification
 Develop integration and diagnostic tools as required.
 Create appropriate test procedures for hardware/software integration.
 Test new hardware components against the existing system.
 Security Clearance statement 
 Due the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a sole British National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.
 Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance- United Kingdom Security Vetting - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk) 
 To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

 Room and attention to personal development

items.desc:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the Role 
 We're looking for a People Specialist to join our International People Team with a particular focus on supporting performance management related activities throughout the EMEA (UK, Ireland, Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland and Italy) and APAC (Japan, India, South Korea, Australia and New Zealand) regions. You'll support People Partners and cross functional teams on the work that helps our managers do their jobs well: performance cases, org changes, developing manager resources, and the operational processes underneath all of it.
 Some weeks you'll be deep in a sensitive performance case coaching a manager. Other weeks you're cleaning up a process, rebuilding a tracker, or helping prep a leader for a hard conversation. We need someone who takes both kinds of work seriously and holds the same quality bar for each.
 A lot of the work is sensitive. You'll be close to performance management, org restructures, and situations that touch ER or Employment Legal. An understanding of the nuances which exist in relation to performance management and employee relations in different legal and cultural contexts will be critical. Good judgment about what to share, with whom, and in what form is paramount. 
 Responsibilities 
 Manage performance casework regionally: building documentation, tracking timelines, prepping talking points, and keeping details from falling through the cracks while owning the process end to end. 
 Own and improve operational processes that managers and People Partners depend on, including outside business activity requests and reorg processing
 Build, maintain, and improve manager resources and documentation so they're useful and current
 Partner with Leadership Design on manager enablement programs like the performance cycle: logistics, content, delivery, and the unglamorous operational work that makes programs run
 Help pull and compile reports and data for sensitive personnel matters 
 Maintain tracking systems for casework and manager enablement initiatives; make them better than you found them
 Minimum Qualifications 
 You have experience working on performance management or employee relations across Europe and ideally APAC
 You've supported complex or sensitive casework before and can work with partial information, messy handoffs, and tight timelines
 You're detail-oriented: you catch things, close loops, and remember where to find crucial information 
 Ability to operationalise and scale your work, ensuring that you are able to build over time processes, frameworks and supporting documentation to help us scale
 Strong written communication. You'll be drafting things leaders use in hard conversations, and you're not precious when they get edited (you used Claude as a guide but not as a final editor)
 Good judgment on need-to-know. You think about what to share, with whom, and what goes in writing versus what stays verbal
 You'll push back when something's off. You have a point of view and you're comfortable raising concerns with people more senior than you
 Comfortable with range. You don't check out on the tedious work or treat it as beneath you
 Ability to operate in the grey - this is a fast-paced organisation, where we are building as we scale fast; not everything will be clear-cut and you should be able to operate in this environment with confidence
 Preferred Qualifications 
 7+ years in an HR- role: people operations, HR coordination, employee relations, HRBP, or something similar
 Experience at a high-growth tech company where process was being built while you used it
 Direct experience supporting HRBPs, Managers and Employees through challenging and sensitive matters. 
 Working knowledge of HR compliance requirements in Europe and APAC
 Interest in AI safety
 Claude power user in your current role

items.desc:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.



🛠️ About our team

We’re seeking an exceptional Cyber Security Engineer to join our Germany-based team, focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 - TARA Assessment of core onboard SW
   
   - Define system assets , define preliminary security level architecture
   
   - Lead TARA assessment per architecture definition
   
   - Derive external and internal vulnerabilities and control mitigations

 - Cybersecurity Concept and Plan
   
   - Formulate a cybersecurity concept and plan that supports OEM cybersecurity compliance.
   
   - Enlist both onboard and development SW and third party library entry points and risks and mitigation plans.

 - Lead SW DevOp security requirements and validation
   
   - Lead specifications for SW DevOp nightly regression flow with respect to security screening
   
   - Lead design reviews, define a method and a flow for security improvements, vulnerability and pentests.

 - OEM and Tier 1 cybersecurity collaboration
   
   - Engage with OEMs and Tier 1s to align on external requirements/assumptions based on formulated cybersecurity concept.
   
   - Penetration testing alignment: Collaborating live with security consultants or red teams
   
   - Joint physical reviews of hardware trust boundaries, key provisioning, secure boot integration, etc.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

As part of our mission to scale end-to-end embodied AI for autonomous driving, we are building a fully automotive compliant ML software product. As an integral part of production compliance and being active in supporting customers complying ISO/SAE 21434, we are looking for an experienced system-minded cybersecurity engineer to lead the security threat analysis and risk assessment of on-board software development process and its in vehicle integration, derive cybersecurity concept and plan and continuously support our SW development cycle from the cybersecurity standpoint.


This role will be critical in defining what level and mitigation policies the company must follow as part of DevOp operation and which security assumptions are translated to OEM and Tier 1 responsibilities as part of the in-vehicle architecture, in order to deploy our embodied AI models in compliance with cybersecurity goals.

 
 

🙌 You should apply if


Essential

 - 5+ years experience in cybersecurity systems engineering.

 - Proven experience orchestrating company’s cybersecurity DevOp policies, running report investigations and ability to drive SW improvements with respect to cybersecurity.

 - Ability to apply TARA (Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment), experience with STRIDE, HEAVENS 2.0, attack trees, or similar frameworks

 - Understanding of ISO/SAE 21434 and mapping threats to cybersecurity goals

 - Skill in assessing impact × feasibility, and converting results into mitigations

 - Familiarity with Secure Boot, TPM, HSMs, and key provisioning

 - Understanding of vehicle trust boundaries, secure diagnostics, and network segmentation

 - Hands-on experience in:
   
   - Fuzzing, static analysis, reverse engineering
   
   - Familiarity with CVEs and common vulnerability classes in C/C++/Python codebases
   
   - Using tools like: Wireshark, CANoe, Binwalk, Ghidra, IDA, Metasploit, AFL, etc.
   
   - Secure Software Engineering
   
   - Systems Integration & Testing
   
   - Comfort working with CI/CD pipelines to enforce security gates

 - Ability to work cross-functionally and translate domain analysis into technical and product requirements.

 - Experience working in an agile, fast-scaling environment with a strong execution mindset.


Desirable:

Familiarity with automotive systems cybersecurity, knowledge of ECU architecture and protocols.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. items.desc: En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise EDF recherche actuellement des profils : Le groupe EDF est l'un des premiers électriciens mondiaux, à la pointe de l'innovation technologique. Le respect de la personne et celui de l'environnement, l'intégrité, la solidarité sont au cœur de nos actions. Face à l’urgence climatique, notre rôle est d’inventer un modèle énergétique qui respecte notre planète. Nous voulons construire un monde où il sera possible de produire une électricité neutre en CO2, grâce au nucléaire et aux énergies renouvelables, conciliant préservation de la planète, bien-être et développement, grâce à l’électricité et à des solutions et services innovants. \n\n La Division Numérique (DivNum) de la DPNT (Direction du Parc Nucléaire et Thermique) a pour ambition de placer l'IT au cœur de la performance industrielle de la DPNT. Elle vise à refondre le système d'information, renforcer la cybersécurité et la gestion des données, et s'appuie sur quatre piliers stratégiques : la standardisation, la cloud'isation, la data'isation et l'industrialisation. La Force d’Action Rapide du Numérique (FARNum) est l’expression d’une volonté de répondre efficacement aux enjeux des grands chantiers industriels de la DPNT. Véritable catalyseur d’innovation, la FARNum réunit une équipe agile et pluridisciplinaire, dont la mission première est de déployer et industrialiser des solutions numériques à forte valeur ajoutée. L’ADN de la FARNum repose sur une approche résolument pragmatique et orientée résultats. À travers une organisation flexible, l’équipe privilégie la rapidité d’exécution et la création de valeur immédiate, tout en s’adaptant aux besoins concrets du terrain. La FARNum est organisé en 3 pôles : Affaires et projets FAST AI IT Data Ops L’équipe Data OPS de la FARNum porte la mise en œuvre opérationnelle des cas d’usage Data et IA, depuis le cadrage technique du besoin métier jusqu’à la mise en production, en s’appuyant sur une approche industrialisée, sécurisée et à valeur. Dans ce cadre, l’équipe Data OPS cherche un.e Data Scientist qui concrétisera l’implémentation et l’usage de l’IA performante et industrielle pour répondre aux besoins métiers mais aussi aux enjeux de la DivNum. Missions principales : Implémenter et améliorer la démarche Data pour les cas d’usage : diagnostic des données, collecte et redressement, valorisation et intégration. Identifier les usages d’IA dans les projets métiers dès la phase d’instruction et de cadrage et évaluer leur faisabilité technique et conformité vis-à-vis des standards groupe en amont de tout engagement. Concevoir avec les architectes et les référents technique les architectures de solutions IA de bout en bout : frameworks, choix de l’infrastructure et des modèles, base de données, patterns, exposition, monitoring, alerting, gestion des risques et des dérives. Déployer, optimiser et piloter les produits Data et IA en production, en anticipant les contraintes de performance, de robustesse, de maintenabilité et de coût. Assurer la veille technologique IA et le partage des connaissances au sein de la FARNum et de la DivNum. Mettre en place et diffuser les bonnes pratiques (DataOps,MLOps), le code review, la capitalisation technique ainsi que l’usage de l’IA générative pour les ingénieurs data. Profil souhaité : 6 ans d'expériences minimum en conception, développement et déploiement de projet Data en production Expertise en analyse Data (diagnostic des données, cartographie des sources de données, collecte, mise en qualité). Expertise en modèles IA, Machine Learning et IA générative (LLM, RAG, Agents, Prompts). Expertise en python, SQL et NoSQL, écosystème GitHub, conteneurisation, développement d'API. Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel (qualité de code, tests, documentation) et de déploiement CI/CD. Bonne connaissance des architectures cloud (GCP, AWS) et on premise ainsi que des patterns de déploiement Data IA. Bonne connaissance de la méthode de travail Agile. Autonomie, sens de la pédagogie, fort esprit d’équipe, de proactivité et de partage. Rémunération attractive selon profil : Rémunération brute annuelle de bas hors primes : de 46 à 57K€, selon diplôme et expérience professionnelle. items.desc:
En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Atos recherche actuellement des profils : Portés par le talent et la diversité de nos 72000 collaborateurs présents dans 68 pays , nous proposons des services informatiques sécurisés et de bout en bout couvrant le cloud, la cybersécurité, la data et l’IA, les applications digitales, les plateformes intelligentes et la digital workplace, ainsi qu’un conseil en stratégie et transformation et des services personnalisés et en proximité, grâce à notre présence mondiale et à notre ancrage local. Que vous soyez étudiant, jeune diplômé ou plus expérimenté, ce qui compte pour nous c’est votre avenir. Depuis plus de 15 ans, la politique handicap du Groupe Atos est animée au quotidien par une équipe dédiée (la Mission Handicap) et par un réseau de référents handicap présents sur l'ensemble du territoire national. Les objectifs sont : Le recrutement de personnes en situation de handicap en adéquation avec les besoins du Groupe ; Le maintien dans l'emploi des salariés handicapés : action prioritaire, elle implique des adaptations de poste et de situations de travail ; La sensibilisation au handicap de l'ensemble des salariés. Découvrez une culture d’entreprise qui favorise la collaboration et l’innovation avec des opportunités d’apprentissage et de développement infinies. Soyez vous-mêmes. Développez, innovez et épanouissez-vous avec nous ! Postulez et rejoignez le « Power of We » ! 

 Pour aller plus loin, nous recherchons un(e) ingénieur(e) IA / Data Scientist, pour renforcer notre équipe nantaise et intervenir sur des projets pour des clients dans des domaines variés (Services Publics, Banque/Assurance, Transport, Industrie, Retail). Vous interviendrez sur des périmètres variés, et selon les missions, vous prendrez plus au moins part aux activités suivantes : Concevoir, entraîner et industrialiser des modèles d’apprentissage automatique et d’intelligence artificielle (générative, agentique, …), de la première analyse jusqu’à la mise en production. Construire et fiabiliser nos briques d’intelligence artificielle générative : moteurs d’inférence, évaluation des modèles, chaînes de génération augmentée par la recherche. Développer en Python des composants robustes et réutilisables (cadres et gabarits de projet) pour accélérer les équipes. Mettre en place l’industrialisation des modèles : intégration et déploiement continus, supervision et observabilité. Partager : revues de code, documentation, veille technologique et diffusion des bonnes pratiques. 

Les atouts pour réussir : Bac+5 en informatique, mathématiques, statistiques ou science des données, vous avez au minimum 3 ans d’expérience professionnelle en science des données et en ingénierie de l’intelligence artificielle. Votre expérience est variée et vous disposez d’un socle technique solide dans les domaines suivants : Science des données : analyse exploratoire des données, réduction de dimensionnalité (PCA), techniques de clustering et modélisation statistique ; apprentissage automatique et profond (Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch). Modèles de langage (LLM) : fine-tuning, prompt engineering, architectures RAG et frameworks d’orchestration ; solutions open source et souveraines autour des modèles de langage (HuggingFace, vLLM). Industrialisation (MLOps / LLMOps) : industrialisation des modèles, intégration et déploiement continus dédiés à l’intelligence artificielle, monitoring et observabilité (MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes). Développement Python : code de qualité, packaging, tests automatisés et structuration de projet. Architecture : maîtrise des API, des architectures microservices et des environnements cloud et on-premise. Sécurité : maitrise des enjeux RGPD, assurer la robustesse et la fiabilité des modèles développés, la sécurité des pipelines IA (MLOps / LLMOps) Un plus : développement front-end Angular pour nos interfaces et portails d’intelligence artificielle et des notions de Java pour le back-end de certains produits.
