items.desc: Hybrid Den Haag, Zuid-Holland, Netherlands €4,477 - €5,793 per month Product & Technology Help build the future of legal practice in the Netherlands. Job details Apply Job description Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day. As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you. You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together. You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date. You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence. You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law. You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter. You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development. Job requirements WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like. You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years. You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries. You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses. You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough. You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus. You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs. You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful. Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus. WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck. A good base salary and a standard working week of 36 hours. An end-of-year bonus of 4% of your gross annual salary and variable profit sharing of up to 6% of your gross annual salary. 23 holidays and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday allowance and 4% you can spend freely, for example on extra days off. A good pension scheme through PGB, including additional partner insurance. A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometre or a public transport allowance, plus an attractive bike scheme. For employees who live less than 10 km or more than 60 km away, we have a tailored arrangement. Hybrid working: two days a week at the office in The Hague, on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Room to grow. In your field, in your role, in …

items.desc: Why Keyrus, Why Now! Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last. Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence. Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two. Role Details Job location: Portugal (Hybrid model) ️ Travel: Available for monthly travel to Lisbon or Madrid Contract type: Employee Target start date: January 2027 Working hours: Full-time Compensation: €60k to €85k gross per year Languages: Portuguese, Spanish and English What You'll Architect As an AI Business Value Advisor , you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining technology, data, intelligence, and human decision-making. This role is both business-focused and consultative — perfect for someone who can combine deep domain expertise, AI fluency, and leadership of client engagements. We’re looking for professionals who think like architects and act like builders. You will shape the business architecture behind intelligent systems: the problems worth solving, the processes and decisions that should change, the use cases to prioritise and the outcomes that define success. You bring deep expertise in [industry / functional domain], with enough understanding of modern AI to recognise opportunities, challenge assumptions and work effectively with technical teams. Once a use case moves into technical execution, Forward Deployed Engineers and specialist engineering teams own how it is designed and deployed; you remain accountable for the business intent and agreed outcomes. Responsibilities Lead business and operational discovery , owning client-facing phases such as discovery and value reviews, and working with senior stakeholders, frontline teams and subject-matter experts to find the real problems behind an initial request. Analyse and redesign processes and decision flows , identifying where human judgement, data, automation and intelligent capabilities should interact differently. Build and prioritise a portfolio of AI opportunities , assessing business relevance, expected value, feasibility, adoption, risk, data readiness and operating-model impact. Develop clear value cases and success measures , establishing baselines, expected benefits, assumptions, dependencies and KPIs, with finance specialists where detailed modelling is needed. Translate selected opportunities into actionable business definitions : problem statements, process requirements, decision logic, user needs, acceptance criteria and intended outcomes. Create adoption and operating-model roadmaps , covering the changes in roles, processes, decision rights, ways of working and human oversight that intelligent capabilities require. Guide multidisciplinary delivery teams on business context and priorities , working with Forward Deployed Engineers, architects, AI, Software and Data Engineers and AI Governance specialists without taking over their decision rights. Review business outcomes through delivery and adoption , using agreed KPIs and operational evidence to decide whether an initiative should continue, change direction, expand or stop. Who You Are You are a senior business consultant or industry specialist who knows the key question is not what AI can do, but where it should operate and why. You understand your sector or function deeply enough to challenge an initial request rather than simply document it. You move easily between executive priorities and frontline reality. You understand how processes actually work, where decisions break down and what people need to change. You discuss AI confidently with technical teams without pretending to be the architect or engineer. You bring structure to ambiguity, make assumptions visible and challenge an initiative when the value does not justify the complexity. ️ What You Bring Qualifications & Experience Degree in Business, Economics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Ensemble, nous visons un impact maximal ! Nous croyons dans la force de la diversité : nous sommes convaincus qu’un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié conduit à plus d’innovation et de créativité ainsi qu’à de meilleurs résultats. Enterprise Data & Information Architect Identifiant de la demande: 11560 Date de début de publication: 16/10/2026 Description de fonction Elia Group recherche un(e) Domain Architect expérimenté(e) pour rejoindre son équipe Central IT Architecture. En tant que Domain IT Architect, vous contribuez à garantir un paysage IT cohérent, sécurisé, exploitable et pérenne au sein de vos domaines de responsabilité. Votre rôle est essentiel pour soutenir une exploitation fiable du réseau électrique tout en veillant à l’alignement avec la stratégie et les obligations réglementaires d’Elia Group. Dans cette fonction, la responsabilité porte sur deux domaines stratégiques : Corporate : un vaste domaine métier couvrant les capacités d’entreprise et les fonctions de support. Artificial Intelligence (AI) : un domaine technologique stratégique dédié au développement, à l’adoption et à la gouvernance des capacités AI à l’échelle de l’organisation. Au-delà de l’expertise architecturale, cette fonction requiert une approche pragmatique et orientée résultats. À l’interface entre la stratégie et l’exécution, elle consiste à transformer des ambitions business en solutions technologiques concrètes, évolutives et durables. Responsabilités En tant que Domain Architect Corporate & AI, vous contribuez à façonner l’avenir du paysage technologique d’Elia et veillez à son alignement avec les ambitions stratégiques du Groupe. Définition et pilotage de la vision d’architecture, de la roadmap et du target landscape pour les domaines Corporate IT et AI. Traduction des besoins métier et des objectifs stratégiques en architecture solutions évolutives et future-proof. Gouvernance des technology decisions en garantissant leur alignement avec les enterprise standards, les security requirements et les architecture principles. Collaboration étroite avec les stakeholders business et IT afin d’identifier des opportunités créatrices de valeur durable et favorisant l’operational excellence. Conduite des architecture reviews et accompagnement des équipes sur des enjeux complexes liés à la technologie, aux données et à l’intégration. Contribution à la portfolio optimization à travers l’application rationalization, le platform reuse et des choix technologiques durables. Garantie de l’évolutivité des solutions tout au long de leur lifecycle, depuis le design et l’implementation jusqu’aux operations et au retirement. Collaboration avec les data architects, platform architects et solution architects afin d’assurer une intégration fluide, une forte interopérabilité et une gestion des données de haute qualité. Intégration des enjeux de resilience, security, compliance et risk management dès les premières décisions architecturales. Développement et gouvernance de l’écosystème AI d’Elia afin de permettre l’adoption responsable de solutions AI créatrices d’innovation et de business value. #DomainArchitect #Architecture #CorporateIT #Oil&Energy #Utilities #LI-HYBRID Votre profil Nous recherchons un(e) architecte stratégique et collaboratif(ve), capable de combiner vision business, expertise technique et solides compétences en stakeholder management. Master en Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems ou expérience équivalente. Minimum 10 années d’expérience en IT Architecture, Enterprise Architecture ou dans des rôles liés à la Digital Transformation. Expérience démontrée dans la conception et la gouvernance de paysages IT complexes au sein d’organisations de grande envergure. Excellente maîtrise des architecture frameworks et des modelling standards tels que TOGAF et ArchiMate. items.desc: L'entreprise Créée il y a plus de 60 ans et membre du Groupe IONIS, l’IPSA est une école d’ingénieurs en aéronautique et spatial, tournée vers les métiers de la mobilité durable. Présente à Paris, Toulouse et Lyon, l’IPSA forme plus de 3 100 étudiants autour de deux cursus : • Le diplôme d’ingénieur en 5 ans • Le Bachelor aéronautique en 3 ans Société à mission, l’IPSA forme des ingénieurs audacieux, responsables, créatifs et engagés dans les transitions éthiques, sociétale et environnementale. Description du poste Dans le cadre du développement de la recherche, l’IPSA recherche un chercheur, basé à Ivry sur seine. Vos missions principales seront les suivantes : Mission 1 développer une méthodologie théorique et numérique pour la caractérisation de trois familles moléculaires d’intérêt pour les biocarburants : la trioléine, représentative des triacylglycérols (TAG), les cétones ou méthylcétones, et les botryococcènes, hydrocarbures issus D’algues. L’étude combinera la chimie computationnelle, l’apprentissage automatique et les spectroscopies Raman, infrarouge (IR) et de résonance magnétique nucléaire (RMN) afin d’identifier leurs signatures moléculaires spécifiques. [Mission 2] générer, sélectionner et optimiser les conformères pertinents de ces molécules à l’aide de méthodes de l’apprentissage automatique. [Mission 3] simuler les spectres Raman et IR ainsi que les paramètres RMN par des approches fondées sur la théorie de la fonctionnelle de la densité (DFT). Les résultats théoriques seront comparés aux données expérimentales pour [Mission 4]- attribuer les bandes vibrationnelles, les déplacements chimiques et les principaux signaux caractéristiques. Des méthodes d’intelligence artificielle pourront être développées pour classer les spectres, prédire les signatures moléculaires et différencier ces composés dans des matrices algales et lipidiques. Formation : Doctorat (Bac+8) en chimie théorique et computationnelle, physico-chimie, physique moléculaire, spectroscopie, ou dans un domaine scientifique étroitement lié. Expérience : Expérience de recherche, acquise notamment au cours du doctorat, en modélisation moléculaire et/ou calculs DFT, idéalement associée à l’exploitation ou à la simulation de données spectroscopiques. Compétences : Maîtrise des calculs DFT, connaissances en spectroscopies Raman, infrarouge (IR) et/ou RMN ; Programmation scientifique et en traitement de données- Python ; Connaissances en apprentissage automatique pour la classification, la différenciation ou la prédiction de données spectrales ; Bon niveau d’anglais scientifique et aptitude à travailler dans un environnement de recherche multidisciplinaire. Qualités personnelles : Esprit d’équipe, capacité d’innovation et créativité, faculté d’adaptation, autonomie scientifique, rigueur et aptitude à résoudre des problèmes complexes. Une appétence pour l’aéronautique, le spatial ou l’enseignement supérieur est un plus. Si vous souhaitez rejoindre le leader de l’enseignement supérieur privé en France porté sur l’innovation et l’esprit d’entreprendre et intégrer des équipes passionnées et pleines d’ambitions, alors n’hésitez pas à postuler ! Ionis Groupe s’engage en faveur d’une politique de recrutement diversifiée, inclusive et équitable afin de favoriser l’égalité des chances. Nous avons à cœur de privilégier des équipes mixtes en promouvant la non-discrimination en termes de handicap, de mixité sociale, d’égalité des sexes ou encore d’intergénérationnel. L'entreprise Atos recherche actuellement des profils : Portés par le talent et la diversité de nos 72000 collaborateurs présents dans 68 pays , nous proposons des services informatiques sécurisés et de bout en bout couvrant le cloud, la cybersécurité, la data et l’IA, les applications digitales, les plateformes intelligentes et la digital workplace, ainsi qu’un conseil en stratégie et transformation et des services personnalisés et en proximité, grâce à notre présence mondiale et à notre ancrage local. Que vous soyez étudiant, jeune diplômé ou plus expérimenté, ce qui compte pour nous c’est votre avenir. Depuis plus de 15 ans, la politique handicap du Groupe Atos est animée au quotidien par une équipe dédiée (la Mission Handicap) et par un réseau de référents handicap présents sur l'ensemble du territoire national. Les objectifs sont : Le recrutement de personnes en situation de handicap en adéquation avec les besoins du Groupe ; Le maintien dans l'emploi des salariés handicapés : action prioritaire, elle implique des adaptations de poste et de situations de travail ; La sensibilisation au handicap de l'ensemble des salariés. Découvrez une culture d’entreprise qui favorise la collaboration et l’innovation avec des opportunités d’apprentissage et de développement infinies. Soyez vous-mêmes. Développez, innovez et épanouissez-vous avec nous ! Postulez et rejoignez le « Power of We » ! 

 Le poste en quelques mots Nous sommes à la recherche de notre futur·e Intégrateur / Intégratrice SOC pour renforcer nos équipes cybersécurité et intervenir sur des projets d’intégration et d’évolution de solutions SOC. Vous contribuerez à l’industrialisation des pipelines de logs et à l’amélioration des capacités de détection. Ce poste nécessitera une habilitation secret . Ce que vous allez faire si vous nous rejoignez Concevoir et maintenir des pipelines de collecte de logs (ingestion, forwarding) Intégrer de nouvelles sources de données et garantir la qualité des flux Développer des règles de parsing et normaliser les données (ECS, CIM, ASIM…) Enrichir les événements pour améliorer la détection dans les outils SIEM Intégrer les flux vers des solutions SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, Wazuh) Automatiser les déploiements et superviser les pipelines de données Assister les équipes SOC sur les problématiques d’ingestion et de fiabilité Participer à l’amélioration continue des capacités de détection et d’observabilité Rédiger la documentation technique et les schémas d’architecture

items.desc: Description de l’offre d’emploi Si vous vous épanouissez dans le travail en commun, la relation aux autres, dans la recherche de solutions opérationnelles et parfois innovantes, le service des affaires juridiques et commande publique du Pays de l’Or vous ouvre ses portes. Depuis plusieurs années, le service s’est organisé en harmonisant les process, en renforçant les compétences des agents de l’équipe et en instaurant un système d’amélioration continue des pratiques pour développer une véritable ingénierie des contrats au service de l’ensemble des directions opérationnelles de la collectivité. Porteuse d’un réel engagement en matière de transition écologique et solidaire, l’Agglomération du Pays de l’Or poursuit aujourd’hui son action en souhaitant faire de la commande publique un levier stratégique majeur pour son territoire. A cette fin, l’Agglomération a mis en place son premier Schéma de Promotion des Achats Socialement et Ecologiquement Responsables (SPASER) applicable depuis le 1er janvier 2026. Dans le cadre d’un départ d’un des agents du service, l’Agglomération de l’Or souhaite recruter un(e) chargé(e) de la commande publique capable de s’investir, de s’épanouir et de prendre du plaisir à manipuler la matière. Directement rattaché(e) au responsable du Service des Affaires juridiques et de la Commande publique au sein de la Direction de l’Administration Générale de l’Agglomération, le(a) chargé(e) de missions travaillera à la politique achats de la collectivité et gérera les procédures de marchés publics en liaison avec tous les services compétents. A ce titre, il (elle) assurera les missions suivantes : Le montage et la passation de l’ensemble des contrats de fournitures, de services, de travaux et de prestations intellectuelles en lien avec les services prescripteurs : Accompagner les services opérationnels dans la définition de leurs besoins, les conseiller dans le montage des contrats, sécuriser les procédures Rédiger les pièces administratives des marchés et participer aux différentes étapes de la procédure de mise en concurrence et d’attribution, en lien avec les services opérationnels et les gestionnaires du service Centraliser et préparer les dossiers des commissions (commissions d’appels d’offres, commissions MAPA, etc.) Porter assistance aux services opérationnels pour des consultations directes de prestataires (mise en concurrence simplifiée, procédures négociées…) S’approprier les nouveaux outils du droit de la commande publique pour faciliter l’accès des TPE/PME à la commande publique d’une part Participer au développement d’outils pour la définition de cas d’usage et l’intégration de l’intelligence artificielle dans les pratiques métier Assurer le rôle de correspondant administratif des entreprises Renforcer le suivi d’exécution des marchés (avenant, sous-traitance, reconduction, renouvellement, …) et assister les services dans la gestion de situations contractuelles Porter assistance au chargé de missions SPASER dans la mise en place d’outils pour le suivi et l’amélioration du SPASER de la collectivité Assurer la veille juridique en relation avec les autres membres de l’équipe En outre, le ou la chargé(e) de commande publique participera également à l’accompagnement des organes de décisions de la collectivité en lien direct et sous la supervision de la responsable des assemblées de la collectivité . items.desc: En 1948, Guy Degrenne rêvait d’offrir le beau à tous, en créant des pièces qui résistent au temps et subliment chaque repas. Plus de 75 ans plus tard, cet esprit visionnaire demeure Maison familiale française d’arts de la table depuis 1948, Guy Degrenne cultive des savoir-faire d’excellence, transmis et réinventés au fil des générations, pour magnifier l’art de recevoir. Dans nos trois Manufactures, à Vire en Normandie, à Limoges et en Hongrie pour la porcelaine, se perpétuent des gestes rares. L’inox, le métal argenté, la porcelaine fine : chaque matière raconte une histoire, celle d’un savoir-faire transmis et réinventé. Ici, l’artisanat rencontre la précision industrielle pour créer des collections raffinées, pensées pour les Chefs et les gastronomes. Guy Degrenne incarne l’art de vivre à la française : la convivialité, le goût du détail, la beauté intemporelle. Nos créations accompagnent les hôtels haut de gamme, les restaurants d’exception et les tables privées où chaque repas devient une expérience. LE POSTE Rattaché(e) à la Direction Générale, vous êtes le/la référent(e) du système d’information. Votre rôle sera particulièrement transverse : infrastructure, sécurité, ERP, projets, accompagnement des utilisateurs et amélioration continue, mise en place et suivi IA. Vous serez un véritable interlocuteur des équipes métiers et de la Direction pour faire évoluer un SI fiable, sécurisé et adapté aux besoins du groupe. VOS MISSIONS Être responsable de la gestion quotidienne des opérations informatiques, y compris l’infrastructure réseau, les serveurs, les bases de données, les systèmes de stockages et les logiciels. Veiller à ce que les systèmes informatiques soient opérationnels, sécurisés et répondent aux besoins de l’organisation Superviser la gestion des projets informatiques (mise en place d’un nouvel ERP pour les manufactures du groupe et le développement de l’IA) pour finaliser la transformation digitale. Définir les objectifs, les délais et les ressources nécessaires, et s’assurer que les projets sont livrés selon les attentes. Coordonner les équipes et collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes et externes pour assurer la réussite du projet Garantir la sécurité des systèmes d’informations du groupe. Assurer la mise en œuvre des politiques de sécurité, surveiller les menaces et les risques potentiels, et établir des protocoles pour prévenir les intrusions, les pertes de données et les violations de confidentialité. Manager l’équipe informatique du groupe. Recruter, former et superviser le personnel, et s’assurer que l’équipe dispose des compétences et des ressources nécessaires pour remplir ses fonctions Vous justifiez de 5 ans d’expérience minimum. Vous disposez de compétences en systèmes, réseaux et sécurité informatique, en ERP et gestion de projets SI. Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes autonome, pragmatique, force de proposition et doté(e) d’un excellent relationnel. Anglais professionnel, une compréhension et une maitrise des sujets IA aussi bien dans l’utilisation que dans la sécurisation sont requis.

Vous mettez en place et faites vivre les pratiques DevOps : CI/CD, automatisation des déploiements, intégration et tests continus, gestion des environnements. Vous concevez et déployez des infrastructures cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) en vous appuyant sur l’Infrastructure as Code, et vous pilotez les aspects sécurité, monitoring et performance. Vous accompagnez les équipes projet (développement, exploitation, sécurité) et définissez les standards techniques, les bonnes pratiques et les patterns d’architecture à appliquer. Qualifications Vous disposez d’une expertise avérée sur Kubernetes et la conteneurisation (Docker), et vous maîtrisez la mise en œuvre d’environnements scalables et résilients. Vous maîtrisez le développement backend en Java (Spring) et en Python, et vous êtes à l’aise avec les bonnes pratiques de conception logicielle (tests, clean code, APIs, etc.). Vous mettez en œuvre des pratiques DevOps (CI/CD, automatisation, gestion de configuration) et vous connaissez les principaux clouds publics (AWS, Azure, GCP) ainsi que l’Infrastructure as Code. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à gérer les enjeux de sécurité, de monitoring et de performance, et pour votre aptitude à accompagner les équipes et à définir des standards techniques partagés. Curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et orienté(e) solution, vous avez envie d’apprendre, de partager et d’avoir un impact concret sur des projets à forte valeur ajoutée ; une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est un plus selon les projets. Vous avez au moins 5 ans d’expérience en conception d’architectures distribuées, microservices et/ou plateformes cloud dans un contexte applicatif exigeant. Découvrez une culture d’entreprise qui favorise la collaboration et l’innovation avec des opportunités d’apprentissage et de développement infinies. Soyez vous-mêmes. Développez, innovez et épanouissez-vous avec nous ! Postulez et rejoignez le « Power of We » !

Vous serez garant(e) de la conception générale et de la cohérence des architectures fonctionnelles et techniques. L'entreprise Capgemini recherche actuellement des profils : Partenaire mondial de la transformation business et technologique, Capgemini intègre la puissance de l’IA pour créer de la valeur pour ses clients. Nous imaginons le futur des organisations et le rendons réel grâce à l’IA, à la technologie et à nos talents. Depuis près de 60 ans, nous sommes un groupe responsable et multiculturel, avec 420000 collaborateurs dans plus de 50 pays. Capgemini propose des services et des solutions de bout en bout, en mobilisant son expertise sectorielle, son écosystème de partenaires et ses compétences de pointe en stratégie, technologie, design, ingénierie et opérations. Le Groupe a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires mondial de 22,1 milliards d’euros en 2024. Choisir Capgemini, c’est avoir la possibilité de faire la différence, que ce soit pour les plus grandes entreprises du monde ou pour la société. Nous recherchons des talents pour entreprendre, inventer, oser, accompagner et construire un avenir inclusif et durable. Ensemble, donnons à la technologie cette touche humaine dont le monde a besoin. Make it real* | www.capgemini.com 

Description de l'entreprise Vous êtes Architecte Cloud ? Vous souhaitez vous investir au sein d'une équipe dynamique, passionnée et aux valeurs humaines fortes, capable d’accompagner ses clients sur toute la chaîne de valeur du projet (Conseil, Expertise et Intégration). Rejoindre nos équipes, c’est appartenir à une communauté internationale d’experts qui travaillent sur des projets passionnants pour divers clients prestigieux. Grâce à nos différents partenariats (AWS, Microsoft, Google, IBM…), nous vous donnerons toutes les clés pour vous former et vous certifier. Notre objectif : faire de vous un véritable expert reconnu et vous faire évoluer vers des postes à responsabilités afin d’accompagner nos clients tout au long de leur transformation digitale. Capgemini veillera à votre épanouissement professionnel au travers de moment de partage. Venir chez Capgemini c’est intégrer une équipe ambitieuse, fun et dynamique ! Concrètement, qu’ allez-vous faire de vos journées ? * Gérer des projets de transformation cloud de bout en bout depuis la phase d’avant-vente au déploiement de la solution, * Développer des solutions cloud opérationnelles, * Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions/projets innovants et compétitifs en interagissant avec les clients, les partenaires et les autres business units, * Définir les standards d’architecture technique (rédaction de documentations), * Participer à l’animation de la communauté d’architecte du Groupe.

Et comment devenir un Capgeminien ? * Vous êtes de formation supérieure en informatique BAC +4/5, * Vous disposez d’une expérience de 5 ans minimum dans un poste similaire et d’une expertise spécifique sur les architectures cloud AWS, * Vous possédez des connaissances sur des plateformes AWS, de l’architecture à multi-niveaux et d’ITIL, * Vous avez une excellente capacité rédactionnelle tant en français qu’en anglais ; la maîtrise de l’Anglais étant indispensable, * Vous faites preuve d'une bonne « orientation client » et vous avez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles. Le poste n’est malheureusement pas pour vous, si : * Le Cloud n’est pas votre passion * Vous pensez ne plus rien avoir à apprendre #Architecte#Cloud#AWS#Certification#ITIL#Anglais Capgemini recherche une personne qui souhaite s’investir et faire vivre notre communauté d’experts. Si vous souhaitez participer à des projets d'envergures dans un environnement motivant. N’hésitez plus et rejoignez la practice Cloud Infrastructure Services de CAPGEMINI. CAPGEMINI, entreprise handi-accueillante, conformément à la norme ANFOR NF X50-783, est également signataire de la charte de la diversité en entreprise.

 En tant que consultant(e) sécurité et sous la responsabilité du responsable de l’équipe intégration, vous aurez la charge de : Gérer l'intégration de la solution logicielle dans le S.I. client Être en support et conseiller le client sur les choix d'intégration Automatiser le déploiement et la configuration des composants Maintenir en condition la plateforme de production sécurisée du client Rédiger la documentation d'architecture, d'installation, cahier de test et d'exploitation Compétences techniques exigées : Maîtrise des environnements linux / Windows et environnement de virtualisation (VMware, …) Sécurité Palo Alto, Stormshield, Juniper, CheckPoint, McAfee CASB, CyberArk, Wallix, IAM, Ping, Okta, PKI, AD, MFA, DLP, AV McAfee, ESET, EDR, AZURE, AWS, GCP, F5, Cisco, TGB, Sophos, Bertin, Tanium, SIEM RSA Netwitness, Splunk, Skybox, GRC RSA Archer… Bonne connaissance en réseaux IP Développement : Scripting, Shell, Python 

De formation Bac+5, vous avez une expérience significative d'au moins 5 ans en intégration cybersécurité matérielle ou logicielle. 5 ans d'expérience en ESN ou en cabinet de conseil Rigueur et capacité d'analyse Travail d'équipe Certifications fournisseurs appréciées (Stormshield, CyberArk...) Anglais : écrit et oral Ce que nous proposons: Jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine Tickets restaurant (valeur faciale 10€, prise en charge 60%) Evénements d'intégration et moments conviviaux réguliers (selon les périmètres/site) Tous vos congés disponibles dès votre arrivée Programme de cooptation jusqu’à 2750 € Accès aux activités sociales et culturelles Aide à la mobilité durable (vélo, covoiturage) La diversité est un moteur au service de la créativité de nos clients, et nous nous efforçons chaque jour de créer un environnement où chacun se sent soutenu et encouragé. La « Tech for Good » s'inscrit au cœur de notre mission, que ce soit en matière de lutte contre le changement climatique, pour promouvoir l'inclusion numérique ou garantir la confiance dans la gestion des données. Nous sommes fiers des nombreuses reconnaissances mondiales pour nos pratiques environnementales, sociales et de gouvernance, et nous nous engageons à construire un avenir meilleur pour tous en exploitant le pouvoir de la technologie.

items.desc: An Amazing Career Opportunity for a Product Owner!! Location: La Ciotat Job ID: 51649 Do you enjoy bringing business needs and technology? As Product Owner, you'll lead product decisions, collaborate with teams in France and India, and deliver smart solutions that transform textile operations worldwide. Who are we? HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. Identification Technologies (IDT):IDT is creating trusted identities for IoT applications through Smart Components and Enabling Services. HID’s Identification Technologies powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things through smart components and cloud services. We make it possible for people and organizations to transact safely, work productively, and travel freely. Our contactless identification and sensing (RFID, NFC, and BLE) components and solution enabling technologies address the dynamic requirements across multiple industries to wirelessly connect, identify, collect and manage data quickly and accurately across virtually any IoT application. You will join our Business Unit specializes in textile management. Our products include durable RFID tags, powerful readers and specialized software to automate inventory tracking across industrial laundries, hotels, hospitals and uniform operations. As our Product Owner, you’ll support HID’s success by: maximize the value delivered by the product by translating product strategy and customer needs into a clear, prioritized and actionable Product Backlog. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Support and Delivery (with teams based in France and India) to ensure that product increments are clearly defined, functionally validated and ready for release. You will report to the Director, Solutions Product Management Product Direction and Stakeholder Alignment Develop a thorough understanding of the product vision, strategic objectives, target users and key customer needs defined with Product Management. Translate the Product Roadmap, owned and maintained by Product Management, into a clear and actionable Product Backlog. Work closely with Product Management, Sales, Support, Delivery and customers to capture feedback, market needs and operational issues. Communicate product priorities, intended outcomes and key decisions clearly to the development team and stakeholders. Product Backlog Ownership Own, maintain, refine and prioritize the Product Backlog to maximize product value and support agreed business priorities. Ensure that backlog items are sufficiently detailed, understood and ready before Sprint Planning. Translate product features into clear user stories, including business context, acceptance criteria and relevant dependencies. Delivery and Functional Validation Act as the day-to-day product decision-maker for the development team, providing timely clarification and removing functional impediments. Participate actively in Scrum ceremonies and ensure that product decisions are made promptly. Work with Engineering to ensure that functional and non-functional requirements, technical dependencies, operational constraints and known limitations are clearly understood before development begins. Release Scope and Functional Readiness Own the functional readiness of each release, ensuring that the release scope, functional testing, documentation, training needs and stakeholder communication are complete before production deployment. Define release scope and contribute to target dates and delivery commitments, working jointly with Engineering to assess effort, technical readiness, dependencies, risks and capacity. Participate in release readiness and go/no-go reviews with the appropriate stakeholders; go/no-go decisions are shared between Product and Engineering. Your Experience and Background include: Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, Engineering, Business or a related field is preferred; equivalent professional experience will also be considered Minimum of 5 years of Product Owner experience preferably in a software, SaaS, IoT, RFID or connected-product environment. You have a strong practical understanding of Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum, and experience working closely with software development teams Strong ability to understand customer workflows, identify user needs and translate them into clear product requirements. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product Management, Engineering, Support, Delivery and commercial teams Ability to make timely decisions, manage competing priorities and communicate risks or dependencies clearly Fluent in English and French, both written and spoken. • Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. items.title: Software Engineer, Go (Edge)
items.card: What you'll do Design and build the Go services behind our serverless platform, function deployment pipeline, and global control plane. Own backend and control-plane software, from customer-facing APIs and resource lifecycles to services that deploy and manage workloads across our edge infrastructure. Make the platform great to use: clean APIs, a sharp CLI, predictable behaviour, and useful error messages. Developer
items.desc: About Telnyx Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications. We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. What you'll do Design and build the Go services behind our serverless platform, function deployment pipeline, and global control plane. Own backend and control-plane software, from customer-facing APIs and resource lifecycles to services that deploy and manage workloads across our edge infrastructure. Make the platform great to use: clean APIs, a sharp CLI, predictable behaviour, and useful error messages. Developer experience is a feature, not an afterthought. Build reliable workflows for deployments, configuration, storage, and observability. Handle the retries, state, and failure cases that come with operations spanning multiple services and data centres. Work with Kubernetes and our runtime infrastructure through the control plane, and help diagnose latency, throughput, and reliability issues across the platform. Build tooling that helps us operate safely at scale. Participate in on-call for the systems you build. What we're looking for 2–5 years of professional backend software development experience. Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in a comparable backend language (Rust, Java, C++) and an interest in writing Go day-to-day. Solid distributed systems fundamentals. You've debugged service-to-service problems in production and understand retries, partial failures, and idempotency. Comfort designing APIs and resource models that other engineers will actually use. Experience with relational databases, including schemas, transactions, and migrations. Experience building asynchronous systems using queues, background jobs, state machines, or similar patterns. Working knowledge of Kubernetes and an interest in building software that deploys and manages workloads on Kubernetes-based infrastructure. Experience running highly available services, including being on-call. Bonus points for Experience building developer tools, platforms, control planes, runtimes, or other products for developers. Experience building software that interacts with Kubernetes, such as controllers, operators, or deployment systems. Familiarity with serverless or edge-compute platforms (Cloudflare Workers, Fastly Compute, Lambda, Fly.io, Deno Deploy, etc.). Experience with technologies in our stack such as Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, NATS/JetStream, Knative, or Dapr. Experience operating software across multiple regions or data centres. Open source contributions, particularly in the Go ecosystem.

You design cloud-native solution architectures based on Kubernetes for highly secure and regulated environments You create technical solution designs as well as architecture and platform documentation (containers, storage, networking, observability) You design CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows (e.g. Flux, ArgoCD), especially for air-gapped and offline environments You evaluate and integrate CNCF technologies and cloud-native components into existing platform architectures You support the design of Kubernetes-based workloads including VM workloads (KubeVirt) and HPC/AI scenarios (GPU operator) You create architecture and security documentation and support accreditation processes as well as BSI baseline security requirements You contribute to reference architectures, deployment blueprints, and technical customer advisory during transformation projects Requirements You have solid experience as a Solution Architect in cloud-native and DevOps environments, including the implementation of complex Kubernetes-based platform solutions, ideally within the public sector or defence industry. Furthermore, you are characterized by in-depth expertise and skills: Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, Kubernetes, and container orchestration (min. 3 years experience) Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and GitOps methodologies (Flux, ArgoCD) Solid understanding of the CNCF ecosystem and modern cloud platform architectures Experience in creating solution designs and technical architecture documentation Strong knowledge of Linux system administration and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Crossplane) Understanding of network virtualization, SDN, CNI, and service mesh concepts Experience in public sector or defence environments and knowledge of BSI baseline security standards Strong knowledge of IT Service Management (ITIL Foundation or higher) Several years of experience (min. 3 years) in ITIL-based consulting and service design processes At least 5 years of experience in public sector environments (federal ministries, agencies, subordinate authorities) Native-level German and very good English skills in spoken and written communication What we offer Flexible working arrangements with hybrid models, remote work options, and flexible hours Individual development through certifications, training programs, and clear career paths in cloud-native technologies Modern working environment with cutting-edge tools and technologies for cloud and DevOps architecture Exciting, high-security projects in cloud transformation, public sector, and defence domains Open and collaborative company culture with strong teamwork orientation Competitive compensation package and comprehensive employee benefits Health and well-being programs supporting work-life balance Your application can be processed by external service providers in Germany. Applications for positions outside Deutsche Telekom AG can also be processed by recruiters in other European countries. This also applies to the processing of applications at subsidiaries of Deutsche Telekom AG. For our civil servant employees, therefore, the following note: You are not obliged to attach documents relevant to personnel files, in particular civil servant appraisals, with your application. However, you are free to provide these documents voluntarily. This position is also possible on a part-time basis. Severely disabled people will be given priority if they are equally qualified. items.desc: About Telnyx Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications. We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. What you'll do Design and build the Go services behind our serverless platform, function deployment pipeline, and global control plane. Own backend and control-plane software, from customer-facing APIs and resource lifecycles to services that deploy and manage workloads across our edge infrastructure. Make the platform great to use: clean APIs, a sharp CLI, predictable behaviour, and useful error messages. Developer experience is a feature, not an afterthought. Build reliable workflows for deployments, configuration, storage, and observability. Handle the retries, state, and failure cases that come with operations spanning multiple services and data centres. Work with Kubernetes and our runtime infrastructure through the control plane, and help diagnose latency, throughput, and reliability issues across the platform. Build tooling that helps us operate safely at scale. Participate in on-call for the systems you build. What we're looking for 2–5 years of professional backend software development experience. Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in a comparable backend language (Rust, Java, C++) and an interest in writing Go day-to-day. Solid distributed systems fundamentals. You've debugged service-to-service problems in production and understand retries, partial failures, and idempotency. Comfort designing APIs and resource models that other engineers will actually use. Experience with relational databases, including schemas, transactions, and migrations. Experience building asynchronous systems using queues, background jobs, state machines, or similar patterns. Working knowledge of Kubernetes and an interest in building software that deploys and manages workloads on Kubernetes-based infrastructure. Experience running highly available services, including being on-call. Bonus points for Experience building developer tools, platforms, control planes, runtimes, or other products for developers. Experience building software that interacts with Kubernetes, such as controllers, operators, or deployment systems. Familiarity with serverless or edge-compute platforms (Cloudflare Workers, Fastly Compute, Lambda, Fly.io, Deno Deploy, etc.). Experience with technologies in our stack such as Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, NATS/JetStream, Knative, or Dapr. Experience operating software across multiple regions or data centres. Open source contributions, particularly in the Go ecosystem.

items.desc: Job Description (Senior) Data Engineer Job Location: Delft Division: Destination & Retail Work Model: Hybrid Full-Time/Part-Time: Full Time Contract Type: Permanent Job Req ID: 1782 Are you ready to be the owner of data systems that power critical business decisions? Do you thrive when you can turn raw data into reliable pipelines, scalable infrastructure, and insights that drive real impact? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you. Within ABB E-mobility, we are building a new venture focused on an end-to-end managed offering that brings together hardware, software, and operational excellence into a unified service model. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-impact business within ABB E-mobility, where you as (Senior) Data Engineer will play a key role in shaping the data platform for our next growth chapter. What you will do: We are looking for a (Senior) Data Engineer to be our first internal hire in this new venture. Our data platform has been built on Azure Databricks and is live in production. You will own it end-to-end. Note: This is not a role for the faint of heart. You’ll be joining a fast-moving team where priorities shift quickly, challenges come without warning, and solutions rarely exist yet. It will demand grit, speed, and relentless ownership. Your responsibilities will include: Own our data platform end-to-end, whether it means deciding on the best strategy to ingest a new data source or repairing a broken pipeline at 10 pm (thankfully our pipelines rarely break :)) Proactively identify data quality issues, pipeline gaps, and business logic inconsistencies before data consumers find them Build and maintain data pipelines using Delta Live Tables (DLT) as our core framework, authored in Python and SQL and deployed via Databricks Asset Bundles Extend and maintain our custom API ingestion framework (a native Spark Data Source) to onboard new data sources, handling pagination, incremental state, and schema evolution Integrate and process streaming data from Azure Event Hubs into our data Lakehouse Own data modelling and medallion architecture decisions (Bronze/Silver/Gold), including evolving them as the business grows Develop a genuine understanding of the business domain: charging network operations, industry protocols (OCPP, OCPI), billing logic, and how the data is used by our Operations team Orchestrate and monitor multi-step jobs end-to-end using Databricks Workflows Manage and evolve cloud infrastructure using Terraform on Azure (Event Hubs, ADLS, Key Vault, Unity Catalog, networking) in combination with Databricks Asset Bundles for workspace assets Enforce data quality through DLT expectations and SQL alert definitions; own freshness and observability standards for the platform Maintain CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps Contribute to our customer-facing Charging Portal, which currently embeds Databricks dashboards and serves as the foundation for future API endpoints and customer self-service features What you will bring: You thrive in ambiguity and like to own outcomes. You excel where things are undefined, turning chaos into structure. You don’t wait for perfect clarity to act. You build, iterate, and scale. You learn new domains fast, both the technical protocols and what they mean in practice for the people depending on them. You can sit with our Operations team, understand what they actually need, and go build it without handholding. You communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders and know when to surface a problem versus silently fix it. Your qualifications: 4–7 years of experience as a Data Engineer or equivalent role Strong SQL and PySpark skills, comfortable reasoning about distributed execution, partitioning, and query performance Hands-on experience with Databricks, ideally with Delta Live Tables (DLT), Databricks Workflows, and Unity Catalog Experience with streaming data architectures (Azure Event Hubs or equivalent) Experience building REST API ingestion pipelines: incremental loads, pagination, schema evolution, auth patterns Comfortable with cloud infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred, or equivalent) Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or equivalent) Truly autonomous, able to define your own priorities and make architectural decisions you can defend Deeply curious about the business domain, you'll be expected to learn and understand the EV charging industry, protocols, billing flows, etc. Strong ownership mentality, you treat production incidents as your personal responsibility Comfortable managing shifting priorities and ambiguity Fluent in English, with strong written and oral communication skills What we can offer: Work with the best specialists in their field, in a diverse environment with unparalleled global reach. items.desc: About Telnyx Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications. We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. What you'll do Design and build the Go services behind our serverless platform, function deployment pipeline, and global control plane. Own backend and control-plane software, from customer-facing APIs and resource lifecycles to services that deploy and manage workloads across our edge infrastructure. Make the platform great to use: clean APIs, a sharp CLI, predictable behaviour, and useful error messages. Developer experience is a feature, not an afterthought. Build reliable workflows for deployments, configuration, storage, and observability. Handle the retries, state, and failure cases that come with operations spanning multiple services and data centres. Work with Kubernetes and our runtime infrastructure through the control plane, and help diagnose latency, throughput, and reliability issues across the platform. Build tooling that helps us operate safely at scale. Participate in on-call for the systems you build. What we're looking for 2–5 years of professional backend software development experience. Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in a comparable backend language (Rust, Java, C++) and an interest in writing Go day-to-day. Solid distributed systems fundamentals. You've debugged service-to-service problems in production and understand retries, partial failures, and idempotency. Comfort designing APIs and resource models that other engineers will actually use. Experience with relational databases, including schemas, transactions, and migrations. Experience building asynchronous systems using queues, background jobs, state machines, or similar patterns. Working knowledge of Kubernetes and an interest in building software that deploys and manages workloads on Kubernetes-based infrastructure. Experience running highly available services, including being on-call. Bonus points for Experience building developer tools, platforms, control planes, runtimes, or other products for developers. Experience building software that interacts with Kubernetes, such as controllers, operators, or deployment systems. Familiarity with serverless or edge-compute platforms (Cloudflare Workers, Fastly Compute, Lambda, Fly.io, Deno Deploy, etc.). Experience with technologies in our stack such as Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, NATS/JetStream, Knative, or Dapr. Experience operating software across multiple regions or data centres. Open source contributions, particularly in the Go ecosystem.

items.card: job description - maybe it suits you or one of your friends? Aviva is looking for a Security Analyst responsible for daily cyber threat monitoring and response across Aviva Group globally. Ready to catapult your cyber security
items.desc: Hi, we're glad you're here! We are hiring to our Aviva Services Excellence Centre! Take a look at our job description - maybe it suits you or one of your friends? Aviva is looking for a Security Analyst responsible for daily cyber threat monitoring and response across Aviva Group globally. You won’t just be watching alerts; you’ll be managing incidents end-to-end, mitigating threats and having real impact on how we operate, detect and respond to cyber incidents. Why join us? Ready to catapult your cyber security career? Join our high-octane Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC) , where no two days - and no two threats - are ever the same. We’re looking for a passionate SOC Analyst to join a world-class team defending our organization 24/7/365, operating on 12h shifts. In-House Power: We manage our security internally. Here, you aren't just a consultant; you have direct influence over our actual defence mechanisms. Constant Evolution: Forget the routine. You’ll face complex, evolving challenges that keep your skills sharp. Cyber - One of Aviva's Key Priorities: We must ensure our colleagues, customers and business are safe. Cyber security is deeply embedded in our organisation and its importance is recognized across the Group. Investing in our people, capabilities and technologies is at the heart of our values. Career Progression: We love seeing our people grow. We put our colleagues first by enabling and supporting career development within cyber and other areas. What will you be doing? Real-Time Defence: Monitoring IT security breaches, responding to cyber incidents to ensure threats are adequately mitigated. Incident Ownership: Driving cyber incident response through the lifecycle, from the detection to containment, eradication and recovery. Threat Correlation: Connecting the dots between different cyber threats to see the bigger picture. Detection Optimization: Recommending improvements for correlation rules and fine-tuning our "radar." Documentation Mastery: Drafting GSOC technical playbooks, response plans, and processes. Subject Matter Expertise: Acting as an SME for GSOC and Detection & Response projects. What we’re looking for: Experience: At least 1 year of hands-on working as a SOC Analyst. Communication: English at a minimum B2/C1 level (written and spoken). Framework Knowledge: Solid understanding of the NIST standard for incident management, ITIL Foundation, the MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain. Autonomy: The ability to work independently, make critical decisions under pressure and tight time scales. Technical Foundations: Strong grasp of networking (Protocols, ISO/OSI) and IT service operations, knowledge of Windows, Linux, iOS, and Active Directory. Tool Proficiency: Hands-on experience with DLP, EDR, SIEM, Firewalls, IPS/IDS, and SOAR. Being Ahead of the Game: A hunger for OSINT, proactive approach to incident response and picking up tasks, providing improvement ideas. In Aviva Services Excellence Centre, we provide: Contract of employment Performance Bonus Private medical care (ENEL-MED) Cafeteria system of benefits (e.g. MultiSport card) Additional parent privileges: baby leave – 6 weeks leave for second parent shortened working time after parental leave Employer-funded group insurance Employee Shares Plan Extra day off for birthday Paid time off to volunteer Additional leave acquired over the years in the company (even 5 days more in a year) Wellbeing Leave - additional two weeks paid leave after 10 years of service Psychological support consultations Access to the e-learning platforms Internal employee referral program Hybrid working model from Poland with a few days in Warsaw office per month Attractive office location in Warsaw - Gdański Business Center Additional entitlements for people with disabilities - Work Without Barriers Work environment that promotes diversity - Diversity Charter Do you see yourself in Aviva Services Excellence Centre? Most of our people are smart working – spending also time in our office - combining the benefits of flexibility, with time together with colleagues. We’re inclusive - we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. Excited but not sure you tick every box? Research tells us that women, particularly, feel this way. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned. Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations. Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution. For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets. May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. items.desc: Your Mission At INBRAIN, we are developing intelligent neural technologies powered by graphene to create life-changing therapies for patients with neurological disorders. Bringing these innovations to patients requires a robust and scalable manufacturing environment built on advanced microfabrication processes, exceptional engineering, and a culture of continuous improvement. We are looking for an Equipment & Automation Engineer to own and optimize the production equipment that enables our manufacturing operations. In this role, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of manufacturing equipment, from specification and installation through qualification, maintenance, automation, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with Operations, Facilities, Quality, and external partners to ensure equipment reliability, support production growth, and develop solutions that improve safety, throughput, and operational efficiency. This is a highly hands-on role with significant ownership and visibility across the organization. What You'll Do Equipment Reliability & Maintenance Own the reliability and maintenance strategy for assigned production equipment, including predictive, preventive, and corrective maintenance activities. Lead complex troubleshooting, root-cause investigations, and corrective actions to minimize downtime and support manufacturing continuity. Monitor equipment performance, failure trends, and maintenance metrics to identify opportunities for reliability improvements and risk reduction. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance equipment availability, performance, and operational efficiency. Equipment Lifecycle & Capital Projects Define technical requirements and specifications for new production equipment, tooling, and critical spare parts, supporting supplier selection and procurement activities. Lead equipment implementation projects from concept through installation, commissioning, qualification, validation, production release, and operational handover. Develop equipment lifecycle plans and contribute to long-term manufacturing scalability and asset management strategies. items.desc: At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. YOUR ROLE About the role Boards are no longer asking how to run shared services more cheaply. They are asking where capability should sit at all. Global Business Services and Global Capability Centers have shifted from back-office cost arbitrage to strategic delivery engines expected to own capability, innovation and resilience not just transaction volume. At the same time, AI and automation are collapsing the cost logic that most GBS/GCC footprints were built on, forcing a rewrite of operating models designed for a pre-AI world. Clients no longer want a location study. They want a defensible answer to where work should happen, who should do it, and how the organization is governed around it – one that holds for the next decade, not the next budget cycle. This role exists to lead that conversation: from first CEO/COO conversation through to target operating model design, GBS/GCC strategy and stood-up delivery. What you'll do Originate and lead. Build and lead operating model and GBS/GCC transformation engagements with C-suite and board-level stakeholders. Own the commercial pipeline for this offer across existing accounts and new clients. Design and deliver. Lead target operating model design, organization design, GBS/GCC location and service-scope strategy, governance model design, and transition roadmaps from diagnostic through to implementation. Build intellectual capital. Develop differentiated points of view and assets on the future of GBS/GCC: AI-enabled delivery, nearshoring economics, talent and skills models that sharpen Capgemini Invent's position in the market. Lead people. Build, coach and grow a team of managers and consultants. Act as a career sponsor within the practice. Connect across Capgemini. Link operating model and GBS/GCC design to the wider Group's technology, AI and managed-services capability, so recommendations convert into build. YOUR PROFILE What you bring Must-have: Significant experience (8+years) leading operating model design and/or GBS/GCC strategy, setup, optimization or transformation engagements within a top-tier strategy or management consulting environment Proven track record in leading complex, multi country transformation programs and delivering measurable value Deep expertise in at least two of: target operating model design, organization design, location strategy, service delivery model design, shared-services governance, offshoring/nearshoring economics Experience building and developing consulting teams Fluent English required; German and/or French depending on location (Zurich, Geneva) Strong commercial acumen, comfortable owning business development targets and engagement economics Strong plus: Strong understanding of Swiss client environments, including an existing client network across industries Experience redesigning service delivery around AI-enabled automation Financial Transformation acumen WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE Be the change by supporting our clients through innovative strategy projects around digital, future-proof topics that challenge and transform the status quo; Enjoy an entrepreneurial freedom and a collaborative atmosphere within a large company where your opinion is valued and will have a strong impact - on our clients, society, and yourself; Experience the benefits of hybrid working, offering flexibility and ensuring work-life balance, 5 weeks of vacation, employee referral bonus, company shares program and annual contribution to a fitness subscription; Capgemini Switzerland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote equality and dignity in all aspects of recruitment and employment, and all offers of employment and promotions are made on the basis of performance, competence and ability. The Corporate Experience (CE) team partners with senior executives to transform corporate functions into future ready, digitally enabled, and business centric value creators. We rethink how Finance, HR, IT, Procurement and other enabling functions operate, leveraging strategy, data, technology, and experience design to deliver measurable impact. As part of CE Switzerland, you will shape and scale a rapidly growing practice focused on next generation corporate transformation—combining strategy, process excellence, AI enabled operating models, and sustainable ways of working. Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. We bring deep expertise in agile delivery, digital transformation, and platform engineering across central government. With a team of over one hundred and twenty-five professionals — more than forty percent of whom are women — we are committed to building inclusive, diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. The Role We are looking for an experienced Test Automation Engineer to build and run automated testing for public sector digital services. You will work in multidisciplinary agile teams, using code to test micro services, user interfaces and APIs, and to build quality into every release through continuous testing. Key Responsibilities Design, build and maintain automated tests for UI and APIs, using Selenium, Cypress or Playwright and REST Assured. Test micro services, including service interactions and contracts. Write behaviour-driven (BDD) tests using Cucumber that the whole team can read and trust. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so tests run continuously. Plan and run performance, security and accessibility testing. Write clean, maintainable test code, and review other engineers' tests. Analyse results, raise defects with clear evidence and help track them to a fix. Work with developers, business analysts and product owners to define acceptance criteria and test coverage. Report on quality, test coverage and release risks. Share good test automation practice and support colleagues. What We are Looking For Essential: Strong, hands-on experience of test automation and programming (for example Java, JavaScript or TypeScript). Experience testing microservices, with UI and API automation. Experience with BDD and Cucumber. Experience with at least one of Selenium, Cypress or Playwright. Experience with REST Assured for API testing. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing. Experience with performance, security and accessibility testing. items.desc: About CreativeX CreativeX is B2B SaaS technology platform that helps global marketing teams make smarter creative decisions and elevate creative expression through the clarity of data. Our technology powers creative decision-making at some of the biggest brands in the world, including Google, Unilever, Pepsi, Bayer, Mondelez, Heineken, and more. We use computer vision and other machine learning techniques to extract creative data from our client's digital advertising copy and transform those previously dark signals into a standardised data model at industrial scale. This creates a new, unique and powerful first party data set that represents the last and most impactful untapped reservoir of advertising performance. That's because multiple studies have shown that the "Creative" itself is responsible for half of sales lift online, higher than reach, targeting, brand, & recency combined. But creative impact has always been the least analysed and least understood component of a complex set of marketing variables. This is the problem CreativeX is focussed on solving. We're an end-to-end solution to ingest, process, and analyse content at scale. We help brands isolate creative elements so they can be analysed against downstream ad impact metrics, from clickthrough rates to brand lift. Our objective is to help marketing organisations power every creative decision with data. You'll be the design lead in a product trio alongside a Product Manager and an Engineering Lead, owning whether users want what we build and whether they can figure out how to use it, while sharing discovery, outcomes and trade-offs with your partners. CreativeX is a complex product with rich data, multiple user types and increasingly sophisticated AI capabilities, and as AI increases the volume and speed of creative production, you'll make that complexity work for marketers, helping them measure performance fast, find the patterns behind what's working and see whether their full set of ads is delivering the strategy. Our roadmap is framed as problems to solve, not screens to make, so we expect you to bring a point of view. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 
 Our Shared Engineering Services team is at the forefront of validating and releasing the cutting-edge Simcenter™ portfolio. Our simulation software and test solutions help companies predict product performance across a broad range of engineering domains - from 3D CAE and system simulation to physical testing.

 Develop and maintain test automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using scripting and automation frameworks, while improving existing test suites and porting automation to high-performance systems where appropriate. 
 Investigate complex technical issues: Go beyond identifying defects by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and system behavior, investigating root causes, and collaborating with Development and AI/ML teams to drive resolution.

 Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with Development, AI/ML Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, Applications Engineering, and other teams in a globally distributed environment.
