items.title: Signal and Power Integrity Engineer
items.card: About the role As a Signal Integrity/Power Integrity Engineer you will work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration by driving cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers the most demanding AI/ML applications. You will be part of a team developing custom silicon solutions, leveraging your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU
items.desc: About us At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. We empower our people with a culture of excellence, and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone’s contribution is welcomed. We are looking for a Signal Integrity/Power Integrity Engineer to join us as part of our team. About the role As a Signal Integrity/Power Integrity Engineer you will work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration by driving cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers the most demanding AI/ML applications. You will be part of a team developing custom silicon solutions, leveraging your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems. You will lead chip and package design, ensuring optimal SI/PI performance and system co-design from concept to production, while collaborating within a cross-functional team of Chip Design, IP, System Design, software, and vendors. As a qualified expert You will Lead signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI) analysis and optimization for High-Performance Computing (HPC) leveraging advanced 2.5D/3D packaging technologies. Partner early in product definition to influence chip floorplanning, power distribution networks (PDN/power trees), netlists, and routability tradeoffs. Evaluate high-speed interface IPs and develop next-generation memory interfaces across IO PHY, SI/PI, and physical design boundaries. Drive post-silicon validation and qualification for NPI, balancing SI/PI performance and DFM constraints to achieve final package design closure. Partner closely with silicon, system, and external vendor teams while developing simulation methodologies to boost modeling accuracy and efficiency. We’re looking for you if you have Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8 years of experience in SI/PI design for chip/package or system PCB. Experience in industry SIPI modeling tool chains (e.g., HFSS, ADS, Sigrity, Siwave, etc.). Experience with lab bring-up, test environments, and characterization for high-speed memory and SerDes. Experience with partnering across chip architecture, physical design, static timing analysis (STA), package, and validation teams. Experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ to establish automated flows and data processing tools. Bonus points Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture. Deep knowledge of SI/PI analysis for high-speed interconnects (HBMx, D2D/chiplets, PCIe, SerDes) and timing budget methodologies. Direct experience with silicon interposers, silicon bridges, and 3D die stacking architectures. What’s in it for You Reveal great tech solutions Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling clients growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Focus on long-term impact and building tailored, long-lasting partnerships with our clients. Experience an agile and flexible working environment Work fully remote around the globe, or in a hybrid work model from our office hubs which are equipped with everything needed for comfortable work. Enjoy a flexible working schedule and create work and rest balance for yourself. Empower yourself with a stable workload and a stable income, focusing on lasting cooperation and high-performance culture. Embrace the opportunity for personal and professional growth Take advantage of performance review and career path. Elevate your skills with mentorship program, personal development plan, and individual learnings through the corporate library, public speaking support, and more. Feel cared about Be among like-minded people and feel supported with collaboration, open communication and mutual respect. Join company-wide tech and cultural events, and contribute to meaningful CSR initiatives that resonate with your values. Interview steps Interview with Recruiter Manager Interview Client Interview Olha Lutsenko Team Lead, Talent Acquisition Work Type: Contract, Remote Category: Engineering Location: France, Germany, Israel, Mexico, Netherlands, United Kingdom

items.desc: Your mission In this role, you will own our plant-based meat products end to end, for both our LEKKA retail brand and our B2B customers, from the first lab-scale prototype to consistent commercial production. You will improve key product attributes such as appearance, texture, and flavor through hands-on experimentation and data-driven insights. You will then translate those formulations into robust, cost-efficient manufacturing processes. Working closely with R&D, production, quality, and engineering, you will make sure the taste and texture we create in the lab is exactly what reaches our customers. We run our own production equipment and also work with co-manufacturers, so the role includes regular travel to co-manufacturing sites for scale-up tests. Key responsibilities Product development (R&D) Lab-Scale Experimentation: Design and run systematic lab experiments to refine formulations and processes, testing ingredient functionality and process parameters against clear product goals. Product Quality Enhancement: Improve the appearance, texture, flavor, and nutrition of our products while optimizing ingredient costs. Product Evaluation: Choose and run the right analysis adapted to the objective: sensory tests (discriminative, descriptive, or hedonic) and measurements such as texture analysis. Data Analysis & Innovation: Analyze results with appropriate statistical methods, validate or challenge hypotheses, and propose evidence-based next steps. Track scientific literature for emerging technologies and ingredients. Scale-up and production Process Development & Scale-Up: Run pilot and scale-up tests, in-house and at co-manufacturers, to validate lab formulations at larger scale, optimize processing parameters, and get products ready for full-scale production. Production Support & Process Control: Troubleshoot with quality & production teams, and set critical process parameters and quality checkpoints for consistent runs. Equipment Evaluation: Assess equipment performance and work with engineering on equipment selection and modification. Across both Technical Documentation: Keep complete records of experiments and results, and maintain process specifications, SOPs, and production guidelines. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Closely collaborate with product development, production, quality, and engineering, keeping projects aligned with timelines and OKRs. Laboratory Management & Safety: Keep the food lab organized, clean, well-stocked, and safe, and order trial ingredients on time. Your profile If you enjoy working both in the lab and on the factory floor, and love turning hands-on experiments into products that run reliably at scale, this is your chance to apply your expertise to revolutionary plant-based meat innovation. Join us now as we scale operations in a fast-growing, purpose-driven startup. Requirements Professional Experience: 3–7 years in food product development and/or food manufacturing, preferably with plant-based foods, alternative proteins, processed foods, or ingredient applications. Hands-on lab experience plus exposure to process development and scale-up. Educational Background: Master's or PhD degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Food Engineering, Food Chemistry, or a related field. Technical Skills: Expertise in food formulation, ingredient functionality, and protein science. Knowledge of food processing technologies and scale-up principles. Experience with sensory evaluation and instrumental analysis. Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Proficiency in experimental design and statistical analysis. Experience with root cause analysis and process improvement. Personal Attributes: Curious, rigorous, and hands-on, with strong attention to detail. Equally comfortable in the lab and on the production floor, working independently while seeking support when needed. Communication Skills: Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical concepts for R&D, production, and quality audiences. Driving license class B: As driving to visit our co-manufacturers is required. Language Proficiency: Fluent English is required; German at B2 level or higher. Why us? Why you should apply now End-to-End Impact: Few roles let you shape a product from first prototype to full-scale production. Here, you see your ideas through. Scaling Big: We already have 7 products on the shelves of major supermarket chains, and we keep expanding our production capacity. Join at a moment of fast growth and help shape how we scale next. Top-Tier Backing: We’re supported by world-class VCs and angels who share our vision and believe in our mission. The Time is Now: Food needs a massive transformation. Join us in creating irresistible, sustainable food that inspires billions to switch away from animal-based meat, fast! A word on Diversity, Equity & Inclusion We embrace diversity and equal opportunities for all. Shared values and alignment with Project Eaden’s purpose matter most to us. We welcome …

items.desc: Deine Mission & Herausforderungen Als Product Owner NeuraGym Cloud Platform bist du für die Vision, Roadmap und das Backlog der Cloud- und Edge-Software von NeuraGym verantwortlich – unserer Physical AI Data & Training Platform . Du triffst die Produktentscheidungen für diesen Bereich und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Ergebnisse. Gemeinsam mit dem Product Owner NeuraGym , der für das Gesamtprodukt verantwortlich ist, übersetzt du eine gemeinsame Vision in ein klares Backlog für unsere Engineering-Teams und daraus in funktionierende Software, die in jedem Sprint ausgeliefert wird und unsere Roboter Schritt für Schritt intelligenter macht. Verantwortung für das Backlog: Du organisierst, verfeinerst und kommunizierst das Product Backlog so, dass die Teams jederzeit wissen, was am wichtigsten ist und warum. Du formulierst klare Backlog Items mit aussagekräftigen Akzeptanzkriterien. Produktgestaltung: Du entscheidest, welche Features umgesetzt werden – und welche nicht. Dabei wägest du Nutzerwert, Aufwand, Risiko und strategische Relevanz gegeneinander ab und machst deine Entscheidungen transparent. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem NeuraGym Product Owner: Du übersetzt die übergeordnete Produktstrategie in konkrete Ziele für die Cloud-Plattform, hältst beide Roadmaps synchron und vertrittst gegenüber Kunden und Stakeholdern eine gemeinsame Linie. Zusammenarbeit mit Architektur und Führung: Du arbeitest eng mit der Bereichsleitung und unseren Architekten zusammen, um neue Features mit Sicherheit, Mandantentrennung, Skalierbarkeit und technischer Verschuldung in Einklang zu bringen. Du strukturierst die Arbeit entlang klarer Domänengrenzen, sodass Teams möglichst unabhängig liefern können. Verstehe deine Nutzer: Du kennst die Bedürfnisse von Robotik-Operatoren, ML-Researchern, Data Teams, Partnern und Kundenadministratoren. Du bringst ihr Feedback in Reviews ein und prüfst kontinuierlich, ob unsere Lösungen ihre tatsächlichen Probleme lösen. Agile Delivery: Du definierst Produktziele und gestaltest Planning, Refinements und Reviews so, dass sie für die Teams echten Mehrwert schaffen. Skalierung von Anfang an mitdenken: Du gestaltest eine Plattform, die viele Kunden in unterschiedlichen Regionen bedienen kann – mit Kostentransparenz und zuverlässigem Betrieb von Beginn an. Das Ökosystem verbinden: Du koordinierst dich mit weiteren Teams innerhalb unserer Cloud-Plattform sowie mit Robotics- und AI-Teams zu gemeinsamen Fähigkeiten und Abhängigkeiten – von Identity und Organisationen bis hin zum Deployment auf unsere Roboter. Was wir von dir erwarten Fundierte Erfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Ownership oder Product Management für Softwareprodukte, idealerweise im Bereich B2B-Plattformen, SaaS oder Data- und ML-Tooling. Agile Arbeitsweise: Du hast Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, und setzt Methoden pragmatisch statt dogmatisch ein. Stakeholder Management: Du hast souverän mit zahlreichen Stakeholdern mit unterschiedlichen und teils konkurrierenden Interessen gearbeitet – bis hin zum Senior Management – und kannst begründet auch einmal Nein sagen. Technisches Verständnis: Du kannst mit Engineers sicher über Cloud-Architekturen, APIs und Domänengrenzen sprechen. Kenntnisse in AWS, Data Pipelines oder ML-Workflows sind ein großer Vorteil; Programmierkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich. Plattformerfahrung: Du hast bereits Verantwortung für komplexe, mandantenfähige Plattformprodukte übernommen und verstehst, was Skalierung für Features, Kosten und Betrieb bedeutet. Outcome-Orientierung: Du misst Erfolg am Mehrwert für Nutzer und nicht nur am Output. Daten und Nutzerfeedback fließen aktiv in deine Entscheidungen ein. Begeisterung für Physical AI: Du möchtest die Zukunft der Robotik aktiv mitgestalten – made in Europe. Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst klar und souverän mit Engineers, Kunden und Management. Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind erforderlich; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

items.desc: Your Mission & Challenges As Product Owner NeuraGym Cloud Platform, you will be responsible for the vision, roadmap and backlog for NeuraGym's cloud and edge software, our Physical AI Data & Training Platform. items.desc: Amentum is seeking a Test Conductor on Andros Island, Bahamas to the Atlantic Undersea Test and Evaluation Center (AUTEC) Mission in Andros Island, Bahamas. The Test Conductor is responsible for the overall conduct and execution of test events on the AUTEC tracked range and is accountable to the Test Operations Manager on the AUTEC project. AUTEC is a Major Range and Test Facility Base (MRTFB) and the Naval Undersea Warfare Center, Division Newport's largest single team project, providing both deep and shallow water test and training environments. Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. Government Clearance. Note: U.S. Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance. Essential Responsibilities: Manage real-time operations of all range tracking systems, vessels, helicopters, and other assets participating in the operation including test participants effectively meeting the test operation requirements in an efficient manner. Review all relevant test operations documents such as operation directives, test plans, pre-test briefings, and unclassified and classified naval messages. Attend pertinent test meetings including Range Safety briefs, pre-test briefs, test specific planning meetings, and range scheduling meetings. Oversee and supervise the Test Operations Real-Time Display Center (RTDC) during test events, ensuring all range operation personnel receive a thorough in-brief on current range operations. Ensure all stations in the RTDC are properly prepared and manned for range testing as required by the Operations Directive and AUTEC Schedule of Operations. Train prospective Test Conductors as assigned by the Lead Test Conductor. Support the US Navy Range Safety Watch Officer (RSWO) to ensure test operations are performed in a safe manner and all test operations are following the AUTEC Range Safety program. In the absence of the RSWO, take decisive action to avoid situations that could result in danger to personnel or damage to vessels or equipment. Maintain real-time logs of all test operations in accordance with established procedures and oversee supplemental documentation requirements such as deficiency reports, range utilization reports, and weapons reports. Provide point of contact between contractor and Naval Undersea Warfare Center (NUWC) duty team and Range Users to ensure real-time requirements and changes are appropriately managed. Provide technical evaluation to the duty team of any real-time problem and suggest alternatives for meeting test objectives. Exercise discretion and independent judgment to meet customer demands in conjunction with keeping company objectives in focus. Perform other duties as assigned. Minimum Requirements BA/BS degree in Engineering, Science, Electronics, or equivalent preferred Five years of AUTEC experience with range test operations or a role that was in a direct test support function preferred. (Military service or commercial experience (5+ yrs.) in a technical field involving large-scale test operations may be substituted in lieu of the degree and/or years of AUTEC experience.) Qualify as a Test Conductor in accordance with Phase I and II work-based learning and certification; required. Computer literacy in a Windows environment. Role Overview Allianz Group is developing the Allianz Security Operations Center (ASOC ) as an integrated capability bringing together threat intelligence, travel security, physical security, executive protection, incident response , and crisis management , with the objective of progressively building scalable 24/7 operational capacity for both man-made and natural risks. In a fast-changing and increasingly volatile environment , Allianz considers this capability a strategic imperative requiring concrete action, sustained commitment, and strong operational leadership. The ASOC will strengthen Allianz Group’s ability to anticipate, monitor, respond to, and recover from disruptions by integrating intelligence and operational capabilities and progressively expanding toward continuous, follow-the-sun coverage. It will protect Allianz personnel, physical assets, business operations, and critical functions through consistent monitoring, analysis, escalation, coordination, and reporting . The ASOC is positioned within Allianz Services and functionally reports into Corporate Security’s Group Protection and Resilience Team. Reporting to the ASOC Operational Lead, the ASOC Operational Officer will support the day-to day functioning of the ASOC operational activities, contributing to incident intake, triage, escalation, coordination, and operational reporting across geographies, business lines, and functions. Working closely with the ASOC Intelligence team, and relevant internal stakeholders. The successful candidate will bring strong analytical, reporting skills, and practical experience in physical security operations, incident response, control room environments, or comparable operational settings. The role requires reliability, discretion, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, on call-based environment. What you do Monitor, assess, and triage security alerts, incidents, and requests, ensuring timely escalation and response in line with ASOC procedures. Execute initial incident response actions, including stakeholder notifications, coordination with local teams, and emergency service engagement when required. Operate and monitor key security platforms, including travel security, mass notification, access control, and incident management systems. Provide clear operational updates, incident summaries, and situation reports while maintaining accurate documentation, reporting, and governance records. Collaborate closely with ASOC teams, Intelligence, Cyber SOC, Protection Resilience, Communications, and other stakeholders to support informed decision-making and coordinated response. Support continuous improvement through post-incident reviews, lessons learned, drills, exercises, and preparedness activities for major incidents and crisis scenarios. Track operational performance metrics, handle sensitive information securely, and ensure compliance with confidentiality, data protection, and governance requirements. What you bring Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Emergency Management, International Relations, or a related field, or equivalent experience in corporate security, government, emergency services, or operational security environments. 2–5 years of experience in security operations, incident response, crisis management support, control rooms, Security Operations Centers (SOC), or similar 24/7 operational environments; financial services experience is a plus. Solid understanding of incident management processes, including intake, triage, escalation, stakeholder communication, operational logging, and shift handovers. Practical experience with travel security, emergency response, executive protection, event security, and crisis management, as well as security technologies such as mass notification and incident management platforms. items.title: Software Engineer - Cypher Planner
items.card: The Role: Join our dynamic Cypher team at Neo4j, where we are at the forefront of optimizing the core codebase that receives query strings and transforms them into efficient, logically sound execution plans. This role delves deep into the heart of the database, determining the most rapid and effective means of retrieving queried data from the underlying stores and indexes of the property graph model.
items.desc: About Neo4j: Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world's largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision: At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data. As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we're disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. The Role: Join our dynamic Cypher team at Neo4j, where we are at the forefront of optimizing the core codebase that receives query strings and transforms them into efficient, logically sound execution plans. This role delves deep into the heart of the database, determining the most rapid and effective means of retrieving queried data from the underlying stores and indexes of the property graph model. Responsibilities: As a Cypher Software Engineer, you will not only enhance and optimize the query planner but also contribute to the development of comprehensive features that elevate the capabilities of the Cypher language and the Neo4j database. Your impact will extend across the entire codebase, from the parser to the storage files and indexes. Success in this role requires the ability to think abstractly, discuss the pros and cons of different options, and anticipate edge cases in a design. What You'll Bring: Experience with performance-driven development, e.g., profiling, benchmarking, and optimizing code Familiarity with Agile development processes (TDD, kanban/scrum, pair programming) Knowledge of or willingness to learn Scala A desire to learn. Nice to also have: Experience programming in Scala and/or Java Understanding or previous experience with database design and implementation Interest or experience in developing compilers A strong foundation in algorithm design and analysis Interest in exploratory learning and transferring academic research into production-grade products 5+ years of experience developing high-quality, highly scalable production-level software We don't expect you to have experience across all these areas. We have a mix of different skills in our team. Many of our teams are spread over two or more locations, so you should be comfortable working as part of a distributed team. Why Join Neo4j? Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j. Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years. Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history. 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others. Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success. Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform. A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers. Research shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don't meet all the qualifications. If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we'd encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application. At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues. One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, …

items.desc: About The Role Are you an early career scientist, looking to gain experience working in a range of wetland habitats within a supportive and internationally recognised team of wetland experts? WWT's Wetland Evidence department are looking to recruit an early career scientist to support our expanding programme of ecological monitoring. Sitting in the Wetland BioScience team the successful candidate will have the opportunity to develop field skills covering a range of taxa including pollinating insects, saltmarsh vegetation, aerial insectivores (bats and birds) and aquatic invertebrates. The role will also involve desk based data collation and management as well as the opportunity to get involved in analysis and reporting tasks. The role will centre on field-based survey work across a range of sites, primarily in the South West but also nationally so a willingness to travel and a driving licence are therefore essential. This is a full-time position, working 37.5 hours per week, for a fixed period until 30th March 2028. During the fieldwork season, this position will require working on some weekends and bank holidays and working outside of normal hours. Considerable flexibility will be required during the fieldwork season. About You The successful candidate will have a background in ecology and an interest in wetland species and habitats have a desire to develop cross-taxa field skills and desk based data management experience be proactive and engaged across multiple projects and tasks have the ability to bring a creative approach to problem solving, finding practical solutions be able to conduct fieldwork independently, managing own time efficiently whilst following health & safety regulation be willing to travel (within the UK) and have a driving licence have good interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate with a wide range of audiences and members of public and maintain effective relationships with colleagues and partners. Please view the full job description for all the responsibilities and specifications for the role. About Us We’re WWT, and we’re on a mission to restore the super-powered ecosystems we call wetlands. There’s never been a more important moment for our work, and we’ve got some phenomenal people on the case. Whether they’re taking a new visitor under their wing, or conducting ground-breaking research further afield, our team are second to none. And there’s nothing we love more than watching them soar. Whatever you do here, you’ll be helping to restore wetlands and unlock their power. So, the only question left is, what role will you play? Why you’ll love working at WWT Wake up every day knowing your work is helping to restore wetlands, and our world Be surrounded and inspired by our team of passionate, dedicated people 33 days annual leave (which goes up to 38 days after 5 years of service) – this includes bank holidays and you have flexibility to take those days whenever you want Free entry to all our wetland centres, including your family Free car parking and secure bike storage areas Colleague discount on shopping and memberships Cycle to work scheme Contributory pension scheme Life Assurance of three times your salary, for peace of mind for your loved ones Independent personal, workplace and financial advice from our Employee Assistance Programme WWT is an equal opportunities employer and all applications will be considered solely on merit. items.desc: About Nscale At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe's AI revolution. Nscale is developing cutting-edge, sovereign generative AI solutions powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads. The rapid growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Positioned at the heart of this transformation, Nscale is delivering the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation. Working closely with the world's most advanced AI technology providers, Nscale integrates next-generation compute hardware and GPU clusters across both partner and self-delivered facilities. This is a unique opportunity to join Nscale's journey, play a pivotal role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across Europe and beyond. The Role The Document Controller will be engaged to manage project documentation on Nscale's colocation data center developments. You will be responsible for maintaining accurate document control systems, ensuring that all project information is current, correctly formatted, approved, and distributed to the right stakeholders at the right time. This role requires a strong understanding of document management processes within complex construction or engineering environments. You'll play a critical role in supporting project delivery, maintaining version integrity, and upholding Nscale's standards for governance, accuracy, and compliance across all design and construction documentation. Key Responsibilities Document Control & Information Management Establish, maintain, and manage document control systems for large-scale construction projects in accordance with Nscale's standards and procedures. Ensure all project documentation — including design drawings, specifications, contracts, reports, and correspondence — is accurately logged, version-controlled, and traceable. Review incoming and outgoing documents for accuracy, completeness, and correct formatting before release. Manage document workflows, approvals, and distribution through designated document control platforms e.g. Procore Governance, Quality & Compliance Implement document control protocols that comply with Nscale's governance framework and regional regulatory requirements. Monitor adherence to naming conventions, revision management, and transmittal procedures across all internal and external contributors. Maintain up-to-date audit trails, ensuring traceability and accountability for all document submissions and approvals. Support internal and external audits by providing complete, accurate document records as required. Collaboration & Support Work closely with Project and Design Managers, and Contractors to ensure information is exchanged efficiently and accurately. Coordinate the flow of information between Nscale's internal teams and external stakeholders, including partners, contractors, and suppliers. Provide document control training and support to project participants to maintain consistent standards and best practices. Assist in preparing reports and dashboards summarising document status, approvals, and outstanding actions. Systems, Tools & Continuous Improvement Champion best practice in digital document management and data governance, supporting Nscale's technology-led approach to project delivery. Regularly review and improve document control procedures, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency. Ensure all project documentation is archived correctly at project close-out for long-term retrieval and record retention. Who You Are 5+ years' experience in document control or information management within large scale, complex construction Proficient in Procore Strong understanding of construction documentation, revision control, and approval workflows. Highly organised, detail-oriented, and capable of managing large volumes of technical information. Excellent communication skills and ability to coordinate across multiple teams and stakeholders. Proactive, solutions-driven, and able to work independently within a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Fluent in English; other European languages advantageous. Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.

Our mission is to help organizations evolve through innovation, scalable data platforms, and high-quality analytical solutions, fostering continuous learning, collaboration, and technological excellence. We are looking for a Data Scientist & AI Specialist with strong expertise in machine learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), generative AI (LLMs/RAG), and data engineering pipelines applied to environmental footprints, life-cycle assessment (LCA), and sustainability analytics to join our team in international digital transformation and scientific data management initiatives. items.desc: Qui sommes nous ? Fondé en France, Talan est aujourd’hui un groupe international qui accompagne ses clients dans leur transformation Data & IA, de bout en bout, en combinant conseil en management et expertise technologique. Avec plus de 6000 collaborateurs sur 5 continents, nous accélérons les transformations de nos clients à travers des partenariats de long terme, en créant un impact mesurable et durable. Notre proposition de valeur repose sur un écosystème d’innovation structuré : 2 500 experts Data & IA, des solutions propriétaires construites sur des modèles avancés et un laboratoire de recherche appliquée, de développement expérimental et d’innovation. Nous traduisons l’innovation technologique en avantage concurrentiel depuis plus de 20 ans dans des secteurs stratégiques : banques et services financiers, énergie, transport et mobilité, luxe et distribution, santé. Porté par sa promesse de Positive Innovation, Talan s’impose comme un acteur de référence pour répondre à la complexité croissante des environnements économiques, technologiques et réglementaires. www.talan.com Et Talan Sud Est ? Talan Sud-Est est présent depuis 2007 à Lyon et compte environ 350 collaborateurs répartis entre Aix-Marseille et Lyon. En plein développement, les équipes s'agrandissent ! Nous continuons de développer aujourd'hui nos activités auprès de grands comptes et d’ETI, principalement dans les secteurs de l’Energie et de l’Environnement, du Transport et de la Logistique, de l’Industrie, de la Distribution, de la Santé et des Services Publiques. L’expertise, la bonne humeur, le collectif et de l’esprit d’entreprendre, constituent notre ADN. Description du poste L’Intelligence Artificielle Générative transforme en profondeur la façon de concevoir, développer et industrialiser les solutions digitales. Chez Talan Sud-Est, notre équipe Data Analytics, forte de 70 collaborateurs, accompagne déjà nos clients sur leurs enjeux Data, Cloud et IA. Aujourd’hui, nous souhaitons accélérer cette dynamique en renforçant notre expertise GenAI afin de concevoir les prochaines solutions à forte valeur ajoutée : assistants métier, copilots, agents IA, architectures RAG et solutions basées sur les LLM. C’est dans ce contexte que nous recrutons notre futur(e) Forward Deployed Engineer AI . Qu'est-ce que nous vous proposons ? L’opportunité de rejoindre une équipe d’experts passionnés et de jouer un rôle clé dans le développement de notre expertise IA Générative. Vous contribuerez à imaginer, concevoir et industrialiser des solutions innovantes pour nos clients, tout en participant à la structuration de notre future communauté GenAI. Vos missions En tant que Forward Deployed Engineer AI , vous serez amené(e) à : Concevoir et développer des solutions basées sur les LLM, RAG, agents IA et copilots. Définir les architectures techniques des projets GenAI et accompagner leur industrialisation. Réaliser des PoC, MVP et projets de production autour de l'IA Générative. Participer aux choix technologiques et à la veille sur les nouveaux modèles et frameworks. Intervenir sur les phases d’avant-vente et contribuer aux réponses aux appels d’offres. Partager votre expertise au travers d’ateliers, formations et communautés techniques. Contribuer au développement de nos accélérateurs et assets GenAI. Qualifications Passionné(e) par l’Intelligence Artificielle et les nouveaux usages, vous expérimentez continuellement et aimez transformer des innovations en solutions concrètes. Vous disposez idéalement : D’une expérience significative en développement, Data Science, IA et GenAI. D’une solide maîtrise de Python et de l’écosystème IA moderne. D’une expérience autour des LLM, RAG, agents IA ou fine-tuning. D’une bonne connaissance des frameworks tels que LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face ou équivalents. D’une culture cloud et DevOps (Azure, AWS ou GCP). D’une forte curiosité technique et d’un goût prononcé pour l’expérimentation. Une expérience autour de sujets tels que les agents autonomes, MCP, Knowledge Graphs, MLOps ou AI Engineering constitue un véritable atout. Plus qu’un diplôme ou un parcours, nous recherchons avant tout une personne passionnée, capable de challenger les standards, de tester les dernières innovations et de partager ses découvertes avec le reste de l’équipe.

items.desc: Reaktor's award-winning tech community is looking for AI developers to join us in Helsinki. items.desc: Formel D ist der globale Dienstleister der Automobilindustrie. Wir entwickeln marktführende Konzepte sowie individuelle, skalierbare Lösungen entlang der kompletten automobilen Wertschöpfungskette – von der Entwicklung über die Produktion bis hin zum Aftersales. Formel D wurde 1993 gegründet, der Hauptsitz der Unternehmensgruppe befindet sich in der Millionenmetropole Köln. In unseren interkulturellen Teams arbeiten heute weltweit mehr als 10.500 Personen aus 45 Nationen zusammen, die in über 90 Niederlassungen in 21 Ländern tätig sind. Aufgaben: Als KI-Architekt (w/m/d) verantwortest du die Konzeption und Umsetzung von KI-Lösungen auf Unternehmensebene. Du verbindest datenwissenschaftliche Ansätze mit robusten Software- und Systemarchitekturen, definierst die technische Infrastruktur, wählst passende KI- und Machine-Learning-Modelle aus und sorgst dafür, dass diese sicher, kosteneffizient und skalierbar in bestehende IT-Systeme integriert werden. Dabei berücksichtigst du sowohl technische als auch geschäftliche Anforderungen und begleitest den Weg von der Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz. In dieser Funktion entwickelst du ganzheitliche unternehmensweite KI-Architekturen. Dazu wählst du geeignete Technologien aus und integrierst KI-Lösungen in bestehende Systeme unter Berücksichtigung von Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Sicherheit. Technische Leitung bei der Umsetzung von KI-Anwendungsfällen (z. B. Generative AI, RAG, NLP, Predictive Analytics). Zudem stellst du die Einhaltung von Kosten, Governance, Standards und Responsible AI innerhalb der Organisation sicher. Du berätst Fachbereiche und Management zu KI-Strategien, Innovation und technologischer Machbarkeit. Die Architektur-, Data- und Engineering-Teams werden von dir fachlich geführt und unterstützt. Profil: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Data Science, KI oder einem verwandten Fach sowie langjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 5 Jahre) in IT-, Software- oder KI-Umgebungen. Wir setzen fundierte Kenntnisse in Cloud-Plattformen (wie Microsoft Azure, AWS oder Google Cloud), Datenarchitekturen, Systemintegration und skalierbaren IT-/KI-Architekturen voraus. Wichtig sind zudem Erfahrungen mit Sicherheits- und Compliance-Anforderungen (z. B. DSGVO) sowie Responsible AI. Ergänzt wird dein Profil durch starke analytische Fähigkeiten, Kommunikationsstärke sowie Erfahrung in technischen Führungsrollen. Abgerundet wird dein Profil durch sehr gute Deutsch- (C1) und Englischkenntnisse (B2). Die Vergütung für diese Position liegt - abhängig von Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung - zwischen 70.000 € - 80.000 € brutto pro Jahr.

Je ontwerpt en ontwikkelt intelligente oplossingen die duidelijkheid brengen in complexe financiële data en slimmere applicatie-agenten aandrijven. Met wereldwijde banken die onder toenemende druk staan om te innoveren, digitaliseren en versnellen, bouwen wij de AI-capaciteiten die hen helpen voorop te blijven lopen. Savings & Investments is gevestigd in Gouda, en je maakt deel uit van een multidisciplinair team dat autonomie, samenwerking en technische diepgang waardeert. Je leidt AI-ontwikkelingen over onze tech stack door machine learning, semantische pijplijnen, retrieval-augmented generation en open-source LLM's toe te passen om financiële data om te zetten in bruikbare inzichten. Je speelt een centrale rol in het opschalen van ons Composable Banking Platform, waarbij je ervoor zorgt dat elke oplossing naadloos integreert over de verschillende business lines. Door te pleiten voor verantwoordelijke AI en het bouwen van transparante, waarde-gedreven applicaties, draag je bij aan software die de efficiëntie verbetert, besluitvorming versterkt en tastbare impact levert voor onze klanten en hun klanten. Wat je gaat doen als AI Engineer Je combineert technische expertise met een gezonde nieuwsgierigheid naar financiële data en de mogelijkheden van AI. Samen met je team werk je aan het ontwikkelen van high-performance data pipelines die financiële workflows en interne processen ondersteunen, zodat kennis efficiënt wordt omgezet in waarde voor klanten en collega’s. Daarnaast optimaliseer je semantische zoekalgoritmes om klanten razendsnel van betrouwbare en relevante inzichten te voorzien. Je bouwt oplossingen voor datakwaliteitsbewaking, waarmee je de consistentie en betrouwbaarheid van onze AI-oplossingen waarborgt. Je houdt je bezig met het fine-tunen en testen van AI-modellen voor specifieke toepassingen, altijd met oog voor effectiviteit en kostenefficiëntie. Ook ben je betrokken bij MLOps-activiteiten, waarbij je secure modellen en data beheert, uitrolt en monitort in productieomgevingen — zodat we van begin tot eind grip houden op het proces. Tot slot implementeer je veilige AI-inference oplossingen die voldoen aan de hoge enterprise-standaarden binnen de banking- en finance-sector. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met analisten, ontwikkelteams en security-specialisten. Wat breng jij mee als AI Engineer Je hebt een passie voor technologie, begrijpt de complexiteit van financiële data en bent altijd op zoek naar betere oplossingen. Technische expertise Ervaring met het modelleren en bevragen van semantische context via knowledge graphs (zoals Neo4j) Ervaring met Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) in vector databases (zoals Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, FAISS) Hands-on ervaring met het toepassen, finetunen en implementeren van (open source) LLM’s Vaardigheid in programmeertalen zoals Python en Java Ervaring met frameworks als LangChain en PyTorch Kennis van agentic tools zoals GitHub Copilot, Cline, Cursor of Windsurf Ervaring met cloud-ML (bijv. Azure) en containerorkestratie (Docker/Kubernetes) Samenwerking & domeinvaardigheden Security-first mindset en ervaring met AI-pijplijnen voor gestructureerde én ongestructureerde data Sterke samenwerkingsvaardigheden met teams zoals development, security en operations Energie om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen én samen resultaten te boeken

items.desc: Un groupe français de services aux entreprises, actif dans le marketing, la data et la tech. Il réunit plusieurs sociétés spécialisées, et leurs clients sont des ETI et de grands comptes. Le groupe crée un studio produit IA. Sa mission : transformer le savoir-faire de ses experts métier en applications et en agents IA, vendus par abonnement à ses clients. Les cas d’usage, les experts et les premiers clients pilotes sont identifiés. Il reste à construire les produits et la plateforme. Le poste : Construire les premiers produits IA de bout en bout : interfaces, back-end, intégration des modèles et des agents, connexion aux outils des clients (régies publicitaires, CRM, ERP selon les produits). Poser le socle commun : multi-tenant, cloisonnement des données, déploiement, observabilité, suivi des coûts de calcul. Faire passer les produits du prototype à un service fiable, sécurisé et capable de monter en charge. Mettre en place l’évaluation des réponses IA dès les premières versions : jeux de tests, cas limites, garde-fous. Garantir la sécurité et la conformité : séparation des données entre clients, AI Act, exigences des DSI grands comptes. Choisir les modèles et les outils, en multi-modèles et sans dépendance à un fournisseur. Participer au choix des produits et aux échanges avec les clients pilotes. Recruter et encadrer l’équipe technique : une vingtaine de personnes visées à 3 ans. Vous travaillez en binôme avec le CPO du studio, recruté en parallèle, et vous êtes rattaché au directeur de la Transformation IA du groupe. Les choix d’architecture et de stack vous reviennent. Vous êtes Ingénieur full-stack avec au moins 8 ans d’expérience, dont plusieurs années en startup SaaS comme CTO, founding engineer ou lead developer. Vous avez déjà livré vous-même un produit complet, du premier écran à la mise en production, avec de vrais utilisateurs. Vous avez mis en production de l’IA générative : appels aux modèles, agents, RAG, évaluation. Vous êtes solide en back-end, front-end et cloud, et à l’aise avec la sécurité, la data et l’architecture multi-tenant. Vous codez au quotidien et vous voulez continuer. Vous avez déjà recruté et fait grandir une petite équipe technique. Un plus : un SaaS B2B vendu à de grands comptes, ou une expérience en martech ou adtech. Ce qu’on propose Une page blanche technique : stack, architecture et méthodes à définir. Des cas réels et des clients pilotes dès le premier jour. Un budget dédié, pour l’équipe comme pour le calcul. Une équipe à construire. Une rémunération fixe et un variable indexé sur les résultats du studio. Un poste basé à Paris. Le process Un premier échange confidentiel avec le cabinet, puis des entretiens avec le directeur de la Transformation IA et un échange technique autour d’un cas d’architecture.

items.desc: Description Join Amazon's Global Sustainable Packaging (GSP) organization as we pioneer the future of sustainable e-commerce packaging. As an Advanced Packaging Materials Engineer based in the EU, you'll serve as the critical link between our European and North American materials science operations—driving paper-based materials development tailored to the EU supplier base while harmonizing global materials strategies across regions. Embedded alongside our automation hardware development teams, you'll ensure that packaging materials and automation systems are co-developed for seamless integration. This is a hands-on, technically broad role spanning pulp and paper manufacturing, packaging converting operations, paper-based materials for manual and automatic packaging, and packaging automation equipment. You'll conduct laboratory research, characterize materials properties, establish specifications, and work directly with EU-based suppliers to bring novel materials from concept to production—while serving as the conduit to align materials globally, simplify where possible, and solve for region-specific requirements driven by regulation, material supply availability, and operational differences. Key job responsibilities Materials Development & Innovation Lead laboratory research and development of paper-based packaging materials for manual and automatic packaging, with deep understanding of pulp and paper manufacturing processes and converting operations. Design and execute experiments to optimize material formulations and processing parameters, applying the materials science triangle framework (processing-structure-properties) across the full range of paper-based packaging materials and converting processes. Develop next-generation materials solutions that unlock step-change improvements in performance, cost, sustainability, and automation compatibility—with specific focus on EU supplier capabilities and regional material availability. Advance materials innovations from concept, pilot, and deployment phases, ensuring solutions are compatible with EU packaging automation hardware and converting equipment. Evaluate and develop paper-based material systems that meet the unique performance demands of automated packaging lines, considering substrate interactions, machine speed requirements, and environmental conditions. EU Materials Strategy & Global Alignment Serve as the primary conduit between EU and NA materials science teams, driving global alignment on materials specifications while identifying opportunities to harmonize and simplify across regions. Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the EU supplier base—including paper mills, converters, and coating suppliers—and how it differs from the North American supply landscape. Identify region-specific materials requirements dictated by EU regulations (e.g., REACH, EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation, CEFLEX), regional material supply constraints, and operational differences in EU fulfillment networks. Balance global standardization with regional customization—driving simplification where materials can be harmonized and developing tailored solutions where regional requirements demand differentiation. Build and maintain a materials roadmap for EU that aligns with global GSP strategy and EU automation hardware development timelines. Automation Hardware Integration Work closely with EU-based automation hardware development teams to ensure paper-based packaging materials are co-developed with automation equipment, optimizing for machine runnability, reliability, and throughput. Provide materials expertise during automation system design, commissioning, and optimization—translating materials properties into actionable equipment parameters. Develop deep understanding of packaging converting equipment (folders, gluers, sealers, labelers) and how paper-based materials properties influence machine performance at production speeds. Support troubleshooting of materials-related automation failures, conducting root cause analysis that spans materials properties, converting conditions, and equipment settings. Materials Characterization & Testing Perform and direct lab engineers to conduct comprehensive materials characterization of physical, structural, strength, resistance, surface, optical, barrier, and recyclability properties while utilizing standards and non-standard methodologies. Establish correlations between fundamental materials properties and operational performance in fulfillment environments, with emphasis on how EU-specific substrates and converting conditions affect outcomes. Design and execute test plans that validate materials performance against specifications and requirements for both manual and automated packaging operations. Analyze test data using statistical methods to drive data-driven materials selection decisions across the EU supplier base. items.desc: Czym będziesz się zajmować? Role summary: Own quality on the two hardest surfaces of a production AI coaching platform: the LLM agents that answer differently every run, and the API layer everything else depends on. As AI & Backend QA Engineer you own the quality of what the model says and what the APIs return. On the AI side that means building the evaluation practice: golden sets, quality metrics, and regression detection that catch a degraded answer before a user does. On the backend side it means API test suites and consumer-driven contract testing with Pact — agreed with the client's US engineering team as a standing requirement for this role, not an optional technique. The defining skill is localization: when an answer is wrong, you can tell whether the problem sits in the model, in the service code, or in the input data — and you bring the evidence, not a guess. What you'll be testing: AI core — a Python service with LangGraph agents producing streaming, non-deterministic coaching responses; this role's primary surface Backend APIs — a NestJS REST gateway behind Auth0, plus the services behind it Mobile app — React Native, shipping to iOS and Android app stores; AI features surface directly in the app that members use Kogo poszukujemy? Must-have skills: 3+ years in technical QA/test automation, incl. API testing on production Python — writing/maintaining tests, pytest, fixtures HTTP/API fundamentals — REST, JSON, status codes, headers, auth tokens Contract testing with Pact — consumer-driven contracts (hard requirement) Security-aware API testing — auth boundaries, token handling, malformed/hostile input Comfort with non-determinism — assert on properties/contracts, not exact output LLM evaluation — datasets/golden sets, response metrics, detect regressions across prompts/models Prompt engineering — modify prompts and measure effects; aware of hallucinations and prompt injection Backend savvy — HTTP/REST, JSON, tokens, logs, DB queries; isolate model vs service vs input issues Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI daily Git in team workflow — branches, PRs, reviews TestRail for test-case management and runs Mobile product context (Android/iOS) — testing app features, release timing, store builds Nice-to-haves: Langfuse or equivalent (LangSmith, Phoenix) — traces and attached evaluations LangGraph — test agents as state graphs (single node and full flow) CI/CD — run evaluations in pipelines and quality gates on PRs Python with Appium — mobile automation exposure alongside API work Czego wymagamy? 5 lat doświadczenia na podobnym stanowisku Znajomości: Python REST Zendesk Security testing LLM Inżynieria promptów Mile widziane: Postman OpenAPI Git TestRail Mobile applications testing Logs and tracing Języki: Polski Angielski Langfuse (mile widziane) Jakie warunki i benefity otrzymasz? 25.2k–28.6k PLN netto/m (B2B) B2B - Overlap with US Mountain Time afternoons (~14:00–18:00 PL time) (100%) Praca zdalna: W całości Pakiet medyczny, Pakiet sportowy Kim jesteśmy? apreel został założony w kwietniu 2010 roku przez przyjaciół, których marzeniem było stworzenie własnego software house'u. Wraz z rozwojem firmy i jednocześnie wzrostem zaufania klientów, rozszerzyła swoją działalność o usługi takie jak leasing ekspertów IT. Dziś ten obszar stanowi główny filar działalności apreel. Nie oznacza to jednak, że założyciele apreela porzucili swoje marzenia. Naszą pasją zawsze będzie tworzenie autorskich rozwiązań informatycznych, a celem, do którego dążymy, jest ciągłe ich doskonalenie. W połączeniu z wyjątkową atmosferą i profesjonalizmem stworzyliśmy w apreelu wyjątkowy klimat. Zapraszamy do aplikowania, jeżeli zależy Ci na pracy wśród dobrych specjalistów, w stabilnych organizacjach oraz z jasnymi warunkami finansowania.

items.desc: 🚀 ¡Únete a RocaSalvatella como AI Developer! RocaSalvatella somos una consultora de referencia en transformación digital, innovación y negocio . Acompañamos a grandes organizaciones en su adaptación al entorno digital, combinando estrategia, tecnología y talento para generar impacto real y sostenible. Creemos en la cocreación con el cliente, la agilidad y la orientación a resultados. Diseñamos e implementamos soluciones que transforman la manera en que las organizaciones trabajan, innovan y crecen. Buscamos a un/a AI Developer para integrarse en nuestro equipo de AI Solutions. Tu misión será diseñar y llevar a producción soluciones de IA para clientes corporativos, con autonomía sobre todo el delivery técnico: desde la arquitectura hasta el despliegue. ¿Cuál será tu rol en el día a día? Trabajarás mano a mano con el equipo de AI Solutions en las siguientes funciones: Construir soluciones de IA end-to-end: agentes conversacionales, sistemas RAG, clasificadores y extractores de información integrados con los sistemas del cliente (ERP, CRM, SAP). Decidir la arquitectura: elegir el stack, diseñar pipelines y definir patrones de integración en los proyectos que lideres. Llevar las soluciones a producción: contenedores, entornos cloud, monitorización y mantenimiento. Automatizar con agentes y workflows: n8n, LangGraph, Copilot Studio o Power Automate sobre M365, según el contexto de cada cliente. Elevar el nivel técnico del equipo: revisar y orientar el trabajo de developers junior y definir estándares, patrones reutilizables y buenas prácticas. ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Al menos 3 años desarrollando soluciones de IA o datos, con responsabilidad directa sobre entregables en producción. Python sólido: desarrollo de aplicaciones, gestión de dependencias, testing y buenas prácticas. Experiencia demostrable construyendo sistemas RAG y agentes con LangChain, LangGraph u otros frameworks. Dominio de APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic u otras): prompting avanzado, gestión de contexto y optimización de costes. Experiencia desplegando en producción (Docker, AWS o Azure, CI/CD) e integrando con sistemas corporativos vía APIs REST y bases de datos relacionales. Castellano fluido, y nivel alto de inglés. ✨ Valoraremos positivamente si has trabajado en consultoría con exposición directa a cliente. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Flexibilidad horaria y trabajo híbrido. Plan de retribución flexible con Payflow. Formar parte de un equipo dinámico, multidisciplinar y con un clima basado en la confianza, la autonomía responsable y la colaboración. Participar en proyectos estratégicos para clientes referentes a nivel nacional e internacional. En RocaSalvatella apostamos firmemente por la diversidad, la inclusión y la igualdad de oportunidades, creando un entorno donde todas las personas puedan desarrollarse y aportar su mejor versión.

items.desc: Software development verschuift steeds meer naar systemen die zelfstandig beslissingen kunnen nemen en workflows autonoom kunnen uitvoeren. In plaats van alleen vaste logica te bouwen, ontwerpen engineers steeds vaker software die AI gebruikt om taken te plannen, tools aan te sturen en processen van begin tot eind te automatiseren. Het doel van deze junior functie is om je in korte tijd goed voor te bereiden op het bouwen van dit soort agentische AI-systemen en direct impact te maken bij klanten. Als Junior Agentic AI Engineer bij Itility begin je met een intern programma van ongeveer drie maanden waarin je de technische en consultancyvaardigheden leert die je nodig hebt om als AI-engineer het verschil te maken. Tijdens dit programma leer je door te doen via interne consultancyprojecten, waarbij je bijvoorbeeld werkt aan multi-agentsystemen en AI-oplossingen die processen kunnen ondersteunen en automatiseren. Dit doe je samen met Junior Data Engineers, zodat je vanaf het begin leert hoe betrouwbare data, generatieve AI en agentische applicaties samenkomen in moderne softwareoplossingen. Daarbij doe je ervaring op met verschillende technologieën, teams en klantscenario's. Na ongeveer drie maanden ga je aan de slag in een projectteam bij een klant, waar je jouw vaardigheden direct in de praktijk brengt en door blijft leren. Je draagt bij aan het ontwikkelen van softwareoplossingen voor grote klanten, waarbij AI wordt geïntegreerd in operationele workflows. Samen met je team bouw je agentische applicaties die aansluiten op bestaande systemen, data verwerken en bedrijfsprocessen van onze klanten automatiseren. Wat ga je leren? Tijdens het programma ontwikkel je zowel hands-on engineeringvaardigheden als consultancyvaardigheden die nodig zijn voor moderne softwareontwikkeling met (agentic) AI in een consultancyomgeving. Je leert onder andere: Het opzetten van een professionele ontwikkelomgeving (Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD-pipelines); Het ontwerpen, bouwen en testen van softwareapplicaties; Het ontwikkelen van API’s en toolintegraties; Het ontwerpen en implementeren van agentische AI-workflows; Werken met agentische AI-frameworks zoals LangChain en Deep Agents; Werken met RAG-systemen en vectordatabases; Het implementeren van korte- en langetermijngeheugenconcepten in AI-agents; Het uitrollen van applicaties naar Azure Cloud/AWS Cloud; Het toepassen van security best practices in software- en AI-systemen. Dit is wat we je bieden Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om je op de beste manier te ontwikkelen, onder persoonlijke begeleiding van de rest van het team. Daar hoort het volgende bij: €3.100 bruto maandsalaris; €115 onkostenvergoeding; Keuze uit een mobiliteitsvergoeding van €450 + kilometervergoeding of een leaseauto + tankpas; Bonus gebaseerd op jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en gezamenlijke successen; Twee keer per jaar doorgroeimogelijkheden in salaris; 50% bijdrage aan de zorgverzekering; 60% bijdrage aan het pensioen; 26 vakantiedagen; Hybride werken na het intern programma; Toegang tot de Itility Academy (technische trainingen en soft skills-trainingen); Laptop en mobiele telefoon; Gebruik van de Itility gym op kantoor. Wie ben jij? Je bent een recent afgestudeerde of junior professional met een achtergrond in software engineering en een sterke interesse in AI-gedreven systemen. Je vindt het leuk om software te bouwen en wil leren hoe AI kan worden ingezet als onderdeel van modern systeemontwerp. Daarnaast breng je mee: Een bachelor- of masterdiploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, ICT, Artificial Intelligence of een vergelijkbare richting; Ervaring met softwareontwikkeling in talen zoals Python, JavaScript of C#; Een sterke interesse in het bouwen van schaalbare softwaresystemen; De bereidheid en enthousiasme om te leren en te werken in een snel veranderende technische omgeving; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels en Nederlands; Een mindset die gericht is op continu leren en verbeteren. Pré: ervaring met Generative AI en het werken aan AI-projecten, bijvoorbeeld met LLM’s, AI-agents, RAG-systemen of AI-automatisering. Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen? Solliciteer gerust! We kijken naar impact en groeipotentieel. Wanneer start je? 1 februari 2027 Screening maakt deel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure. Location Eindhoven, Nederland Contact Julia Bakker +31 (0)6 44 76 18 25 Nieuwsgierig naar onze coole initiatieven? Klik hier om meer te lezen over onze customer use cases.

items.desc: The Impact You'll Make AI agents are moving from demos into everyday work, and we want every team at Danfoss to be able to use them. You'll build the tools, integrations and templates that let engineers, product teams and domain experts create useful AI agents. Those people should be able to do this without being AI specialists themselves. We're looking for a strong engineer who loves connecting systems and building tools other people rely on, and who is already curious about LLMs and AI agentic development with some experience even if not production ready. Alongside experienced engineers you'll integrate AI into our tools and services bring them to production level components. What You’ll Be Doing Build integrations that let AI agents work with our platform services, using APIs, MCP servers and whatever patterns turn out to work best. Create reusable agent templates and workflows that other teams can pick up and adapt. Build simple tools that let non-technical colleagues create and use agents safely. Work directly with product teams and domain experts to find tasks worth automating, then ship solutions and improve them. Make agents reliable in practice, through testing, monitoring and security, and by understanding why an agent did what it did. Keep exploring new AI capabilities and share what you learn with the rest of the organisation. What We're Looking For 3-5 years building backend services, integrations, automation or internal tools in Python or TypeScript or Go. Experience connecting APIs, services and data sources into something that runs in production. Real curiosity about AI agent topics, LLMs, RAG, MCP or agent framework LangGraph or LangChain you've built something with one, even a side project or hackathon prototype, and you want to go deeper. You like being close to users, asking what slows them down and building what fixes it. Fluent English and the confidence to explain technical ideas to non-technical colleagues. Exploiter les outils de développement assisté par l'IA afin d'améliorer la productivité et la qualité du code. Concevoir et développer des API et des services backend performants et sécurisés. Participer à la conception de solutions basées sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM). Mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de prompt engineering et d'orchestration des modèles d'IA. Réaliser les tests unitaires, les tests d'intégration et les contrôles de qualité du code. Participer à l'intégration continue, au déploiement et à l'industrialisation des applications. Collaborer avec les équipes IT, Data, DevOps et métiers pour identifier et mettre en œuvre des solutions innovantes. Développement backend : conception d'API REST et développement de services applicatifs. Intelligence artificielle générative : compréhension des LLM et de leurs cas d'usage. Prompt engineering : capacité à concevoir, tester et optimiser des prompts. Développement assisté par l'IA : utilisation d'outils de génération de code et d'assistance au développement. Frameworks Python : connaissance de FastAPI, Flask ou Django. Tests et qualité logicielle : tests automatisés, bonnes pratiques de développement, revue de code et gestion de versions avec Git. Bases de données : maîtrise des bases SQL et/ou NoSQL. Industrialisation : notions de CI/CD, Docker et environnements de déploiement. RAG et outils d'orchestration IA : connaissance de frameworks tels que LangChain ou LlamaIndex, appréciée. Expérience ou forte appétence pour le développement de solutions intégrant l'intelligence artificielle. Capacité à utiliser efficacement les outils d'IA tout en conservant une approche rigoureuse en matière de qualité, de sécurité et de maintenabilité du code. Esprit d'analyse, autonomie, curiosité technique et capacité à résoudre des problèmes complexes. Bonnes capacités de communication et aptitude à travailler en équipe dans un environnement agile. Livrables attendus Code source documenté, testé et maintenable. API et services Python opérationnels. Prototypes et fonctionnalités intégrant l'IA générative. Tests automatisés et documentation technique. Contributions aux pipelines d'intégration et de déploiement. Recommandations d'amélioration continue et de bonnes pratiques de développement AI-Native.

items.desc: About Oper Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency. The fastest growing part of our business is Herman , our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. It is agentic software doing real work in a regulated environment. A passionate and engaging team of around 30 stellar Fintech operators works vigorously to transform European mortgages by enhancing efficiency and alleviating borrower anxiety. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Motive Ventures, we have raised EUR 14 million, placing Oper at the forefront of revolutionizing mortgages in Europe. Oper currently has offices in Zürich, Switzerland, and Antwerp, Belgium. Now, we're looking for an AI Solutions Engineer to join our AI Squad and help shape the future of automated mortgages in Europe and beyond. Your Mission You'll join the AI Squad , the team building Herman. This is a hands-on, hybrid role spanning AI engineering, product management, and solutions architecture . You'll scope and build working AI prototypes, take them in front of real banks to pressure-test against live mortgage workflows, and work alongside the team to turn these into working Herman features. You own delivery end-to-end: from a rough use case to a shipped capability, communicating progress clearly the whole way. This is an applied role, not a research one. We want a builder who can both code and collaborate, who is comfortable in front of a client in the morning and deep in a codebase in the afternoon. Tasks What you'll do Scope and build working AI prototypes - LLMs, RAG, agentic automation, and integrations - that solve concrete origination problems. Engage directly with clients : run workshops, gather requirements, demo, and iteratively refine solutions against the real workflows of regulated banks. Define and manage AI use cases , structuring them functionally so they can scale beyond a single client. Work closely within your team to turn validated prototypes into production features. Own delivery timelines and communicate progress clearly to both clients and internal stakeholders. Work AI-native Building agentic software is the job, and we expect you to build the way you ship: AI-first. Write code AI-first: agents produce the bulk of your code under your direction, while you own the architecture, integrations, review, and quality. We measure your output in shipped value, not hand-typed lines. Build agentic workflows that do real work: scaffolding prototypes and integrations from a spec, generating and running tests, drafting evaluation harnesses, and reviewing diffs. Use modern AI tooling as the default way you build, configure, and debug, not as an occasional helper. Aim for a delivery cadence a non-AI-native engineer simply cannot match, and help us raise the bar on what an AI-native delivery function looks like at Oper. Requirements What you'll bring 4 to 6 years of experience in software development, with hands-on AI/LLM work. Strong with Python and modern AI tooling: LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks, orchestration, and evaluation . Able to structure projects functionally and own delivery end-to-end , from scoping to shipped feature. Comfortable being client-facing : running workshops, gathering requirements, and translating ambiguity into working software. Comfortable working with flexible and loosely defined requirements, bringing your own structure where needed. Genuinely AI-native : agents already write most of your code and you build agentic workflows to multiply your output. You can name the tools, the workflows, and the concrete recent projects where AI gave you real leverage. Excellent communication skills. Creative and analytical mindset. Ambition to learn, experiment, and grow while staying humble and open-minded. Fluency in English; additional languages (e.g. Dutch, German) are a plus. Experience in a relevant industry (financial services) and thriving in a scale-up environment are a plus. This is an applied, client-facing, cross-functional role. We are not looking for researchers, "idea people," or internal-only engineers. Location & Setup Belgium-based candidates: hybrid setup with 2 to 3 days per week in our Antwerp office Working in CET hours Reporting to the CTO Close collaboration with the AI Squad, Product, and client-facing teams Benefits As a fast-growing fintech, we're building a team where you can truly make an impact. items.desc: Elliptic is building AI-powered tools that enable the business to scale faster and with greater confidence. Our operations team is at the centre of that work — designing the backend systems and AI integrations behind Elliptic's agentic transformation. This transformation is all about rethinking existing business processes – from workflows to ticket queues to decisions – and enabling our workforce to take the next great leap forward in productivity. We're looking for a full-stack Agent Engineer to help us design and build agent fleets, AI integrations, APIs, workflows, UIs and services that make this possible. The Impact You Will Have As Agent Engineer on the Operations team, you will help design and deliver scalable, reliable services that power Elliptic’s internal business systems, focusing on building our agent fleets to automate core business processes. You’ll partner with the Head of Business Transformation and VP of Operations, to turn complex internal processes into intelligent, user‑friendly experiences that help teams around the business perform their jobs with greater speed and confidence. Your work will make a tangible and immediate impact on team productivity, and you will work iteratively directly with your users to forge solutions that meet their needs. Working collaboratively across disciplines, you’ll contribute to impactful features and continuously improve quality, reliability, and usability across our internal platforms. Through this work, you’ll play an essential role in advancing Elliptic’s mission to make crypto markets safer, more transparent, and more efficient. What You Will Do Lead the development of agent fleets to model complex business processes in Langchain. Develop APIs and workflows that integrate AI and LLM frameworks with business systems. Design, optimise, and query data models across relational and NoSQL databases. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver an agentic platform from concept through to production. Take part in technical design reviews, planning sessions, and code reviews to continuously improve system quality. Contribute to infrastructure and observability practices alongside the Engineering team — you won't own this alone, but you'll be expected to care about how your services run in production. What You'll Bring Strong, demonstrable engineering experience, ideally including Python. We weigh the depth and relevance of your experience rather than years served, so there's no hard minimum. Production AI/agent experience: you've personally built and run an LLM or agent system with real users in production, not demos or prototypes. Hands-on experience with LangSmith or an equivalent LLM/agent platform. This one's essential. We're looking for genuine, practical use rather than awareness, so you should be able to talk us through what you built and ran on it. Evaluations: you've written evals to measure and improve the quality of an LLM or agent system. Solid API design skills: you've built and maintained production APIs and know how to integrate with external systems. Cloud and deployment experience: you've worked with AWS services (e.g. Lambda, ECS, S3) in production, and you're comfortable with CI/CD deployment pipelines like CircleCI. Database proficiency: you're comfortable with SQL (Postgres or similar) and have some exposure to NoSQL stores. A structured approach to problem-solving: you think clearly about system design and trade-offs. Strong collaboration skills: you communicate well across engineering, product and design. Nice to Have Experience with Node.js frameworks like NestJS or Express. Hands-on experience with Terraform, or infrastructure-as-code tooling. Experience with Helm and Kubernetes. Experience with observability platforms like Datadog (metrics, tracing, alerting). Exposure to DynamoDB or other NoSQL databases at scale. Experience with distributed or event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS, etc.). Interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, or compliance — though we're happy to bring you up to speed. Don't Meet Every Requirement? If this role excites you but your experience doesn't perfectly match every bullet point, we'd still love to hear from you. We value curiosity, willingness to learn, and diverse perspectives just as much as specific tool experience. Ensuring that people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences feel welcome at Elliptic is an ongoing priority for us. We believe diverse thinking enables us to solve problems in new ways — benefiting both our team and our customers.
