items.desc:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project. 
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

1.Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
2.Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
3.Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
4.Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
5.Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

items.desc: About Us At BGBx , we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges. Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day. If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx. Position Overview We are looking for an AI Engineer with 3-5 years of experience to help maintain and evolve our fleet of AI agents, LLM-as-a-judge systems, and other AI-powered tools used by healthcare, life sciences, and marketing teams. This role will work closely with senior engineers on graph design and with product and research teams to define what "a good answer" means, including grounding, coverage, and citation honesty. The AI Engineer will contribute to the continued development of these systems by improving tools, retrieval and citations, agent architecture, and overall system speed, cost, and accuracy. They will also support evaluations and experiments that help us understand and improve system performance. We are looking for someone with strong Python skills and a solid understanding of LLM systems who is excited to continue growing their technical depth. At this level, the engineer should be comfortable owning a component of a production service from design through testing and review, while partnering with more senior engineers on broader architecture and system design. Responsibilities Agent tools: Create new agent tools and improve existing ones across retrieval and grounding, vector and keyword search, live-source search, analytics queries, PDF generation, and more. Integrate external APIs and data sources into our agent systems, including Pinecone, Meilisearch, Hasura, Cube, and GCP. Graphs and middleware: Extend and improve our agent state machines, including skill resolution, tool-calling loops, review gates, answer post-processing, and token guards. Observability and operations: Work with real production data and infrastructure and help improve the observability, reliability, and ongoing maintenance of our AI systems. End-to-end ownership: Own features from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. Qualifications 3-5 years of hands-on engineering experience, ideally working with data and/or AI systems. Professional experience writing and testing Python. Experience integrating APIs, including reading documentation and working with pagination, timeouts, authentication, and complex JSON responses. Experience using LLMs as a developer and an interest in building reliable AI systems, including addressing issues such as hallucinations, incorrect citations, and context limitations. Ability to write high-quality code using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Codex, or Claude Code, or willingness to learn quickly. Comfort working with production systems and taking ownership of features through implementation, testing, and deployment. Knowledge of search and RAG concepts, including embeddings, filters, and hybrid keyword and vector retrieval. Exposure to GraphQL or analytics APIs, such as Cube or similar semantic layers. Understanding of logs, traces, observability, and general maintenance of production systems. Comfort contributing to frontend-adjacent work when needed. Why Join Us? items.desc: Why Keyrus, Why Now! Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last. Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This role is both technical and consultative — perfect for someone who can combine hands-on AI engineering, solution design, and close collaboration with client teams. We’re looking for professionals who think like architects and act like builders. Your focus is the intelligence layer of the solution: how models are integrated, how information is retrieved, how agents behave, how quality is evaluated, and how the capability performs once deployed. You will work closely with Software Engineers, Data Engineers, AI Foundation Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers and AI Governance specialists , while retaining clear ownership of the AI behaviour and quality of the solution. Design and build production AI capabilities , including RAG systems, intelligent assistants and agent-enabled workflows aligned with the approved solution architecture. Engineer agent behaviour across instructions, context, tools, state, routing, memory, recovery, stopping conditions and appropriate human checkpoints. Design evaluations and quality gates using representative datasets, automated and regression testing, task-success measures, groundedness and other relevant indicators. Deploy, monitor and improve AI capabilities in production , using evaluation results and observed system behaviour to drive continuous improvement. Implement reliability and control mechanisms such as validation, guardrails, failure handling and human oversight, within the architecture and governance standards defined for the engagement. Integrate AI capabilities with the surrounding solution and client systems , working with Software Engineers on application interfaces and with Data Engineers on retrieval, data quality and AI-ready data. Enable client teams to run and extend the agents after go-live. Document and reuse what works , including AI behaviour, dependencies, evaluation criteria, limitations and engineering patterns that strengthen future Keyrus engagements. You care about what happens after the model responds: whether the context was right, whether the agent chose the appropriate action, and whether the result holds up when it runs repeatedly in production. You make pragmatic technical trade-offs rather than searching for the perfect technology choice. You use evidence and evaluations to improve systems, and you communicate limitations clearly. Wist je dat Elia België hierbij een cruciale rol speelt? Als onderdeel van de Elia groep, een Europese transmissienetbeheerder, verzekert Elia België de betrouwbaarheid en duurzaamheid van de elektriciteitsbevoorrading in ons land. Bij ons bouw je samen met andere talentvolle collega’s aan een duurzame, groene en betrouwbare energie-infrastructuur die economische groei stimuleert en onze ecologische voetafdruk verkleint. Samen gaan we voor maximale impact! We geloven in de kracht van diversiteit: we zijn ervan overtuigd dat een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving leidt tot meer innovatie, creativiteit en betere resultaten. Domain Architect Corporate & AI Vacature ID: 11560 Startdatum publicatie: 16-10-2026 Functiebeschrijving Elia Group is op zoek naar een ervaren Domain Architect om ons Central IT Architecture-team te versterken. Als Domain IT Architect zorg je ervoor dat het IT-landschap binnen jouw domeinen coherent, veilig, performant en toekomstbestendig blijft. Je speelt een sleutelrol in het ondersteunen van een betrouwbare uitbating van het elektriciteitsnet door technologiekeuzes af te stemmen op de strategische doelstellingen en de regelgevende verplichtingen van Elia Group. In deze rol neem je ownership over twee strategische domeinen: Corporate: een breed businessdomein dat de corporate capabilities en ondersteunende processen van de organisatie omvat. Artificial Intelligence (AI): een strategisch technologiedomein gericht op het ontwikkelen, schalen en governen van AI-capabilities binnen de organisatie. We zoeken geen puur theoretische architect, maar een pragmatische bruggenbouwer die strategie vertaalt naar concrete oplossingen. Je beweegt je vlot tussen business en technologie en zet strategische doelstellingen om in schaalbare en duurzame architectuurkeuzes. Verantwoordelijkheden: Verantwoordelijk voor het definiëren en uitdragen van de architectuurvisie, roadmap en target architecture voor Corporate IT en AI. Vertaling van businessbehoeften en strategische doelstellingen naar schaalbare en future-proof architecture solutions. Sturing en governance van technology decisions, met aandacht voor alignment met enterprise standards, security requirements en architecture principles. Nauwe samenwerking met business- en IT-stakeholders om opportuniteiten te identificeren die duurzame waarde creëren en bijdragen aan operational excellence. Leiding nemen in architecture reviews en richting geven bij complexe uitdagingen rond technologie, data en integratie. Bijdragen aan portfolio optimization door application rationalization, platform reuse en duurzame technologiekeuzes te stimuleren. Waarborgen dat oplossingen gedurende hun volledige lifecycle kunnen evolueren, van design en implementation tot operations en retirement. Samenwerking met data-, platform- en solution architects om een naadloze integratie, interoperabiliteit en hoogwaardig databeheer te verzekeren. Integratie van resilience, security, compliance en risk management in architecturale beslissingen vanaf de eerste ontwerpfase. Verder uitbouwen en governen van het AI-ecosysteem van Elia, zodat AI-oplossingen op een verantwoorde manier kunnen bijdragen aan innovatie en business value. #DomainArchitect #Architecture #CorporateIT #Oil&Energy #Utilities #LI-HYBRID Jouw profiel Voor deze rol zoeken we een architect die strategisch inzicht combineert met technische expertise en die moeiteloos bruggen slaat tussen business en technologie. Een masterdiploma in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems of gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Minstens 10 jaar relevante ervaring binnen IT Architecture, Enterprise Architecture of Digital Transformation. Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwerpen en governen van complexe IT-landschappen binnen grootschalige organisaties. Grondige kennis van architectuurframeworks en modelling standards zoals TOGAF en ArchiMate. Hands-on ervaring met moderne architectuurpraktijken zoals Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Event Storming en Agile Architecture. Een goede kennis van Corporate-domeinen zoals HR, Finance, Procurement en Corporate Services. Sterke stakeholder management skills en het vermogen om zowel executive leadership als technische delivery teams mee te nemen in architectuurbeslissingen. Ervaring met het afwegen van business value, cost, risk, security en sustainability binnen complexe besluitvormingstrajecten. Sterke kennis van AI architectures, AI governance en emerging technologies zoals Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG en Machine Learning. Een vlotte kennis van Nederlands of Frans, aangevuld met een professionele kennis van het Engels. Kennis van de andere landstaal vormt een extra troef. Gartner Consulting is where that insight becomes action, helping the world's most influential enterprises and public sector leaders turn complexity into competitive advantage. About the Role As a Managing Partner in Gartner Consulting Finland, you will play a pivotal leadership role in growing Gartner's consulting presence and impact across Finland’s leading Manufacturing, Engineering and Energy companies. This is a senior leadership position for an accomplished consulting executive with an established reputation in the Finnish market, a strong personal brand at the C-suite level, and a passion for helping clients address their most critical business challenges. You will work alongside fellow partners in Finland, across the Nordics, and throughout EMEA to shape opportunities, build trusted executive relationships, and deliver transformative outcomes for clients. Rather than operating within a standalone portfolio, you will contribute to a shared client ecosystem, acting as lead partner for some strategic accounts while co-leading others in close collaboration with colleagues across Gartner's consulting, research, and advisory businesses. While a strong understanding of the Finnish business ecosystem and industrial landscape is highly valuable, success in this role is equally dependent on the ability to lead through influence, develop talent, foster collaboration, and expand Gartner's long-term presence within the Finnish executive community. What You Will Do As a Managing Partner, you will operate at the intersection of executive leadership, business transformation, technology, and growth. You will serve as a trusted advisor to the C-suite, business leaders, executives, and board-level stakeholders, helping them navigate growth, transformation, geopolitical uncertainty, technology disruption, and changing market conditions. You will: Build and strengthen relationships with senior executives across Finland's largest organisations, leveraging an active and credible C-suite network. Collaborate with Gartner partners across Finland, the Nordics, and EMEA to identify opportunities, shape engagements, and deliver client impact. Lead strategic client relationships while contributing to a broader shared portfolio model built on teamwork and collective success. Bring together Gartner's world-class research, benchmarking capabilities, advisory expertise, and consulting services to solve mission-critical client challenges. Shape and win complex consulting engagements and transformation programmes. Guide executive teams through strategic, operational, digital, technology, and organisational transformation initiatives. Act as a visible market leader, strengthening Gartner's profile within the Finnish executive community. Mentor, coach, and develop consultants and future leaders, helping individuals achieve their professional potential. Foster a culture of inclusion, collaboration, belonging, and high performance across the consulting team. Support the growth of Gartner Consulting in Finland by contributing to recruiting, talent development, intellectual capital, and practice building initiatives. What You Bring University degree in business, engineering, technology, economics, public administration, defence studies, or a related discipline. Significant experience as a senior consulting leader, partner, or executive advisor within a leading consulting or professional services organisation. A well established and actively maintained network of C-suite executives, business leaders, and decision-makers across Finland. Proven ability to build trusted executive relationships and develop long-term strategic client partnerships. Strong commercial acumen with a track record of originating, shaping, and growing large consulting engagements. Demonstrated technology domain expertise across SAP/ERP, cloud, data, enterprise architecture, infrastructure and/or cybersecurity, with the ability to understand complex technology environments and translate them into relevant business outcomes. Experience leading enterprise wide transformation programmes involving strategy, operations, technology, organisational change, or digital transformation. Demonstrated success leading, coaching, and developing high-performing consulting teams. A collaborative leadership style with a passion for building talent, fostering inclusion, and creating environments where people thrive. items.desc: We’re looking for an Agentic Platform Engineer to join our tech team and help build the future of neuro-contextual advertising at global scale. Who We Are At Seedtag, our mission is to transform advertising by proving that effectiveness and user privacy can truly coexist. As the leading Neuro-Contextual Advertising Company, we combine Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and neuroscience to understand not only what content is about, but how it makes people feel and what they intend to do next. Our proprietary AI, Liz, enables brands to connect with audiences across the open web and Connected TV without cookies or user tracking. Founded in 2014 by two ex-Googlers, Seedtag has grown to 500+ Seedtaggers in 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and operates today as a global ad-tech leader. If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and building AI-driven systems at scale, you’ll feel right at home here. Your Challenge As our Agentic Platform Engineer, you will help build and scale Liz Agent, Seedtag's AI agent platform, ensuring reliability, security, and seamless integration across teams. Your main responsibilities will include: Agent Platform Development: Build and maintain the core Liz Agent runtime, including agent execution, context management, and event streaming. Tools & Integrations: Develop MCP tool servers, APIs, and integrations that enable secure access to internal data and services. Agentic AI Capabilities: Improve agent functionality through memory, multi-model routing, durable execution, and LLM frameworks. Reliability & Observability: Monitor platform performance, troubleshoot production issues, and improve tracing and evaluation capabilities. Platform Engineering: Contribute to APIs, service templates, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments that enable teams to build agents independently. Security & Quality: Implement security best practices, automated evaluations, and regression testing to ensure reliable agent behaviour. End-to-End Ownership: Take responsibility for features from development to deployment and monitoring, collaborating with Data, ML, Platform, and Product teams. Our Core Values Outcome over Output We measure success by impact and value, not by volume of features or lines of code. Failure Is Allowed, Learning Is a Must Experimentation is key to innovation. We test early, iterate often, and learn fast. We Are All Scouts We take ownership and leave things better than we found them. We Are Data-Driven Data informs our decisions and helps us continuously improve our systems and results. Tech Stack You'll work with the technologies powering Liz Agent, our AI agent platform, built on 30+ services running on GKE. Our stack includes: Languages: Python, Go. Cloud & Infrastructure: GCP, GKE, Kubernetes, Vertex AI, BigQuery. Agentic AI: MCP, PydanticAI, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, OpenAI Agent SDK. Data & Messaging: Pub/Sub, Redis, Firestore. LLMOps & Observability: Langfuse, Prometheus, Logfire, LiteLLM. DevOps & CI/CD: ArgoCD, Kustomize, GitHub Actions. Additional Technologies: TypeScript, Next.js, embeddings, vector search. What You’ll Need to Succeed 3+ years of experience building and maintaining backend systems in production. Strong Python expertise, including APIs, asynchronous programming, testing, and clean architecture. Hands-on experience developing LLM applications or AI agents, including tool calling, structured outputs, and evaluations. Solid understanding of event-driven architectures, microservices, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure. Experience with LLMOps, observability, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting. Knowledge of AI security practices, including authentication, access controls, and prompt-injection protection. Ability to own features end to end, work autonomously, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Why Join Seedtag? A key moment of growth with real ownership and global impact. Flexible work model with 100% remote or hybrid options. (Remote contracts available in Spain, Italy, UK, Belgium, Netherlands, France, and Germany.) Continuous learning through a learning platform and optional language classes. A supportive, trust-based culture that values well-being. Team activities, offsites, and opportunities to connect beyond work. Additional Perks Home office setup budget up to €1,000 Paid trips to our HQ in Madrid MacBook Pro M3 Ready to Join the Seedtag Adventure? At Seedtag, we create an environment where everyone can thrive. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, let us know and we’ll ensure a positive experience. Send us your CV and let’s build the future of neuro-contextual advertising together.

items.desc: Dublin, -, Ireland Galway, -, Ireland Cork, -, Ireland Ireland Limerick, -, Ireland Ground Engineering Europe Region    DUB0000VF Requisition # Geotechnical Engineer Dublin or Cork | Ireland Shape a future with purpose at Arup in Ireland. Engineer the ground beneath tomorrow’s most critical infrastructure. Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 75 years, guiding how we shape a better world. Our Ground Engineering team is the largest in Ireland, bringing together geotechnical engineers, hydrogeologists, contaminated land specialists, and engineering geologists. We deliver innovative projects with creativity and passion, shaping the built environment across Ireland and the wider European business. The Opportunity This is an excellent opportunity to join a highly specialised team and contribute to a dynamic portfolio of complex, multidisciplinary projects. You will play a key role in shaping some of the most significant infrastructure and development schemes in Ireland and across Europe. While the role focuses on geotechnical engineering design and delivery, you will also gain valuable exposure to the full breadth of Ground Engineering disciplines. This position offers a stimulating and supportive environment to advance your technical, business, and people skills, working alongside industry experts and developing relationships with our firm’s wider engineering community. It also offers the opportunity to place sustainability at the heart of engineering solutions. As a Geotechnical Engineer at Arup, you will: Deliver geotechnical design and analysis for foundations, retaining structures, slope stability, and earthworks on major international commissions (e.g., hyperscale data centres in Europe, the Fehmarnsund Link) and nationally significant Irish infrastructure (e.g., Metrolink, DART+, N6 Galway Ring Road). Prepare high-quality design reports, technical specifications, desk studies, and site walkovers for educational, pharmaceutical, industrial, and commercial developments. Plan, supervise, and interpret geotechnical ground investigations, providing technical support during the construction phase, including periodic site visits. Incorporate the latest digital tools, automation, and numerical analysis into our projects to enhance project delivery. Develop your project management and commercial awareness skills, while supporting and mentoring junior colleagues as you strengthen your own leadership capabilities. Does this role inspire you? We're looking for a motivated and ambitious engineer looking to build a strong foundation in geotechnical design. We also value: An honours Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Geotechnical, or Structural Engineering (or equivalent). A post-graduate qualification in Geotechnical Engineering or Soil Mechanics is an advantage. Over 3 years of post-graduate experience in geotechnical design and/or construction. Strong technical understanding of the design of deep excavations, deep and shallow foundations, earthworks, slope stability, and soft ground solutions. Good planning, organisational, and time management skills, with the ability to maintain personal effectiveness across several projects and communicate confidently in both technical and non-technical settings. Experience in planning, managing, supervising, and interpreting ground investigation contracts, and/or experience in numerical analysis and GIS. A commitment to continuous professional development, ideally working towards Chartered status, with the flexibility to travel and work on-site (a full driver’s licence is a strong advantage). items.desc: Description Oritain is a global leader in forensic origin verification of products and raw materials. With offices in London, Auckland, Dunedin, Paris, Singapore and Washington D.C, our vision is to be the source of truth in global supply chains. Through our proprietary methodology, our mission is to harness cutting edge science, data, and specialised services to create a community of origin verified buyers and suppliers, protecting our people and planet. We empower the world’s leading brands to make positive changes across their supply chain; ensuring product integrity, meeting regulatory demands, and reducing the risk of fraud and unethical sourcing, creating real change in our world. About the role We’re looking for an Infrastructure & Security Engineer to take ownership of the security and infrastructure foundations that support Oritain’s growth. Reporting to our Head of IT & Security, you’ll secure our cloud, identity and network environments and play a central role in maturing our compliance programme through ISO 27001 renewal, Cyber Essentials certification and alignment with the NIST and CMMC frameworks. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thrives taking on a task, shaping the plan, bringing the right people together and delivering it. In your first months, around half of your time will focus on strengthening our security posture, so you’ll make a visible impact early. You’ll work closely with our Service Desk, Engineering teams and colleagues across the business. While there are no direct reports, you’ll be a leading voice in the team: drawing in colleagues to deliver projects, guiding others on how to build securely and helping shape how we work. You’ll also lead the secure adoption of AI across Oritain, bringing an AI-first approach to how we run and protect our infrastructure. We’re a fast-growing business, and many of our processes are still being built. If you see that as an opportunity to create structure, raise standards and leave your mark, you’ll find real scope to grow here, including the chance to build expertise in our modern cloud-based networking and security platform. What you'll be doing Your core focus will be the security of our infrastructure and platforms. You’ll identify, track and remediate vulnerabilities, stay ahead of patching priorities, and administer and continuously improve Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel, integrating infrastructure and security tooling for monitoring and detection. When incidents happen, you’ll coordinate and technically lead the response alongside our external Security Operations Centre (SOC). You’ll drive our compliance and accreditation work for ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials, NIST and CMMC, using Vanta to manage control coverage and evidence collection. You’ll also contribute to the ongoing development of our Information Security Management System (ISMS) and conduct third-party risk assessments, using automation, Vanta and AI to work efficiently. On the infrastructure side, you’ll design, build, secure and improve our cloud and on-premises services. This includes delivering identity and access solutions with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, role-based access control and secure authentication, and administering Azure infrastructure such as VNets, routing, VPN and site-to-site gateways, and network security groups. You’ll design network segmentation using VLANs, firewall rules and access controls, build and troubleshoot SD-WAN technologies, and support wired and wireless networking, including RADIUS and certificate-based authentication. You’ll also lead the secure adoption of AI across Oritain. That means designing, deploying and securing tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude, with data loss prevention (DLP) and Purview controls across Microsoft 365 and Azure. You’ll define AI guardrails, governance standards and usage policies, assess risks such as data leakage and regulatory exposure, and apply AI and automation to make our infrastructure and security workflows more efficient. What we're looking for You’ll bring senior, hands-on experience delivering and supporting IT infrastructure and security, ideally in an organisation of a similar size with global reach, or larger. Most importantly, you’ll have a track record of taking a broad security objective, defining the approach and delivering it end to end with minimal direction. Technically, you’ll have strong working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, identity and access management and secure authentication, alongside practical experience with Azure and Microsoft 365 infrastructure, including Microsoft Defender and Sentinel. You’ll have solid networking fundamentals, including VLANs, switches, firewalls, routing and VPNs, and experience supporting security incident response and vulnerability management. You’ll also have working knowledge of security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST and Cyber Essentials, with experience supporting audits, ISMS activities or compliance …

items.desc: Are you passionate about leveraging AI to transform global industries? Do you have experience working with LLMs and building agentic solutions? Join Elixirr Digital as an AI Engineer , where you will drive innovation and help shape the future of intelligent systems for clients across industries like banking, insurance, healthcare, telecommunications, consumer goods, and more. We're looking for proactive self-starters who are constantly reading research, applying it, and using AI to improve their processes, fully embracing the technology. At Elixirr Digital , we've been on the cutting edge of generative AI from the beginning, developing our own platforms and deploying transformative solutions to global clients for several years. Our expertise spans working with frontier and open-source models across providers including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Meta, and leading frameworks like LangChain, Google ADK, and AutoGen to build innovative, agentic solutions built on open standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP). From underwriting agents that empower financial professionals to knowledge agents streamlining customer workflows, our solutions are revolutionizing industries by embedding AI at their core. If you're excited to work at the forefront of generative AI, helping enterprises transform from the inside out, we want to hear from you. Let's build the future of AI together! Drive Innovation: Work on a mix of internal R&D projects and enterprise-level solutions, building and optimizing tools for both internal and client use. Deploy at Scale: Develop and maintain production-ready AI solutions, ensuring scalability, performance, reliability, and observability through tracing and evaluation tooling. End-to-End Lifecycle: Contribute to the entire AI development lifecycle, from research and prototyping to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Deliver Tangible Outcomes: Help global enterprises achieve measurable impact through solutions like underwriting agents, airport assistants, pharmacy workflow optimizers, and customer due diligence systems. Experience integrating tools, managing context, and working with retrieval pipelines. Bring Technical Expertise: Solid background in programming and foundational experience in machine learning, with working knowledge in at least one area such as deep learning, fine-tuning, or RAG-based architectures. Care About Quality: Familiarity with testing and evaluating LLM outputs, using logging or tracing tools to debug and improve system behaviour in production. Are Innovation-Driven: Stay ahead of AI trends, continuously learn and experiment, and actively apply cutting-edge research to improve processes and develop scalable, impactful solutions. items.desc: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, nos solutions N2F et Keeple s’imposent comme des références sur le marché français. N2F est une solution complète de gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs), et Keeple centralise la gestion RH du quotidien (congés, absences, temps de travail) le tout dans une interface simple, intuitive et 100% connectée (app web et mobile). Portés par une équipe engagée, qui place l’humain au centre de ses priorités, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles. Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(se) spécialisé(e) en Intelligence Artificielle pour renforcer notre équipe R&D et accélérer le développement de nos solutions innovantes. Tu travailleras sur la conception, l’intégration et l’industrialisation de cas d’usage IA (LLM, Machine Learning, RAG, automatisation) au service de nos produits SaaS. Missions principales : Conception et développement de solutions IA en Python. Mise en place de pipelines RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pour améliorer la pertinence des modèles, Exploitation du cloud AWS et en particulier des services IA/LLM (ex. Bedrock), Intégration d’outils IA et d’orchestration (N8N, OpenAI, Claude, …), Expérimentation et amélioration continue via prompt engineering et fine-tuning de modèles, Veille technologique sur les innovations IA et proposition d’idées/concepts pour enrichir nos produits, Collaboration avec les équipes produit, data et dev pour industrialiser des solutions IA fiables et scalables. Compétences techniques attendues : Maîtrise du langage Python. Expérience sur AWS (idéalement Bedrock, Lambda, S3, etc.), Bonne culture des APIs IA (OpenAI, Claude, etc.). C’est un plus si : Première expérience en mise en production de solutions IA/LLM Connaissances avancées en LLM et techniques de prompting, Pratique du RAG et des architectures de recherche de données contextuelles, Familiarité avec des outils d’orchestration et d’automatisation (ex. N8N), Soft skills : Force de proposition : capable de transformer la veille technologique en solutions concrètes, Autonomie et rigueur dans le développement, Goût pour le travail collaboratif (produit, QA, data, dev), Curiosité et capacité à vulgariser l’IA pour des profils non techniques. Profil recherché : Expérience confirmée (3 à 5 ans minimum) en développement logiciel (si possible sur des projets IA) Expérience dans un contexte cloud (idéalement AWS), Ce que ce poste n’est PAS : de la data science (pas de modélisation statistique, pas d’entraînement de modèles maison), un rôle de recherche LLM ou NLP, un poste MLOps centré sur l’infrastructure ou la gestion de clusters, un rôle orienté expérimentation académique. Ce poste est bel et bien un rôle de développeur(se) logiciel : il s’agit de concevoir, intégrer et industrialiser des fonctionnalités IA directement dans nos produits SaaS. Tech, pragmatique, orienté production. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un environnement stimulant et innovant, Des défis techniques stimulants à fort impact technologique dans une culture de la qualité et du partage, Une vraie autonomie dans les choix techniques, et du temps pour faire bien, Un cadre de travail flexible : télétravail possible avec une semaine de présence par trimestre. Les avantages chez N2JSOFT : Prime de vacances, Chèques cadeaux à Noël, Chèques rentrée scolaire (si tu as des enfants), Chèque culture, Cours de musique, Événements d’équipe toute l’année. Poste en CDI avec full remote possible (une semaine de présence par trimestre requise).

items.desc: Au sein de l'équipe Agentic Platform, en tant qu 'Ingénieur(e) IA , vous contribuerez au développement d'AURA — le Virtual Companion dédié aux business users de la plateforme 3DEXPERIENCE. AURA accompagne des utilisateurs métier dans leurs tâches quotidiennes grâce à des capacités de recherche sur corpus documentaire et à une bibliothèque de fonctionalités connectées aux processus industriels. Nos clients opèrent dans des environnements exigeants où la fiabilité de l'information, la traçabilité des réponses et l'adéquation aux usages métier sont non négociables. Vos missions Votre mission est de concevoir et d'opérer les composants IA orientés business d'AURA : pipelines RAG sur des corpus documentaires d'entreprise, Skills conversationnels et Tools d'intégration métier. Vous serez l'interface entre les besoins exprimés par les équipes produit et les utilisateurs finaux, et les capacités techniques de la plateforme agentique sous-jacente. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des product managers, des UX researchers et des équipes R&D pour garantir la pertinence, la qualité et la conformité des expériences IA délivrées. A cet effet, vous devrez: Concevoir et maintenir les pipelines RAG d'AURA : chunking stratégique, indexation sémantique, reranking, et évaluation de la qualité des réponses sur des corpus documentaires industriels (procédures, référentiels métier, données produit). Spécifier, développer et qualifier les Skills et Tools d'AURA : intégrations métier (ERP, PLM, bases de connaissances), logique de routage des intentions, gestion des contextes utilisateur. Travailler en proximité avec les business users pour comprendre leurs besoins, modéliser leurs cas d'usage et itérer rapidement sur la pertinence des réponses agentiques. Contribuer à l'évaluation continue des performances d'AURA : définir des benchmarks métier, analyser les traces de conversation, identifier les patterns d'échec et proposer des corrections. Assurer la traçabilité et l'explicabilité des réponses générées : sourcing des réponses, gestion des hallucinations, conformité aux politiques de données de nos clients industriels. Participer à la veille active sur l'écosystème RAG et les usages émergents des LLM en contexte enterprise (techniques d'évaluation, nouveaux patterns d'orchestration, évolutions des modèles). Vos Qualifications De formation Bac+5 en informatique, data science, ingénierie logicielle ou domaine équivalent. +2 ans d'expérience professionnelle incluant une exposition concrète aux LLM et aux systèmes RAG. Maîtrise de Python et des bibliothèques de l'écosystème IA (LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou équivalent). Expérience avec des systèmes de recherche vectorielle (OpenSearch, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, ou équivalent). Sensibilité aux enjeux d'évaluation des systèmes RAG : métriques de fidélité, de pertinence, de couverture. Capacité à dialoguer avec des utilisateurs métier non techniques et à transformer leurs besoins en spécifications fonctionnelles. Maîtrise de l'anglais professionnel, écrit et oral — environnement de travail international. Atouts différenciants: Expérience avec LangGraph ou un framework d'orchestration agentique structuré. Pratique d'outils d'évaluation RAG (RAGAS, DeepEval, ou équivalent). Connaissance des environnements PLM, ERP ou des processus industriels. Appétence pour le design conversationnel et l'expérience utilisateur des interfaces IA. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement multiculturel Cadre de travail convivial axé sur le bien-être et la santé (salles de sport & de musique, conciergerie…) Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Politique dynamique de développement de carrière : plan de formation, mobilités internes, etc Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

Help shaping the architecture and long-term strategy of our AI platform, including the use of LLMs, RAG pipelines, and Agentic AI. Optimize system performance and scalability while maintaining high code quality. Your profile You hold a Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field. 5+ years of hands-on experience in building and deploying production-grade AI solutions using Python. Strong expertise in traditional machine learning combined with hands-on experience in modern LLM-based solutions. Solid knowledge of relational and vector databases, such as PostgreSQL and pgvector. Proven experience in setting up and operating open-weight LLMs (e.g., Llama, Mistral), including inference optimization. A practical, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to translate complex data challenges into scalable AI solutions. Familiarity with AWS, REST APIs, microservices and MLOps practices (monitoring, CI/CD, Docker) is a plus. A proactive, solution-oriented mindset, strong communication skills, and comfort working in dynamic environments (German B2 level required). Der Recruiting-Prozess Our interview process is designed to be simple, personal, and a little bit fun, so we can get to know each other naturally. It kicks off with a short, relaxed phone chat (about 15–20 minutes) just enough to exchange first impressions and spark curiosity. Next, you’ll hop on a video call via MS Teams with someone from the team, where you can dive deeper, ask questions, and see how we collaborate day-to-day. The final step is the most exciting: we invite you to our office! Here, you’ll try a small, hands-on case study don’t worry, it’s not a test, just a playful way for us to show how we work and for you to get a real feel of our world. Finally, we’ll make a decision promptly openly, thoughtfully, and with a smile. Why us? Our office is based in Berlin-Mitte, with a flexible hybrid work model in place. You’ll be fully equipped from day one with everything you need to do your best work We offer you a varied and challenging job in a dynamically growing company with great personal development potential. In addition to flexible working hours, we offer a modern workplace (mobile) with the freedom to help shape your own area of responsibility. Of course, you will receive an attractive compensation package and 30 days of vacation. Our work culture is characterized by transparency, respect and personal responsibility. We believe that a diverse workforce drives innovation and promote an inclusive workplace where all colleagues are valued and given the opportunity to fulfill their full potential. We consider all qualified applicants for employment at eClear, regardless of race or national origin, religion or belief, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, age or marital status. In the case of equal suitability, applicants with a severe disability will be given preference. With our software products and services, all tax, customs and payment processes in cross-border online trade are automated and significantly simplified.

items.desc: BEDRIJF : Deze Belgische B2B SaaS-speler ontwikkelt software waarmee professionele gebruikers complexe dossiers, documenten en dagelijkse processen beheren. Het platform heeft vandaag dagelijks duizenden gebruikers en staat voor een belangrijke technologische evolutie: AI wordt een integraal onderdeel van het product. De ambitie is om repetitieve processen te automatiseren, grote hoeveelheden informatie toegankelijk te maken en gebruikers te ondersteunen met intelligente AI-functionaliteiten waaronder een semantic search engine. Je komt terecht in een ondernemende productomgeving met de financiële slagkracht van een sterke groep. De lijnen zijn kort, de technologische ambities groot en er is veel ruimte om zelf technische keuzes te maken. JOBOMSCHRIJVING: Als AI Engineer bouw je mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een commercieel SaaS-platform naar een AI-driven product. Je ontwikkelt RAG-oplossingen die informatie ontsluiten uit grote documentcollecties, gebruikt LLM's om documenten automatisch te interpreteren en structureren, en bouwt AI Agents die taken en processen zelfstandig uitvoeren. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige traject: van het ontwerpen van de oplossing en het selecteren van modellen tot de integratie in het platform en de uitrol naar productie. Samen met Product Owners, Designers en Software Developers vertaal je nieuwe use cases naar concrete productfunctionaliteiten. Je krijgt de autonomie om technologiekeuzes te maken, nieuwe toepassingen uit te testen en mee richting te geven aan de AI-architectuur en productroadmap. JOUW PROFIEL : Voor deze rol wordt gezocht naar een AI Engineer met een sterke technische basis en duidelijke interesse in AI. Kandidaten met een achtergrond in data engineering, data science of backend development komen zeker in aanmerking. Je hebt minstens 3 jaar relevante ervaring als AI Engineer of ML Engineer. Je bent sterk in Python en hebt ervaring met LLM-toepassingen in productie. Je hebt kennis van RAG-architecturen, vector databases en AI Agents. Je hebt ervaring met frameworks zoals LangChain. Je hebt aandacht voor monitoring, evaluatie en betrouwbaarheid van AI-systemen. Je denkt mee over performantie, schaalbaarheid en kostenoptimalisatie. Je communiceert vlot met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders. Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met Azure OpenAI of cloud-native architecturen. UNIEK KARAKTER : Je bouwt AI-functionaliteiten die rechtstreeks geïntegreerd worden in een bestaand SaaS-product en dagelijks hun weg vinden naar duizenden gebruikers. Je krijgt de vrijheid om te experimenteren, mee te bouwen aan de AI-roadmap maar ook de verantwoordelijkheid om je oplossingen betrouwbaar en schaalbaar in productie te brengen. De combinatie van een ondernemende productomgeving, financiële slagkracht en veel technische autonomie maakt dit een interessante stap voor een AI-Engineer die mee de technologische richting wil bepalen. Je zit dicht bij de productontwikkeling, hebt invloed op architectuurkeuzes en bouwt mee aan een platform waarin AI een centrale rol krijgt. Benieuwd naar meer? Stuur nu jouw CV naar Gilles@cartiere.be en bel +32 3 369 33 05 voor meer informatie. Bekijk onze website www.cartiere.be voor meer vacatures.

items.desc: AI Engineer - Build Production AI at Scale Stockholm | Permanent Build AI that actually gets used. We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to join a small central AI team at a major Nordic consumer business. This isn't a role where you'll spend your time writing requirements for someone else to build. You'll work directly with product teams and business stakeholders, help decide what is actually worth building , challenge ideas when needed, prototype quickly and then write the code to turn those ideas into production systems. If you enjoy the space between software engineering, AI and real business problems , this could be a very interesting role. What are you actually going to build? The team already has a growing pipeline of AI projects across the business. Current and upcoming work includes: Customer-facing conversational AI with the potential to reach millions of users. Semantic search and retrieval using modern embedding and vector technologies. Internal AI assistants helping thousands of employees access knowledge. AI-powered content production at significant scale. Image generation and processing for campaigns and digital content. Internal platforms that make it easier for teams to build and deploy AI-powered applications. The technology isn't fixed. The team takes a pragmatic approach to AI - using whatever works best for the problem rather than forcing everything through one framework or vendor. You'll have the freedom to experiment, prototype, rip things apart and rebuild them when necessary. This is the important bit. We're not looking for a traditional Data Scientist . We're looking for someone who can combine: Strong software engineering + modern AI + product judgement. You should be comfortable going from: “The business wants this…” to: “Here's what I think we should actually build…” to: “I've built it — let's get it into production.” You'll work closely with product owners, stakeholders and other engineers throughout that process. What you'll bring We're looking for someone who has: Experience delivering real AI solutions , not just prototypes or experiments. Strong Python/software engineering skills. Experience building backend services and APIs. Good understanding of modern LLM and Generative AI technologies. Experience working with real-world data using SQL, Pandas or similar tools. The confidence to communicate directly with stakeholders. The technical judgement to push back when there is a better solution. A genuine hands-on attitude — you like building things yourself. Your previous job title isn't particularly important. You might currently be an: AI Engineer Applied AI Engineer AI Software Engineer Software Engineer Backend Engineer Product Engineer Machine Learning Engineer Generative AI Engineer What matters is what you've actually built and owned . You don't need to know every tool. Experience with things like these would be valuable: LLM applications RAG Semantic search Embeddings Vector databases AI agents Tool calling Recommendation systems AI evaluation Production AI monitoring Image generation Ecommerce/search/personalisation Specific framework experience isn't a deal-breaker. If you've used Pinecone rather than Qdrant, LangGraph rather than another agent framework, or AWS rather than another cloud platform, that's fine. Strong engineering fundamentals transfer. Why this role is different You'll be joining a small AI team with a big surface area . Rather than owning one small component of a huge platform, you'll have visibility across a substantial part of the business. You'll work directly with the people asking: “Could AI solve this?” and have the opportunity to answer: “Yes — and here's how I'd build it.” That means exposure to: Product. Engineering. AI strategy. Architecture. Business stakeholders. Real customers. Real production systems. And you'll remain hands-on technically . No need to become a people manager to increase your influence. The setup 📍 Central Stockholm — close to Stockholm Central Station. 🏖️ 30 days holiday 💻 Flexible choice of laptop/equipment. 🏠 Hybrid working with plenty of flexibility within the team. ✈️ Occasional Copenhagen travel, typically a day trip. Candidates must already have full working rights in Sweden . Swedish is preferred, although strong English-speaking candidates can be considered.

items.desc: A PwC-nél azon dolgozunk, hogy együttműködve segítsük ügyfeleinket a megalapozott döntések meghozatalában, hatékony működésben, és közösen formáljuk a jövőt. Tapasztalt szoftverfejlesztő vagy, és a következő szakmai lépésedet már a generatív AI területén képzeled el? Ha senior fejlesztőként erős technikai alapokkal rendelkezel, már elkezdtél foglalkozni a generatív AI világával, és hosszú távon ezen a területen szeretnéd folytatni a karriered, csatlakozz generatív AI fejlesztésekre szakosodott tanácsadó csapatunkhoz AI Engineer pozícióba. Technológiai tanácsadó csapatunk többek között nagy nyelvi modellek és generatív AI alkalmazásán, valamint vállalati folyamatok AI-alapú fejlesztésén dolgozik. Miért izgalmas ez a lehetőség? Csatlakozhatsz a PwC GenAI Lab dinamikusan fejlődő csapatához; Senior fejlesztői tudásodat a generatív AI területén kamatoztathatod és építheted tovább; Valós üzleti problémákon, hazai és nemzetközi ügyfélprojekteken dolgozhatsz; Tapasztalt GenAI szakértőktől tanulhatsz, miközben önállóan is mélyítheted tudásodat. Feladataid a következők lesznek: LLM-ekre épülő, RAG és agentic megoldások fejlesztése a koncepciótól a működő alkalmazásig; Stabil és jól strukturált GenAI megoldások kialakítása meglévő szoftverfejlesztői tudásodra építve; Új GenAI technológiák és megközelítések megismerése, kipróbálása és gyakorlati alkalmazása; Önálló felelősségvállalás PoC projektekben, senior szakértőinkkel együttműködve. Sikeres lehetsz a pozícióban, ha: Senior/medior szintű szoftverfejlesztői tapasztalattal és erős programozási alapokkal rendelkezel; Már elkezdtél megismerkedni az LLM-ek, RAG, agentic AI vagy kapcsolódó technológiák világával; Tudatosan a generatív AI irányába szeretnéd továbbépíteni a karriered; Motivált vagy abban, hogy intenzív tanulással és önálló, illetve on the job fejlődéssel megszerezd a szükséges mélyebb AI tudást; Proaktív, megoldásorientált hozzáállás és erős szoftverfejlesztői szemlélet jellemez; Legalább középfokú angol nyelvtudással rendelkezel. Python tapasztalat (3+ év) Docker tapasztalat és valamely Cloud Platform gyakorlati ismerete (AWS/Azure/GCP) Előnyt jelent: Saját GenAI/LLM projekt vagy gyakorlati tapasztalat; RAG, agentic vagy multi-agent megoldások ismerete; Kubernetes, LangGraph, n8n vagy Copilot Studio tapasztalat; Aktívan követed a GenAI fejlődését és önállóan is kísérletezel az új technológiákkal. Miért válassz bennünket? Nálunk lehetőséget kapsz arra, hogy tapasztalt fejlesztőként tudatosan a generatív AI irányába építsd tovább a karriered, miközben valódi ügyfélprojekteken, tapasztalt szakértőkkel dolgozol. Rugalmas munkavégzés, folyamatos szakmai fejlődési lehetőség és széles körű juttatási csomag vár. Ha készen állsz arra, hogy a következő szakmai fejezetedet a generatív AI területén kezdd el, várjuk jelentkezésed!

items.desc: Buenos dias!! Hoy buscamos un/a Conversational Designer especializado/a en Inteligencia Artificial Generativa para incorporarse a un proyecto estratégico dentro del sector banca . La persona seleccionada participará en el diseño, evolución y optimización de experiencias conversacionales basadas en IA, trabajando en estrecha colaboración con equipos de producto, datos e ingeniería. Buscamos un perfil capaz de combinar diseño centrado en usuario, diseño conversacional, prompting, agentes de IA y análisis , con soltura para desenvolverse en entornos tecnológicos en constante evolución. Responsabilidades Diseñar experiencias conversacionales centradas en el usuario para interfaces basadas en IA. Definir flujos, comportamientos y lógica conversacional para asistentes y agentes inteligentes. Diseñar y optimizar prompts y system prompts para controlar el comportamiento de modelos generativos. Participar en el diseño y orquestación de agentes de IA , tanto single-agent como multi-agent. Prototipar rápidamente nuevas experiencias conversacionales y validar hipótesis mediante pruebas e iteración. Evaluar la calidad de las respuestas generadas por los modelos, identificando problemas de precisión, alucinaciones, seguridad o comportamiento inesperado. Analizar datos e interacciones para detectar oportunidades de mejora y evolucionar la experiencia. Traducir necesidades de negocio y usuario en requisitos funcionales y especificaciones técnicas. Colaborar con equipos de ingeniería, datos, producto y negocio para garantizar la viabilidad de las soluciones. Participar en sesiones de co-creación con stakeholders y acompañar la toma de decisiones durante el desarrollo del producto. Requisitos técnicos Experiencia en diseño conversacional aplicado a asistentes virtuales, chatbots, voicebots o soluciones basadas en IA. Experiencia trabajando con IA Generativa y LLMs . Conocimientos sólidos de Prompt Engineering y diseño de system prompts. Experiencia o conocimiento en diseño y orquestación de agentes de IA . Familiaridad con frameworks o plataformas como OpenAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex o tecnologías equivalentes. Experiencia evaluando modelos generativos y analizando calidad, robustez, alucinaciones y seguridad. Capacidad para analizar métricas y datos de interacción y utilizarlos para iterar sobre el producto. Experiencia trabajando con metodologías de prototipado, testing e iteración rápida. Competencias Buscamos una persona cómoda trabajando en contextos donde no siempre existe una respuesta única o completamente predecible. Será importante contar con: Capacidad para tomar decisiones con información incompleta. Mentalidad experimental y orientación a MVP: prototipar, testar, aprender y ajustar . Tolerancia a la ambigüedad tecnológica y facilidad para adaptarse a nuevas herramientas y modelos. Capacidad para gestionar expectativas con stakeholders en proyectos donde los resultados de la IA pueden ser probabilísticos. Resiliencia ante fallos o comportamientos inesperados de los modelos. Capacidad de priorización y adaptación ante cambios de alcance o requisitos. Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo multidisciplinar. Curiosidad tecnológica y alta capacidad de autoaprendizaje. Valorable Experiencia previa en sector financiero o banca . Experiencia en proyectos enterprise de IA conversacional. Conocimientos de NLP/NLU. Experiencia con arquitecturas RAG, agentes autónomos o sistemas multi-agente. Experiencia definiendo metodologías de evaluación de soluciones GenAI. Perfil ideal Buscamos un perfil híbrido entre Conversational Designer, AI Product Designer y GenAI Specialist , capaz de entender tanto la experiencia de usuario como las posibilidades y limitaciones técnicas de los modelos generativos. Si eres tú, te estamos esperando. Manda tu correo a talento@lainfamedigital.com

items.desc: About Us At BGBx , we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges. Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day. If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx. Position Overview We are looking for an AI Engineer with 3-5 years of experience to help maintain and evolve our fleet of AI agents, LLM-as-a-judge systems, and other AI-powered tools used by healthcare, life sciences, and marketing teams. This role will work closely with senior engineers on graph design and with product and research teams to define what “a good answer” means, including grounding, coverage, and citation honesty. The AI Engineer will contribute to the continued development of these systems by improving tools, retrieval and citations, agent architecture, and overall system speed, cost, and accuracy. They will also support evaluations and experiments that help us understand and improve system performance. We are looking for someone with strong Python skills and a solid understanding of LLM systems who is excited to continue growing their technical depth. At this level, the engineer should be comfortable owning a component of a production service from design through testing and review, while partnering with more senior engineers on broader architecture and system design. Responsibilities Agent tools: Create new agent tools and improve existing ones across retrieval and grounding, vector and keyword search, live-source search, analytics queries, PDF generation, and more. Integrate external APIs and data sources into our agent systems, including Pinecone, Meilisearch, Hasura, Cube, and GCP. Graphs and middleware: Extend and improve our agent state machines, including skill resolution, tool-calling loops, review gates, answer post-processing, and token guards. Observability and operations: Work with real production data and infrastructure and help improve the observability, reliability, and ongoing maintenance of our AI systems. End-to-end ownership: Own features from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in the Benelux Region. This is a hands-on, in-region role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.

As our first marketing hire in the Benelux Region, your work will shape how Benelux businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across Benelux priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement.

 - Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function.

 - Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the the Benelux market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team.

 - Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns.

 - Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - 4+ years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle.

 - Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI.

 - Deep knowledge of the Benelux market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network.

 - Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market.

 - Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact.

 - Curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional …

items.desc: About Behavox Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world. From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise. Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are. We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before. About the Role The Front Office Subject Matter Expert is an experienced individual contributor in the Subject Matter Expert (SME) team. The role is the primary owner of one or two related asset classes and makes sure that the Behavox Financial Data Model (BFDM) and the Unified Risk Taxonomy (URT) reflect how trading desks, venues and regulation actually work. The URT is the common language for risks across preventive controls (such as conflicts of interest and conduct) and detective controls (such as trade and communications surveillance). Working with little day-to-day instruction, the role defines asset class data specifications, turns market abuse typologies into scenarios for Polaris, the Behavox trade surveillance product, and advises product, engineering and data science teams. It supports the revenue team in client meetings, demos and requests for proposal (RFPs) alongside a senior SME or the manager, but does not lead engagements with high-profile prospects or regulators on its own. The role is AI-native: it works with AI agents and agentic workflows, not only chat assistants, specifying requirements for agent-based pipelines and validating their outputs through structured data models and Git-based workflows. This is a remote friendly opportunity. Typical background: Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in a front office role, in market surveillance, or with front office data at an exchange, trading venue, market data provider or trading technology vendor. Languages: English required; other languages a strong plus. Agentic workflows: hands-on experience is a plus. Location: open for a remote candidate within Italy. What You'll Bring: Asset class markets – Practitioner-level knowledge of at least one of: commodities and environmental products; digital assets and event contracts; fixed income and structured products; equities and funds; foreign exchange and money markets. This includes instruments, venues, trading conventions and pricing. Front office workflows – Understanding of how execution, sales, research and risk functions operate on a trading desk, including order handling, quoting and hedging. Market abuse typologies – Knowledge of behaviors such as insider dealing, spoofing and layering, wash trading, front running and benchmark manipulation, and how they appear in trade, order and market data. Financial markets regulation – Working knowledge of trading conduct rules, such as the EU Market Abuse Regulation (MAR), the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID II), and US rules of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Structured data modelling – Understanding of trade, order, market and reference data, their quality issues, and modelling concepts such as entities, schemas, validation rules and versioning. What You'll Do: Asset class data specification – Defines BFDM fields, schemas and validation rules for owned asset classes, and checks data outputs against them. Surveillance scenario design – Turns market abuse typologies into Polaris risk scenarios, anchors them to regulatory enforcement cases, and validates their outputs with engineering and data science. Risk taxonomy maintenance – Maps owned asset classes to URT risk situations and regulatory requirements, and keeps coverage current. Client engagement support – Answers front office, data and surveillance questions in client meetings, demos and RFPs alongside the revenue team, and produces SME-reviewed collateral. AI-native, agentic ways of working – Writes clear specifications for agent-based pipelines, reviews and validates their outputs, and contributes changes through Git-based workflows in GitLab. What We Offer: A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation Highly competitive compensation with 100% bonus pay already integrated Benefits include individual career development budget for your learning and growth Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule About Our Process: We take Talent …

items.desc: We’re looking for a [Job Title] to join our tech team and help build the future of neuro-contextual advertising at global scale. Who We Are At Seedtag, our mission is to transform advertising by proving that effectiveness and user privacy can truly coexist. As the leading Neuro-Contextual Advertising Company, we combine Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and neuroscience to understand not only what content is about, but how it makes people feel and what they intend to do next. Our proprietary AI, Liz, enables brands to connect with audiences across the open web and Connected TV without cookies or user tracking. Founded in 2014 by two ex-Googlers, Seedtag has grown to 500+ Seedtaggers in 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and operates today as a global ad-tech leader. If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and building AI-driven systems at scale, you’ll feel right at home here. Your Challenge As our Junior Data Scientist, you will join our Insights team to transform contextual, audience, and campaign data into actionable insights for clients and commercial teams, leveraging Liz, Seedtag's AI. Your main responsibilities will include: Data Pipelines & Analytics: Build and maintain pipelines to analyse campaign performance, audience behaviour, and contextual data across the open web and CTV. Analytical Models: Develop models for audience profiling, content analysis, campaign comparisons, and pre-campaign planning. Data Products: Turn analyses into scalable data products using tools such as dbt, Trino, and Airflow, ensuring data quality and reliability. AI Agents & Automation: Prototype LLM-based agents and workflows using techniques such as embeddings, classification, clustering, and summarisation. Experimentation & Evaluation: Design and evaluate experiments to ensure automated insights are accurate, reliable, and actionable. Data Quality & Troubleshooting: Investigate data anomalies, identify root causes, and improve pipeline reliability. Data Storytelling: Communicate findings through clear visualisations and actionable recommendations for Product, Sales, and clients. Our Core Values Outcome over Output We measure success by impact and value, not by volume of features or lines of code. Failure Is Allowed, Learning Is a Must Experimentation is key to innovation. We test early, iterate often, and learn fast. We Are All Scouts We take ownership and leave things better than we found them. We Are Data-Driven Data informs our decisions and helps us continuously improve our systems and results. Tech Stack You'll work with modern data and AI technologies to build scalable insights products. Our stack includes: Languages & Libraries: Python, SQL, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn. Data Engineering: dbt, Trino, Airflow. AI & Machine Learning: LLMs, AI agents, embeddings, classification, clustering, NLP. Agent Frameworks: LangGraph, PydanticAI, MCP, OpenAI and Claude Agent SDKs. Cloud & Data Platforms: GCP, BigQuery. Development Tools: Git, unit testing, code review. What You’ll Need to Succeed 0–2 years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, or Machine Learning, including internships, research, or personal projects. Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field , or equivalent practical experience. Strong Python and SQL skills , with a solid understanding of statistics, machine learning, and model evaluation. Hands-on experience building LLM-based agents or agentic workflows , including tool calling, structured outputs, or multi-step processes. Good software engineering practices, including Git, testing, and clean, reproducible code . Strong analytical thinking and data storytelling skills , with the ability to communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders. Curious, proactive, and eager to learn, with professional working proficiency in English . Why Join Seedtag? A key moment of growth with real ownership and global impact. Flexible work model with 100% remote or hybrid options. (Remote contracts available in Spain, Italy, UK, Belgium, Netherlands, France, and Germany.) Continuous learning through a learning platform and optional language classes. A supportive, trust-based culture that values well-being. Team activities, offsites, and opportunities to connect beyond work. Additional Perks Home office setup budget up to €1,000 Paid trips to our HQ in Madrid MacBook Pro M3 Ready to Join the Seedtag Adventure? At Seedtag, we create an environment where everyone can thrive. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, let us know and we’ll ensure a positive experience. Send us your CV and let’s build the future of neuro-contextual advertising together.
