items.desc: DESCRIPTION AWS Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems. We are looking for a Security Engineer to join the FDE security team and help secure production AI systems deployed in customer environments. You will conduct security reviews, write security tooling, perform threat modeling, and implement controls that protect AI systems built by FDE engineers. You work alongside FDE delivery pods in customer environments, getting hands-on with production code, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML pipelines. You learn fast, ship fast, and build security into the system rather than bolting it on after the fact. This is a hands-on security engineering role where you spend most of your time writing code, reviewing architectures, and testing systems. You work with senior security engineers who will mentor you, but you own real security deliverables from your first engagement. If you want to learn AI security by doing it, in production, at enterprise scale, this is the role. Key job responsibilities Conduct security design reviews, code reviews, and architecture assessments for production AI systems (agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, orchestration layers, model integrations) under guidance from senior security engineers Perform threat modeling and penetration testing for AI/ML applications deployed in customer environments; identify vulnerabilities and work with FDE engineers to implement fixes before production release Build and maintain security automation: scanning tools, CI/CD security gates, guardrail testing scripts, secrets detection, and dependency vulnerability checks for forward-deployed AI systems Implement security controls for AI-specific threats: prompt injection prevention, output filtering, data isolation, model API endpoint hardening, and guardrail configuration Support security incident response for FDE-delivered production AI systems; assist with triage, root cause analysis, and remediation under senior engineer guidance Document security findings, patterns, and remediation guidance as reusable playbooks and runbooks that benefit future FDE engagements Contribute to the FDE security accelerator library: reusable modules, templates, and reference configurations that help FDE engineers build secure AI systems faster Requires up to 25% travel A day in the life You start the morning running your automated security scan against a new Bedrock-powered application an FDE pod shipped overnight, triaging the findings and filing issues for two real vulnerabilities. Mid-morning you pair with an FDE engineer to fix an IAM policy that's overly permissive for their multi-agent orchestration system. After lunch you're writing a Python script that automates guardrail bypass testing for the team's standard deployment pattern. You close out the day joining a threat modeling session led by a senior security engineer, where you learn how to assess data flow risks in a customer's RAG pipeline. Every week you're working on a different AI architecture, building skills you can't get anywhere else. About the team AWS Forward Deployed Engineering embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to build production AI systems. AWS invested $1B in this initiative. We move at the speed of the customer: demonstrating ROI in weeks, not quarters. We are customer-obsessed. We lead customers toward outcomes, build together, and leave behind scalable patterns. Security is our enabling function: without it, nothing goes to production. Our culture is people-first, anti-burnout, bold, and engineering-excellence-driven. ABOUT AWS: Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices …

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit. Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive. Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse. LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher. Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz. Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit. Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET. LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle. Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.title: AI Engineer Google Cloud
items.card: Vos missions : Cadrer : vous animez les ateliers avec les équipes du client, vous identifiez les cas d'usage qui valent le coup et vous écartez ceux qui n'en valent pas. Construire des agents : avec Gemini, l'Agent Development Kit (ADK) et Vertex AI, vous développez des agents, des systèmes multi-agents et des RAG, branchés sur les outils du client (Google Workspace, APIs métier, BigQuery). Déployer sur Google Cloud
items.desc: Chez Pyl.tech, nous aidons nos clients, de la startup au grand compte, à construire des solutions sur-mesure sur Google Cloud. En tant qu'AI Engineer, vous concevez et mettez en production des agents IA avec Gemini et Vertex AI, de l'atelier de cadrage jusqu'à l'exploitation. En pratique, comptez environ 80 % de temps projet client et 20 % de contribution interne. Vous êtes rattaché·e à Dorian , notre AI Platform Director, à Guillaume , notre Partner Data & AI et vous vous appuyez sur notre partenariat Google Cloud. Vos missions : Cadrer : vous animez les ateliers avec les équipes du client, vous identifiez les cas d'usage qui valent le coup et vous écartez ceux qui n'en valent pas. Construire des agents : avec Gemini, l'Agent Development Kit (ADK) et Vertex AI, vous développez des agents, des systèmes multi-agents et des RAG, branchés sur les outils du client (Google Workspace, APIs métier, BigQuery). Déployer sur Google Cloud : Cloud Run, GKE ou Agent Engine, Terraform, CI/CD, IAM. Vos agents tournent en production, de façon sécurisée et maîtrisée en coût. Évaluer et fiabiliser : vous mettez en place les évaluations, l'observabilité et les garde-fous qui permettent de suivre la qualité des réponses dans le temps. Prendre le lead technique : selon votre expérience, vous faites les choix d'architecture et guidez techniquement une petite équipe. Côté interne : Partenariat Google : vous contribuez à nos spécialisations Google Cloud, aux événements co-organisés et aux échanges avec les équipes Google. Partager : vous suivez de près ce qui sort sur l’IA chez Google Cloud (Gemini, ADK, Vertex AI…), vous le testez, et vous partagez vos découvertes et vos réflexions pour faire grandir les équipes avec lesquelles vous travaillez, chez Pyl.tech comme chez nos clients. Environnement technique (non exhaustif) : IA : Gemini, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform ( ex Vertex AI ), Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Runtime, Agent Search, MCP, A2A, A2UI Google Cloud : Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Firestore, Cloud Functions, IAM, Secret Manager Langages et outillage : Python, SQL, Terraform, Docker, Cloud Build / GitHub Actions Nous ne cherchons pas un profil parfait ! L'IA évolue trop vite pour ça. Ce qui nous intéresse : quelqu’un qui a commencé par écrire du code, qui a mis de l’IA générative en production chez des clients, qui l’a vue casser, et qui sait pourquoi. Ce qui compte pour nous : Vous avez au moins 3 ans de développement (back, data, cloud / DevOps), en produit ou en ESN. Vous avez une première expérience probante dans l'écosystème technique IA de Google Cloud. Vous avez construit et mis en production au moins un système d'IA générative : agent, RAG, workflow agentique. Pas seulement un POC. Vous êtes hands-on en Python et vous savez déployer proprement : CI/CD, conteneurs, infra as code. Vous parlez français professionnel et anglais technique. Votre posture terrain : Vous savez embarquer un interlocuteur non technique et construire vos choix avec les équipes IT du client. Ce sur quoi on est plus souples : Le framework : ADK, LangGraph, LangChain… Les petits + Vous avez une ou plusieurs certifications Google Cloud (Professional Cloud Agentic Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Cloud Architect…). Vous avez déjà travaillé chez un partenaire Google Cloud. Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour vous si… Vous n'avez jamais écrit de code qui tourne en production : votre parcours en ESN s'est fait côté pilotage ou coordination. Vous préférez enchaîner les POC plutôt que porter un agent jusqu'à la production et le faire vivre. L'écosystème Google ne vous intéresse pas : c'est le cœur de notre activité, vous y passerez l'essentiel de votre temps. Ce que nous vous proposons ; 🤑 Rémunération : 50 - 70 K€ 🧑‍💼 Rythme : hybride ; télétravail fréquent et horaires flexibles. Bureaux récents et équipés, ambiance conviviale, équipes rodées au travail à distance. 💪 Développement des compétences : budget annuel, certifications Google Cloud prises en charge, licences des outils IA que vous voulez tester, budget conférences. 🚀 Une aventure à construire : vous n'arrivez pas dans une case figée. Votre expérience, votre savoir-être et votre ambition participeront activement au développement de votre rôle. Une trajectoire en construction avec celle de l'entreprise. Si vous avez envie de laisser votre empreinte plutôt que d'appliquer un cadre existant, vous allez vous plaire ici 🫶 3 semaines au total, réponse sous 3 jours maximum à chaque étape. Échange RH en visio avec Chloé : faire connaissance, comprendre votre parcours, vos motivations et ce que vous avez déjà mis en production. Entretien avec votre futur manager, Dorian ou Guillaume en visio ou présentiel : on parle des agents que vous avez construits, de vos choix d'architecture sur Google Cloud et de votre façon de travailler avec un client. Entretien final avec l'un des cofondateurs, en présentiel : vos ambitions, vos dernières questions, et la place que nous voulons donner à …

Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc: SEARGIN IS HIRING! As a dynamic multinational tech company operating in 50 countries, we drive innovation and create projects that shape the future and greatly enhance the quality of life. You will find our solutions supporting advanced AI initiatives, financial analytics, and enterprise-scale digital transformation across global organisations. About the role We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to design, develop and integrate Generative AI solutions, intelligent assistants, AI agents and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) services. The role focuses on building practical AI applications, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with external tools and APIs, and transforming prototypes into scalable, production-ready solutions. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Agentic AI, agent orchestration and AI application development, alongside the ability to deliver well-documented, maintainable solutions following software engineering best practices. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and integrate Generative AI solutions, intelligent assistants and autonomous AI agents. Build and implement RAG pipelines and services to enhance LLM capabilities with relevant data sources. Develop AI applications and API-based services, including FastAPI applications. Develop prototypes and take them through testing, industrialization and production deployment. Implement CI/CD pipelines and follow software engineering best practices. Prepare technical documentation and ensure solutions are maintainable, scalable and reliable. Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to translate requirements into effective AI solutions. Required Skills & Experience Hands-on experience developing and integrating Generative AI applications, assistants or AI agents. Strong practical knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementation. Experience working with LLMs, APIs and external tool integrations. Knowledge of RAG architectures and implementation. Experience with Python and API development, preferably using FastAPI. Understanding of agent orchestration and, ideally, multi-agent architectures. Experience taking AI prototypes towards production-ready solutions. Knowledge of CI/CD practices, testing and technical documentation. French proficiency at B2 level or higher. Preferred Technical Experience Candidates should ideally demonstrate hands-on experience in at least 5 of the following areas: Building AI agents. Developing multi-agent systems. Using LangGraph. Using CrewAI. Building AI-powered applications. Developing FastAPI services. Implementing agent orchestration. Integrating external tools and APIs with LLMs. Taking AI agents into production. Languages French: B2 minimum; C1/C2 or native proficiency strongly preferred. English: Professional working proficiency. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical experience in Agentic AI. They can independently build AI agents and applications, integrate LLMs with external tools and services, design orchestration workflows, and help move solutions from proof of concept to production. Challenge requirements and propose better approaches when the brief doesn't solve the real problem. Own your project timelines. Flag risks early and deliver what you commit to. Identify high-leverage opportunities to apply software and AI across the company and scope them into concrete projects. A focused, talent-dense team where your work is visible and your decisions count. items.desc: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. We are hiring an Applied AI Engineer to build AI agents and intelligent product capabilities that transform how finance teams work. This is a product engineering role - not an isolated prototyping or research role. You will own agent-based features end to end: from architecture and evaluation through backend integration, deployment, and operation in production. Your Responsibilities Build and Ship AI Agents Design and build agents that automate complex finance workflows. Own features from initial concept and prototype through production deployment. Integrate agents deeply with our backend services, APIs, data model, permissions, and product workflows. Design how agents securely access and use data from across the Moss platform. Turn emerging AI capabilities into reliable, customer-facing product features. Evaluate and Improve Agent Performance Build systematic evaluations for agent quality, reliability, and business impact. Create representative test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression tests, and human-review processes. Measure and improve accuracy, latency, cost, and user experience. Establish observability and feedback loops that make agent behavior understandable and continuously improvable. Develop the AI Application Architecture Apply context-engineering techniques such as RAG, MCP and knowledge graphs. Design prompts, tools, memory, workflows and orchestration strategies for production agents. Select and use appropriate orchestration frameworks, such as Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable technologies. Build appropriate guardrails, approval steps, and human-in-the-loop controls for sensitive financial workflows. Integrate Machine-Learning Capabilities Collaborate with data scientists to integrate machine-learning models into our production systems. Build the services, data flows, APIs, and operational tooling required to make models usable within the product. Take responsibility for the production integration rather than handing prototypes to another engineering team. About You You are a seasoned software engineer with experience building and operating production applications. You are highly proficient in Python and/or Java and comfortable working across backend services, APIs, data, and application architecture. You have built and shipped at least one agent or LLM-powered product capability end to end. You have personally integrated agents into a broader product and backend architecture - not only developed standalone prototypes. You have practical experience evaluating agents or other non-deterministic AI systems. You understand how to provide agents with the right data and context while respecting security, permissions, and privacy. You have hands-on experience with prompt engineering, context engineering, and agent orchestration. You balance rapid experimentation with reliable, maintainable production engineering. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science. Relevant Technologies You do not need experience with every technology below. We care most about strong engineering judgment and demonstrated end-to-end ownership. Agent orchestration: Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable frameworks Context engineering: RAG, MCP, knowledge graphs, tool use, memory, and retrieval systems AI evaluation: offline and online evaluations, test datasets, regression testing, observability, and human review Language models: Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Mistral, or similar Backend engineering: Python or Java, REST APIs, Kafka, microservices, and distributed systems Data systems: SQL, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, vector search, and data pipelines Cloud AI platforms: GCP and Vertex AI, or comparable platforms About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star. We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ …

items.desc: Als einer der größten Banken-IT-Dienstleister und Digitalisierungspartner Europas sind wir der Treiber der Digitalisierung innerhalb der Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe. Mit über 5.000 Mitarbeitenden an 3 Standorten machen wir digitales Banking von heute leistungsfähig und entwickeln smarte Finanz-Services von morgen. Dabei bieten wir ein breites Aufgabenspektrum, in dem die individuellen Stärken hervorragend eingebracht werden können. Ob App-Entwicklung, Netzwerktechnologien und Serverbetrieb oder Beratung, Schulung und Support – bei uns findet jede:r seine bzw. ihre Berufung! Als Spezialist:in oder auch als Generalist:in. Alles mit besten Karrierechancen, viel Raum für persönliche Entfaltung und zahlreichen Benefits. Für die Organisationseinheit Interne Individualsysteme suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Termin für den Standort Hannover oder Münster einen AI Engineer / KI-Entwickler (m/w/d) . Unsere Abteilung in der Internen IT– Interne Individuelle Systeme (OE5152) gestaltet die digitale Zukunft des Unternehmens aktiv mit. Wir entwickeln und betreiben maßgeschneiderte SharePoint-Lösungen, setzen KI-Technologien für interne Prozesse ein und schaffen standardisierte Kommunikationsplattformen. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam in zukunftsweisenden KI- und Digitalisierungsprojekten mit. In unserem Team herrschen flachen Hierarchien und wir feiern Erfolge gemeinsam! Hinweis: Die Abteilung ist ausschließlich am Standort Hannover angesiedelt Ihre Aufgaben: Entwicklung & Implementierung: Sie entwickeln und implementieren produktive KI- und Generative-AI-Lösungen im Rahmen interner Projekte. AI-Agents & Workflows: Sie erstellen AI-Agents und agentic Workflows, die Geschäftsprozesse intelligent unterstützen und automatisieren. Integration & Anbindung: Sie integrieren KI-Modelle und AI-Services über APIs und MCP (Model Context Protocol) in bestehende Unternehmenssysteme. RAG-Systeme: Sie konzipieren und implementieren Retrieval-Augmented-Generation (RAG)-Systeme für den Zugriff auf Unternehmenswissen. Dokumentation & Wissensmanagement: Sie erstellen und pflegen technische Dokumentationen für KI-Komponenten, APIs und Workflows. Zudem gestalten Sie übergreifende Dokumentationsstrukturen, um die Kommunikation in Projekten zu stärken und das AI-Wissen nachhaltig im Unternehmen zu sichern. Technische Qualität: Sie sorgen für die technische Umsetzung und Qualität der KI-Komponenten, inklusive Testing und Monitoring. Architekturmitwirkung: Sie wirken an Lösungs- und Architekturentscheidungen mit und beraten fachliche Teams bei der KI-Nutzung. Arbeiten an zukunftsweisenden KI-Projekten mit direktem Unternehmensnutzen. Ihr Profil: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation. Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung im genannten Aufgabenbereich und in der Softwareentwicklung. Kenntnisse in Python und modernen KI-Frameworks (z. B. LangChain, LlamaIndex). Praxiserfahrung im Umgang mit LLMs und Generative AI (Prompting, Fine-Tuning). Erfahrung mit API-Entwicklung (REST) und Git-basierter Softwareentwicklung. Grundverständnis von Software-Engineering-Prinzipien (Testing, CI/CD). Ausgeprägte kommunikative Stärken sowie die Bereitschaft, Fachwissen durch verständliche Dokumentation an andere Teams zu übertragen. Ihre Benefits bei der Finanz Informatik: Sie fragen sich, warum Sie bei der Finanz Informatik arbeiten sollten? Wir hätten da ein paar gute Gründe für Sie. Neben flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, vergünstigten Jobtickets oder der Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten, bieten wir Ihnen noch viel mehr: Altersvorsorge Barrierefrei Betriebssport Familienservice Firmenevents Flexible Arbeitszeiten Mobiles Arbeiten Jobticket Kantine Tarifvertrag Weiterbildung Fitnessförderung Bei uns erwartet Sie eine attraktive Vergütung basierend auf Ihrer Qualifikation sowie Ihrer relevanten, praktischen Erfahrung. Klingt interessant? Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerbungen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, Religion, ethnischer Herkunft oder sexueller Identität, unter Angabe der Kennziffer E 362/B. Sollten Sie vorab weitere Auskünfte zu dieser Stelle wünschen, steht Ihnen gerne Herr Gerrit Graën zur Verfügung. Sie erreichen Gerrit Graën unter Tel. 0511 51022 2675 oder per E-Mail unter karriere@f-i.de.

items.desc: Location: Wrocław / Katowice / Warsaw - 2 days in office / 3 days remote Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY. The opportunity Join a high-impact role shaping next-generation enterprise AI solutions powered by NVIDIA. You will lead architecture for complex agentic systems, multimodal AI, and real-time vision platforms, working with advanced tooling to transform business use cases into scalable, high-performance AI products deployed at scale. Your Key Responsibilities Design and implement end-to-end AI architectures leveraging NVIDIA NIM, NeMo, DeepStream, and TensorRT; build multi-agent and RAG systems; optimize inference performance; define GPU infrastructure; and collaborate cross-functionally to deliver robust, scalable, and production-grade AI solutions. Skills And Attributes For Success Strong architectural thinking combined with deep hands-on expertise, ability to translate business needs into complex AI systems, excellent stakeholder communication, problem-solving in distributed GPU environments, and a pragmatic mindset focused on scalability, performance, reliability, and measurable business value. To qualify for the role, you must have 8+ years of experience in infrastructure and software engineering, including 2–3 years with NVIDIA technologies. Hands-on expertise with NVIDIA NIM, NeMo Agent Core, NeMo Guardrails, NeMo Retriever, TensorRT and TensorRT-LLM. Experience designing multi-agent architectures, agent orchestration patterns and advanced RAG solutions using vector databases. Strong Python, C++, Linux, PyTorch and OpenCV skills, including experience with modern CV models such as YOLO, SAM or VLMs. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, NVIDIA GPU Operator, KServe, cloud platforms and GPU environments such as DGX or InfiniBand. Willingness to travel occasionally. Ideally, you’ll also have Experience with Kafka, GStreamer, RTSP streaming architectures and DeepStream SDK for real-time video analytics. LLMOps/MLOps experience, including model lifecycle governance and scalable deployment practices. Knowledge of AI security, guardrails design, knowledge graphs and graph-based retrieval. Experience with multimodal AI platforms, GPU capacity planning and performance tuning. Experience working in regulated enterprise environments. Customer-facing or consulting background, supported by relevant NVIDIA or cloud certifications. What We Look For We value professionals passionate about NVIDIA’s Physical AI ecosystem—Omniverse, OpenUSD, Isaac Sim, and GPU-accelerated robotics. If you thrive on building digital twins, simulating real-world physics, and deploying AI policies to robots, this role is for you. You bring deep technical excellence with strong collaboration skills, enjoy solving complex spatial computing problems, and are excited about pushing the boundaries of simulation-driven engineering. If you’re hands-on, curious, and comfortable working across infrastructure, graphics, and robotics domains in a fast-evolving NVIDIA stack, you will fit in well. What We Offer EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. About EY EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today. items.title: AI Solutions Engineer
items.card: What You'll Do You'll sit at the heart of a fast-moving, deliberately exploratory new team, working across revenue, operations, and everything in between: Discover, map, and build: You'll embed yourself with business units, get under the skin of their daily workflows, identify where AI adds real value (versus where traditional code or P&T support is the better answer), and then build and deploy the solution —
items.desc: Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to fueling decisions with expert insights . We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics. For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies. Do you get more excited by a vague problem than a fully-specced one? Are you the person who's already built something with AI before anyone asked you to? Third Bridge is creating a brand-new AI function — and you’ll be one of the first! These are founding roles. You'll be embedded with business teams across our global organisation — understanding their workflows, identifying automation opportunities, building solutions that genuinely change how people work, and making sure those solutions stick! What You'll Do You'll sit at the heart of a fast-moving, deliberately exploratory new team, working across revenue, operations, and everything in between: Discover, map, and build: You'll embed yourself with business units, get under the skin of their daily workflows, identify where AI adds real value (versus where traditional code or P&T support is the better answer), and then build and deploy the solution — hands-on, sleeves rolled up. Make it stick: You won't throw solutions over the fence. You'll actively train internal teams so they can own, iterate, and develop agents themselves — your goal is to make them less dependent on you over time, not more. Monitor and maintain in production: You'll define success KPIs for every agent you deploy and proactively track performance as models (e.g. Claude) update or data structures evolve. Problems get caught by you, not by clients. Govern as you go: You bake compliance and risk controls into your builds from day one — not as an afterthought. You'll work alongside Compliance, Legal, and Risk to ensure every solution is approved before it goes anywhere near a client. Build the knowledge base: Your prompts, playbooks, and best-practice documentation will form the reusable library that the whole team learns from. What You'll Bring You bring a balance of technical experience and genuine commercial curiosity. In this role, if you only talk about the technology or only talk about the business outcome, that's a flag — you do both instinctively. Hands-on AI agent and prompt engineering experience: Your experience of designing and deploying production LLM solutions goes beyond side projects. You can point to concrete outputs — agents that shipped, workflows that changed, problems that got solved. Business analysis instincts: Before you write a single line of a prompt, you ask "what's actually broken here?" Your experience mapping processes and structuring problem statements means you build the right thing, not just a technically impressive thing. Technical foundations that match your level: For senior hires, your toolkit includes Python, RAG, API integrations, and agent architecture. For mid-level hires, your learning trajectory and intellectual curiosity matter as much as your current depth. Communication that bridges the gap: You can explain hallucination, context windows, and bidirectional encoding to a VP with no technical background — clearly, confidently, and without condescension. The training element of this role is as important as the building element. Pragmatic quality obsession: You favour shipped-and-good over perfect-and-delayed — but you don't ship outputs you don't understand or can't control. That's the balance this role requires. How will you be rewarded? We truly care about our people so in return for your work, you’ll get: Vacation: 25 days (which increases to 28 days after 2 years of service) plus UK Bank Holidays Learning: personal development allowance of £1000 per year Health and wellbeing: private medical insurance and healthcare cash plan, a variety of health and wellbeing events to focus on mental health, Ride to Work scheme (savings on bikes and accessories) Future and family: pension contributions of 4% (increases with tenure) and life insurance of 4x of your base salary Flexibility: work from anywhere for one month per year, 2 annual volunteer days, 2 personal days when life throws you a curveball and 'Summer Fridays' Rewards: get points through our colleague-to-colleague recognition programme to spend on hotels, gift cards, donations to charity and more Social: optional social gatherings, daily breakfast and snacks, social events ESG: CSR, Environment and Diversity & Inclusion (including Women at Third Bridge, Pride and Blkbridge) Frontline Innovation: your chance to share your ideas for improvement through Hackathons and other events Why Join Us? Build from zero: This function doesn't exist yet. You'll help define the tools, the standards, and the culture of AI at Third Bridge — …

items.desc:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Data and GenAI Architect to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS data-driven and AI solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle, with a specific focus on data architecture, AI/ML implementations, and generative AI solutions.
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Data and GenAI Architect you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure data platforms and AI solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current data infrastructure, and propose effective strategies for implementing modern data architectures and GenAI solutions on AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging AI technologies, and innovative data solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

Dans ce cadre, vous intervenez sur les sujets suivants : Architecture & industrialisation sécurisée de l’IA : Vous concevez des architectures cibles pour des systèmes de Machine Learning, IA Générative (LLM, RAG, copilotes) et IA Agentique (multi-agents, workflows autonomes), sécurisées et alignées sur les besoins métier et les contraintes réglementaires. Vous définissez et déployez les pipelines d'industrialisation (MLOps/LLMOps) : intégration continue, monitoring des modèles, gestion du cycle de vie (versioning, retraining, décommissionnement), et outillage avec des outils de sécurisation des modèles d'IA Vous participez aux choix de solutions (cloud IA, plateformes LLM, frameworks d'orchestration, AISPM, Guardrails, Protection contre la fuite de données et/ou de modèle) et validez les orientations via POC/POV. Vous réalisez les revues d'architecture de systèmes d’IA et présentez les recommandations en comité technique et auprès des parties prenantes seniors (C-level). Sécurité de l'IA : Vous qualifiez les besoins de sécurité spécifiques à l'IA et définissez les exigences (disponibilité, intégrité, confidentialité, preuve/traçabilité ; DICP appliqué aux données et modèles). Vous identifiez, cartographiez et anticipez les menaces ciblant les systèmes d'IA LLM et agentiques (prompt injection, data poisoning, exfiltration de modèle, évasion, jailbreak) en s'appuyant sur les référentiels MITRE ATLAS et MITRE ATT&CK. Vous intégrez les principes de « security & privacy by design » dans les spécifications, backlogs et pipelines MLOps dès la phase de conception. items.desc: Ascendix Technologies is an AI and Real Estate Technology partner headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with offices in Poland, Portugal, and Ukraine. We specialize in AI solutions, Salesforce, and custom software development, helping businesses streamline their operations through innovative technology. We're looking for an experienced QA Engineer to join our Product Department and take ownership of quality assurance for our Salesforce-related products, starting with the Ascendix AI Agent. In this role, you'll work with a small, collaborative team to ensure the reliability of both traditional software functionality and AI-driven features. You'll combine manual testing, test automation, and LLM evaluation techniques to validate AI-generated responses, identify potential issues, and continuously improve product quality. If you enjoy exploring AI technologies, thinking critically about complex scenarios, and taking initiative in shaping QA processes, we'd love to hear from you. What We're Looking For Requirements : 5+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance; Hands-on experience testing AI-powered applications with non-deterministic outcomes, such as LLM-based products, AI agents, or chatbots; Practical experience with LLM evaluation techniques, including test datasets, scoring rubrics, LLM-as-judge approaches, and regression tracking; Experience in test automation and maintaining automated test suites; Solid API testing skills using Postman or similar tools; Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate not only whether an AI-generated response is incorrect, but also why; Ownership mindset, proactive approach to problem-solving, and willingness to improve QA processes; Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a small, distributed team; Upper-Intermediate English (B2+) or higher, both written and spoken. Nice to Have: Experience with Playwright (TypeScript or JavaScript); Salesforce testing experience, including Lightning, managed packages, and permission sets; Familiarity with LLM evaluation tools such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, Ragas, or Langfuse; Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar; Basic prompt engineering skills; Experience working with CRM systems or real estate data. What You'll Do Responsibilities : Take ownership of product quality across our Salesforce-related solutions, initially focusing on the Ascendix AI Agent; Perform functional, regression, and exploratory testing of both deterministic and non-deterministic functionality; Evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy, hallucinations, and correct execution of actions; Design, maintain, and improve LLM evaluation datasets, scoring criteria, and regression tests; Develop and maintain automated tests using Playwright and modern AI-assisted tools; Collaborate with developers and the Business Analyst in a spec-driven development process, reviewing specifications and defining clear acceptance criteria; Establish and continuously improve QA processes, including maintaining AI agent skills, rules, and workflow documentation in Markdown files; Investigate and reproduce issues reported by clients, providing clear and actionable bug reports; Proactively identify quality risks and suggest improvements to product reliability and testing practices. Ascendix Offers You: Healthcare : 20 paid days-off; 5 paid sick days. Career and Professional Growth: B2B and remote cooperation; Career development and professional growth; Technical performance reviews and 360 Evaluation; Collaboration with a personal Direct Manager, Technical Leads, and mentors. Learning and Development: Opportunity for external event compensation; Internal knowledge-sharing opportunities. Corporate Spirit: Online and offline events and team buildings; Friendly and supportive atmosphere; Open management.

Mission Le pôle Data & IA d'Isagri accompagne les équipes produit dans l'intégration de l'IA au sein de leurs solutions. Les systèmes agentiques constituent un axe majeur de cette ambition. Au-delà de leur conception, ces systèmes doivent être exploités, maintenus et sécurisés dans la durée, dans le respect des exigences de continuité de service et de souveraineté d'Isagri. Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur IA pour accompagner les équipes de la conception jusqu'à l'exploitation de leurs cas d'usage agentiques. La Mission Accompagnement des équipes produit Qualifier les cas d’usage agentiques : faisabilité, valeur ajoutée et risques. Concevoir les architectures adaptées (RAG, agents, workflows), choisir les modèles, outils et sources de données. Accompagner le développement et l’industrialisation des solutions, en favorisant la réutilisation des briques existantes. Mettre en place des évaluations et diffuser les bonnes pratiques de conception, de qualité et d’exploitation. Exploitation et évolution des systèmes Assurer le suivi des agents en production : qualité, coûts, performances, observabilité et gestion des incidents. Piloter les mises à jour des modèles et frameworks, avec des tests de non-régression. Faire évoluer les solutions selon les besoins métier et optimiser durablement leurs coûts et performances. Continuité et reprise d’activité Définir les stratégies de continuité : modes dégradés, solutions de repli et gestion des indisponibilités. Garantir la sauvegarde des configurations et des connaissances, ainsi que la capacité de redéploiement. Organiser et tester régulièrement les dispositifs de continuité et de reprise. Souveraineté, sécurité et conformité Orienter les choix de modèles et d’hébergement selon les enjeux de souveraineté et de réversibilité. Sécuriser les agents : permissions, garde-fous, protection contre les injections de prompt et traçabilité. Veiller à la conformité RGPD et AI Act, contribuer au cadre d’industrialisation et assurer une veille technologique. Profil Le Profil Recherche 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel, ML engineering ou ingénierie de production, dont au moins une expérience concrète de mise en production et d'exploitation d'applications basées sur des LLM. Très bonne maîtrise de Python et du développement d'API. Pratique des API de LLM et d'au moins un framework agentique (LangGraph, Pydantic AI, LlamaIndex, SDK fournisseurs ou équivalents), ainsi que du protocole MCP. Pratique de l'évaluation et de l'observabilité de systèmes LLM (Langfuse, LangSmith ou équivalents). Expérience de l'exploitation en production : supervision, gestion des incidents, CI/CD, conteneurisation, infrastructure as code. Connaissance des démarches de continuité et de reprise d'activité appliquées à des services cloud. Connaissance des enjeux de souveraineté (hébergement qualifié, modèles open-weight, solutions d'inférence auto-hébergées) et du cadre réglementaire (RGPD, AI Act). EVOLUTIONS La politique RH vous garantit un accompagnement régulier pour vous faire progresser et évoluer vers de nouvelles missions en fonction de votre projet. Rejoindre notre Groupe, c'est la garantie d'une formation initiale et continue, d'un plan de carrière personnalisé et d'un management de proximité. CONDITIONS PROPOSEES Poste basé à Beauvais, à pourvoir dès que possible. Rémunération : Fixe + Variable. Dans le cadre de sa politique RH, nous étudions, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap. ISA-RECRUT1 Référence de l'offre : uquwh4vsyk

items.desc: Your role Every internal team at Cloover, Ops, Energy, Sales, CS, Finance, has work that AI agents can do faster and better. You'll build the systems that make that real: agentic pipelines, MCP servers, and internal tools that change how we operate day-to-day, not in some future roadmap. Success in this role means colleagues stop doing the work you've automated, and start doing the work only they can do. You'll report to Florent (Head of Operations & Energy) and work within a team of amazing people alongside. Your mission Design, build, and ship end-to-end agentic systems, RAG pipelines, embeddings, retrieval, prompt engineering, and evaluation, that automate Cloover's highest-volume internal workflows. Build and deploy custom MCP servers and integrations connecting HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Aircall, and other tools, so data flows where it needs to without manual work in between. Write production-grade Python and TypeScript with sound schema design, security, and authorization, code that ships and runs, not prototypes that sit. Own internal tooling end-to-end: spot the gap, build the tool, and deploy it on Firebase, Vercel, or GCP with proper version control and CI/CD. Build custom Claude Code skills, plugins, and connectors, then onboard colleagues into AI-native workflows that they actually keep using. Partner with Ops, Energy, Sales, CS, and Finance to identify the highest-leverage automation use cases, then personally implement them. Your profile We care more about how you think and what you've built than where you've been. Here's what will set you up for success in this role: You've shipped agentic systems, RAG pipelines, or AI-powered tools, in school, side projects, hackathons, or work, not just experimented with prompts in a chat window. You write production-grade Python and/or TypeScript and can defend the trade-offs in your code. You're comfortable wiring REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication across third-party tools (HubSpot, Slack, Notion, or similar) and can model data sensibly. You identify the gap, scope the solution, and ship it without waiting to be told what to do. Based in Berlin and energized by being in the room. We're intentionally office-first, decisions get made in real time, prototypes get stress-tested over lunch, and the founding team is ten meters away. If that's how you thrive, you'll feel at home here. Nice to have (but not required): Hands-on experience with MCP, Claude Code, or agentic frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, or Google ADK. German language proficiency (B1 or above), useful for collaborating with the Ops & Energy team. Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. We hire for potential and perspective, credentials are a starting point, not a ceiling. How We Hire We keep things transparent and respect your time. Most go from first call to offer in under three weeks. Intro call (30 min) — We want to understand what you're looking for, not just screen your CV. Hiring manager interview (30 min) — We go deep: your experience, your thinking, how you approach problems. Case study (1 hour) — You get the brief in advance. We care about your approach, not whether you land on the right answer. Offer & signed contract. Need any adjustments at any stage? Just let us know. Why us? Competitive pay. Fair compensation for your time and contribution, benchmarked to the Berlin internship market. AI-first & unthrottled. Unlimited enterprise-grade AI, no caps, no approval process. Every role, every team. The grunt work disappears so you can focus on what actually requires human judgement. Real ownership on a real mission. From day one you're shaping decisions that impact thousands of installers. We're not just building software, we're powering the energy transition across Europe. Grow faster than anywhere else. You'll work directly alongside the founding team and world-class investors. If you're building toward your own venture one day, there's no better room to be in. The basics, done well. Prenzlauer Berg office with the latest Apple hardware. Free breakfast and dinner, stocked kitchen, regular team events, 25 days vacation, Urban Sports Club (M), and company discounts. About Us At Cloover, we're building the AI operating system for the energy transition — a platform that helps thousands of installation companies across Germany and Austria sell more, plan faster, and deliver better. We've secured $1.22B in total financing — including $1.2B in committed debt financing and a $22M Series A — and are just getting started on our European expansion. We're a high-performance team that works with purpose. We own our work fully, debate ideas hard, commit together, and execute without hesitation. Seniority doesn't win arguments here — the best idea does. Speed isn't a deadline we hit — it's how we're wired. And we’re AI-first by default. We're not experimenting with AI — we're built on it. Tech ships faster because AI prototypes before we build. Sales closes more because outreach is personalized …

About the Role We’re hiring an AI Solutions Architect who can take an ambiguous problem – “extract structured insight from hours of video” – and turn it into a production pipeline that actually works. This isn’t a role for someone who only knows how to call an API and parse the response. We need an engineer who understands the full lifecycle: how raw data gets shaped, chunked, embedded, routed through a foundation model, validated, and turned into something a downstream system or human can act on. You’ll architect and build AI pipelines and autonomous agent systems on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), working closely with product, data, and engineering to deliver capabilities that move beyond proof‑of‑concept into reliable, scalable production workloads. About Sycomp Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries. Responsibilities Design and build AI pipelines that handle real‑world messiness – long‑form media, unstructured documents, streaming data, multi‑modal inputs – including the chunking, context management, retry logic, and output validation that production systems require. Architect autonomous agent systems: tool selection, planning loops, memory strategies, evaluation, and the guardrails that keep them from going off the rails. Build on AWS using services like Bedrock, S3, Lambda, Step Functions, SageMaker, OpenSearch, and ECS/EKS – choosing the right primitive for the job rather than forcing one pattern everywhere. Make pragmatic decisions about model selection, prompt design, fine‑tuning vs. RAG vs. agentic workflows, and cost/latency/quality tradeoffs. Own the data layer: how data is ingested, transformed, stored, indexed, and surfaced to models so that outputs are accurate, traceable, and useful. Establish evaluation frameworks and observability so we know whether the system is actually getting better when we change it.Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to translate fuzzy business problems into technical designs and shipped systems. Qualifications 4+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building AI/ML systems in production. Hands‑on experience with AWS, including Bedrock or equivalent foundation model services, and at least a few of: S3, Lambda, Step Functions, SageMaker, OpenSearch, Dynamo DB, ECS/EKS. Demonstrable experience building AI pipelines or agentic systems that handle non‑trivial data shapes – long documents, audio/video, large structured datasets, or streaming inputs.Strong intuition for prompt engineering, context window management, chunking strategies, and output validation (structured outputs, schema enforcement, retries on malformed responses). Proficiency in Python; comfortable with at least one frameworks in the LLM ecosystem (LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Bedrock Agents, Strands, or similar) – though you should also be willing to drop the framework when it gets in the way.Solid grasp of data engineering fundamentals: how to clean, transform, embed, index, and retrieve data so that what reaches the model is actually useful. Experience designing evaluation pipelines for non‑deterministic systems – you know that “it worked when I tested it” is not a quality bar. Required Skills Experience with Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, AI Search) or GCP (Vertex AI, Gemini APIs).Background in multi‑modal systems (vision‑language models, audio transcription pipelines, video understanding). Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, OpenSearch k‑NN) and hybrid retrieval strategies.Familiarity with fine‑tuning, distillation, or model adaptation techniques.Experience with MLOps tooling, model versioning, and A/B testingfor AI systems.Contributions to open source AI/ML projects. Preferred Skills You’re skeptical of hype but excited about what actually works. You can tell the difference between a demo and a system. You think about failure modes early. What happens when the model returns garbage? When the input is 10× bigger than expected? When the API rate‑limits you mid‑pipeline? You care about cost and latency, not just capability. items.desc: À propos de nous POURQUOI NOUS CHOISIR ? Première Entreprise générale du Digital en Europe et 7ème ESN de France, le groupe Econocom est précurseur dans la création de solutions globales, durables et circulaires, permettant d’accompagner la transformation digitale des entreprises et des organisations publiques. Riche d’une histoire de plus de 50 ans avec un chiffre d’affaires de 2,9 milliards d’euros, nous sommes l’un des seuls acteurs européens à pouvoir coordonner et réaliser toute la chaîne d’expertises d’un projet digital : depuis la conception et le design jusqu’au déploiement des équipements et leur infogérance, en passant par l’achat ou la location et le reconditionnement. Convaincu que le numérique de demain doit être plus responsable, Econocom s’engage depuis de nombreuses années pour réduire l’impact environnemental du digital et développer des modèles plus circulaires. Cet engagement est aujourd’hui reconnu à travers la médaille EcoVadis Platinum, qui positionne Econocom parmi le Top 1 % des entreprises évaluées au niveau mondial. Une reconnaissance qui illustre la volonté du groupe de placer la responsabilité sociétale et environnementale au cœur de sa stratégie. Ce qui va suivre : 1. Postulez sur notre site Carrière Econocom ou via l’un de nos partenaires 2. Si votre profil est en adéquation avec le poste, vous rencontrez Amar CHIAKH en premier rendez-vous 3. Si votre profil le séduit, vous rencontrez ensuite votre futur manager accompagné d’un responsable technique sur un second rendez-vous Nous mettons un point d’honneur à donner suite à toutes les candidatures. Et si ce poste n’est pas le vôtre, il en sera peut-être différemment pour le suivant ! Votre chargé de recrutement : Amar CHIAKH Le groupe Econocom s'engage à promouvoir la diversité. Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Mission Mission : Nous vous invitons à relever de nouveaux challenges et à évoluer sur des projets d’expertise et d’innovation en prenant part à l’aventure Econocom. L’activité Services & Solutions en région Ile de France accompagne ses clients grands comptes et institutions publiques dans tout secteur d’activité dans la transformation de leur système d’information, à travers la mise à disposition de moyens humains et techniques. Ce qui vous attend : Dans le cadre de nos activités de services informatiques en prestation, nous accompagnons l’un de nos clients dans un contexte de sécurité et de défense, votre objectif sera de : Déployer la plateforme d'inférence Large Language Model (LLM) sur le cluster Kubernetes, en conformité avec les standards de durcissement Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL). Développer les API et services d'intégration entre le LLM et les outils du SOC (SIEM, SOAR, CTI, ticketing, bases documentaires). items.desc: Bouw AI Oplossingen die verder komen dan het experiment Een RAG-oplossing bouwen die het in een demo goed doet, is te leren. Er een bouwen waar collega's elke dag blind op vertrouwen, is een ander vak. Wat gebeurt er met de kwaliteit als de context verandert? Welke modelkeuze maak je en hoe onderbouw je die? Hoe meet je betrouwbaarheid als er geen labels zijn? Kortom wanneer voegt agentic AI werkelijk iets toe en wanneer is het een dure omweg? Dat zijn de vragen waar je bij AI Works dagelijks mee bezig bent. AI Works is het programma waarmee we AI toepasbaar maken voor de hele Veldsink Groep. Dat betekent twee dingen tegelijk: toepassingen bouwen die collega's echt gebruiken en daarnaast de standaarden, werkwijzen en infrastructuur neerzetten om AI verantwoord op te schalen. Met Python, LLM's, RAG en machine learning bouwen we generatieve en voorspellende toepassingen voor onze financiële dienstverlening: AI-assistenten, kennisontsluiting, documentanalyse, speech-to-text, en modellen waarmee we beter voorspellen en efficiënter werken. Je krijgt daarbij niet altijd een uitgetekend technisch vraagstuk. Je onderzoekt, stelt vragen, maakt keuzes en brengt een oplossing verder: van eerste experiment naar iets dat betrouwbaar, verantwoord en onderhoudbaar in productie draait. Zo werken we We werken in sprints van twee weken, maar niet alles ligt vooraf vast. We maken bewust tijd voor onderzoek en experimenten: nieuwe technologie verkennen, kennis delen en ideeën bouwen en testen. Dat is nodig in een vakgebied dat voortdurend verandert. We vinden het interessanter dat je begrijpt wat er onder de motorkap gebeurt dan dat je ieder framework kunt afvinken. Werk je met Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph of agentic AI, dan sluit dat mooi aan. Wat je gaat doen Samen met data scientists, data engineers, product owners en collega's uit de business: ontwikkel je machine learning- en GenAI-oplossingen met Python, LLM's en RAG werk je aan retrieval, prompting, evaluatie en modelkeuzes breng je prototypes naar stabiele toepassingen, inclusief monitoring op kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid onderzoek je nieuwe mogelijkheden, waaronder agentic AI neem je privacy, AI-wetgeving en verantwoord gebruik mee in het ontwerp, niet achteraf leg je technische keuzes uit aan collega's binnen én buiten IT Wat je meebrengt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring in data science of een sterk vergelijkbaar vakgebied WO werk- en denkniveau sterke Python-skills praktijkervaring met generatieve AI, LLM's en RAG ervaring met AI-oplossingen die voorbij het notebook zijn gekomen en waar echte gebruikers op zitten het vermogen om complexe techniek begrijpelijk te maken goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal Je hoeft niet alles gezien te hebben. De basis moet stevig genoeg zijn om zelf koers te bepalen in een vraagstuk dat nog niet is uitgetekend. Waar je terechtkomt Midden in de Veldsink Groep zit onze eigen Data, IT & Development-organisatie met ongeveer 120 collega's. Onze digitale ontwikkeling doen we zelf, wat betekent dat je direct samenwerkt met andere technische disciplines en dicht zit op de mensen die je oplossingen gebruiken. Geen leverancier ertussen, geen ticket dat drie afdelingen verderop belandt. Veldsink begon als familiebedrijf en dat merk je nog steeds: korte lijnen, makkelijk bij elkaar binnenlopen, elkaar kennen. Onze thuisbasis is Nuenen. Thuiswerken kan, maar voor sommige vraagstukken werkt een whiteboard nu eenmaal beter dan nog een Teams-call. Wat we bieden € 4.500 – € 6.000 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur 29 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen pensioen waarvan wij twee derde betalen maximaal twee thuiswerkdagen per week bij 40 uur, inclusief thuiswerkvergoeding reiskostenvergoeding en een fietsplan Veldsink Academy voor je technische en persoonlijke ontwikkeling voordelig sporten en activiteiten met collega's Meer weten? We willen binnen financiële dienstverlening vooroplopen met AI die werkt, verantwoord is en effectief gebruikt wordt. Daar kunnen we veel meer over vertellen dan we in deze tekst kwijt kunnen. Benieuwd wat er achter AI Works zit? Reageer op de vacature of neem contact met mij op. We geven je graag een kijkje in de keuken: onze technische omgeving en de vraagstukken waar we nu aan werken. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

About The Client Our client is an ambitious consulting company helping businesses navigate the opportunities of digital transformation. By combining strategic thinking, technological expertise and a strong understanding of business operations, the company develops practical solutions that improve efficiency, support better decision-making and create long-term business value. With a focus on AI, data and automation, the company works closely with its clients to turn complex challenges into tangible results. Its approach combines strategic advisory with hands-on implementation, ensuring that innovative technologies deliver real value in everyday business operations. Operating in an international environment with an entrepreneurial mindset, the company offers an opportunity to contribute to its continued development while working alongside experienced professionals and decision-makers. About The Role We are looking for two AI Engineers to design, develop and deploy production-ready AI solutions that solve real-world business challenges. You will work across the AI development lifecycle, from building data pipelines and APIs to developing intelligent applications and deploying machine learning models. Depending on your experience and interests, you can focus on AI Applications & RAG or Platform, Backend & MLOps . Both positions offer the opportunity to take ownership of solutions from initial prototype to scalable deployment, working closely with cross-functional teams to build reliable, maintainable and high-performing AI products. We value practical experience and problem-solving skills over formal credentials or years of experience. Whether you have gained your expertise professionally, through open-source contributions, academic projects or substantial personal projects, this is an opportunity to turn your technical skills into impactful AI solutions. Key Responsibilities Develop AI-powered applications: Design, build and maintain applications using Python, LLMs and modern AI frameworks. Build AI data pipelines: Process, extract, structure and enrich unstructured data using LLMs, embeddings and vector search technologies. Develop RAG solutions: Build and maintain retrieval-augmented chatbots, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval workflows and conversational interfaces. Build and maintain APIs: Develop reliable REST APIs that expose AI models and inference logic for applications such as semantic search, similarity matching and recommendations. Implement machine learning models: Prepare data, engineer features, train, evaluate and deploy classification and prediction models. Deploy and operate AI services: Support the full lifecycle of AI solutions, including testing, CI/CD, monitoring, evaluation and ongoing maintenance. Optimize performance and costs: Improve the reliability, scalability, efficiency and cost-effectiveness of AI applications and infrastructure. Collaborate across teams: Work closely with colleagues from different technical and business backgrounds to translate requirements into dependable solutions. About You You are a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and building AI solutions that go beyond prototypes. You combine strong programming fundamentals with a practical understanding of modern AI technologies and are motivated to take ownership of your work from development through deployment and ongoing improvement. You Bring The Following Skills And Experience Approximately 1–3 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering or machine learning, with flexibility for candidates who demonstrate strong practical skills through relevant projects. Strong Python programming skills and a solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control and clean architecture. Practical experience building LLM-powered applications using LangChain, LangGraph or related technologies. A good understanding of embeddings, vector search and their application in AI-powered systems. Experience developing REST APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent framework. A willingness to take ownership of solutions throughout their lifecycle, from initial development to deployment and maintenance. Nous transformons les organisations en créant un impact tangible et durable — non pas en suivant les tendances, mais en les industrialisant à côté de nos clients. Notre conviction : l'IA agentique bien orchestrée permet une accélération massive sur les cycles de livraison. Les organisations qui prendront de l'avance ne seront pas celles qui adopteront l'IA le plus tôt, mais celles qui sauront l'industrialiser avec méthode. C'est exactement ce que nous faisons à travers notre approche du Context Engineering , de notre partenariat avec Anthropic & notre plateforme GenAI RAISE. Nos chiffres clés : 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et à Bruxelles Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du volet Services du Claude Partner Network depuis le 1er juin ! 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, Partner of the Year à plusieurs reprises, et un écosystème de partenaires premium (AWS, Microsoft, Scaleway, S3NS, Databricks, Snowflake, Confluent, dbt…) +90 clients actifs et +5000 personnes formées par an via SFEIR Institute 💫 Qu'est-ce qui nous anime ? 💫 Le point commun de nos Sfeirians, c'est la passion pour la Tech. Notre culture est résolument tournée vers l'excellence technologique, le transfert de compétences et nos valeurs phares : bienveillance, diversité, excellence, liberté, responsabilité. Nous sommes AI-Powered : on utilise RAISE (notre outil interne) et Claude Code au quotidien. Notre partenariat Anthropic te permet d’avoir accès aux outils et certifications avant tout le monde. L’esprit communautaire est dans notre ADN : speakers dans les meetups locaux, présentations mensuelles internes, blog communautaire et des chemins de carrière IC pour grandir en expertise sans quitter le code. 💻 Ce qu’on recherche chez toi Tu n’as pas peur de : ✔ Prompter et parler à des LLMs comme à des collègues, ✔Jongler avec Python, FastAPI, LangChain ou LiteLLM pour intégrer des modèles d’IA, ✔ Penser architecture, orchestration, RAG, diffusion, FinOps et tout le reste, ✔ Expérimenter, documenter, partager, Tu veux comprendre comment ça marche, pas juste consommer. 🛠️ Les projets sur lesquels tu pourrais t’amuser ✔ Construire des APIs GenAI unifiées (texte, image, vidéo, RAG) sur du Google Cloud, ✔ Créer des chatbots spécialisés capables de recommandations 100% perso, ✔ Intégrer des plateformes GenAI chez nos clients et les adapter à leur contexte, ✔ Concevoir des jumeaux numériques pour modéliser le réel, Bref, du concret, pas des PoC qui finissent au placard. ✔ Français & anglais mandatory 🇧🇪 Le "Bruxelles Factor" SFEIR Belgium, c'est une ambiance de start-up avec les reins d'un grand groupe : Une team de +10 devs où tout le monde se connaît. Un Engineering Director ( Renaud Hoyoux ) qui code encore avec toi. Des bureaux stylés sur l’avenue Louise. Une scène tech vivante : talks internes, meetups, afterworks et partage. Le programme AI Champions pour passer au niveau supérieur avec l’IA 🎁 Ce qu'on t'offre Salaire : Basé sur tes skills réels validés aux PlayOffs, notre process de recrutement technique Voiture de société ou budget mobilité. Matos Premium : MacBook Pro ou Dell au choix. Chèque-repas Pluxee et écochèques. Abonnement téléphonique européen. Assurance santé : DKV Hospi 🎯 En pratique Lieu : chez nos clients sur la métropole bruxelloise 🎮 La suite des événements Entretien RH avec Quentin Puis des tests tech en pair-programming (algo, langage, plateforme) notre process est une découverte mutuelle — et tu décides aussi si on est le bon endroit pour toi. On évalue ton raisonnement, ta façon de collaborer et de débloquer des situations — bien au-delà de ce qu'un CV peut dire. Let's go ✌🏻 ! Envoie-nous ton CV ou viens discuter en DM. SFEIR collecte vos données à caractère personnel afin de traiter votre candidature. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. Your Responsibilities Build and Ship AI Agents Design and build agents that automate complex finance workflows. Own features from initial concept and prototype through production deployment. Take responsibility for the production integration rather than handing prototypes to another engineering team. You have practical experience evaluating agents or other non-deterministic AI systems. You understand how to provide agents with the right data and context while respecting security, permissions, and privacy. As an AI Engineer (Software), you will design, build, and ship production-grade software across the full stack, using AI-assisted tooling as standard daily practice alongside your core engineering skills. You will work on real client programs across industries, building production-grade software that connects to and supports agentic AI systems — understanding how your full-stack work integrates with agent architecture, LLM APIs, and enterprise AI pipelines. This is not a stepping-stone role: it is a core engineering function in the most in-demand part of the market, with a direct pathway to the Forward Deployed Engineer program for those who develop agentic depth. We offer what no single product company can: breadth across every industry, every enterprise technology stack, and every level of organizational complexity — combined with vendor fellowship access inside Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google engineering teams, structured AI certification pathways, and a clear development track toward agentic and forward-deployed engineering. Architected intelligence does.
