items.desc: AI Engineer (GenAI & Agentic AI) – Financial Services Workflows International Tech Co Birmingham, UK (Onsite) Full-time Role Overview International Tech Co is hiring hands-on AI Engineers to build enterprise-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions for complex financial-services workflows. You will focus on AI-assisted exception classification, triage, root-cause analysis, impact assessment, workflow orchestration, and remediation across large-scale transaction and data-processing environments. This role requires strong Python, SQL, API, and software-engineering fundamentals, plus practical experience building LLM and agentic AI applications with controls, reliability, and auditability in mind. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities) - Build AI workflows for exception classification, triage, root-cause analysis, impact assessment, and remediation recommendations. - Develop agentic workflows including orchestration, tool/function calling, state management, and human-in-the-loop validation. - Correlate new exceptions with historical issues, known root causes, business rules, and transaction/data attributes. - Build Python and SQL-based services to query, transform, and analyze structured enterprise datasets. - Integrate AI applications with enterprise APIs, databases, workflow/ticketing platforms, and internal data sources. - Develop reusable tools and services that AI agents can invoke for retrieval, investigation, analysis, and workflow execution. - Apply RAG/context retrieval to search regulatory documents, historical knowledge, and issue repositories where needed. - Implement confidence scoring, validation, guardrails, traceability, and audit-ready evidence for AI-generated outcomes. - Build backend services and APIs using Python and FastAPI. - Implement testing, logging, evaluation, observability, exception handling, and production engineering best practices. - Collaborate with AI engineers, architects, business analysts, data engineers, and application teams. Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have) - Strong/expert Python skills with solid software-engineering fundamentals (Git, code quality, testing, production readiness). - Strong SQL and data analysis skills, including complex relational queries and working with structured enterprise datasets. - Strong hands-on experience building GenAI/LLM applications for real workflows (not only demos). - Hands-on experience implementing agentic AI workflows with orchestration, tool/function calling, and state management. - Strong experience building and integrating APIs, including Python/FastAPI services and REST/JSON integrations. - Proven ability to solve ambiguous problems and perform root-cause analysis across data, systems, and process context. Agentic AI Experience (Required) - Hands-on experience with at least one agent/workflow orchestration framework such as LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or an equivalent custom framework. - Ability to implement patterns such as Input → Classification → Tool/Data Retrieval → Investigation → Reasoning → Validation → Action. Data & Integration Experience (Required) - Experience working with structured transaction, event, or operational data in enterprise environments. - Experience integrating across multiple data sources and systems, including workflow/ticketing data and historical issue/event repositories. - Comfort handling incomplete, inconsistent, or changing enterprise data and building resilient correlation logic. GenAI Controls, Safety, and Quality (Required) - Experience implementing confidence-based or known-vs-unknown classification approaches. - Working knowledge of RAG/semantic matching and contextual retrieval. - Working knowledge of LLM/agent evaluation, output validation, and guardrails. - Ability to design deterministic + LLM hybrid workflows with traceability and audit trails. - Familiarity with observability practices for AI systems (logging, metrics, evaluation runs, error analysis). Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have) - Financial-services domain exposure (preferred but not mandatory), including regulatory reporting, capital markets, trade lifecycle, post-trade processing, transaction reporting, reconciliations, exception management, risk, or controls. - Familiarity with regulations such as EMIR, MiFID II, or SFTR. - Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). What Success Looks Like - You rapidly build working prototypes that connect to real enterprise data and systems and then harden them into reliable services. - You produce agentic workflows that are controllable, testable, observable, and safe for enterprise use with human-in-the-loop gates. - You deliver measurable improvements in exception classification accuracy, investigation speed, and remediation consistency with clear auditability. International Tech Co is an equal opportunity employer. Please get in touch on info@projectbrains.io

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 At Roche, we are committed to delivering greater benefits to our patients by applying digital, data, and AI capabilities to real-world operational challenges. The AI Engineer is a senior hands-on technical contributor within the AI Engineering Cluster, responsible for designing, delivering, evaluating, and operating robust AI solutions across Pharma Technical Operations.
 This role owns meaningful parts of end-to-end AI delivery, including solution architecture, data pipelines, machine learning and GenAI systems, agentic workflows, AI evaluation harnesses, backend services, user interfaces, and production operations. The role partners with business, IT, quality, and technical experts to translate complex operational challenges into reliable, scalable, compliant, and measurable AI-enabled products.
 Role description 
 The role is a senior AI engineering role for someone who combines strong technical depth with practical delivery ownership. The AI Engineer is expected to independently lead solution delivery, make sound architectural decisions, mentor other engineers, and ensure AI solutions create measurable business value while meeting reliability, scalability, evaluation, agent management, and compliance expectations.
 AI Solution Leadership & Delivery 
 End-to-end delivery ownership: Own the technical delivery of AI solutions from problem understanding and design through build, deployment, monitoring, evaluation, adoption, and continuous improvement.
 Solution architecture: Design scalable AI application architectures, including data flows, model integration, GenAI orchestration, APIs, user interfaces, agent workflows, and production infrastructure.
 GenAI and agentic AI: Design and implement advanced GenAI solutions, including RAG architectures, multi-step workflows, tool-using agents, LLM orchestration, and evaluation approaches.
 Engineering quality: Apply and help evolve strong engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, observability, documentation, and maintainability.
 Production performance: Ensure AI solutions are reliable, secure, monitored, cost-aware, and continuously improved in production or production-like environments.
 Value delivery: Translate business needs into technical solutions and help define success metrics that demonstrate operational and business impact.
 Modern AI Engineering Capabilities 
 Evaluation framework design: Design and implement data science-driven evaluation frameworks for AI, GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI systems, including offline benchmarks, golden datasets, synthetic test cases, human evaluation workflows, and automated regression testing.
 AI harness development: Own the development of AI engineering harnesses for repeatable experimentation, evaluation, validation, and comparison of models, prompts, retrieval strategies, agent behaviors, and tool integrations.
 Agentic AI solution ownership: Design and deliver production-grade agentic AI systems, including agent orchestration, tool integration, task decomposition, state handling, memory patterns, guardrails, and human escalation paths.
 Agent lifecycle management: Manage deployed agents across their lifecycle, including versioning, testing, release management, monitoring, incident response, continuous improvement, and retirement.
 Performance and risk monitoring: Implement and operate observability for AI systems, including quality metrics, business impact metrics, cost, latency, failure modes, drift, hallucination risk, grounding quality, and operational reliability.
 Model and workflow comparison: Lead structured experiments to compare foundation models, prompts, embeddings, retrieval approaches, orchestration patterns, and agent configurations.
 Technical Expertise 
 AI engineering depth: Apply strong knowledge of machine learning, predictive modeling, time-series, computer vision and multimodal AI, as well as LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI application design.
 Software and platform engineering: Build robust Python-based services, APIs, microservices, dashboards, and integrations using modern software engineering practices.
 Cloud and DevOps: Design and deploy solutions using AWS, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and cloud or hybrid deployment patterns.
 Data engineering: Work with SQL, operational data, time-series data, structured and unstructured data, and data pipelines required for AI products.
 Evaluation methods: Use quantitative metrics, qualitative review, …

items.desc: Why Keyrus, Why Now! Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries , built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills - you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, every deployment that compounds on the last. Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence. Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates . Industrial discipline connects the two. What You'll Architect As an AI Foundation Architect, you will define the technical architecture that enables production AI and agentic systems to operate reliably at enterprise scale. You will define how models, agents, data, applications, APIs, cloud services, security controls, and operational capabilities fit together, and set the architecture principles and boundaries that guide AI Engineers, Software Engineers, Data Engineers, and other technical teams. Within your assigned architecture scope, you are accountable for the integrity of the target design. Depending on the engagement, this may include formal design approval; explicitly define broader enterprise governance authority rather than assume it. Your primary focus is client-facing architecture and technical design. You will also turn successful approaches into reusable Keyrus architecture patterns and standards without automatically owning an internal platform product or roadmap. Your responsibilities Define target architectures for production GenAI and agentic systems, connecting models, agents, enterprise data, applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, security, and operational services. Establish architecture principles, reference patterns, technical boundaries, and non-functional requirements that engineering and delivery teams can apply consistently. Make and document material architecture decisions across platform selection, model access, integration patterns, agent execution, data access, deployment, scalability, resilience, observability, and architecture-level cost. Review solution and engineering designs for architectural integrity, approving material design decisions within the assigned scope where the role has been designated as the architecture authority. Design secure, scalable, and operable foundations for intelligent systems, ensuring that reliability, identity, access, auditability, recovery, maintainability, and human-control requirements are considered from the start. Guide specialist engineering teams without replacing their ownership, working with AI Engineers, Software Engineers, Data Engineers, Governance specialists, and delivery teams on decisions that cross technical domains. Engage with client architecture and technical stakeholders, explaining architecture choices, dependencies, risks, trade-offs, and required decisions in clear technical and business terms. Convert successful architecture decisions into reusable Keyrus assets, including reference architectures, decision records, standards, patterns, and design guidance that can strengthen future engagements. Architecture-level AI FinOps, including model/provider routing, consumption patterns, capacity decisions, and cost optimisation. Who You Are You are an experienced technical architect who combines strategic architecture judgment with recent practical understanding of production AI systems. You can move between the complete system and its individual components without trying to become the implementation owner for every layer, and you know when an architecture decision requires depth and when it requires coordination across specialists. You remain close enough to modern GenAI and agentic engineering to understand how these systems actually behave in production – not only how they appear on an architecture diagram. You are credible with engineers and client architects alike and can explain why an architecture decision matters for security, reliability, scalability, performance, cost, and long-term operability. What You Bring Must Have - Seniority threshold -8+ years designing complex architectures, set locally Strong experience designing and owning architecture for complex production technology environments, with clear accountability for …

Design end-to-end cloud-native solutions leveraging AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, serverless technologies, and microservices architectures. Guide engineering teams on architecture best practices, application modernization, security, performance, and maintainability. Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and consultants to align architecture decisions and support successful delivery. Champion data integration and governance initiatives to support data-driven applications and AI capabilities. Mentor developers and technical leads, promoting engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is a plus. Proven experience designing cloud-native applications using Kubernetes, microservices, serverless technologies, and distributed architectures. Strong architectural design and documentation skills (HLD, LLD, target-state architectures). Working knowledge of modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, Go, or .NET. Hands-on experience designing and deploying generative AI solutions on AWS using Bedrock, SageMaker, and related AI services. Experience building agentic AI workflows using Bedrock Agents, Flows, tool integration, and orchestration frameworks. Understanding of LLM integration, RAG, vector databases, and AI-powered automation in enterprise applications. Experience leading architecture decisions and transitioning solutions from PoC to production. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English. items.desc: We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to design, build and maintain the backend services behind a cloud-based Quality Management System used by Life Sciences companies. This role is suited for a mature, experienced engineer who is comfortable working independently, makes sound technical decisions without close supervision, and uses AI tools as a natural part of daily development. About the Project: Our client is a fully remote SaaS company building a pre-validated Quality Management System for the Life Sciences industry. Their customers make life-saving and life-enhancing products, and the platform helps them manage quality, processes and products while staying compliant with regulatory requirements. You will join a scrum team or a small pod of 2-3 developers, working closely with UI developers, product managers, DevOps engineers and other team leads across several time zones. Go is the team's target backend language. Responsibilities: Design and build scalable backend services with robust REST APIs; Apply Domain-Driven Design and microservice patterns to keep services loosely coupled and aligned with business domains; Write unit and integration tests to keep services reliable in a regulated environment; Look after services across their full lifecycle, including CI/CD, monitoring, diagnostics and maintenance; Collaborate with UI developers, product managers, DevOps and other engineers to deliver complete features; Support junior developers through code reviews and knowledge sharing; Help the team get the most out of AI-assisted development. Qualifications: 5+ years of hands-on backend software development experience; Commercial experience with Go, or some Go knowledge combined with strong Python or TypeScript skills and their web and testing frameworks; Solid understanding of Domain-Driven Design and microservice architecture; Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs, with GraphQL or gRPC experience as a plus; Experience with Kafka, MQTT or SQS, and a good understanding of message bus and queue concepts; Understanding of UI/backend decoupling patterns such as CQRS or BFF, and of frontend patterns like MVVM/MVI; Experience with SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar) and at least one NoSQL store (MongoDB, Elasticsearch or similar); Hands-on Docker and Docker Compose experience, familiarity with basic Kubernetes concepts, and experience with AWS, Azure or GCP; Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or similar) and with logging, distributed tracing and monitoring; Strong unit and integration testing skills, including mocking strategies and secure, failsafe coding practices; Daily use of AI tools as part of your development workflow; Very good written and spoken English; Valid EU work permit. Recruitment Process: Initial interview with our recruitment team; Technical interview with the client; Final decision and offer. The ideal candidate is a seasoned data professional with a passion for performance optimization and an analytical mindset. Advanced expertise in SQL, data modeling, and the Microsoft Azure ecosystem is essential. Contribute to the evolution of a modern cloud-based data architecture, ensuring it meets functional and analytical requirements while supporting future growth. Implement processes and controls to guarantee high data quality, integrity, and efficiency throughout the data lifecycle, fostering trust in data-driven decisions. Collaborate closely with software developers and product managers to seamlessly integrate data solutions into the broader application ecosystem, enhancing overall product functionality. Advanced expertise in designing and managing data solutions within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem, including services like Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, and SQL Databases, ensuring effective cloud-based operations. Familiarity with development and operations practices, including performance tuning, CI/CD, Agile methodology, and version control systems like Git, ensuring streamlined workflows. items.desc: Senior AI Engineer / Agentic AI Consultant – Build the Future of Intelligent Systems Location: Gothenburg (on site 3 days a week) Company: Boutique Consultancy (Confidential) Salary: Competitive + Ownership Opportunity Job type: Full-time permanent employment Are you the kind of person who spends your evenings experimenting with LangGraph, AutoGen, MCPs, agent frameworks, local LLMs or the latest breakthroughs in Agentic AI—simply because you find it fascinating? Do you get excited about building systems that don't just answer questions, but reason, collaborate, make decisions and solve problems autonomously? If that's you, keep reading. Why This Role Is Different We are partnering with a highly respected boutique consultancy that sits at the intersection of AI, Data, Engineering and Organisational Change . Founded by an industry leader with a long track record of delivering business-critical projects, the company has grown organically through trust, expertise and long-term partnerships—not sales targets. Today, they are a tight-knit team of just eight specialists. Over the next 12 months they plan to double in size, creating a rare opportunity to join at an early stage and have a genuine influence on the company's future direction. Their flagship engagement is with one of the Nordics' most recognised telecom organisations, delivering mission-critical projects within national security and military infrastructure . The Opportunity You'll join a small, highly capable team working on advanced data and AI initiatives for a strategically important customer. This isn't a role where you'll spend your days building PowerPoints or sitting in endless meetings. Instead, you'll have the autonomy to: ✅ Design and build intelligent AI solutions ✅ Explore and implement modern Agentic AI architectures ✅ Work directly with senior stakeholders ✅ Mentor and share knowledge with colleagues ✅ Take ownership of critical projects from concept to deployment ✅ Influence how AI is adopted within large-scale enterprise environments The team values curiosity, independent thinking and people who genuinely enjoy learning. Who We Think Will Thrive Here We're looking for someone who combines deep technical capability with genuine enthusiasm for AI. The ideal person is likely someone who: Has hands-on experience building AI/ML solutions in production Actively follows developments in Agentic AI, LLMs and autonomous systems Experiments with new technologies outside of work Enjoys solving complex problems simply because they're interesting Is collaborative, approachable and enjoys mentoring others Can make decisions and take ownership without excessive bureaucracy Values learning over ego Fluency in Swedish Bonus points if you've worked within Telecom, Connectivity, Infrastructure or mission-critical environments. And culturally? We're looking for the person who gets excited about a new AI framework, enjoys a deep technical discussion, and probably has a board game collection or a Steam library that's slightly out of control (I'm more a PS4 girl personally, but whatever your preferences are!). What You'll Get In Return 🌟 Stability Rarely Seen in Consulting The founder has maintained a major client relationship for over 15 years, consistently retaining projects through changing market conditions, organisational restructures and consultant reductions. 📈 Real Career Growth Join while the company is still small enough for your contribution to have a visible impact. Work directly with leadership and benefit from an exceptionally short feedback loop. 🧠 A Learning-First Culture Knowledge sharing isn't encouraged—it's expected. You'll be surrounded by people who enjoy teaching, mentoring and exploring new ideas together. 🏖️ Exceptional Team Experiences Recent company gatherings have included bringing the entire team together in a private Spanish villa with a personal chef, combining focused collaboration with unforgettable experiences. 💰 Ownership & Wealth Creation The company is establishing an employee ownership structure, allowing consultants to become part-owners and share in future success. Employees will also receive guidance on investing, fund management and long-term wealth creation—helping you build more than just a career. Sound Like You? If you're someone who regularly finds yourself reading AI research papers, building side projects, experimenting with agent frameworks at weekends or discussing the future of AI over a board game and a coffee, we'd love to speak with you. Apply now to learn more about this unique opportunity. items.desc: Contribuez aux grandes transformations des entreprises et des acteurs publics en alliant innovation technologique et expertise métier, au service de nos clients et de la société pour les faire avancer durablement. Au-delà de la RSE, nous avons développé notre propre approche, RESET, qui englobe l’ensemble de nos engagements en matière de responsabilité économique, sociale, environnementale et technologique, tant au sein de notre collectif que chez nos clients. Onepoint, est une entreprise inclusive, handi accueillante, avec une politique de diversité affirmée. Vos nouveaux challenges pour ce poste : Dans le cadre du développement de notre centre national de compétences AWS, nous renforçons nos équipes et recherchons un profil AI Engineer AWS F/H pour accompagner nos clients dans la conception, l'automatisation et l'exploitation de plateformes cloud modernes. En tant qu'AI Engineer AWS, vous concevez, développez et industrialisez des systèmes reposant sur l'interaction avec des modèles de langage (LLM), au sein d'architectures serverless AWS. Vous êtes le référent technique des briques GenAI que vous livrez : de la structuration de l'agent jusqu'à sa mise en production, dans un cadre exigeant en performance, en coût et en fiabilité. Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : Vous créez des agents capables de répondre à un ensemble de questions métiers, en traduisant un besoin fonctionnel en architecture d'agent, d'outils et de sources de connaissances. Vous développez les outils permettant de requêter intelligemment une base de connaissances (RAG). Vous mettez en place les méthodes qui rendent un agent réellement exploitable en contexte industriel : gestion avancée de la mémoire, optimisation des requêtes RAG, structuration des outils, intégration des connaissances métiers par prompt engineering, maîtrise de la latence et du coût par requête. Vous concevez et développez les composants associés : Amazon Bedrock (Knowledge Bases, Model Provider, Guardrails), Amazon Bedrock Agentcore (Runtime, Gateway, Observability), en intégrant dès la conception les contraintes propres à une architecture serverless. Vous évaluez vos systèmes (jeux de tests, métriques de pertinence, non-régression), instrumentez l'observabilité et fiabilisez le déploiement via l'Infrastructure as Code et le CI/CD. Vous diffusez les bonnes pratiques au sein de la communauté technique, contribuez à nos assets réutilisables et intervenez en appui des équipes sur les sujets GenAI. Votre palette technique: Socle Core Maîtrise de Python et des patterns Software Engineering (Clean Code, tests, Design Patterns, CI/CD) Maîtrise de SQL Écosystème AWS Amazon Bedrock : Agentcore, Knowledge Bases, choix et paramétrage des modèles Serverless : Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, Step Functions Sécurité et exploitation : IAM, CloudWatch Infrastructure as Code : CDK, Terraform ou CloudFormation GenAI et agents Conception d'agents et d'outils, orchestration (Bedrock Agentcore, LangChain, LlamaIndex ou équivalent) RAG : stratégies de chunking, embeddings, recherche hybride, reranking, text-to-SQL Stratégies d'optimisation : prompt engineering, gestion de la mémoire, arbitrages qualité / latence / coût Industrialisation et évaluation Évaluation des systèmes LLM (Ragas, LangSmith, jeux de tests métiers) et logique LLMOps Vector stores : OpenSearch, Aurora pgvector ou Pinecone Une certification AWS (AI Practitioner, Solutions Architect) est un atout apprécié. Votre profil et les expertises que vous souhaitez développer : Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle ou Data Scientist dont une expérience significative de mise en production de systèmes à base de LLM sur AWS. Vous portez une brique complexe de bout en bout, du cadrage avec le métier jusqu'à l'exploitation, et vous savez défendre vos arbitrages techniques. Vous mesurez votre réussite à la stabilité en production, à maintenir un système, à la pertinence mesurée des réponses et à la clarté de votre code. Vous collaborez naturellement avec les architectes, Product Owners et équipes IT clientes, et vous savez vulgariser des sujets techniques complexes auprès d'interlocuteurs métiers. Notre processus de recrutement : 1er échange avec Vanessa ou Chloé ou Grégory: échange sur vos souhaits et motivations, et présentation de l'entreprise (durée : 1 heure, Teams ou présentiel) 2ème échange avec un expert ou une experte technique : questions techniques et descriptif de nos projets (durée : 1 heure, Teams ou présentiel) 3e échange avec un ou une partenaire en fonction du poste : projection sur votre rôle au sein de Onepoint (durée : 1 heure, Teams ou présentiel) Onepoint en quelques mots Créée en 2002 par David Layani, Onepoint est devenu en un peu plus de 20 ans l’un des acteurs majeurs du conseil et de la tech, notre collectif compte aujourd’hui plus de 4000 talents en France (Aix-en-Provence, Bordeaux, Lyon, Nantes, Paris, Rennes, Strasbourg et Toulouse) et dans le monde (Australie, Belgique, …

Job Description Design and maintain scalable data solutions that support AI applications and advanced analytics. Build and optimize semantic data models, ensuring high-quality, trusted metrics for business and AI consumption. Develop integrations between data platforms, semantic layers, and AI-powered solutions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into reliable data products. Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field. 5+ years of experience in senior Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related data-focused roles. Strong hands-on experience with modern data platforms, including Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Databricks Apps) and Google Cloud Platform services such as BigQuery, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, and Vertex AI. Solid expertise in Python for advanced data engineering, API development (FastAPI), and integration with LLM frameworks such as LangChain or Anthropic. Experience building and leveraging semantic layers and metric definitions to support advanced analytics, SQL workloads, and AI-powered applications. Strong understanding of causal inference techniques, including Difference-in-Differences (DiD), Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD), Instrumental Variables (IV), and modern Causal ML frameworks. Experience working with Generative AI solutions, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and evaluating LLM outputs. Good understanding of data governance, identity and access management (IAM), and secure data architecture principles. Proven ability to lead technical initiatives, mentor engineering teams, and influence architectural decisions across multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences. items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI
items.card: What you'll doAdvise on AI trust and governance. Lead workshops that help clients understand and take control of their AI landscape — agents, copilots, models, and the data behind them, including the shadow AI they didn't know about. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO
items.desc: Enterprises are adopting AI faster than they can govern it — and they are looking for a partner who can do two things at once: speak credibly about AI trust, governance, and security, and actually build. The Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) is that partner. You are the technical face of AvePoint inside client organizations: equally comfortable whiteboarding AI trust and governance concepts with a CISO, translating a business problem into a scoped AI build project, and writing the first working prototype yourself. You embed with clients, ship real outcomes, and own the engagement end to end. This is not a pre-sales role with a demo script, and not a back-office delivery role. It is the engagement model pioneered by leading AI companies for their strategic enterprise customers: a senior engineer deployed forward, with the autonomy to own the problem from first workshop to production. What you'll doAdvise on AI trust and governance. Lead workshops that help clients understand and take control of their AI landscape — agents, copilots, models, and the data behind them, including the shadow AI they didn't know about. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO 42001, and help them stand up practical operating models: AI inventories, approval workflows, risk classification, and audit evidence. Scope and shape AI build projects. Sit with business stakeholders to understand the underlying need behind "we want AI for X." Identify the highest-value use cases, define success criteria, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, estimable technical scopes — architecture outlines, data and integration requirements, delivery phases, effort and risk assessments. Write statements of work that engineering teams can actually deliver and clients can actually sign. Build and deliver. Develop prototypes and production components for client AI solutions: agent workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Anthropic), MCP-based tool integrations, and the governance and security controls around them. Deliver custom adapters and local tooling for regulated, cloud-restricted, or air-gapped environments where standard SaaS approaches cannot go. Own the relationship through delivery. Act as the trusted technical advisor from first workshop through go-live: run enablement sessions, support adoption, troubleshoot in production, and expand the engagement where you see genuine value for the client. What we're looking forMust-haves 5+ years in software engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting, with at least 2 years hands-on with modern AI/LLM systems in real projects (not only experimentation). Practical experience building with LLM APIs and frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, LangChain, Semantic Kernel) and patterns such as RAG, agentic workflows, and tool/function calling. Machine Learning Expertise: Hands-on machine learning experience spanning model development, evaluation, deployment, and operationalization, with a focus on enterprise AI solutions, predictive analytics, and scalable MLOps practices. Strong programming skills in Python and/or C#/TypeScript, plus working fluency with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including identity, networking, and data services. Demonstrated ability to scope technical projects from ambiguous business requirements: you can run a requirements workshop, challenge assumptions constructively, and produce a credible plan with phases, estimates, and risks. Excellent communication in front of senior stakeholders — you can explain why AI governance matters to a board member and debate vector database trade-offs with a platform engineer in the same meeting. Willingness to travel to client sites and to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving engagements. Strong pluses Working knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks: EU AI Act, NIS2, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, or Gartner's AI TRiSM model. Experience with AI security topics: prompt injection, data leakage, agent permissioning, model and data security posture (AI-SPM/DSPM concepts). Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent runtimes, or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma). Background in enterprise data governance, security, backup/resilience, or the Microsoft 365 / multi-cloud ecosystem where AvePoint operates. Experience delivering into regulated industries (public sector, defense, financial services, healthcare) or air-gapped/sovereign environments. Prior experience in a forward-deployed, embedded consulting, or customer-facing engineering role. Additional languages relevant to your region's client base. How we'll measure success Within your first 6–12 months, you will have led AI discovery and governance workshops for multiple enterprise clients, scoped and …

items.desc:
Job Title
Software Development Engineer 
 Job Description
 Software Development Engineer 
 Design, build and deliver cloud-native, FHIR-based diagnostic reporting applications, including responsibly integrated GenAI capabilities, that help clinicians make faster, more confident decisions.
 Your role: 
 You will be involved in the next generation of cloud-native and FHIR-based integrated diagnostics reporting applications, including the responsible use of GenAI to automate manual clinical workflows and help clinicians reach faster and more confident decisions. You are responsible for the design, implementation, integration, deployment and testing of software components and services to a high standard of quality, according to requirements and on time, while translating market and clinical needs into implementation requirements with the overall solution in mind.
 You will work as a member of an agile team, together with product owners, users, clinical domain experts, architects and other teams contributing to the same solution. You will collaborate on technical design and implementation with architects and partner teams, align with the team's software development professionalism standards (processes, quality of requirements, design, coding and testing), and contribute to a collaborative, open and high-quality engineering culture.
 You will work with state-of-the-art technologies and practices in cloud, healthcare interoperability, GenAI and AI-assisted software development, and stay abreast of technical developments through literature, courses and trainings, and technical contacts. You will deepen your expertise in digital diagnostics, healthcare interoperability and responsible AI.
 You're the right fit if: 
 You hold a Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent (including other technical or scientific disciplines combined with demonstrated software engineering experience). A postgraduate qualification in software technology (Master's, Engineering Doctorate or PhD) is preferred.
 You have a minimum of 5 years of experience with a Bachelor's in areas such as Software Development, Software Design and Architecture, Testing and Quality Assurance or equivalent, OR a minimum of 2 years of experience with a Master's or postgraduate degree in a software-related field.
 You have a proven track record of building and delivering production-grade back-end services, from design and implementation through testing and release, in collaboration with platform and operations teams.
 You have experience working in regulated or data-sensitive environments (e.g. healthcare, medical devices, finance), where quality, security and compliance shape the way software is built.
 You have hands-on experience delivering GenAI capabilities beyond proof of concept in production or near-production environments, including LLM integration, RAG and agentic workflows. You understand evaluation, grounding, validation and safeguards required for responsible use in clinical or other regulated settings.
 You have strong back-end development skills in Java and/or Python, API design skills, and hands-on experience integrating HL7 FHIR APIs and data models. Experience with Clinical Quality Language (CQL) is preferred.
 You are familiar with cloud-native application environments, containers and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with Azure or AWS is preferred.
 Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms such as Apache Kafka is preferred.
 You apply solid engineering practices such as Domain-Driven Design, test-driven development and secure coding, and you work comfortably in Agile/Scrum teams, refining requirements with product owners, users and domain experts.
 You communicate clearly and collaborate across teams and locations.
 Compensation & benefits 
 Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base annual salary range for this role is €61,185.00 – €101,976.00. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. This role is eligible for short-term incentive, with your rewards linked to both KPIs and company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision. Benefits include:
 A flexible and collaborative way of working: work in an environment that values both in-person collaboration and the flexibility to balance work and your personal commitments.
 25 holidays and excellent leave arrangements: enjoy 25 holidays on full time basis, the option to purchase additional leave and a wide range of family-friendly and life-stage leave arrangements.
 Health and wellbeing support: join a company that is dedicated to improving lives and supports your physical, mental and financial wellbeing through a broad …

items.desc: Where: 100% Remote Type: Full-time, via our employer of record About MarketFully Group We've combined four established companies - MotionPoint, Key Content, GetGloby, and Social Element - into one company: MarketFully. MarketFully pairs AI technology with real human expertise to help brands create, adapt, and distribute content that reaches the right people in the right way. The result: stronger connections with global audiences, more engaged communities, and better visibility - all leading to marketing results you can actually measure. The role We are looking for a Salesforce Admin who is passionate about driving business outcomes as they are about building smart, scalable solutions whether through configuration, automation, or code when needed. In this role, you'll seek to understand how our business works, collaborate with stakeholders to translate real needs into thoughtful Salesforce solutions, and avoid over-engineering in favor of pragmatic, scalable improvements. You'll be a key partner in helping our internal teams work smarter and faster leveraging Salesforce, automation, and AI. When solutions show measurable impact internally, you'll help us explore how to bring those capabilities to our customers as well. This is a senior, high-autonomy role. The Operations leadership team sets priorities based on business impact and you'll be trusted to independently design, build, and execute the Salesforce solution itself, without technical guidance from leadership on how to get there. This role requires someone who is curious, grounded, strategic, and able to effectively manage competing requests from across the organization while working with leadership to prioritize based on business impact. items.desc: Contribuez aux grandes transformations des entreprises et des acteurs publics en alliant innovation technologique et expertise métier, au service de nos clients et de la société pour les faire avancer durablement. Au-delà de la RSE, nous avons développé notre propre approche, RESET, qui englobe l’ensemble de nos engagements en matière de responsabilité économique, sociale, environnementale et technologique, tant au sein de notre collectif que chez nos clients. Onepoint, est une entreprise inclusive, handi accueillante, avec une politique de diversité affirmée. Votre futur collectif Au sein de Creative Tech & Design, collectif de 900 talents orienté technologies et innovations, nous intervenons sur toute la chaîne de valeur associée aux transformations numériques de nos clients. Nous croyons que l’IA agentique ne se pilote pas depuis un slide, elle se déploie au contact du terrain. En tant que Forward Deployed Engineer Agentic AI, vous serez l’ingénieur que nous envoyons chez le client pour faire passer un cas d’usage de l’idée à la production en quelques semaines plutôt qu’en quelques mois en combinant une expertise solide en ingénierie logicielle avec une maîtrise des agents et outils d’IA générative. Votre mission : Vous embarquez directement dans les équipes de nos clients, vous identifiez avec eux le bon problème à résoudre avec l’IA, et vous livrez une solution agentique robuste et exploitable en production du prototypage à la mise en exploitation, en passant par l’industrialisation et le transfert de compétences. Ce poste s’inscrit dans le déploiement d’un référentiel interne d’ingénierie accélérée par l’IA (méthodes, accélérateurs, outillage agentique) que nous appliquons en mission chez nos clients, quel que soit leur fournisseur cloud ou leur plateforme d’agents. Votre rôle au quotidien Être en mission auprès de nos clients Vous êtes déployé dans les équipes du client (sur site ou hybride) pour des missions de quelques semaines à quelques mois, avec un haut niveau d’autonomie et de responsabilité sur la livraison. Vous cadrez le problème avec les équipes métier et engineering du client avant de coder : entretiens, observation du terrain, analyse des contraintes réelles (données, systèmes existants, usages) pour éviter de construire la bonne solution au mauvais problème. Vous travaillez en équipe resserrée et pluridisciplinaire (ingénieur, expert IA, profil produit/métier) plutôt qu’en grande équipe séquentielle l’objectif est de livrer du code de production en jours ou semaines, pas en mois. Construire des systèmes agentiques en production Concevoir, développer et déployer des agents et workflows IA robustes, sécurisés et exploitables (orchestration multi-agents, function calling, RAG, protocole MCP pour le branchement d’outils et de serveurs) au service de l’automatisation de processus métier concrets. Adopter une approche structurée de type recherche → plan → implémentation → revue : explorer le code et les contraintes existantes avant de coder, documenter un plan d’implémentation validable, livrer par incréments vérifiés plutôt que par gros blocs non vérifiés. Cadrer avec le client le niveau d’autonomie pertinent pour chaque agent (validation humaine à chaque étape, supervision a posteriori, ou autonomie complète sous garde-fous) selon la criticité du processus métier concerné. Outiller l’équipe et le client : custom agents, prompts et instructions réutilisables, skills, et concevoir les dispositifs d’évaluation (evals) et de garde-fous (guardrails) qui rendent les agents observables et mesurables en production. Assurer la qualité du code via tests automatisés, revue de code assistée par IA, et validation systématique des sorties des agents — un agent qui fonctionne en démo n’est pas un agent prêt pour la production. Intégrer les solutions aux systèmes d’information existants du client via API et microservices (cloud, CI/CD, Kubernetes/Docker) et appliquer les principes de sécurité (OWASP, gestion des secrets, isolation des environnements). Capitaliser et transmettre Documenter les patterns réutilisables (accélérateurs, prompts, architectures de référence) pour accélérer les missions suivantes, chez ce client comme chez d’autres. Faire remonter le retour terrain (limites des modèles, frictions outillage) aux équipes internes pour faire évoluer nos méthodes et notre outillage agentique. Accompagner la montée en compétence des équipes client pour qu’elles puissent reprendre la main sur la solution livrée. Assurer une veille technologique constante (LLM, agents, protocole MCP, frameworks d’orchestration) et partager ses connaissances au sein du collectif. Expertises IA agentique IDE et agents de code : pratique quotidienne d’outils agentiques (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Antigravity, Kiro…). Frameworks d’orchestration : conception de workflows multi-agents (LangChain, LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework). Personnalisation : configuration d’instructions, règles et …

C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: C3 AI As a Forward Deployed Engineer , you will be engineering full-stack AI-driven web applications on the C3 AI Platform, working directly with customers to design, develop, and deploy production applications, demos, and proofs-of-technology. An ideal candidate possesses strategic and analytical aptitude, software development expertise, and excellent interpersonal skills. You will work with some of the largest and most demanding organisations on the planet to build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise applications. You will work directly with data scientists, software engineers, and subject matter experts to define new analytics capabilities that give our customers the information they need to make decisions under pressure and accelerate their digital transformation. This is a frontline role on some of the most consequential AI programmes in UK and European defence today. You will help design and deploy AI that keeps aircraft and platforms mission-ready through predictive maintenance, that sharpens decision-making through Digital Targeting, and that sustains operations through logistics in contested and degraded environments. These are live programmes with real operational stakes, delivered into demanding, secure settings across the UK MOD, NATO, and allied European partners. This role supports defence programmes that require UK Security Clearance. Candidates must hold, or be able to obtain and maintain, [SC / NATO] clearance. Eligibility is set by the contracting authority and typically requires a minimum of five years’ continuous UK residence. Responsibilities Develop and deploy applications. Engineer full-stack, AI-based enterprise applications on the C3 AI Platform. Mentor junior team members. Share coding standards and design techniques with less experienced engineers. Conduct design and code reviews. Review customer software applications for quality, architecture, and best practices. Test and enhance customer applications. Troubleshoot, test, and improve customer software applications directly and on behalf of customers. Deliver technical enablement. Lead technical deep-dives, product demonstrations, and customer training sessions. Write documentation. Produce application specifications, technical documentation, and supporting artifacts. Identify and mitigate risk. Continuously surface technical risks and gaps; devise mitigation strategies in anticipation of customer needs. Drive product improvement. Work closely with product management and engineering to improve the overall quality of C3 AI software. Qualifications MSc or Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or a comparable area of study. 5+ years of professional software development experience with object-oriented programming languages. Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to work effectively on a cross-functional team. Analytical, problem-solving abilities, organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to travel as needed. Preferred Qualifications PhD in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or a comparable area of study. Experience deploying enterprise-scale applications. Proficient Software development expertise with JavaScript and Python. Proficient with Git or other version control software. Experience working with JavaScript frameworks such as React, Redux, Vue, Backbone, or Angular. C3 AI provides excellent benefits, a competitive compensation package and generous equity plan. C3 AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status.

items.desc: About Elixirr Elixirr International plc is a global consulting firm with a bold ambition: to become the best consulting firm in the world. Founded in 2009 to challenge a declining industry standard, we’ve grown from a single vision into a powerhouse of entrepreneurial talent, delivering boardroom strategy through to execution. After IPO-ing on AIM in July 2020, Elixirr moved to the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange in July 2025. In that time, our market cap has grown from £98 million to over £350 million – a testament to our differentiated approach and relentless pursuit of excellence. With a presence across the UK, US, EU, and South Africa, and a client base spanning industries and geographies, we’ve welcomed seven boutique firms into the Group. This has broadened our capabilities across creative, digital marketing, data and AI, procurement, transformation, and more. Our vision of becoming a services unicorn is firmly within reach – and this is just the beginning. We’re looking for exceptional talent to join us on this exciting growth journey and shape the future of consulting. Location You will be based in London. Our headquarters are in Central London. It’s where it all began for us and continues to be a hub of innovation and growth. Job Summary Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are the people we put in the room when a problem is ambiguous, the data is messy, and a working solution needs to exist in weeks, not quarters. As an FDE at Elixirr, you will embed with our delivery teams and internal functions to go from idea to working prototype, and to build the internal tools and agents that accelerate how Elixirr itself delivers. We’ve deliberately modelled this role on how the category is defined in the market — pioneered at Palantir and scaled by firms like OpenAI. An FDE is a hybrid of technical lead, consultant and product manager: someone who writes production-quality code, but is just as comfortable sitting with users, understanding how decisions actually get made, and stress-testing a prototype in the field. Business acumen is not a bonus here — it is core to the job. An important scope point: this role is focused on idea-to-prototype and on building internal solutions that make Elixirr faster and better. A separate, dedicated team owns productionization into enterprise-grade software. You will work closely with them — and hand over cleanly — but the core of your job is learning fast, building fast, and proving value. Key Responsibilities Embed With Delivery Teams and Internal Functions Deploy into Elixirr delivery teams and internal functions to identify the highest-leverage AI opportunities inside real workflows. Sit with consultants, operators and end users to understand how decisions are actually made — then design around what you see, not what was described in a deck. Translate ambiguous business problems into concrete agentic solutions with clear success metrics and an honest view of the business case. Idea to Prototype, Fast Take ideas from napkin to working prototype in days, not quarters. Design, build and demo agents and agentic applications that execute real work — document processing, research, analysis, operational automations, internal copilots, workflow accelerators. Use modern agent frameworks and tooling (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, MCP, A2A) pragmatically — pick the simplest thing that works. Instrument prototypes properly from day one: traces, evaluations, cost, latency and user feedback so decisions are grounded in data, not demos. Build Internal Solutions That Compound Ship internal agents and tools that measurably accelerate how Elixirr delivers — from research and analysis to proposal shaping, document production and operational tasks. Extract reusable components, patterns and accelerators from each engagement back into Elixirr’s internal platform so the next team starts further up the curve. Run tight feedback loops with the consultants and operators using what you build, and iterate aggressively on what’s actually useful. Hand Off to Production, Cleanly Partner with Elixirr’s production engineering team when a prototype earns the right to become enterprise-grade software. Package prototypes for handover: clear documentation, evals, architectural notes and known limitations — so the production team can industrialize quickly and safely. Stay engaged as a subject matter expert during productionization without becoming the bottleneck. Business Acumen and Client Presence Understand the economics of what you build — where value is created, where cost sits, and what a realistic adoption path looks like inside a real organization. Navigate security, compliance, change management and data realities without using them as reasons to slow down. Be the trusted technical voice leaders turn to when they want to know whether something is real or a demo — and say so honestly, either way. Where engagements are client-facing, engage credibly with senior client …

items.desc: Talan Data x AI is a leading Data Management and Analytics consultancy, working closely with leading software vendors and top industry experts across a range of sectors, unlocking value and insight from their data. At Talan Data x AI, innovation is at the heart of our client offerings, and we help companies to further improve their efficiency with modern processes and technologies, such as Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI). Job Description As our AI practice scales, we are seeking an experienced AI Architect / Engineer to act as the senior technical authority shaping how we design and deliver next-generation AI solutions. This is a role for someone who has moved beyond building individual models to architecting entire systems: agentic platforms, LLM-powered applications, and the production infrastructure that makes them dependable at enterprise scale. You will sit at the intersection of strategy and delivery, operating across multiple client engagements simultaneously. In the early phases you will shape solutions, validate technical approaches, and translate ambiguous business problems into robust, deployable architectures. As engagements mature, you will provide the technical oversight that keeps delivery teams aligned to the original design intent. Your influence will be felt in pre-sales conversations, solution blueprints, and the technical standards that define how our practice builds. This is a hands on architectural role, not a purely advisory one. We expect you to remain close to the code, to prototype where it accelerates a decision, and to set a credible technical example for the engineers and data scientists you guide. Required skills & experience: Lead end-to-end solution architecture for AI and LLM-based systems, spanning data, integration, infrastructure, and deployment. Design agentic architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns, defining how LLMs, tools, APIs, and retrieval layers interact reliably. Shape early-stage engagements (scoping, solutioning, estimation, and pre-sales) turning client ambition into deliverable technical plans. Provide technical validation and quality oversight across several concurrent projects, mitigating risk before it reaches delivery. Define LLM integration and prompting strategies, including RAG, fine-tuning, evaluation, and guardrailing approaches. Establish MLOps and LLMOps practices that ensure solutions are observable, testable, and production ready. Set architectural standards, reusable patterns, and reference implementations that raise the quality bar across the practice. Partner with Responsible AI colleagues to embed safety, security, and governance into solution designs from the outset. Qualifications To qualify for this role, you must have: Minimum 5 years in AI architecture or AI engineering, ideally 10+, with a track record of production deployments. Deep expertise in LLMs, agent frameworks (e.g. LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel), API design, and orchestration. Strong cloud engineering experience. Proven MLOps / LLMOps capability — CI/CD for models, monitoring, evaluation, and cost optimisation. Hands-on software engineering background (Python and modern tooling) underpinning your architectural decisions. Comfort managing multiple engagements at once, with pragmatic judgement on trade-offs and delivery risk. Ideally, you’ll also have, but not essential: Experience in consulting, professional services, or pre-sales environments. Exposure to enterprise-scale, regulated AI deployments (financial services, public sector, healthcare). Familiarity with vector databases, knowledge graphs, and advanced retrieval techniques. Relevant cloud or AI certifications. You must be: Willing to work on client sites, potentially for extended periods. Willing to travel for work purposes and be happy to stay away from home for extended periods. Eligible to work in the UK without restriction. #TalanUK Additional Information Compensation & Benefits Package: BDP Plus – A reward programme whereby you accrue points to trade against a 3-month paid sabbatical or cash equivalent. 25 days holiday + bank holidays. 5 days holiday buy/sell option. Private medical insurance. Life cover. Cycle to work scheme. Eligibility for company pension scheme (5% employer contribution, salary sacrifice option). Employee assistance programme. Bespoke online learning via Udemy for Business. Why join: You will be a founding technical voice in a practice that is investing decisively in AI. The work is varied, intellectually demanding, and commercially significant, you will shape solutions that reach production, not slideware. You will have the autonomy to define how we build, the support of a collaborative multidisciplinary team, and a clear platform to grow into a practice-leading technical figure.
